Translation: 固定营业场所的维护若专门用于子段落a]至e]所述任何活动的组合，并且该固定营业场所由此类组合产生的经营活动整体性质具有预备性或辅助性，则适用本规定。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , where a person C other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies -- is acting on behalf of an enterprise and has , and habitually exercises , in a Contracting State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in that State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise , unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 尽管第1款和第2款有相关规定，除第6款所指的独立代理人以外的其他人为某企业履行职责，并在缔约国境内以该企业名义通常行使缔结合同的权力时，该企业应被视为在该国设有常设机构，负责该人所从事的各项活动。但若该人的活动仅限于第4款所列情形，则不适用此规定——因为根据该款规定，若此类活动通过固定场所进行，该固定场所本身亦不会构成常设机构。

Query_Text_en: 6 . An enterprise of a Contracting State shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that other State through a broker , general commission agent or any other agent of an independent status , provided that such persons are acting in the ordinary course of their business .
Translation: 一缔约国的企业，仅因其通过经纪人、一般佣金代理人或其他具有独立地位的代理人，在另一缔约国从事经营活动，不应视为在该另一国构成常设机构。但上述人员须在其常规业务范围内进行此类活动。

Query_Text_en: However , when the activities of such an agent are devoted wholly or almost wholly on behalf of that enterprise , he will not be considered an agent of an independent status within the meaning of this paragraph .
Translation: 然而，当此类代理人的活动完全或几乎完全代表该企业进行时，根据本段规定，其将不被视为具有独立地位的代理人。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The fact that a company which is a resident of a Contracting State controls or is controlled by a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State , or which carries on business in that other State [ whether through a permanent establishment or otherwise ] , shall not of itself constitute either company a permanent establishment of the other .
Translation: 缔约国一方的居民公司直接或间接控制或被缔约国另一方的居民公司控制，或者在另一缔约国从事营业活动（无论是通过常设机构或其他方式），不应仅凭此事实构成任何一方公司为另一方国家的常设机构。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from immovable property [ including income from agriculture or forestry ] situated in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民因位于另一缔约国境内的不动产（包括农业或林业所得）而取得的所得，可以在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The term immovable property shall have the meaning which it has under the law of the Contracting State in which the property in question is situated .
Translation: 不动产一词应具有该财产所在地的缔约国法律所规定的含义。

Query_Text_en: The term shall in any case include property accessory to immovable property , livestock and equipment used in agriculture and forestry , rights to which the provisions of general law respecting landed property apply , usufruct of immovable property and rights to variable or fixed payments as consideration for the working of , or the right to work , mineral deposits , sources and other natural resources .
Translation: 本术语应包括附属不动产的财产、农业和林业中使用的牲畜及设备、适用有关土地财产一般法律规定之权利、不动产用益权，以及因开发矿藏、水源及其他自然资源或享有其开采权而获得可变或固定支付款项的权利。

Query_Text_en: Ships and aircraft shall not be regarded as immovable property .
Translation: 船舶和航空器不得视为不动产。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The profits of an enterprise of a Contracting State shall be taxable only in that State unless the enterprise carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业所获得的利润，应仅在该国征税，除非该企业在另一缔约国通过设在其中的常设机构进行营业。

Query_Text_en: If the enterprise carries on business as a foresaid , the profits of the enterprise may be taxed in the other State , but only so much of them as is attributable to that permanent establishment .
Translation: 如果该企业从事上述业务活动，另一国可对该企业的利润征税，但仅限于归属于该常设机构的那一部分利润。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In determining the profits of a permanent establishment , there shall be allowed as deductions expenses which are incurred for the purposes of the business of the permanent establishment , including executive and general administrative expenses so incurred , whether in the State in which the permanent establishment is situated or elsewhere .
Translation: 在确定常设机构的利润时，凡与该常设机构业务有关的费用，包括上述业务中发生的管理费用和一般行政性费用，无论发生在该常设机构所在国境内还是境外，均准予扣除。

Query_Text_en: This provision shall apply subject to limitations under the domestic law .
Translation: 本条款的适用应受国内法限制。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Insofar as it has been customary in a Contracting State to determine the profits to be attributed to a permanent establishment on the basis of an apportionment of the total profits of the enterprise to its various parts , nothing in paragraph 2 shall preclude that Contracting State from determining the profits to be taxed by such an apportionment as may be customary .
Translation: 在缔约国习惯于根据企业总利润分摊至其各部分的情况确定应归属于常设机构的利润时，本条第2款的规定不得妨碍该缔约国继续采用此种分摊方法来确定应税利润。

Query_Text_en: The method of apportionment adopted shall , however , be such that the result shall be in accordance with the principles contained in this Article .
Translation: 然而，所采用的分配方法应确保结果符合本条所载原则。

Query_Text_en: 6 . For the purposes of the preceding paragraphs , the profits to be attributed to the permanent establishment shall be determined by the same method year by year unless there is good and sufficient reason to the contrary .
Translation: 根据前款规定，应归属于常设机构的利润应按同一方法按年确定，除非存在充分理由反对。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Profits from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 从事国际运输业务的船舶或飞机所获得的利润，应仅在该企业实际管理机构所在地的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If the place of effective management of a shipping enterprise is aboard a ship , then it shall be deemed to be situated in the Contracting State in which the home harbor of the ship is situated , or , if there is no such home harbor , in the Contracting State of which the operator of the ship is a resident .
Translation: 如果航运企业的实际管理机构所在地位于船舶上，则应视为位于该船舶母港所在的缔约国；如该船舶无母港，则应视为位于船舶经营人所在缔约国。

Query_Text_en: and b ] profits from the use , maintenance or rental of containers [ including trailer sand related equipment for the transport of containers ] used for the transport of goods or merchandise , where such rental or such use , maintenance or rental , as the case may be , is incidental to the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic .
Translation: 从事国际运输中船舶或飞机运营的附属业务所取得的利润，其中此类租赁或使用、维护活动（视情况而定）涉及用于货物运输的集装箱（包括运输集装箱所用的拖车及相关设备）的使用、维护或租赁。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 , 2 and 3 of this Article shall also apply to profits from the participation in a pool , a joint business or an international operating agency .
Translation: 本条第一、二、三款的规定亦适用于参与资金池、联营企业或国际运营机构所获利润。

Query_Text_en: b ] the same persons participate directly or indirectly in the management , control or capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State , and in either case conditions are made or imposed between the two enterprises in their commercial or financial relations which differ from those which would be made between independent enterprises , then any profits which would , but for those conditions , have accrued to one of the enterprises , but , by reason of those conditions , have not so accrued , may be included in the profits of that enterprise and taxed accordingly .
Translation: 如果缔约国一方企业的同一人直接或间接参与缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，并且在两种情况下，两家企业在商业或财务关系中达成或施加的条件，与独立企业之间达成的条件存在差异，那么任何本应归属于其中一家企业的利润，但由于上述条件未实际产生的利润，可计入该企业利润并依法征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where a Contracting State includes in the profits of an enterprise of that State -- and taxes accordingly -- profits on which an enterprise of the other Contracting State has been charged to tax in that other State and the profits so included are profits which would have accrued to the enterprise of the first-mentioned State if the conditions made between the two enterprises had been those which would have been made between independent enterprises , then that other State shall make an appropriate adjustment to the amount of the tax charged therein on those profits .
Translation: 当一缔约国将另一缔约国企业已在该另一国缴纳所得税的利润计入本国企业利润并相应征税时，如果所计入的利润属于以下情形：即若双方企业之间所制定的交易条件与独立企业之间所能达成的条件相同时，该利润本应归属于首个提及的缔约国企业，则该另一国应对该部分利润所征税款作出适当调整。

Query_Text_en: In determining such adjustment , due regard shall be had to the other provisions of this Agreement and the competent authorities of the Contracting States shall , if necessary , consult each other .
Translation: 在确定此类调整时，应充分考虑本协议的其他条款，缔约国主管当局在必要时应进行协商。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 由缔约国一方居民公司支付给缔约国另一方居民的股息，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends .
Translation: 然而，此类股息也可能在支付股息公司的居民国缔约国根据该国法律征税，但如果该股息的受益所有人为另一缔约国的居民，则征税金额不得超过股息总额的百分之五。

Query_Text_en: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall by mutual agreement settle he mode of application of this limitation .
Translation: 缔约国的主管机关应通过协商一致确定本限制条款的适用方式。

Query_Text_en: This paragraph shall not affect the taxation of the company in respect of the profits out of which the dividends are paid .
Translation: 本条款不得影响公司就支付股息所产生利润的税务处理。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term dividends as used in this Article means income from shares or other rights , not being debt-claims , participating in profits , as well as income from other corporate rights which is subjected to the same taxation treatment as income from shares by the laws of the State of which the company making the distribution is a resident .
Translation: 本条款中所指的“股息”是指来源于股份或其他非债权性质的权利参与利润分配所获得的收入，以及其他根据分配公司所在国法律规定与股息收入适用相同税收待遇的其他公司权利收入。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the dividends , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 如果股息的受益所有人为缔约国一方居民，并在股息支付公司作为其居民的缔约国另一方进行营业，或在该另一方通过固定基地从事独立个人劳务，且支付股息的股份持有与该常设机构或固定基地存在实质性联系，则本条第一款和第二款不适用。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Where a company which is a resident of a Contracting State derives profits or income from the other Contracting State , that other State may not impose any tax on the dividends paid by the company , except insofar as such dividends are paid to a resident of that other State or insofar as the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with a permanent establishment or a fixed base situated in that other State , nor subject the company 's undistributed profits to a tax on the company 's undistributed profits , even if the dividends paid or the undistributed profits consist wholly or partly of profits or income arising in such other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民公司从缔约国另一方取得利润或所得的，该另一国不得对该公司的股息征收任何税收，除非该股息支付给该另一国的居民，或支付股息的权益与设在该另一国的常设机构或固定基地存在有效关联；也不得对公司的未分配利润征收未分配利润税，即使所支付的股息或未分配利润全部或部分来源于该另一国的所得或收入。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 来源于某一缔约国的利息，支付给另一缔约国的居民，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed7 per cent of the gross amount of the interest .
Translation: 然而，该利息也可以在该利息产生的缔约国按照该国法律征税；但如果该利息的受益所有人为另一缔约国的居民，则所征税收不得超过利息总额的百分之七。

Query_Text_en: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall by mutual agreement settle the mode of application of this limitation .
Translation: 缔约国的主管机关应通过协商确定本限制条款的适用方式。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 , interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to , or on loans guaranteed or insured by , the Government , a local authority or the Central Bank of the other Contracting State shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 尽管有第二款的规定，但某一缔约国发生的利息，如支付给另一缔约国政府、地方当局或中央银行，或由其担保或保险的贷款，则在该缔约国免予征税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term interest as used in this Article means income from debt-claims ofevery kind , whether or not secured by mortgage and whether or not carrying a right to participate in the debtor 's profits , and in particular , income from government securities and income from bonds or debentures , including premiums and prizes attaching to such securities , bonds or debentures .
Translation: 本条所使用的“利息”一词指各种债权产生的所得，无论该债权是否以抵押为担保，也无论是否享有分享债务人利润的权利。具体包括政府债券所得、债券或公司债所得，以及附属于此类证券、债券或公司债的溢价和奖金等收入。

Query_Text_en: Penalty charges for late payment shall not be regarded as interest for the purpose of this Article .
Translation: 就本条规定而言，逾期付款的滞纳金不应被视为利息。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the interest , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the interest arises , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 如果利息的受益所有人为缔约国一方居民，并通过设在该利息发生所在另一国境内的常设机构在该另一国开展营业活动，或在该另一国通过设在境内的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，且支付利息的债权与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系，则本条第一款和第二款的规定不适用。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Interest shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is a resident of that State .
Translation: 6. 当付款人是某缔约国居民时，利息应视为产生于该国。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the interest , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the indebtedness on which the interest is paid was incurred , and such interest is borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base , then such interest shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 然而，如果支付利息的人（无论其是否为缔约国一方的居民），在缔约国一方设有常设机构或固定基地，且该债务是因与该常设机构或固定基地相关联而产生，同时该利息由该常设机构或固定基地承担，则该利息应视为发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在的缔约国一方。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 在缔约国境内发生的特许权使用费，如支付给另一缔约国的居民，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties .
Translation: 2. 然而，此类特许权使用费也可在其来源的缔约国按照该国法律征税，但如果该特许权使用费的受益所有人为另一缔约国的居民，则所征税款不得超过该特许权使用费总额的5%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term royalties as used in this Article means payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of , or the right to use , any copyright of literary , artistic or scientific work including cinematography films , or films or tapes for radio or television broadcasting , any patent , trade mark , design or model , plan , secret formula or process , or for the use of , or the right to use , industrial , commercial , or scientific equipment , or for information concerning industrial , commercial or scientific experience .
Translation: 本条所称特许权使用费，指因使用或有权使用下列任何一项而收到的任何形式的款项：文学、艺术或科学作品（包括电影作品、广播或电视用胶片或磁带）的版权；专利、商标、设计、模型、图纸、秘密配方或工艺；工业、商业或科学设备的使用权；以及有关工业、商业或科学经验的信息。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the royalties , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other11 Contracting State in which the royalties arise , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the right or property in respect of which the royalties are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 本条第一款和第二款的规定不适用于以下情况：特许权使用费的受益所有人是某一缔约国居民，并在该特许权使用费来源的另一缔约国境内通过常设机构开展业务，或在该另一国境内通过固定基地从事独立个人劳务，且支付该特许权使用费的权利或财产与上述常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the royalties , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the liability to pay the royalties was incurred , and such royalties are borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base , then such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 如果支付特许权使用费的人，无论其是否为缔约国居民，在某一缔约国境内设有与该特许权使用费支付义务相关联的常设机构或固定基地，且此类特许权使用费由该常设机构或固定基地承担，则此类特许权使用费应视为发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在的国家。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Gains derived by a resident of a Contracting State from the alienation of immovable property referred to in Article 6 and situated in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民转让本协定第六条所规定的 situate在另一缔约国境内的不动产所取得的收益，可以在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Gains from the alienation of movable property [ including shares and other comparable interests in a company ] forming part of the business property of a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State or of movable property pertaining to a fixed base available to a resident of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing independent personal services , including such gains from the alienation of such a permanent establishment [ alone or with the whole enterprise ] or of such a fixed base , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业设在缔约国另一方的常设机构的营业财产中，属于该常设机构组成部分的动产（包括公司股份及其他类似权益）的转让收益，或缔约国一方居民用于在缔约国另一方从事独立个人劳务活动的固定基地相关的动产的转让收益，包括转让该常设机构（单独转让或连同整个企业一并转让）或该固定基地所取得的上述收益，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Gains from the alienation of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 从事国际运输的船舶或飞机及其运营相关的动产处置所取得的收益，应仅在企业实际管理机构所在地所在缔约国缴纳。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Gains derived by a resident of a Contracting State from the alienation of shares deriving more than 50 per cent of their value directly or indirectly from immovable property situated in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民转让股份所取得的收益，如果该股份价值的百分之五十以上直接或间接来源于缔约国另一方境内的不动产，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 Gains from the alienation of any property other than that referred to in paragraphs 1 to 4 , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident .
Translation: 除本条第一款至第四款所指财产外，转让其他财产所取得的所得，仅应在转让方为居民的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Income derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of professional services or other activities of an independent character shall be taxable only in that State except in one of the following circumstances , when such income may also be taxed in the other Contracting State :
Translation: 缔约国一方居民因提供专业服务或其他独立性质活动所取得的所得，除本款下列情况外，应仅在该国征税。但在下列情况下，该项所得也可在另一缔约国征税：

Query_Text_en: a ] if he has a fixed base regularly available to him in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing his activities ;
Translation: a) 如果他在另一缔约国为了开展其活动而有一个经常性地可供其使用的固定基地；

Query_Text_en: b ] if his stay in the other Contracting State is for a period or periods amounting to or exceeding in the aggregate 183 days in any twelve month period commencing or ending in the calendar year concerned ;
Translation: 如果其在另一缔约国停留的期间或多个期间，在相关日历年度内开始或结束的任何十二个月期间内合计达到或超过一百八十三天；

Query_Text_en: in that case , only so much of the income as is derived from his activities performed in that other State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 在这种情况下，只有来源于该国境内开展活动的那部分收入可在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The term professional services includes especially independent scientific , literary , artistic , educational or teaching activities as well as the independent activities of physicians , lawyers , engineers , architects , dentists and accountants .
Translation: 专业服务一词尤其包括独立进行的科学研究、文学、艺术、教育或教学活动，以及医师、律师、工程师、建筑师、牙医和会计师的独立执业活动。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of Articles 16 , 18 , 19 , 20 and 21 , salaries , wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of an employment shall be taxable only in that State unless the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State .
Translation: 根据本协定第十六条、第十八条、第十九条、第二十条和第二十一条的规定，缔约国居民因受雇所取得的薪金、工资以及其他类似报酬，应仅应向该国缴纳，除非该雇佣关系是在另一缔约国境内行使。

Query_Text_en: If the employment is so exercised , such remuneration as is derived therefrom may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 如果该就业在该国境内履行，由此取得的报酬可由另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: and c ] the remuneration is not borne by a permanent establishment or a fixed base which the employer has in the other State .
Translation: C项：该笔报酬不由雇主设在缔约国另一方的常设机构或固定基地负担。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article , remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of the effective management of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 尽管有本条前述规定，对在国际运输的船舶或飞机上从事受雇工作的所得报酬，应仅在企业实际管理机构所在地的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: Directors ' fees and other similar payments derived by a resident of a Contracting State in his capacity as a member of the board of directors of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民作为缔约国另一方居民公司的董事会成员所取得的董事费和其他类似款项，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 14 and 15 , income derived by a resident of a Contracting State as an entertainer , such as a theater , motion picture , radio or television artiste , or a musician , or as a sportsman , from his personal activities as such exercised in the other Contracting State , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 根据本条规定，不受第十四条和第十五条限制，缔约国一方居民作为演艺人员，如戏剧、电影、广播或电视艺术家，或音乐家，或作为运动员，由于其作为此类人员在另一缔约国从事个人活动所取得的所得，可以在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where income in respect of personal activities exercised by an entertainer or a sportsman in his capacity as such accrues not to the entertainer or sportsman himself but to another person , that income may , notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 7,14 and 15 , be taxed in the Contracting State in which the activities of the entertainer or sportsman are exercised .
Translation: 对于演艺人员或运动员以该身份从事的个人活动所取得的收入，如果该收入并非归属于该演艺人员或运动员本人，而是归属于其他人，则不考虑本协定第七条、第十四条和第十五条的规定，其活动实际开展的缔约国对该部分收入有权征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , income derived from the activities referred to in paragraph 1 within the framework of cultural or sports exchanges agreed to by the Governments of the Contracting States and carried out other than for the purpose of profit shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting State in which these activities are exercised .
Translation: 尽管本条第一款和第二款有相关规定，缔约国政府同意的文化或体育交流框架内进行的、非以营利为目的并参照第一款所述活动所取得的收入，可在该活动实施的缔约国一方免予征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 19 , pensions and other similar remuneration paid to a resident of a Contracting State in consideration of past employment shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 在本条第十九条第二款规定条件下，缔约国一方居民因过往雇佣关系所获得的养老金和其他类似报酬，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 , pensions paid and other similar payments made by the Government of a Contracting State or a local authority thereof under a public welfare scheme of the social security system of that State shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 尽管有本条第一款的规定，缔约国政府或其地方当局根据该国社会保障体系的公共福利计划支付的养老金和其他类似款项，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . a ] Salaries , wages and other similar remuneration , other than a pension , paid by the Government of a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or a local authority thereof , shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国一方政府或该国地方当局支付给个人的工资、薪金和其他类似报酬（不包括养老金），凡根据提供给该国或该国地方当局的服务而支付的部分，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] did not become a resident of that State solely for the purpose of rendering the services .
Translation: [ii] 不仅为提供服务之目的而成为该州居民。

Query_Text_en: 2 . a ] Any pension paid by , or out of funds created by a Contracting State or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to the Government of that State or a local authority thereof shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国或其地方当局支付的，或由该缔约国或其地方当局设立的资金支付的任何养老金，若支付对象为因向该国政府或地方当局提供服务而获得该养老金的个人，则应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: b ] However , such pension shall be taxable only in the other Contracting State if the individual is a resident of , and a national of , that other State .
Translation: 但是，如果该个人是该另一方缔约国的居民并具有该国国籍，则此类养老金仅在该另一方缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of Articles 15 , 16 , 17 and 18 shall apply to salaries , wages , pensions and other similar remuneration in respect of services rendered in connection with a business carried on by a Contracting State or a local authority thereof .
Translation: 第三条 本条约第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定，应适用于缔约国或其地方当局开展业务活动中所提供服务的薪金、工资、养老金及其他类似报酬。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Remuneration which an individual who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State for the primary purpose of teaching , giving lectures or conducting research at the invitation of any university , college , school or other similar non-profitable educational institution or scientific research institution recognized by the Government of the first-mentioned State derives for the purpose of such teaching , lectures or research shall not be taxed in the first-mentioned State , for a period of three years from the date of his first arrival in the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 根据《税收协定》，对于在访问缔约国之前为另一缔约国居民的个人，若其进入该国境内主要目的是应政府认可的任何大学、学院、学校或其他非营利性教育或科研机构邀请从事教学、讲学或研究活动，其因该等活动所获报酬在首次入境之日起三年内，免予在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall not apply to income from research if such research is undertaken not in the public interest but primarily for the private benefit of a specific person or persons .
Translation: 本条第一款的规定不适用于研究所得收入，如果此类研究并非出于公共利益，而是主要为了特定个人或某些人的私人利益。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Payments which a student , business apprentice or trainee who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State solely for the purpose of his education or training receives for the purpose of his maintenance , education or training shall not be taxed in that State , provided that such payments arise from sources outside that State .
Translation: 根据《中华人民共和国和新加坡共和国关于对所得避免双重征税和防止偷漏税的协定》相关条款规定：学生、企业学徒或受训人员在前往某一缔约国之前曾是另一缔约国居民，且仅因在该国接受教育或培训而停留期间，其因维持生活、教育或培训需要而获得的款项，若该款项来源于该国境外，则不应在该国缴纳所得税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . A student or business apprentice who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State for a continuous period not exceeding four year shall not be taxed in the first-mentioned State in respect of remuneration for services rendered in that state , provided that the services are in connection with his studies or training and the remuneration constitutes earnings necessary for his maintenance .
Translation: 根据税收协定，若某学生或学徒在访问某一缔约国前或此前一直是另一缔约国的居民，并在该缔约国境内在一个连续期间内停留时间不超过四年，则其因在该国境内提供与学习或培训相关服务所获得的报酬，如该报酬属于维持其生活的必要所得，应在该缔约国境内免予征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Items of income of a resident of a Contracting State , wherever arising , not dealt with in the foregoing Articles of this Agreement shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民的所得，无论来源于何处，凡本协定未作规定的，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of paragraph 1 shall not apply to income , other than income from immovable property as defined in paragraph 2 of Article 6 , if the recipient of such income , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the right or property in respect of which the income is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation:
本条第一款的规定不适用于缔约国一方居民取得的除第六条第二款定义的不动产所得以外的其他所得，如果该人：  
（一）在缔约国另一方设有常设机构并从事营业活动，且该项所得的权利或财产与该常设机构有实际联系；或  
（二）在缔约国另一方通过固定基地提供独立个人劳务，且该项所得的权利或财产与该固定基地有实际联系。

Query_Text_en: a ] Where a resident of China derives income from Ethiopia , the amount of tax on that income payable in Ethiopia in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , may be credited against the Chinese tax imposed on that resident .
Translation: 根据本协定的规定，中国居民从埃塞俄比亚取得的所得在该国应缴纳的税额，可予抵免该居民所承担的中国税收。

Query_Text_en: The amount of the credit , however , shall not exceed the amount of the Chinese tax on that income computed in accordance with the taxation laws and regulations of China .
Translation: 然而，抵免金额不得超过按照中国税收法律法规计算的该收入的应纳税额。

Query_Text_en: b ] Where the income derived from Ethiopia is dividend paid by a company which is a resident of Ethiopia to a company which is a resident of China and which owns not less than 20 per cent of the shares of the company paying the dividend , the credit shall take into account the tax paid to Ethiopia by the company paying the dividend in respect of its income .
Translation: 根据埃塞俄比亚税收抵免条款，若来源于埃塞俄比亚的所得为埃塞俄比亚居民公司向中国居民公司支付的股息，且中国居民公司持有支付股息公司不低于20%的股份，则抵免应考虑支付股息公司就其所得向埃塞俄比亚缴纳的税款。

Query_Text_en: Where a resident of Ethiopia derives income , which in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement may be taxed in China , Ethiopia shall allow as a deduction from the tax on the income of that resident , an amount equal to the income tax paid in China .
Translation: 根据本协议规定，埃塞俄比亚居民取得的收入可在中国征税时，埃塞俄比亚应允许从该居民的所得税收中扣除相当于在中国缴纳所得税的金额。

Query_Text_en: Such deduction shall not , however , exceed that part of the income tax , as computed before the deduction is given , which is attributable , as the case may be , to the income which may be taxed in China .
Translation: 本项扣除额不得超过在未作扣除前计算的应纳税所得额中归属于可能在中国境内征税的所得部分。

Query_Text_en: 3 . For the purposes of this Article , where business profits arising in a Contracting State are exempt or taxed at a reduced rate in that State for a limited period of time in accordance with the laws and regulations of that State , then the tax on such business profits which have been exempt or taxed at a reduced rate in that State shall be credited against the tax on business profits owing in the State where the beneficial owner of the business profits is a resident .
Translation: 本条所述情形下，缔约国一方产生的营业利润根据该国法律和法规在一定期限内予以免税或减税时，该国已免税或减税的营业利润税款应在受益所有人居住国应缴纳的营业利润税款中予以抵免。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Nationals of a Contracting State shall not be subjected in the other Contracting State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith , which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which nationals of that other State in the same circumstances are or may be subjected .
Translation: 缔约国一方的国民在缔约国另一方境内所承受的税收及与此相关的各项义务，不得比该缔约国另一方的国民在相同情况下所可能承受的税收及相关义务更为繁重或存在差异。

Query_Text_en: This provision shall , notwithstanding the provisions of Article 1 , also apply to persons who are not residents of one or both of the Contracting States .
Translation: 尽管第一条有相关规定，本条规定仍应适用于并非缔约国一方或双方居民的个人。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The taxation on a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State shall not be less favorably levied in that other State than the taxation levied on enterprises of that other State carrying on the same activities .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业设在另一缔约国另一方的常设机构所负担的税收，不应重于在相同情况下另一缔约国另一方对从事相同经营活动的企业所征税收。

Query_Text_en: This provision shall not be construed as obliging a Contracting State to grant to residents of the other Contracting State any personal allowances , reliefs and reductions for taxation purposes on account of civil status or family responsibilities which it grants to its own residents .
Translation: 本条款不得解释为强制要求某一缔约国必须向另一缔约国居民提供任何因其自身居民享有的民事状态或家庭责任原因而在税收方面给予的个人免税额、减免和抵扣。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Except where the provisions of paragraph 1 of Article 9 , paragraph 7 of Article11 , or paragraph 6 of Article 12 , apply , interest , royalties and other disbursements paid by an enterprise of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall , for the purpose of determining the taxable profits of such enterprise , be deductible under the same conditions as if they had been paid to a resident of the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 根据第九条第一款、第十一条第七款或第十二条第六款规定的情形外，缔约国一方企业支付给缔约国另一方居民的利息、特许权使用费和其他款项，在确定该企业应纳税所得额时，应比照向缔约国第一方居民支付的情况准予扣除。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Enterprises of a Contracting State , the capital of which is wholly or partlyowned or controlled , directly or indirectly , by one or more residents of the other Contracting State , shall not be subjected in the first-mentioned State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which other similar enterprises of the first-mentioned State are or may be subjected .
Translation: 缔约国一方的企业，其资本全部或部分由另一缔约国一方的居民直接或间接拥有或控制的，该企业在第一缔约国一方不得因税收或与税收相关的任何要求而遭受比该第一缔约国一方其他同类企业所承受或可能承受的税收及关联要求更为苛刻的待遇。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of this Article shall , notwithstanding the provisions of Article 2 , apply to taxes of every kind and description .
Translation: 本条条款的规定，不受第二条规定限制，适用于一切种类的税收。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Where a person considers that the actions of one or both of the Contracting States result or will result for him in taxation not in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , he may , irrespective of the remedies provided by the domestic law of those States , present his case to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which he is a resident or , if his case comes under paragraph 1 of Article 24 , to that of the Contracting State of which he is a national .
Translation: 如某人认为缔约国一方或双方所采取的征税措施导致或可能导致其征税不符合本协定规定，不论相关国家 domestic law 是否提供其他救济途径，该人可向其作为居民的缔约国主管当局提出申诉；如其案件属于第二十四条第一款情形，则可向其所属国籍国的主管当局提出。

Query_Text_en: The case must be presented within three years from the first notification of the action resulting in taxation not in accordance with the provisions of the Agreement .
Translation: 自导致不符合协议规定的征税行为首次通知之日起，相关案件必须在三年内提出。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The competent authority shall endeavor , if the objection appears to it to be justified and if it is not itself able to arrive at a satisfactory solution , to resolve the case by mutual agreement with the competent authority of the other Contracting State , with a view to the avoidance of taxation which is not in accordance with the Agreement .
Translation: 主管当局应当努力，如果其认为申诉理由正当且自身无法达成满意解决方案时，与缔约国另一方的主管当局通过相互协商达成解决，以避免不符合本协定的征税。

Query_Text_en: Any agreement reached shall be implemented notwithstanding any time limits in the domestic law of the Contracting States .
Translation: 缔约国国内法中的时间限制不得妨碍协议的实施，任何达成的协议均应严格执行。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall endeavor to resolve by mutual agreement any difficulties or doubts arising as to the interpretation or application of the Agreement . They may also consult together for the elimination of double taxation in cases not provided for in the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局应当通过相互协商解决在协定解释或适用方面出现的困难或疑义。对于协定未作规定的场合，他们还可就消除双重征税问题进行协商。

Query_Text_en: When it seems advisable for reaching agreement , representatives of the competent authorities of the Contracting States may meet together for an oral exchange of opinions .
Translation: 当认为达成协议是可取时，缔约国主管机关的代表可举行会晤，进行口头磋商。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange such information as is necessary for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or of the domestic laws of the Contracting States concerning taxes covered by the Agreement , insofar as the taxation thereunder is not contrary to the Agreement , in particular for the prevention of evasion of such taxes .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局应当就执行本协定或涉及本协定涵盖税种的缔约国国内法之规定所需的信息交换情报，尤其是为防止此类税种的偷逃税行为，只要相关税收规定不违背本协定。

Query_Text_en: The exchange of information is not restricted by Articles 1 and 2 .
Translation: 信息交换不受第一条和第二条的限制。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any information received by a Contracting State shall be treated as secret and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities [ including courts and administrative bodies ] involved in the assessment or collection of , the enforcement or prosecution in respect of , or the determination of appeals in relation to , the taxes covered by the Agreement . Such persons or authorities shall use the information only for such purposes .
Translation: 缔约国收到的任何信息均应视为机密，仅可向参与本协定涵盖税种评定、征收、执行、起诉或上诉裁决的人员或机构（包括法院和行政机构）披露。此类人员或机构仅可为上述目的使用该信息。

Query_Text_en: They may disclose the information in public court proceedings or in judicial decisions .
Translation: 他们可能在公开的法庭审理程序或司法裁决中披露该信息。

Query_Text_en: c ] to supply information which would disclose any trade , business , industrial , commercial or professional secret or trade process , or information , the disclosure of which would be contrary to public policy [ order public ] .
Translation: 不得提供任何可能泄露商业、商务、工业、行业或专业秘密，或贸易流程或工艺，或其披露将有悖于公共政策（公共秩序）的信息。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day of the latter of the notification through which the Contracting States shall notify each other that the internal legal procedures for the entry into force of this Agreement have been complied with and its provisions shall have effect with respect to income derived during the taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January next following that in which this Agreement enters into force .
Translation: 本协议应自缔约国相互通知已完成本协议生效所需内部法律程序的通知中较晚者之日起第30日生效。其条款应适用于本协议生效年度次年一月一日或之后开始的纳税年度内取得的所得。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall continue in effect indefinitely but either of the Contracting States may , on or before the thirtieth day of June in any calendar year beginning after the expiration of a period of five years from the date of its entry into force , give written notice of termination to the other Contracting State through the diplomatic channels .
Translation: 本协定应无限期有效。但自本协定生效之日起满五年后的第一个日历年，任一缔约方均可在该日历年6月30日之前，通过外交途径向另一方缔约方提交书面终止通知。

Query_Text_en: In such event this Agreement shall cease to have effect with respect to income derived during the taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January in the calendar year next following that in which the notice of termination is given .
Translation: 本协议应终止对在终止通知发出年份的次年起开始的纳税年度中取得的收入的效力，具体自该次年1月1日或之后起始的纳税年度所涉收入起适用。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS whereof the undersigned , duly authorized thereto , have signed this Agreement .
Translation: 鉴此，本签署方经正式授权，特签署本协议。

Query_Text_en: Done at on this day of , in duplicate in the Chinese and English languages , both texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本协议于______日签署，中文和英文版本各一式两份，两种文本具有同等法律效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 1With respect to paragraph 2 g ] of Article 5 , a commercial warehouse refers to facilities maintained by an enterprise of a Contracting State for storage of goods or merchandise for other enterprises for profit purposes .
Translation: 关于第五条第二款(g)项，商业仓库是指缔约国企业为其他企业以营利为目的而经营的储存货物或商品的设施。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 With respect to paragraph 3 of Article 7 , limitations under domestic law apply only when the result from such limitations is in accordance with the principles contained in this Agreement .
Translation: 关于第七条第三款，国内法中的限制性规定仅在这些限制的结果符合本协议所载明的原则时方可适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 With respect to paragraph 3 of Article 11 , the Ethiopian Government has been giving tax exemption to financial institutions wholly owned by the Chinese Government for their interest income from loans . This same favorable tax treatment may continue in the future on a case-by-case basis on loans financed , guaranteed or insured by financial institutions wholly owned by the Chinese Government .
Translation: 根据《第11条》第3款，埃塞俄比亚政府一直对中国政府全资拥有的金融机构给予税收减免，对其贷款利息收入免征税收。对于由中国政府全资拥有的金融机构融资、担保或保险的贷款，未来可能继续以个案处理方式实施上述税收优惠。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 With respect to paragraph 1 of Article 26 , when exchange of information is requested in regard of taxes other than the taxes covered in Article 2 , there might be difficulty for the Ethiopian competent authority on account of its information gathering capacity .
Translation: 第四条 关于第二十六条第一款的规定，当涉及请求交换本协定第二条未涵盖的税种相关信息时，由于埃塞俄比亚主管当局的信息收集能力限制，可能存在困难。

Query_Text_en: However , for significant cases , the Ethiopian competent authority shall try its best to provide the information requested .
Translation: 然而，对于重大案件，埃塞俄比亚主管部门应尽力提供所要求的信息。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS whereof the undersigned , duly authorized thereto , have signed this Protocol .
Translation: 兹证明，经正式授权的签署人已签署本议定书。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Agreement shall apply to taxes on income imposed on behalf of a Contracting State or of its administrative subdivisions or local authorities , irrespective of the manner in which they are levied .
Translation: 本协定适用于缔约国或其行政分区及地方当局代表名义课征的所得税，无论其征收方式如何。

Query_Text_en: 2 . There shall be regarded as taxes on income all taxes imposed on total income or on elements of income , including taxes on gains from the alienation of movable or immovable property , as well as taxes on capital appreciation .
Translation: 应视为所得税的包括对总收入或收入要素课征的税，其中包括对动产或不动产转让所得收益课征的税，以及对资本增值课征的税。

Query_Text_en: including any prepayments [ pr comptes ] , surcharges on the above-mentioned taxes and prepayments as well as the additional taxes on the individual income tax .
Translation: 包括上述税款及预付款[预存账户]的任何预缴款项、对上述税款和预付款的加征部分以及个人所得税的附加税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Agreement shall apply also to any identical or substantially similar taxes which are imposed after the date of signature of the Agreement in addition to , or in place of , the existing taxes .
Translation: 本协议应同样适用于在本协议签署日后实施的、附加于或替代现有税种的任何相同或实质相似的税种。

Query_Text_en: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall notify each other in due time of substantial changes which have been made in their respective taxation laws .
Translation: 缔约国的主管当局应当及时相互通知对其各自税收法律所作的重大变更。

Query_Text_en: when used in a geographical sense , it means the territory of the Kingdom of Belgium including its territorial sea as well as areas over which , in accordance with international law , the Kingdom of Belgium has sovereign rights with respect to exploration for and exploitation of the natural resources of the seabed and subsoil thereof and the above-lying waters ;
Translation: 在地理意义上使用时，指包括比利时王国领海在内的王国领土，以及根据国际法比利时王国对其海床、底土及其上覆水域的自然资源享有勘探和开发主权权利的区域。

Query_Text_en: when used in a geographical sense , means all the territory of the People 's Republic of China , including its territorial sea , in which the laws relating to Chinese tax are in force , and all the area beyond its territorial sea over which , in accordance with international law , the People 's Republic of China has sovereign rights for the purposes of exploration for and exploitation of the resources of the seabed and subsoil thereof and the above-lying waters ;
Translation: 在地理意义上使用时，指中华人民共和国税法适用的全部领域，包括其领海在内的中华人民共和国全部陆地和水域疆域，以及根据国际法中华人民共和国对其海床、底土以及上覆水域的勘探和开发资源享有主权权利的领海以外区域。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] the terms `` a Contracting State '' and `` the other Contracting State '' mean Belgium or China , as the context requires ;
Translation: “缔约国”和“另一缔约国”指比利时或中国，视具体情况而定；

Query_Text_en: [ d ] the term `` tax '' means Belgian tax or Chinese tax , as the context requires ;
Translation: 本条款中“税收”一词指比利时税收或中国税收，具体含义视语境而定；

Query_Text_en: [ e ] the term `` person '' includes an individual , a company and any other body of persons ;
Translation: “人”这一术语包括个人、公司以及其他组织；

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] all legal persons , partnerships and associations constituted in accordance with the law in force in a Contracting State ;
Translation: [ ii ] 缔约国根据现行法律成立的所有法人、合伙企业和协会；

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] with respect to China , the Ministry of Finance or its authorized representative .
Translation: [ii] 关于中国，财政部或其授权代表。

Query_Text_en: 2 . As regards the application of the Agreement by a Contracting State any term not defined therein shall , unless the context otherwise requires , have the meaning which it has under the law of that State concerning the taxes to which the Agreement applies .
Translation: 关于缔约国适用本协定时，凡协定中未作定义的术语，除上下文另有要求外，应具有该国关于本协定适用税种的法律中赋予的含义。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term `` resident of a Contracting State '' means any person who , under the laws of that State , is liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile , residence , place of head office or any other criterion of a similar nature .
Translation: 根据本协定，“缔约国居民”一词指根据该国法律，因住所、居所、总机构所在地或其他类似性质标准而在该国负有纳税义务的任何人。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where by reason of the provisions of paragraph 1 an individual is a resident of both Contracting States , the competent authorities of the Contracting States shall determine , by mutual agreement , of which State that individual is a resident .
Translation: 根据本条第一款规定，个人同时为缔约国双方居民的，应通过缔约国双方主管当局相互协商确定该个人为哪一国居民。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Where by reason of the provisions of paragraph 1 a person other than an individual is a resident of both Contracting States , then it shall be deemed to be a resident of the Contracting State in which its place of head office is situated .
Translation: 如果根据第一款规定，某除个人以外的人在两国均为居民，则应将其视为总机构所在地所在缔约国的居民。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] a building site or assembly project or supervisory activities connected therewith , but only if the construction , assembly or supervisory activities last for more than 6 months ;
Translation: 建筑工地、组装项目及相关监督活动，但仅限于施工、组装或监督活动持续时间超过6个月的情形。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] the maintenance of a fixed place of business solely for any combination of activities mentioned in sub-paragraphs [ a ] to [ e ] , provided that the overall activity of the fixed place of business resulting from this combination is of a preparatory or auxiliary character .
Translation: 如果该固定营业场所由此类活动组合产生的整体经营活动具有准备性或辅助性质，则仅为子段落[a]至[e]所述活动的任何组合而维持的固定营业场所。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , where a person-other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies-is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State and has , and habitually exercises , an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise , unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 除第1款和第2款的规定外，如果某人（不包括第6款适用的独立地位代理人）代表另一缔约国企业在一个缔约国境内进行营业活动，并拥有且通常以该企业名义签订合同的权限，则该企业应被视为在该缔约国就该人员为该企业所从事的任何活动构成常设机构。但若该人员的活动仅限于第4款所述情形，即如果通过固定场所进行此类活动，则根据该款规定，该固定场所不构成常设机构的，则不在此限。

Query_Text_en: 6 . An enterprise of a Contracting State shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that State through a broker , general commission agent or any other agent of an independent status , provided that such persons are acting in the ordinary course of their business .
Translation: 根据缔约国一方企业的经营活动仅通过代理人（如经纪人、一般佣金代理人或者其他具有独立地位的代理人）在缔约国另一方开展，且这些代理人在其常规业务范围内行事，则不应仅因上述情形认定该企业在缔约国另一方构成常设机构。

Query_Text_en: However , where the activities of such an agent are carried out exclusively or almost exclusively on behalf of that enterprise , that agent is not considered an independent agent for the purposes of this paragraph .
Translation: 然而，如果某代理人的活动完全或几乎完全代表某企业开展，则就本款而言，该代理人不被视为独立代理人。

Query_Text_en: 1 . lncome derived by a resident of a Contracting State from immovable property situated in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民因位于另一缔约国境内的不动产而取得的所得，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The term `` immovable property '' shall have the meaning which it has under the law of the Contracting State in which the property in question is situated .
Translation: "不动产"一词的含义应根据该不动产所在地缔约国的法律所规定的含义确定。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of paragraph 1 shall apply to income derived from the direct use or right to use , letting , or use in any other form of immovable property .
Translation: 本条第一款规定适用于来源于不动产直接使用、使用权、出租或其他任何形式使用所取得的收入。

Query_Text_en: If the enterprise carries on business as aforesaid , the profits of the enterprise may be taxed in the other State but only so much of them as is attributable to that permanent establishment .
Translation: 如果企业从事上述经营活动，另一国可对该企业的利润征税，但仅以归属于该常设机构的部分为限。

Query_Text_en: However , no such deduction shall be allowed in respect of amounts , if any , paid [ otherwise than towards reimbursement of actual expenses ] by the permanent establishment to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices , by way of royalties , fees or other similar payments in return for the use of patents or other rights , or by way of commission , for specific services performed or for management , or , except in the case of a banking enterprise , by way of interest on moneys lent to the permanent establishment .
Translation: 但是，如果常设机构向企业的总机构或其他分支机构支付任何款项，作为使用专利或其他权利的对价而支付的特许权使用费、费用或其他类似款项，或因具体服务已提供或管理而支付的佣金，或（除非是银行企业的情况）因向常设机构提供贷款而支付的利息，此类款项金额不得准予此类扣除。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , no account shall be taken , in the determination of the profits of a permanent establishment , of amounts charged [ otherwise than towards reimbursement of actual expenses ] by the permanent establishment to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices , by way of royalties , fees or other similar payments in return for the use of patents or other rights , or by way of commission for specific services performed or for management , or , except in the case of a banking enterprise , by way of interest on moneys lent to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices .
Translation: 在确定常设机构利润时，不得计入该常设机构向企业总机构或其他营业机构收取的下列金额：以专利或其他权利使用费、特定服务报酬或管理费等形式支付的特许权使用费、费用或类似款项；以及非银行业企业向总机构或其他营业机构提供的贷款所收取的利息，但银行业企业除外。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Insofar as it has been customary in a Contracting State to determine the profits to be attributed to a permanent establishment on the basis of an apportionment of the total profits of the enterprise to its various parts , nothing in paragraph 2 shall preclude that State from determining the profits to be taxed by such an apportionment as may be customary ;
Translation: 如果缔约国一方习惯于根据企业总利润分摊原则确定应归属于常设机构的利润，则本条第2款不应妨碍该国继续采用此种符合惯例的利润分摊方法予以征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Profits from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of head office of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 从事国际运输业务的船舶或飞机所获得的利润，应仅在企业总机构所在地的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of paragraph 1 shall also apply to profits from the participation in a pool , a joint business or an international operating agency .
Translation: 第一款的规定应同样适用于参与联营池、联营业务或国际经营机构所获得的利润。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] the same profits participate directly or indirectly in the management , control or capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State , and in either case conditions are made or imposed between the two enterprises in their commercial or financial relations which differ from those which would be made between independent enterprises , then any profits which would , but for those conditions , have accrued to one of the enterprises , but , by reason of those conditions , have not so accrued , may be included in the profits of that enterprise and taxed accordingly .
Translation: 如果缔约国一方企业与缔约国另一方企业之间存在同一利润的直接或间接参与管理、控制或资本关系，且在两种情况下，两企业在商业或财务关系中达成或施加的条件与独立企业间达成的条件存在差异，那么任何本应归属于其中一方企业的利润（若非因上述条件本可归属），但由于此类条件导致未实际归属的利润，可计入该企业利润并据此征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends .
Translation: 然而，此类股息也可能在支付股息的公司所在缔约国根据该国法律征税，但如果股息的受益所有人为另一缔约国的居民，则所征税款不得超过股息总额的百分之十。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` dividends '' as used in this Article means income from shares or rights to participate in profits , not being debt-claims , as well as other income which is subjected to the same taxation treatment as income from shares by the laws of the Contracting State of which the company making the distribution is a resident .
Translation: 本条所使用的“股息”一词指股份所得或参与利润分配的权利（而非债权请求权），以及根据进行分配的公司实际管理机构所在缔约国法律，适用与股份所得相同税收待遇的其他所得。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Where a company which is a resident of a Contracting State derives profits or income from the other Contracting State , that other State may not impose any tax on the dividends paid by the company , except insofar as such dividends are paid to a resident of that other State or insofar as the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with a permanent establishment or a fixed base situated in that other State , nor subject the company 's undistributed profits to a tax , even if the dividends paid or the undistributed profits consist wholly or partly of profits or income arising in such other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民公司从缔约国另一方取得利润或所得时，该另一方不得对该等股息征收任何税收，除非该等股息支付给该另一方居民，或支付股息的股权与该另一方境内设立的常设机构或固定基地存在实际关联；同时，亦不得对该公司未分配利润征税，即使该已支付股息或未分配利润全部或部分构成源自该另一方的利润或所得。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest .
Translation: 但是，此类利息亦可在利息产生的缔约国根据该国法律征税，但如果利息的受益所有人是另一缔约国的居民，则所征税收不得超过利息总额的10%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , interest arising in a Contracting State shall be exempt from tax in that State , when it concerns interest paid to the account of the other Contracting State or interest paid to banking or credit institutions the capital of which is wholly owned by the other State or which are recognized by mutual agreement between the competent authorities of both Contracting States .
Translation: 本条规定不影响第一条和第二款的规定。如果利息由缔约国一方支付，并且符合以下情形之一，则该利息在该缔约国应免予征税：（一）支付给另一缔约国政府或中央银行；（二）支付给由另一缔约国完全拥有资本的银行或金融机构；（三）经两国主管当局相互协商认可的其他金融机构所获得的利息。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term `` interest '' as used in this Article means income from debt-claims of every kind , whether or not secured by mortgage and whether or not carrying a right to participate in the debtor 's profits , and in particular , income from government securities and income from bonds or debentures , including premiums and prizes attaching to such securities , bonds or debentures .
Translation: 本条所称“利息”指各种债权产生的所得，无论该债权是否以抵押为担保，是否附有分享债务人利润的权利，尤其是政府证券、债券或公司债券的所得，包括附属于此类证券、债券或公司债券的溢价和奖金。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 , 2 and 3 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the interest , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the interest arises , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected which such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 本条第一、二、三款的规定不适用于以下情况：利息的受益所有人为缔约国一方居民，且其通过设在利息发生所在缔约国另一方的常设机构在该国开展营业活动，或在该另一国通过固定基地提供独立个人劳务，同时支付利息的债权债务与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Interest shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is that State itself , an administrative subdivision , a local authority or a resident of that State .
Translation: 利息应视为来源于缔约国一方，当支付利息的一方为该国政府、该国的行政区域、地方当局或该国居民时。

Query_Text_en: In such case , the excess part of the interest shall remain taxable according to the laws of each Contracting State , due regard being had to the other provisions of this Agreement .
Translation: 在这种情况下，利息的超额部分仍应按照各缔约国的法律缴纳，但需考虑本协定的其他规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable in that other State .
Translation: 在缔约国境内发生的特许权使用费，如支付给另一缔约国居民，应仅在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties .
Translation: 然而，此类版税亦可在其发生的缔约国根据该国法律征税，但如该版税的受益所有人为另一缔约国居民，则征税金额不得超过该版税总额的百分之十。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` royalties '' as used in this Article means payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of , or the right to use , any copyright of literary , artistic or scientific work including cinematograph films and films or tapes for radio or television broadcasting , any patent , know-how , trade mark , design or model , plan , secret formula or process , or for the use of , or the right to use , industrial , commercial , or scientific equipment , or for information concerning industrial , commercial or scientific experience .
Translation: 本条所称“特许权使用费”，指因使用或有权使用下列任何权利或财产而收到的任何款项：文学、艺术或科学作品的著作权（包括电影作品及用于无线电或电视广播的影片或录音带），任何专利、专有技术、商标、设计、模型、图纸、秘密配方或工艺，或因使用或有权使用工业、商业或科学设备，或因提供工业、商业或科学经验相关信息而获得的报酬。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the royalties , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the royalties arise , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the right or property in respect of which the royalties are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 本条第一款和第二款的规定不适用于以下情况：特许权使用费的受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，其通过设在特许权使用费来源国的常设机构在该国开展业务，或在该国通过设在当地的固定基地提供独立个人服务，且支付该特许权使用费的权利或财产与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Royalties shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is the Government of that State itself , an administrative subdivision , a local authority or a resident of that Contracting State .
Translation: 特许权使用费应视为来源于该缔约国，当支付方为该国政府、该国的行政分区、地方当局或该缔约国居民时。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the royalties , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the obligation to pay the royalties was incurred , and those royalties are borne by that permanent establishment , then such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the Contracting State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 如果支付特许权使用费的人，无论其是否为缔约国居民，在缔约国境内设有与支付该特许权使用费有关的常设机构或固定基地，并且该特许权使用费由该常设机构或固定基地负担，则此类特许权使用费应视为来源于该常设机构或固定基地所在的缔约国。

Query_Text_en: In such case , the excess part of the royalties shall remain taxable according to the laws of each Contracting State , due regard being had to the other provisions of this Agreement .
Translation: 在这种情况下，特许权使用费的超出部分仍应根据各缔约国的法律缴纳，同时考虑到本协定的其他规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Gains from the alienation of movable property forming part of the business property of a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State or of movable property pertaining to a fixed base available to a resident of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing independent personal services , including such gains from the alienation of such a permanent establishment [ alone or with the whole enterprise ] or of such fixed base , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业设在缔约国另一方的常设机构的营业财产部分的动产，或者构成缔约国一方居民在缔约国另一方从事独立个人劳务所使用的固定基地的动产的转让收益，包括转让常设机构（单独转让或者连同整个企业一起转让）或者转让该固定基地的收益，可以在该另一方国家征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Gains from the alienation of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of head office of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 从事国际运输的船舶或飞机及其运营相关的动产因转让所获收益，应仅在企业总机构所在地的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Gains from the alienation of shares in the capital of a company , the assets of which consist mainly , directly or indirectly , of immovable property situated in a Contracting State , may be taxed in that State .
Translation: 股份转让所得，若该公司的资产主要直接或间接由位于某一缔约国境内的不动产构成，可以在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Gains derived from the alienation of shares , other than those mentioned in paragraph 4 and which represent a participation of 25 per cent in a company which is a resident of a Contracting State , may be taxed in that State .
Translation: 除第四款规定的情形外，转让某缔约国居民公司25%股份所取得的收益，可以在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Gains from the alienation of any property other than that referred to in paragraphs 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 and 5 shall be taxable in the Contracting State in which the transferred property is situated .
Translation: 除第1、2、3、4、5款所指财产以外的任何财产转让所得，应仅在该转让财产所在地的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Income derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of professional services or other activities of an independent character shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国居民因提供专业服务或其他具有独立性质的活动而取得的收入，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: or [ b ] if his stay in the other Contracting State is for a period or periods equalling or exceeding in the aggregate 183 days during the calendar year concerned ; in such case only so much of the income as is derived from the activities performed in that other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 如果其在另一缔约国境内的停留期间或停留期间的累计总和在有关日历年度内达到或超过一百八十三天；在此情况下，仅就其在该另一缔约国境内从事活动所获得的收入部分，可由该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The term `` professional services '' includes especially independent scientific , literary , artistic , educational or teaching activities as well as the independent activities of physicians , lawyers , engineers , architects , dentists and accountants .
Translation: "专业服务"一词尤其包括独立进行的科学、文学、艺术、教育或教学活动，以及医生、律师、工程师、建筑师、牙医和会计师等专业人士的独立执业活动。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of Articles 16 , 18 , 19 and 20 , salaries , wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of an employment shall be taxable only in that State unless the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State .
Translation: 在不违反本协定第十六条、第十八条、第十九条和第二十条规定的情况下，缔约国居民因受雇所取得的工资、薪金和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国征税，除非该雇佣职位是在另一缔约国履行。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] the remuneration is not borne by a permanent establishment or a fixed base which the employer has in the other State .
Translation: 并且[ c ]，该报酬不由雇主设在缔约国另一方的常设机构或固定基地负担。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article , remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic may be taxed in the Contracting State in which the place of head office of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 尽管本条前述规定有相反 stipulations，对在从事国际运输的船舶或飞机上任职受雇所取得的报酬，可以在企业总机构所在的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: Directors ' fees and other similar payments derived by a resident of a Contracting State in his capacity as a member of the board of directors or similar body of a joint-stock company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民作为股份有限公司（该股份有限公司是缔约国另一方居民）董事会或其他类似机构成员而取得的董事费和其他类似款项，可以由该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of this Article shall also apply to payments derived by persons for the exercising of functions similar to those mentioned in the preceding paragraph .
Translation: 本条的规定也适用于人员因行使与前款所述职能类似的职能而获得的款项。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 14 and 15 , income derived by a resident of a Contracting State as an entertainer , such as a theater , motion picture , radio or television artiste , or a musician , or as an athlete , from his personal activities as such exercised in the other Contracting State , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 尽管本协定第十四条和第十五条有规定，缔约国居民作为演艺人员（如戏剧、电影、广播或电视艺术家、音乐家）或运动员，因其作为上述人员在另一缔约国从事的个人活动所取得的所得，可以由该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where income in respect of personal activities exercised by an entertainer or an athlete in his capacity as such accrues not to the entertainer or athlete himself but to another person , that income may , notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 7 , 14 and 15 , be taxed in the Contracting State in which the activities of the entertainer or athlete are exercised .
Translation: 当演艺人员或运动员以其身份从事个人活动所获得的收入并非归属于该演艺人员或运动员本人，而是归属于其他人时，尽管存在第七条、第十四条和第十五条的规定，该收入仍可在该演艺人员或运动员开展活动的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , income derived by an entertainer or an athlete who is a resident of a Contracting State from activities exercised in the other Contracting State within the framework of cultural exchange program between the Government of both States , shall not be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 尽管本条第一款和第二款有其他规定，缔约国一方居民的艺术家或运动员根据两国政府之间签订的文化交流协议，在另一缔约国进行活动所取得的所得，不应在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 , pensions paid and other payments made by a Contracting State , a political subdivisions or a local authorities thereof or by a legal person which is part of the social security system of that State may be taxed in that State .
Translation: 尽管有第1款的规定，缔约国、其地方行政区域或地方政府机构，或属于该国社会保障体系的法人实体所支付的养老金和其他款项，可在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] did not become a resident of that other State solely for the purpose of rendering the services .
Translation: [ii] 并非仅为提供相关服务而成为该另一国的居民。

Query_Text_en: 2 . [ a ] Any pension paid by , or out of funds created by , a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or subdivision or authority shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国或该国的地方政府部门或地方当局以其设立的资金向个人支付的任何养老金，因该个人为该国或该地方部门/当局所提供服务而发放的，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] However , such pension shall be taxable only in the other Contracting State if the individual is a resident of , and a national of , that State .
Translation: 如果该个人为该国居民并具有该国国籍，则此类养老金仅由另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of Articles 15 , 16 and 18 shall apply to remuneration and pensions in respect of services rendered in connection with a business carried on by a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof .
Translation: 本条第十五条、第十六条和第十八条的规定应适用于缔约国或其地方政府或地方当局开展业务所涉及服务的报酬及养老金。

Query_Text_en: Remuneration which an individual who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State , and who is present in the first-mentioned State solely for the purpose of teaching , giving lectures or engaging in research at a university or other teaching or research institution recognized by that State , receives for such services shall not be taxable in that State for a period not exceeding , in total , 3 years as from the date of his arrival in that State .
Translation: 根据缔约国双方税收协定，对于在访问某一缔约国前系另一缔约国居民，并仅为在该国认可的大学或其他教育或研究机构从事教学、授课或研究活动而进入该国的个人，其因上述服务所获报酬在自其抵达该国之日起总计不超过三年的期间内，不应在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: Payments which a student or business apprentice who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State solely for the purpose of his education or training receives for the purpose of his maintenance , education or training shall not be taxed in that State .
Translation: 根据缔约国双方税收协定，学生或学徒在访问某一缔约国前或之前一直是另一缔约国居民，并仅因学习或培训目的存在于该国时，其获得的用于生活维持、教育或培训的款项，不应在该国缴纳税收。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Items of income of a resident of a Contracting State not dealt with in the foregoing Articles of this Agreement and which arise in the other Contracting State shall be taxable in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民的下列各类所得，如在本协定上述条款中未作规定而来源于另一缔约国的，应仅在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Items of income of a resident of a Contracting State which arise from sources situated outside the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in the first State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民来源于另一缔约国境外的所得，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply to income , other than income from immovable property as defined in paragraph 2 of Article 6 , if the recipient of such income , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the right or property in respect of which the income is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment of fixed base .
Translation: 本条第一款和第二款的规定不适用于缔约国一方居民取得的所得（第六条第二款所定义的不动产所得除外）。如果该所得受益人在缔约国另一方通过设在该国的常设机构进行营业，或在该国通过设在那里的固定基地从事独立个人劳务，且支付所得的权利或财产与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系，则上述规定不适用。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Where a resident of Belgium derives income which is taxable in China in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , with the exception of the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 10 , paragraphs 2 and 7 of Article 11 and paragraphs 2 and 6 of Article 12 , Belgium shall exempt such income from tax but it may , in calculating the amount of its taxes on the remaining income of such resident , apply the same rate as if the income in question had not been exempted .
Translation: 根据本协定规定，比利时居民在中国取得的所得应在中国缴纳所得税。除本协定第十条第二款、第十一条第二款和第七款、第十二条第二款和第六款规定外，比利时应对该项所得免予征税，但计算该居民其余所得应纳税额时，仍可按照未予免税的情况计算税率。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Where a resident of Belgium derives items of income which are included in his total income subject to Belgian tax and which consist of dividends taxable in accordance with paragraph 2 of Article 10 and which are not exempt from Belgian tax by virtue of [ c ] below , of interest taxable in accordance with paragraphs 2 or 7 of Article 11 , or of royalties taxable in accordance with paragraphs 2 or 6 of Article 12 , Belgium shall allow a deduction from the tax on that income taking into account the Chinese tax on that income , whether or not such tax has actually been paid .
Translation: 如果比利时居民取得的所得属于其应计入比利时应税总收入范围，并且该所得属于根据第10条第2款征税的股息（且未依据以下条款[ c ]免予征收比利时税收）、根据第11条第2款或第7款征税的利息、或根据第12条第2款或第6款征税的特许权使用费，则比利时应对该所得的应纳税额给予抵免，具体抵免额应考虑该所得在中国所缴纳的税收，无论该税收是否实际缴纳。

Query_Text_en: Such deduction shall be equal to the lump-sum deduction of foreign tax provided by Belgian law , but the tax may not , however , be less than 15 per cent of the amount of income in question received after deducting the Chinese tax which might be levied .
Translation: 该抵免额应等于比利时法律规定的外国税收固定数额抵免，但该税收抵免不得低于在扣除可能征收的中国税款后所获得的收入金额的15%。

Query_Text_en: The deduction is granted at a rate of 20 per cent in the case of royalties which are taxable in China by virtue of the general rules of its tax laws but which are exempt from Chinese tax on the basis of special regulations for the economic development of the country .
Translation: 根据中国税法的一般规定应纳税的特许权使用费，若根据国家经济发展相关特殊规定免纳中国税收，则按20%的比例给予减免。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] where a company which is a resident of Belgium owns shares in a company which is a resident of China , the dividends paid to it by the last-mentioned company and which are taxable in China in accordance with paragraph 2 of Article 10 shall be exempt from the corporate income tax in Belgium , to the extent that such exemption would have been granted had both companies been residents of Belgium .
Translation: 根据《中华人民共和国企业所得税法》第十条第二款规定，在比利时注册的公司如持有中国居民公司的股份，该中国居民公司向其支付的股息若已在中国缴纳所得税，则比利时方面将对该笔股息免征企业所得税，免税额度以这两家公司均为比利时居民公司时本可获得的免税范围为限。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Where , in accordance with Belgian law , losses incurred by an enterprise managed by a resident of Belgium through a permanent establishment located in China have been effectively deducted from the profits of that enterprise for purposes of Belgian taxation , the exemption provided in [ a ] shall not apply in Belgium to the profits of other taxable periods which are attributable to that establishment , to the extent that such profits will also have been exempt from tax in China because of their compensation by such losses .
Translation: 根据比利时法律规定，若比利时居民通过其设在中国的常设机构所发生的亏损已在比利时税收中实际扣除，则鉴于此类利润在中国亦因上述亏损的冲抵而获得免税待遇，本条[ a ]规定的免税规定在比利时不适用于归属于该常设机构的其他纳税期间利润。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] The tax levied in Belgium by virtue of this Agreement on income derived in Belgium and received by a resident of China shall be deducted from the Chinese tax payable by that resident on such income , but the amount of the deduction may not exceed the amount of Chinese tax calculated in accordance with Chinese law which is proportionally assignable to such income .
Translation: 根据本协定在比利时征收的税款，就中国居民从比利时取得并收到的所得而言，应从该中国居民就该所得依中国税法应纳的税额中抵扣，但抵扣金额不得超过按中国税法计算的就该所得应分配的相应税额比例。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Where the income consists of dividends paid by a company that is a resident of Belgium to a company which is a resident of China and which owns more than 10 per cent of the shares of the company paying the dividends , then , for the deduction from Chinese tax , the Belgian tax paid by the company paying the dividends which corresponds to those dividends must also be taken into account .
Translation: 如果支付股息的公司是在比利时的居民公司，而获得股息的公司是在中国的居民公司且直接拥有支付股息公司股份超过10%，则在扣除中国税收时，必须一并考虑支付股息公司已缴纳的对应该笔股息的比利时税款。

Query_Text_en: This provision shall notwithstanding the provisions of Article 1 , also apply to persons who are not residents of one or both of the Contracting States .
Translation: 本条规定不受第一条规定的限制，同时也适用于非缔约国一方或双方居民的个人。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The taxation on a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State shall not be less favourably levied in that other State than the taxation levied on enterprises of that other State carrying on the same activities .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业设在另一缔约国的常设机构所负担的税收，不得比该缔约国对从事相同活动的本国企业所征收的税收更为不利。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Except where the provisions of Article 9 , paragraph 7 of Article 11 , or paragraph 6 of Article 12 , apply , interest , royalties and other disbursements paid by an enterprise of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall , for the purpose of determining the taxable profits of such enterprise , be deductible under the same conditions as if they had been paid to a resident of the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 除本协定第九条第七款、第十一条第七款或第十二条第六款规定的情形外，缔约国一方企业向缔约国另一方居民支付的利息、特许权使用费和其他款项，在确定该企业应税利润时，应与支付给第一缔约国居民的情况同样允许扣除。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Enterprises of a Contracting State , the capital of which is wholly or partly owned or controlled , directly or indirectly , by one or more residents of the other Contracting State , shall not be subjected in the first-mentioned State to any taxation or requirement connected therewith which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which other similar enterprises of the first-mentioned State are or may be subjected .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业如其资本全部或部分为缔约国另一方居民直接或间接拥有或控制，则该缔约国一方不得对该企业课征比该缔约国一方其他同类企业所承受或可能承受的税收及有关要求更为沉重或不同的税负。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall endeavor to resolve by mutual agreement any difficulties or doubts arising as to the interpretation or application of the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局应力求通过相互协商解决在本协定解释或适用方面产生的任何困难或疑义。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States may communicate with each other on the subject of the administrative measures which are necessary for carrying out the provisions of the Agreement and particularly on the subject of the proof to be provided by residents of each State in order to benefit in the other State from the tax exemptions or reductions provided by this Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局可就执行本协定规定所需采取的行政措施进行交流，特别是就缔约国一方居民为在另一方国家享受本协定规定的税收减免所需提供的证明文件交换信息。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States may communicate with each other directly for the application of the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国主管机关可为执行本协定直接相互联系。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange such information as is necessary for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or of the domestic laws of the Contracting States concerning taxes covered by the Agreement insofar as the taxation thereunder is not contrary to the Agreement , in particular for the purpose of combatting tax fraud or evasion with respect to these taxes .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局应交换为执行本协定规定或缔约国涉及本协定涵盖税种的国内法所需的信息，只要这种征税不违反本协定，尤其是为了打击这些税种的逃税或避税行为。

Query_Text_en: Any information received by a Contracting State shall be treated as secret in the same manner as information obtained under the domestic laws of that State and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities [ including courts and administrative bodies ] involved in the assessment or collection of , the enforcement or prosecution in respect of , or the determination of appeals in relation to , the taxes covered by the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国所获取的任何信息，均应按照该国国内法律所获取信息的方式，作为机密信息处理，并仅向参与本协定涵盖税种评估、征收、执行或起诉相关事宜，或裁决此类税种上诉事宜的人员或机构（包括法院和行政机关）披露。

Query_Text_en: Such persons or authorities shall use the information only for such purposes . They may disclose the information in public court proceedings or in judicial decisions .
Translation: 此类个人或机构应当仅将信息用于上述目的。可以在公开的法庭审理程序或司法裁决中披露相关信息。

Query_Text_en: Nothing in this Agreement shall affect the fiscal privileges of members of diplomatic missions or consular posts under the general rules of international law or under the provisions of special agreements .
Translation: 本协议中的任何内容均不影响外交使团或领事馆成员根据国际法一般原则或特别协定的规定所享有的财政特权。

Query_Text_en: The Contracting States shall notify each other in writing through diplomatic channels that the procedures required by their respective laws for the bringing into force of this Agreement have been completed .
Translation: 缔约双方应通过外交渠道书面通知对方，各自根据本国法律完成的关于本协议生效所需的程序已经履行完毕。

Query_Text_en: The Agreement shall enter into force on the 30th day after the date of the later of the notifications .
Translation: 本协议应自较晚通知的日期起第30日生效。

Query_Text_en: It shall apply to income arising as from 1 January of the year following that of its entry into force or to income pertaining to taxable periods beginning as from 1 January of the year following that of its entry into force .
Translation: 本协定应适用于其生效次年1月1日起产生的所得，或适用于应税期间自其生效次年1月1日起开始的所得。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall remain in force indefinitely .
Translation: 本协议应无限期保持有效。
