Query_Text_en: However , 5 years after entry into force , each of the Contracting State may give notice through diplomatic channels , before 1 July of a calendar year of termination of this Agreement at the end of that calendar year .
Translation: 本协议生效满五年后，各缔约国可于该日历年度的一月一日之前通过外交渠道通知终止本协议，终止生效时间为该日历年结束时。

Query_Text_en: In such case , the Agreement shall cease to apply for the last time to income arising as from 1 January of the year following that of termination or to income pertaining to taxable periods begining as from 1 January of the year following that of termination .
Translation: 在上述情况下，本协定将最终停止适用于终止年份次年1月1日起产生的所得，或纳税年度始于终止年份次年1月1日的所得。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF , the undersigned , duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments , have signed this Agreement .
Translation: 兹证明，各方签约人经其各自政府正式授权，签署本协议。

Query_Text_en: DONE at Beijing , 18 April 1985 , in duplicate in the Chinese and French , Dutch languages , the three texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本协议于1985年4月18日在北京签署，以中、法、荷兰三国文字写成，三种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: The term `` Aeronautical Authorities '' means , in the case of the People 's Republic of China , the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China and , in the case of the Kingdom of Greece , the Civil Aviation Authority ;
Translation: “航空当局”一词，在中华人民共和国的情况下，指中国民用航空局；在希腊王国的情况下，则指希腊民航局。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The term `` designated airline '' means an airline which one Contracting Party shall have designated , by written notification to the other Contracting Party , in accordance with Article 3 of the present Agreement , for the operation of the agreed services on the route specified in the Annex to the present Agreement ;
Translation: “指定航空公司”一词指一方缔约方根据本协议第三条，通过书面通知另一方缔约方指定的、用于在本协议附件所规定的航线上运营双方同意的服务的航空公司；

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` air service '' means any scheduled air service performed by aircraft for the public transport of passengers , cargo or mail ;
Translation: "航空运输服务"指航空器执行的、用于公众运输乘客、货物或邮件的定期航空运输服务。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term `` international air service '' means an air service which passes through the air space over the territory of more than one State ;
Translation: “国际航空服务”是指经过一个以上国家领土领空的航空运输服务。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The term `` airline '' means any air transport enterprise operating an international air service ;
Translation: “航空公司”一词指从事国际航空运输服务运营的任何航空运输企业。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The term `` stop for non-traffic purposes '' means the technical landing for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers , cargo or mail .
Translation: “非交通目的停靠”指除上下旅客、装卸货物或邮件外，因其他任何目的而进行的技术性着陆。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 1 . Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the right to operate scheduled air services [ hereinafter called `` the agreed services '' ] on the routes specified in Annex I to the present Agreement [ hereinafter referred to as `` the specified routes '' ] for carriage of international passengers , baggage , cargo and mail .
Translation: 第二条第一款 每一缔约方应准许另一缔约方在本协定附件一所列航线上【以下简称"指定航线"】经营定期航班服务【以下简称"约定服务"】，以载运国际旅客、行李、货物及邮件。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] to make stops at the point on the specified routes in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of putting down and taking on international traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail coming from or destined for the territory of the other Contracting Party or of a third country .
Translation: 在另一缔约方领土内的指定航线上指定点经停，以便装卸来自或前往该缔约方领土或第三国的国际运输旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall not enjoy the right to take up at one point in the territory of the other Contracting Party traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail destined for another point in the same territory .
Translation: 每一缔约方指定的航空公司不得享有在另一缔约方领土内的一个地点，从事将旅客、行李、货物和邮件运往该领土内另一点的权利。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Each territory party shall notify the other Contracting Party sixty [ 60 ] days in advance of the date of the commencement of operation of the agreed services by its designated airline .
Translation: 每一缔约方应在其指定航空公司开始运营协议规定的航空服务之日六十（60）日前，通知另一缔约方。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 1 . Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate , by diplomatic note to the other Contracting Party , one airline to operate scheduled international air services on the routes specified in Annex I to the present Agreement .
Translation:
第三条第一款  
每一缔约方有权通过外交信函通知另一缔约方，指定一家航空公司在本协定附录一所列航线上经营定期国际航空运输业务。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The substantial ownership and effective control of the airline designated by each Contracting Party shall remain vested in such Contracting Party or its citizens .
Translation: 各缔约方指定的航空公司，其实质性所有权和有效控制权应始终属于该缔约方或其公民。

Query_Text_en: 3 . On receipt of such designation , the other Contracting Party shall , subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article , grant without delay to the designated airline of the first Contracting Party the appropriate operating authorization .
Translation: 收到此类指定后，另一缔约方应根据本条第2款规定，在遵守相关条款的前提下，立即向首先指定的缔约方指定空运企业授予相应的运营许可。

Query_Text_en: or [ c ] where that airline otherwise fails to operate in accordance with the conditions prescribed under the present Agreement .
Translation: 或（C）若该航空公司未能按照本协议规定之条件运营。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Unless immediate revocation , suspension or imposition of the conditions mentioned in paragraph 1 of this Article is essential to prevent further infringements of laws and regulations , such right shall be exercised only after consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 除非立即撤销、暂停或采取本条第一款所述条件是防止进一步违反法律法规的必要措施，否则该权利的行使须经另一缔约方协商后方可实施。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 1 . Aircraft operated on the specified routes by the designated airline of either Contracting Party , as well as the regular equipment , spare parts , fuel , oil , lubricants and aircraft stores retained on board the aircraft shall be exempted on a basis of reciprocity from any customs duties , inspection fees and other charges by the other Contracting Party on arrival in and departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 根据对等原则，任一缔约方指定航空公司运营指定航线的航空器，以及留存在该航空器上的常规设备、备件、燃料、滑油、润滑剂及机上用品，在进出另一缔约方领土时，应免纳另一缔约方征收的关税、检验费及其他费用。

Query_Text_en: The above mentioned regular equipment , spare parts and aircraft stores may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only after approval has been obtained from the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 上述常规设备、备件及航材仅在经另一缔约方海关当局批准后，方可卸载于该缔约方领土内。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The fuel , oil , lubricants and aircraft stores for consumption replenished to or taken on board the aircraft in the territory of the other Contracting Party by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party for the operation of the specified routes shall be exempted on a basis of reciprocity from customs duties , inspection fees and other charges by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第一缔约方指定空运企业在运营指定航线时，在另一方缔约方领土内补充或装载到飞机上的燃料、油料、润滑油及机载物料，应由另一方缔约方在互惠基础上免征关税、检验费及其他相关费用。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Spare parts and regular airborne equipment introduced into the territory of the other Contracting Party for the maintenance and repair of the aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party shall also be exempted on a basis of reciprocity from customs duties , inspection fees and other charges by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方指定空运企业为在协定航线上运营的航空器进行维护和修理而输入另一缔约方境内的零部件及常规机载设备，亦应由另一缔约方在对等基础上免征关税、检验费及其他税费。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The articles unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party as mentioned in paragraph 1 of this Article as well as the articles introduced into the said territory as mentioned in paragraph 3 of this Article shall be kept under customs supervision and control subject to storage charges , as per the regulations of the other Contracting Party , and shall not be sold or used for other purposes in the said territory until such time as they are re-exported or disposed of in accordance with the regulations of the above mentioned customs authorities .
Translation: 根据本条第一款在另一缔约方领土内卸载的货物，以及根据第三款输入该领土的货物，应按照对方缔约方的相关规定接受海关监管和控制，并缴纳仓储费用。此类货物不得在该领土内销售或用于其他用途，直至其被重新出口或根据上述海关主管部门的规定完成处置。

Query_Text_en: Article 6The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the admission to , stay in , departure from and navigation in its territory of aircraft engaged in the operation of international air services as well as the laws and regulations relating to the admission to , stay in and departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail shall be applicable to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , its passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail carried by such aircraft , while in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第六条  
本协定任一缔约方有关从事国际航空运输的航空器在其领土内入境、停留、离境及航行的法律和法规，以及有关其领土内乘客、机组、行李、货物和邮件入境、停留及离境的法律和法规，均适用于另一缔约方指定空运企业运营的航空器及其所载运的乘客、机组、行李、货物和邮件，当这些航空器及相关人员和物品处于首先提及的缔约方领土内时。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall supply the other Contracting Party information relevant to the above mentioned laws and regulations in time .
Translation: 每一缔约方应及时向另一缔约方提供与上述法律法规相关的资料。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 1 . Each Contracting Party grants to the designated airline of the other Contracting Party the right of free transfer at the official rate of exchange of the excess of receipts over expenditure earned by that airline in its territory in connection with the carriage of passengers , baggage , mail and cargo .
Translation: 缔约各方应准许对方指定的航空公司在其领土内因运输旅客、行李、邮件和货物所获得的收入超过支出的差额，以官方汇率自由兑换。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Whenever the payments system between Contracting Parties is governed by a specified agreement , this agreement shall apply .
Translation: 当缔约方之间的支付系统受特定协议管辖时，该协议应适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 8Passengers , baggage and cargo in direct transit across the territory of either Contracting Party and not leaving the area of the airport reserved for such purpose shall normally be subject to a simplified control . Baggage and cargo in direct transit shall be exempt from custom duties and other similar taxes .
Translation: 第八条  通过任一缔约方领土过境的旅客、行李及货物，若未离开机场为此目的保留的区域，通常应适用简化监管。直接过境的行李及货物应免征关税和其他类似税费。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 1 . Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory airport and alternate airports to be used by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified routes , and provide the latter with communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary services in its territory as are required for the operation of the agreed services in accordance with provisions laid down in Annex II to the present Agreement .
Translation:
第九条  
1. 每一缔约方应在其领土内指定供另一缔约方指定航空公司运营指定航线所使用的机场和备降机场，并根据本协议附件二的规定，向其提供在其领土内运营约定服务所需的通信、导航、气象及其他辅助服务。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The designated airline of one Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airport [ s ] , equipment and technical services of the other Contracting Party at the just and reasonable rates prescribed by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 某一缔约方指定的航空公司应按照另一缔约方规定的公正合理的费率，向另一方缴纳使用其机场、设备及技术服务的费用。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 1 . The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall have fair and equal opportunities in operating the agreed services on the specified routes .
Translation: 第十条第一款 本协定缔约双方指定的空运企业，在指定航线上经营协议规定的航空服务时，应享有公平和平等的机会。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Matters relating to frequency , type of aircraft , schedule , conditions of carriage , sales representation and ground handling in the operation of the specified routes shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and shall be subject to the approval of their respective Aeronautical Authorities .
Translation: 关于指定航线上运营涉及的航班班次、机型、航班时刻、运输条件、销售代理及地面服务等事宜，应由双方缔约方指定的空运企业通过协商确定，并须经各自航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In operating the agreed services , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services which the latter provides on the whole or part of the same routes .
Translation: 在运营协议服务时，每一缔约方指定的航空公司应顾及其他缔约方指定航空公司的利益，以免对其在同一航线上全部或部分航段所提供的服务造成不当影响。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The agreed services provided by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall bear close relationship to the requirements of the public for transportation on the specified routes and shall have as their primary objective the provision , at a reasonable load factor , of capacity adequate to satisfy the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party which has designated the airline .
Translation: 缔约双方指定航空公司的约定服务应与指定航线上公众的运输需求密切相关，并应以合理载运率为基础，提供足够的运力，以满足始发或目的地为指定该航空公司的缔约方领土的旅客、行李、货物及邮件当前及合理预期的运输需求。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] The requirements of through airline operation .
Translation: 联程航班运营的要求。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 1 . The tariffs to be charged by the designated airline of one Contracting Party for carriage to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors , including cost of operation , reasonable profit , and the tariffs of other airlines .
Translation: 第一条十一款一、缔约一方指定空运企业往来另一缔约方领土的运输服务收费，应综合考虑运营成本、合理利润以及其他航空公司的收费标准等因素，设定在合理水平。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The tariffs referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties ; where possible , consultation may be made with other airlines operating over the whole and part of the same routes .
Translation: 本条第一款所指运价应由双方缔约方指定航空公司通过协商确定；在可能情况下，可与其他在同一航线全部或部分航段上运营的航空公司进行协商。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The tariff so agreed shall be submitted to the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties for approval at least sixty [ 60 ] days before the proposed date of their introduction .
Translation: 双方商定的关税应于拟议实施日期至少六十（60）日前提交缔约双方航空当局审批。

Query_Text_en: In special cases , this period may be reduced subject to the agreement of said Authorities .
Translation: 在特殊情况下，经相关当局同意，本期限可予以缩短。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If a tariff can not be agreed between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article , or if the Aeronautical Authorities of one Contracting Party give the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party notice of its disapproval of a tariff agreed in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article , the Aeronautical Authorities of the two Contracting Parties shall endevour to determine the tariff by mutual agreement .
Translation: 如果双方指定空运企业未能根据本条第二款规定达成运价协议，或缔约一方航空当局向另一方航空当局书面通知其反对根据本条第二款规定达成的运价协议，缔约双方航空当局应努力通过协商达成一致。

Query_Text_en: 5 . If the Aeronautical Authorities of the two Contracting Parties can not agree on any tariff submitted to them under paragraph 3 of this Article , or on the determination of any tariff under paragraph 4 of this Article , the difference of opinion shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article 16 of the present Agreement .
Translation: 如果本协议双方缔约方的航空当局就根据本条第三款提交的任何费率无法达成一致，或就根据本条第四款确定的任何费率存在分歧，则应按照本协议第十六条的规定予以解决。

Query_Text_en: 6 . A tariff established in accordance with the provisions of this Article shall remain in force until a new tariff has been established .
Translation: 根据本条款规定制定的关税应继续有效，直至新的关税确定。

Query_Text_en: 7 . In case where the Aeronautical Authorities of one Contracting Party notify the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party of their intention to terminate the application of a tariff , this tariff shall not remain in force for more than twelve [ 12 ] months after the date of receipt of this notification by the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party , unless an agreement would be reached during this period .
Translation: 缔约一方航空当局如通知缔约另一方航空当局其拟终止某项费率的适用，则自缔约另一方航空当局收到该通知之日起，该项费率不得继续有效超过十二[12]个月，除非在此期间达成协议。

Query_Text_en: Article 12The Aeronautical Authorities of each Contracting Party shall supply to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party , at their request , information and statistics relevant to the traffic to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party carried on the agreed services of the designated airlines of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十二条  
每一缔约国的航空当局应根据另一缔约国航空当局的请求，向其提供由该缔约国指定空运企业经营的协议航线上、前往或来自另一缔约国领土的航班运营相关数据和统计资料。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 1 . For the operation of the specified routes , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have the right to set up its representative office at the point of call on the specified routes in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第十三条第一款 为运营指定航线，各方指定空运企业有权在另一缔约方领土内指定航线的停靠点设立其代表处。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such representative office shall be citizens of the People 's Republic of China and of the Kingdom of Greece , and number of staff shall be agreed upon through consultation between the competent authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 此类代表处的工作人员应为中华人民共和国和希腊王国公民，其人数由双方主管部门通过协商确定。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such representative office must observe the laws and regulations in force of the country where such office is located .
Translation: 此类代表处的工作人员必须遵守该代表处所在国现行的法律法规。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Contracting Party shall extend assistance and convenience to the representative office and its staff members of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party and ensure their safety .
Translation: 每一缔约方应向另一缔约方指定航空公司的代表机构及其工作人员提供协助和便利，并确保其安全。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Contracting Party shall ensure the safety of the aircraft , stores and other properties in its territory used on the agreed services by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方应确保在其领土内由另一缔约方指定空运企业在根据协议提供服务时使用的航空器、供应品及其他财产的安全。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 1 . Aircraft of the airline designated by one Contracting Party during flights over the territory of the other Contracting Party shall bear its own nationality and registration marks and shall carry certificates of registration , certificates of airworthiness and other aircraft documents established by the Aeronautical Authorities of Contracting Parties and also permission for radio equipment .
Translation: 第十四条 一、缔约一方指定的航空公司在其领土上飞行期间，应显示其本国国籍和登记标志，并携带登记证、适航证以及缔约方航空当局制定的其他航空器文件，以及无线电设备使用许可。

Query_Text_en: Pilots and other crew members shall have effective personal certificates of competency .
Translation: 飞行员和其他机组人员应当持有有效适任证书。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall recognize the above mentioned valid documents issued by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方均应承认上述由另一缔约方签发的有效文件。

Query_Text_en: However , each Contracting Party reserves the right to refuse to recognize , for the purpose of flight over its own territory , the certificates of competency and licenses granted to its own citizens by the other Contracting Party or by any third country .
Translation: 但是，每一缔约国保留拒绝承认其他缔约国或任何第三国授予本国公民的、以飞越其领土为目的的合格证书和执照的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The crew members of the designated airline of either Contracting Party flying on the specified routes shall be citizens of their respective countries .
Translation: 任一缔约方指定航空公司在指定航线上飞行的机组成员应为各自国家的公民。

Query_Text_en: However , citizens of third countries may be employed as crew members for the operation of the agreed services subject to the approval of a list of names to be submitted to the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第三国公民可被雇佣为船员，负责操作协定服务，但须经拟提交名单报另一方缔约方批准。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] Communicate in writing to the first Contracting Party the results of the investigation .
Translation: 书面通知第一缔约方调查结果。

Query_Text_en: The expenses incurred in connection with the above mentioned investigation shall be borne by the party in whose territory the accident has occurred .
Translation: 与上述调查相关的费用应由事故发生的辖区内的当事方承担。

Query_Text_en: Article 16Both Contracting Parties shall ensure the correct implementation of the present Agreement in a spirit of close cooperation and mutual support .
Translation: 第十六条 缔约双方应本着密切合作和相互支持的精神，确保本协议得到正确实施。

Query_Text_en: If any difference of opinion arises in the respect of the interpretation or implementation of the present Agreement , the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties shall settle it through consultation in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual understanding . Failing to reach agreement , the Contracting Parties shall settle it through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 如对本协议的解释或执行产生任何分歧，缔约双方航空当局应本着友好合作和相互谅解的精神通过协商予以解决。如果未能达成一致，缔约双方应当通过外交渠道解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 17If either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to modify or amend any provision of the present Agreement or its Annexes it may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party and such consultation shall begin within a period of sixty [ 60 ] days from the date of receipt of the suggestion by the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第十七条  
如缔约任何一方认为有必要修改或修正本协议或其附件的任何条款，可随时要求与另一方进行磋商，此类磋商应于另一方收到建议之日起六十天内开始。

Query_Text_en: Any modification or amendment to the present Agreement or its Annexes shall come into force when they have been agreed upon through diplomatic notes between the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: 本协定及其附件的任何修改或修订，经缔约双方通过外交换文达成一致时，即行生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 18Annexes I and II to the present Agreement and the notes exchanged in connection hereto shall be an integral part of the present Agreement .
Translation: 第十八条 本协议的附件一和附件二以及与本协议相关的交换的谅解备忘录构成本协议的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Article 19Either Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party of its desire to terminate the present Agreement .
Translation: 第十九条 缔约任何一方可随时通知另一缔约方其终止本协定的意愿。

Query_Text_en: The present Agreement shall then terminate twelve months after the date of receipt of the notice by the other Contracting Party . If the above notice is withdrawn before expiry of this period , the present Agreement shall continue to be in force with the concurrence of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 本协议应在另一方缔约国收到通知之日起十二个月后终止。如果上述通知在该期限届满前被撤回，经另一方缔约国同意后，本协议将继续有效。

Query_Text_en: Article 20The present Agreement shall be applied provisionally as from the date of signature and shall enter into force officially after both Contracting Parties have respectively fulfilled their necessary formalities and notified each other to this effect through exchange of diplomatic notes .
Translation: 第二十条 本协议自签署之日起暂予实施，并在缔约双方各自完成必要法律程序并通过交换外交照会通知对方后正式生效。

Query_Text_en: In witness whereof the undersigned , being duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments , have signed the present Agreement .
Translation: 兹证明，下列签署人经各自政府正式授权，已签署本协议。

Query_Text_en: Done at Peking on this 23rd day of May , 1973 , in duplicate in Chinese , Greek and English languages , all three texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本文件于1973年5月23日在北京签订，以中文、希腊文和英文三种文本一式两份写成，三种文本具有同等法律效力。

Query_Text_en: Points in China , via Karachi or Rawalpindi , Kabul or Kandahar , Teheran , Bagdad , Kuwait , Damascus , Beirut , Ankara or Istanbul , Cairo to Athens or Thessaloniki , Tirana , Rome , Algiers , Paris , London and\/or points of extension in other countries to be agreed upon by the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: 中国经卡拉奇或拉瓦尔品第、喀布尔或坎大哈、德黑兰、巴格达、科威特、大马士革、贝鲁特、安卡拉或伊斯坦布尔、开罗至雅典或塞萨洛尼基、地拉那、罗马、阿尔及尔、巴黎、伦敦，以及经由两国缔约方同意的其他国家的延伸地点。

Query_Text_en: However , the said airline shall enjoy traffic rights between Athens and one point to be selected at its own option among Rome , Paris and London .
Translation: 然而，该航空公司可在罗马、巴黎和伦敦中自行选定一点，享有与雅典之间的航权。

Query_Text_en: Points in Greece , via intermediate points to be agreed upon by the two Contracting Parties , to Peking or Shanghai or Canton to Tokyo and\/or points of extension in other countries to be agreed upon by the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: 希腊境内的各点，经由双方缔约方协商确定的中间点，至北京、上海、广州或至东京，以及缔约双方协商确定的其他国家延伸点。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The designated airline of either Contracting Party shall not use more than four intermediate points listed above for each service .
Translation: 任一缔约方指定的航空公司每一项服务不得使用上述列出的超过四个中途点。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The aircraft of the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties flying the specified routes may omit any intermediate point and beyond point on their respective routes .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司的航班在指定航线上飞行时，可不降停航线中的任何中间经停点及终点站。

Query_Text_en: In such case , soonest possible submission of notification to this effect is required .
Translation: 在这种情况下，需尽快提交相关内容的通知。

Query_Text_en: 5 . In case the designated airline of one Contracting Party desires to operate special or charter flights to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party , the Aeronautical Authorities of the first Contracting Party shall submit request at least three working days before the day of operation to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party which shall be responsible for attending to the clearance formalities as well as for giving reply to the former .
Translation: 如某缔约方指定空运企业希望运营至另一缔约方领土的特殊航班或包机航班，该缔约方航空当局应至少提前三个工作日向另一缔约方航空当局提交申请，后者负责办理相关手续并予以答复。

Query_Text_en: In case the designated airline of one Contracting Party desires to operate additional flights on the specified routes , it shall , under normal circumstances , give notice to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party at least two working days before the day of operation and the flight shall be operated only after approval has been obtained therefrom .
Translation: 如某一方指定航空公司希望在指定航线上运营额外航班，应在正常情况下至少提前两个工作日通知另一方航空当局，并须经对方批准后方可执行。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Transportation of mail by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties on the agreed services shall be performed in accordance with the accepted international procedures .
Translation: 缔约双方指定航空公司在约定服务范围内运输邮件，应按照国际通行程序进行。

Query_Text_en: [ h ] aeronautical charts published .
Translation: [h] 航空图已出版。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Alterations or additions to the above-mentioned information , if any , shall be sent in time to the airline designated by the other Contracting Party in the form of NOTAM .
Translation: 上述信息如有任何修改或补充，应及时以航行通告形式提交至另一缔约方指定的航空公司。

Query_Text_en: Urgent NOTAM shall be transmitted in a proper way , and where necessary , directly by radio to the aircraft concerned of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party and later on confirmed in writing .
Translation: 紧急航行通告应以适当方式发送，必要时需通过无线电直接发送至另一缔约方指定航空公司的相关航空器，并随后以书面形式确认。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Aeronautical information and NOTAMs shall be made available in English .
Translation: 3. 航空情报和航行通告（NOTAMs）应以英文提供。

Query_Text_en: NOTAM code and abbreviations of the international usage shall be used in the transmission of NOTAMs .
Translation: 航行通告的国际通用代码和缩写应在航行通告的发布中使用。

Query_Text_en: II . Meteorological ServiceMeteorological service shall be provided in accordance with internationally adopted meteorological technical regulations .
Translation: 气象服务应按照国际认可的气象技术规范提供。

Query_Text_en: III . Air Traffic Control1 . Crew members of the aircraft of the airline designated by one Contracting Party flying the specified routes shall be fully conversant and strictly compliant with the air traffic control procedures of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方指定航空公司所属的航空器机组人员，在执飞指定航线时，应当熟练掌握并严格遵守另一缔约方的空中交通管制程序。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Prior to departure the pilot-in-command or his representative shall file a flight plan to be approved by the air traffic control services of the aerodrome of departure , and the flight should proceed according to the approved flight plan .
Translation: 航空器起飞前，机长或其代理人应当向起飞机场的空中交通管制部门提交飞行计划以获得批准，飞行活动应当按照批准的飞行计划执行。

Query_Text_en: in emergency where immediate deviation from the flight plan is required and there is no enough time for obtaining clearance from the air traffic control services concerned , the pilot-in-command shall have the right to deviate from the flight plan and concurrently notify the air traffic control services concerned of such deviation . The air traffic control services concerned shall do their best to cooperate with the pilot-in-command who , however , shall be responsible for any consequence arising therefrom .
Translation: 在紧急情况下，当需要立即偏离飞行计划且无法及时获得相关空中交通管制服务许可时，机长有权偏离飞行计划，并应同时将偏离情况通知相关空中交通管制服务部门。相关空中交通管制服务部门应尽力配合机长，但机长应对由此产生的任何后果负责。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Prior to each flight , the appropriate air traffic services of each Contracting Party shall , with the information available , brief the crew members of the aircraft on the aerodrome of departure , aerodrome of first destination and alternate along the specified routes , including radio communications and navigation facilities etc , as may be requires for the safe conduct of the flight .
Translation: 每次飞行前，各缔约国应根据可获得的信息，向机组成员就起飞机场、首个目的地机场以及指定航线上备降机场的情况进行简报，包括无线电通信、导航设施等确保飞行安全所需的相关信息。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The air traffic control services of one Contracting Party shall issue to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party instructions necessary for the safety and regularity of such flight when the aircraft is within its Flight Information Region [ F.
Translation: 某一缔约方的空中交通管制服务，应当向另一缔约方指定航空公司的飞机，在其飞行情报区（FIR）内飞行时，提供确保该航班安全与正常所需的必要指令。

Query_Text_en: I. R ] . IV . Radio Communications and Navigational Services1 . The procedure of the transmission of messages between the two countries for the purpose of operating the specified routes shall be observed in accordance with the provisions set forth in Addendum to this Annex .
Translation: 两国之间为运营指定航线而传递信息的程序应遵循本附件增补条款中规定的各项条款。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Aircraft used in the operation of the specified routes by the airline designated by one Contracting Party shall be provided to the greatest possible extent with equipment fit for operation on the radio communications and navigation facilities provided by the competent Authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 指定航空公司运营指定航线所使用的航空器，应在其最大可能范围内配备适配于另一缔约方主管机关提供的无线电通讯和导航设施的设备。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Aircraft used in the operation of the specified routes shall be equipped with necessary radio frequencies to operate on the ground radio communications and navigation facilities .
Translation: 在指定航线上运营的航空器应当配备必要的无线电频率，以便在地面无线电通信和导航设施中运行。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The pilot-in-command shall maintain a continuous two-way communication on the specified frequency with the designated air traffic control services .
Translation: 机长应当在指定频率上与指定的空中交通管制服务部门保持持续双向通信。

Query_Text_en: 5 . English language and aeronautical Q code of the international usage shall be used in the air-ground and point-to-point radio telegraph and radio telephony communications .
Translation: 在地空和点对点无线电报及无线电通话通信中应使用国际通用的英语语言和航空Q简语。

Query_Text_en: V. ConsultationIn case of necessity for consultation on matters pertaining to this Annex , such consultation shall be carried out between the competent Authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation:
第五条 咨询  
如需就本附录事宜进行磋商，应由双方主管机关进行。

Query_Text_en: ADDENDUM TO ANNEX IIProcedures for transmission ofAeronautical Messages between the two Countries1 . In view of the non-availability of direct point-to-point radio communication link between the competent authorities of the two Contracting Parties , the aeronautical messages between the said authorities shall be relayed via Karachi .
Translation:
关于两国航空电报传输程序的附加条款  
鉴于两国主管当局之间尚无直接点对点无线电通信链路，双方主管当局间的航空电报应通过卡拉奇转递。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Format of international usage shall be applied in the transmission of messages .
Translation: 2. 信息传输应采用国际通用格式。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Greenwich Mean Time shall be used in the transmission of messages .
Translation: 信息传输应使用格林尼治标准时间。

Query_Text_en: [ v ] concessions conferred by law or under contract if permitted by law , including concessions to search for and exploit natural resources .
Translation: 依法或依合同授予的特许权（在法律允许范围内），包括勘探和开发自然资源的特许权。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The term `` returns '' means profit , interest , dividends and other lawful income derived from investments .
Translation: 本准则所称“收益”，是指来源于投资的利润、利息、股息以及其他合法收入。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] with respect to the People 's Republic of China , a natural person who is of Chinese nationality in accordance with the Nationality Law of the People 's Republic of China .
Translation: 就中华人民共和国而言，指根据《中华人民共和国国籍法》具有中国国籍的自然人。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] with respect to the Kingdom of Norway , a natural person who is a citizen of the Kingdom of Norway according to its law .
Translation: 就挪威王国而言，根据其法律规定属于该国公民的自然人。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] with respect to the People 's Republic of China any economic entity established and domiciled in the territory of the People 's Republic of China under its law .
Translation: 就中华人民共和国而言，指根据中华人民共和国法律在中国境内设立并登记的任何经济实体。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] with respect to the Kingdom of Norway , any juridical person as well as any sole proprietorship or any company or association , irrespective of whether the liability of its partners , associates or members is limited or unlimited and whether or not its activities are directed at profit , having its seat in the territory of Norway .
Translation: 关于挪威王国，指在挪威王国境内设立的任何法人、独资企业、公司或协会，无论其合伙人的责任、成员的责任或股东的责任是否有限或无限，亦无论其经营活动是否以营利为目的。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 Applicability of this AgreementThis Agreement shall apply to investments made in the territory of the Kingdom of Norway under its laws and regulations by nationals or companies of the People 's Republic of China and to investments made in the territory of the People 's Republic of China under its laws and regulations by nationals or companies of the Kingdom of Norway prior to as well as after the entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation:
第二条 本协定的适用范围  
本协定适用于中华人民共和国国民或公司在挪威王国领土内根据其法律和法规所进行的投资，以及挪威王国国民或公司在中华人民共和国领土内根据其法律和法规所进行的投资，包括本协定生效前以及生效后所进行的投资。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Promotion and Protection of InvestmentsEach Contracting Party shall encourage nationals or companies of the other Contracting Party to commit investments in its territory , and accept such investments in accordance with its laws and regulations and accord them equitable and reasonable treatment and protection .
Translation:
第三条 投资的促进与保护  
每一缔约方应鼓励另一缔约方的自然人或企业在其境内进行投资，并依据其法律法规接受此类投资，同时给予公平合理待遇和保护。

Query_Text_en: Such investments shall be consistent with the national objectives of and be subject to the laws and regulations of the Contracting Party in whose territory the investments are made .
Translation: 此类投资应符合投资所在缔约方的国家发展目标，并遵守该缔约方的法律法规。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 Most-Favoured-Nation Provisions1 . Investments made by nationals or companies of one Contracting Party in the territory of the Other Contracting Party shall be accorded treatment no less favourable than that accorded to investments made by nationals or companies of any third State .
Translation:
第四条 最惠国待遇条款  
缔约一方的自然人或公司依据本条规定在另一缔约方境内所作的投资，应享受不低于该缔约方给予其他任何第三国自然人或公司投资的待遇。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Nationals or companies of one Contracting Party whose investments suffer losses in the territory of the other Contracting Party owing to war , other armed conflicts , state of national emergency or other similar events shall be accorded treatment no less favourable than that accorded to nationals or companies of any third State , if the other Contracting Party take any measures relating to such losses .
Translation: 一方缔约方的国民或公司在另一方缔约方境内因战争、其他武装冲突、国家紧急状态或其他类似事件遭受投资损失时，若另一方缔约方采取与上述损失相关的措施，应给予的待遇不得低于其给予任何第三国国民或公司的待遇。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] any advantage accorded to nationals or companies of a third State by the other Contracting Party for the purpose of facilitating frontier trade .
Translation: 另一缔约方为便利边境贸易而给予第三国自然人或企业的任何优惠待遇。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] shall be against compensation .
Translation: [iii] 不予补偿。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The amount of compensation shall be paid without undue delay and shall be convertible and freely transferable .
Translation: 赔偿金额应尽快支付，并应为可兑换且可自由转移的。

Query_Text_en: Such compensation shall amount to the value of the investment immediately before the expropriation and shall include interest until the date of payment .
Translation: 此类补偿应相当于征收前的时点价值，并包括直至支付日的利息。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] the lawful earnings of nationals of the other Contracting Party who work in connection with an investment in the territory of one Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方领土内进行投资相关受雇工作的另一缔约方国民的合法收益。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The treatment accorded under the provisions of Paragraph 1 of this Article by one Contracting Party to nationals or companies of the other Contracting Party shall be no less favourable than that accorded to nationals or companies of any third State .
Translation: 根据本条第一款规定，一方缔约方给予另一方缔约方公民或公司的待遇，不得低于其给予任何第三国公民或公司所享受的待遇。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 SubrogationIf a Contracting Party guarantees an investment made by its nationals or companies in territory of the other Contracting Party and makes a payment to its nationals or companies under the guaranty , the other Contracting Party shall recognize the transfer of the relevant rights of such nationals or companies to the one Contracting Party and the subrogation of the one Contracting Party to such rights .
Translation:
第七条 代位权  
如一缔约方对其国民或公司在另一缔约方领土内所进行的投资提供担保，并根据担保条款向其国民或公司进行赔付，则另一缔约方应承认该国民或公司的相关权利转移至该缔约方，并承认该缔约方因此取得的代位权。

Query_Text_en: But the rights subrogated by the one Contracting Party shall not exceed the rights of the original nationals or companies .
Translation: 但一方缔约方让渡的权利不得超过原属国民或公司的权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Settlement of Disputesbetween the Contracting Parties1 . Disputes between the Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement shall , as far as possible , be settled through friendly consultation .
Translation:
第八条 缔约方之间争端的解决  
1. 缔约方之间因本协议解释或适用产生的争端，应尽可能通过友好协商解决。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If a dispute can not thus be settled within six months , it shall , upon the request of either Contracting Party , be submitted to an arbitral tribunal .
Translation: 如果争端在六个月内仍无法通过这种方式解决，应任何一方缔约方的请求，应将其提交仲裁庭。

Query_Text_en: each Contracting Party shall appoint an arbitrator . The two arbitrators shall appoint a third arbitrator as Chairman , who is a national of a third State which has diplomatic relations with both Contracting Parties . The Chairman shall be approved by both Parties .
Translation: 每一缔约方应指定一名仲裁员。两位仲裁员应指定第三名仲裁员担任主席，该主席应为与双方缔约方均有外交关系的第三国国民。主席人选须经双方缔约方批准。

Query_Text_en: The arbitrators shall be appointed within two months and the Chairman within four months from the date when one Contracting Party notifies the other Contracting Party of its submission of the dispute to arbitration .
Translation: 自一缔约方通知另一缔约方将其争议提交仲裁之日起，仲裁员应在两个月内指定，主席应在四个月内指定。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If appointments are not made within the period specified in paragraph 3 , either Contracting Party may , in the absence of any other agreement , invite the President of the International Court of Justice to make any necessary appointments .
Translation: 若未在本条第3段规定的期限内完成任命，且缔约双方未达成其他协议，则任一缔约方得请求国际法院院长进行必要的任命。

Query_Text_en: If the President is a national of either Contracting Party or is otherwise unable to discharge the said function , the Vice President or next most senior member or the International Court of Justice shall be invited make the necessary appointments .
Translation: 如国际法院院长为缔约方的国民或因其他原因无法履行上述职责，则应邀请副院长或级别最高的其他成员作出必要的任命。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The arbitral tribunal shall reach its decision by a majority vote . Such decision shall be binding on both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 仲裁庭应以多数票表决的方式作出决定。该裁决对双方缔约方具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall bear the cost of its own arbitrator and of its representation in the arbitral proceedings .
Translation: 每一缔约方应承担其自身仲裁员的费用及其在仲裁程序中的代理费用。

Query_Text_en: The cost of Chairman in discharging his arbitral function shall be borne equally by the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 仲裁主席履行仲裁职责所产生的费用应由缔约各方平均承担。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The arbitral tribunal shall determine its own procedures .
Translation: 仲裁庭有权自行决定其程序安排。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 Entry into Force , Duration and Termination1 . This Agreement shall enter into force thirty days after the date of notification by each Contracting Party of the fulfillment of its respective internal legal procedures necessary for its entry into force .
Translation: 本协定应在各缔约方就各自完成为本协议生效所需的内部法律程序发出通知之日起三十日后生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of fifteen years .
Translation: 本协议有效期为十五年。

Query_Text_en: If neither Contracting Party terminates it by giving a written notice to the other Contracting Party after the expiry of the initial period of fourteen years , this Agreement shall continue in force .
Translation: 如果缔约双方在十四年初始期限届满后未以书面通知方式终止本协议，则本协议将继续有效。

Query_Text_en: 3 . After the expiry of the initial fifteen-year period , either Contracting Party may notify in writing at any time the other Contracting Party of the termination of this Agreement . This Agreement shall remain in force for one year from the date of notice of termination .
Translation: 3. 在初始十五年期满后，任一缔约方可随时以书面形式通知另一方终止本协议。本协议应自终止通知之日起继续有效一年。

Query_Text_en: 4 . With respect to investments made prior to the date of termination of this Agreement , the provisions of all of the other Articles of this Agreement shall continue to be effective for a further period of fifteen years from the date of termination .
Translation: 对于本协议终止日期之前所作的投资，本协议其他条款的规定自终止之日起继续有效十五年。

Query_Text_en: Done in duplicates at Beijing , on November 21 , 1984 . in the Chinese , Norwegian and English languages , all texts being equally authentic . In case of divergencies of interpretation the English text shall prevail .
Translation: 本文件于1984年11月21日在北京签署，一式两份。中文、挪威文和英文三种文本具有同等效力。如对解释存在分歧，以英文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: 1 . `` Investment '' mentioned in Paragraph 1 of Article I includes investment of a juridical person in a third state which is controlled by nationals or companies of one Contracting Party and which is established in the territory of the other Contracting Party under the laws and regulations of the latter one .
Translation: 第一条所称"投资"包括一缔约方的国民或公司控制的法人实体在第三国所作的投资，且该法人实体根据另一缔约方的法律和法规在其领土内设立。

Query_Text_en: The relevant provisions of this Agreement shall apply to such investment only when such third State has no right or abandons the right to claim compensation after the investment is expropriated by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 本协议的相关规定仅在第三国无权主张或放弃就该等投资被另一缔约方征收所提出的补偿请求权时方适用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . [ i ] Concerning `` expropriation '' in Article V , if a national or company of either Contracting Party whose investment is expropriated asserts that the expropriation does not conform to the law of the Contracting Party taking the expropriatory measures , the competent legislature or courts of the Contracting Party taking the expropriatory measures may upon the request of such national or company , review such expropriation .
Translation: 关于第五条中“征收”的规定，如某缔约方的国民或公司其投资被征收，且主张该征收不符合采取征收措施的缔约方法律，采取征收措施的缔约方有权的立法或司法机构可应该等国民或公司的请求，对该征收行为进行审查。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] If a national or company of one Contracting Party whose investment has been expropriated challenges the amount of the compensation , such national or company may negotiate it with the other Contracting Party which adopted the expropriatory measures .
Translation: [ 二 ] 如果某一缔约方的国民或企业对其投资被征收的补偿金额提出异议，该国民或企业可与采取征收措施的另一缔约方进行协商。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] If no agreement is reached within six months from the commencement of the negotiation , the competent courts of the other Contracting Party taking the expropriatory measures or an international arbitral tribunal shall , upon the request of such national or company of one Contracting Party , review the amount of the compensation .
Translation: 如果自谈判开始之日起六个月内未达成协议，采取征用措施的缔约方的主管法院或国际仲裁庭应根据一缔约方的国民或公司的请求，对补偿金额进行审查。

Query_Text_en: each party concerned shall appoint an arbitrator . The two arbitrators shall appoint an arbitrator as Chairman , who is a national of a third State which shall have diplomatic relations with both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 各方应各指定一名仲裁员。两位仲裁员应共同指定一名主席仲裁员，该主席仲裁员应为与缔约双方均有外交关系的第三国国民。

Query_Text_en: The arbitrators shall be appointed within two months and the Chairman within four months from the date when one party concerned notifies the other party of its submission of the dispute to arbitration .
Translation: 自有关一方通知另一方将其争议提交仲裁之日起，仲裁员应于两个月内任命，仲裁主席应于四个月内任命。

Query_Text_en: If the necessary appointments are not made within the period specified in the previous Paragraph , either party may , in the absence of any other agreement , request the chairman of the International Arbitration Institute of the Stockholm Chamber of Commerce to make the necessary appointments .
Translation: 如未在前款规定的期限内作出必要任命，且各方未达成其他约定的，任何一方均有权请求斯德哥尔摩商会国际仲裁院院长作出必要任命。

Query_Text_en: The arbitral tribunal shall determine its own arbitral procedures with reference to the `` Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes Between States and Nationals of Other States '' done at washington on March 18 , 1965 .
Translation: 仲裁庭应参照1965年3月18日于华盛顿签订的《解决国家和他国国民间投资争端公约》，自行确定其仲裁程序。

Query_Text_en: The decision of the arbitral tribunal shall be final and binding , and shall be enforceable in accordance with domestic laws .
Translation: 仲裁庭的裁决应为终局的，并具有约束力，且可根据国内法律予以强制执行。

Query_Text_en: The arbitral tribunal shall state the basis of its decision and state reasons upon the request of either party concerned .
Translation: 仲裁庭应说明决定的依据，并在有关方请求时说明理由。

Query_Text_en: Each party concerned shall bear the cost of its own arbitrator and its representation in the arbitral proceedings .
Translation: 每一方当事人应当承担其自身仲裁员及在仲裁程序中的代理费用。

Query_Text_en: The cost of the Chairman in discharging his arbitral function shall be borne equally by the parties concerned .
Translation: 主席履行仲裁职责的费用应由有关方平均承担。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any other dispute over an investment between one Contracting Party and a national or company of the other Contracting Party shall be settled through the local remedies of the one Contracting Party under its laws and regulations .
Translation: 缔约一方与缔约另一方的自然人或企业之间产生的其他投资争端，应通过该缔约方根据其法律法规提供的当地法律救济途径予以解决。

Query_Text_en: But such provisions shall not exclude both Contracting Parties from using the procedures specified in Article VIII where a dispute concerns the interpretation or application of this Agreement .
Translation: 但本条规定不应妨碍缔约双方在争议涉及本协议的解释或适用时，使用第八条规定的程序。

Query_Text_en: 4 . This Agreement shall also apply to investments made by nationals or companies of one Contracting Party in the maritime zone or on the Continental Shelf where the other Contracting Party exercises its sovereignity , sovereign rights or jurisdiction .
Translation: 本协定亦适用于缔约一方的国民或企业所进行的投资，该等投资位于另一缔约方行使主权、主权权利或管辖权的海域或大陆架区域内。

Query_Text_en: Done in duplicate at Beijing , on November 21 , 1984 in the Chinese , Norwegian and English language , all texts being equally authentic . In case of divergencies of interpretation the English text shall prevail .
Translation: 本文件于1984年11月21日在北京一式两份签署，用中文、挪威文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。如对解释发生分歧，以英文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Agreement shall apply to taxes on income and on capital imposed on behalf of a Contracting State or of its political subdivisions or local authorities , irrespective of the manner in which they are levied .
Translation: 本协定应适用于缔约国或其地方行政区域或地方政府代表名义征收的所得和资本税，无论其征收方式如何。

Query_Text_en: 2 . There shall be regarded as taxes on income and on capital all taxes imposed on total income , on total capital , or on elements of income or of capital , including taxes on gains from the alienation of movable or immovable property , taxes on the total amounts of wages or salaries paid by enterprises , as well as taxes on capital appreciation .
Translation: 应视为对收入和资本征收的税，包括所有针对总收入、总资本或收入及资本组成部分所征收的税款，具体涵盖转让动产或不动产所获收益的税收、企业支付的工资或薪金总额的税收，以及资本增值税。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] the income tax on enterprises with foreign investment and foreign enterprises ;
Translation: [ii] 外商投资企业和外国企业的企业所得税；

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] the income tax including the natural gas investment tax ;
Translation: （二）所得税（含天然气投资税）；

Query_Text_en: 4 . This Agreement shall apply also to any identical or substantially similar taxes which are imposed after the date of signature of this Agreement in addition to , or in place of , the existing taxes .
Translation: 本协定亦适用于本协定签署日后征收的任何相同或实质相似的税种，无论该税种是附加于现有税种之上，还是取代现有税种。

Query_Text_en: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall notify each other of any significant changes which have been made in their respective taxation laws .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局应当相互通知各自税收法律所作的任何重大变更。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] in the case of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia , the Ministry of Finance represented by the Minister of Finance or his authorised representative .
Translation: 沙特阿拉伯王国方面，财政部由财政部长或其授权代表进行代表。

Query_Text_en: 2 . As regards the application of this Agreement at any time by a Contracting State , any term not defined therein shall , unless the context otherwise requires , have the meaning that it has at that time under the law of that State for the purposes of the taxes to which the Agreement applies , any meaning under the applicable tax laws of that State prevailing over a meaning given to the term under other laws of that State .
Translation: 就本协议由任一缔约国适用而言，凡本协议未作定义之用语，除非上下文另有要求，应具有该国当时法律下适用于本协议所涉税种之含义，且该国适用税法中之含义应优先于该国其他法律中赋予该用语之含义。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term resident of a Contracting State means any person who , under the laws of that Contracting State , is liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile , residence , place of management or head office , or any other criterion of a similar nature , and also includes that State and any political subdivision or local authority thereof .
Translation: 根据本协定之规定，"缔约国一方居民"系指按照该缔约国法律，因住所、居所、管理机构所在地、总机构所在地或其他类似标准而在该国负有纳税义务的任何个人或实体，且包括该国及其任何政治分支机构或地方当局。

Query_Text_en: This term , however , does not include any person who is liable to tax in that State in respect only of income from sources in that State or capital situated therein .
Translation: 然而，本术语不包括仅因来源于该州的所得或位于该州的资本而负有纳税义务的任何个人。

Query_Text_en: d ] if he is a national of both Contracting States or of neither of them , the competent authorities of the Contracting States shall settle the question by mutual agreement .
Translation: 如果该人为缔约国双方的国民或都不是缔约国国民，缔约国主管当局应通过相互协商解决该问题。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Where by reason of the provisions of paragraph 1 herein , a person other than an individual is a resident of both Contracting States , then it shall be deemed to be a resident only of the State in which its place of effective management or head office is situated .
Translation: 根据本条第一款规定，某一非个人实体同时为缔约国双方居民的，则该实体应仅视为其实际管理机构或总机构所在地所在国的居民。

Query_Text_en: f ] a mine , a quarry or any other place of extraction of natural resources .
Translation: 矿山、采石场或其他自然资源开采地。

Query_Text_en: b ] the furnishing of services , including consultancy services , by an enterprise through employees or other personnel engaged by an enterprise for such purpose , but only where activities of that nature continue [ for the same or a connected project ] within the Contracting State for a period or periods aggregating more than six months within any twelve-month period .
Translation: 企业通过其雇佣的员工或其他人员提供服务（包括咨询服务），但仅在为同一项目或相关联的项目开展此类活动的情况下，在任何连续十二个月期间内在缔约国境内持续进行的期限或期限累计超过六个月时适用。

Query_Text_en: f ] the maintenance of a fixed place of business solely for any combination of activities mentioned in subparagraphs a ] to e ] , provided that the overall activity of the fixed place of business resulting from this combination is of a preparatory or auxiliary character .
Translation: 仅为上述子条款a]至e]所述活动的任意组合而设立的固定营业场所，只要该营业场所由此类组合活动产生的整体性质属于准备性或辅助性特征。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , where a person -- other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies -- is acting on behalf of an enterprise and has , and habitually exercises , in a Contracting State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in that State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise , unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 尽管本条第一款和第二款有规定，如果某人（不包括适用第六款的独立地位代理人）代表企业行事，并在某一缔约国境内拥有且通常行使以该企业名义签订合同的权限，则该企业应视为在该国就该人员为该企业进行的任何活动设有常设机构。但若该人员的活动仅限于第四款所列情形，则不在此限——若这些活动通过固定营业场所进行，根据该款规定本不会构成该固定场所成为常设机构的情形。

Query_Text_en: 6 . An enterprise of a Contracting State shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that other Contracting State through a broker , general commission agent or any other agent of an independent status , provided that such persons are acting in the ordinary course of their business .
Translation: 缔约国一方的企业，仅因通过经纪人、一般佣金代理人或其他具有独立地位的代理人在缔约国另一方从事营业活动，而不构成在该缔约国另一方设有常设机构，前提是这些人员从事的是其常规业务活动。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The fact that a company which is a resident of a Contracting State controls or is controlled by a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State , or which carries on business in that other Contracting State [ whether through a permanent establishment or otherwise ] , shall not of itself constitute either company a permanent establishment of the other .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民公司控制或被缔约国另一方居民公司控制，或者在缔约国另一方从事营业活动（无论是通过常设机构或其他方式），这一事实本身并不构成任何一方公司在另一方的常设机构。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Income derived by a resident of a Contracting State from immovable property [ including income from agriculture or forestry ] situated in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民取得的来源于位于另一缔约国境内的不动产（包括农业或林业活动所得）的所得，可以在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The term immovable property shall have the meaning which it has under the laws of the Contracting State in which the property in question is situated .
Translation: 不动产一词应具有该财产所在地缔约国法律所规定的含义。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall apply to income derived from the direct use , letting or use in any other form of immovable property .
Translation: 本条第一款的规定适用于来源于不动产直接使用、出租或者其他任何形式使用所产生的收入。

Query_Text_en: If the enterprise carries on business as aforesaid , the profits of the enterprise may be taxed in the other Contracting State but only so much of them as is attributable to that permanent establishment .
Translation: 如果该企业从事上述业务活动，则其利润可在另一缔约国征税，但仅限于归属于该常设机构的部分。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In the determination of the profits of a permanent establishment , there shall be allowed as deductions expenses which are incurred for the purposes of the business of the permanent establishment including executive and general administrative expenses so incurred , whether in the Contracting State in which the permanent establishment is situated or elsewhere .
Translation: 在确定常设机构利润时，应准予扣除与常设机构业务有关的费用，包括所发生的行政和管理费用，无论该费用发生在该常设机构所在的缔约国境内还是境外。

Query_Text_en: However , no such deduction shall be allowed in respect of amounts , if any , paid [ otherwise than towards reimbursement of actual expenses ] by the permanent establishment to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices , by way of royalties , fees or other similar payments in return for the use of patents or other rights , or by way of commission , for specific services performed or for management , or , except in the case of a banking enterprise , by way of income from debt-claims with regard to moneys lent to the permanent establishment .
Translation: 然而，如果常设机构向企业总机构或其他营业机构支付的款项（非用于补偿实际支出的部分）属于以下情形，则不得扣除：因使用专利或其他权利而支付的特许权使用费、管理费或其他类似款项；因提供特定服务或管理而支付的佣金；或除银行业企业外，向该常设机构提供的贷款所取得的债权收入。

Query_Text_en: Likewise , no account shall be taken , in the determination of the profits of a permanent establishment , for amounts charged [ otherwise than towards reimbursement of actual expenses ] , by the permanent establishment to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices , by way of royalties , fees or other similar payments in return for the use of patents or other rights , or by way of commission for specific services performed or for management , or , except in the case of a banking enterprise , by way of income from debt-claims with regard to moneys lent to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices .
Translation: 在确定常设机构利润时，不得计入该常设机构向企业总机构或其他分支机构收取的下列款项：以专利或其他权利使用费形式支付的特许权使用费、管理费或其他类似费用；因提供特定服务或管理而产生的佣金；以及除银行业企业外，向总机构或其他分支机构提供的贷款所形成的债权收入。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Where profits include items of income which are dealt with separately in other Articles of the Agreement , then the provisions of those Articles shall not be affected by the provisions of this Article .
Translation: 如果利润中包含本协定其他条款中另行规定的收入项目，则本条款的规定不应影响这些条款的规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Profits from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management or head office of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 从事国际运输业务的船舶或飞机的运营利润，仅应向其实际管理机构所在地或总机构所在的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If the place of effective management or head office of a shipping enterprise is aboard a ship , then it shall be deemed to be situated in the Contracting State in which the home harbor of the ship is situated , or , if there is no such home harbor , in the Contracting State of which the operator of the ship is a resident .
Translation: 若航运企业的实际管理机构或主要办事机构位于船舶上，则应视为位于该船舶母港所在的缔约国；若该船舶没有母港，则视为位于船舶经营者为居民的缔约国。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of paragraph 1 shall also apply to profits from the participation in a pool , a joint business or an international operating agency .
Translation: 本条第一款的规定也适用于参与资金池、联营企业或国际经营机构所获得的利润。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where a Contracting State includes in the profits of an enterprise of that State -- and taxes accordingly -- profits on which an enterprise of the other Contracting State has been charged to tax in that other Contracting State and the profits so included are profits which would have accrued to the enterprise of the first-mentioned Contracting State if the conditions made between the two enterprises had been those which would have been made between independent enterprises , then that other State shall make an appropriate adjustment to the amount of the tax charged therein on those profits .
Translation: 缔约国一方如果将其企业所获得的利润中包含另一缔约国企业已在该另一国缴纳了税款的利润，并据此对该利润征税；而所包含的利润属于以下情形：即如果上述两个企业之间所设定的条件与独立企业之间所设定的条件相同的话，该利润本应归属于首先提及的缔约国的企业。则该另一方国家应对该等利润在其境内已征收的税额作出适当调整。

Query_Text_en: In determining such adjustment , due regard shall be had to the other provisions of this Agreement and the competent authorities of the Contracting States shall if necessary consult each other .
Translation: 在确定此类调整时，应考虑本协议的其他条款；如必要时，缔约国主管当局应相互协商。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State , but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 percent of the gross amount of the dividends .
Translation: 然而，此类股息所得也可在支付股息的公司所在缔约国征税，并按照该国法律课税，但如股息受益所有人为收款人，则所征税收不得超过股息总额的百分之五。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other Contracting State if the beneficial owner of the dividend is the Government of that other Contracting State or any of its institutions or other entity wholly owned directly or indirectly by the Government of that other Contracting State .
Translation: 尽管本条第一款和第二款有规定，如果股息的受益所有人为该另一缔约国政府或其任何机构或该另一缔约国政府直接或间接全资拥有的其他实体，则该股息应仅在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term dividends as used in this Article means income from shares , mining shares , founder 's shares or other rights , not being debt-claims , participating in profits , as well as income from other corporate rights which is subjected to the same taxation treatment as income from shares by the laws of the State of which the company making the distribution is a resident .
Translation: 在本条款中使用的“股息”一词指来源于股份、矿业股份、创始人股份或其他权利且不属于债权请求权的利润分配所得，以及根据支付股息的公司所在国法律，与股份所得适用相同税收待遇的其他公司权利所得。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 , 2 and 3 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the dividends , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 本条第一款、第二款和第三款的规定不适用的情形为：如股息的受益所有人为某一缔约国居民，并在支付股息的公司为其居民的另一缔约国设有常设机构从事营业活动，或在该另一缔约国通过固定基地提供独立个人劳务，且支付股息所对应的股份权益与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系。

Query_Text_en: In such case , the provisions of Article 7 or Article 14 , as the case may be , shall apply .
Translation: 在这种情况下，应适用第七条或第十四条的规定。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Where a company which is a resident of a Contracting State derives profits or income from the other Contracting State , that other State may not impose any tax on the dividends paid by the company , except insofar as such dividends are paid to a resident of that other State or insofar as the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with a permanent establishment or a fixed base situated in that other State , nor subject the company 's undistributed profits to a tax on the company 's undistributed profits , even if the dividends paid or the undistributed profits consist wholly or partly of profits or income arising in such other State .
Translation: 根据本协定第一条，缔约国一方居民公司从缔约国另一方取得的利润或所得，该另一方不得对该公司的股息征收任何税收，除非此类股息支付给该另一方居民，或支付股息的持股与设在该另一方的常设机构或固定基地存在实际关联；同时，也不得对公司的未分配利润征收未分配利润税，即使这些已支付股息或未分配利润全部或部分来源于该另一方的所得或收入。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Income from debt-claims arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 来源于缔约国一方的债权所得，支付给另一缔约国居民的，可以在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such income may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State , but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the income from debt-claims , the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the income from debt-claims .
Translation: 然而，此类收入亦可在其发生的缔约国征税，并按照该国法律规定课税，但若收入接收方为债权所得的受益所有人，则所征税款不得超过该债权所得总额的10%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 , income from debt-claims arising in a Contracting State and derived by the Government of the other Contracting State , a local authority and the Central Bank thereof or any financial institution wholly owned by the Government of that other State , or by any other resident of that other State with respect to debt-claims indirectly financed by the Government of that other State , a local authority , and the Central Bank thereof or any financial institution wholly owned by the Government of that State , shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned Contracting State .
Translation: 尽管本条第二款有规定，缔约国另一方政府、当地政府、中央银行或该国政府全资拥有的金融机构，或缔约国另一方居民因间接由该国政府、当地政府、中央银行或该国政府全资拥有的金融机构融资的债权所取得的来源于缔约国一方的债权所得，在缔约国另一方应予免税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term income from debt-claims as used in this Article means income from debt-claims of every kind , whether or not secured by mortgage and whether or not carrying a right to participate in the debtor 's profits , and in particular , income from government securities and income from bonds or debentures , including premiums and prizes attaching to such securities , bonds or debentures .
Translation: 本条款中所指的"债权所得收入"系指任何形式的债权所得收入，无论该债权是否以抵押担保，亦无论是否附带参与债务人利润分配的权利。具体包括政府证券所得收入、债券或公司债券所得收入，以及此类证券、债券或公司债券附带的溢价和奖金收入。

Query_Text_en: Penalty charges for late payment shall not be regarded as income from debt-claims for the purpose of this Article .
Translation: 根据本条款，逾期支付的滞纳金不应视为债权收入。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 , 2 and 3 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the income from debt-claims , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the income from debt-claims arises , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the debt-claims in respect of which the income is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 第五，本条第一、二、三款的规定不适用于以下情形：若债权权益的所得受益所有人为一缔约国居民，并且其在该债权权益产生所得的另一缔约国通过设立于该国的常设机构从事营业活动，或通过该国的固定基地提供独立个人劳务，且该等债权权益的所得款项与该常设机构或固定基地存在实质性联系。

Query_Text_en: In such cases the provisions of Article 7 or Article 14 , as the case may be , shall apply .
Translation: 在这种情况下，应适用第七条或第十四条的规定，视具体情况而定。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Income from debt-claims shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is the Government of that State , a local authority thereof or a resident of that State .
Translation: 当支付人是该缔约国政府、该国的地方当局或该国居民时，债权所得应视为来源于该缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying such income from debt-claims , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the indebtedness on which the income from debt-claims is paid was incurred , and such income from debt-claims is borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base , then such income shall be deemed to arise in the Contracting State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 如果支付此类债权收入的付款方无论是否为任一缔约国的税收居民，在缔约国境内设有与产生该债权收入的债务相关的常设机构或固定基地，并且该债权收入应由上述常设机构或固定基地承担，则此类收入应视为来源于该常设机构或固定基地所在的缔约国。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Where , by reason of a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person , the amount of the income from debt-claims , having regard to the debt-claims for which it is paid , exceeds the amount which would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship , the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last-mentioned amount .
Translation: 根据支付人与受益所有人之间或他们双方与其他人之间的特殊关系，导致债权产生的收入金额（相对于该债权应获得的收入而言）超出在不存在此种关系情况下支付人与受益所有人之间可能达成一致的金额时，本条规定仅适用于上述后述金额。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State , but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties , the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the royalties .
Translation: 然而，此类特许权使用费也可以在所得来源的缔约国按照该国法律征税，但如果收款人是该特许权使用费的受益所有人，此项征税税额不得超过特许权使用费总额的10%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term royalties as used in this Article means payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of , or the right to use , any copyright of literary , artistic or scientific work including cinematography films , or films , tapes for radio or television broadcasting , any patent , trade mark , design or model , plan , secret formula or process , or for the use of , or the right to use , industrial , commercial , or scientific equipment , or for information concerning industrial , commercial or scientific experience .
Translation: 本条所使用的“特许权使用费”一词指因使用或有权使用下列内容而收取的任何形式的款项：文学、艺术或科学作品（包括电影作品、无线电或电视广播用影片及录音带）的著作权；任何专利、商标、设计、模型、图纸、秘密配方或工艺流程；以及因使用或有权使用工业、商业或科学设备，或获取工业、商业或科学经验相关信息而收取的款项。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Royalties shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is the Government of that State , a local authority thereof or a resident of that State .
Translation: 当支付方为该国政府、地方当局或该国居民时，特许权使用费应被视为来源于该缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the royalties , whether that person is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the liability to pay the royalties was incurred , and such royalties are borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base , then such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 但是，如果支付特许权使用费的人（无论该人是否为缔约国居民）在某一缔约国内拥有常设机构或固定基地，且该特许权使用费的支付义务与该常设机构或固定基地存在关联，并且该特许权使用费由该常设机构或固定基地负担，则该特许权使用费应视为产生于该常设机构或固定基地所在的国家。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Gains from the alienation of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic , or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management or head office of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 从事国际运输业务的船舶或飞机的转让收益，或与该等船舶或飞机运营相关的动产转让收益，应仅在企业实际管理机构或总公司的所在地所在缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Gains from the alienation of shares of the capital stock of a company the property of which consists directly or indirectly principally of immovable property situated in a Contracting State may be taxed in that Contracting State .
Translation: 转让公司股本股份所取得的收益，若该公司财产直接或间接主要由位于某一缔约国境内的不动产组成，则该收益可以在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Gains from the alienation of shares other than those mentioned in paragraph 4 representing a participation of 25 per cent in a company which is a resident of a Contracting State may be taxed in that Contracting State .
Translation: 除第4款所述股份以外，转让所持缔约国居民公司股权比例未达25%的股份所获收益，可以在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Gains derived from the alienation of any property other than that referred to in the preceding paragraphs 1 to 5 of this Article , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident .
Translation: 本条前述第1至5款所指财产以外的其他财产转让所取得的所得，应仅在财产转让方为其居民的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Income derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of professional services or other activities of an independent character shall be taxable only in that State except in the following circumstances , when such income may also be taxed in the other Contracting State :
Translation: 缔约国一方居民因提供专业服务或其他具有独立性质的活动取得的所得，应仅在该国征税。但本款规定不适用于下列情况，此时该笔收入也可在另一缔约国征税：

Query_Text_en: or b ] if his stay in the other Contracting State is for a period or periods amounting to or exceeding in the aggregate 183 days in the fiscal year concerned ;
Translation: 如果其在另一缔约国停留的单次或多次天数在相关财政年度内总计达到或超过一百八十三天；

Query_Text_en: or c ] if the remuneration for his activities in the other Contracting State is paid by a resident of that other Contracting State or is borne by a permanent establishment or a fixed base situated in that other Contracting State and exceeds in the fiscal year 30000 USD or its equivalent in Chinese or Saudi Currency .
Translation: 如果某人在另一缔约国进行的活动所获得的报酬，是由该其他缔约国的居民支付，或由该其他缔约国境内的常设机构或固定基地承担，并且在该财政年度内超过30000美元或等值的人民币或沙特货币。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of Articles 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 and 21 , salaries , wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of an employment shall be taxable only in that State unless the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State .
Translation: 根据本协定第十六条、第十七条、第十八条、第十九条、第二十条和第二十一条的规定，缔约国一方居民因受雇所得的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，应仅在该国征税，除非该雇佣关系是在另一缔约国履行。

Query_Text_en: If the employment is so exercised , such remuneration as is derived there from may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 如果该就业活动是在这种情况下进行的，因此取得的报酬可以由该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: c ] the remuneration is not borne by a permanent establishment or a fixed base which the employer has in the other State .
Translation: 该报酬不由雇主在另一国设立的常设机构或固定基地承担。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article , remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic , may be taxed in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management or head office of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 尽管有本条前述规定，对在从事国际运输的船舶或飞机上任职取得的薪金报酬，可以在企业实际管理地或总机构所在的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: Directors 's fees and other similar payments derived by a resident of a Contracting State in that person 's capacity as a member of the board of directors of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民作为缔约国另一方居民公司董事会成员而取得的董事费和其他类似款项，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 14 and 15 , income derived by a resident of a Contracting State as an entertainer , such as a theater , motion picture , radio or television artiste , or a musician , or as a sportsperson , from his personal activities as such exercised in the other Contracting State , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 尽管本协定第十四条和第十五条另有规定，缔约国一方居民作为演艺人员，如戏剧、电影、广播或电视艺术家，或音乐家，以及作为运动员，为其个人从事此类活动从另一缔约国取得的所得，可以在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where income in respect of personal activities exercised by an entertainer or a sportsperson in his capacity as such accrues not to the entertainer or sportsperson himself but to another person , that income may , notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 7 , 14 and 15 , be taxed in the Contracting State in which the activities of the entertainer or sportsperson are exercised .
Translation: 根据本协定第七条、第十四条和第十五条的规定，若演艺人员或运动员以本人身份从事个人活动所获得的收入，并非归属于该演艺人员或运动员本人，而是归属于其他人，则该收入仍可在该演艺人员或运动员从事活动的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the proceeding provisions of this Article , income derived by entertainers or sportspersons who are residents of a Contracting State from activities exercised in the other Contracting State under a plan of cultural exchange between the Governments of both Contracting States , shall be exempt from tax in that other State .
Translation: 根据缔约双方政府间文化交流计划在另一缔约国从事活动而取得的所得，应予免征该另一缔约国的税收。本条规定不受本条前述条款限制，适用于缔约国一方居民的演艺人员或运动员。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of Article 19 , pensions and other similar remuneration paid to a resident of a Contracting State in consideration of past employment shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 根据第十九条的规定，因过去雇佣关系而向某一缔约国居民支付的养老金和其他类似报酬，仅由该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . a ] Salaries , wages and other similar remuneration , other than a pension , paid by a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or subdivision or authority thereof shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 一、缔约国或其地方政府部门、地方当局因向该缔约国或其地方政府部门、地方当局提供服务而支付给个人的薪金、工资及其他类似报酬（养老金除外），应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . a ] Any pension paid by , or out of funds created by , a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or subdivision or authority thereof shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国或其政治分区或地方当局向个人支付的、或从缔约国或其政治分区或地方当局设立的资金中支付的、因向该国或其分区、地方当局提供服务而获得的任何养老金，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of Articles 15 , 16 , 17 and 18 shall apply to salaries , wages and other similar remuneration , and to pensions , in respect of services rendered in connection with a business carried on by a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof .
Translation: 本协定第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定，应适用于缔约国或其政治分部或地方当局开展业务所涉及服务的薪金、工资、其他类似报酬以及养老金。

Query_Text_en: Remuneration which an individual who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State , a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State for the primary purpose of teaching , giving lectures or conducting research at a university , college , school , or educational institution or scientific research institution recognized by the Government of the first-mentioned State derives for the purpose of such teaching , lectures or research shall not be taxed in the first-mentioned State , for a period of three years from the date of his first arrival in the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 根据本条所述，在某一缔约国停留且此前曾是另一缔约国居民的个人，若其入境该国的主要目的是在经该国政府认可的大学、学院、学校或其他教育机构、科研机构从事教学、授课或研究，则其因上述教学、授课或研究取得的报酬，在自首次入境该国之日起不超过三年的期限内，该国应免予征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Payments which a student , business apprentice or trainee who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State solely for the purpose of his education or training , receives for the purpose of his maintenance , education or training , shall not be taxed in that State , provided that such payments arise from sources outside that State .
Translation: 根据缔约国双方税收协定，学生、企业学徒或受训人员在访问某一缔约国之前或正在访问时是另一缔约国居民，且仅因教育或培训目的存在于该国者，其获得的用于维持生活、教育或培训的款项，若来源于该国境外，则不应在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In respect of grants , scholarships and remuneration from employment not covered by paragraph 1 , a student , business apprentice or trainee described in paragraph 1 shall , in addition , be entitled during such education or training to the same exemptions , reliefs , or reductions in respect of taxes available to residents of the State which he is visiting .
Translation: 关于未包含在第1款中的补助金、奖学金及就业报酬，第1款所述的学生、商业学徒或受训者在其接受教育或培训期间，应有权享受其前往该国访问时，该国居民可获得的同等税收减免或减税待遇。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Capital represented by immovable property referred to in Article 6 , owned by a resident of a Contracting State and situated in the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other Contracting State .
Translation: 根据第六条所指的不动产所构成的资本，如果由缔约国一方的居民拥有并位于另一缔约国境内，则该另一缔约国可以对该资本行使征税权。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Capital represented by movable property forming part of the business property of a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State or by movable property pertaining to a fixed base available to a resident of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing independent personal services , may be taxed in that other Contracting State .
Translation: 一缔约国企业在另一缔约国设有常设机构的，构成该常设机构营业财产部分的动产所代表的资本，或属于某一缔约国居民在另一缔约国使用的固定基地并用于开展独立个人服务的动产所代表的资本，可以在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Capital represented by ships and aircraft operated in international traffic and by movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships and aircraft , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management or head office of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 从事国际运输的船舶和飞机所代表的资本，以及与上述船舶或飞机运营相关的动产，应仅由企业实际管理机构或总机构所在地的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . All other elements of capital of a resident of a Contracting State shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民的其他各类资本要素应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: a ] in the case of China : where a resident of China derives income from the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia , the amount of tax on that income payable in Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , may be credited against the Chinese tax imposed on that resident .
Translation: 根据本协定的规定，中华人民共和国居民在中国以外的沙特阿拉伯王国取得的所得，在沙特阿拉伯王国缴纳的税额，可以在中华人民共和国对该居民征收的税收中予以抵免。

Query_Text_en: where a resident of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia derives income or owns capital which , in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , may be taxed in China , the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia shall deduct the amount paid in China , as a tax specified in Article 2 of this Agreement , against the tax levied in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia .
Translation: 如果沙特阿拉伯王国的居民取得的所得或拥有的资本，根据本协定规定可能在中国征税，沙特阿拉伯王国应扣除该居民在中国已缴纳的税款（即本协定第二条规定的税款），以抵免其在沙特阿拉伯王国应缴纳的税款。

Query_Text_en: The amount of such deduction , however , shall not exceed the amount of the tax on that income or capital computed in accordance with the taxation laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia .
Translation: 此类扣除金额不得超过根据沙特阿拉伯王国税收法律法规计算得出的该收入或资本应缴纳的税额。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The tax which was exempted or reduced under the legal provisions for encouragement of investment in either Contracting State shall be deemed to have been paid for application of this Article .
Translation: 根据缔约国为鼓励投资而规定的免税或减税条款所享受的税款，本条的规定适用时应视为该税款已缴纳。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of this paragraph shall be effective for 10 years starting from the year of the entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 本条的规定有效期为10年，自本协议生效之日起算。

Query_Text_en: 1 .
