Where a person considers that the actions of one or both of the Contracting States result or will result for him in taxation not in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , that person may , irrespective of the remedies provided by the domestic law of those Contracting States , present his case to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which he is a resident .
Translation: 纳税人认为缔约国一方或双方的行为已导致其被征税不符合本协定规定或可能将导致此种结果时，无论缔约国国内法是否规定其他救济途径，该纳税人可向其为居民的缔约国主管当局提出申诉。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The competent authority shall endeavor , if the objection appears to it to be justified and if it is not itself able to arrive at a satisfactory solution , to resolve the case by mutual agreement with the competent authority of the other Contracting State , with a view to the avoidance of taxation which is not in accordance with this Agreement .
Translation: 如果主管当局认为该异议确有理由，且自身无法达成满意解决方案，应努力与另一缔约国的主管当局通过相互协商达成一致，以避免不符合本协定的征税行为。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The competent authorities of both Contracting States shall endeavor to resolve by mutual agreement any difficulties or doubts arising as to the interpretation or application of this Agreement . They may also consult together for the elimination of double taxation in cases not provided for in this Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国双方的主管当局应当努力通过相互协商一致解决因本协议解释或应用所产生的任何困难或疑问。他们也可以就本协议未作规定的其他情况下的双重征税问题进行协商。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States may communicate with each other directly for the purpose of reaching an agreement in the sense of the preceding paragraphs .
Translation: 缔约国的主管当局可以就达成协议事宜直接进行沟通，以符合前款规定的精神。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange such information as is necessary for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or of the domestic laws of the Contracting States concerning taxes covered by this Agreement insofar as the taxation thereunder is not contrary to this Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局应当交换为执行本协定条款或缔约国国内法律中涉及本协定涵盖税种的规定所需的信息，只要该税收规定不与本协定相抵触。

Query_Text_en: The exchange of information is not restricted by Article 1 . Any information received by a Contracting State shall be treated as secret in the same manner as information obtained under the domestic laws of that State and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities [ including courts and administrative bodies ] involved in the assessment or collection of , the enforcement or prosecution in respect of , or the determination of appeals in relation to the taxes covered by this Agreement .
Translation: 信息交换不受本协定第一条限制。缔约国所收到的任何信息，均应按照该缔约国国内法所获取信息的方式予以保密处理，仅可向参与本协定涵盖税款评估或征收、执行或起诉有关税务事宜、或裁决与本协定涵盖税款相关上诉的人员或机构[包括法院和行政机关]披露。

Query_Text_en: c ] to supply information which would disclose any trade , business , industrial , commercial or professional secret or trade process , or information , the disclosure of which would be contrary to public policy .
Translation: 不得披露任何商业秘密、商务秘密、工业秘密、商业秘密或职业秘密，以及生产工艺等信息，或披露后将有悖于公共政策的其他信息。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Contracting State shall notify the other Contracting State through diplomatic channels of the completion of the legal procedures required for entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 每一缔约方应通过外交渠道书面通知另一缔约方本协定生效所需法律程序的完成情况。

Query_Text_en: The Agreement shall enter into force as of the first day of the next month following that month in which the last notice was given .
Translation: 本协议应自最后通知送达的当月之后次月的第一日起生效。

Query_Text_en: b ] in respect of other taxes on income and on capital , to taxes chargeable for any taxable period beginning on or after 1st January in any calendar year next following that in which the Agreement enters into force .
Translation: 关于其他收入税和资本税，对于协议生效之后的下一个日历年度内，纳税期间开始于1月1日或之后的应纳税款。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Agreement shall remain in force indefinitely but either of the Contracting States may terminate this Agreement through diplomatic channels , by giving to the other Contracting State written notice of termination not later than 30 June of any calendar year starting five years after the year in which this Agreement entered into force .
Translation: 本协议应无限期有效，但任一缔约国可通过外交途径，在本协议生效之日起满五年的次年起，在该日历年度的6月30日之前以书面形式通知另一缔约国终止本协议。

Query_Text_en: b ] in respect of other taxes for any taxable year beginning on or after the first day of January of the calendar year next following that in which the notice is given .
Translation: 涉及其他税种的，纳税年度始于或晚于通知发布所在日历年的下一个日历年1月1日。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned , duly authorised thereto , have signed this Agreement .
Translation: 鉴此，上述签署方经正式授权，特此签署本协议。

Query_Text_en: DONE in Beijing on the 23rd day of January , 2006 in duplicate , each in the Chinese , Arabic and English languages , all texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本协议于2006年1月23日在北京签署，一式两份，每份均用中文、阿拉伯语和英语写成，三种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Ad Article 7 a ] The term business profits includes , but is not limited to , income derived from manufacturing , mercantile , banking , insurance and the furnishing of services .
Translation: 营业利润一词包括但不限于来源于制造业、商业、银行业、保险业以及提供服务所取得的收入。

Query_Text_en: b ] Each Contracting State shall apply its domestic law with regard to insurance activities .
Translation: 每一缔约国应就保险活动事项适用其国内法。

Query_Text_en: II . Ad Article 24In the case of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia , the methods for elimination of double taxation will not prejudice the provisions of the Zakat collection regime as regards the Saudi nationals .
Translation: 关于沙特阿拉伯王国的情况，消除双重征税的措施不得损害针对沙特国民的 Zakat 征收制度的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned , duly authorised thereto , have signed this Protocol .
Translation: 兹证明，下列经正式授权之签署人特签署本议定书。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The term `` Convention '' means the Convention on International Civil Aviation opened for signature at Chicago on the seventh day of December , 1944 and includes any Annex adopted under Article 90 of that Convention and any amendment of the Annexes or Convention under Articles 90 and 94 thereof so far as those Annexes and amendments have become effective for or been ratified by both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 【1】“公约”指1944年12月7日在芝加哥开放签署的《国际民用航空公约》，包括根据该公约第90条通过的任何附件，以及根据该公约第90条和第94条对附件或公约作出的修正，但仅限于对双方缔约国均已生效或已被双方缔约国批准的附件及修正案。

Query_Text_en: and in the case of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia , the General Authority of Civil Aviation , or any person or agency authorized to perform any function presently exercised by the said authorities .
Translation: 在沙特阿拉伯王国的情况下，沙特民航总局，或任何获授权行使所述当局现所行使的任何职能的个人或机构。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] the term `` Agreement '' means this Agreement and its Annex as well as any amendment to this Agreement and\/or its Annex made in accordance with Article 19 of this Agreement .
Translation: "协议" 一词指本协议及其附件，以及根据本协议第19条对本协议和/或其附件作出的任何修改。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] the term `` airline '' means any air transport enterprise offering or operating international air services .
Translation: “航空运输企业”指任何提供或经营国际航空运输服务的企业。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] the term `` designated airline '' means an airline which has been designated and authorized in accordance with Article 3 of this Agreement .
Translation: “指定航空公司”指根据本协议第三条指定并授权的航空公司。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] the term `` aircraft '' means civil aircraft .
Translation: 术语“航空器”指民用航空器。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] the term `` air service '' means any scheduled air service performed by aircraft for the public transport of passengers , baggage , cargo or mail .
Translation: 航空服务是指由航空器提供的任何定期航空运输服务，用于公众旅客、行李、货物或邮件的运输。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] the term `` international air service '' means an air service which passes through the air space over the territory of more than one State .
Translation: “国际航空服务”是指飞经一个以上国家领土上空领空的航空服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 9 ] the term `` stop for non-traffic purposes '' means a landing for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers , baggage , cargo or mail .
Translation: 本条所称“非运输目的停靠”，是指除上下旅客、行李、货物或邮件外，出于任何其他目的的停靠。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] in relation to an aircraft , the payload of that aircraft available on a route or section of a route ;
Translation: 指该航空器在某航线上或航线某航段上可利用的有效载荷。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] in relation to an air service , the capacity of the aircraft used on such service multiplied by the frequency operated by such aircraft over a given period on a route or section of a route .
Translation: 就某项航空服务而言，指该服务所使用的飞机运力乘以该飞机在某一特定期间内在某航线或航线某段上的飞行班次频率。

Query_Text_en: [ 11 ] the term `` tariff '' means the prices to be paid for the carriage of passengers , baggage and cargo and the conditions under which those prices apply , including prices and conditions for agency and other auxiliary service , but excluding prices and conditions for the carriage of mail .
Translation: 本条所称"运价"，是指运输旅客、行李及货物应支付的费用及相关适用条件，包括代理服务及其他辅助服务的价格和条款，但不包括邮件运输的价格和条件。

Query_Text_en: [ 12 ] the term `` Route Schedule '' means the Route Schedule annexed to this Agreement or as amended in accordance with the provisions of Article 17 of this Agreement .
Translation: “航线时刻表”一词指附于本协议的航线时刻表，或根据本协议第17条的规定经修订的版本。

Query_Text_en: The Route Schedule forms an integral part of this Agreement .
Translation: 路线安排构成本协议不可分割的一部分。

Query_Text_en: [ 13 ] the term `` specified route '' means the route specified in the Route Schedule .
Translation: “指定路线”指在路线表中规定的路线。

Query_Text_en: [ 14 ] the term `` spare parts '' means articles of a repair or replacement nature for incorporation in an aircraft , including engines .
Translation: "零部件"指用于飞机维修或更换并安装于飞机上的物品，包括发动机。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in this Agreement to enable the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party to establish and operate international air services on the route specified in the Annex [ hereinafter called `` the agreed services '' ] .
Translation: 每一缔约方应给予另一缔约方本协议中规定的权利，以便其指定空运企业能够按照附件中规定的航线开办并经营国际航空运输服务（以下简称"约定服务"）。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] to make stops at the point [ s ] on the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of taking on board and discharging international traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail , originating in or destined for the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 在指定路线上的[ s ]点停靠，以便在另一缔约方境内装卸来自或前往第一缔约方的国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The right of the designated airline [ s ] of one Contracting Party to take on board and discharge at point [ s ] in the territory of the other Contracting Party international traffic to or from a third country shall be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约一方指定空运企业在另一缔约方领土内的指定地点搭载和卸载往返第三国的国际运输业务的权利，应由双方航空当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Contracting Party one or more airlines to operate the agreed services on the specified route , and to withdraw or alter such designations .
Translation: 每一缔约方有权以书面形式向另一缔约方指定一家或多家航空公司在指定航线上运营约定的航空服务，并可撤销或变更此类指定。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The substantial ownership and effective control of the airline [ s ] designated by each Contracting Party shall remain vested in such Contracting Party or its nationals .
Translation: 缔约各方指定的航空公司的实质性所有权和实际控制权应归属于该缔约方或其国民。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the airline [ s ] designated by the first Contracting Party to satisfy them that it is qualified to meet the conditions and the obligations prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied to the operation of international air services by such authorities .
Translation: 另一缔约方航空主管当局有权要求由一方缔约国指定的空运企业，使其确信该企业具备满足其根据正常合理适用的法律法规所规定条件和义务的能力。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] On receipt of such designation , the other Contracting Party shall , subject to the provisions of paragraphs [ 2 ] and [ 3 ] of this Article , grant to the airline [ s ] so designated the appropriate operating authorization without unreasonable delay .
Translation: 收到此类指定后，另一缔约方应在符合本条第2款和第3款规定的情况下，向被指定的航空公司授予相应的运营许可，并不得无理拖延。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The designated airline [ s ] of one Contracting Party may commence , when it has acquired operating authorization , operation of the agreed services in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Agreement from the date prescribed in such authorization .
Translation: 缔约一方指定的空运企业，在获得运营授权后，即可自该授权规定的日期起，按照本协议相关规定开展约定的航空运输服务运营。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] where the said designated airline [ s ] otherwise fails to operate in accordance with the conditions prescribed under this Agreement .
Translation: 如指定空运企业[ s ]未按本协议规定之条件运营。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Unless immediate revocation , suspension of rights or imposition of conditions prescribed in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article is essential to prevent further infringement of laws and regulations by the said designated airline [ s ] , such rights shall be exercised only after consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 除非立即撤销、暂停权利或依据本条第一款规定采取限制性措施对防止所述指定航空公司进一步违反法律法规至关重要，否则此类权利的行使须经与另一缔约方协商后方可实施。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to the admission to , departure from or operation and navigation in its territory of aircraft engaged in the international operation shall be applicable to the aircraft of the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party , while entering , departing from or operating and navigating in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 本协定一方缔约方关于国际运营的航空器进入、离开或在其领土内运营和航行的法律和法规，应适用于另一方缔约方指定空运企业的航空器，当其进入、离开或在该缔约方领土内运营和航行时。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The laws and regulations of one Contracting Party relating to admission to , stay in or departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo or mail , such as laws and regulations relating to entry , clearance , immigration , passports , customs and quarantine , shall be applicable to the passengers , crew , baggage , cargo or mail carried by the aircraft of the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party while entering , staying in and departing from the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 本协定一方缔约方关于乘客、机组人员、行李、货物或邮件进入、停留或离开其领土的法律和法规，如涉及入境、通关、移民、护照、海关和检疫等方面的法律和法规，应适用于另一方缔约方指定空运企业所载运的乘客、机组人员、行李、货物或邮件在进入、停留及离开本协定一方缔约方领土期间。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Other relevant laws and regulations relating to aircraft and provisions in respect of civil aviation of one Contracting Party shall be applicable to the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party while operating the agreed services in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 一方缔约方关于航空器的其他相关法律法规及其民用航空规定，应适用于另一方缔约方指定空运企业在其领土内运营协议规定的服务时。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Passengers , baggage , cargo and mail in direct transit and not leaving the area of the airport reserved for such purpose shall be subject to no more than a simplified control .
Translation: 直接过境且不离开机场为此划定专门区域的旅客、行李、货物和邮件，应仅接受不超过简化检查。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] There shall be a fair and equal opportunity for the designated airline [ s ] of the Contracting Parties to operate the agreed services on the specified route .
Translation: 缔约各方指定的空运企业应在指定航线上经营协议规定的空运服务方面享有公平平等的机会。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] In operating the agreed services the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services provided by the latter on the whole or part of the same route .
Translation: 在运营约定的空运服务时，各缔约方指定的空运企业应顾及其他缔约方指定空运企业的利益，以免不当影响后者在整个航线或部分航段上提供的服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The agreed services supplied by the designated airline [ s ] of the Contracting Parties shall provide at a reasonable load factor capacity adequate to meet the traffic requirements for the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail between the territories of the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约各方指定的航空公司所提供的约定服务，应以合理的载运率提供充足的运力，以满足缔约方领土之间运输旅客、行李、货物和邮件的交通需求。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] the requirements of through airline [ s ] operation .
Translation: 联程航班运营的要求。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Capacity , frequency and type of aircraft shall be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约双方航空主管部门应就运力、班次频率及机型达成协议。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The ground handling operations of either designated airline [ s ] shall be undertaken in accordance with the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 指定航空公司的地面勤务作业应按照另一缔约方的法律和法规实施。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Each Contracting Party shall grant the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party the right to engage in the sale of air transportation in its territory directly and , at the airline 's discretion , through licensed agents .
Translation: 每一缔约方应准许对方指定的航空公司在其领土内直接从事航空运输服务的销售，或由航空公司自行决定通过授权代理进行。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party may , according to traffic requirements , apply for operation of extra section on the specified route .
Translation: 缔约双方任一指定的航空公司可根据交通需求，向对方申请在指定航线上运营加班航班。

Query_Text_en: The application for such flight shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party , at least three days before its proposed operation , and the flight can be operated only after approval has been obtained .
Translation: 此类飞行活动的申请应至少在其计划实施前三天提交给另一缔约方的航空主管部门，且须经批准后方可实施。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party shall , not later than sixty [ 60 ] days prior to the date of operation of any agreed service [ s ] , submit its proposed time-tables to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party for approval .
Translation: 缔约双方指定的空运企业应于任何已达成协议的服务开航日期六十[60]天前，向另一缔约方的航空当局提交其拟定的航班时刻表，以供审批。

Query_Text_en: Such timetables shall include the type of service and aircraft to be used , the flight schedule and any other relevant information .
Translation: 此类时刻表应包括服务类型及拟使用的航空器、航班时刻表以及其他相关信息。

Query_Text_en: This shall , likewise , apply to any subsequent changes .
Translation: 本条款同样适用于任何后续变更。

Query_Text_en: In special cases this time limit may be reduced subject to the approval of the said authorities .
Translation: 在特殊情况下，经相关主管部门批准，该时限可予以缩短。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The tariffs applicable to the agreed services on the specified route shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors including cost of operation , reasonable profit , characteristics of service [ such as speed and standard of accommodation ] and tariffs applicable to the services of other airline [ s ] on any section of the specified route .
Translation: 适用协定服务的关税应在合理水平确定，综合考虑包括运营成本、合理利润、服务特性（如速度和住宿标准）以及其他航空公司在该指定航线上任何航段所提供服务所适用的关税在内的所有相关因素。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The tariffs referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , in consultation when necessary and possible with other airline [ s ] operating over the same route or section .
Translation: 本条第一款所指运价应由缔约双方指定的空运企业商定，必要且可能时需与其他使用同一航线或航段的空运企业进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: The tariffs so agreed shall be submitted to their respective aeronautical authorities at least sixty days prior to the proposed date of introduction of these tariffs and become effective after their approval by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 经协议确定的运价应在拟议运价实施日期至少六十天前提交各自国家的航空主管当局，并在获得双方缔约方航空主管当局的批准后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on the tariffs , the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties shall determine the tariffs through consultation .
Translation: 如果缔约双方指定的航空公司未能就运价达成一致，缔约双方的航空当局应通过协商确定运价。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on the approval of any tariff submitted to them under paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article or on the determination of any tariff under paragraph [ 3 ] of this Article , the matter shall be referred to the Contracting Parties for settlement in accordance with the provisions of Article 18 of this Agreement .
Translation: 如果缔约各方的航空当局未能就根据本条第二款提交的任何运价的审批，或根据本条第三款确定的任何运价达成一致，则应根据本协议第十八条的规定，将此事提交缔约各方解决。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party shall provide regular airport [ s ] , alternate airport [ s ] and air navigation facilities in its territory and relevant services including communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary facilities and services for the operation of the agreed services by the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方应在领土内为其指定的空运企业运营双方商定的服务，提供定期使用的机场、备降机场及航空导航设施，并配备相关服务，包括通信、导航、气象及其他辅助设施和服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airports and air navigation facilities of the other Contracting Party at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the appropriate authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方指定的航空公司使用另一缔约方的机场和航空导航设施时，应按照对方缔约方主管机构规定的公平合理费率缴纳费用。

Query_Text_en: Such rate shall not be higher than those applicable to any airline of other States for the services and the use of similar airports and air navigational facilities in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 该费率不得高于其他任何缔约方的航空公司在另一缔约方领土内提供相同服务或使用类似机场及航空导航设施时所适用的费率。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 Provision of Statistical DataThe aeronautical authorities of either Contracting Party shall furnish to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party , at their request , statistical data as may be reasonably required for the purpose of reviewing the capacity provided by the agreed services operated by the designated airline [ s ] of the first Contracting Party on the specified route . Such data shall include all information required to determine the amount of traffic carried by the said designated airline [ s ] on the agreed services .
Translation:
第十条 统计资料提供  
任一缔约方的航空当局应根据对方要求，向另一方的航空当局提供为审查首方指定空运企业在指定航线上运营的协议规定航班服务所提供运力而合理要求的统计资料。此类资料应包含确定所述指定空运企业在协议规定航班服务中所承运运输量所需的一切信息。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] For the operation of the agreed services on the specified route , the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party shall have the right , on the reciprocal basis , to set up representative offices in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 在指定航线上运营约定服务时，每一缔约方指定的航空公司有权在互惠基础上，在另一缔约方领土内设立代表机构。

Query_Text_en: The staff members of the representative offices of the designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be nationals of either Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方指定的航空公司在另一缔约方境内的代表处工作人员应为任一缔约方的国民。

Query_Text_en: However , the designated airline [ s ] of one Contracting Party shall be entitled , in accordance with the laws and regulations relating to entry , residence and employment of the other Contracting Party , to bring in and maintain in the territory of the other Contracting Party their representatives and those of its own managerial , technical , operational and other specialist staff at managerial level who are required for the provisions of the present air services , including third country nationals .
Translation: 某一缔约方指定的空运企业有权根据另一缔约方关于入境、居留和就业的法律法规，在另一缔约方领土内带入并维持其代表及其为提供本航空服务所需的管理人员、技术人员、运营人员和其他专业技术人员，包括第三国国籍人员。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The crew members of the designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party on the agreed services shall be nationals of the said Contracting Party .
Translation: 在约定服务中，缔约任何一方指定航空公司的机组成员应为该缔约方的国民。

Query_Text_en: If a designated airline of either Contracting Party desires to employ crew members of any other nationality on the agreed services , prior approval shall be obtained from the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 如果一方缔约国指定的航空公司希望在协议规定的航班服务中雇佣其他国家国籍的机组人员，应事先获得另一方缔约国的批准。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] When an aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline [ s ] of one Contracting Party arrives in the territory of the other Contracting Party , the said aircraft and its regular equipment , spare parts [ including engines ] , fuels , oil [ including hydraulic fluids , lubricants ] and aircraft stores [ including food , beverages and tobacco ] on board such aircraft shall be exempt on the basis of reciprocity from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges , provided such equipment and items remain on board the aircraft up to such time as they are re-exported .
Translation: 当一缔约方指定空运企业的航空器执行协议航班抵达另一缔约方领土时，在互惠基础上，该航空器及其机载设备、备件（包括发动机）、燃料、油料（包括液压油、润滑剂）和机上用品（包括食品、饮料及烟草制品）应予以免税，且免征检验费及其他类似费用。上述免税待遇适用于设备和物品自入境起直至重新出口期间持续留存在航空器上的情形。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] spare parts [ including engines ] introduced into the territory of the other Contracting Party for the maintenance or repair of aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline [ s ] .
Translation: 为维修或维护指定空运企业在协议服务中运营的航空器而输入另一缔约方境内的航空器零部件（包括发动机）。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The equipment and items referred to in paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party with the approval of the Customs authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 本条第一款和第二款所指的设备和物品，经另一缔约方海关当局批准后，可以向该缔约方境内卸载。

Query_Text_en: Such equipment and items shall be kept under the supervision or control of the Customs authorities of the other Contracting Party up to such time as they are re-exported , or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the customs regulations of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 此类设备和物品应接受另一方缔约方海关的监管，直至其重新出口，或根据该缔约方海关规定进行其他处置。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The exemption provided for in paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article shall also be available where a designated airline of one Contracting Party has contracted with other airline [ s ] , which similarly enjoy [ s ] such exemptions in the territory of the other Contracting Party , for the loan or transfer in the territory of the other Contracting Party of the equipment and items specified in paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article .
Translation: 本条第[1]款和第[2]款规定的豁免亦应适用于以下情形：一方缔约方指定的航空公司与其他同样在另一缔约方领土内享有此类豁免的航空公司缔约，在另一缔约方领土内就本条第[1]款和第[2]款所列设备及物品进行借贷或移交。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] Publicity materials which are intended for the airlines ' own use and do not exceed reasonable limit , and printed ticket stock and air waybills introduced by the designated airline [ s ] of one Contracting Party into the territory of the other Contracting Party , shall be exempt on the basis of reciprocity from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges .
Translation: 根据互惠原则，缔约一方指定的航空公司为自用且数量在合理范围内的宣传材料，以及输入至另一缔约方境内的印刷机票库存和航空货运单，应免征一切关税、税收、检验费及其他类似费用和收费。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] Baggage , cargo and mail in direct transit shall be exempt from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges on the basis of reciprocity with the exception of the charges corresponding to the services provided .
Translation: 在互惠基础上，直接过境的行李、货物和邮件应予以豁免所有关税、税收、检验费及其他类似费用和收费，除外情形为所提供服务对应的费用。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] Wages , salaries and other similar remuneration received by the employees of the representation of the designated airline of either Contracting Party , who are nationals of the first Contracting Party , shall be exempt from all taxes on the basis of reciprocity by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 根据互惠原则，任一缔约方指定航空公司在华常驻人员中属于首方国籍的员工所获得的工资、薪金及其他类似报酬，应由另一方缔约方免予征收一切税收。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The designated airline [ s ] of each Contracting Party shall have , on the reciprocal basis , the right to remit its revenue received in the territory of the other Contracting Party to the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方指定的航空公司应享有在互惠基础上，将其在另一缔约方领土内获得的收入汇回本国领土的权利。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The conversion and remittance of such revenue shall be effected in convertible currencies at the effective rate of exchange prevailing on the date of remittance .
Translation: 此类收入的兑换及汇款应以可自由兑换货币按照汇款当日适用的汇率进行。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Each Contracting Party shall facilitate the conversion and remittance of the revenue received in its territory by the designated airline [ s ] of the other Contracting Party , and assist promptly the said airline [ s ] in attending to the relevant formalities .
Translation: 每一缔约方应便利另一缔约方指定空运企业在其领土内所获收入的兑换及汇出，并及时协助上述空运企业办理相关手续。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The Contracting Parties reaffirm that their obligation to each other to protect the security of civil aviation against acts of unlawful interference forms an integral part of this Agreement .
Translation: 缔约各方重申，相互承担的保护民用航空安全、防止非法干扰行为的义务构成本协议不可分割的一部分。

Query_Text_en: The Contracting Parties shall in particular act in conformity with the provisions of the Convention on Offenses and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft , signed at Tokyo on 14 September 1963 , the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft , signed at The Hague on 16 December 1970 , and the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation , signed at Montreal on 23 September 1971 .
Translation: 缔约各方尤其应遵守1963年9月14日于东京签订的《关于在航空器上犯罪及其他某些行为的公约》、1970年12月16日于海牙签订的《制止非法劫持航空器公约》以及1971年9月23日于蒙特利尔签订的《制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为公约》的各项规定。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The Contracting Parties shall provide upon request all necessary assistance to each other to prevent acts of unlawful seizure of aircraft and other unlawful acts against the safety of such aircraft , their passengers and crew , airports and air navigation facilities , and any other threat to the security of civil aviation .
Translation: 缔约各方应根据请求相互提供必要协助，以防止非法劫持航空器及其他危害航空器及其乘客、机组人员、机场及航空导航设施安全的行为，以及任何其他威胁民用航空安全的活动。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The Contracting Parties shall , in their mutual relations , act in conformity with the Standards and Recommended Practices relating to aviation security established by the International Civil Aviation Organization and designated as Annexes to the Convention on International civil Aviation to the extent that such Standards and Recommended Practices are applicable to the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约国各方应在相互关系中遵守国际民航组织就航空安全事宜制定的标准和建议措施，并在这些标准和建议措施被指定为《国际民用航空公约》附件的范围内予以实施。

Query_Text_en: They shall require that operators of aircraft of their registry and operators of aircraft who have their principal place of business or permanent residence in their territory and operators of airport in their territory act in conformity with such aviation security provisions .
Translation: 缔约国应当要求其登记的航空器运营人、其境内设有主要营业地或常住地的航空器运营人以及其领土内的机场运营人遵守上述航空安保规定。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Both Contracting Parties agree that such operators of aircraft may be required to observe the aviation security provisions established by the other Contracting Party as referred to in paragraph [ 3 ] of this Article for entry into , departure from , or while within the territory of that other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约双方同意，航空器运营人应当遵守缔约另一方根据本条第3款所述制定的航空安全规定，该规定适用于航空器进入、离开或在其领土内停留期间的情况。

Query_Text_en: Both Contracting Parties shall ensure that adequate measures are effectively applied within its territory to protect the safety of the aircraft prior to and during boarding or loading , and to inspect passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and aircraft stores prior to boarding or loading .
Translation: 缔约双方应确保在其领土内采取充分有效的措施，以保障航空器在登机或装载前及过程中的安全，并在登机或装载前对旅客、机组人员、行李、货物及航空器供应品进行检查。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall also give sympathetic consideration to any request from the other Contracting Party for reasonable special security measures to meet a particular threat .
Translation: 各缔约方应对另一缔约方提出的、为应对特定威胁而采取合理特殊安全措施的任何请求予以善意考虑。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] When an incident or threat of unlawful seizure of aircraft or other unlawful acts against the safety of such aircraft , their passengers and crew , airports or air navigation facilities occurs , the Contracting Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications and other appropriate measures intended to terminate rapidly and safely such incident or threat .
Translation: 当发生非法劫持航空器或其他危害航空器及其乘客、机组人员、机场或航空导航设施安全的事件或威胁时，缔约国应当通过提供通信协助及其他适当措施相互协作，以迅速、安全地终止此类事件或威胁。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party may request consultations at any time concerning the safety standards maintained by the other Contracting Party in areas relating to aeronautical facilities , flight crew , aircraft and the operation of aircraft .
Translation: 缔约各方可随时就另一缔约方在航空设施、机组人员、航空器及其运行等领域维持的安全标准提出磋商请求。

Query_Text_en: Such consultations shall take place within thirty days of that request .
Translation: 此类磋商应在该请求提出后三十日内举行。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] If , following such consultations , one Contracting Party finds that the other Contracting Party does not effectively maintain and administer safety standards in the areas referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] that meet the Standards established at that time pursuant to the Convention on International Civil Aviation , the other Contracting Party shall be informed of such findings and of the steps considered necessary to conform with the ICAO Standards .
Translation: 在进行此类磋商后，如一缔约方认定另一缔约方未能有效维持和管理本条第[1]款所指领域中符合《国际民用航空公约》当时制定标准的安全标准，应将相关发现及认为必要的纠正措施告知另一缔约方。

Query_Text_en: The other Contracting Party shall then take appropriate corrective action within an agreed time period .
Translation: 另一缔约方应在商定的期限内采取适当的纠正措施。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Pursuant to Article 16 of the Convention , it is further agreed that , any aircraft operated by , or on behalf of an airline of one Contracting Party , on service to or from the territory of another Contracting Party , may , while within the territory of the other Contracting Party be the subject of a search by the authorized representatives of the other Contracting Party , provided this does not cause unreasonable delay in the operation of the aircraft .
Translation: 根据公约第十六条，缔约各方进一步达成一致：缔约国一方的航空公司的航空器，或由其代表运营的航空器，在飞往或飞离另一缔约国领土的航程中，进入另一缔约国领土时可接受该缔约国授权代表的检查，但不得因此造成该航空器运营的不合理延误。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the obligations mentioned in Article 33 of the Convention , the purpose of this search is to verify the validity of the relevant aircraft documentation , the licensing of its crew , and that the aircraft equipment and the condition of the aircraft conform to the Standards established at that time pursuant to the Convention .
Translation: 尽管存在公约第33条所述的义务，此次检查的目的在于验证相关航空器文件的有效性、机组人员的执照情况，以及航空器设备及适航状态是否符合根据公约规定当时制定的标准。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] When urgent action is essential to ensure the safety of an airline operation , each Contracting Party reserves the right to immediately suspend or vary the operating authorization of an airline or airlines of the other Party .
Translation: 当采取紧急措施成为确保航空运营安全的必要手段时，各缔约国保留立即暂停或调整另一缔约方航空公司运营许可的权利。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] Any action by one Contracting Party in accordance with paragraph [ 4 ] above shall be discontinued once the basis for the taking of that action ceases to exist .
Translation: 一旦采取该行动的基础不再存在，相关缔约方依据上文第4款采取的任何行动均应终止。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] With reference to paragraph [ 2 ] , if it is determined that one Contracting Party remains in non-compliance with ICAO Standards when the agreed time period has elapsed , the Secretary General of ICAO should be advised thereof .
Translation: 根据第[2]段，当约定时间期满后，如经核查某缔约方仍未遵守国际民航组织标准，则应向国际民航组织秘书长通报有关情况。

Query_Text_en: The latter should also be advised of the subsequent satisfactory resolution of the situation .
Translation: 后者还应被告知相关情况后续已得到圆满解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Recognition of Certificates and LicensesEach Contracting Party shall recognize the valid certificate of air worthiness , certificate of competency and licenses issued or validated by the other Contracting Party for the operation of the agreed services on the specified route , provided that the standards of such certificates and licenses are equivalent to or above the minimum standards established from time to time in accordance with the Convention .
Translation:
第十六条 证书及执照的互认  
每一缔约方应承认另一缔约方为在指定航线上运营的约定服务所签发或确认的有效适航证书、适任证书及执照，前提是此类证书和执照的标准等同于或高于根据公约不时制定的最低标准。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] In a spirit of close cooperation the two Contracting Parties or their aeronautical authorities shall consult each other from time to time with a view to ensuring the implementation of and satisfactory compliance with the provisions of this Agreement and Annexes thereto .
Translation: 缔约双方或其航空当局应秉持密切合作的精神，适时进行磋商，以确保本协议及其附件各项规定的有效实施和顺利遵守。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] If either Contracting Party considers it desirable to amend any of the provisions of this Agreement , it may request consultation with the other Contracting Party . Such consultation , which may be through discussion or by correspondence , shall begin within a period of sixty [ 60 ] days from the date of the request .
Translation: [2] 如任一缔约方认为有必要修改本协议的任何条款，可向另一方缔约方提出磋商请求。此类磋商可通过讨论或书面形式进行，应自请求之日起六十[60]日内启动。

Query_Text_en: Any amendments so agreed shall come into force when they have been confirmed by an exchange of diplomatic notes following completion of the constitutional or otherwise required procedures .
Translation: 经各方同意的修正案，应在完成宪法规定的或其他必要的程序后，通过交换外交照会予以确认，并自确认之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Amendments relating only to the provisions of the annexed Schedules and memorandum of understanding may be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 仅涉及附约及谅解备忘录条款的修正案，可由缔约各方的航空主管当局达成协议。

Query_Text_en: Such amendments will become effective as soon as they are approved by both aeronautical authorities .
Translation: 此类修订内容一经双方航空主管部门批准即可生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] If any dispute arises between the Contracting Parties relating to the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement , the aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties shall in the first place settle the dispute by negotiation .
Translation: 如果缔约双方就本协议的解释或实施发生任何争端，缔约双方的航空当局应首先通过谈判解决该争端。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to reach a settlement of the said dispute , the Contracting Parties shall settle such dispute through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 如果缔约方的航空当局未能解决上述争端，缔约方应通过外交渠道解决此类争端。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 TerminationEither Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party through diplomatic channels of its decision to terminate this Agreement .
Translation:
第十九条 终止  
任一缔约方均可随时通过外交渠道通知另一缔约方其决定终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall then terminate 12 months after the date of receipt of the notice by the other Contracting Party unless such notice is withdrawn by agreement between the Contracting Parties before the expiry of this period .
Translation: 本协议应于另一缔约方收到通知之日起12个月后终止，除非缔约双方在该期限届满前协商一致撤回该通知。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 RegistryThis Agreement or any amendment thereto shall be registered with the International Civil Aviation Organization .
Translation:
第二十条 登记  
本协议及其任何修正均应向国际民航组织办理登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 Entry Into forceThis Agreement shall enter into force on the date of the last notification through diplomatic notes by either Contracting Party to the other Contracting party that it has fulfilled the necessary measures in accordance with its laws and regulations for the entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation:
第二十一条 生效  
本协定应于双方缔约方通过外交照会将最后通知送达对方之日生效。该生效日期以任一缔约方依据其国内法律和法规完成为使本协定生效所需措施后所作的通知为准。

Query_Text_en: In witness whereof , the undersigned , duly authorized by their respective Governments , have signed this Agreement .
Translation: 鉴此，下列签署人经各自政府正式授权，签署本协议。

Query_Text_en: Done in Beijing on 23rd July 2007 in duplicate in the Chinese , Arabic and English languages , all texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 于2007年7月23日在北京市签署，用中文、阿拉伯语和英语三种文字写成，一式两份，各文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The designated airline [ s ] of either Contracting Party may omit , at its own discretion , any point on the specified route on any or all flights , provided that the agreed services begin and terminate in the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline [ s ] .
Translation: 缔约双方指定的空运企业可在任何或所有航班上自行决定取消其指定航线上任何中途点，但须确保相关服务的起讫点位于指定空运企业所属缔约方的领土内。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 1 1 . Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the right to operate scheduled air services [ hereinafter referred to as `` the agreed services '' ] on the route specified in the Annex to the present Agreement [ hereinafter referred to as `` the specified route '' ] .
Translation: 第一条 每一缔约方应向另一缔约方授予在本协议附件所列航线上经营定期航空运输服务的权利（以下简称"约定服务"）。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Subject to the provisions of the present Agreement , aircraft of the airline designated by each Contracting Party [ hereinafter referred to as `` the designated airline '' ] operating on the agreed services over the specified route shall have the right to make stops at the point on the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of putting down or taking on international traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail coming from or destined for the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 根据本协议规定，每一缔约方指定空运企业的航空器在指定航线上经营协议规定航班时，有权在另一缔约方领土内指定航线上指定的地点经停，以便上下来自或前往第一个缔约方领土的国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: The exercise of the traffic right between the point in the territory of the other Contracting Party and the intermediate points on the specified route shall be subject to the relevant provisions of the Annex to the present Agreement .
Translation: 在另一缔约方领土内的地点与指定航线上中间点之间的航权行使，应受本协议附件中相关规定之约束。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Contracting Party shall notify the other Contracting Party not later than sixty [ 60 ] days in advance of the date of the commencement of operation of the agreed services by its designated airline .
Translation: 每一缔约方应将其指定空运企业开始运营协议规定的航空服务的日期，不迟于六十（60）日前通知另一缔约方。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 2 1 . Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate one airline to operate the agreed services on the route specified in the Annex to the present Agreement and shall notify the other Contracting Party of such designation through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 第二条第一款 每一缔约方均有权指定一家航空公司运营本协定附件所列航线上协定的航空服务，并通过外交途径将此项指定通知另一缔约方。

Query_Text_en: 3 . On receipt of such notification , the other Contracting Party shall , subject to the provisions of paragraph 2 of this Article , grant without delay to the designated airline of the first Contracting Party the appropriate operating permission .
Translation: 另一缔约方应在收到此类通知后，在符合本条第二款规定的情况下，立即向首个缔约方指定的空运企业授予相应的运营许可。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Aeronautical Authorities of each Contracting Party [ for the purpose of the present Agreement , the term `` Aeronautical Authorities '' means , in the case of China , the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China , and in the case of Kingdom of Spain , the Subsecretaria de Aviation Civil , Ministry of Transport and Communications ] may require the designated airline of the other Contracting Party to satisfy them that it is qualified to fulfil the conditions prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied to the operation of international air services by such Authorities .
Translation: 根据本协议，"航空当局"一指在中国为民用航空总局，在西班牙为运输和通信部民航次-secretaria的各缔约国航空当局，可要求另一缔约国指定的航空公司向其证明，该航空公司具备符合此类航空当局在管理国际航空服务时通常合理适用的法律法规所规定条件的能力。

Query_Text_en: orc ] where that airline otherwise fails to operate in accordance with the conditions prescribed under the present Agreement .
Translation: 若该航空公司未能按照本协议规定的条件开展运营，则适用上述其他条款（ORC）。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 4The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the admission to , stay in , departure from and operation in its territory of aircraft engaged in the operation of international air services as well as the laws and regulations relating to the admission to , stay in and departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail shall be applicable to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , its crew as well as the passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried by such aircraft , while in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第四条  
缔约一方有关从事国际航空运输的航空器进入、停留、离境及其在该方领土内运营的法律和法规，以及有关旅客、机组人员、行李、货物和邮件进入、停留及离境的法律和法规，均应适用于另一缔约方指定航空公司的航空器及其机组人员，以及该航空器载运的旅客、行李、货物和邮件在其领土内的期间。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall supply the other Contracting Party with information relevant to the above-mentioned laws and regulations in time .
Translation: 每一缔约方应及时向另一缔约方提供与上述法律法规相关的资料。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 5 1 . Aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline of either Contracting Party as well as the regular equipment , spare parts , supplies of fuel and lubricants and aircraft stores [ including food , beverages and tobacco ] retained on board the aircraft shall be exempt from all customs duties , inspection fees and other similar charges on arrival in and departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party , provided that such equipment and supplies remain on board the aircraft up to such time as they are re-exported or are used on the part of the journey performed over that territory .
Translation:
第五条  
一、缔约任何一方指定空运企业经营协议航班的航空器及其常规设备、备件、燃料和润滑油补给、机上用品（包括食品、饮料及烟草），在进出缔约另一方领土时，只要上述设备和用品一直保留在机上直至重新出口或在该领土航段使用完毕，应免征关税、检验费及其他类似费用。

Query_Text_en: andc ] fuel and lubricants destined to supply outbound aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party , even when these supplies are to be used on the part of the journey performed over the territory of the Contracting Party in which they are taken on board .
Translation: 专供另一缔约方指定承运人运营的协议规定航班服务出境航班使用的燃料和润滑油，即使这些补给品需在装运地领陆境内的航段中使用。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The regular airborne equipment as well as the materials and supplies retained on board the aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 任一缔约方指定航空公司的航空器上常规机载设备，以及留存于该航空器上的材料和供应品，仅可在获得另一方海关当局批准后，在另一方领土内卸载。

Query_Text_en: The articles unloaded in the said territory as well as those introduced into the said territory shall be placed under the supervision of the said authorities and shall not be sold or used for other purposes in the above territory until such time as they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the customs regulations .
Translation: 本地区卸载的货物以及输入该地区的货物应接受相关主管部门监管，在重新出口或按照海关规定完成其他处置程序前，不得在上述区域内销售或用于其他用途。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Passengers in transit across the territory of either Contracting Party shall be subject to no more than a very simplified control .
Translation: 缔约任何一方领土内过境的旅客应仅接受极为简化的检查。

Query_Text_en: Baggage and cargo in direct transit shall be exempt from customs duties and other similar taxes .
Translation: 直接过境的行李和货物应免征关税及其他类似税款。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 6 1 . Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory regular airport and alternate airport to be used by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified route , and provide the latter with communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary services in its territory as are required for the operation of the agreed services .
Translation:
第六条第一款  
每一缔约方应在其领土内为另一缔约方指定的空运企业运营指定航路，指定常备机场和备用机场，并在其领土内提供通信、导航、气象及其他所需的辅助服务，以满足协定服务运营所需。

Query_Text_en: Detailed arrangements for the above shall be agreed upon between the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 上述具体安排应由双方航空主管当局商定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The designated airline of one Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airport [ s ] , equipment , technical services and air navigation facilities of the other Contracting Party at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the appropriate authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方指定的空运企业应按照缔约另一方主管当局规定的公平合理费率，缴纳使用缔约另一方机场、设备、技术服务及航空导航设施的费用。

Query_Text_en: Such rates shall not be higher than those normally paid by airlines of other States .
Translation: 此类费率不得高于其他缔约国航空公司的通常支付标准。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 7 1 . The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall have fair and equal opportunities in operating the agreed services on the specified routes .
Translation: 第七条第一款 缔约双方指定的空运企业应在指定航线上经营约定的航空服务时享有公平和平等的机会。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In operating the agreed services , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party , so as not to affect unduly the services which the latter provides on the whole or part of the same route .
Translation: 在运营约定航班时，各缔约方指定的空运企业应顾及其他缔约方指定空运企业的利益，以免不当影响后者在全部或部分相同航线上提供的航班服务。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Matters relating to the operation of the specified routes such as frequency , type of aircraft , schedule , sales representation and ground handling shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 关于指定航线运营的相关事宜，包括航班班次、机型、航班时刻表、销售代理安排及地面服务等，应由缔约双方指定的航空公司通过协商确定。

Query_Text_en: The frequency , type of aircraft as well as schedule so agreed shall be subject to the approval of their respective Aeronautical Authorities .
Translation: 双方协议中达成一致的航班频率、机型以及航班时刻表，应经各自航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The agreed services provided by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall satisfy the current and anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail coming from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party which has designated the airline .
Translation: 缔约双方指定空运企业所提供的协议服务，应能满足指定该空运企业的缔约方领土所来自或前往的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的当前及未来运输需求。

Query_Text_en: andc ] the requirements of through airline operation .
Translation: 直航运营的相关要求。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 8 1 . In the following paragraphs , the term `` tariff '' means the prices to be paid for the carriage of passengers , baggage and cargo and the conditions under which those prices apply , including prices and conditions for agency and other auxiliary services , but excluding remuneration or conditions for the carriage of mail .
Translation:
第八条第一款  
本条所称"运价"，是指旅客、行李和货物运输的价格以及这些价格适用的条件，包括代理服务和其他辅助服务的价格和条件，但不包括邮件运输的报酬或条件。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The tariffs to be applied on the specified routes between the territory of one Contracting Party and that of the other Contracting Party shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约一方领土与另一缔约方领土之间指定航线适用的关税，应由双方缔约方指定的航空公司协商确定。

Query_Text_en: Such tariffs shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors , including cost of operation , reasonable profit and the tariffs of other airlines .
Translation: 此类运价应设定在合理水平，在综合考虑各项相关因素的基础上确定，包括运营成本、合理利润以及其他航空公司的运价水平。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The tariffs so agreed shall be submitted for the approval of the respective Aeronautical Authorities at least ninety [ 90 ] days before the proposed date of their introduction .
Translation: 双方商定的关税应于计划实施日期至少九十日前提交各自航空主管当局批准。

Query_Text_en: In special cases , this period may be reduced , subject to the agreement of the said Authorities .
Translation: 在特殊情况下，经相关机构同意，本期限可予以缩短。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If neither of the Aeronautical Authorities of the two Contracting Parties has expressed disapproval within thirty [ 30 ] days from the date of submission in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article , these tariffs shall be considered as approved .
Translation: 如果两国缔约方的航空当局均未在按照本条第三款规定提交之日起三十[30]日内提出异议，则这些费率应视为已获批准。

Query_Text_en: In the event of the period for submission being reduced , as provided for in paragraph 3 , the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties may agree that period within which any disapproval must be notified shall be less than thirty [ 30 ] days .
Translation: 根据本条第三款规定，如提交期限被缩短时，缔约双方航空当局可商定反对意见必须通知的期限可少于三十[30]日。

Query_Text_en: 5 . If a tariff can not be agreed in accordance with paragraph 2 of this Article , or if , during the period applicable in accordance with paragraph 4 of this Article the Aeronautical Authorities of one Contracting Party give the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party notice of their disapproval of any tariff agreed in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 2 , the Aeronautical Authorities of the two Contracting Parties shall endeavor to determine the tariff by mutual agreement .
Translation: 如根据本条第二款未能达成关税协议，或在根据本条第四款规定适用的期限内，一方缔约方航空当局向另一方缔约方航空当局通知其不同意根据本条第二款规定达成的任何关税，则双方缔约方航空当局应努力通过协商确定相关关税。

Query_Text_en: 6 . If the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties can not agree on any tariff submitted to them under paragraph 3 of this Articles , or on the determination of any tariff under paragraph 5 of this Article , the dispute shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article 15 of the present Agreement .
Translation: 如果本协议双方缔约方的航空当局无法就根据本条第三款提交的任何费率达成一致，或就根据本条第五款确定的任何费率达成一致，则相关争议应按照本协议第十五条的规定予以解决。

Query_Text_en: 7 . A tariff established in accordance with the provisions of this Article shall remain in force until a new tariff has been established .
Translation: 根据本条规定设立的关税应继续有效，直至新关税被设立。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , a tariff shall not be prolonged by virtue of this paragraph for more than twelve months after the date on which it otherwise would have expired .
Translation: 但是，根据本段规定延长的关税期限不得超过其原本应到期日后十二个月。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 9The revenue derived from the transportation of international traffic by the designated airline of each Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be permitted to be transferred at the official rate of exchange by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第九条 一方缔约方指定航空公司从另一缔约方领土内国际运输业务中取得的收入，应准予其按照官方汇率进行转移。

Query_Text_en: Wherever the payments system between the Contracting Parties is governed by a special agreement , that agreement shall apply .
Translation: 凡缔约双方之间的支付系统受特别协议管辖的情形，该协议应予适用。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 10The Aeronautical Authorities of either Contracting Party shall supply to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party , at their request , such statistic statement as may be reasonably required for the purpose of reviewing the capacity provided on the agreed services by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 第十条 缔约任何一方的航空当局应向另一缔约方的航空当局提供合理所需的统计报表，以审查首方指定航空公司在其协议服务中提供的运力。

Query_Text_en: Such statements shall include all information required to determine the amount of traffic carried by that airline on the agreed services .
Translation: 此类申报文件应包含确定该航空公司在协议服务中所承运的客货流量所需的所有信息。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 11 1 . For the operation of the specified route , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have the right to set up its representative office at the point of call on the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第十一款第一条：在运营指定航线时，缔约各方指定的空运企业有权在另一缔约方领土内指定航线的停靠点设立其代表机构。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such representative office shall be citizens of the People 's Republic of China and of the Kingdom of Spain , and the number of staff shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , and shall be subject to the approval of the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 此类代表处的工作人员应为中华人民共和国和西班牙王国的公民，其人数由双方缔约方指定的航空公司通过协商确定，并须经双方航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such representative office must observe the laws and regulations in force in the country where such office is located .
Translation: 该代表处的工作人员必须遵守所在国现行有效的法律法规。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Contracting Party shall endeavor to ensure the safety of the aircraft , stores , and other properties in its territory used on the agreed services by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方应努力确保在其领土内由另一缔约方指定的空运企业用于约定服务的航空器、供应品及其他财产的安全。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The crew members of the designated airline of either Contracting Party flying on the specified route shall be citizens of such Contracting Party .
Translation: 任一缔约方指定航空公司在指定航线上飞行的机组人员应为该缔约方的公民。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 12Certificates of airworthiness , certificates of competency and licenses issued or rendered valid by one Contracting Party and still in force shall be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party for the purpose of operating the route and services provided in the Annex to the present Agreement , provided that the requirement under which such certificates or licenses were issued or rendered valid are equal to or above the minimum standards which may be established pursuant to the laws and regulations of the respective Contracting Parties .
Translation: 根据本协议附件规定的航线上运营相关业务时，一方缔约方颁发或确认有效且仍然有效的航空器适航证书、人员合格证书及执照，另一方缔约方应予承认有效，前提是颁发此类证书或执照所依据的要求不低于根据各自缔约方的法律和法规所确立的最低标准。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party reserves the right , however , of refusing to recognize the validity of the certificates of competency and the licenses granted to its own citizens by the other Contracting Party for the purpose of flight in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 各缔约方保留拒绝承认另一缔约方为其本国公民颁发的合格证书和执照有效性的权利，该证书及执照的适用范围为在第一缔约方领土内从事飞行活动。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 13 1 . Should an aircraft of the designated airline of one Contracting Party experiences and accident or be in distress in the territory of the other Contracting Party , the latter shall instruct its appropriate authorities to immediately inform the Aeronautical Authorities of the first Contracting Party and provide necessary assistance to the crew and passengers on board the aircraft .
Translation:
第十三条  
1. 如果某一缔约方指定航空公司的飞机在另一缔约方领土内发生事故或遇险，后者应指令其有关部门立即通知首述缔约方的航空主管部门，并向机上机组人员及乘客提供必要协助。

Query_Text_en: f ] communicate in writing to the Aeronautical Authorities of the first Contracting Party the result of the investigation .
Translation: f ] 向第一缔约方的航空当局书面通报调查结果。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 14In a spirit of close cooperation , the two Contracting Parties shall consult each other from time to time with a view to ensuring the implementation of , and satisfactory compliance with the provisions of the present Agreement and the Annex thereto .
Translation: 第十四条 本着密切合作的精神，缔约双方应定期进行磋商，以确保本协议及其附件的规定得到实施和有效遵守。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 15If any dispute arises between the Contracting Parties relating to the interpretation or implementation of the present Agreement , the Contracting Parties shall in the first place instruct their respective Aeronautical Authorities to settle it by negotiation .
Translation:
第十五条  
如果缔约方之间发生关于本协议解释或实施的争端，缔约方应首先指示各自航空当局通过协商解决。

Query_Text_en: If the said Authorities fail to reach an agreement , the dispute shall be settled through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 如有关当局未能达成一致，争端应通过外交渠道解决。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 16If either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to modify or amend any provisions of the present Agreement or the Annex thereto , it may request consultation with the other Contracting Party . Such consultation , which may be between the Aeronautical Authorities and which may be through discussion or by correspondence , shall begin within a period of sixty [ 60 ] days from the date of the request .
Translation:
第十六条  
如缔约任何一方认为有必要修改或修正本协议或本协议附件的任何条款，可向另一方提出协商请求。此类协商可在航空当局之间进行，且可通过讨论或书面形式开展，应当自请求之日起六十天内开始。

Query_Text_en: Modifications or amendments so agreed upon shall come into force when they have been confirmed by an exchange of diplomatic notes .
Translation: 经各方同意的修改或修正，经交换外交照会确认后生效。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 17Either Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party of its desire to terminate the present Agreement .
Translation: 第十七条 任一缔约方均可随时通知另一缔约方，表明其终止本协定之意图。

Query_Text_en: The present Agreement shall then terminate twelve [ 12 ] months after the date of receipt of the notice by the other Contracting Party . If the above notice is withdrawn before the expiry of this period , the present Agreement shall continue to be in force with the concurrence of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 本协议应于另一缔约方收到通知之日起十二（12）个月后终止。若上述通知在该期限届满前被撤回，则经另一缔约方同意后，本协议将继续有效。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 18The present Agreement shall come into force after both Contracting Parties have respectively completed their legal formalities and notified each other to this effect through exchange of diplomatic notes .
Translation: 第十八条 本协议应于缔约双方各自完成各自应履行的法律程序，并通过外交照会相互通知后生效。

Query_Text_en: Done at Peking on this nineteenth day of June , 1978 in duplicate in the Chinese , Spanish and English languages , the three texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本文件于一九七八年六月十九日在北京签署，制成中文、西班牙文和英文三种文本，三种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: The route of the agreed services to be operated by the designated airline of the Government of the People 's Republic of China shall be as follows in both directions :
Translation: 中华人民共和国政府指定的航空公司运营协议规定航空服务的往返航线如下：

Query_Text_en: one point in China - intermediate points - one point in SpainThe points referred to in the above route shall be agreed upon between the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation:
中国一点——中间点——西班牙一点  
上述航线所涉及的点位应由双方航空主管部门协商确定。

Query_Text_en: one point in Spain - intermediate points - one point in China
Translation: 西班牙的一个枢纽——中间节点——中国的枢纽点

Query_Text_en: The points referred to in the above route shall be agreed upon between the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 上述航线上所涉及的相关事项应由缔约双方的航空当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: II . TRAFFIC RIGHTThe exercise of the traffic right by the designated airline of either Contracting Party between the intermediate points and the point on the specified route in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be determined by an agreement between the Aeronautical Authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 关于航权的行使，任一缔约方指定航空公司在另一缔约方领土内指定航线上各中间点与指定航点之间的运营安排，应通过双方航空当局之间的协议确定。

Query_Text_en: III . RIGHT OF OMISSIONThe aircraft of the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties operated on the agreed services over the specified routes may omit calling at any intermediate point , provided that prior notification to this effect is served to each other as much in advance as practicable .
Translation: 缔约双方指定航空公司在指定航线上运营协议服务时，可不经停任何中途点，但须事先向对方发出通知，并尽可能提前。

Query_Text_en: and [ e ] such business-concessions under public law or under contract , including concessions regarding the prospecting for , or the extraction or winning of natural resources , as give to their holder a legal position of some duration .
Translation: 以及[ e ]根据公法或合同授予的此类商业特许权，包括涉及自然资源勘探、开采或获取的特许权，这些特许权赋予其持有人某种持续性的法律地位。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The term `` investor '' shall mean : In respect of the People 's Republic of China , any company , other legal person or citizen of China authorized by the Chinese Government to make an investment ;
Translation: “投资者”一词应指：就中华人民共和国而言，经中国政府授权进行投资的任何中国公司、其他法人或中国公民；

Query_Text_en: In respect of Sweden , any individual who is a citizen of Sweden according toSwedish law well as any legal person with its seat in Sweden or with a predominating Swedish interest .
Translation: 就瑞典而言，指根据瑞典法律具有瑞典国籍的任何个人，以及注册地在瑞典或主要利益关联在瑞典的任何法人实体。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 [ 1 ] Each Contracting State shall at all times ensure fair and equitable treatment to the investments by investors of the other Contracting State .
Translation: 第二条 [1] 每一缔约国应在任何时候确保对另一缔约国投资者的投资给予公平公正待遇。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Investments by investors of either Contracting State in the territory of the other Contracting State shall not be subjected a treatment less favourable than that accorded to investments by investors of third States .
Translation: 缔约任一一方投资者在缔约另一方领土内的投资，不得给予比第三国投资者所享受的待遇更为不利的待遇。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article , a Contracting State , which has concluded with one or more other States an agreement regarding the formation of a customs union or a free-trade , shall be free to grant a more favourable treatment to investments by investors of the State or States , which are also parties to the said agreement , or by investors of some of these States .
Translation: 本条第2款另有规定者除外，与其他一个或多个国家缔结有关建立关税同盟或自由贸易协定的协议的缔约国，可自由给予来自该协议缔约国或其他缔约国的投资者，或其中部分缔约国的投资者的投资以更优惠的待遇。

Query_Text_en: A Contracting State shall also be free to grant a more favourable treatment to investments by investors of other States , if this is stipulated under bilateral agreements concluded with such States before the date of the signature of this Agreement .
Translation: 缔约方亦有权自主决定根据在本协定签署之日前与相关国家缔结的双边协定规定，给予其他国家投资者更优惠的待遇。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 [ 1 ] Neither Contracting State shall expropriate or nationalize , or take any other similar measure in regard to , an investment made in its territory by an investor of the other Contracting State , except in the public interest , under due process of law and against compensation , the purpose of which shall be to place the investor in the same financial position as that in which the investor would have been if the expropriation or nationalization had not taken place .
Translation: 缔约一方不得对缔约另一方投资者在其境内的投资采取征收、国有化或其他类似措施，除非是为了公共利益、遵循法律程序并给予补偿，其目的应是使投资者处于若未发生征收或国有化时本可处的同等财务地位。

Query_Text_en: The expropriation or nationalization shall not be discriminatory and the compensation shall be paid without unreasonable delay and shall be convertible and freely transferable between the territories of the Contracting States .
Translation: 征收或国有化不得具有歧视性，补偿金应以可兑换且可自由转移至缔约国境内的货币支付，且不得无故拖延。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The provisions of paragraph [ 1 ] shall also apply to the current income from an investment as well as , in the event of liquidation , to the proceeds from the liquidation .
Translation: 本条第一款规定同样适用于投资的经常性收入，以及在清算情况下适用于清算所得。

Query_Text_en: and [ d ] The earnings of nationals of the other Contracting States who are allowed to work in connection with an investment in its territory .
Translation: 以及[ d ] 缔约国国民获准在其领土内与投资相关的所得。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 If a Contracting State makes a payment to an investor under a guarantee it has granted in respect of an investment in territory of the other Contracting State , that Contracting State shall , without prejudice to the rights of the former Contracting State under Article 6 , recognize the transfer of any right or title of such investor to the former Contracting State and the subrogation of the former Contracting State to any such right or title .
Translation: 第五条 如果一缔约方根据其就另一缔约方领土内投资所出具的担保向投资者进行赔付，该缔约方应在不妨碍其根据第六条所享权利的情况下，承认该投资者向其转移的任何权利或所有权，以及该缔约方基于此获得的任何权利或所有权的代位权。

Query_Text_en: The subrogation shall concern the claim of the investor from which shall be deducted any debts which the investor may have to the other Contracting State .
Translation: 代位权应涉及投资者的债权，从中应扣除投资者对另一缔约国可能负有的任何债务。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 [ 1 ] Disputes between the Contracting States concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement shall , if possible , be settled by negotiations between the Governments of the two Contracting States .
Translation: 第六条 [1] 缔约国之间关于本协定的解释或适用所产生的争端，如有可能，应由两国政府通过谈判解决。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] If the dispute can not thus be settled it shall , upon the request of either Contracting State , be submitted to an arbitral tribunal .
Translation: 如果争端因此无法解决，应任何一方缔约国的要求，应提交仲裁庭处理。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Such arbitral tribunal shall be established in each individual case , each Contracting State appointing one member , and those two members shall then agree upon a national of a third State as their Chairman to be appointed by the Governments of the two Contracting States .
Translation: 仲裁庭应在每一具体案件中设立，每一缔约国任命一名成员，该两名成员应随后就第三国的一名国民作为其主席达成一致，该主席须由两国政府任命。

Query_Text_en: Such members shall be appointed within two months , and such Chairman within three months , after either Contracting State has made known to the other Contracting State that it wishes the dispute to be submitted to an arbitral tribunal .
Translation: 在任一缔约方向另一缔约方通知其希望将争端提交仲裁庭后，相关成员应在两个月内任命，主席则应在三个月内任命。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] If the periods specified in paragraph [ 3 ] have not been observed , either Contracting State may , in the absence of any other relevant arrangement , invite the Secretary-General of the United Nations to make the necessary appointments .
Translation: 若未遵守第[3]条所规定的期限，任一缔约国可在没有其他相关安排的情况下，邀请联合国秘书长作出必要任命。

Query_Text_en: If the Secretary-General is a national of either Contracting State or if he is otherwise prevented from discharging the said function , the Under Secretary-General for Legal Affairs shall be invited to make the necessary appointments .
Translation: 如果秘书长属于缔约国国民，或因其他原因无法履行上述职责，则应邀请法律事务副秘书长负责相关任命事宜。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The arbitral tribunal shall reach its decision by a majority of votes . Such decisons shall be binding .
Translation: 仲裁庭应以投票表决的多数票作出决定。此类决定应具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting State shall bear the cost of its own member and of its counsel in the arbitral proceedings , the cost of the Chairman and the remaining costs shall be borne in equal parts by both Contracting States .
Translation: 每个缔约国应承担其在仲裁程序中本方成员及法律顾问的费用，主席的费用以及其余费用应由双方缔约国平均分担。

Query_Text_en: The arbitral tribunal may make a different regulation concerning costs .
Translation: 仲裁庭可就费用问题另行规定。

Query_Text_en: In all other respects , the arbitral tribunal shall determine its own procedure .
Translation: 在其他方面，仲裁庭应自行决定其程序。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 Nothing in this Agreement shall prejudice any rights or benefits accruing under national or international law to interests of a national or a company of one Contracting State in the territory of the other Contracting State .
Translation: 本协定的任何规定均不得损害缔约国一方的国民或公司在另一缔约国领土内依据国内法或国际法所享有的任何权利或利益。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 This Agreement shall apply to all investments made after July , 1 , 1979 .
Translation: 第八条 本协议适用于1979年7月1日之后作出的所有投资。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 [ 1 ] This Agreement shall enter into force immediately upon signature .
Translation: 第九条 [1] 本协议应自签署之日起立即生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of fifteen years and shall continue in force thereafter nuless , after the expiry of the initial period of fourteen years , either Contracting State notifies in writing the other Contracting State of its intention to terminate this Agreement . The notice of termination shall become effective one year after it has been received by the other Contracting State .
Translation: 本协议有效期为十五年，并在期满后继续有效，除非在初始十四年期满后，任一缔约方以书面形式通知另一方终止本协议。终止通知在送达另一方后一年生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] In respect of investments made prior to the date when the notice of termination of this Agreement becomes effective , the provisions of Articles 1 to 8 shall remain in force for a further period of fifteen years from that date .
Translation: 对于在本协议终止通知生效之日前所作的投资，本协议第一条至第八条的规定自该日起再延长十五年有效。

Query_Text_en: Done in Beijing on March 29 , 1982 , in two originals in the Chinese , Swedish and English languages , all texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本协定于一九八二年三月二十九日在北京签订，正本用中文、瑞典文和英文写成，三种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] the term `` stop for non-traffic purposes '' means a landing for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers , baggages , cargo or mail .
Translation: “非交通目的停靠”指除上下旅客、行李、货物或邮件以外的任何目的的着陆。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The Route Schedule forms an integral part of the Present Agreement , and all references to the Agreement shall include reference to the Route Schedule except where otherwise provided .
Translation: 航线时刻表构成本协议的不可分割部分，除非另有规定，否则协议条款中所有提及协议之处均包括对航线时刻表的引用。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 2 [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in the present Agreement to enable the designated airline of the other Contracting Party to establish and operate international air services [ hereinafter referred to as `` the agreed services '' ] on the routes specified in the Route Schedule to the present Agreement [ hereinafter referred to as `` the specified route '' ] .
Translation: 第二条 [1] 每一缔约方应根据本协议规定向另一缔约方授予相应权利，以便另一缔约方指定空运企业能够按照本协议所附航线表（以下简称"指定航线"）中规定的航路，设立并运营协议约定的航空运输服务（以下简称"约定服务"）。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] to make stops in the said territory at the points on the routes specified in the Route Schedule to the Present Agreement for the purpose of putting down and taking on international traffic in passengers , baggages , cargo and mail .
Translation: 得在本协定所指区域内航线表规定的航线上指定点作停留，以便装卸国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Nothing in paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article shall be deemed to confer on the airline of one Contracting Party the privilege of taking up , in the territory of the other Contracting Party , passengers , baggages , cargo or mail carried for remuneration or hire and destined for another point in the territory of that other Contracting Party .
Translation: 本条第二款的规定不得视为赋予某一缔约方的航空公司在另一缔约方领土内享有承运乘客、行李、货物或邮件的权利，且此类运输以获取报酬或租金为目的，目的地为该另一缔约方领土内的另一点。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 3 [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate in writing to the other Contracting Party one airline for the purpose of operating the agreed services on the specified routes .
Translation: 第三条 [1] 每一缔约方有权以书面形式向另一缔约方指定一家航空公司，用于在指定航线上运营约定的服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] On receipt of such designation , the other Contracting Party shall , subject to the provisions of paragraphs [ 3 ] and [ 4 ] of this Article , without delay grant to the airline designated by the first Contracting Party the appropriate operating permission .
Translation: 缔约另一方在收到此类指定后，应遵守本条第[3]和[4]款规定，在遵守前提下尽快予以首方指定航空公司的相应运营许可。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the airline designated by the first Contrasting Party to satisfy them that it is qualified to fulfil the conditions prescribed by the said Aeronautical Authorities under the laws and regulations normally and reasonably applied to the operation of international air services .
Translation: 另一缔约方航空当局可要求首缔约方指定的航空公司证明其具备履行该航空当局根据国际航空服务运营中通常合理适用的法律法规所规定条件的能力。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The other Contracting Party shall have the right to withhold or revoke the operating permission referred to in paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article , in respect of the airline designated by the first Contracting Party in any case where the other Contracting Party is not satisfied that the substantial ownership and effective control of such airline are vested in the Contracting Party designating the airline or in its nationals .
Translation: 另一缔约方在认为第一缔约方指定的航空公司的实质性所有权和有效控制权未归属该指定缔约方或其国民的情况下，有权暂停或撤销该航空公司的运营许可。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The airline designated and authorized in accordance with the provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article may begin to operate the agreed services , provided that the tariffs established in accordance with the provisions of Article 11 of the present Agreement are in force in respect of these services .
Translation: 根据本条第一款和第二款规定指定和授权的航空公司，在按照本协议第十一条规定制定的运价对这些服务生效的前提下，可开始经营协议规定的航空服务。

Query_Text_en: or [ b ] where such airline otherwise fails to operate in accordance with the conditions prescribed in the present Agreement .
Translation: 或[ b ]若该航空公司未按照本协议规定之条件进行运营。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The right referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article shall be exercised only after consultation with the other Contracting Party , unless immediate suspension or imposition of necessary conditions is essential to prevent further infringement of such laws and regulations .
Translation: 本条第一款所指权利应经与另一方缔约方磋商后方可行使，除非立即中止或采取必要限制措施对于防止进一步违反相关法律法规至关重要。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 5The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the admission to , stay in , departure from and operation in its territory of aircraft engaged in the operation of international air services as well as the laws and regulations relating to the admission to , stay in and departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggages , cargo and mail shall be applicable to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , its crew as well as the passengers , baggages , cargo and mail carried by such aircraft , while in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第五条  
缔约一方有关航空器进入、停留、离开及其在境内运营国际航空服务的相关法律、法规，以及有关人员、机组、行李、货物和邮件进入、停留和离开其境内的规定，均应适用于另一缔约方指定的空运企业在其境内的期间。该规定适用于该空运企业的航空器及其机组人员，以及其所载乘客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] if it carries cargo , a manifest and detailed declaration of the cargo .
Translation: 如果载运货物，则需提供货物的载货清单及详细申报。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Certificate of airworthiness , certificates of competency and licenses issued or rendered valid by one Contracting Party and still in force , shall be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party for the purpose of operating the routes and services provided for in this Agreement , provided that the requirements under which such certificates or licenses were issued or rendered valid are not below the minimum standards which are normally applicable in international air transportation .
Translation: 缔约一方颁发或确认有效的适航证书、人员资格证书及运营许可证，如仍属有效，缔约另一方应承认其有效性，以便运营本协议规定的航线和业务。前提是签发或确认这些证书和执照的要求不低于国际航空运输中通常适用的最低标准。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Notwithstanding the preceding paragraph , each Contracting Party reserves the right to refuse to recognize , for the purpose of flight above its own territory , licenses and certificates as referred to in paragraph [ c ] of this Article granted to any of its nationals by the other con - tracting Party or by any third country .
Translation: 尽管有前文规定，各缔约方仍保留拒绝承认另一缔约方或第三国向其本国国民颁发的本条(c)款所述执照和证书的权利，此类拒绝承认适用于在其领空飞行的情形。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The crew members of aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party operating the agreed services above the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be nationals of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 任一缔约方指定航空公司在飞越另一方领土运营约定服务时，其机组成员应为该缔约方的国民。

Query_Text_en: In case the said airline desires to employ crew members of other nationalities for the operation of the agreed services , prior approval shall be obtained from the other Contracting Party through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 该航空公司如需雇佣其他国家的机组成员执行协议规定的服务，须事先通过外交途径获得另一缔约方的批准。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 7 [ 1 ] In case where aircraft of the designated airline of one Contracting Party is in distress or meets with an accident in the territory of the other Contracting Party , that other Contracting Party shall at once provide measures of assistance as far as practicable , and immediately inform the Aeronautical Authorities and the designated airline of the first Contracting Party of the circumstances of the distress or accident as well as such measures of assistance [ 2 ] If an accident to aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party involves death or serious injury to any persons or serious damage to the aircraft , the other Contracting Party shall take the following measures :
Translation:
第七条  
[1] 如一方缔约国指定空运企业的航空器在另一方缔约国领土内遇险或发生事故，该另一方缔约国应立即在可行范围内采取援助措施，并即刻将遇险或事故情况以及所采取的援助措施通知第一方缔约国的航空当局及该指定空运企业。  
[2] 若任一缔约国指定空运企业的航空器在另一缔约国领土内发生事故，且事故导致人员死亡或重伤，或造成航空器严重损毁，另一缔约国应采取以下措施：

Query_Text_en: and [ e ] to send the report of the investigation to the Aeronautical Authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 并将[ e ]将调查报告提交给另一缔约方的航空当局。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 8 [ 1 ] Aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline of either Contracting Party as well as the regular aircraft equipment , spare parts , supplies of fuel and lubricants and aircraft stores [ including food , beverages and tobacco ] retained on board the aircraft shall be exempt from all customs duties , inspection fees and other similar charges on arrival in and departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party , provided that such equipment and supplies remain on board the aircraft up to such time ms they are re - exported or are used on the part of the journey performed over that territory .
Translation: 第八条 [1] 双方缔约方指定空运企业运营协议航班的航空器及其常规机载设备、备用零件、燃油和润滑油、航空器储物（包括食品、饮料及烟草制品），在进出另一缔约方领土时，若上述设备和物资保留在航空器上直至重新出口或在该领土航段使用完毕，应免征关税、检验费和其他类似费用。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] fuel and lubricants destined to supply outbound aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party , even when these supplies are to be used on the part of the journey performed over the territory of the Contracting party in which they are taken on board .
Translation: 用于供应另一缔约方指定的空运企业经营协议规定航线服务所使用的出境航空器所需燃料和润滑油，即使这些供应品在被装载的缔约方领土领空飞行的航段中使用。
