Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] In operating the agreed services the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services provided by the latter on the whole or part of the same route .
Translation: 在运营双方协议约定的服务时，缔约各方指定的航空公司应顾及对方指定航空公司的利益，以不致过度影响后者在同一航线全部或部分航段上所提供的服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The agreed services supplied by the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties shall provide at a reasonable load factor capacity adequate to meet the traffic requirements for the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail between the territories of the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约各方指定航空公司提供的协议服务应以合理载运率提供充足的运力，以满足缔约各方领土之间旅客、行李、货物和邮件运输的运输需求。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] the requirements of through airline operation .
Translation: 直航运营的要求。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Capacity , frequency , type of aircraft and flight schedule shall be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约国航空当局应就运力、班次频率、机型及航班时刻表达成协议。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Each designated airline shall have the right to engage in the sale of air transportation in the territory of the other Contracting Party directly and , at its discretion , through licensed agents .
Translation: 指定航空公司有权在其另一缔约方的领土内直接进行航空运输销售，或根据其自行决定通过持证代理机构进行。

Query_Text_en: Each designated airline shall have the right to use for this purpose its own transportation documents .
Translation: 每家指定航空公司有权为此目的使用自身的运输单证。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Each designated airline shall , in the territory of the other Contracting Party , have the right to contract with a competing agent of its choice for ground handling services , including the designated airlines of the other Contracting Party which perform ground-handling , for such services in whole or in part .
Translation: 每一指定航空公司应在另一缔约方领土内享有权利，可自行选择与竞争性代理签订合同以获取地面服务，包括由另一缔约方指定并从事地面服务的航空公司所提供之全部或部分服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The designated airline of either Contracting Party may , according to traffic requirements , apply for operation of extra section on the specified route .
Translation: 任一缔约方指定的航空公司可根据运输需求，申请在指定航线上运营加班航班。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] If the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on the tariffs , the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties shall determine the tariffs through consultations .
Translation: 缔约方指定的航空公司如未能就运价达成协议，缔约方航空当局应通过协商确定运价。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] If the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties fail to agree on the approval of any tariff submitted to them under paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article or on the determination of any tariff under paragraph [ 3 ] of this Article , the matter shall be referred to the Contracting Parties for settlement in accordance with the provisions of Article [ 18 ] of this Agreement .
Translation: 缔约各方的航空当局若未能就根据本条第二款提交的任何运价的批准，或根据本条第三款确定的任何运价达成一致，则应将相关事宜提交缔约各方根据本协议第十八条的规定予以解决。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party shall provide regular airport [ s ] , alternate airport [ s ] and air navigation facilities in its territory and relevant services including communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary facilities and services for the operation of the agreed services by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方应在其领土内为另一缔约方指定的空运企业运营约定服务，提供常规机场、备降机场及航空导航设施，并提供包括通信、导航、气象及其他辅助设施和服务在内的相关服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airports and air navigation facilities of the other Contracting Party at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the appropriate authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方指定的航空公司使用另一缔约方的机场及航空导航设施时，应按照该另一缔约方相关主管当局规定的公平合理费率支付费用。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 Provision of Statistical DataThe aeronautical authorities of either Contracting Party shall furnish to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party , at their request , statistical data as may be reasonably required for the purpose of reviewing the capacity provided by the agreed services operated by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party on the specified route . Such data shall include all information required to determine the amount of traffic carried by the said designated airline on the agreed services .
Translation:
第十条 统计数据的提供  
缔约一方航空当局应对方要求，应向缔约另一方航空当局提供为审查缔约一方指定空运企业在指定航线上运营的协议航班所提供运力而合理所需的统计数据。此类数据应包含确定该指定空运企业在协议航班上所载运输量所需的一切信息。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] For the operation of the agreed services on the specified route , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have the right , on the reciprocal basis , to set up representation at the point [ s ] on the specified route within the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 对于在指定航线上运营约定服务，缔约双方指定的航空公司应可在互惠基础上，在对方缔约方领土内的指定航线上各点设立代表机构。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The staff members of the representation of the designated airline of each Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be nationals of either Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方指定航空公司在另一缔约方领土内设立的代表处工作人员，应为任一缔约方的国民。

Query_Text_en: However , the staff members of the representation of the designated airlines at managerial level could be nationals of a third country .
Translation: 不过，指定航空公司派驻机构的管理层级工作人员可以是第三国国民。

Query_Text_en: Such staff shall be subject to the laws and regulations of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 此类人员应遵守另一缔约方的法律和法规。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Each Contracting Party shall extend assistance and facilities to the representation and its staff members of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party necessary for the efficient operation of the agreed services .
Translation: 缔约各方应向另一缔约方指定航空公司的常驻机构及其工作人员提供为高效运营双方商定的服务项目所必需的协助和便利。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The crew members of the designated airline of either Contracting Party on the agreed services shall be nationals of the said Contracting Party .
Translation: 在约定服务中，任一缔约方指定航空公司的机组成员应为该缔约方的国民。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] When an aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline of one Contracting Party arrives in the territory of the other Contracting Party , the said aircraft and its regular equipment , spare parts [ including engines ] , fuels , oil [ including hydraulic fluids , lubricants ] and aircraft stores [ including food , beverages and tobacco ] on board such aircraft shall be exempt on the basis of reciprocity from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges , provided such equipment and items remain on board the aircraft up to such time as they are re-exported .
Translation: 根据对等原则，当一缔约方指定空运企业运营协议航班的飞机抵达另一缔约方领土时，只要此类设备和物品在飞机离境前一直保留在机上，该飞机及其机载常规设备、备用零件（包括发动机）、燃料、油料（包括液压油、润滑剂）和机上供应品（包括食品、饮料及烟草制品）应免征关税、税收、检验费及其他类似费用。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] spare parts [ including engines ] introduced into the territory of the other Contracting Party for the maintenance or repair of aircraft operated on the agreed services by the designated airline .
Translation: 进口至另一缔约方境内的零部件（包括发动机），用于指定航空公司根据协议运营的服务所使用的航空器进行维修或检修。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] Printed ticket stock , air waybills and publicity materials introduced by the designated airline of one Contracting Party into the territory of the other Contracting Party , shall be exempt on the basis of reciprocity from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges .
Translation: [5] 一方法定指定航空公司将其印刷机票、航空运单及宣传材料带入另一方领土内的，应依据互惠原则免征所有关税、税收、检验费及其他类似费用和收费。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] Office supplies , vehicles for office use , vehicles for special use at airport , bus-type vehicles [ excluding cars ] for carriage of crew members and their baggage , as well as computer reservation system and communication equipment including their spare parts of the representation of the designated airline of either Contracting Party shall , when introduced into the said territory of the other Contracting Party , be exempt from customs duties and other duties on importation on the basis of reciprocity provided these supplies are intended for the airline 's own use and do not exceed reasonable limit .
Translation: 根据互惠原则，缔约任一方指定航空公司的常驻机构在进入另一缔约方领土时，其引进的办公用品、办公用车、机场专用车辆、用于运送机组人员及其行李的巴士类型车辆（不包括汽车），以及计算机预订系统和通信设备（含备件），只要专门用于该航空公司的自身运营且数量合理，应免征进口关税和其他进口税费。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] Baggage , cargo and mail in direct transit shall be exempt from all customs duties , taxes , inspection fees and other similar fees and charges on the basis of reciprocity with the exception of the charges corresponding to the services provided .
Translation: 直接过境的行李、货物和邮件应在互惠基础上免征一切关税、税款、查验费用及其他类似费用和收费，但所提供服务产生的费用除外。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have , on the reciprocal basis , the right to remit its excess of receipts over expenditures achieved in connection with the operation of the agreed services in the territory of the other Contracting Party to the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方指定的航空公司应享有在对等基础上，将其在另一缔约方领土内运营约定服务所产生的收入超过支出的结余汇回至本国领土的权利。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The conversion and remittance of such excess of receipts shall be effected in convertible currencies at the effective rate of exchange prevailing on the date of remittance .
Translation: 上述收入盈余的兑换和汇款应以可自由兑换货币进行，并按汇款当日适用的汇率执行。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Each Contracting Party shall facilitate the conversion and remittance of the excess of receipts received in its territory by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party , and assist promptly the said airline in attending to the relevant formalities .
Translation: 每一缔约方应便利另一缔约方指定航空公司在其境内获得的超额收入的兑换和汇款，并及时协助该航空公司办理相关手续。

Query_Text_en: The Contracting Parties shall in particular act in conformity with the provisions of the Convention on Offenses and Certain Other Acts Committed on Board Aircraft , signed at Tokyo on 14 September 1963 , the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Seizure of Aircraft , signed at The Hague on 16 December 1970 , and the Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Civil Aviation , signed at Montreal on 23 September 1971 , and the Protocol for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts of Violence at Airports Serving International Civil Aviation , signed at Montreal on 24 February 1988 or any other convention on aviation security to which both Contracting Parties shall become members .
Translation: 缔约各方应特别遵守1963年9月14日在东京签订的《关于航空器内犯罪和其他某些行为的公约》、1970年12月16日在海牙签订的《制止非法劫持航空器公约》、1971年9月23日在蒙特利尔签订的《制止危害民用航空安全的非法行为公约》以及1988年2月24日在蒙特利尔签订的《关于制止在国际民用机场发生暴力行为的议定书》，或缔约各方均成为缔约国的其他航空安全公约的规定。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The Contracting Parties shall , in their mutual relations , act in conformity with the Standards and Recommended Practices relating to aviation security established by the International Civil Aviation Organization and designated as Annexes to the Convention on International Civil Aviation to the extent that such Standards and Recommended Practices are applicable to the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 缔约各方在相互关系中应遵守国际民航组织制定的关于航空安全的标准和建议措施，并将其指定为《国际民用航空公约》的附件，且在这些标准和建议措施适用于缔约各方的范围内予以实施。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Pursuant to Article [ 16 ] of the Convention , it is further agreed that , any aircraft operated by , or on behalf of an airline of one Contracting Party , on service to or from the territory of another Contracting Party , may , while within the territory of the other Contracting Party be the subject of a search by the authorized representatives of the other Contracting Party , provided this does not cause unreasonable delay in the operation of the aircraft .
Translation: 根据《公约》第十六条，双方进一步达成一致：一方缔约国的航空公司的航空器，或由其代表运营的航空器，在前往或来自另一缔约国领土的航行中，可在进入另一缔约国领土时接受该缔约国授权代表的检查，但不得因此导致航空器运营的不合理延误。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the obligations mentioned in Article [ 33 ] of the Chicago Convention , the purpose of this search is to verify the validity of the relevant aircraft documentation , the licensing of its crew , and that the aircraft equipment and the condition of the aircraft conform to the Standards established at that time pursuant to the Convention .
Translation: 尽管存在《芝加哥公约》第[33]条所述的义务，此次核查的目的在于确认相关航空器文件的有效性、机组人员的执照情况，以及航空器设备和航空器状况是否符合当时根据公约制定的标准。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] When urgent action is essential to ensure the safety of an airline operation , each Contracting Party reserves the right to immediately suspend or vary the operating authorization of an airline or airlines of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 当确保航空安全需要采取紧急行动时，每一缔约方有权立即暂停或调整另一缔约方航空公司的运营授权。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party shall recognize the valid certificate of air worthiness , certificate of competency and licenses issued or validated by the other Contracting Party for the operation of the agreed services on the specified route , provided that the standards of such certificates and licenses are equivalent to or above the minimum standards established from time to time in accordance with the Convention on International Civil Aviation .
Translation: 缔约各方应承认对方缔约方为指定航班运营签发或确认的有效适航证书、适任证书及执照，前提是此类证书和执照的标准等同或高于根据《国际民用航空公约》规定不时制定的最低标准。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Each Contracting Party , however , reserves the right to refuse to recognize , for flights above its own territory , certificates of competency and licences granted or validated to its own nationals by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 然而，每一缔约方均有权拒绝承认另一缔约方对其本国国民所颁发或确认有效的合格证书和执照，在涉及该缔约方领空内飞行时。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] The Contracting Parties shall , in the spirit of close cooperation and mutual support , ensure the correct implementation of and satisfactory compliance with the provisions of this Agreement .
Translation: 缔约各方应秉持紧密合作和相互支持的精神，确保本协定各项规定的正确实施并达到满意遵守程度。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Either Contracting Party may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party concerning this Agreement .
Translation: 任一缔约方可随时就本协议事项请求与另一方缔约方进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: Such consultation shall begin as soon as possible , and at least within 60 days from the date of receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party unless otherwise agreed to .
Translation: 此类协商应尽快开始，并最迟不超过收到请求之日起60天内，除非双方另有约定。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] If either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to amend any provision of this Agreement or its Annex , it may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party , and such consultation , which may be through discussion or by correspondence , shall begin within a period of 90 days from the date of receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party , unless both Parties agree to an extension of this period .
Translation: 如缔约任何一方认为有必要修改本协定或其附件的任何条款，可随时要求与另一方进行协商。此类协商可通过讨论或书面方式进行，应在另一方收到请求之日起90天内启动，除非双方同意延长该期限。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The consultation referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article may also be held between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 本条第一款所述磋商也可在缔约方的航空当局之间举行。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Any amendment to this Agreement or its Annex shall come into force when it has been confirmed by an exchange of notes through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 本协议或其附件的任何修改，经外交渠道交换照会确认后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 TerminationEither Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party through diplomatic channels of its decision to terminate this Agreement .
Translation:
第二十条 终止  
任一缔约方均可随时通过外交途径通知另一方其决定终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 RegistryThis Agreement or any amendment thereto shall be registered with the International Civil Aviation Organization .
Translation:
第二十一条 登记  
本协议及其任何修正案应向国际民航组织登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 22 TitlesThe title of each article of this Agreement is for the purpose of reference and convenience and in no way to define , limit or describe the scope or intent of the provisions of this Agreement .
Translation:
第二十二条 条款标题  
本协议各条的标题仅为参考和方便之用，不得视为对本协议条款范围或意图的界定、限制或描述。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 Entry Into forceThis Agreement shall enter into force after both Contracting Parties have notified each other through diplomatic channels that their internal legal procedures for the entry into force of this agreement have been completed .
Translation:
第二十三条 生效  
本协议应在缔约双方通过外交途径相互通知各自完成本协议生效所需的内部法律程序后生效。

Query_Text_en: Done in Beijing , on November 6 , 2006 in duplicate in the Chinese , Arabic and English languages , all texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 于2006年11月6日在北京签署，以中、阿拉伯及英文写成，各文本一式两份，所有文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The designated airline of either Contracting Party may omit , at its own discretion , any point on the specified route on any or all flights , provided that the agreed services begin and terminate in the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline .
Translation: 缔约任一方指定的空运企业可自行决定在其指定航线上任何或所有航班中省略任何航点，前提是协定的服务须起讫于指定该空运企业的缔约方领土内。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 PERSONS COVEREDThis Agreement shall apply to persons who are residents of one or both of the Contracting States .
Translation:
第一条 适用对象  
本协定应适用于在缔约国一方或双方居住的个人。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Agreement shall apply to taxes on income imposed on behalf of a Contracting State or of its political subdivisions or local authorities , irrespective of the manner in which they are levied .
Translation: 本协定适用于缔约国或其行政分区及地方当局代表课征的所得税，无论采取何种方式征收。

Query_Text_en: [ hereinafter referred to as Botswana tax ] .
Translation: [以下简称“博茨瓦纳税收”。]

Query_Text_en: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall notify each other of any significant changes which have been made in their taxation laws .
Translation: 缔约国的主管当局应当相互通知各自税收法律中所作的任何重大变更。

Query_Text_en: and [ ii ] any legal person , partnership or association deriving its status as such from the laws in force in a Contracting State .
Translation: 以及（二）依据缔约国现行法律确立其地位的任何法人、合伙企业或协会。

Query_Text_en: 2 . As regards the application of the Agreement at any time by a Contracting State , any term not defined therein shall , unless the context otherwise requires , have the meaning which it has at that time under the law of that State for the purposes of the taxes to which the Agreement applies , any meaning under the applicable tax laws of that State prevailing over a meaning given to the term under other laws of that State .
Translation: 关于缔约国随时适用本协定的情况，任何未在其中定义的术语，除非上下文另有要求，均应具有该国当时适用于本协定所涉税收的法律所赋予的含义，且该国适用税法中对该术语的定义优先于该国其他法律中所赋予的含义。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term `` resident of a Contracting State '' means any person who , under the laws of that State , is liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile , residence , place of incorporation , place of effective management or any other criterion of a similar nature , and also includes that State and any political subdivision or local authority thereof .
Translation: 根据本协定之目的，"缔约国居民"一词指按照该国法律，因住所、居所、注册地、实际管理机构所在地或其他类似标准而在该国负有纳税义务的任何个人，并包括该国及其任何政治分支或地方当局。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Where by reason of the provisions of paragraph1 a person other than an individual is a resident of both Contracting States , then it shall be deemed to be a resident only of the State in which its place of effective management is situated .
Translation: 根据第一条的规定，如果某人（非个人）同时是缔约国双方的居民，则应仅将其视为实际管理机构所在地所在国的居民。

Query_Text_en: b ] the furnishing of services , including consultancy services , by an enterprise through employees or other personnel engaged for such purpose , but only if activities of that nature continue [ for the same or a connected project ] within a Contracting State for a period or periods aggregating more than 183 days within any twelve-month period .
Translation: 企业通过为此目的雇佣的员工或其他人员提供服务（包括咨询服务），但仅当此类活动在某一缔约国境内（针对同一或相关项目）持续进行，且在任何连续十二个月期间内累计时长超过183天时适用。

Query_Text_en: and f ] the maintenance of a fixed place of business solely for any combination of activities mentioned in sub-paragraphs a ] to e ] , provided that the overall activity of the fixed place of business resulting from this combination is of a preparatory or auxiliary character .
Translation: 以及f] 仅为开展上述a]至e]条款所述任何活动组合而维持的固定营业场所，前提是该固定营业场所由此类组合产生的整体活动具有预备性或辅助性性质。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs1 and 2 , where a person other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies -- is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State , and has , and habitually exercises , in that Contracting State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in that Contracting State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes or the enterprise , unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph4 which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 尽管第1款和第2款有相关规定，如果某人（该人并非第6款适用的具有独立身份的代理人）在某一缔约国代表另一缔约国的企业行事，并且在该缔约国拥有签订合同的权限且通常行使该权限，则该企业应被视为在该缔约国设有常设机构，以处理该人或该企业所进行的任何活动，除非该人的活动仅限于第4款所列情形，即如果通过固定营业场所进行这些活动，根据该款规定，该固定营业场所不会构成常设机构。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of paragraph1 shall apply to income derived from the direct use , letting , or use in any other form of immovable property .
Translation: 本条第一款规定适用于来源于不动产直接使用、出租或其他任何形式使用的所得。

Query_Text_en: If the enterprise carries on business as aforesaid , the profits of the enterprise may be taxed in the other State , but only so much of them as is attributable to that permanent establishment .
Translation: 如果该企业从事上述业务活动，其利润可能在另一国征税，但仅限于归属于该常设机构的那一部分利润。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Subject to the provisions of paragraph3 , where an enterprise of a Contracting State carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein , there shall in each Contracting State be attributed to that permanent establishment the profits which it might be expected to make if it were a distinct and separate enterprise engaged in the same or similar activities under the same or similar conditions and dealing wholly independently with the enterprise of which it is a permanent establishment .
Translation: 除本条第三款另有规定外，缔约国一方企业通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在该缔约国另一方进行营业的，应将归属于该常设机构的利润，在各缔约国中确定为：若该常设机构作为从事相同或类似活动且在相同或类似条件下经营的独立核算的企业，与其所属企业实体完全独立交易时可合理预期获得的利润。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Insofar as it has been customary in a Contracting State to determine the profits to be attributed to a permanent establishment on the basis of an apportionment of the total profits of the enterprise to its various parts , nothing in paragraph2 shall preclude that Contracting State from determining the profits to be taxed by such an apportionment as may be customary ;
Translation: 在缔约国惯常根据企业总利润分摊至其各部分为基础确定常设机构应归属于的利润时，本条第2款不应妨碍该缔约国继续按照惯常采用的分摊方法确定应税利润。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Profits from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic by an enterprise of a Contracting State shall be taxable only in that Contracting State .
Translation: 缔约国企业经营国际运输业务的船舶或飞机所取得的利润，应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of paragraph1 shall also apply to profits from the participation in a pool , a joint business or an international operating agency .
Translation: 本条第一款的规定同样适用于参与资金池、合资企业或国际运营机构所获得的利润。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where a Contracting State includes in the profits of an enterprise of that State and taxes accordingly profits on which an enterprise of the other Contracting State has been charged to tax in that other State and the profits so included are profits which would have accrued to the enterprise of the first-mentioned State if the conditions made between the two enterprises had been those which would have been made between independent enterprises , then that other State shall make an appropriate adjustment to the amount of the tax charged therein on those profits .
Translation: 当一缔约国将某一企业在其境内的利润计入该国企业所得并据此征税时，若该利润已由另一缔约国对企业征税，且所计入利润系指若双方企业间达成的条件与独立企业间条件相同时本应归属于首提缔约国企业所得的利润，则该另一国应对该等利润在其国境内已征税款作出相应调整。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State maybe taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民公司支付给缔约国另一方居民的股息，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` dividends '' as used in this Article means income from shares , mining shares or other rights , not being debt-claims , participating in profits , as well as income from other corporate rights which is subjected to the same taxation treatment as income from shares by the laws of the State of which the company making the distribution is a resident .
Translation: 本条所使用的"股息"一词指从股份、矿产股份或其他权利中获得的参与利润分配的收入，此类收入非债务主张，同时也包括根据分配利润的公司所在国法律，与股份收入适用相同税收待遇的其他公司权利收入。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the dividends , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with such permanentestablishment or fixed base .
Translation: 本条第一款和第二款的规定不适用于以下情况：如果股息的受益所有人是缔约国一方的居民，并且在支付股息公司的所在缔约国另一方，通过设在该国的常设机构开展业务，或者通过设在该国的固定基地在该缔约国另一方从事独立个人劳务，并且支付股息所对应的股权与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The provision of this Article shall not apply if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes of any person concerned with the creation or assignment of the shares or other rights in respect of which the dividend is paid to take advantage of this Article by means of that creation or assignment .
Translation: 本条之规定不适用于下列情形：若相关股份或其他权利的创设或转让行为的参与方，其主要目的或主要目的之一系通过该等创设或转让行为利用本条规定以获取股息，则本条规定不适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 INTEREST 1 . Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation:
第十一章 利息  
一、缔约国一方发生的利息，支付给缔约国另一方居民的，可以在该缔约国另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed 7 .
Translation: 然而，此类利息也可由其来源地所在缔约国按照该国法律征税；但如果该利息的受益所有人为另一缔约国的居民，则所征税收不得超过7%。

Query_Text_en: 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall by mutual agreement settlethe mode of application of this limitation .
Translation: 利息总额的5%。缔约国的主管当局应通过协商一致确定该限制的适用方式。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph2 , interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to , or on loans guaranteed or insured by , the Government , a political subdivision or a local authority , the Central Bank or any financial institution wholly owned by the Government of the other Contracting State shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 尽管本条第二款有相关规定，在缔约国境内产生的利息，若支付给另一缔约国政府、其政治分支机构或地方政府当局、中央银行或该缔约国政府全资拥有的任何金融机构，或支付给由上述机构担保或承保的贷款，均应在本条所提及的缔约国免纳税收。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of paragraphs1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the interest , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the interest arises , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 本条第一款和第二款的规定不适用的情形为：利息的受益所有人属于缔约国一方居民，并且在利息产生的缔约国另一方设有常设机构并经由该机构开展营业活动，或在该另一国通过固定基地从事独立个人劳务，且支付利息的债权与该常设机构或固定基地存在实质性联系。

Query_Text_en: 8 . The provision of this Article shall not apply if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes of any person concerned with the creation or assignment of the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid to take advantage of this Article by means of that creation or assignment .
Translation: 本条之规定不适用于以下情形：若利息所涉债务主张的设立或转让的相关方，其设立或转让该债务主张的主要目的之一即为通过该设立或转让行为利用本条规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 在缔约国境内发生的特许权使用费，如由另一缔约国的居民实际拥有，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` royalties '' as used in this Article means payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of , or the right to use , any copyright of literary , artistic or scientific work including cinematography films , or films or tapes or discs for radio or television broadcasting , any patent , trademark , design or model , plan , secret formula or process , or for information concerning industrial , commercial or scientific experience , or for technical and consultancy services .
Translation: 本条所称“权利金”指因使用或有权使用下列各项而获得的各种款项：文学、艺术或科学作品的著作权（包括电影影片、无线电或电视广播用的胶片、磁带、光盘），任何专利、商标、设计、模型、图纸、秘密配方或工艺流程，或有关工业、商业或科学经验的信息，以及技术服务和咨询服务。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Where , by reason of a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person , the amount of the royalties , having regard to the use , right or information for which they are paid , exceeds the amount which would have been agreed up on by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship , the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last-mentioned amount .
Translation: 根据本条的规定，若由于支付方与受益所有人之间或双方与他人之间的特殊关系，导致特许权使用费金额（考虑其支付所涉及的使用、权利或信息）超出在不存在该等关系情况下支付方与受益所有人可能达成一致的金额，则本条仅适用于上述金额部分。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The provision of this Article shall not apply if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes of any person concerned with the creation or assignment of the rights in respect of which the royalties are paid to take advantage of this Article by means of that creation or assignment .
Translation: 本条之规定不适用于以下情形：若涉及支付使用费之权利设立或转让的相关人员，在设立或转让该权利时的主要目的或主要目的之一，系通过该权利的设立或转让而利用本条规定之优惠。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Gains from the alienation of movable property forming part of the business property of a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State or of movable property pertaining to a fixed base available to a resident of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing independent personal services , including such gains from the alienation of such a permanent establishment [ alone or with the whole enterprise ] or of such a fixed base , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业设在缔约国另一方的常设机构所拥有的动产，或缔约国一方居民在缔约国另一方设有从事独立个人劳务的固定基地所使用的动产，在发生转让时所取得的收益，包括转让该常设机构（单独或连同整个企业）或该固定基地所取得的收益，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Gains from the alienation of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic by an enterprise of a Contracting State , or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft , shall be taxable only in that Contracting State .
Translation: 缔约国企业从事国际运输业务的船舶或飞机的转让所取得的收益，以及与上述船舶或飞机运营相关的动产收益，应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Gains from the alienation of any property , other than that referred to in paragraphs1 to 4 , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident .
Translation: 除第1款至第4款所指财产外，任何财产转让所得应仅在转让方为其居民的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: or b ] if his stay in the other Contracting State is for a period or periods amounting to or exceeding in the aggregate 183 days in any twelvemonth period commencing or ending in the fiscal year concerned ;
Translation: 或（b）其在另一缔约国停留的期间或期间合计在相关财政年度开始或结束的任何十二个月期间内达到或超过183天；

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of Articles 16 , 18 , and 19 , salaries , wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of an employment shall be taxable only in that State unless the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State .
Translation: 1. 在本条第16、18和19条规定的条件下，缔约国一方居民因受雇所得的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，应仅在该国征税，除非该受雇活动是在另一缔约国进行。

Query_Text_en: c ] the remuneration is not borne by a permanent establishment or a fixed base which the employer as in the other State .
Translation: 该报酬不由雇主在另一国的常设机构或固定基地承担。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article , remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic by an enterprise of a Contracting State , may be taxed in that Contracting State .
Translation: 本条前述规定另有规定的除外，缔约国一方企业经营的国际运输船舶或飞机上的受雇人员取得的薪俸，可以在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 DIRECTORS ' FEESDirectors ' fees and other similar payments derived by a resident of a Contracting State in his capacity as a member of the board of directors of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation:
第十六条 董事费  
缔约国一方居民因担任缔约国另一方居民公司董事会成员而取得的董事费及其他类似报酬，可以在该另一方征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 7 , 14 and 15 , income derived by a resident of a Contracting State as an entertainer , such as a theater , motion picture , radio or television artiste , or a musician , or as a sportsman , from his personal activities as such exercised in the other Contracting State , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 根据《协定》第七条、第十四条和第十五条的规定，缔约国一方居民作为演艺人员，如戏剧、电影、广播或电视艺术家，或音乐家，或作为运动员，以其个人身份在另一缔约国从事演出、比赛等活动所取得的所得，可以在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs1 and 2 , income derived from such activities as are referred to in paragraph 1 performed under a cultural agreement or arrangement between the Contracting States shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting State in which the activities are exercised if the visit to that State is wholly or substantially supported by public or government funds of either Contracting State .
Translation: 本条规定不妨碍第1款和第2款的规定。缔约国一方居民根据缔约国之间缔结的文化协定或安排进行的、属于第1款所述类型的活动所取得的所得，如果该缔约国一方的公共资金或政府资金完全或主要资助了对该国的访问，则应免予在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph1 , pensions paid and other similar payments made by the Government of a Contracting State or a local authority thereof under a public welfare scheme of the social security system of that State shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 根据第1款的规定，缔约国一方政府或其地方当局为实施该国社会保障制度而支付的养老金和其他类似款项，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . a ] Salaries , wages and other similar remuneration , other than a pension , paid by a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or subdivision or authority , shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国或其地方政府部门或地方当局向个人支付的、除养老金外的工资、薪金及其他类似报酬，若该报酬是因向该国、部门或当局提供服务而取得的，则仅应向该国缴纳所得税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . a ] Pensions and other similar remuneration paid by , or out of funds created by , a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to that State or subdivision or authority shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国或其地方政府或地方当局向个人支付的养老金和其他类似报酬（包括以其设立的资金支付的款项），若该报酬是因向该国或地方政府或地方当局提供服务而获得的，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of Articles15 , 16 , 17 , and 18 shall apply to salaries , wages , pensions , and other similar remuneration in respect of services rendered in connection with a business carried on by a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof .
Translation: 本议定书第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定应适用于薪金、工资、养老金及其他类似报酬，就缔约国或其政治分区或地方当局开展的业务有关的服务而言。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 STUDENTSPayments which a student who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State solely for the purpose of his education receives for the purpose of his maintenance or education shall not be taxed in that State , provided that such payments arise from sources outside that State .
Translation:
第二十条 学生  
缔约国居民或在访问缔约国前立即曾是另一缔约国居民的学生，因仅为了接受教育的目的而在首先提及的国家停留期间，其因维持生活或就学而获得的款项，如该款项来源于该国境外，不应在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provision of this Article shall not apply if it was the main purpose or one of the main purposes of any person concerned with the creation or assignment of the rights in respect of which the income is paid to take advantage of this Article by means of that creation or assignment .
Translation: 本条的规定不适用的情形是：如就支付所得所涉及的权利之创设或转让而言，有关人员创设或转让该权利的主要目的或主要目的之一系通过该创设或转让行为利用本条之规定。

Query_Text_en: a ] Where a resident of China derives income from Botswana , the amount of tax on that income payable in Botswana in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement may be credited against the Chinese tax imposed on that resident .
Translation: 中国居民从博茨瓦纳取得所得时，该居民在博茨瓦纳就该项所得缴纳的税额，可根据本协定的规定抵免其应缴纳的中国税收。

Query_Text_en: b ] Where the income derived from Botswana is dividend paid by a company which is a resident of Botswana to a company which is a resident of China and which owns not less than 20 per cent of the shares of the company paying the dividend , the credit shall take into account the tax paid to Botswana by the company paying the dividend in respect of its income .
Translation: 当来源于博茨瓦纳的所得为博茨瓦纳税收居民公司向中国税收居民公司支付的股息，且该中国公司持有支付股息公司的股份不低于20%时，税收抵免应考虑该支付股息公司在其所得环节向博茨瓦纳缴纳的税款。

Query_Text_en: Subject to the provisions of the laws of Botswana regarding the allowance of a credit against Botswana tax of tax payable under the laws of a country outside Botswana , China tax payable under the laws of China and in accordance with this Agreement , whether directly or by deduction , on profits or income liable to tax in China shall be allowed as a credit against any Botswana tax payable in respect of the same profits or income by reference to which the China tax is computed .
Translation: 根据博茨瓦纳法律关于允许对来自博茨瓦纳境外国家税款进行税收抵免的规定，以及中国法律和本协定的规定，凡在中国应纳税所得或收入上直接缴纳或以扣除方式缴纳的中国税收，均可作为抵免依据，用于抵扣博茨瓦纳居民就同一所得或收入应缴纳的博茨瓦纳税款。

Query_Text_en: However , the amount of such credit shall not exceed the amount of the Botswana tax payable on that income in accordance with the laws of Botswana .
Translation: 但是，此类抵免额不得超过该收入依照博茨瓦纳法律应缴纳的税款金额。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 MISCELLANEOUS RULENothing in this Agreement shall prejudice the right of each Contracting State to apply its domestic laws and measures concerning the prevention of tax avoidance , whether or not described as such , insofar as they do not give rise to taxation contrary to this Agreement .
Translation: 本协定的任何规定均不得损害缔约国根据其国内法就防止避税所采取的法律和措施（无论此类法律和措施是否被明确界定为防止避税措施）的适用权，只要这些法律和措施不会导致与本协定相抵触的税收后果。

Query_Text_en: This provision shall not be construed as obliging a Contracting State to grant to residents of the other Contracting State any personal allowances , reliefsand reductions for taxation purposes on account of civil status or family responsibilities which it grants to its own residents .
Translation: 本条款不应被视为要求缔约国必须向另一缔约国居民提供其本国居民享有的基于民事状况或家庭责任的税收目的免税额、减免及减除待遇。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of the Article shall , notwithstanding the provisions of Article 2 , apply to taxes of every kind and description .
Translation: 本条款的规定应适用于各种类型的税收，不受第二条规定的限制。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Where a person considers that the actions of one or both of the Contracting States result or will result for him in taxation not in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , he may , irrespective of the remedies provided by the domestic law of those States , present his case to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which he is a resident or , if his case comes under paragraph1 of Article 24 , to that of the Contracting State of which he is a national .
Translation: 当个人认为缔约国一方或双方的行为已导致或可能导致其税收不符合本协定规定时，其无须考虑这些国家的国内法所规定的救济途径，可向其为居民的缔约国主管当局提交其案件；若其案件属于第二十四条第一款所述情形，则可向其国籍所属的缔约国主管当局提交。

Query_Text_en: Any agreement reached shall be implemented notwithstanding anytime limits in the domestic law of the Contracting States . 3 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall endeavor to resolve by mutual agreement any difficulties or doubts arising as to the interpretation or application of the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国达成的任何协议均应予以执行，不受缔约国国内法中的时间限制影响。缔约国的主管当局应努力通过相互协商解决在解释或执行本协定时出现的任何困难或疑义。

Query_Text_en: They may also consult together for the elimination of double taxation in cases not provided for in the Agreement .
Translation: 他们还可就协定未作规定的其他情况消除双重征税事宜进行协商。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States may communicate with each other directly for the purpose of reaching an agreement in the sense of paragraphs2 and 3 .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局可根据本条第二款和第三款的规定直接进行沟通，以达成协议。

Query_Text_en: When it seems advisable for reaching an agreement , representatives of the competent authorities of the Contracting States may meet together for an oral exchange of opinions .
Translation: 如认为必要时，缔约国主管机关的代表可举行磋商，交换意见。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange such information as is foreseeably relevant for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or to the administration or enforcement of the domestic laws concerning taxes of every kind and description imposed on behalf of the Contracting States , or of their political subdivisions or local authorities , insofar as the taxation thereunder is not contrary to the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局应当交换可合理预见的相关信息，以便执行本协定条款，或用于管理及执行缔约国国内税收法律的实施。此类税收系由缔约国及其政治分支机构或地方当局所征收，且只要这种税收不与本协定相抵触。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any information received under paragraph1 by a Contracting State shall be treated as secret in the same manner as information obtained under the domestic laws of that State and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities [ including courts and administrative bodies ] concerned with the assessment or collection of , the enforcement or prosecution in respect of , the determination of appeals in relation to the taxes referred to in paragraph 1 , or the oversight of the above .
Translation: 根据第一款收到信息的缔约国应以与该国国内法所获取信息相同的方式予以保密，并仅限向涉及本条第一款所述税收评估或征收、执行或起诉、上诉裁决或上述事项监督的人员或机构披露（包括法院和行政机关）。

Query_Text_en: c ] to supply information which would disclose any trade , business , industrial , commercial or professional secret or trade process , or information , the disclosure of which would be contrary to public policy [ ordre public ] .
Translation: 不得提供任何可能泄露贸易、业务、工业、商业或专业秘密，或披露将有悖于公共政策（ordre public）的其他信息。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If information is requested by a Contracting State in accordance with this Article , the other Contracting State shall use its information gathering measures to obtain the requested information , even though that other State may not need such information for its own tax purposes .
Translation: 如果一缔约方根据本条请求信息，另一缔约方应采取其信息收集措施以获取所请求的信息，即使该缔约方可能无需该信息用于自身的税收目的。

Query_Text_en: The obligation contained in the preceding sentence is subject to the limitations of paragraph3 but in no case shall such limitations be construed to permit a Contracting State to decline to supply information solely because it has no domestic interest in such information .
Translation: 前文所述义务受第三款限制，但无论如何不得将此类限制解释为允许缔约国仅以对相关信息无国内利益为由拒绝提供信息。

Query_Text_en: 5 . In no case shall the provisions of paragraph3 be construed to permit a Contracting State to decline to supply information solely because the information is held by a bank , other financial institution , nominee or person acting in an agency or a fiduciary capacity or because it relates to ownership interests in a person .
Translation: 本条第三款的规定不得解释为允许缔约国仅因信息由银行、其他金融机构、代名人或以代理或信托身份行事的人持有，或涉及某人权益的所有权，而拒绝提供信息。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Contracting States shall endeavor to lend assistance to each other in the collection of revenue claims .
Translation: 缔约各方应相互尽力协助征收税收债权。

Query_Text_en: The competent authorities of the Contracting States may by mutual agreement settlethe mode of application of this Article .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局可通过相互协议确定本条的适用方式。

Query_Text_en: b ] to carry out measures which would be contrary to public policy [ ordre public ] .
Translation: 实施违反公共政策（ordre public）的措施。

Query_Text_en: ] Article 28 MEMBERS OF DIPLOMATIC MISSIONS AND CONSULAR POSTSNothing in this Agreement shall affect the fiscal privileges of members of diplomatic missions or consular posts under the general rules of international law or under the provisions of special agreements .
Translation: 本协定的任何规定均不影响外交机构或领事机构人员根据国际法一般原则或专门协定的规定所享有的财政特权。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Both Contracting States shall notify each other through diplomatic channels that they have completed the internal legal procedures necessary for the entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 缔约双方应通过外交渠道相互通知已完成使本协定生效所需的内部法律程序。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall enter into force on the date of receipt of the latter notification .
Translation: 本协议应自收到后一份通知之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: and [ ii ] with regard to other taxes , on taxable income derived on or after the first day of July of the year next following that of the entry into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 二、关于其他税收，适用于本协议生效后的下一年七月一日及以后产生的应纳税所得额。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Agreement shall continue in effect indefinitely but either of the Contracting States may , after the expiration of a period of five years from the date of its entry into force , give written notice of termination to the other Contracting State through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 本协定应无限期有效，但自本协定生效之日起满五年后，任何一方缔约国均可通过外交渠道书面通知另一方缔约国终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: and [ ii ] with regard to other taxes , on taxable income derived on or after the first day of July of the year next following that in which the notice of termination is given .
Translation: [ 二 ] 关于其他税收，涉及在终止通知发出年份的下一个年度七月一日起取得的应税所得。

Query_Text_en: Done at Gaborone on the 11th day of April , 2012 , in duplicate in the Chinese and English languages , both texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本文件于2012年4月11日在中国哈博罗内签署，一式两份，分别以中文和英文写成，两种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: 2 . There shall be regarded as taxes on income all taxes imposed on total income , or on elements of income , including taxes on gains from the alienation of movable or immovable property , and taxes on the total amount of wages or salaries paid by enterprises .
Translation: 视为所得税的税种包括以总收入或收入构成要素为征收对象的所有税收，其中包括转让动产或不动产所获收益征收的税收，以及对企业支付的工资或薪金总额征收的税收。

Query_Text_en: [ hereinafter referred as `` Ecuadorian tax '' ] .
Translation: [以下简称“厄瓜多尔税”]

Query_Text_en: and [ ii ] any legal person or association deriving its status as such from the laws in force in a Contracting State .
Translation: （二）根据缔约国现行法律确立其地位的任何法人或团体。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term `` resident of a Contracting State '' means any person who , under the laws of that State , is liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile , residence , place of incorporation , place of effective management , or any other criterion of a similar nature , and also includes that State and any political subdivision or local authority thereof .
Translation: 本协议中，“缔约国居民”一词指根据该国法律，因住所、居住地、注册地、实际管理机构所在地或其他类似性质标准而在该国负有纳税义务的任何个人，同时包括该国及其任何政治分支机构或地方当局。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Where by reason of the provisions of paragraph 1 a person other than an individual is a resident of both Contracting States , the Contracting States shall endeavor to settle the question by mutual agreement .
Translation: 如果根据本条第一款规定，某一非个人实体在两国均为居民，则缔约国双方应努力通过协商达成协议解决该问题。

Query_Text_en: b ] the furnishing of services , including technical , management and consultancy services , by an enterprise through employees or other personnel engaged for such purposes , but only if activities of that nature continue , for the same or connected projects , within a Contracting State for a period or periods aggregating more than183 days in the fiscal year concerned .
Translation: 企业通过其雇佣的员工或其他为其特定目的而聘用的人员，提供包括技术、管理及咨询在内的服务，但仅当此类活动在同一缔约国境内针对相同或相关项目，在所涉财政年度内累计停留期间超过183天时方适用。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , where a person - other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 6 applies - is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State , and has , and habitually exercises , in that Contracting State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in that Contracting State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise , unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 根据第1款和第2款的规定，若某人（不包括第6款规定的具有独立地位的代理人）在某一缔约国代表另一缔约国的企业开展业务，并且该人在该缔约国拥有以企业名义签订合同的权限且经常行使该权限，则该企业应被视为在该缔约国就该人所从事的活动构成常设机构。除非该人的活动仅限于第4款所述情形——若通过固定营业场所开展此类活动，根据该款规定本不会构成常设机构。

Query_Text_en: Ships and aircrafts shall not be regarded as immovable property .
Translation: 船舶和航空器不得视为不动产。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of paragraph 1 shall apply to income derived from the direct use , letting or use in any other form of immovable property .
Translation: 本条第一款规定适用于来源于不动产直接使用、出租或以其他形式使用所取得的收入。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The business profits of an enterprise of a Contracting State shall be taxable only in that State unless the enterprise carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业的营业利润，应仅在该国征税，除非该企业在另一缔约国境内设有常设机构，并通过该常设机构进行营业。

Query_Text_en: If the enterprise carries on business as aforesaid , the profits of the enterprise may be taxed in the other State , buy only so much of them as is attributable to that permanent establishment .
Translation: 如果企业按照上述方式开展业务，其利润可能在另一国缴纳所得税，但仅限于归属于该常设机构的部分。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Subject to the provisions of paragraph 3 , where an enterprise of a Contracting State carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein , there shall in each Contracting State be attributed to that permanent establishment the profits which it might be expected to make if it were a distinct and separate enterprise engaged in the same or similar activities , under the same or similar conditions and dealing wholly independently with the enterprise of which it is a permanent establishment .
Translation: 除本条第3款另有规定外，缔约国一方企业通过其在缔约国另一方的常设机构在该缔约国另一方开展业务的，该常设机构在每个缔约国境内应归属于其可能获得的利润，即如果该常设机构是一个从事相同或类似业务、在相同或类似条件下并与所属企业完全独立经营的独立企业时，所能预期获得的利润。

Query_Text_en: a ] an enterprise of a Contracting State participates directly or indirectly in the management , control or capital of an enterprise of the other Contracting State , orb ] the same persons participate directly or indirectly in the management , control or capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State , and in either case conditions are made or imposed between the two enterprises in their commercial or financial relations which differ from those which would be made between independent enterprises , then any profits which would , but for those conditions , have accrued to one of the enterprises , but , by reason of those conditions , have not so accrued , may be included in the profits of that enterprise and taxed accordingly .
Translation: 如果缔约国一方企业直接或间接参与缔约国另一方企业之管理、控制或资本，或同一人直接或间接参与缔约国一方企业及缔约国另一方企业的管理、控制或资本，且在上述两种情形下，缔约国双方企业之间达成或强加的商业或财务关系条件，与独立企业间交易条件存在差异；则任何本可归属于某企业的利润，若因上述条件未实际归属于该企业，可将该部分利润计入该企业应税所得并依法征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where a Contracting State includes in the profits of an enterprise of that State C and taxes accordingly - profits on which an enterprise of the other Contracting State has been charged to tax in that other State and the profits so included are profits which would have accrued to the enterprise of the first-mentioned State if the conditions made between the two enterprises had been those which would have been made between independent enterprises , then that other State shall make an appropriate adjustment to the amount of the tax charged therein on those profits , provided that it agrees to do so .
Translation: 当一缔约国将该国企业C的利润中包含的、已在另一缔约国对企业课税的利润计入本国企业应税所得时，若所包含的利润属于以下情形：即若两国企业间交易条件遵循独立企业间原则，则该利润本应归属于首提缔约国企业。在此情况下，另一缔约国应对该部分利润在其境内已征税额作出相应调整，但须以双方同意为前提。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State .
Translation: 然而，此类股息也可能在支付股息的公司为其居民企业的缔约国依照该国法律被征税。

Query_Text_en: However , if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends .
Translation: 如果股息的实际受益所有人是缔约国另一方的居民，所征税款不得超过股息总额的百分之五。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` dividends '' as used in this Article means income from shares or other rights , not being debt-claims , participating in profits , as well as income from other corporate rights which is subjected to the same taxation treatment as income from shares by the laws of the State of which the company making the distribution is a resident .
Translation: 在本条中所称“股息”，指来源于股份或其他非债权请求权而参与利润分配的所得，以及根据支付股息的公司所在国法律，与股份收入适用相同税收待遇的其他公司权益所得。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the dividends , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other Contracting State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 第四款 如股息的受益所有人为缔约国一方居民，并在股息支付公司的所在缔约国另一方设有常设机构，或在该另一方通过固定基地开展独立个人劳务，且支付股息的股份持有与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系，则第一款和第二款规定不适用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest .
Translation: 然而，此类利息亦可在该利息发生的缔约国按照该国法律征税，但如果利息的受益所有人是另一缔约国的居民，则所征税款不得超过利息总额的百分之十。

Query_Text_en: c ] on loans guaranteed or insured by the Government , a political subdivision or a local authority , the Central Bank or any institution wholly owned by the Government of the other Contracting State , in relation to exportation or investment financing programs .
Translation: 由另一缔约国政府、其政治分支机构或地方当局、中央银行或该缔约国政府全资拥有的机构担保或承保的贷款，涉及出口或投资融资计划相关事项。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term `` interest '' as used in this Article means income from debt-claims of every kind , whether or not secured by mortgage and whether or not carrying a right to participate in the debtor 's profits , and in particular , income from government securities and income from bonds and debentures , including premiums and prizes attaching to such securities , bonds or debentures .
Translation: 本条所称“利息”指各种形式的债权主张所产生的收入，无论该债权是否以抵押担保，亦无论是否附带参与债务人利润分配的权利。具体包括政府证券的收入、债券及票据的收入，以及此类证券、债券或票据所附的溢价和奖金。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the interest , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the indebtedness on which the interest is paid was incurred , and such interest is borne by such a permanent establishment or fixed base , then such interest shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 根据上述条件，如果支付利息的人（无论其是否为缔约国一方的居民）在缔约国境内设有常设机构或固定基地，且该债务的产生与该常设机构或固定基地有关联，同时该利息由该常设机构或固定基地承担，则此类利息应视为发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在的缔约国。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State , the tax so charged shall not exceed percent of the gross amount of the royalties .
Translation: 此类特许权使用费也可在其发生的缔约国按照该国法律征税，但如果该特许权使用费的受益所有人是另一缔约国的居民，则所征税收不得超过该特许权使用费总额的百分之比。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` royalties '' as used in this Article means amounts of any kind received as a consideration for the use of , or the right to use , any copyright of literary , artistic or scientific work including cinematography films , or films or tapes for radio or television broadcasting , any patent , trade mark , design or model , plan , secret formula or process , or for the use of , or the right to use , industrial , commercial or scientific equipment , or for information concerning industrial , commercial or scientific experience .
Translation: 本条所称“特许权使用费”，是指因使用或有权使用下列知识产权或专有技术而收到的任何形式的款项：文学、艺术或科学作品的著作权（包括电影作品、无线电或电视广播用影片或录音带），专利、商标、设计、模型、图纸、秘密配方或工艺，或因使用或有权使用工业、商业或科学设备，或因提供工业、商业或科学经验相关信息而获得的款项。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the royalties , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the royalties arise through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the right or property in respect of which the royalties a repaid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 本条第一款和第二款的规定不适用于以下情况：特许权使用费的受益所有人是某一缔约国居民，且其在该特许权使用费来源的另一缔约国境内通过常设机构从事营业活动，或通过该国境内的固定基地从事独立个人劳务活动，同时支付该特许权使用费所涉及的权利或财产与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Where , by reason of a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person , the amount of the royalties , having regard to the use , right or information for which they are paid , exceeds the amount which would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the10absence of such relationship , the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last mentioned amount .
Translation: 根据付款人与受益所有人之间或他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，若所支付的特许权使用费金额（考虑到其对应的使用、权利或信息价值）超出在不存在上述关系情况下双方可能同意的金额，则本条款仅适用于后者金额部分。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Gains from the alienation of movable property forming part of the business property of a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State or of movable property pertaining to a fixed base available to a resident of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing independent personal services , including such gains from the alienation of such a permanent establishment [ alone or with the whole enterprise ] or of such a fixed base may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业设在缔约国另一方的常设机构业务财产中所包含的动产转让所得，或缔约国一方居民在缔约国另一方用于开展独立个人劳务的固定基地所涉及的动产转让所得，包括此类常设机构（单独或连同整个企业）或此类固定基地的转让所得，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Gains from the alienation of any property , other than that referred to in paragraphs 1to 4 , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident .
Translation: 除本条第一款至第四款所指财产以外的其他财产转让所得，应仅由转让人居民身份所属的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: or b ] if his stay in the other Contracting State is for a period or periods amounting to or exceeding in the aggregate 183 days in any twelve month period commencing or ending in the fiscal year concerned ;
Translation: 若其在另一缔约国停留的期间或期间合计达到或超过183天，且该停留发生在涉及财政年度内起算或终止于的任何连续12个月期间内；

Query_Text_en: 2 . The term `` professional services '' includes especially independent scientific , literary , artistic , educational or teaching activities as well as the independent activities of physicians , lawyers , engineers , architects , dentists , accountants and auditors .
Translation: “专业服务”一词尤其包括独立进行的科学、文学、艺术、教育或教学活动，以及医师、律师、工程师、建筑师、牙医、会计师和审计师独立开展的活动。

Query_Text_en: If the employment is so exercised , such remuneration as is derived here from may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 如果该就业活动以这种方式实施，因此获得的报酬可以在另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , income derived from such activities as are referred to in paragraph 1 performed under a cultural agreement or arrangement between the Contracting States shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting State in which the activities are exercised if the visit to that State is wholly supported by public or government funds of either Contracting State .
Translation: 根据缔约国之间缔结的文化协定或安排进行的、属于本条第一款所述活动所取得的收入，如该访问活动完全由缔约国一方的公共或政府资金资助，则应免予在该缔约国征税。本规定不受本条第一款和第二款约束。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 , pensions paid and other similar payments made by the Government of a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof under a public welfare scheme of the social security system of that State shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 尽管存在第1款的规定，缔约国政府或其政治分区或地方当局依据该国社会保障制度下的公共福利计划所支付的养老金及其他类似款项，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . a ] Salaries , wages and other similar remuneration , other than a pension , paid by the Government of a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to the Government of that State or subdivision or authority , shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国政府或其地方政府或地方当局支付给个人的薪金、工资及其他类似报酬（不包括养老金），若该报酬系因该个人为该国政府或该地方机构提供服务而支付，则应仅由该国征税。

Query_Text_en: or [ ii ] did not become a resident of that State solely for the purpose of rendering the services .
Translation: 或（二）成为该州居民并非仅为提供相关服务之目的。

Query_Text_en: 2 . a ] Pensions and other similar remuneration paid by , or out of funds created by , a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to the Government of that State or subdivision or authority shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国或其地方政府、地方当局支付或由其设立的资金支付给个人的养老金及其他类似报酬（因向该国政府或该分属机构及当局提供服务而给予），应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of Articles 15 , 16 , 17 and 18 shall apply to salaries , wages , pensions , and other similar remuneration in respect of services rendered in connection with a business carried on by the Government of a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof .
Translation: 第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定应适用于缔约国政府或其地方政府或地方当局开展业务所涉及的服务所得的薪金、工资、养老金及其他类似报酬。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Items of income of a resident of a Contracting State , wherever arising , not dealt within the foregoing Articles of this Agreement shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国居民的所得项目，不论来源于何处，凡未在本协定其他条款中作规定的，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: a ] Where a resident of China derives income from Ecuador , the amount of tax on that income payable in Ecuador in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement may be credited against the Chinese tax imposed on that resident .
Translation: 根据本协定的规定，中国居民从厄瓜多尔取得的所得在该国应缴纳的税额，可抵免该居民在中国就该项所得应缴纳的税收。

Query_Text_en: b ] Where the income derived from Ecuador is dividend paid by a company which is a resident of Ecuador to a company which is a resident of China and which owns not less than 20 per cent of the shares of the company paying the dividend , the credit shall take into account the tax paid to Ecuador by the company paying the dividend in respect of its income .
Translation: 当来自厄瓜多尔的所得为厄瓜多尔居民公司向中国居民公司支付的股息，且该中国居民公司持有支付股息公司至少20%的股份时，则抵免应考虑该支付股息公司就其所得向厄瓜多尔缴纳的税款。

Query_Text_en: b ] Where a resident of Ecuador derives items of income which , in accordance with the provisions of Articles 10 , 11 and 12 , may be taxed in China , Ecuador shall allow as a deduction from the tax on the income of that resident an amount equal to the tax paid in China .
Translation: 根据本协定第十条、第十一条和第十二条的规定，如厄瓜多尔居民取得的所得项目可在中国征税，则厄瓜多尔应允许其从该居民所得应纳税额中扣除相当于在中国已缴纳税款的数额。

Query_Text_en: Such deduction shall not , however , exceed that part of the tax , as computed before the deduction is given , which is attributable to such items of income derived from China .
Translation: 此类扣除额不得超过在未作扣除前计算的税款中归属于此类来源于中国所得项目的部分。

Query_Text_en: c ] Where in accordance with any provision of this Agreement income derived by a resident of Ecuador is exempt from tax in Ecuador , Ecuador may nevertheless , in calculating the amount of tax on the remaining income of such resident , take into account the exempted income .
Translation: 根据本协定的任何规定，如厄瓜多尔居民的所得在厄瓜多尔免于征税，厄瓜多尔在计算该居民的其余收入应纳税额时，仍可将该免税所得予以考虑。

Query_Text_en: d ] The provisions of sub-paragraph a ] shall not apply to income derived by a resident of Ecuador where China applies the provisions of this Agreement to exempt such income from tax or applies the provisions of paragraph 2 of Article 10 , paragraph2 of Article 11 or paragraph 2 of Article 12 to such income .
Translation: 本款a项规定不适用于中国根据本协定规定对相关所得免予征税，或对相关所得适用本协定第十条第二款、第十一条第二款或第十二条第二款规定的厄瓜多尔居民取得的所得。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Except as otherwise provided in this Article , a resident of a Contracting State who derives income from the other Contracting State shall be entitled to all the benefits of this Agreement otherwise accorded to residents of a Contracting State only if such resident is a `` qualified person '' as defined in paragraph 2 and meets the other conditions of this Agreement for the obtaining of such benefits .
Translation: 除非本条另有规定，缔约国一方居民从另一缔约国取得的所得，只有同时符合本款第二项规定的"合格人士"条件，并满足本协定其他规定条件，方可享受本协定规定的各项税收优惠待遇。

Query_Text_en: c ] a company , if [ i ] the principal class of its shares is listed on a recognized stock exchange specified in subparagraph a ] or b ] of paragraph 6 and is regularly traded on one or more recognized stock exchanges , or [ ii ] at least 50 per cent of the aggregate vote and value of the shares in the company is owned directly or indirectly by five or fewer companies entitled to benefits under subdivision [ i ] of this subparagraph , provided that , in the case of indirect ownership , each intermediate owner is a resident of either Contracting State ;
Translation:
若一家公司满足以下条件之一：  
[i] 其主要类别股份在第六款[a]项或[b]项所列明的认可证券交易所上市，并在该交易所或其他认可的交易所定期交易；  
或  
[ii] 该公司股份的总投票权及总价值中至少50%由五家或更少的公司直接或间接持有，而这些公司符合本款第[i]项规定的受益资格，且在间接持有情况下，每一中间持有方均应为缔约国任一方的居民。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] on at least half the days of the fiscal year persons that are qualified persons by reason of subparagraph a ] , b ] or d ] or subdivision c ] [ i ] of this paragraph own , directly or indirectly , at least 50 per cent of the aggregate vote and value of the shares or other beneficial interests in the person , and [ ii ] less than 50 per cent of the person 's gross income for the taxable year is paid or accrued , directly or indirectly , to persons who are not residents of either Contracting State in the form of payments that are deductible for purposes of the taxes covered by this Agreement in the person 's State of residence [ but not including arm 's length payments in the ordinary course of business for services or tangible property and payments in respect of financial obligations to a bank , provided that where such a bank is not a resident of a Contracting State such payment is attributable to a permanent establishment of that bank located in one of the Contracting States ] .
Translation: [一] 在财政年度至少半数的日子里，根据本款子项a]、b]或d]或分项c] [i]被认定为合格人士的人员，直接或间接持有该实体股份或其他权益性利益总投票权及总价值的至少50%；且[二]该实体在纳税年度内的总收入中，以可在其居住国适用本协定涵盖税种前扣除的款项形式，直接或间接支付或应支付给非缔约国居民的金额不足50%（但正常经营活动中按正常交易价格支付的服务费或有形财产费用，以及向银行支付的金融债务款项不在此限；若该银行非缔约国居民，则此类支付需归属于该银行在缔约国任一国设立的常设机构）。

Query_Text_en: 3 . a ] A resident of a Contracting State will be entitled to benefits of the Agreement with respect to an item of income , derived from the other State , regardless of whether the resident is a qualified person , if the resident is actively carrying on business in the first-mentioned State [ other than the business of making or managing investments for the resident 's own account , unless these activities are banking , insurance or securities activities carried on by a bank , insurance company or registered securities dealer ] , the income derived from the other Contracting State is derived in connection with , or is incidental to , that business and that resident satisfies the other conditions of this Agreement for the obtaining of such benefits .
Translation: 根据本协定规定，缔约国一方居民如在该国实际开展业务（除仅为自身账户进行投资或管理投资的业务外，但银行、保险公司或经注册的证券商从事的银行业务、保险业务或证券业务除外），且从缔约国另一方取得的所得与该业务直接相关或属于该业务的附带收入，并满足协定中规定的其他条件，则无论该居民是否符合资格人士，均应有权享受本协定对该项所得规定的税收优惠。

Query_Text_en: b ] If the resident or any of its associated enterprises carries on a business activity in the other Contracting State which gives rise to an item of income , subparagraph a ] shall apply to such item only if the business activity in the first-mentioned State is substantial in relation to business carried on in the other State .
Translation: 如果缔约国一方居民或其关联企业在一个缔约国从事产生某项所得的营业活动，仅当该居民在第一缔约国进行的营业活动相对于其在另一缔约国进行的营业活动具有实质性时，子条款a ] 方适用于该项所得。

Query_Text_en: Whether a business activity is substantial for purposes of this paragraph will be determined based on all the facts and circumstances .
Translation: 就本段而言，某项商业活动是否具有实质性，将根据所有事实和情况综合判定。

Query_Text_en: c ] In determining whether a person is actively carrying on business in a Contracting State under subparagraph a ] , activities conducted by a partnership in which that person is a partner and activities conducted by persons connected to such person shall be deemed to be conducted by such person .
Translation: 在根据子款a]判定某人是否在一个缔约国积极从事营业活动时，该人作为合伙人参与的合伙企业所进行的活动，以及与该人有关联的人员所进行的活动，均应视为该人本人所进行的活动。

Query_Text_en: A person shall be connected to another if one possesses at least 50 per cent of the beneficial interest in the other [ or , in the case of a company , at least 50 per cent of the aggregate vote and value of the company 's shares ] or another person possesses , directly or indirectly , at least50 per cent of the beneficial interest [ or , in the case of a company , at least 50 percent of the aggregate vote and value of the company 's shares ] in each person .
Translation: 当一方直接或间接持有另一方至少50%的受益权益（或在公司情形下，持有该公司股份投票权和价值总和的至少50%），或另一方直接或间接持有每一方至少50%的受益权益（或在公司情形下，持有每一方股份投票权和价值总和的至少50%）时，则该两方视为存在关联关系。

Query_Text_en: In any case , a person shall be considered to be connected to another if , based on all the facts and circumstances , one has control of the other or both are under the control of the same person or persons .
Translation: 根据所有事实和情况，如果一方控制另一方，或者双方均受同一人或数人控制，则应视为两者之间存在关联。

Query_Text_en: and b ] 50 per cent or more of the voting power and value of which is owned by persons who are not qualified persons the benefits of this Agreement shall not apply to the disproportionate part of the income .
Translation: 若某实体50%或以上的投票权和价值由非合格人士持有，则本协议的优惠不适用于该实体收入的不成比例部分。

Query_Text_en: 5 . A resident of a Contracting State that is neither a qualified person pursuant to the provisions of paragraph 2 or entitled to benefits under paragraph 3 or 4 shall , nevertheless , be granted benefits of the Agreement if the competent authority of that other Contracting State determines that the establishment , acquisition or maintenance of such person and the conduct of its operations did not have as one of its principal purposes the obtaining of benefits under the Agreement .
Translation: 根据缔约国另一方主管当局的判定，若某缔约国居民虽不符合第2款规定的资格或无权享受第3款或第4款规定的优惠，但其设立、收购或维持该实体以及开展经营行为并非以获取本协定规定的优惠待遇为主要目的之一，则该居民仍可享受本协定规定的优惠待遇。

Query_Text_en: and c ] any other stock exchange which the competent authorities agree to recognize for the purposes of this Article .
Translation: 以及(c)主管机关同意认可的任何其他证券交易所。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Nationals of a Contracting State shall not be subjected in the other Contracting State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith , which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which nationals of thatother State in the same circumstances , in particular with respect to residence , are or maybe subjected .
Translation: 缔约国一方的居民在另一缔约国境内所承受的税收或相关要求，不得比该另一缔约国居民在相同情况下（特别是在居住方面）所承受的更为苛刻或不同。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Enterprises of a Contracting State , the capital of which is wholly or partly owned or controlled , directly or indirectly , by one or more residents of the other Contracting State , shall not be subjected in the first-mentioned State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which other similar enterprises of the first-mentioned State are or maybe subjected .
Translation: 缔约国一方的企业，如果其资本全部或部分由另一缔约国的居民个人或实体直接或间接拥有或控制，则在其境内不得因税收或与税收相关的任何要求而受到不同于或比该缔约国境内其他同类企业所承受或可能承受的税收及有关要求更为苛刻的待遇。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The competent authority shall endeavor , if the objection appears to be justified and if it is not itself able to arrive at a satisfactory solution , to resolve the case by mutual agreement with the competent authority of the other Contracting State , with a view to the avoidance of taxation which is not in accordance with the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国一方主管当局如认为异议确属正当且自身无法达成满意解决方案时，应努力与缔约国另一方的主管当局通过相互协商解决该案，以避免出现不符合本协定规定的征税情形。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States may communicate with each other directly for the purpose of reaching an agreement in the sense of paragraphs 2 and3 .
Translation: 缔约国的主管当局可根据本条第二款和第三款的规定直接进行联络，以达成协议。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any information received under paragraph 1 by a Contracting State shall be treated as secret in the same manner as information obtained under the domestic laws of that State and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities [ including courts and administrative bodies ] concerned with the assessment or collection of , the enforcement or prosecution in respect of , the determination of appeals in relation to the taxes referred to in paragraph 1 , or the oversight of the above . Such persons or authorities shall use the information only for such purposes .
Translation: 缔约国根据第一款收到的信息，应以与该国国内法所获取信息相同的方式视为机密，并仅限向负责本条第一款所述税种评估、征收、执行或起诉、裁决相关上诉，或监督上述事项的人员或机构（包括法院和行政机关）披露。上述人员或机构仅可为上述目的使用此类信息。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Agreement shall apply to taxes on income imposed on behalf of a Contracting State or its local authorities , irrespective of the manner in which they are levied .
Translation: 本协议适用于缔约国或其地方当局代表征收的所得税，无论采取何种征收方式。

Query_Text_en: 2 . There shall be regarded as taxes on income all taxes imposed on total income , or on elements of income , including taxes on gains from the alienation of movable or immovable property , as well as taxes on capital appreciation .
Translation: 应视为所得税的包括对总收入或收入组成部分征收的税款，其中包括对动产或不动产转让所得征收的税款，以及对资本增值征收的税款。

Query_Text_en: and [ vi ] the tax withheld at source from non residents ' income [ rajoitetustiverovelvollisen lhdevero ; kllskatten fr begrnsat skattskyldig ] ;
Translation: 以及[vi]对非居民所得源泉扣缴的税款[rajoitetustiverovelvollisen lhdevero；kllskatten fr begrnsat skattskyldig]；

Query_Text_en: [ hereinafter referred to as `` Finnish tax '' ] .
Translation: 以下简称“芬兰税收”。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Agreement shall apply also to any identical or substantially similar taxes that areimposed after the date of signature of the Agreement in addition to , or in place of , theexisting taxes .
Translation: 本协议亦适用于在本协议签署日后实施的任何相同或实质相似的税收，无论其作为现行税收的补充或替代。

Query_Text_en: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall notify each other ofany significant changes which have been made in their taxation laws .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局应当相互通知对其税收法律所作的任何重大变更。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term `` resident of a Contracting State '' means any person who , under the laws of that State , is liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile , residence , place of incorporation [ registration ] , place of effective management or any other criterion of a similar nature , and also includes that State and any statutory body or local authority thereof .
Translation: 根据本协定之规定，"缔约国一方居民"系指按照该国法律，因住所、居所、注册地[登记地]、实际管理机构所在地或任何类似的 criteria而在该国负有纳税义务的个人或实体，亦包括该国政府及其任何法定机构或地方当局。

Query_Text_en: This term , however , does not include any person who is liable to tax in that State in respect only of income from sources in that State situated therein .
Translation: 然而，本术语不包括仅就来源于该州境内的所得负有纳税义务的任何人。

Query_Text_en: and f ] a mine , an oil or gas well , a quarry or any other place of extraction of natural resources .
Translation: 指矿井、油气井、采石场或其他自然资源开采场所。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The furnishing of services , including consultancy services , by an enterprise through employees or other personnel engaged for such purpose , but only if activities of that nature continue [ for the same or a connected project ] within a Contracting State for a period or periods aggregating more than 183 days within any twelve-month period .
Translation: 企业通过雇员或其他为此目的雇佣的人员提供服务（包括咨询服务），仅当此类活动在某一缔约国境内持续进行（同一项目或相关项目）且在任何连续十二个月期间内累计超过183天的情况下。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , where a person -- other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 7 applies -- is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State , and has , and habitually exercises , in that Contracting State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in that Contracting State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise , unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 尽管本条第一款和第二款有规定，如果某人（独立地位的代理人除外）在一个缔约国代表另一缔约国的企业开展业务，并且在该缔约国通常以该企业的名义签订合同，则该企业在该缔约国就该人员为该企业所从事的任何活动应视为构成常设机构。但若该人员的活动仅限于第四款所列情形，即如果通过固定场所进行此类活动，根据该款规定不会构成常设机构的，则不在此限。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article , an insurance enterprise of a Contracting State shall , except in regard to re-insurance , be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State if it collects premiums in the territory of that other State or insures risks situated therein through a person other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 7 applies .
Translation: 本条前述规定不排除，缔约国一方的保险企业在再保险业务以外，如其通过第七款所述独立地位代理人以外的其他人，在另一缔约国领土内收取保费或承保该领土内的风险，则应视为在另一缔约国设有常设机构。

Query_Text_en: 7 . An enterprise of a Contracting State shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that other State through a broker , general commission agent or any other agent of an independent status , provided that such persons are acting in the ordinary course of their business .
Translation: 根据《中华人民共和国政府和新加坡共和国政府关于对所得避免双重征税和防止偷漏税的协定》相关条款规定，缔约国一方企业仅通过在缔约国另一方的经纪人、一般佣金代理人或其他具有独立地位的代理人开展业务活动，不能因此构成在该另一国设有常设机构，条件是此类代理人系按照其常规经营业务活动进行操作。

Query_Text_en: 8 . The fact that a company which is a resident of a Contracting State controls or is controlled by a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State , or which carries on business in that other State [ whether through a permanent establishment or otherwise ] , shall not of itself constitute either company a permanent establishment of the other .
Translation: 缔约国一方的企业如果被缔约国另一方的企业控制或施以控制，或者在另一缔约国从事营业活动（无论是通过常设机构或其他方式），这一事实本身并不构成任何一方企业在另一方国家的常设机构。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Where the ownership of shares or other corporate rights in a company entitles the owner of such shares or corporate rights to the enjoyment of immovable property held by the company , the income from the direct use , letting , or use in any other form of such right to enjoyment may be taxed in the Contracting State in which the immovable property is situated .
Translation: 如果某人持有公司的股份或其他股权，并因此享有该公司所拥有的不动产权益，则通过直接使用、出租或以其他形式行使该权益所取得的收入，可在不动产所在地的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 and 3 shall also apply to the income from immovable property of an enterprise and to income from immovable property used for the performance of independent personal services .
Translation: 第一款和第三款的规定亦应适用于企业不动产所得，以及用于从事独立个人劳务的不动产所得。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Insofar as it has been customary in a Contracting State to determine the profits to be attributed to a permanent establishment on the basis of an apportionment of the total profits of the enterprise to its various parts , nothing in paragraph 2 shall preclude that Contracting States from determining the profits to be taxed by such an apportionment as may be customary ;
