Translation: 关于将划归中国的这些区域范围，中缅两国政府分别于1957年7月26日和1959年6月4日提交了在地图上标示的提案。

Query_Text_en: The area where the proposals of the two Governments coincide will definitely be turned over to China
Translation: 两国政府提议中达成一致的领域将完全移交给中国。

Query_Text_en: Where the proposals of the two Governments differ as to the area under the jurisdiction of the Panhung tribe the joint committee will send out a team composed of an equal number of persons from each side to ascertain on the spot as to whether it is under the jurisdiction of the Panhung tribe so as to determine whether it is to be turned over to China
Translation: 对于两国政府就盘Hung部落管辖区域存在分歧的部分，联合委员会将派出由双方各派同等人数组成的小组，实地查明该地区是否属于盘Hung部落的管辖范围，以确定是否应将其移交中国。

Query_Text_en: After the extent of the areas under the jurisdiction of the Panhung and Panlao tribes to be turned over to China has been thus determined the joint committee will send out joint survey teams composed of an equal number of persons from each side to conduct on the spot survey of the specific alignment of this section of the boundary line and to set up boundary markers
Translation: 在盘匈和盘瑶部落管辖区域内移交中国的范围确定后，联合委员会将派出由双方各派同等人数人员组成的联合勘界队，实地勘测该段边界线的具体走向并设立界标。

Query_Text_en: 4 Except for the adjustment provided for in paragraph 3 of this Article the section of the boundary from the junction of the Nam Ting and the Nampa Rivers to the No 1 marker on the southern delimited section of the boundary shall be delimited as defined in the notes exchanged between the Chinese and the British Governments on June 18 1941 The joint committee shall send out joint survey teams composed of an equal number of persons from each side to carry out delimitation and demarcation along this section of the boundary line and set up boundary markers
Translation: 除本条第3款规定的调整外，从南汀河与南巴河交汇处至边界南部已划界段第1号界标之间的边界分段，应按照中英两国政府1941年6月18日交换的备忘录中所界定的内容进行划界。联合委员会应派出由双方人数相等人员组成的联合测绘小组，沿该段边界线开展划界定界工作并设立界标。

Query_Text_en: Article 3The Contracting Parties agree that the joint committee after working out solutions for the existing issues concerning the Sino Burmese boundary as enumerated in Article 2 of the present Agreement shall be responsible for drafting a Sino Burmese boundary treaty which shall cover not only all the sections of the boundary as mentioned in Article 2 of the present Agreement but also the sections of the boundary which were already delimited in the past and need no adjustment
Translation: 缔约双方同意，联合委员会在研究解决本协议第二条所列举的中缅边界现存问题后，应负责起草中缅边界条约。该条约不仅应涵盖本协议第二条所提及的所有边界段落，还应包括过去已勘定且无需调整的边界段落。

Query_Text_en: After being signed by the Governments of the two countries and coming into effect the new boundary treaty shall replace all old treaties and notes exchanged concerning the boundary between the two countries
Translation: 本边界新条约自两国政府签署并生效之日起，将取代两国间涉及边界的各项旧条约及换文。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese Government in line with its policy of being consistently opposed to foreign prerogatives and respecting the sovereignty of other countries renounces China 's right of participation in mining enterprises at Lufang of Burma as provided in the notes exchanged between the Chinese and the British Governments on June 18 1941
Translation: 中国政府一贯坚持反对外国特权、尊重他国主权的政策，根据1941年6月18日中英两国政府交换的照会条款，宣布放弃在中国缅甸卢方矿区参与采矿企业的权利。

Query_Text_en: 1 The present Agreement is subject to ratification and the instruments of ratification will be exchanged in Rangoon as soon as possible
Translation: 本协议须经批准，批准书将在仰光尽快交换。

Query_Text_en: 2 The present Agreement will come into force immediately on the exchange on the instruments of ratification and shall automatically cease to be in force when the Sino Burmese boundary treaty to be signed by the two Governments comes into force
Translation: 本协议一经双方交换批准书即行生效，并自中缅边界条约（由两国政府即将缔结）生效之日起自动终止。

Query_Text_en: Done in duplicate in Peking on the twenty eighth day of January 1960 in the Chinese and English languages both texts being equally authentic
Translation: 本文件于1960年1月28日在北京一式两份签署，中文本和英文本具有同等法律效力。

Query_Text_en: and [ iii ] the income tax [ including the local income tax ] concerning foreign enterprises ;
Translation: （三）涉及外国企业的企业所得税（含地方所得税）；

Query_Text_en: and [ iii ] the capital gains tax ;
Translation: 及[ iii ] 资本利得税；

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Agreement shall also apply to any identical or substantially similar taxes which are imposed by either Contracting State after the date of signature of this Agreement in addition to , or in place of , the taxes referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article .
Translation: 本协定亦适用于缔约国一方在本协定签署日期之后征收的、与本条第[1]款所指税收相同或实质相同的任何税种，无论此类税收是作为补充或替代原有税种。

Query_Text_en: The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall notify each other of any changes which are made in their respective taxation laws .
Translation: 缔约国的主管当局应当相互通知在其各自税收法律中所作的任何变更。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] the term `` competent authority '' means , in the case of China , the General Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance or its authorised representatives , and in the case of the United Kingdom , the Board of Inland Revenue or their authorised representatives .
Translation: “主管当局”一词，在中国的含义是指财政部税务总局及其授权代表；在英国的含义是指内陆 Revenue 委员会及其授权代表。

Query_Text_en: 2 . As regards the application of this Agreement by a Contracting State any term not otherwise defined shall , unless the context otherwise requires , have the meaning which it has under the law of that Contracting State relating to the taxes to which this Agreement applies .
Translation: 本协定由缔约国实施时，凡未在本协定中另行定义的任何术语，除上下文另有要求外，应具有该缔约国关于本协定所适用税种的法律中规定的含义。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term `` resident of a Contracting State '' means any person who , under the law of that State , is liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile , residence , place of head office , place of effective management or any other criterion of a similar nature .
Translation: 根据本协定，“缔约国一方居民”是指按照该国法律，因住所、居所、总机构所在地、实际管理机构所在地或其他类似性质标准而在该国负有纳税义务的个人或机构。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] if he is a national of both States or of neither of them , the competent authorities of the Contracting States shall settle the question by mutual agreement .
Translation: 如果某人同时具有两国国籍或都不具有两国国籍，缔约国的主管机关应当通过协商达成一致予以解决。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Where by reason of the provisions of paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article a person other than an individual is a resident of both Contracting States , then it shall be deemed to be a resident of the State in which the place of effective management of its business is situated .
Translation: 如果根据本条第[1]款的规定，某人（非个人）同时为缔约国双方的居民，则应将其视为实际管理机构所在地所在国的居民。

Query_Text_en: However , where such a person has the place of effective management of its business in one of the Contracting States and the place of head office of its business in the other Contracting State , then the competent authorities of the Contracting State shall determine by mutual agreement the State of which the company shall be deemed to be a resident for the purposes of this Agreement .
Translation: 然而，当某人的企业实际管理机构位于缔约国一方，而企业总机构设在另一缔约国时，缔约国双方主管当局应通过相互协商，确定该公司在本协定目的项下应被视为居民的国家。

Query_Text_en: and [ g ] an installation or structure used for the exploration or exploitation of natural resources .
Translation: [g] 用于勘探或开发自然资源的设施或结构。

Query_Text_en: 3 . A building site or a construction , installation or assembly project constitutes a permanent establishment only if it lasts more than six months .
Translation: 建筑工地或建筑、安装、装配项目仅在存续期超过六个月的情况下构成常设机构。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] the maintenance of a fixed place of business solely for any combination of activities mentioned in sub-paragraphs [ a ] to [ e ] of this paragraph , provided that the overall activity of the fixed place of business resulting from this combination is of a preparatory or auxiliary character .
Translation: 仅为本款第[ a ]至[ e ]项所述活动的任何组合而设立并维持的固定营业场所，但以该固定营业场所由此类组合产生的整体活动具有准备性或辅助性为条件。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article , where a person , other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph [ 6 ] of this Article applies , is acting in a Contracting State on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State and has , and habitually exercises , in the first-mentioned Contracting State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the first-mentioned Contracting State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise , unless the activities of such a person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph [ 4 ] of this Article which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make that fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 尽管本条第1款和第2款有相关规定，但若某人（不包括本条第6款适用的具有独立身份的代理人）在某一缔约国代表另一缔约国的企业进行营业活动，并在该缔约国境内通常行使以该企业名义签订合同的权限，则该企业应视为在该缔约国设有常设机构，除非该人员的活动仅限于本条第4款所述的活动，若这些活动是通过固定营业场所进行的，则根据该款规定不会构成常设机构。

Query_Text_en: 6 . An enterprise of a Contracting State shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that other State through a broker , general commission agent or any other agent of an independent status , provided that such a person is acting in the ordinary course of his business .
Translation: 根据缔约国一方企业的规定，仅因该企业在缔约国另一方通过经纪人、一般佣金代理人或其他具有独立地位的代理人开展业务，不应视为在该另一国设有常设机构。只要该人员是在其正常业务范围内进行活动。

Query_Text_en: However , when the activities of such an agent are devoted wholly or almost wholly on behalf of that enterprise , he shall not be considered an agent of an independent status within the meaning of this paragraph .
Translation: 但是，如果此类代理人的活动完全或几乎完全代表该企业进行，则根据本款规定不应被视为具有独立地位的代理人。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article shall apply to income derived from the direct use , letting , or use in any other form of immovable property .
Translation: 本条第一款规定适用于来源于不动产直接使用、出租或其他形式使用所取得的收入。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 3 ] of this Article shall also apply to the income from immovable property of an enterprise and to income from immovable property used for the performance of independent personal services .
Translation: 本条第[1]款和第[3]款的规定，同样适用于企业拥有的不动产所得，以及用于开展独立个人劳务的不动产所得。

Query_Text_en: if the enterprise carries on business as aforesaid , the profits of the enterprise may be taxed in the other State but only so much of them as is attributable to that permanent establishment .
Translation: 如果企业以所述方式开展业务，该企业利润可在另一国征税，但仅限于归属于该常设机构的部分。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Subject to the provisions of paragraph [ 3 ] of this Article , where an enterprise of a Contracting State carries on business in the other Contracting State through a permanent establishment situated therein , there shall in each Contracting State be attributed to that permanent establishment the profits which it might be expected to make if it were a distinct and separate enterprise engaged in the same or similar activities under the same or similar conditions and dealing wholly independently with the enterprise of which it is a permanent establishment .
Translation: 除本条第[3]款另有规定外，如一缔约国的企业通过设在缔约国另一方的常设机构在该国开展营业活动，则在缔约国各方，应将归属于该常设机构的利润确定为：如果该常设机构是一个独立核算和经营的、从事相同或类似业务且处于相同或类似条件下的独立企业，并与所属企业完全独立进行交易时，所能预期获得的利润。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In the determination of the profits of a permanent establishment , there shall be allowed as deductions expenses which are incurred for the purposes of the business of the permanent establishment including utive and general administrative expenses so incurred , whether in the State in which the permanent establishment is situated or elsewhere .
Translation: 在确定常设机构的利润时，应准予扣除为该常设机构业务目的而发生的各项费用，包括因此而发生的行政和管理费用，无论该费用发生于常设机构所在国境内还是境外。

Query_Text_en: However , no such deduction shall be allowed in respect of amounts , if any , paid [ otherwise than towards reimbursement of actual expenses ] by the permanent establishment to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices , by way of royalties , fees or other similar payments in return for the use of patents or other rights , or by way of commission , for specific services performed or for management , or by way of fees for technical services , or , except in the case of a banking enterprise , by way of interest on moneys lent to the permanent establishment .
Translation:
然而，常设机构向企业总机构或其他营业机构支付的任何款项，若属于以下情形，则不得享受此类扣除：  
作为特许权使用费、费用或其他类似支付，换取专利或其他权利的使用；  
作为佣金，因提供特定服务或管理；  
作为技术服务费；  
或除银行业企业外，作为借给常设机构款项的利息。

Query_Text_en: Likewise , no account shall be taken , in the determination of the profits of a permanent establishment , of amounts charged [ otherwise than towards reimbursement of actual expenses ] by the permanent establishment to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices , by way of royalties , fees or other similar payments in return for the use of patents or other rights , or by way of commission for specific services performed or for management , or by way of fees for technical services , or , except in the case of a banking enterprise , by way of interest on moneys lent to the head office of the enterprise or any of its other offices .
Translation: 同样地，在确定常设机构利润时，不得计入该常设机构向企业总机构或其他营业机构所收取的下列款项：并非用于补偿实际支出的因使用专利或其他权利而支付的特许权使用费、费用或类似款项；因提供特定服务或管理而收取的佣金；技术服务费；以及除银行业企业外，因向企业总机构或其他营业机构提供的贷款而产生的利息。

Query_Text_en: 4 . No profits shall be attributed to a permanent establishment by reason of the mere purchase by that permanent establishment of goods or merchandise for the enterprise .
Translation: 仅因该常设机构为该企业购买货物或商品，不得将利润归属于该常设机构。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Profits from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the business of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 从事国际运输业务的船舶或飞机所取得的利润，应仅在该企业实际管理机构所在地的缔约国一方有权征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If the place of effective management of the business of a shipping enterprise is aboard a ship , then it shall be deemed to be situated in the Contracting State in which the home harbor of the ship is situated , or , if there is no such home harbor , in the Contracting State of which the operator of the ship is a resident .
Translation: 如果航运企业的业务实际管理地位于一艘船舶上，则应视为位于该船舶母港所在的缔约国；若不存在该母港，则视为位于船舶运营商的居住国。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of this Article shall also apply to profits derived from participation in a pool , a joint business or an international operating agency .
Translation: 本条之规定亦适用于因参与联合经营体、合资企业或国际经营机构而获得的利润。

Query_Text_en: or [ b ] the same persons participate directly or indirectly in the management , control or capital of an enterprise of a Contracting State and an enterprise of the other Contracting State ;
Translation: 或者（b）同一人直接或间接参与缔约国一方的企业以及另一缔约国的企业的管理、控制或资本；

Query_Text_en: and in either case conditions are made or imposed between the two enterprises in their commercial or financial relations which differ from those which would be made between independent enterprises , then any profits which would , but for those conditions , have accrued to one of the enterprises , but , by reason of those conditions , have not so accrued , may be included in the profits of that enterprise and taxed accordingly .
Translation: 在任何情况下，若两家企业在其商业或财务关系中达成或施加的条件，不同于独立企业之间达成的条件，则因这些条件未归属某企业的利润，若在无此条件情况下本应归属于该企业，可计入该企业利润并相应征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Dividends derived from a company which is a resident of a Contracting State by a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民从缔约国另一方取得的股息，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the law of that State , but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends .
Translation: 然而，此类股息也可能在支付股息公司的居民国（即缔约国）根据该国法律征税；但如果该股息的受益所有人为另一缔约国的居民，则所征税收不应超过股息总额的10%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` dividends '' as used in this Article shall have the meaning which it has under the taxation law of the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividend is a resident and shall include any item which is treated under that law as a dividend or distribution .
Translation: 本条所指的"股息"一词应具有支付股息的公司为其居民的缔约国税法所赋予的含义，并包括该国税法下被视为股息或分配的任何款项。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article shall not affect the taxation of the company in respect of the profits out of which the dividends are paid .
Translation: 本条第2款的规定不得影响公司对其支付股息所涉及利润的征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the dividends , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 本条第[1]款和第[2]款的规定不适用的情形是：股息的受益所有人虽为一缔约国居民，但其通过设在股息支付公司所在另一缔约国境内的常设机构在该国境内从事营业活动，或通过设在该另一国境内的固定基地在该国境内从事独立个人劳务，且该股息所涉及的股份权益与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系。

Query_Text_en: In such case , the provisions of Article 7 or Article 15 , as the case may be , shall apply .
Translation: 在这种情况下，应适用第七条或第十五条的规定（视情况而定）。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Where a company which is a resident of a Contracting State derives profits or income from the other Contracting State that other State may not impose any tax on the dividends paid by the company , except insofar as such dividends are paid to a resident of that other State or insofar as the holding in respect of which the dividends are paid is effectively connected with a permanent establishment or a fixed base situated in that other State , nor subject the company 's undistributed profits to a tax on undistributed profits , even if the dividends paid or the undistributed profits consist wholly or partly of profits or income arising in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方的居民公司从另一缔约国取得利润或收入时，该另一缔约国不得对该公司支付的股息征收任何税收，但以下情况除外：该股息支付给该另一缔约国的居民；或该股息支付所涉及的股份与设在该另一缔约国的常设机构或固定基地存在实际关联。同时，即使这些股息或未分配利润完全或部分来源于该另一缔约国，该缔约国也不得对该公司未分配利润征收未分配利润税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Interest arising in a Contracting State which is derived by a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 由另一缔约国居民取得的来源于缔约国一方的利息，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises , and according to the law of that State ;
Translation: 但此类利息也可由其产生的缔约国依照该国法律征税；

Query_Text_en: but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest .
Translation: 但如果利息的受益所有人为缔约国另一方的居民，则所征税收不应超过利息总额的10%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article , interest arising in a Contracting State and derived by the Government of the other Contracting State , a political sub-division or local authority thereof , the Central Bank of that other Contracting State or any agency of that Government , or by any other resident of that other Contracting State with respect to debt-claims of that resident which are financed , guaranteed or insured by the Government of that other Contracting State , a political sub-division or local authority thereof , the Central Bank of that other Contracting State or any agency of that Government , shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned Contracting State .
Translation: 本条第[2]款规定不排除以下情形：缔约国一方政府、其地方政府部门或地方当局、该缔约国另一方的中央银行或其任何机构所获得的利息，或缔约国另一方居民因该居民的债权由其政府、地方政府部门或地方当局、中央银行或政府机构提供融资、担保或保险而取得的利息，可在首先提及的缔约国一方免征税收。该利息在首先提及的缔约国一方产生的且由上述缔约国另一方主体所获取。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term `` interest '' as used in this Article means income from debt-claims of every kind , whether or not secured by mortgage , and whether or not carrying a right to participate in the debtor 's profits , and in particular , income from government securities and income from bonds or debentures , including premiums and prizes attaching to such securities , bonds or debentures , but shall not include any item which is treated as a distribution under the provisions of Article 10 of this Agreement .
Translation: 本条所使用的“利息”一词指各种债权产生的所得，无论该债权是否以抵押担保，也无论是否附有分享债务人利润的权利。具体包括政府证券所得、债券或公司债券所得（含此类证券、债券上附有的溢价及奖金），但不包括根据本协定第十条规定应视为分配的款项。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the interest , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the interest arises , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 本条第一款和第二款的规定不适用于以下情况：利息的受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，并且该居民在利息发生的另一缔约国通过设于此地的常设机构开展业务，或在该另一国通过设于此地的固定基地提供独立个人劳务，同时支付利息的债权债务与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Interest shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is the Government of that State or a political sub-division thereof or a local authority or a resident of that State .
Translation: 利息应视为来源于缔约国一方，当支付方为该国政府、该国的政治分支、地方当局或该国居民时。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the interest , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the indebtedness on which the interest is paid was incurred , and such interest is borne by that permanent establishment or fixed base , then such interest shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 然而，如果支付利息者（无论其是否为缔约国一方的居民）在某一缔约国设有常设机构或固定基地，且该笔利息所涉债务系与该常设机构或固定基地相关而产生，并由该常设机构或固定基地承担，则此类利息应视为发生在该常设机构或固定基地所在的国家。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Where , by reason of a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person , the amount of the interest paid exceeds , for whatever reason , the amount which would have been agreed upon be the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship , the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last-mentioned amount .
Translation: 如果由于支付方与受益所有人之间或他们与其他人之间的特殊关系，导致实际支付的利息金额无论出于何种原因超过在不存在该关系情况下支付方与受益所有人本应达成一致的金额，则本条的规定仅适用于上述提到的金额。

Query_Text_en: In such case , the excess part of the payments shall remain taxable according to the law of each Contracting State , due regard being had to the other provisions of this Agreement .
Translation: 在这种情况下，款项的超额部分仍应根据各缔约国的法律征税，同时需考虑本协议的其他条款。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Royalties arising in a Contracting State which are derived by a resident of the other Contracting State may he taxed in that other State .
Translation: 由缔约国一方来源的特许权使用费，如由缔约国另一方居民取得，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the law of that State ;
Translation: 但是，此类特许权使用费也可以在产生该费用的缔约国，根据该国法律征税；

Query_Text_en: [ a ] in the case of royalties referred to in sub-paragraph [ a ] of paragraph [ 3 ] of this Article , 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties ;
Translation: 本条第3款第[a]项所指的版税情况下，按毛额的10%计算；

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] in the case of royalties referred to in sub-paragraph [ b ] of paragraph [ 3 ] of this Article , 10 per cent of the adjusted amount of the royalties .
Translation: 以及（b）本条第3款第（b）项所指的版税，按其调整后金额的10%计算。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of this subparagraph `` the adjusted amount '' means 70 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties .
Translation: 就本款而言，“调整后的金额”指版税总额的70%。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of , or the right to use , any industrial , commercial or scientific equipment .
Translation: 因使用或获取使用工业、商业或科学设备的权利而收到的任何形式的款项。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the royalties , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the royalties arise , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the right or property in respect of which the royalties are paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 本条第一款和第二款的规定不适用于以下情况：特许权使用费的受益所有人是缔约国一方居民，并在该特许权使用费来源的缔约国另一方通过设立于该国的常设机构开展业务，或在该另一国依托设立于当地的固定基地提供独立个人劳务，且支付特许权使用费所涉及的权利或财产与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Royalties shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is the Government of that State or a political subdivision thereof or a local authority or a resident of that State .
Translation: 特许权使用费应视为发生于缔约国一方，当付款人是该国政府、该国的政治分支机构、地方政府机构或该国居民时。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the royalties , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the obligation to pay the royalties was incurred , and such royalties are borne by that permanent establishment or fixed base , then such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 如果支付版税的人（无论其是否为缔约国居民）在缔约国境内设有常设机构或固定基地，且该版税支付义务与该常设机构或固定基地存在关联，并由该常设机构或固定基地负担，则该版税应视为产生于该常设机构或固定基地所在的国家。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Where , by reason of a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person , the amount of the royalties paid exceeds , for whatever reason , the amount which would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship , the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last-mentioned amount .
Translation: 如果由于支付方与受益所有人之间或双方与其他人之间存在特殊关系，导致实际支付的特许权使用费金额超过在无此关系情况下双方本应达成一致的金额，无论出于何种原因，本条规定的适用范围仅限于上述提及的金额。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Technical fees arising in a Contracting State which are derived by a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 在某一缔约国境内产生的技术费用，如由另一缔约国的居民取得，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such technical fees may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise , and according to the law of that State ;
Translation: 不过，此类技术费用也可在其产生地的缔约国依照该国法律征税；

Query_Text_en: but if the beneficial owner of the technical fees is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the adjusted amount of the technical fees .
Translation: 但如果该技术费用的受益所有人为另一缔约国居民，则所征税款不得超过该技术费用调整后金额的百分之十。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of this paragraph , `` the adjusted amount '' means 70 per cent of the gross amount of the technical fees .
Translation: 就本段而言，"调整后的金额"指技术费用总金额的70%。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` technical fees '' as used in this Article means payments of any kind to any person in consideration for any services of a technical , supervisory or consultancy nature , including the use of , or the right to use , information concerning industrial , commercial or scientific experience , but it does not include payments made to an employee of the person making the payments for dependent personal services mentioned in Article 16 .
Translation: 本条所使用的"技术服务费"一指因提供任何技术、监督或咨询性质的服务而向任何人支付的任何形式的款项，包括使用或有权使用工业、商业或科学经验相关的信息，但不包括向支付方员工支付的、根据第十六条所述依赖性个人服务款项。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the technical fees , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the technical fees arise , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the technical fees are effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 如果技术使用费的受益所有人是缔约国一方的居民，并通过设在该技术使用费产生缔约国另一方的常设机构在该国开展业务，或在该另一国通过设在那里的固定基地提供独立个人劳务，且该技术使用费与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系，则本条第一款和第二款的规定不适用。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Technical fees shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is the Government of that State or a political subdivision thereof or a local authority or a resident of that State .
Translation: 技术费用应被视为来源于某一缔约国，当支付方为该国政府、该国的下级政治实体、地方当局或该国居民时。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the technical fees , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the obligation to pay the technical fees was incurred , and such technical fees are borne by that permanent establishment or fixed base , then such technical fees shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 如果支付技术费用的人（无论其是否为缔约国一方居民）在某一缔约国设有常设机构或固定基地，且该机构或基地与支付义务存在关联，同时该费用由该常设机构或固定基地承担，则该费用应视为发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在的缔约国一方。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Where , by reason of a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person , the amount of the technical fees paid exceeds , for whatever reason , the amount which would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship , the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last-mentioned amount .
Translation: 根据本条的规定，若由于付款方与受益所有人之间或双方与其他人之间的特殊关系，导致支付的技术费用金额无论出于何种原因超过正常情况下无此关系时双方约定的金额，则本条仅适用于上述金额部分。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article , capital gains which arise in a Contracting State may be taxed by that State in accordance with the provisions of its domestic law .
Translation: 除本条第2款另有规定外，来源于缔约国的资本利得，该缔约国可按照其国内法的规定对其实行征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Gains from the alienation of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic and any property , other than immovable property , pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the business of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 2. 从事国际运输的船舶或飞机及其相关动产（不包括不动产）的转让收益，应仅在该企业实际管理机构所在地的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of Article 13 , income derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of professional services or other activities of independent character shall be taxable only in that State except in the following circumstances , when such income may also be taxed in the other Contracting State :
Translation: 根据第十三条的规定，缔约国一方居民因提供专业服务或其他具有独立性质的活动所取得的所得，应仅在该国征税。但本款另有规定的除外：在这种情况下，该收入也可在另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] if his stay in the other Contracting State is for a period or periods amounting to or exceeding in the aggregate 183 days in the fiscal year concerned ;
Translation: 如果其在另一缔约国停留的期间或期间合计达到或超过183天，在相关纳税年度内；

Query_Text_en: in that case so much of the income as is derived from his activities performed in that other State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 在这种情况下，来源于其在另一国从事活动的那一部分收入，该另一国可以对其征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to the provisions of Articles 17 , 19 , 20 , 21 and 22 salaries , wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in respect of an employment shall be taxable only in that State unless the employment is exercised in the other Contracting State .
Translation: 除本协定第十七条、第十九条、第二十条、第二十一条和第二十二条另有规定外，缔约国一方居民因雇佣关系取得的薪金、工资和其他类似报酬，应仅在该缔约国征税，除非该雇佣关系是在另一缔约国执行。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article , remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic may be taxed in the Contracting State in which the place of effective management of the business of the enterprise is situated .
Translation: 根据本条第[1]款和第[2]款的规定，因任职或受雇于从事国际运输的船舶或飞机而取得的报酬，可以在该企业业务的实际管理机构所在地所在缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article , salaries , wages and other remuneration earned by a national of a Contracting State in respect of services rendered to an enterprise of that Contracting State engaged in the operation of aircraft in international traffic as an officer or employee posted to the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in the first-mentioned Contracting State .
Translation: 尽管本条第[1]款和第[2]款有相关规定，缔约国一方居民因被派往另一缔约国向该国从事国际运输业务的航空器运营企业担任雇员或工作人员而取得的薪金、工资及其他报酬，应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 15 and 16 , income derived by a resident of a Contracting State as an entertainer , such as a theater , motion picture , radio or television artiste , or a musician , or as an athlete , from his personal activities as such exercised in the other Contracting State , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 根据《税收协定》第十五条和第十六条的规定，缔约国一方居民作为演艺人员，如剧院、电影、广播或电视艺术家，或音乐家，或作为运动员，在另一缔约国从事其个人演艺或体育活动所取得的所得，可以在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where income in respect of personal activities exercised by an entertainer or an athlete in his capacity as such accrues not to the entertainer or athlete himself but to another person , that income may , notwithstanding the provisions of Articles 7 , 15 and 16 , be taxed in the Contracting State in which the activities of the entertainer or athlete are exercised .
Translation: 当演艺人员或运动员以该身份从事活动所取得的收入归属于本人以外的其他人时，尽管存在第七条、第十五条和第十六条的规定，该收入仍可在该演艺人员或运动员开展活动的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article , income derived from such activities as are referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] performed under a cultural agreement or arrangement between the Contracting States shall be exempt from tax in the Contracting State in which the activities are exercised if the visit to that State is wholly or substantially supported by public or government funds of either Contracting State .
Translation: 根据本条第[1]款和第[2]款的规定，缔约国一方开展的属于第[1]款所述活动如符合以下条件则应免予征税：该等活动系根据缔约国之间缔结的文化协议或安排进行，且对缔约国一方领土的访问全部或主要由任一缔约国的公共资金或政府资金提供资助。

Query_Text_en: Subject to the provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] of Article 20 , pensions and other similar remuneration paid to a resident of a Contracting State in consideration of past employment shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 根据第二十条第二款的规定，支付给缔约国一方居民的因往任职务所得的养老金和其他类似报酬，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . [ a ] Remuneration , other than a pension , paid by the Government of a Contracting State or by a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to the Government of that State or subdivision or local authority shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国政府、其地方政府部门或地方当局向个人支付的非养老金性质的服务报酬，应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] did not become a resident of that State solely for the purpose of performing the services .
Translation: [ ii ] 并非仅仅为了提供服务而成为该州居民。

Query_Text_en: 2 . [ a ] Any pension paid by , or out of funds created by , the Government of a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to the Government of that State or subdivision or authority shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 根据缔约国政府、其地方政府部门或地方当局支付给个人的养老金，或从上述机构设立的资金中支付的养老金，如果该养老金是因该个人为该国政府、地方政府部门或地方当局提供服务而支付的，则仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of Articles 16 , 17 , 18 and 19 shall apply to remuneration and pensions in respect of services rendered in connection with a business carried on by a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof .
Translation: 第十六条、第十七条、第十八条和第十九条的规定应适用于缔约国或其政治分区及地方当局开展的业务相关服务所支付的报酬和养老金。

Query_Text_en: An individual who , immediately before visiting a Contracting State , was a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State for a period not exceeding three years for the purpose of teaching , giving lectures or conducting research at a university , college , school or other recognized educational or scientific research institution in the first-mentioned State shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned State for a period not exceeding three years from the date of his first arrival in that State in respect of remuneration from such teaching , lectures or research .
Translation: 在访问某一缔约国前立即为另一缔约国居民的个人，如因在该国的大学、学院、学校或其他经认可的教育或科研机构从事教学、讲座或研究而停留不超过三年，可在该国就此类报酬免纳所得税，且免税期限自其首次抵达该国之日起不超过三年。

Query_Text_en: and [ iii ] income from personal services performed in that Contracting State [ other than any rendered by a business apprentice to the person or partnership to whom he is apprenticed , or , in the case of a trainee , other than services rendered to the person providing the training ] in an amount not in excess of one thousand pounds sterling , or its equivalent in Chinese yuan , for any year of assessment .
Translation: 在该缔约国境内提供个人服务所取得的所得（不包括学徒向其师傅或合伙企业提供的服务，或受训人员向其培训提供者提供的服务），且在任何纳税年度内不超过一千英镑（或等值人民币）的金额。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The exemptions under paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article shall only continue for such period of time as may reasonably or customarily be required to complete the education or training undertaken but in no event shall any individual have the benefit of paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article for more than 5 years from the commencement of such education or training .
Translation: 本条第[1]款规定的免税待遇仅在合理或惯例所需完成相关教育或培训的期限内有效，但无论如何，任何个人自教育或培训开始之日起享受本条第[1]款规定的免税待遇的期限不得超过5年。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Where a resident of China derives profits , income or capital gains from the United Kingdom , the amount of the United Kingdom tax payable in respect of such profits , income or capital gains in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement shall be allowed as a credit against the Chinese tax imposed on that resident .
Translation: 中国居民因取得源自英国的利润、所得或资本利得，按照本协定规定应缴纳的英国税收税额，准予在该居民的中国税收应纳税额中抵免。

Query_Text_en: The amount of credit , however , shall not exceed the amount of the Chinese tax computed with respect to such profits , income or capital gains in accordance with the tax laws and regulations of China .
Translation: 然而，抵免金额不得超过根据中国税法及有关规定就该利润、收入或资本利得计算的应纳税额。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Where the income derived from the United Kingdom is a dividend paid by a company which is a resident of the United Kingdom to a company which is a resident of China and which owns more than 10 per cent of the shares of the company paying the dividend , the credit shall take into account the United Kingdom tax payable by the company paying the dividend in respect of its income .
Translation: 如果来自英国的所得为英国居民公司支付给中国居民公司的股息，且该中国居民公司持有支付股息公司超过10%的股份，则抵免额应包括支付股息的公司在其所得方面应缴纳的英国税款。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Chinese tax payable under the law of China and in accordance with this Agreement whether directly or by deduction , on profits , income or capital gains from sources within China [ excluding , in the case of a dividend , tax payable in respect of the profits out of which the dividend is paid ] shall be allowed as a credit against any United Kingdom tax computed by reference to the same profits , income or capital gains by reference to which the Chinese tax is computed :
Translation: 根据中国法律和本协定规定，对来源于中国境内的利润、收入或资本利得应缴纳的中国税款（无论是直接缴纳还是通过扣除方式），包括股息情形下对支付该股息的利润所缴纳的税款以外的部分，均可在中国税款与英国税款的计税依据相同时，抵免相应的英国税款。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] in the case of a dividend paid by a company which is a resident of China to a company which is a resident of the United Kingdom and which controls directly or indirectly at least 10 per cent of the voting power in the company paying the dividend , the credit shall take into account [ in addition to any Chinese tax for which credit may be allowed under the provisions of sub-paragraph [ a ] of this paragraph ] the chinese tax payable by the company in respect of the profits out of which such dividend is paid .
Translation: 在由中国居民公司向英国居民公司支付股息的情况下，如果该英国公司直接或间接持有支付股息公司的至少10%投票权，则抵免应包括除本款子款[a]规定可给予抵免的中国税款外，该股息所涉及利润应缴纳的中国税款。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] any other provision which may subsequently be made granting an exemption from or reduction of tax which is agreed by the competent authorities of the Contracting States to be of a substantially similar character , if it has not been modified thereafter or has been modified only in minor respects so as not to affect its general character .
Translation: 任何嗣后经缔约国主管当局同意具有实质上相似性质的其他免税或减税规定，只要此后未予修改或仅在次要方面作出修改且未影响其一般性质。

Query_Text_en: Provided that relief from United Kingdom tax shall not be given by virtue of this paragraph in respect of income from any source if the income arises in a period starting more than ten years after the exemption from , or reduction of , Chinese tax was first granted in respect of that source .
Translation: 根据本款规定，对于任何来源所得，如果该所得产生于中国对该来源所得首次给予免税或减税待遇之日起超过十年后开始的期间内，则不得因此给予英国税收减免。

Query_Text_en: 4 . For the purposes of paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] of this Article profits , income and capital gains owned by a resident of a Contracting State which may be taxed in the other Contracting State in accordance with this Agreement shall be deemed to arise from sources in that other Contracting State .
Translation: 根据本条第[1]款和第[2]款，缔约国一方居民拥有的利润、收入和资本收益，根据本协定可在另一缔约国一方征税的，应视为来源于该另一缔约国一方。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Where profits on which an enterprise of a Contracting State has been charged to tax in that State are also included in the profits of an enterprise of the other State and the profits so included are profits which would have accrued to that enterprise of the other State if the conditions made between the enterprises had been those which would have been made between independent enterprises dealing at arm 's length , the amount included in the profits of both enterprises shall be treated for the purposes of this Article as income from a source in the other State of the enterprise of the first-mentioned State and relief shall be given accordingly under the provisions of paragraph [ 1 ] or paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article .
Translation: 根据本条之目的，缔约国一方企业已就其利润缴纳该国税收的利润，若同时被计入另一缔约国企业的利润中，且该计入利润属于若双方企业间交易条件符合独立企业间公平成交价格原则时本应归属于后一企业所得，则双方企业计入利润的金额应视为第一缔约国企业来源于另一缔约国的所得，并应根据本条第[1]款或第[2]款规定给予抵免。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Nationals of a Contracting State shall not be subjected in the other Contracting State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which nationals of that other State in the same circumstances are or may be subjected .
Translation: 缔约国一方国民在另一缔约国境内不得受到比该另一国国民在相同情况下所承担或可能承担的税收及与此相关的各项要求更加繁重或不同的待遇。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Enterprises of a Contracting State , the capital of which is wholly or partly owned or controlled , directly or indirectly , by one or more residents of the other Contracting State , shall not be subjected in the first-mentioned State to any taxation or any requirement connected therewith which is other or more burdensome than the taxation and connected requirements to which other similar enterprises of that first-mentioned State are or may be subjected .
Translation: 缔约国一方的企业，其全部或部分资本由另一缔约国一方的居民直接或间接拥有或控制的，在该缔约国一方不得因此而承受比该国其他同类企业所受或可能承受的税收及与此相关的规定更为苛刻或不同的待遇。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Except where the provisions of Article 9 , paragraph [ 7 ] of Article 11 , paragraph [ 6 ] of Article 12 or paragraph [ 6 ] of Article 13 apply , interest , royalties , technical fees and other disbursements paid by an enterprise of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State shall , for the purpose of determining the taxable profits of such enterprise , be deductible under the same conditions as if they had been paid to a resident of the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 本协定缔约国一方企业向缔约国另一方居民支付的利息、特许权使用费、技术服务费及其他款项，在确定该企业应纳税所得额时，若不适用本协定第十一条第六款、第十二条第六款或第十三条第六款的规定，则应按照向该缔约国一方居民支付的情况同等条件予以扣除。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Nothing contained in this Article shall be construed as obliging either Contracting State to grant to individuals not resident in that State any of the personal allowances , reliefs and reductions for tax purposes which are granted to individuals so resident .
Translation: 本条的任何内容均不应被解释为要求任一缔约国必须向非居民个人提供其向本国居民提供的个人免税额、减免和减税优惠。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Where a resident of a Contracting State considers that the actions of one or both of the Contracting States result or will result for him in taxation not in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement , he may , irrespective of the remedies provided by the domestic laws of those States , present his case to the competent authority of the Contracting State of which he is a resident .
Translation: 缔约国居民如认为缔约国一方或双方的行为已经或将导致对其征税不符合本协定规定，均可向其所属缔约国的主管当局提出申诉，而无须考虑相关缔约国国内法是否规定了其他救济途径。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall endeavor to resolve by mutual agreement any difficulties or doubts arising as to the interpretation or application of this Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局应努力通过相互协商解决关于本协定解释或适用所产生的任何困难或疑义。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States may communicate with each other directly for the purpose of reaching an agreement in the sense of paragraphs [ 2 ] and [ 3 ] of this Article .
Translation: 缔约国的主管机关可根据本条第（二）款和第（三）款的规定，直接进行联系以达成协议。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange such information as is necessary for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or of the domestic laws of the Contracting States concerning taxes covered by this Agreement insofar as the taxation thereunder is not contrary to the provisions of this Agreement , in particular for the prevention of fraud or fiscal evasion .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局应当交换为实施本协定条款或缔约国国内与本协定涵盖税收相关的法律所必需的信息，只要该税收规定不与本协定条款相抵触，尤其是为了防止欺诈或逃税行为。

Query_Text_en: The exchange of information shall not be restricted by Article 1 .
Translation: 信息交换不得受第一条限制。

Query_Text_en: Any information so exchanged shall be treated as secret and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities [ including courts and administrative bodies ] involved in the assessment or collection of , the enforcement or prosecution in respect of , or the determination of appeals in relation to , the taxes covered by the Agreement .
Translation: 根据本协议交换的任何信息均应视为机密，仅限于涉及协议涵盖税种的评估或征收、执行或起诉，或上诉裁决的人员或机构知悉。

Query_Text_en: or [ c ] to supply information which would disclose any trade , business , industrial , commercial or professional secret or trade process , or information the disclosure of which would be contrary to public policy .
Translation: 不得提供可能泄露任何贸易、商业、产业、行业或专业秘密，或贸易流程的信息，或披露将有悖于公共政策的信息。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Nothing in this Agreement shall affect the fiscal privileges of members of diplomatic or permanent missions or consular posts under the general rules of international law or under the provisions of special agreements .
Translation: 本协议中的任何内容均不得影响外交使团、常驻代表团或领事机构成员根据国际法一般原则或特别协定的规定所享有的财政特权。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph [ 1 ] of Article 4 , an individual who is a member of the diplomatic or permanent mission or consular post of a Contracting State or any third State which is situated in the other Contracting State and who is subject to tax in that other State only if he derives income from sources therein , shall not be deemed to be a resident of that other State .
Translation: 根据本条第[1]款规定，缔约国一方或任何第三国派驻缔约国另一方的外交代表机构、领事机构成员或其他官方机构人员，仅在其从该国取得收入时方负有纳税义务，不应被视为该国居民。

Query_Text_en: Nothing in this Agreement shall affect the provisions of the Agreement between the Government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and the Government of the People 's Republic of China for the Reciprocal Avoidance of Double Taxation on Revenues arising from the Business of Air Transport , signed at Beijing on 10 March 1981 , to the extent that they have effect as regards taxes to which this Agreement applies .
Translation: 本协定的任何规定均不影响大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国政府与中华人民共和国政府于1981年3月10日在北京签署的《关于航空运输业务收入相互避免双重征税协定》的相关条款在本协定适用税种范围内的效力。

Query_Text_en: However , where any greater relief for such taxes is afforded by any provision of this Agreement , that provision shall apply .
Translation: 然而，如本协议任何条款为此类税收提供更大减免，则适用该条款。

Query_Text_en: Each of the Contracting States shall notify to the other the completion of the procedures required by its law for the bringing into force of this Agreement .
Translation: 每个缔约国应将其为使本协定生效而完成的本国法律程序通知另一方。

Query_Text_en: The Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date of the later of these notifications and shall thereupon have effect :
Translation: 本协议应于上述通知中较晚送达之日后第三十日生效，并自生效之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: b ] in China :
Translation: B. 在中国：

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] the income tax for enterprises with foreign investment and foreign enterprises ;
Translation: [ ii ] 外商投资企业和外国企业的所得税；

Query_Text_en: a ] the term `` Mexico '' means the United Mexican States , when used in a geographical sense , means the territory of the United Mexican States as defined in its Constitution , including any area beyond its territorial sea where the United Mexican States may exercise its sovereign rights of exploration and exploitation of the natural resources of the seabed , sub-soil and the supra-jacent waters , in accordance with international law ;
Translation: "墨西哥"一词在地理意义上指墨西哥合众国根据其宪法界定的领土范围，包括根据国际法，墨西哥合众国可在其领海以外行使勘探和开发海床、底土及上覆水域自然资源的主权权利的任何区域。

Query_Text_en: b ] the term '' `` China '' '' means the People 's Republic of China , when used in geographical sense , means all the territory of the People 's Republic of China , including its territorial sea , in which the Chinese laws relating to taxation apply , and any area beyond its territorial sea , within which the People 's Republic of China has sovereign rights of exploration for and exploitation of resources of the sea-bed and its sub-soil and superjacent water resources in accordance with international law ;
Translation: 本文件中“中国”一词指中华人民共和国；在地理意义上，指中华人民共和国的全部领土，包括其领海，在此范围内适用中国的税收相关法律；以及中华人民共和国根据国际法在其领海以外区域享有的勘探和开发海底、底土及上覆水域资源的主权权利所及范围。

Query_Text_en: in the case of Mexico , the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit , and in the case of China , the State Administration of Taxation or its authorized representative .
Translation: 在墨西哥的情况下，为财政部及公共信用部；在中国的情况下，则为国家税务总局或其授权代表。

Query_Text_en: 2 . As regards the application of the Agreement at any time by a Contracting State , any term not defined therein shall , unless the context otherwise requires , have the meaning , for the purpose of the taxes to which the Agreement applies , which it has at that time under the law of that State .
Translation: 关于任何缔约国在适用本协定时，除上下文另有要求外，就本协定适用的税收而言，其中未作定义的任何术语应具有该缔约国法律当时赋予其的含义。

Query_Text_en: Any meaning under the applicable tax laws of that State shall prevail over a meaning given to the term under other laws of that State .
Translation: 根据该国适用税收法律所规定的任何含义，均应优先于该国其他法律中对该术语的解释。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Agreement , the term `` resident of a Contracting State '' means any person who , under the laws of that State , is liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile , residence , place of management , place of incorporation or place of head office or any other criterion of a similar nature .
Translation: 根据本协定之规定，"缔约国一方居民"是指依该国法律和法规负有纳税义务的个人或实体，其判定标准包括习惯居所、实际居住地、实际管理机构所在地、注册地、总机构所在地或其他类似性质的标准。

Query_Text_en: d ] in any other case , the competent authorities of the Contracting States shall settle the question by mutual agreement .
Translation: 在其他情况下，缔约国主管当局应通过相互协商解决相关事宜。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Where by reason of the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article , a person other than an individual is a resident of both Contracting States , then the competent authorities of the Contacting States shall determine by mutual agreement the State of which the person shall be deemed to be a resident for the purposes of this Agreement .
Translation: 根据本条第一款的规定，如某一非个人实体在两国均被认定为居民，则缔约国双方主管当局应通过相互协商确定该实体在本协定项下应被视为居民的国家。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` permanent establishment '' shall also include a building site , a construction , assembly or installation project , or supervisory activities in connection therewith , but only if such building site , project or activities last more than six months .
Translation: 本条所称"常设机构"应包括建筑工地，建筑、装配或安装工程，或者与上述工程相关的监督管理活动，但仅以该建筑工地、工程或活动持续时间超过六个月为限。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 , where a person - other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 7 applies - is acting on behalf of an enterprise of the other Contracting State and has , and habitually exercises , in a Contracting State an authority to conclude contracts in the name of the enterprise , that enterprise shall be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the first-mentioned Contracting State in respect of any activities which that person undertakes for the enterprise , unless the activities of such person are limited to those mentioned in paragraph 4 which , if exercised through a fixed place of business , would not make this fixed place of business a permanent establishment under the provisions of that paragraph .
Translation: 除第1款和第2款的规定外，如果某人（不包括第7款适用的独立地位代理人）代表缔约国另一方的企业在某一缔约国境内设有营业场所，并经常以该企业名义在该国境内签订合同，则该企业应被视为在首先提及的缔约国境内设有常设机构，以从事该人所进行的任何活动为基准，除非该人的活动仅限于第4款所述情形——若通过固定营业场所开展此类活动，则根据该款规定不会构成常设机构。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Notwithstanding the foregoing provisions of this Article , an insurance enterprise of a Contracting State shall , except in regard to reinsurance , be deemed to have a permanent establishment in the other Contracting State if it collects premiums in the territory of that other State or insures risks situated therein through a person other than an agent of an independent status to whom paragraph 7 applies .
Translation: 本条上述规定另有规定的除外，缔约国一方的保险企业在另一缔约国境内收取保费或承保该国境内的风险时，若通过第七款适用的独立地位代理人以外的其他人员开展业务，则应视为在另一缔约国构成常设机构。但再保险业务不在此限。

Query_Text_en: 7 . An enterprise shall not be deemed to have a permanent establishment in a Contracting State merely because it carries on business in that State through a broker , general commission agent or any other agent of an independent status , provided that such persons are acting in the ordinary course of their business .
Translation: 企业仅因在某一缔约国通过经纪人、一般佣金代理人或者其他具有独立地位的代理人开展营业活动，不应视为在该国设有常设机构，只要这些代理人在其营业常规范围内行事。

Query_Text_en: If the enterprise carries on business as aforesaid , the profits of the enterprise may be taxed in the other State but only so much of them as are attributable to that permanent establishment .
Translation: 如果企业从事上述业务活动，该企业的利润可能在该国缴纳所得税，但仅限于归属于该常设机构的那一部分利润。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Profits of an enterprise of a Contracting State from the operation of ships or aircraft in international traffic shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业从事国际运输业务的船舶或飞机所取得的利润，应仅在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 and Article 7 , profits derived from the operation of ships or aircraft used principally to transport passengers or goods exclusively between places in a Contracting State may be taxed in that Contracting State .
Translation: 尽管本条第一款和第七条另有规定，用于主要在缔约国境内两地之间运输乘客或货物的船舶或飞机所取得的利润，仍可在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where a Contracting State includes in the profits of an enterprise of that State , and taxes accordingly , profits on which an enterprise of the other Contracting State has been charged to tax in that other State , and the profits so included are profits which would have accrued to the enterprise of the first mentioned State if the conditions made between the two enterprises had been those which would have been made between independent enterprises , then that other State may make an appropriate adjustment to the amount of the tax charged therein on those profits .
Translation: 如果某一缔约国在其企业利润中计入该企业从另一缔约国企业获得的利润并相应征税，而该利润已在另一国对后者企业征税，且所计入利润属于：若双方企业间交易条件符合独立企业间交易原则时，本应归属于前缔约国企业的利润，则另一国可对其对该部分利润征收的税额作相应调整。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State , but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends , the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 % per cent of the gross amount of the dividends .
Translation: 此类股息也可能在支付股息公司的居民国，即缔约国，根据该国法律征税；但如果收款人是股息的受益所有人，则所征税收不得超过股息总额的百分之五。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State , but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest , the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest .
Translation: 根据缔约国一方产生的利息，该国可依据其国内法律对此征税；但如收款人系该利息的受益所有人，则税额不得超过利息总额的百分之十。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 2 , interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to , guaranteed or insured by , the Government , a political subdivision or a local authority , the Central Bank or any financial institution wholly owned by the Government of the other Contracting State shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 尽管本条第二款有相关规定，在一方缔约国发生的利息，如支付给、由另一缔约国政府、该国地方政府部门或地方当局、中央银行或由该国政府全资拥有的任何金融机构担保或保险，应在首提缔约国免予征税。

Query_Text_en: and [ vi ] any institution wholly owned by the Government of China , as may be agreed from time to time between the competent authorities of the Contracting States .
Translation: 以及[vi]经缔约国主管当局随时商定的中国政府全资拥有的任何机构。

Query_Text_en: [ v ] any institution wholly owned by the Government of Mexico , as may be agreed from time to time between the competent authorities of the Contracting States .
Translation: [V] 根据缔约国主管当局之间随时达成的协议，指由墨西哥政府全资拥有的任何机构。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The provisions of paragraphs 1 , 2 and 3 shall not apply if the beneficial owner of the interest , being a resident of a Contracting State , carries on business in the other Contracting State in which the interest arises , through a permanent establishment situated therein , or performs in that other State independent personal services from a fixed base situated therein , and the debt-claim in respect of which the interest is paid is effectively connected with such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 本条第一、二、三款的规定不适用于以下情况：利息的受益所有人为缔约国一方居民，其通过设在利息发生所在缔约国另一方的常设机构在该另一方开展业务，或在该另一方通过设于其境内的固定基地提供独立个人劳务，且支付利息所涉及的债权与该常设机构或固定基地存在实际联系。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Interest shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is the Government of that State , a political subdivision , a local authority thereof or a resident of that State .
Translation: 利息应被视为在缔约国产生，当支付方为该国政府、地方政府、地方当局或该国居民时。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the interest , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base , in connection with which the indebtedness on which the interest is paid was incurred , and such interest is borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base , then such interest shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 根据《中华人民共和国和新加坡共和国关于对所得避免双重征税和防止偷漏税的协定》相关条款，若支付利息之人（无论其是否为缔约国一方居民）在缔约国任一国家境内设有常设机构或固定基地，且该利息所涉债务的发生与该常设机构或固定基地存在关联，并由该常设机构或固定基地承担，则该利息应视为来源于该常设机构或固定基地所在的国家。

Query_Text_en: 8 . Where , by reason of a special relationship between the payer and the beneficial owner or between both of them and some other person , the amount of the interest exceeds , for whatever reason , the amount which would have been agreed upon by the payer and the beneficial owner in the absence of such relationship , the provisions of this Article shall apply only to the last-mentioned amount .
Translation: 根据本条规定的适用范围，若因付款人与受益所有人之间，或他们与任何其他个人之间存在特殊关系，导致利息金额无论基于何种原因超过在不存在上述关系的情况下付款人与受益所有人本应达成一致的金额，则本条仅适用于后者所述金额。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , such royalties may also be taxed in the State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State , but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties .
Translation: 版税也可能在所得来源国根据该国法律被征税，但若收款人是该版税的受益所有人，则所征税款不得超过该版税总额的百分之十。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` royalties '' as used in this Article means payments of any kind received as a consideration for the use of , or the right to use , any copyright of literary , artistic or scientific work including cinematographic films , or films or tapes for radio or television broadcasting , any patent , trade mark , design or model , plan , secret formula or process , or for the use of or the right to use , industrial , commercial , or scientific equipment , or for information concerning industrial , commercial or scientific experience .
Translation: 本条所称“版税”指因使用或有权使用文学、艺术或科学作品的著作权（包括电影片、无线电或电视广播用影片或录音带）、任何专利、商标、设计、模型、图纸、秘密配方或工艺，或因使用或有权使用工业、商业或科学设备，或因提供工业、商业或科学经验信息而收到的任何形式的款项。

Query_Text_en: or the use of , or the right to use , in connection with television or radio broadcasting , visual images or sounds , or both , for the purpose of transmission to the public by satellite , cable , optic fiber or similar technology .
Translation: 与电视或广播播放相关联的视觉图像或声音（或两者兼有）的使用或使用权，其目的是通过卫星、电缆、光纤或其他类似技术向公众传输。

Query_Text_en: The term `` royalties '' also includes gains derived from the alienation of any such right or property which are contingent on the productivity , use or disposition thereof .
Translation: “特许权使用费”一词还包括因转让此类权利或财产而获得的收益，这些收益取决于该权利或财产的生产力、使用或处置情况。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Royalties shall be deemed to arise in a Contracting State when the payer is the Government of that Contracting State , a political subdivision , a local authority thereof or a resident of that Contracting State .
Translation: 版税应视为在缔约国产生，当付款人为该缔约国政府、其地方政府部门、地方当局或该缔约国居民时。

Query_Text_en: Where , however , the person paying the royalties , whether he is a resident of a Contracting State or not , has in a Contracting State a permanent establishment or a fixed base in connection with which the liability to pay the royalties was incurred and such royalties are borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base , then such royalties shall be deemed to arise in the State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated .
Translation: 如果支付特许权使用费的人（无论其是否为缔约国居民），在某一缔约国境内拥有与该特许权使用费支付义务相关的常设机构或固定基地，且此类特许权使用费由该常设机构或固定基地承担，则此类特许权使用费应视为来源于该常设机构或固定基地所在的国家。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Gains from the alienation of shares of the capital stock of a company the property of which consists directly or indirectly principally of immovable property situated in a Contracting State may be taxed in that Contracting State .
Translation: 如果某公司的财产主要直接或间接由位于缔约国境内的不动产构成，则转让该公司股份所获得的收益，可以在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Gains from the alienation of shares other than those mentioned in paragraph 2 representing a participation in a company which is a resident of a Contracting State may be taxed in that State .
Translation: 除本条第二款所述股份外，转让缔约国居民公司股权的其他股份所取得的所得，可以在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Gains from the alienation of movable property forming part of the business property of a permanent establishment which an enterprise of a Contracting State has in the other Contracting State or of movable property pertaining to a fixed base available to a resident of a Contracting State in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing independent personal services , including such gains from the alienation of such a permanent establishment [ alone or with the whole enterprise ] or of such fixed base , may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方企业设在缔约国另一方的常设机构的动产转让所得，或缔约国一方居民在缔约国另一方设有从事独立个人劳务活动的固定基地的动产转让所得，包括转让该常设机构（单独转让或连同整个企业一并转让）或该固定基地的所得，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Gains from the alienation of ships or aircraft operated in international traffic , or movable property pertaining to the operation of such ships or aircraft , shall be taxable only in the Contracting State in which the enterprise is a resident .
Translation: 从事国际运输的船舶或飞机及其运营相关的动产的转让或处置所得，仅在该企业为其居民的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Gains from the alienation of any property other than that referred to in Article 12 or in the preceding paragraphs of this Article shall be taxable only in the Contracting State of which the alienator is a resident .
Translation: 6. 除本协定第十二条或本条上述段落所指财产以外的其他财产转让所得，仅在转让方为其居民的缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: a ] he has a fixed base regularly available to him in the other Contracting State for the purpose of performing his activities , in that case , only so much of the income as is attributable to that fixed base may be taxed in that other State ;
Translation: 如果某人在另一缔约国拥有一个固定基地，并用于开展其活动，且该基地经常可供其使用，那么仅与该固定基地相关的那部分收入可以在该另一国征税；

Query_Text_en: or b ] his stay in the other Contracting State is for a period or periods amounting to or exceeding in the aggregate 183 days in the calendar year concerned , in that case , only so much of the income as is derived from his activities performed in that other State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 如果某人在另一缔约国停留时间在该日历年内总计达到或超过183天，则在这种情况下，仅可就其来源于该国的部分所得在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The term `` professional services '' includes especially independent scientific , literary , artistic , educational or teaching activities , as well as the independent activities of physicians , lawyers , engineers , architects , dentists and accountants .
Translation: "专业服务"一词尤其包括独立进行的科学研究、文学、艺术、教育或教学活动，以及医师、律师、工程师、建筑师、牙医和会计师等独立从事的专业活动。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the preceding provisions of this Article , remuneration derived in respect of an employment exercised aboard a ship or aircraft operated in international traffic by an enterprise of a Contracting State may be taxed in that State .
Translation: 本条规定不排除前款规定。缔约国企业经营的国际运输船舶或飞机上受雇人员的所得报酬，可以在该缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Directors ' fees and other similar payments derived by a resident of a Contracting State in his capacity as a member of the board of directors or a similar organ of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民因担任缔约国另一方居民公司的董事会或其他类似机构成员而取得的董事费及其他类似报酬，可以在该另一国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Salaries , wages and other similar remuneration derived by a resident of a Contracting State in his capacity as an official in a top-level managerial position of a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民作为在另一缔约国成立的公司内担任高级管理职位的官员，其取得的薪金、工资及其他类似报酬，可以在该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 1 . a ] Salaries , wages and other similar remuneration , other than a pension , paid by the Government of a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to the Government of that State or subdivision or authority thereof shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国一方向个人支付的薪金、工资及其他类似报酬（养老金除外），凡是由该国政府或其地方政府部门或地方当局因该个人为该国政府或其地方政府部门或地方当局提供服务而支付的，应仅由该国征税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . a ] Any pension paid by , or out of funds created by , the Government of a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof to an individual in respect of services rendered to the Government of that State or subdivision or authority thereof , shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国政府或其政治分区、地方当局所支付的，或以其设立的资金支付的任何养老金，若支付对象系就其向该国政府或该分区/当局提供服务所获，此类养老金应仅在该国征税。

Query_Text_en: b ] However , such pension shall be taxable only in the other Contracting State if the individual is a resident of , and a national of , that State .
Translation: 如果个人是该国的居民并具有该国国籍，则此类养老金仅由该另一缔约国征税。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of Articles 15 , 16 , 17 and 18 shall apply to salaries , wages and other similar remuneration and pensions in respect of services rendered in connection with a business carried on by the Government of a Contracting State or a political subdivision or a local authority thereof .
Translation: 本条约第一条第十五条、第十六条、第十七条和第十八条的规定应适用于与缔约国政府或其政治行政区划或地方当局开展的业务有关的服务所支付的薪金、工资、其他类似报酬及养老金。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Payments which a teacher or researcher who is or was immediately before visiting a Contracting State , a resident of the other Contracting State and who is present in the first-mentioned State for the primary purpose of teaching or scientific research at a university , college , school or other educational or scientific research institution accredited by the Governments , received for such teaching or research , shall be exempt from tax in the first-mentioned State for a period not exceeding three years in the aggregate from the date of his first arrival in the first-mentioned State .
Translation: 根据税收协定，教师或研究人员在访问缔约国之前系另一缔约国居民，并以在该国从事教学或科学研究为主要目的而停留期间，因该教学或科研工作取得的所得，可在其首次抵达该国之日起累计不超过三年的期限内，免缴该国税款。该教学或科研活动须在经政府认可的大学、学院、学校或其他教育科研机构开展。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Article shall not apply to income from research if such research is undertaken not in the public interest but primarily for the private benefit of a specific person or persons .
Translation: 本条款不适用于研究所得收入，如该研究并非出于公共利益，而是主要为了特定个人或个人的私利而进行。

Query_Text_en: Items of income of a resident of a Contracting State , wherever arising , not dealt with in the foregoing articles of this Agreement shall be taxable only in that State .
Translation: 缔约国一方居民的所得，如在本协定上述条款中未作规定，不论来源地如何，应仅在该缔约国一方征税。

Query_Text_en: a ] as a credit from the tax on the income of that resident , an amount equal to the income tax paid in that other State , such credit in either case , shall not , however , exceed that part of the income tax as computed before the credit is given , which is attributable to the income which may be taxed in that other State ;
Translation: 作为该居民收入税的抵免额，其金额应等同于在另一州所缴纳的所得税税款。然而，在任何情况下，该抵免额不得超过在未给予抵免前计算的应纳税额中，可归属于另一州有权征税的那部分收入所对应的税款。

Query_Text_en: b ] where the income derived from a Contracting State is a dividend paid by a company which is a resident of the first-mentioned State to a company which is a resident of the other Contracting State and which owns not less than 10 per cent of the shares of the company paying the dividend , the credit shall take into account the tax paid to the first-mentioned State by the company paying the dividend in respect of its income .
Translation: 当缔约国一方取得的所得是该国居民公司向缔约国另一方居民公司支付的股息，且该接受股息的公司持有支付股息公司至少10%的股份时，则在计算抵免时应考虑支付股息公司就其所得向第一国缴纳的税款。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The competent authority shall endeavor , if the objection appears to it to be justified and if it is not itself able to arrive at a satisfactory solution , to resolve the case by mutual agreement with the competent authority of the other Contracting State , with a view to the avoidance of taxation which is not in accordance with the Agreement , provided that the competent authority of the other Contracting State is notified of the case within four and a half years from the due date or the date of filing of the return in that other State , whichever is later .
Translation: 主管当局如认为异议确属合理且自身无法达成满意解决方案时，应努力与另一缔约国的主管当局通过相互协议解决该案件，以避免不符合本协定的征税。但须以另一缔约国主管当局在该国纳税申报截止日期或实际申报日期之后四年半内收到案件通知为前提，以较晚者为准。

Query_Text_en: In such case , any agreement reached shall be implemented within ten years from the due date or the date of filing of the return in that other State , whichever is later , or a longer period if permitted by the domestic law of that other State .
Translation: 在这种情况下，达成的协议应在自应尽之日或在另一方国家提交申报表之日中的较晚者起十年内实施；如果该另一国国内法允许更长期限，则可按更长期限执行。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The competent authorities of the Contracting States shall exchange such information as is necessary for carrying out the provisions of this Agreement or of the domestic laws of the Contracting States concerning taxes covered by the Agreement insofar as the taxation there under is not contrary to the Agreement , in particular for the prevention of evasion of such taxes .
Translation: 缔约国主管当局应当就执行本协定规定或缔约国关于本协定涵盖税种的国内法律（只要该征税行为不违反本协定）所需的信息交换情报，特别是为了防止此类税种的逃避缴纳税款。

Query_Text_en: Any information received by a Contracting State shall be treated as secret and shall be disclosed only to persons or authorities [ including courts and administrative bodies ] involved in the assessment or collection of , the enforcement or prosecution in respect of , or the determination of appeals in relation to the taxes covered by the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约国所收到的任何信息均应作为机密予以处理，仅可向负责处理税收协定所涵盖税收评定、征收、执行或追诉，以及有关税收上诉案件裁决的人员或机构（包括法院和行政机构）披露。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day after the date on which diplomatic notes indicating the completion of internal legal procedures necessary in each country for the entry into force of this Agreement have been exchanged .
Translation: 本协议应在双方完成各自国内法律审批程序后交换外交照会之日起第三十日生效。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall have effect as respects income relating to the taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January next following that in which this Agreement enters into force .
Translation: 本协议应适用于本协议生效年份次年1月1日或之后开始的应税年度所涉及的收入。

Query_Text_en: In such event this Agreement shall cease to have effect as respects income relating to the taxable years beginning on or after the first day of January in the calendar year next following that in which the notice of termination is given .
Translation: 本协议在发生上述情形时，对于终止通知发出所在日历年度次年1月1日起开始的纳税年度所涉收入，本协议将不再具有效力。

Query_Text_en: DONE in duplicate at Mexico City this twelfth day of September of two thousand and five in the Chinese , Spanish and English languages , all texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本文件于二〇〇五年九月十二日于墨西哥城签署，一式两份，分别以中文、西班牙文和英文写成，三种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: In the case of divergence in the interpretation of this Agreement , the English text shall prevail .
Translation: 如对本协议的解释出现分歧，以英文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: At the moment of signing the Agreement for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income , this day concluded between the People 's Republic of China and the United Mexican States , the undersigned have agreed that the following provisions shall form an integral part of the Agreement .
Translation: 在中华人民共和国和墨西哥合众国于本日缔结的《关于对所得避免双重征税和防止财政逃税的协定》签署之际，双方代表兹达成一致，下列规定应构成该协定的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: I With reference to the term `` fixed base `` It is understood that for tax purposes , the fixed base will be treated in accordance with the principles that apply to permanent establishment .
Translation: 关于“固定基地”这一术语，据理解，就税收目的而言，固定基地将按照适用于常设机构的原则进行处理。

Query_Text_en: II With reference to the term `` interest `` It is understood that the term `` interest '' also includes other income treated as income from money lent by the taxation law of the Contracting State in which the income arises , provided the income is from debt-claim of some kind .
Translation: 就"利息"一词的含义而言，应理解为该术语还包括收入来源国税收法律视为贷款所得的其他收入，只要该收入源自某种形式的债权主张。

Query_Text_en: In case of divergence of interpretation , the Contracting States shall resort to mutual agreement procedure .
Translation: 如出现解释分歧，缔约国应诉诸相互协议程序。

Query_Text_en: III With reference to Articles 11 and 12For the purpose of the provisions in the second sentence of paragraph 7 of Article 11 and the second sentence of paragraph 5 of Article 12 , if the loan or the royalty is incurred by the head office of the enterprise and the amount in question affects several permanent establishments or fixed bases situated in different countries , then the interest or royalty , as the case may be , shall be deemed to arise in the Contracting State in which the permanent establishment or fixed base is situated , but only so much of the interest or royalty payment as is borne by such permanent establishment or fixed base .
Translation: 根据第11条和第12条，就第11条第7款第二句和第12条第5款第二句的规定而言，如果企业总机构承担的贷款或特许权使用费涉及金额涉及位于不同国家的多个常设机构或固定基地，则相应利息或特许权使用费应视为发生于该常设机构或固定基地所在的缔约国，但仅以该常设机构或固定基地应负担的利息或特许权使用费部分为限。

Query_Text_en: IV With reference to Article 25For the purposes of paragraph 3 of Article XXII [ Consultation ] of the General Agreement on Trade in Services , the Contracting States agree that , notwithstanding that paragraph , any dispute between them as to whether a measure falls within the scope of this Agreement may be brought before the Council for Trade in Services , as provided by that paragraph , only with the consent of both Contracting States .
Translation: 根据第二十五条，关于《服务贸易总协定》第XXII条第3款（磋商）的适用，缔约各方同意，尽管有该款规定，缔约方之间关于某项措施是否属于本协定范围的争端，仅可在双方缔约方均同意的情况下，依据该款规定提交服务贸易理事会处理。

Query_Text_en: Any doubt as to the interpretation of this paragraph shall be resolved under paragraph 3 of Article 25 or , failing agreement under that procedure , pursuant to any other procedure agreed to by both Contracting States .
Translation: 对本段的解释存在任何疑义时，应依据第二十五条第三款解决；若通过该程序未能达成一致，则按照缔约双方同意的其他程序处理。

Query_Text_en: a. The term `` the Convention '' means the Convention on International Civil Aviation opened for signature at Chicago on the seventh day of December , 1944 , and includes any annex adopted under Article 90 of that Convention and any amendment of the annexes or Convention under Articles 90 and 94 thereof so far as those annexes and amendments are applicable for both Contracting Parties ;
Translation: 本公约所称“公约”指1944年12月7日在芝加哥开放签署的《国际民用航空公约》，包括根据该公约第90条通过的任何附件，以及根据该公约第90条和第94条规定对附件或公约进行的修正，但仅限于对双方缔约国均具有约束力的附件及修正案。

Query_Text_en: b. The term `` aeronautical authorities '' means , in the case of the People 's Republic of China , the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China and in the case of the United Republic of Tanzania , the Minister for the time being responsible for matters relating to Civil Aviation , or in both cases any person or body , authorized to exercise the function presently assigned to the said authorities .
Translation: 航空当局在中华人民共和国方面指中国民用航空总局，在联合共和国坦桑尼亚方面指负责民用航空事务的国务部长；两国情况中的任何经授权行使上述当局现有职能的个人或机构均包括在内。

Query_Text_en: c. The term `` designated airlines '' means an airline or airlines which one Contracting Party has designated , in accordance with Article 5 [ Designation and Operating Authorization ] of the present Agreement , for the operation of the agreed air services ;
Translation: “指定航空公司”指根据本协议第五条（指定和运营授权）的规定，由一缔约方指定的、从事协议规定的航空服务运营的航空承运人或航空承运人。

Query_Text_en: d. The term `` agreed services '' means air services on the specified routes for the carriage of passengers , cargo and mail , separately or in combination ;
Translation: “约定服务”指在指定航线上运输旅客、货物和邮件的航空服务，包括单独或同时运输。

Query_Text_en: e. The terms `` air services '' , `` international air services '' , `` airline '' and `` stop for non-traffic purposes '' shaft have the meaning respectively assigned to them in Article 96 of the Convention ;
Translation: e. 本协议中"航空服务"、"国际航空服务"、"航空器经营人"和"非业务性经停"等术语应分别具有《公约》第96条所规定的含义。

Query_Text_en: f. The term `` territory '' in relation to a State means the land areas and territorial waters adjacent and airspace thereabove under the sovereignty of that state ;
Translation: 领土在国家法语境下指一国主权管辖下的陆地疆域、所属领水及其上空的领空。

Query_Text_en: g. The term `` tariff '' means the prices to be paid for the carriage of passengers , baggage and cargo and the conditions under which these prices apply , including commission charges and other additional remuneration for agency or sale of transportation documents but excluding remuneration and conditions for the carriage of mail .
Translation: g. "运价规则"一词指运输乘客、行李和货物应支付的费用及相关适用条件，包括代理或销售运输文件产生的佣金及其他额外报酬，但不包括邮件运输的报酬和条件。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Annex forms an integral part of the present Agreement .
Translation: 附件构成本协议不可分割的一部分。

Query_Text_en: All references to the Agreement shall include the Annex unless explicitly agreed otherwise .
Translation: 除非另有明确约定，否则对本协议的任何提及均应包括附件。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 2 GRANT OF RIGHTS1 . Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the rights specified in the present Agreement for the purpose of operating international air services on the routes specified in the schedules of the Annex .
Translation:
第二条 权利授予  
1. 每一缔约方应授予另一缔约方本协定规定的权利，以便其在本协定附件所列航线表中规定的航线上经营国际航空运输服务。

Query_Text_en: Such services and routes are hereafter called `` agreed services '' and `` specified routes '' respectively .
Translation: 此后，此类服务和航线分别称为"约定服务"和"指定航线"。

Query_Text_en: c. the rights otherwise specified in this Agreement ,3 . Nothing in this Article shall be deemed to confer on the designated airlines of one Contracting Party the privilege of embarking , in the territory of the other Contracting Party , passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried for remuneration or hire and destined for another point in the territory of that Contracting Party .
