Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Airline tickets , airway bills as well as airline publicity materials and give away items of the designated airline of either Contracting Party introduced into the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from all customs duties , inspection fees and other duties or taxes .
Translation: 任一缔约方指定航空公司的机票、航空运单以及宣传材料和赠品，当输入另一缔约方境内时，应免征一切关税、检验费及其他税费。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 7 FINANCIAL PROVISIONSEither Contracting Party undertakes to grant the designated airline of the other Contracting Party free transfer , at the official rate of exchange , of the excess of receipt over expenditure achieved on its territory in connection with the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail by the said designated airline .
Translation:
第七条 财务条款  
每一方缔约国均承诺准予对方缔约国指定空运企业在其领土内运输旅客、行李、货物和邮件时，所获得的收入超过支出的差额部分，可按官方汇率自由转移。

Query_Text_en: Whenever the payment system between the Contracting Parties is governed by a special agreement , that agreement shall apply .
Translation: 缔约双方之间的支付体系如由专门协议规范，则应适用该协议。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 8 EXEMPTION FROM INCOME AND OTHER TAXES [ 1 ] The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall be exempt from income tax or other similar taxes in the territory of the other Contracting Party in respect of the gains or profits accruing to it from the operation of the agreed services .
Translation:
第八条 税收豁免  
[1] 每一缔约方指定的空运企业在另一缔约方领土内运营协定规定的服务所取得的收益或利润，应免征收入税及其他类似税款。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The employees of the designated airline who are nationals of either Contracting Party , shall be exempt from income tax or other similar taxes in the territory of the other Contracting Party , in respect of their emoluments , allowances or other gains , accruing to them from their employment in the said territory by the said designated airline for the purposes of the operation of the agreed services .
Translation: 缔约双方指定航空公司的本国籍员工，对其因在对方领土内为运营协议约定的服务而受雇于该指定航空公司所获得的薪俸、津贴或其他所得，应免予在对方领土缴纳所得税或其他类似税收。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 9 ENTRY AND CLEARANCE REGULATIONS [ 1 ] The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the admission into , stay in , departure from and flight over its territory of aircraft engaged in the operation of international air services , as well as laws and regulations relating to the admission to , stay in and departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail shall be applicable to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , its crew as well as the passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried by such aircraft , while in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第九条 航空器进出境管理  
缔约双方关于从事国际航空服务的航空器在其领土内入境、停留、离境及飞越的相关法律和法规，以及关于旅客、机组人员、行李、货物和邮件入境、停留及离境的法律和法规，均适用于另一缔约方指定的空运企业及其机组人员、所载旅客、行李、货物和邮件在其领土内的活动。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 10 CAPACITY PROVISIONS [ 1 ] There shall be fair and equal opportunity for the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties in operating the agreed services on the specified routes .
Translation:
第十条 运力条款  
[1] 缔约各方指定的空运企业在指定航线上经营约定业务时，应享有公平、平等的机会。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Matters relating to frequency , type of aircraft , schedule , ground handling and other matters pertaining to the operation of the agreed services shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 关于约定服务运营中涉及的航班班次、机型、时刻表、地面服务及其他相关事宜，应通过缔约双方指定航空公司的协商确定。

Query_Text_en: Frequency and type of aircraft so agreed shall be subject to the approval of aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 经缔约双方商定的航班班次和机型应经缔约双方航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] In the operation of the agreed services on the specified route , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the air services which the latter airline operates over the whole route or parts thereof .
Translation: 在指定航线上运营约定的航空服务时，每一缔约方指定的空运企业应考虑另一缔约方指定空运企业的利益，避免不当影响后者在整个航线或其部分航段上所经营的航空运输。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The agreed services provided by a designated airline shall retain as their primary objective the provision at a reasonable load factor , of capacity adequate to current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers , mail and cargo , originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline .
Translation: 指定航空公司的协议服务应以合理载运率为基础，确保运力充足以满足当前及可合理预见的旅客、邮件和货物运输需求，此类需求应起源于或目的地为指定该航空公司的缔约方领土。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] the requirements of through airline operation
Translation: （c）联程航班运营的要求

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The capacity to be provided at the outset shall be agreed upon between both Contracting Parties before the agreed services are inaugurated .
Translation: 在约定服务正式启动前，初始提供的能力应由双方缔约方商定。

Query_Text_en: Thereafter , the capacity to be provided shall be discussed from time to time between the Aeronautical Authorities of the Contracting Parties and any change in capacity agreed upon shall be confirmed by an Exchange of Notes .
Translation: 缔约国航空当局应就应提供的运力定期进行讨论，任何经双方同意的运力变更均应通过外交换文确认。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 11 INFORMATION AND STATISTICSThe aeronautical authorities of either Contracting Party shall furnish to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party at their request , statistical data as may be reasonably required for the purpose of reviewing the capacity provided by the designated airline of the first Contracting Party on the specified route .
Translation:
第十一条 信息与统计  
应另一方要求，缔约一方航空当局应向缔约另一方航空当局提供合理所需的统计数据，以供审查该指定航空公司在指定航线上所提供运力。

Query_Text_en: ARTCLE 12 APPROVAL OF TIME-TABLES [ 1 ] The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall submit to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party not later than thirty days prior to the inauguration of agreed services on specified routes information on type of service , type of aircraft to be used and flights time-tables .
Translation:
第十二条 航班时刻表的批准  
[1] 各缔约方指定航空公司应在指定航线上商定服务开通前至少三十日，向另一缔约方的航空当局提交以下信息：服务类型、拟使用的航空器类型及航班时刻表。

Query_Text_en: This rule shall be applicable to any subsequent changes and also prior to coming into force of summer and winter time-tables .
Translation: 本规定适用于任何后续变更以及夏令时和冬令时时刻表生效之前。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Aeronautical authorities receiving such timetables shall normally approve them or suggest amendments thereto .
Translation: 航空主管部门收到此类时刻表后，应予以批准或提出修改建议。

Query_Text_en: In any case , this designated airline shall not start operating its services unless such aeronautical authorities grant approval to these time-tables .
Translation: 无论如何，该指定航空公司不得开始运营其服务，除非相关航空当局批准了这些航班时刻表。

Query_Text_en: The same rule shall apply to any subsequent changes .
Translation: 同一规则应适用于任何后续变更。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 13 ESTABLISHMENT OF TARIFFS [ 1 ] The tariffs on any agreed services shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors including cost of operation , reasonable profit , characteristics of service [ such as standards of speed and accommodation ] and the tariffs of other airlines for any part of the specified route .
Translation:
第十三条 关税费率的制定  
[1] 对于任何已达成协议的服务，其费率应设定在合理水平，需综合考虑以下相关因素：运营成本、合理利润、服务特性（如速度和住宿标准），以及指定航线上其他航空公司的费率。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The tariffs referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article shall be agreed upon between the designated airline of both Contracting Parties , in consultation , when necessary and possible , with other airlines operating over the whole or part of that route .
Translation: 本条第[1]款所述关税应由双方指定航空公司协商确定，必要且可能时，可与运营该航线全部或部分航段的其他航空公司进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: The tariffs so agreed shall be subject to the approval of the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties and shall be submitted to their respective aeronautical authorities at least 90 days prior to the proposed date of introduction of these tariffs .
Translation: 双方协商一致的关税应经缔约各方航空主管部门批准，并须在拟实施这些关税的日期至少提前90天提交双方各自的航空主管部门。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] If the aeronautical authorities can not agree on the approval of any tariff submitted to them under paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article or on the determination of any tariff under paragraph [ 3 ] , the matter shall be referred to the Contracting Parties for settlement in accordance with the provisions of Article [ 17 ] of the present Agreement .
Translation: 如果航空当局无法就根据本条第[2]款提交的任何关税的批准或根据第[3]款确定的任何关税达成一致，则该事项应提交缔约方根据本协议第[17]条的规定予以解决。

Query_Text_en: i ] general declaration .
Translation: 一般性声明

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall recognize as valid the certificates and licences mentioned above issued or rendered valid by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方均应承认由另一缔约方签发或确认有效的上述证书和执照。

Query_Text_en: h ] communicate in writing to the first Contracting Party its conclusions and the final report concerning the investigation .
Translation: 书面通知第一缔约方其关于调查的结论及最终报告。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 16 CONSULTATIONS [ 1 ] The aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall , when necessary , exchange views to the effect of ensuring close cooperation and approval of all matters relating to the implementation of this agreement .
Translation:
第十六条 咨询  
双方航空当局应当在必要时就确保密切合作及批准与本协议实施相关的所有事宜交换意见。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Each Contracting Party may , at any time , request consultations with the other Contracting Party for the purpose of amending the present Agreement or Schedule .
Translation: 每一缔约方均可随时就修改本协议或其附件与另一方缔约方进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: Such consultations shall begin within a period of 60 days from the date of receipt of such request .
Translation: 此类磋商应自收到该请求之日起60天内开始。

Query_Text_en: Any amendments to the present Agreement agreed to , as a result of such consultations shall enter into force on the date of exchange of Diplomatic Notes stating that the legal procedures required have been fulfilled in accordance with their respective national laws .
Translation: 经此类磋商达成一致的对本协议的任何修改，应于各方交换声明已完成各自国家法律所规定必要程序的外交照会之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] If the amendment relates only to the Schedule , the consultations shall be between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 如果修正案仅涉及附件，则磋商应由双方缔约方的航空当局进行。

Query_Text_en: When these authorities agree on a new or revised Schedule , the agreed amendments shall come into force as soon as they have been confirmed by an exchange of Diplomatic Notes .
Translation: 当各方就新的或修订后的附表达成一致时，经各方同意的修改内容一经外交换文确认即生效。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 17 SETTLEMENT OF DISPUTESBoth Contracting Parties shall ensure correct implementation of the present Agreement in a spirit of close cooperation and mutual support .
Translation: 第十七条 争端解决缔约双方应确保本协议得到正确实施，并本着密切合作和相互支持的精神。

Query_Text_en: If any difference of opinion arises in respect of the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement , the competent authorities of both Contracting Parties shall endeavor to settle it directly through consultations in a spirit of friendly cooperation and mutual under standing .
Translation: 如果在本协议的解释或执行方面出现任何分歧，缔约双方的主管机关应本着友好合作和相互理解的精神，通过直接磋商努力解决。

Query_Text_en: On request , consultations shall begin within a period of 60 days from the date of receipt of such request .
Translation: 应要求，磋商应在收到该请求之日起60天内启动。

Query_Text_en: If agreement can not be reached within 60 days , the Contracting Parties shall settle it through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 如果在60天内未能达成协议，缔约各方应通过外交渠道解决。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 18 TERMINATIONEither Contracting Party may at any time notify the other Contracting Party of its decision to terminate this Agreement .
Translation:
第十八条 终止  
任何一方缔约方均有权随时通知另一方缔约方其决定终止本协议的意向。

Query_Text_en: If such notice is given , the present Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date of receipt by the other Contracting Party of the notice to terminate , unless by agreement between the Contracting Parties the notice under reference is withdrawn before the expiry of that period .
Translation: 若发出此类通知，则本协议应自另一方收到终止通知之日起十二个月后终止，除非缔约双方在此期间届满前达成协议撤回该通知。

Query_Text_en: Notice shall be deemed to have been received fourteen days after the date of the notice , or at the date of handing the notice to the diplomatic mission of the other Contracting Party in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 通知应视为自通知之日起第十四日后收到，或在向第一个缔约方领土内另一缔约方的外交使团递交通知之日收到。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 19 TITLESTitles are inserted in this Agreement at the head of each article for the purpose of reference and convenience and in no way to define , limit or describe the scope or intent of the present Agreement .
Translation:
第十九条 条款标题  
本协议各条款前载明的标题，仅为参考和方便起见，不得视为对本协议范围或意图的界定、限制或说明。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 20 ENTRY INTO FORCEThe present Agreement shall come into force on the date of exchange of Diplomatic Notes confirming that the Contracting Parties have completed their respective legal procedures .
Translation:
第二十条 生效  
本协议应于确认缔约双方已完成各自国内法律程序的外交换文交换之日生效。

Query_Text_en: In witness whereof , the undersigned , being duly authorised by their respective Governments , have signed the present Agreement .
Translation: 鉴此，下列经各自政府正式授权的签署人，签署了本协议。

Query_Text_en: Done at Muscat on the third day of May , 1983 , in two originals , each in the Arabic , Chinese and English languages , the three texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本协议于1983年5月3日在马斯喀特签订，共两份正本，每份均以阿拉伯语、中文和英语写成，三种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: In ease of divergent interpretations of the Arabic and Chinese texts , the English text shall prevail .
Translation: 如阿拉伯语和中文文本的解释出现分歧，以英文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: A point in the Sultanate of Oman - two intermediate , points - Beijing - two points beyond .
Translation: 阿曼苏丹国——两个中间节点——北京——两个节点之后。

Query_Text_en: N. B. : Operation may be established on the two intermediate and the two beyond points on the specified route provided no traffic rights shall be exercised to and from Beijing and such points .
Translation: 在指定航线上，可设立航线运营于两个中间点和两个延伸点，但不得行使至北京及上述各点的航权。

Query_Text_en: A point in China - two intermediate points - Muscat - two points beyond .
Translation: 中国境内一点——两个中间节点——马斯喀特——其后两个节点。

Query_Text_en: N. B. : Operation may be established on the two intermediate and the two beyond points on the specified route provided no traffic rights shall be exercised to and from Muscat and such points .
Translation: 注：可在指定航线上设立两个中间航点和两个延伸航点进行运营，但不得行使从马斯喀特及这些航点进出的航权。

Query_Text_en: [ A ] Landing at any or all points on the specified route , on any or all flights , may be omitted provided that operation originates and terminates in the territory of the Contracting Party designating the airline .
Translation: 在指定航线上任何或所有经停地点，以及任何或所有航班的经停，只要该航空公司的指定缔约方领土是运营的起点和终点，均可不进行。

Query_Text_en: [ B ] The designated airline shall specify and submit to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party the two intermediate and the two beyond points for approval prior to the inauguration of the agreed services and prior to any subsequent changes to the schedule .
Translation: 指定航空公司应在商定服务开通前以及后续调整班期前，向另一缔约方航空当局明确并提交两个中间点和两个延伸点，以供批准。

Query_Text_en: Such points shall not necessarily be the same on different flights .
Translation: 此类点位在不同航班中不必然相同。

Query_Text_en: For the Government of Pakistan : Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Minister of External Affairs ;
Translation: 巴基斯坦政府：祖尔菲卡尔·阿里·布托 外交部长；

Query_Text_en: Article 1In view of the fact that the boundary between China 'S Sinkiang and the contiguous areas the defense of which iS under the actual control of Pakistan has never been formally delimited the two Parties agree to delimit lt on the basis of the traditional customary boundary line including natural features and in a spirit of equality mutual benefit and friendly cooperation
Translation: 鉴于中国Sinkiang地区与巴基斯坦实际控制其防务的接壤地区之间的边界从未正式划定，双方同意以包括自然地理特征在内的传统习惯边界线为基础，在平等互利、友好合作的精神下进行划定。

Query_Text_en: 1 Commencing from its northwestern extremity at Height 5630 metres a peak the reference co ordinates of which are approximately Longitude 74 34 E and Latitude 37 03 N the boundary line runs generally eastward and then southeastward strictly along the main watershed between the tributaries of the Tashkurgan River of the Tarim River system on the one hand and the tributaries of the Hunza River of the Indus River system on the other hand passing through the Kilik Daban Dawan the Mintaka Daban Pass the Kharchanai Daban named on the Chinese map only the Mutsjilga Daban named on the Chinese map only and the Parpik Pass named on the Pakistan map only and reaches the Khunjerab Yutr Daban Pass
Translation: 边界线自其西北端海拔5630米的某山峰（其参考坐标约为东经74°34′、北纬37°03′）起始，大致向东延伸，随后转向东南方向，严格沿塔里木河流域塔什库尔干河支流与印度河流域洪扎河支流之间的主分水岭行进，途经基里克达坂、明塔克达坂山口、仅在中国地图上标注的赫尔坎奈达坂、仅在中国地图上标注的穆赤日嘎达坂、仅在巴基斯坦地图上标注的帕尔皮克山口，最终抵达坤尔杰布尤图尔达坂山口。

Query_Text_en: 2 After passing through the Khunjerab Yutr Daban Pass the boundary line runs generally southward along the above mentioned main watershed upto a mountain top south of this Daban Pass where it leaves the main waterslled to follow the crest of a spur lying generally in a southeasterly direction which is the watershed between the Akjilga River a nameless corresponding river on the Pakistan map on the one hand and the Taghdumbash Oprang River and theKeliman Su Oprang Jilga on the other hand
Translation: 边界线经过昆贾拉布尤特尔达班山口后，大致沿上述主分水岭向南延伸，直至该达班山口南侧的一座山顶。在此处离开主分水岭，沿向东南方向延伸的山脊顶部前行，该山脊是阿吉尔加河与巴基斯坦地图上标注的无名河流一方，以及塔格敦巴什奥普朗河和凯利曼苏奥普朗吉尔加另一方之间的分水岭。

Query_Text_en: According to the map of the Pakistan side the boundary line after leaving the southeastern extremity of this spur reaches the sharp bend of the Shaksgam or Muztagh River
Translation: 根据巴基斯坦方面的地图，边界线在离开该山脊支脉的东南端后，延伸至萨斯加姆河或慕士塔格河的急转弯处。

Query_Text_en: 3 From the aforesaid point the boundary line runs up the Kelechin River Shaksgam or Muztagh River along the middle line of its bed to its confluence reterence co ordinates approximately Longitude 76 02 E and Latitude 36 26 N with the shorbulak Daria Shimshal River or Braldu River
Translation: 从上述点起，边界线沿克勒钦河（萨尔哈木河）或穆斯塔格河河床中线向上延伸，直至其与肖尔布拉克达里亚·什姆沙尔河（或布拉尔杜河）的汇合处，参考坐标约为东经76度02分、北纬36度26分。

Query_Text_en: According to the map of the Pakistan side the boundary line from the confluence of the above mentioned two rivers ascends the crest of a corresponding spur and runs along it passing through Height 6520metres 21 390 feet till it joins the Karakoram Range main watershed at a peak reference co ordinates approximately Longitude 75 57 E and Latitude 36 03 N
Translation: 根据巴基斯坦方面绘制的地图，边界线从上述两条河流的交汇处出发，沿相应山脊的脊顶延伸，并沿该山脊延伸经过海拔6520米（21390英尺）的高地，直至与喀喇昆仑山脉主分水岭在某山峰交汇（参考坐标约为东经75度57分、北纬36度03分）。

Query_Text_en: 5 Thence the boundary line running generally southward and then eastward strictly follows the Karakoram Range main watershed which separates the Tarlm River drainage system from the Indus River drainage system passing through the East Mustagh Pass Muztagh Pass the top of the Chogri Peak K2 the top of the Broad Peak the top of the Gasherbrum Mountain 8068 the Indirakoli Pass named on the Chinese map only and the top of the Teram Kangri Peak and reaches its southeastern extremity at the Karakoram Pass
Translation: 边界线大致向南延伸，随后转向东行，严格沿喀喇昆仑山脉主分水岭而行，该分水岭将塔尔姆河流域系统与印度河流域系统分隔开。边界线途经东慕士塔格山口、慕士塔格山口、乔戈里峰顶、K2峰顶、布洛阿特峰顶、迦舒布鲁姆8068峰顶、仅在中国地图上标注的因迪拉科利山口以及特兰康加里峰顶，最终在喀喇昆仑山口达到其最东南端。

Query_Text_en: The alignment of the entire boundary line as described in Section of this Article has been drawn on the 1 one million scale map of the Chinese side in Chinese and the 1 one million scale map of the Pakistan side in English which are signed and attached to the present Agreement
Translation: 本条所述的整个边界线走向已绘制于中方提供的中文版百万分之一比例尺地图和巴方提供的英文版百万分之一比例尺地图上，上述地图业经签署并作为本协议附件。

Query_Text_en: In view of the fact that the maps of the two sides are not fully identical in their representation of topographical features the two Parties have agreed that the actual features on the ground shall prevail so far as the location and alignment of the boundary described in Section is concerned ; and that they will be determined as far as possible by joint survey on the ground
Translation: 鉴于双方地图对地形特征的表示尚未完全一致，缔约双方一致同意，就本条款所述边界的位置和走向而言，应以实地实际存在的地形特征为准，并尽可能通过实地联合勘测予以确定。

Query_Text_en: Wherever the boundary passes through a Daban Pass the water parting line thereof shall be the boundary line
Translation: 无论边界经过哪个达坂口，其分水线即为边界线。

Query_Text_en: The two Parties have agreed to set up as soon as possible a joint Boundary Demarcation Cornmission
Translation: 双方已同意尽快设立联合边界划界委员会。

Query_Text_en: Each side will appoint a Chairman one or more members and a certain number of advisers and technical staff
Translation: 每一方将任命一名主席、一名或多名成员，以及若干顾问和技术人员。

Query_Text_en: 1 To conduct necessary surveys of the boundary area on the ground as stated in Article Two of the present Agreement SO as to set up boundary markers at places considered to be appropriate by the two Parties and to delineate the boundary line on the jointly prepared accurate maps
Translation: 根据本协议第二条之规定，对实地边界区域进行必要的勘察，以便在双方认为合适的位置设立界标，并在共同编制的精确地图上划定边界线。

Query_Text_en: 2 To draft a Protocol setting forth in detail the alignment of the entire boundary line and the location of all the boundary markers and prepare and get printed detailed maps to be attached to the Protocol with the boundary 1ine and the location of the boundary markers shown on them
Translation: 双方应起草一份议定书，详细规定整个边界线的走向及所有界标的具体位置，并准备及印制详细地图作为议定书的附件，地图上需明确标示边界线及界标的具体位置。

Query_Text_en: The aforesaid Protocol upon being signed by the representatives of the Governments of the two countries shall become an Annex to the present Agreement and the detailed maps shall replace the maps attached to the present Agreement
Translation: 上述议定书一经两国政府代表签署，即成为本协议的附件，所述详细地图将取代本协议所附地图。

Query_Text_en: Upon the conclusion of the above mentioned Protocol the tasks of the Joint Boundary Demarcation Commission shall be terminated
Translation: 自上述协议生效之日起，联合边界划定委员会的任务即告终止。

Query_Text_en: Article 5The two Parties have agreed that any dispute concerning the boundary which may arise after the delimitation of the boundary line actually existing between the two countries shall be settled peacefully by the two Parties through friendly consultations
Translation: 第五条 缔约双方一致同意，两国实际存在的边界线划定后可能产生的有关边界问题的任何争端，均应通过友好协商和平解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 6The two Parties have agreed that after the settlement of the Kashmir dispute between Pakistan and India the sovereign authority concerned will reopen Degotiations with the Government of the People 'S Republic of China on the boundary as described in Article Two of the present Agreement SO as to sign a formal boundary treaty to replace the present Agreement provided that in the event of that sovereign authority being Pakistan the provisions of the present Agreement and of the aforesaid Protocol shall be maintained in the formal Boundary Treaty to be signed between the People 's Republic of China and Pakistan
Translation: 第六条双方一致同意，待巴基斯坦与印度之间的克什米尔争端解决后，相关主权方应就本协议第二条所述边界范围，与中华人民共和国政府重启谈判，以签订正式边界条约取代本协议。若相关主权方为巴基斯坦，则本协议及上述议定书的各项条款应在中华人民共和国与巴基斯坦缔结的正式边界条约中予以保留。

Query_Text_en: Article 7The present Agreement shall come into force on the date of its signature
Translation: 第七条 本协议自签署之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Done in duplicate in Peking on the second day of March 1963 in the Chinese and English languages both texts being equally authentic
Translation: 本文件于一九六三年三月二日在北京一式两份签署，中文本和英文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: g ] the term `` stop for non-traffic purposes '' means a landing for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers , baggage , cargo or mail .
Translation: “非交通目的停靠”指除上下旅客、行李、货物或邮件外，因其他任何目的而进行的停靠。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 2 [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the right to establish and operate scheduled air services on the routes specified in the Annex to the present Agreement . Such services and routes shall hereinafter be referred to as `` the agreed services '' and `` the specified routes '' respectively .
Translation: 第二条 [1] 每一方缔约方均授予另一方缔约方在本协定附件中指定的航线上建立并运营定期航班服务的权利。此类服务和航线以下简称"协议服务"和"指定航线"。

Query_Text_en: c ] to make stops at points on the specified routes in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of taking on board and discharging international traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail .
Translation: 在另一缔约方领土内指定航线上的指定地点停靠，以便装卸国际运输的旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 3 [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate through the diplomatic channel to the other Contracting Party one airline to operate the agreed services on the routes specified in the Annex to the present Agreement .
Translation: 第三条 [1] 每一缔约方有权通过外交途径向另一缔约方指定一家航空公司，运营本协定附件所列航线上双方已商定的服务。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] On receipt of such designation , the other Contracting Party shall , subject to the provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article , grant without delay to the airline so designated the appropriate operating authorization .
Translation: 收到上述指定后，另一缔约方应在本条第[2]款规定的前提下，立即向被指定的航空公司授予相应的运营许可。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party may require the airline designated by the first Contracting Party to satisfy them that it is qualified to fulfil the conditions prescribed under the laws and regulations normally and reasonable applied to the operation of air services by the said authorities .
Translation: 另一缔约方的航空当局有权要求由第一缔约方指定的航空公司证明其具备满足该当局在航空运输运营中通常合理适用的法律法规所规定条件的能力，并予以确认。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] When an airline has been so designated and authorized it may commence operation of the agreed services .
Translation: 当航空公司被指定并获得授权后，即可开始运营协议约定的服务。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 5The laws and regulations of either Contracting Party relating to the admission to , stay in , departure from and flight over its territory of aircraft engaged in the operation of international air services as well as the laws and regulations relating to the admission to , stay in and departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail shall be applicable to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , its crew as well as the passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried by such aircraft , while in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第五条  
缔约任何一方关于从事国际航空运输的航空器进入、停留、离开及其领土上空飞越的法律和法规，以及关于乘客、机组人员、行李、货物和邮件进入、停留、离开其领土的法律和法规，均适用于另一缔约方指定的航空公司的航空器及其机组人员、所载乘客、行李、货物和邮件在其领土内时。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 6 [ 1 ] Aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party engaged in the operation of the agreed services on the specified routes as well as the regular equipment , spare parts , fuel , oils [ including hydraulic fluids ] , lubricants and aircraft stores [ including food , beverages and tobacco ] retained on board such aircraft shall be exempt from all customs duties , inspection fees and other similar charges on arrival in and departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第六条 [1] 双方缔约方指定航空公司运营约定航线协定航班的航空器及其保留机上的正常设备、备件、燃料、油料[包括液压油]、润滑剂和机上用品[包括食品、饮料及烟草]，在进入或离开另一方缔约方领土时，应免缴关税、检验费及其他类似费用。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] fuel , oils [ including hydraulic fluids ] and lubricants supplied in the territory of one Contracting Party to the aircraft of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party engaged in the operation of the agreed services , even when these supplies are for use on the part of the journey performed over the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方领土内向另一方缔约方指定航空公司的飞机提供的燃料、油料（包括液压油）和润滑剂，即使这些供应品用于在第一缔约方领土上空飞行航段的使用。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 7The regular airborne equipment as well as the material and supplies , referred to in Article 6 of the present Agreement , retained on board the aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party engaged in the operation of the agreed services may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 根据本协议第六条规定，留在任一缔约方指定航空公司运营协议规定服务的航空器上的常规机载设备、物料和供应品，须经另一缔约方海关当局批准后，方可在该缔约方领土内卸载。

Query_Text_en: In such event , they shall be placed under the supervision of the said authorities , subject to fair and reasonable storage charges , up to such time as they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the regulations of such authorities .
Translation: 在这种情况下，相关货物将被置于相关主管部门的监管之下，并按公平合理的仓储费用缴纳费用，直至其根据主管部门的规定重新出口或以其他方式处理为止。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 8 [ 1 ] The minimum formalities only shall be required in respect of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried in direct transit across the territory of one Contracting Party by aircraft of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party engaged in the operation of the agreed services .
Translation: 第八条 [ 1 ] 对一方缔约方指定空运企业的航空器载运的在另一方缔约方领土内实行直接过境运输的旅客、行李、货物和邮件，仅要求办理最低限度的手续。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Baggage , cargo and dutiable objects carried through the mail , carried in direct transit , shall be exempt from customs duties and other similar duties or charges .
Translation: 通过邮寄方式运输或直接过境运输的行李、货物及应税物品，应免征关税及其他类似税费。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 9 [ 1 ] Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory regular airport and alternate airports to be used by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified routes , and shall provide the latter with such communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary services in its territory as are required for the operation of the agreed services . Detailed arrangements relating to the above shall be agreed between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Party .
Translation: 第九条 [1] 每一缔约国应在其领土内为另一缔约国指定航空公司的指定航线运营，指定常规机场和备降机场，并在其领土内向后者提供运营协定服务所需之通信、导航、气象及其他辅助服务。上述具体安排应由双方缔约国航空主管当局协商确定。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The designated airline of one Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airports , equipment and technical services of the other Contracting Party at fair and reasonable rates prescribed by the appropriate authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约一方指定的航空公司使用缔约另一方的机场、设备及技术服务时，应按照缔约另一方有关当局规定的公平合理费率缴纳费用。

Query_Text_en: Such rates shall not be higher than those paid by airlines of other States engaged in international air services .
Translation: 此类费率不得高于其他国家从事国际航空服务的航空公司所支付的费率。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 10 [ 1 ] The designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall have fair and equal opportunity in operating the agreed services on the specified routes .
Translation: 第十条 [1] 缔约双方指定的空运企业在指定航线上经营约定的航空服务时，应享有公平和平等的机会。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Matters relating to frequency , type of aircraft , schedule , additional flights , conditions of carriage , sales representation and other matters pertaining to the operation of the agreed services shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and shall be subject to the approval of their respective aeronautical authorities .
Translation: 有关航班频率、机型、时刻表、加班航班、运输条件、销售代理以及其他有关商定服务运营的事项，应由双方指定航空公司通过协商确定，并须经各自航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] In operating the agreed services , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services provided by the latter on the whole or part of the same routes .
Translation: 在运营约定航线时，缔约各方指定的航空公司应顾及其他缔约方指定航空公司的利益，以免对后者在全部或部分相同航线上提供的服务造成不当影响。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The agreed services provided by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall bear a close relationship to the requirements of the public for transportation on the specified routes and shall have as their primary objective the provision , at the reasonable load factor , of capacity adequate to satisfy the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail originating in or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party which has designated the airline .
Translation: 缔约双方指定航空公司提供的协议服务应与其指定航线上运输需求密切相关，并应以合理载运率下提供充足的运力为首要目标，以满足乘客、行李、货物及邮件在缔约方领土内始发或目的地的需求，涵盖当前及合理预期的运输要求。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] the requirements of through airline operation .
Translation: [c] 直航运营的要求。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 11 [ 1 ] The tariffs to be charged by the designated airline of one Contracting Party for carriage to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors , including cost of operation , reasonable profit and the tariffs of other airlines .
Translation: 第十一款 [1] 一方缔约方指定空运企业往来于另一缔约方领土内的运输所收取的票价和费用，应确定在合理水平，需充分考虑各项相关因素，包括运营成本、合理利润及其他航空公司的票价。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The tariffs referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article shall be agreed by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 本条第[1]段所指的运价应由缔约双方指定的航空公司协商确定。

Query_Text_en: If appropriate , the said airlines shall hold consultations with other airlines operating over the whole or part of the route .
Translation: 如需适当，有关航空公司应与在该航线全部或部分航段运营的其他航空公司进行协商。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The tariffs so agreed shall be submitted to the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties for approval at least ninety [ 90 ] days before the proposed date of their introduction .
Translation: 双方商定的关税应于拟实施日期至少九十[90]天前提交缔约双方的航空当局以获得批准。

Query_Text_en: In special cases , this period may be shortened subject to the agreement of the said authorities .
Translation: 在特殊情况下，经相关主管部门同意，本期限可予以缩短。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] This approval may be given expressly .
Translation: 该批准可明确作出。

Query_Text_en: If neither of the aeronautical authorities has expressed disapproval within thirty [ 30 ] days from the date of submission , in accordance with paragraph [ 3 ] of this Article , these tariffs shall be considered as approved .
Translation: 如果双方航空主管当局均未在提交之日起三十[30]日内按照本条第3款规定提出异议，这些费率应视为已获批准。

Query_Text_en: In the event of the period for submission being reduced , as provided for in paragraph [ 3 ] , the aeronautical authorities may agree that the period within which any disapproval must be notified shall be less than thirty [ 30 ] days .
Translation: 根据第[3]款规定缩短提交期限时，航空主管部门可同意将反对意见必须予以通知的期限少于三十[30]日。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] If a tariff can not be agreed between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties in accordance with the provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article , or if the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party give the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party notice of their disapproval of a tariff agreed in accordance with the provisions of paragraph [ 2 ] of this Article , the aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties shall endeavor to determine the tariff through mutual consultation .
Translation: [5] 如果缔约双方指定的航空公司未能按照本条第[2]款的规定达成运价协议，或缔约一方航空当局就缔约另一方依据本条第[2]款规定达成的运价协议向对方航空当局提出反对通知，则缔约双方航空当局应努力通过协商确定运价。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] If the aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties can not agree on any tariff submitted to them under paragraph [ 3 ] of this Article , or on the determination of any tariff under paragraph [ 5 ] of this Article , the difference of opinion shall be settled in accordance with the provisions of Article 16 of the present Agreement .
Translation: 如本协定缔约双方航空当局对根据本条第三款提交的任何费率，或根据本条第五款确定的任何费率未能达成一致意见，分歧应按照本协议第十六条的规定予以解决。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] A tariff established in accordance with the provisions of this Article shall remain in force until a new tariff has been established .
Translation: 根据本条规定设立的关税应继续有效，直至新的关税确定设立。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 12Each Contracting Party grants to the designated airline of the other Contracting Party the right to transfer freely the excess of receipts earned in the territory of the first Contracting Party over its expenditure therein .
Translation: 每一缔约方应准予对方缔约方指定空运企业将其在该缔约方领土内所获收入超过支出的差额自由转移。

Query_Text_en: Such transfers shall be effected in convertible currency at the foreign exchange rate applicable at the time of transfer .
Translation: 此类转账应以可自由兑换货币按照转账时适用的汇率进行。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 13The aeronautical authorities of each Contracting Party shall supply to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party , at their request , statistics relevant to the traffic to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party carried on the agreed services of the designated airline of the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 第十三条 每一缔约国的航空当局应应另一缔约国航空当局的要求，提供由该缔约国指定的航空公司根据约定服务进行的、涉及另一缔约国领土往来运输的相关统计资料。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 14 [ 1 ] For the operation of the agreed services on the specified routes , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have the right to set up its representative offices at the points on its specified routes within the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 第十四条 [1] 在指定航线上运营约定服务时，每一缔约方指定的空运企业有权在另一缔约方领土内其指定航线上各航点设立其代表机构。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such representative offices shall be nationals of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland and \/ or of the People 's Republic of China , and the number of staff shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , and shall be subject to the approval of the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 此类代表处的工作人员应为大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国和/或中华人民共和国的国民，且工作人员数量应由双方缔约方指定的航空公司经协商确定，并须经双方缔约方民航主管机关批准。

Query_Text_en: The staff of such representative offices shall be subject to the laws and regulations in force in the country where such offices are located .
Translation: 此类代表处的工作人员应当遵守其所在国现行的法律法规。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Each Contracting Party shall take all necessary steps to facilitate and to assist the setting up and operation of the representative offices referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article .
Translation: 每一缔约方应采取一切必要措施，促进和协助本条第一款所规定的代表机构的设立及运营。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Each Contracting Party shall use its best endeavors to safeguard , within its territory , the airline operations and personnel of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方应采取一切必要措施，确保在其领土内另一缔约方的航空运营及人员得到保护。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The crew members of the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties flying on their specified routes shall be nationals of their respective countries .
Translation: 缔约双方指定航空公司在指定航线上飞行的机组人员应为各自国家的公民。

Query_Text_en: If the designated airline of either Contracting Party desires to utilise crew members who are nationals of any third State for the operation of the agreed services , it shall obtain prior approval from the other Contracting Party through the diplomatic channel .
Translation: 如某一方缔约方指定的航空公司希望在运营协议规定的航空服务时使用第三国国民作为机组人员，须事先通过外交途径获得另一方缔约方的批准。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 15The Contracting Parties reaffirm their grave concern about acts or threats against the security of aircraft , which jeopardize the safety of persons or property , adversely affect the operation of air services and undermine public confidence in the safety of civil aviation .
Translation: 缔约各方重申对危害航空器安全的行为或威胁深表关切，这些行为或威胁危及人员或财产安全，影响航空运输的正常运营，并损害公众对民航安全的信心。

Query_Text_en: The Contracting Parties agree to provide any necessary aid to each other with a view to preventing hijackings and sabotage to aircraft , airports and air navigation facilities and threats to aviation security .
Translation: 缔约国同意相互提供必要的援助，旨在防止劫持、破坏航空器、机场和航空导航设施以及对航空安全的威胁。

Query_Text_en: When incidents or threats of hijacking or sabotage against aircraft , airports or air navigation facilities occur , the Contracting Parties shall assist each other by facilitating communications intended to terminate such incidents rapidly and safely .
Translation: 当针对航空器、机场或航空导航设施的劫持或破坏事件或威胁发生时，缔约国应通过促进旨在迅速、安全地终止此类事件的沟通与联络相互提供协助。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall give sympathetic consideration to any request from the other Contracting Party for special security measures for its aircraft or passengers to meet a particular threat .
Translation: 每一缔约方应给予另一缔约方提出的、对其航空器或乘客采取特殊安全措施以应对特定威胁的任何请求以善意考虑。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 16 [ 1 ] The Contracting Parties shall ensure the correct implementation of , and satisfactory compliance with , the provisions of the present Agreement in a spirit of close co-operation and mutual support .
Translation: 缔约各方应本着密切合作和相互支持的精神，确保本协议各项规定的正确实施以及有效遵守。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Either Contracting Party may request consultation with the other Contracting Party , which may be either oral or in writing , and which shall begin within a period of sixty [ 60 ] days from the date of receipt of the request , unless both Contracting Parties agree to an extension of this period .
Translation: 任一缔约方均可要求与另一缔约方进行磋商，磋商可采取口头或书面形式，应自收到请求之日起六十日内开始，除非双方同意延长该期限。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] If any difference of opinion arises in respect of the interpretation or implementation of the present Agreement , the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall , where appropriate , endeavor to settle it directly through consultation in a spirit of friendly co-operation and mutual understanding .
Translation: 如果在解释或执行本协议过程中出现任何意见分歧，缔约双方指定的航空公司应在适当情况下，努力通过友好合作和相互理解的精神直接协商解决。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 17 [ 1 ] If either of the Contracting Parties considers it desirable to modify or amend any provision of the present Agreement or the Annex thereto , it may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party and such consultation , which may be either oral or in writing , shall begin within a period of sixty [ 60 ] days from the date of receipt of the request by the other Contracting Party unless both Contracting Parties agree to an extension of this period .
Translation:
第十七条  
如任一缔约方认为有必要修改或变更本协议或其附件的任何条款，可随时要求与另一缔约方进行磋商。此类磋商可采取口头或书面形式，应在另一缔约方收到请求之日起六十[60]日内启动，除非双方同意延长该期限。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Any modification or amendment to the present Agreement shall come into force when it has been confirmed by an Exchange of Notes , through the diplomatic channel , except as provided in paragraph [ 3 ] of this Article .
Translation: 本协议的任何修改或修订，除本条第[3]款另有规定者外，均须通过外交渠道以外交换文确认后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Modifications or amendments to the Annex to the present Agreement may be agreed between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties and shall be applied provisionally and confirmed as soon as possible by an Exchange of Notes , through the diplomatic channel .
Translation: 本协议附件的修改或修订可由缔约方的航空当局达成一致后暂行实施，并通过外交渠道以交换外交文书的方式尽快确认。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 18Either Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party of its decision to terminate the present Agreement .
Translation: 第十八条 缔约任何一方可随时通知另一方缔约方，表示其决定终止本协定。

Query_Text_en: The present Agreement shall then terminate twelve [ 12 ] months after the date of receipt of the notice by the other Contracting Party , unless the notice to terminate is withdrawn by the first Contracting Party by agreement with the second Contracting Party before the expiry of this period .
Translation: 本协议应于另一方收到通知之日起十二（12）个月后终止，除非在该期限届满前，发出通知方与另一方达成协议并撤回终止通知。

Query_Text_en: ARTICLE 19The present Agreement shall enter into force on the date of its signature .
Translation: 第十九条 本协议应于签署之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: In witness whereof the undersigned being duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments , have signed the present Agreement .
Translation: 鉴此，下列经各自政府正式授权的签署方，特签署本协议。

Query_Text_en: Done in duplicate at London this 1st day of November 1979 in the English and Chinese languages , both texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本文件于1979年11月1日于伦敦以英文和中文一式两份签署完毕，两种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: London-Rome-Tehran-Bahrain-Dubai-Oman-Kuwait-Rawalpindi or Karachi - Bombay-Delhi-Calcutta-Peking .
Translation: 伦敦-罗马-德黑兰-巴林-迪拜-阿曼-科威特-拉瓦尔品第或卡拉奇-孟买-新德里-加尔各答-北京。

Query_Text_en: Notes [ i ] Any point or points may be omitted on any or all flights provided that the agreed services originate at a point in the territory of the United Kingdom .
Translation: 只要约定的服务起始于英国领土内的某一点，任何航点均可在任何或所有航班中取消。

Query_Text_en: Any such omission shall be notified to the designated airline of China as soon as possible .
Translation: 任何此类遗漏应尽快通知中国指定的航空公司。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] Not more than two points outside the territories of the Contracting Parties may be served as intermediate points on any one flight .
Translation: [ ii ] 任何一次航班作为中间经停点的境外地点不得超过两个。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] Not more than one point in the Gulf and not more than one point in India may be served on any one flight .
Translation: 每架航班在同一航程中，海湾地区和印度各不得超过一个航点。

Query_Text_en: Peking-Rawalpindi or Karachi-a point in India - a point in the Gulf - Tehran-Bucharest-Athens-Rome-Zurich-Frankfurt-Paris-London .
Translation: 北京—拉瓦尔品第或卡拉奇—印度的一个点—海湾的一个点—德黑兰—布加勒斯特—雅典—罗马—苏黎世—法兰克福—巴黎—伦敦

Query_Text_en: Notes [ i ] Any point or points may be omitted on any or all flights provided that the agreed services originate at a point in the territory of China .
Translation: 只要约定服务起始于中国境内的某一地点，可在任何或所有航班中免除某一或某些航点。

Query_Text_en: Any such omission shall be notified to the designated airline of the United Kingdom as soon as possible .
Translation: 任何此类遗漏应尽快通知英国指定的航空公司。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] Not more than one point in Europe may be served as an intermediate point on any one flight .
Translation: 每条航线在欧洲境内作为中转点不得超过一个。

Query_Text_en: II . Non-Scheduled ServicesAny airline of either Contracting Party may submit a request to the appropriate authorities of the other Contracting Party to operate charter flights to or from the territory of the latter Contracting Party .
Translation:
第二条 不定期航班服务  
缔约任何一方的航空公司可向另一方缔约国有关当局提交申请，运营至或来自该缔约国领土的包机航班。

Query_Text_en: The authorities to whom such a request is submitted shall consider it promptly in the light of their charter worthiness rules , applying the principle of reciprocity .
Translation: 提交此类请求的主管部门应当根据其章程规定的资格要求及时予以考虑，并适用对等原则。
第五条、第六条、第七条、第九条、第十二条、第十四条[3]及[4]以及第十五条。

Query_Text_en: Investments made in the territory of one Contracting Party by any company of that same Contracting Party which is actually owned or controlled by investors of the other Contracting Party shall likewise be considered as investments of investors of the latter Contracting Party if they have been made in accordance with the laws and regulations of the former Contracting Party .
Translation: 根据缔约另一方投资者实际拥有或控制的缔约一方境内任何公司在该缔约一方领土内所作的投资，若符合缔约该方法律法规规定，应视为缔约另一方投资者的投资。

Query_Text_en: b ] legal entities , including companies , associations , partnerships and other organizations , incorporated or constituted under the laws and regulations of either Contracting Party and have their seats in that Contracting Party .
Translation: 根据任一缔约方的法律和法规成立或组建，并且其总机构设在该缔约方境内的法人实体，包括公司、协会、合伙企业及其他组织。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` return '' means the amounts yielded from investments , including profits , dividends , interests , capital gains , royalties , fees and other legitimate income .
Translation: "收益"指从投资中获得的金额，包括利润、股息、利息、资本利得、特许权使用费、相关费用及其他合法收入。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term `` territory '' means the territory of either Contracting Party , including the land territory , territorial sea and the airspace above them , as well as the exclusive economic zone and the continental shelf that extend beyond the territorial sea over which the Contracting Party concerned exercises sovereign rights and\/or jurisdiction in accordance with its domestic law and international law .
Translation: “领土”系指任何一缔约方的领土，包括陆地领土、领海及其之上的空域，以及该缔约方依据其国内法和国际法，在领海以外延伸的专属经济区和大陆架上行使主权权利和/或管辖权的区域。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Contracting Party shall encourage and create favourable conditions for investors of the other Contracting Party to make investments in its territory and admit such investments in accordance with its laws and regulations .
Translation: 每一缔约方应鼓励并为另一缔约方的投资者在其领土内进行投资创造有利条件，并根据其国内法律和法规接受此类投资。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Investments of the investors of either Contracting Party shall enjoy the constant protection and security in the territory of the other Contracting .
Translation: 缔约一方投资者的投资在另一缔约方的领土内应受到持续的保护和安全保障。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Neither Contracting Party shall take any unreasonable or discriminatory measure against the management , maintenance , use , enjoyment and disposal of the investments by the investors of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约双方均不得对另一缔约方投资者在其境内的投资管理、维护、使用、收益或处置采取任何不合理的或具有歧视性的措施。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Subject to its laws and regulations , either Contracting Party shall give sympathetic consideration to application for obtaining visas and working permits to nationals of the other Contracting Party engaging in activities associated with investments made in the territory of that Contracting Party .
Translation: 4. 根据各自法律法规，每一缔约方应对另一缔约方国民为在该缔约方领土内进行投资相关活动而申请签证和工作许可的请求予以积极考虑。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Investments of investors of each Contracting Party shall all the time be accorded fair and equitable treatment in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约各方投资者的投资应在另一缔约方境内始终获得公平公正待遇。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Contracting Party shall accord to investments and activities associated with such investments by the investors of the other Contracting Party treatment no less favourable than that which it accords to the investments and associated activities by its own investors .
Translation: 每一缔约方应给予另一缔约方投资者的投资及其相关活动不低于其给予本国投资者投资及相关活动的待遇。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Neither Contracting Party shall subject investments and activities associated with such investments by investors of the other Contracting Party to treatment less favourable than that accorded to the investments and associated activities by the investors of any third State .
Translation: 缔约任何一方不得对来自另一缔约方投资者的投资及其相关活动给予低于该缔约方给予任何第三国投资者同类投资及相关活动的待遇。

Query_Text_en: c ] any arrangements for facilitating small scale frontier trade in border areas .
Translation: 关于边境地区边境小额贸易便利化安排事宜

Query_Text_en: d ] and against compensation .
Translation: D] 反对补偿。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The compensation mentioned in Paragraph 1 of this Article shall be equivalent to the market value of the expropriated investments immediately before the expropriation is taken or the impending expropriation becomes public knowledge , whichever is earlier .
Translation: 本条第一款所述补偿应相当于被征收投资在征收措施实施前或即将征收公开前的市场价值，以较早者为准。

Query_Text_en: The market value shall be determined in accordance with generally recognized principles of valuation .
Translation: 市场价值应按照普遍认可的评估原则确定。

Query_Text_en: The compensation shall be paid without delay , be effectively realizable and freely transferable .
Translation: 补偿应当及时支付、切实可行且可自由转让。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The investor affected shall have the right , under the law of the Contracting Party making the expropriation , to prompt review , by a judicial or other independent authority of that Contracting Party , of its case , including the valuation of its investment and the payment of compensation , in accordance with the principles set out in this Article .
Translation: 受影响的投资者有权根据实施征收的缔约方的法律，由该缔约方的司法或其他独立机构对其案件进行及时审查，包括投资估值和赔偿支付，依据本条所规定的原则。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Investors of one Contracting Party whose investments in the territory of the other Contracting Party suffer losses owing to war , a state of national emergency , insurrection , riot or other similar events in the territory of the latter Contracting Party shall be accorded by the latter Contracting Party treatment , as regards restitution , indemnification , compensation and other settlements , no less favourable than that accorded to the investors of its own or any third State , whichever is more favourable to the investor concerned .
Translation: 缔约一方投资者在其对方缔约方境内因战争、国家紧急状态、暴动、骚乱或其他类似事件而遭受损失的，后者缔约方应在恢复、赔偿、补偿和其他形式的解决方面，给予不低于其本国投资者或任何第三国投资者所获待遇中更为有利的那一方待遇。

Query_Text_en: shall be accorded by the latter Contracting Party restitution or compensation .
Translation: 应由后者缔约方予以赔偿或补偿。

Query_Text_en: Resulting payments shall be made without delay and be freely transferable .
Translation: 产生的支付款项应得到及时支付，并可自由转移。

Query_Text_en: g ] earnings of personnel engaged from abroad who work in connection with an investment in its territory .
Translation: 与在该国领土内投资相关的外籍人员所得。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Contracting Party shall allow the investors of the other Contracting Party the free transfer of compensation and other payments under Articles 4 and 5 of this Agreement .
Translation: 每一缔约方应允许另一缔约方的投资者自由转移根据本协定第四条和第五条所规定的赔偿和其他款项。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The transfer mentioned above shall be made without delay in a freely convertible currency at the prevailing market rate of exchange applicable within the Contracting Party accepting the investment and on the date of transfer .
Translation: 上述资金转移应立即以可自由兑换货币进行，按接收投资的缔约方境内适用的现行汇率，并在资金转移当日执行。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] that the former Contracting Party or its designated agency is entitled by virtue of subrogation to exercise the rights and enforce the claims of that investor to the same extent as the investor .
Translation: 原缔约方或其指定机构可根据代位权，在与该投资者相同的范围内，行使该投资者的权利并主张其诉求。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Any dispute between the Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement shall , as far as possible , be settled with consultations through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 缔约各方关于本协定的解释或适用所引起的任何争议，应尽可能通过外交途径协商解决。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If a dispute can not thus be settled within six months , it shall , upon the request of either Contracting Party , be submitted , to an ad hoc arbitral tribunal .
Translation: 如争端未能在六个月内通过此方式解决，应一方缔约方请求，应提交至特别仲裁庭。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Such tribunal comprises of three arbitrators .
Translation: 该仲裁庭由三名仲裁员组成。

Query_Text_en: Those two arbitrators shall , within further two months , together select a national of a third State having diplomatic relations with both Contracting Parties as Chairman of the arbitral tribunal .
Translation: 上述两名仲裁员应于随后的两个月内共同选定一名在缔约双方均有外交关系的第三国国民担任仲裁庭主席。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If the arbitral tribunal has not been constituted within four months from the receipt of the written notice requesting arbitration , either Contracting Party may , in the absence of any other agreement , invite the President of the International Court of Justice to make any necessary appointments . If the President is a national of either Contracting Party or is otherwise prevented from discharging the said functions , the Member of the International Court of Justice next in seniority who is not a national of either Contracting Party or is not otherwise prevented from discharging the said functions shall be invited to make such necessary appointments .
Translation: 如仲裁庭自收到请求仲裁的书面通知之日起四个月内仍未成立，如无其他协议，任一缔约方可邀请国际法院院长进行必要任命。若院长系任一缔约方国民或因其他原因无法履行上述职责，则可邀请国际法院资历最深的其他成员（且非上述任何一缔约方国民或无其他阻碍其履行上述职责的情形）进行必要任命。

Query_Text_en: The arbitral tribunal shall reach its award in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement and the generally recognized principles of international law .
Translation: 仲裁庭应依据本协议的规定以及国际法普遍认可的原则作出裁决。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Each Contracting Party shall bear the costs of its appointed arbitrator and of its representation in the arbitral proceedings .
Translation: 每一缔约方应承担其指派的仲裁员费用及其在仲裁程序中的代表费用。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Any dispute between an investor of one Contracting Party and the other Contracting Party in connection with an investment in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be notified in writing by the investor to the latter Contracting Party and , as far as possible , be settled amicably through negotiations between the parties to the dispute .
Translation: 缔约一方的投资者与缔约另一方就其在缔约另一方境内进行的投资所发生的任何争端，应由投资者以书面形式通知该缔约方，并尽可能通过争端各方之间的谈判友好解决。

Query_Text_en: c ] to an ad hoc tribunal of arbitration established under the Arbitration Rules of the United Nations Commission on International Trade Law [ UNCITRAL ] .
Translation: 提交至根据联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则设立的特别仲裁庭。

Query_Text_en: Once the investor has submitted the dispute to the competent court of the Contracting Party concerned or to the ICSID or to an ad hoc tribunal established under the Arbitration Rules of UNCITRAL , the choice of one of the three procedures shall be final .
Translation: 一旦投资者将争端提交有关缔约方的有管辖权法院、国际投资争端解决中心（ICSID）或根据联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则设立的临时仲裁庭，则选定其中一种程序即为最终决定，不可更改。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The arbitration award shall be based on the law of the Contracting Party to the dispute , including its rules on the conflict of laws , the provisions of this Agreement as well as the universally accepted principles of international law .
Translation: 仲裁裁决应依据争端所涉缔约方的法律，包括其冲突法规则、本协议的规定以及国际法普遍认可的原则。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The arbitration award shall be final and binding upon both parties to the dispute .
Translation: 仲裁裁决对争议双方具有终局性和约束力。

Query_Text_en: 1 . If the legislation of either Contracting Party or obligations under international law existing at present or established hereafter between the Contracting Parties in addition to this Agreement contain a regulation , whether general or specific , entitling investments by investors of the other Contracting Party to a treatment more favourable than that provided for by this Agreement , such regulation shall , to the extent that it is more favourable , prevail over this Agreement .
Translation: 缔约任何一方现时或今后根据国际法或缔约双方之间本协议以外另行制定的法律、义务中，如包含无论是一般性还是具体性规定，赋予缔约另一方投资者的待遇优于本协议规定的，则此类规定在更为优惠的范围内，应优先于本协议适用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Contracting Party shall observe any commitments it may have entered into with investors of the other Contracting Party as regards their investments .
Translation: 每一缔约方应遵守其与另一缔约方投资者就其投资事宜已达成的任何承诺。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall apply to investments made prior or after its entry into force by investors of one Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Contracting Party concerned .
Translation: 本协议适用于一方缔约方投资者根据相关缔约方的法律和法规，在另一方缔约方领土内所作的生效前或生效后的投资。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Agreement substitutes and abrogates the Agreement on reciprocal encouragement and protection of investments between the Kingdom of Spain and the People s Republic of China , signed in Madrid on 6th February ,1992 .
Translation: 本协议取代并废止中华人民共和国与西班牙王国于1992年2月6日在马德里签署的《关于相互促进和保护投资协定》。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The present Agreement shall apply to all investments made by investors of either Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party , whether made before or after its entry into force , but shall not apply to any dispute or any claim concerning an investment which was already under judicial or arbitral process before its entry into force .
Translation: 本协定适用于缔约任一方投资者在缔约另一方领土内所作的一切投资，无论该等投资是在本协定生效前或生效后作出，但不适用于本协定生效前已进入司法或仲裁程序的任何争议或与投资相关的任何诉求。

Query_Text_en: Such disputes and claims shall continue to be settled according to the provisions of the Agreement of 1992 mentioned in paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 此类争端和索赔应继续按照本条第一款所述1992年协定的相关规定予以解决。

Query_Text_en: Either Contracting Party may propose to the other Contracting Party that consultations be held on any matter concerning interpretation , application and implementation of the Agreement .
Translation: 缔约一方可向另一方提议就协议解释、应用和实施的有关事项举行磋商。

Query_Text_en: The other Contracting Party shall accord sympathetic consideration to the proposal and shall afford adequate opportunity for such consultations .
Translation: 另一缔约方应对该提议给予善意考虑，并应提供充分机会进行此类磋商。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Agreement shall enter into force on the first day of the following month after the date on which both Contracting Parties have notified each other in writing that their respective internal legal procedures necessary therefore have been fulfilled and shall remain in force for an initial period of ten years
Translation: 本协议应于缔约双方书面通知对方各自完成必要内部法律程序后的次月第一天生效，并有效期为十年。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Agreement shall continue in force if either Contracting Party fails to give a written notice to the other Contracting Party to terminate this Agreement one year before the expiration of the initial period specified in paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 如果缔约任何一方未按照本条第一款规定的初始期限届满前一年向另一方缔约方提交书面终止通知，则本协议在所述初始期限届满后将继续有效。

Query_Text_en: 3 . After the expiration of the initial ten year period , either Contracting Party may at any time thereafter terminate this Agreement by giving at least one year s written notice to the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 本协议初始十年期满后，任何一方缔约方可通过向另一方缔约方发出至少一年的书面通知，在期满后任何时间终止本协议。

Query_Text_en: 4 . With respect to investments made prior to the date of termination of this Agreement , the provisions of Articles 1 to 13 shall continue to be effective for a further period of ten years from such date of termination .
Translation: 对于本协议终止日期之前所作的投资，本协议第一条至第十三条的规定应自终止日起继续有效十年。

Query_Text_en: DONE in duplicate at Madrid on Nov , 14 , 2005 in the Spanish , Chinese and English languages , all texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本文件于2005年11月14日在马德里签署完毕，以西班牙语、中文和英语三种文字写成，三种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: Ad Article 1Returns from the investment and reinvestments shall enjoy the same protection as the investment .
Translation: 第一条 投资所得和再投资应享有与原投资同等的保护待遇。

Query_Text_en: c ] any amendment to any such non-conforming measure referred to in subparagraph a ] to the extent that the amendment does not increase the non-conformity of the measureThe People 's Republic of China will take all appropriate steps in order to progressively remove the non-conforming measures .
Translation: 对上述(a)项所述任何非合规措施所作的任何修改，只要此类修改不会增加该措施的不合规性中华人民共和国将采取一切适当措施，以逐步取消非合规措施。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of Article 3 do not oblige a Contracting Party to extend to investors resident in the territory of the other Contracting Party tax privileges , tax exemptions and tax reductions which according to its tax laws are granted only to investors resident in its territory .
Translation: 本条第三款的规定不妨碍一缔约方根据其税法，仅向本国居民投资者提供税收优惠、税收减免及减税措施，而无需将此类待遇给予另一缔约方领土内的投资者。

Query_Text_en: Ad Article 61 .
Translation: 第六十一条：每一缔约方应采取适当措施，确保其管辖范围内的自然人和法人充分履行勤勉义务，以预防、发现和遏制腐败行为。

Query_Text_en: With regard to the People 's Republic of China , the transfer referred to in the paragraph 1 of Article 6 shall comply with relevant transfer formalities stipulated by the Chinese laws and regulations relating to exchange control .
Translation: 关于中华人民共和国，第六条第一款所指的转移应当遵守中国相关外汇管理法律法规规定的手续。

Query_Text_en: 2 . These formalities shall not be construed as a means of avoiding the Contracting Party 's commitments or obligations under this Agreement .
Translation: 本条所列程序不得解释为缔约方规避本协议项下承诺或义务的手段。

Query_Text_en: 3 . A transfer shall be deemed `` without delay '' within the meaning of paragraph 3 of Article 6 if effected within such period as is normally required for the completion of transfer formalities .
Translation: 根据第六条第三款关于"及时"的含义，转让如在通常完成转让手续所需期限内完成，应被视为"及时"。

Query_Text_en: The said period shall commence on the day on which the relevant application has been submitted with the necessary supportive documentation and may on no account exceed two months .
Translation: 所述期间应自相关申请提交并附齐所需证明材料之日起开始，且不得超出两个月期限。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Transfer formalities relating to an investment shall in no case be more restrictive than formalities required at the time when the original investment was made .
Translation: 涉及投资的转移手续在任何情况下都不得比初始投资时所需手续更加严格。

Query_Text_en: 5 . A Contracting Party may , in exceptional balance of payments difficulties , exercise , through equitable , non-discriminatory and good faith basis , regulatory measures in accordance with the commitments that either Contracting Party has or may have as a Contracting Party to the Articles of Agreement of the International Monetary Fund . Ad Article 9The Kingdom of Spain takes note of the statement that the People 's Republic of China requires that the investor concerned exhausts the domestic administrative review procedure specified by the laws and regulations of the People 's Republic of China , before submission of the dispute to the arbitration procedures stipulated in paragraphs 2 [ b ] or 2 [ c ] of this Article .
Translation:
第五条 缔约方在面临例外的国际支付平衡困难时，可基于公平、非歧视和诚信原则，采取符合其作为国际货币基金组织协定缔约方所作出承诺的监管措施。

第九条 西班牙王国注意到中华人民共和国的如下声明：在将争议提交本条第2款[b]或[c]项规定的仲裁程序前，中华人民共和国要求相关投资者须先完成中国法律法规规定的国内行政复议程序。

Query_Text_en: The People 's Republic of China declares that such a procedure will take a maximum period of three months .
Translation: 中华人民共和国宣布，该程序将最多需要三个月时间。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned , duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments , have signed this Protocol .
Translation: 鉴此，下列经各自政府正式授权的签署人签署了本议定书。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] goods that , under a leasing agreement , are placed at the disposal of a lessee in the territory of a Party in conformity with its laws and regulations .
Translation: 根据租赁协议，在一缔约方境内依照其法律法规提供给承租人使用的货物。

Query_Text_en: Any change in the form in which assets are invested does not affect their character as investments , provided that such change is made in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Party in whose territory the investment has been made .
Translation: 只要这种变更依照接受投资的国家（或地区）的相关法律法规进行，就不会影响其作为投资的性质。

Query_Text_en: - legal entities , including companies , associations , partnerships and other organizations , incorporated or constituted under its laws and regulations and have their seats in Portugal ;
Translation: 在葡萄牙根据其法律法规成立或设立并设有主要办事机构的法人实体，包括公司、协会、合伙企业及其他组织；

Query_Text_en: - economic entities , including companies , corporations , associations , partnerships and other organizations , incorporated and constituted under the laws and regulations of and with their seats in the People s Republic of China , irrespective of whether or not for profit and whether their liabilities are limited or not ;
Translation: 在中华人民共和国法律下注册成立且主要机构位于中华人民共和国境内的经济实体，包括公司、企业、协会、合伙组织及其他组织，无论是否以营利为目的，也不论其责任是否有限。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The term `` return '' means the amounts yielded from investments , including in particular , though not exclusively , profits , dividends , interests , capital gains , royalties , fees and other legitimate income .
Translation: "收益"指投资所获得的收益额，包括但不限于利润、股息、利息、资本收益、特许权使用费、费用以及其他合法收入。

Query_Text_en: In cases where the returns of investments , as defined above , are reinvested , the income resulting from the reinvestment shall also be considered as income related to the first investments .
Translation: 根据上述定义，如将投资收益进行再投资，再投资所产生的收入也应视为与初始投资相关的收入。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The term territory means the territory in which the Parties have , in accordance with international law and their national laws , sovereign rights or jurisdiction , including land territory , territorial sea and air space above them , as well as those maritime areas adjacent to the outer limit of the territorial sea , including seabed and subsoil thereof .
Translation: 本协议中，“领土”一词指缔约方根据国际法和各自的国内法所拥有的主权权利或管辖权范围内的区域，包括陆地领土、领海及其上空，以及毗邻领海外部界限的海域，包括其海床和底土。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Party shall encourage investors of the other Party to make investments in its territory and admit such investments in accordance with its laws and regulations .
Translation: 每一缔约方应鼓励另一缔约方的投资者在其境内进行投资，并根据其法律和法规准许此类投资。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Investments of the investors of either Party shall enjoy constant protection and security in the territory of the other Party .
Translation: 缔约一方投资者在另一方缔约国领土内的投资应始终受到保护和安全保障。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Neither Party shall take any arbitrary or discriminatory measures against the management , maintenance , use , enjoyment and disposal of the investments by the investors of the other Party .
Translation: 缔约双方均不得采取任何任意或歧视性措施，妨碍缔约另一方投资者对其投资的管理、维护、使用、收益和处置。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Subject to its laws and regulations , either Party shall give sympathetic consideration to applications for obtaining visas and working permits to nationals of the other Party engaging in activities associated with investments made in the territory of that Party .
Translation: 缔约方应根据各自法律法规，对另一方公民为在该缔约方境内进行投资相关活动而提出的签证和工作许可申请予以积极考虑。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Investments of investors of each Party shall all the time be accorded fair and equitable treatment in the territory of the other Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方投资者在另一缔约方领土内的投资应始终获得公平公正待遇。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Party shall accord to investments and activities associated with such investments by the investors of the other Party treatment no less favourable than that which it accords to the investments and associated activities by its own investors .
Translation: 每一方应给予另一方投资者及其投资的相关活动不低于该方给予本国投资者及其投资相关活动的待遇。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Neither Party shall subject investments and activities associated with such investments by investors of the other Party to treatment less favourable than that accorded to the investments and associated activities by the investors of any third State .
Translation: 任何一方不得对其它一方投资者的投资及其相关活动给予比第三国投资者同类投资及活动更不优惠的待遇。

Query_Text_en: c ] Any arrangements for facilitating small scale frontier trade in border areas .
Translation: 有关边境地区小额边境贸易便利化安排的任何事项。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The investor affected shall have the right , under the law of the Party making the expropriation , to prompt review , by a judicial or other independent authority of that Party , of its case , including the valuation of its investment and the payment of compensation , in accordance with the principles set out in this Article .
Translation: 受影响的投资者应根据实施征收的缔约方法律规定，有权向该缔约方的司法或其他独立机构提起对其案件的及时审查，包括对其投资的估值及补偿金额的支付，相关审查应按照本条所述原则进行。

Query_Text_en: Investors of either Party whose investments suffer losses in the territory of the other Party owing to war or other armed conflict , revolution , a state of national emergency or revolt , shall be accorded treatment by such other Party not less favourable than that which the latter Party accords to its own investors or to investors of any third State as regards restitution , indemnification , compensation or other valuable consideration .
Translation: 缔约一方投资者在其对方缔约方领土内因战争、其他武装冲突、革命、国家紧急状态或暴动而遭受投资损失时，该对方缔约方应给予的待遇不得低于其给予本国投资者或任何第三国投资者在恢复原状、赔偿、补偿或其他等价补偿方面的待遇。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] earnings of nationals of the other Party who work in connection with an investment in the territory of the other Party .
Translation: 缔约另一方国民在其境内从事与投资有关工作的所得。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The transfer mentioned above shall be made without delay in a freely convertible currency and at the prevailing market rate of exchange applicable within the Party accepting the investments and on the date of transfer .
Translation: 上述转让应立即以可自由兑换货币办理，并按接受投资一方所在国在转让当日适用的现行市场汇率进行。

Query_Text_en: In the event that the market rate of exchange does not exist , the rate of exchange shall correspond to the cross rate obtained from those rates , which would be applied by the International Monetary Fund on the date of payment for conversions of the currencies concerned into Special Drawing Rights .
Translation: 当市场汇率不存在时，汇率应对应于通过相关汇率计算得出的交叉汇率，该交叉汇率为国际货币基金组织在付款日将采用的、将相关货币转换为特别提款权时所适用的汇率。

Query_Text_en: If one Party or its designated agency makes a payment to its investor under a guarantee given in respect of an investment made in the territory of the other Party , the latter Party shall recognize the assignment of all the rights and claims of the indemnified investor to the former Party or its designated agency , by law or by legal transactions , and the right of the former Party or its designated agency to exercise by virtue of subrogation any such right to same extent as the investor .
Translation: 如果一缔约方或其指定机构依据对投资所提供的担保向其投资者支付了款项，另一缔约方应依法或依法律行为承认该获得补偿的投资者将其所有权利和请求权转让给前者或其指定机构，并认可前者或其指定机构可代位行使上述任何权利，且行使权利的范围与投资者相同。

Query_Text_en: As regards the transfer of payments made by virtue of such assigned claims , Article 6 shall apply mutatis mutandis .
Translation: 关于根据此类让与债权进行的支付转移，第六条经相应调整后适用。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Any dispute between the Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement shall be settled , as far as possible , with consultation through diplomatic channel .
Translation: 缔约双方关于本协议解释或适用所产生的任何争议，应尽可能通过外交渠道协商解决。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If a dispute can not thus be settled within six months , it shall , upon the request of either Party , be submitted to an ad hoc arbitral tribunal .
Translation: 若争端未能在六个月内解决，应任何一方缔约方请求，应提交至特别仲裁庭。

Query_Text_en: Within two months of the receipt of the written notice requesting arbitration , each Party shall appoint one arbitrator .
Translation: 自收到要求仲裁的书面通知之日起两个月内，每一方应指定一名仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: Those two arbitrators shall , within further two months , together select a national of a third State having diplomatic relations with both Parties to be appointed as Chairman of the arbitral tribunal by both Parties .
Translation: 上述两名仲裁员应于此后两个月内共同选定与双方均有外交关系的第三国国民，由双方任命其为仲裁庭主席。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If the arbitral tribunal has not been constituted within four months from the receipt of the written notice requesting arbitration , either Party may , in the absence of any other agreement , invite the President of the International Court of Justice to make any necessary appointments .
Translation: 若仲裁庭自收到书面仲裁请求之日起四个月内未能成立，则在无其他协议的情况下，任何一方均可邀请国际法院院长进行必要的任命。

Query_Text_en: If the President is a national of either Party or is otherwise prevented from discharging the said functions , the Member of the International Court of Justice next in seniority who is not a national of either Party or is not otherwise prevented from discharging the said functions shall be invited to make such necessary appointments .
Translation: 如总统属于任一缔约方的国民，或因其他原因无法履行上述职责，应邀请国际法院法官中资历较深且不属于任一缔约方的国民或未因其他原因无法履行上述职责者作出必要任命。

Query_Text_en: The arbitral tribunal shall reach its award in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement and the applicable principles of international law .
Translation: 仲裁庭应根据本协议的规定和适用的国际法原则作出裁决。

Query_Text_en: Such award shall be final and binding upon both Parties .
Translation: 本裁决应为最终裁决，并对双方均具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: The arbitral tribunal , upon the request of either Party , shall explain the reasons of its award .
Translation: 仲裁庭应任何一方当事人的请求，应当说明其裁决的理由。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Each Party shall bear the costs of its appointed arbitrator and of its representation in arbitral proceedings .
Translation: 每一方应承担其指定的仲裁员费用及其在仲裁程序中的代理费用。

Query_Text_en: The relevant costs of the Chairman and tribunal shall be borne in equal parts by the Parties .
Translation: 仲裁主席和仲裁庭的相关费用应由双方各半承担。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Any dispute concerning investments between a Party and an investor of the other Party should as far as possible be settled amicably between the parties in dispute .
Translation: 缔约一方与另一缔约方投资者之间发生的任何投资争端，应尽可能由争端各方通过友好方式解决。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The decision to submit the dispute to one of the above mentioned procedures shall be final .
Translation: 将争议提交至上述程序之一的决定应为最终决定。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Any award by an ad-hoc tribunal shall be final and binding .
Translation: 临时仲裁庭作出的任何裁决均具有终局性和约束力。

Query_Text_en: Any award under the procedures of the Convention mentioned in 2 .
Translation: 根据本公约第二条所述程序作出的任何裁决。

Query_Text_en: b ] above shall be binding and subject only to those appeals or remedies provided for in this Convention .
Translation: 上述规定应具有约束力，并仅以本公约所规定的上诉或补救措施为限。

Query_Text_en: The awards shall be enforced in accordance with domestic law .
Translation: 裁决应依据国内法律予以执行。

Query_Text_en: 1 . If the legislation of either Parties or obligations under international law existing at present or established hereafter between the Parties in addition to this Agreement contain a regulation , whether general or specific , entitling investments by investors of the other Party to a treatment more favourable than is provided for by this Agreement , such regulation shall to the extent that it is more favourable prevail over this Agreement .
Translation: 如果缔约一方现时存在或今后与缔约另一方之间依据国际法确立的法律或义务中，包含赋予缔约另一方投资者的投资以比本协议更为优惠待遇的条款，无论该条款具有一般性或具体性，则在更为优惠的范围内，此类条款应优先于本协议适用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Party shall observe any other obligation it has entered into with regard to investments in its territory by investors of the other Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方应遵守其与另一方投资者在其境内投资相关的其他已缔结义务。

Query_Text_en: This Agreement shall apply to investment , which are made prior to or after its entry into force by investors of either Party in accordance with the laws and regulations of the other Party in the territory of the latter , but shall not apply to any dispute concerning investments which has arisen before its entry into force .
Translation: 本协定适用于缔约一方投资者根据另一方缔约国的法律和法规在其境内于本协定生效前或生效后所作的投资，但不适用于本协定生效前已产生的与投资相关的任何争议。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of the present Agreement shall apply irrespective of the existence of diplomatic or consular relations between the Parties .
Translation: 本协议条款的适用性不受缔约双方是否建立外交或领事关系的影响。

Query_Text_en: Either Party may propose to the other Party that consultations be held on any matter concerning interpretation , application and implementation of the Agreement .
Translation: 任何一方均可向另一方提议，就本协定的解释、适用及执行等任何事宜举行磋商。

Query_Text_en: The other Party shall accord sympathetic consideration to the proposal and shall afford adequate opportunity for such consultations .
Translation: 另一方应认真考虑该提案，并为就此进行磋商提供充分机会。

Query_Text_en: The attached protocol shall form an integral part of this Agreement .
Translation: 所附议定书构成本协议不可分割的一部分。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The present Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the receipt of the last notification in writing and through diplomatic channels , stating that all the internal procedures of both Parties have been fulfilled .
Translation: 本协议应于双方各自完成国内程序的最后通知通过书面及外交渠道送达后第三十日生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Upon the entry into force of the present Agreement , the Agreement between the Portuguese Republic and the People s Republic of China on the Promotion and Reciprocal Protection of Investments , signed in Lisbon , on February 3rd , 1992 shall be terminated .
Translation: 本协议生效后，于1992年2月3日在里斯本签署的《葡萄牙共和国与中华人民共和国促进和相互保护投资协定》即行终止。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The present Agreement shall remain in force for a period of ten years .
Translation: 本协议有效期为十年。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Unless either Party notifies the other , in writing and through diplomatic channels , of its intention to terminate the present Agreement at least one year before the end of the initial period of ten years , the present Agreement shall remain in force for indeterminate periods of five years .
Translation: 除非任一缔约方在初始十年期结束前至少一年，通过书面形式及外交渠道通知另一方其终止本协议的意向，否则本协议将继续有效，以五年为周期无限期延续。

Query_Text_en: 3 . After the initial period of ten years , either Party may terminate at any time the present Agreement by giving at least one year s written notice to the other Party . The notice shall be sent through diplomatic channels .
Translation: 初始十年期满后，任何一方均可随时通过向另一方发出至少一年的书面通知的方式终止本协议。该通知应通过外交渠道发送。

Query_Text_en: 4 . In respect of investments made prior to the date of termination of present Agreement , the provisions of Articles 1 to 13 shall remain in force for a further period of ten years from the date of termination .
Translation: 对于在本协议终止之日前所作的投资，本协议第一条至第十三条的规定应自终止之日起继续有效十年。

Query_Text_en: Done at Lisbon on Dec , 9th , 2005 in duplicate in the Portuguese , Chinese and English languages , all texts being authentic .
Translation: 本文件于2005年12月9日在里斯本以葡萄牙语、中文和英语三种文字制成正本，各文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: In case of divergent interpretation of texts , the English text shall prevail .
Translation: 如对文本解释存在分歧，以英文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: PROTOCOL TO THE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE PORTUGUESE REPUBLIC AND THE PEOPLE 'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA ON THE ENCOURAGEMENT AND RECIPROCAL PROTECTION OF INVESTMENTS On signing the Agreement between the Portuguese Republic and the People 's Republic of China on the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investments , the plenipotentiaries , being duly authorized , have , in addition , agreed on the following provisions , which shall be regarded as an integral part of the said Agreement :
Translation:
中华人民共和国和葡萄牙共和国关于促进和相互保护投资协定议定书  
在签署中华人民共和国和葡萄牙共和国关于促进和相互保护投资协定时，缔约全权代表经正式授权，就以下规定达成一致，应视为上述协定的不可分割组成部分：

Query_Text_en: Ad Article 1Returns from the investment and from reinvestments shall enjoy the same protection as the investment .
Translation: 第一条 投资及其再投资的收益应享受与投资同等的保护。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] any amendment to any such non-conforming measure to the extent that the amendment does not increase the non-conformity of these measures .
Translation: 对任何此类不符合规定措施的任何修正，只要该修正不会增加这些措施的不符合性。

Query_Text_en: The People 's Republic of China will take all appropriate steps in order to progressively remove the non-conforming measures .
Translation: 中华人民共和国将采取一切适当措施，逐步取消不符合规定的措施。

Query_Text_en: The following shall more particularly , though not exclusively , be deemed `` activity '' within the meaning of Article 3 .
Translation: 以下各项尤其包括但不限于，应视为根据本条第3款规定的"活动"。
