Query_Text_en: The following shall , in particular , though not exclusively , be deemed `` treatment less favourable '' within the meaning of Article 3 unequal treatment in the case of restrictions on the purchase of raw or auxiliary materials , of energy or fuel or of means of production or operation of any kind as well as any other measures having similar effects .
Translation: 根据本条规定，在限制购买原材料或辅助材料、能源或燃料以及各类生产运营所需物资，以及其他具有同等效力的措施情况下，凡构成"较差待遇"的，均应被视为第3条所述的不平等待遇。

Query_Text_en: Measures that have to be taken for reasons of public security and order , public health or morality shall not be deemed `` treatment less favourable '' within the meaning of Article 3 .
Translation: 根据公共安全和秩序、公共卫生或道德需要而采取的措施不得视为本公约第三条所指的“歧视性待遇”。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of Article 3 do not oblige a Party to extend to investors resident in the territory of the other Party tax privileges , tax exemptions and tax reductions which according to its tax laws are granted only to investors resident in its territory .
Translation: 第三条的规定不构成要求一方必须向另一方领土内的投资者提供税收优惠、税收减免和税收豁免。根据其税法，此类优惠仅向本国居民投资者给予。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Article 6 , paragraph 1 . [ c ] will apply provided that the transfer shall comply with the relevant formalities stipulated by the present Chinese laws and regulations relating to exchange control .
Translation: 第六条第一款第（三）项应适用，前提是资金转移需遵守现行中国外汇管理相关法律法规规定的手续要求。

Query_Text_en: 2 . A transfer shall be deemed to have been made `` without delay '' within the meaning of Article 6 . 3 if effected within such period as is normally required for the completion of transfer formalities .
Translation: 根据第6.3条关于"无拖延"的定义，若转让在通常完成转让手续所需期限内完成，则应视为已及时作出。

Query_Text_en: The said period shall commence on the day on which the relevant request has been submitted to the relevant foreign exchange administration with full and authentic documentation and information and may on no account exceed two months .
Translation: 本条款所述期间应自相关申请连同完整且真实的文件及信息提交至相关外汇管理部门之日起开始，且不得超过两个月。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In this respect , the People 's Republic of China shall accord to investors of the Portuguese Republic treatment not less favourable than that accorded to the investors of any third State .
Translation: 在此方面，中华人民共和国应给予葡萄牙共和国投资者的待遇，不低于给予任何第三国投资者的待遇。

Query_Text_en: 4 . These formalities shall not be construed as a means of avoiding the Party 's commitments or obligations under this Agreement .
Translation: 本条款所述程序不得视为规避本协议项下任何一方承诺或义务的手段。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The provisions of Article 6 of this Agreement shall not affect the rights and obligations with respect to exchange restrictions that either Party has or may have as a member to the International Monetary Fund .
Translation: 本协议第6条的规定不影响任何一方作为国际货币基金组织成员目前或可能拥有的与外汇限制措施相关的权利和义务。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Paragraph 1 [ d ] will apply provided that a loan-agreement has been registered with the relevant foreign exchange administration authority .
Translation: 第6条：只要贷款协议已向相关外汇管理部门办理登记手续，第1(d)款即适用。

Query_Text_en: 7 . To the extent that the formalities mentioned above are no longer required according to the relevant provisions of Chinese law , Article 6 shall apply without restrictions .
Translation: 如根据中国法律的相关规定，上述手续不再必要，则第六条无限制地适用。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the investor has referred the issue to an administrative review procedure according to Chinese law , [ b ] the dispute still exists three months after he has brought the issue to the review procedure .
Translation:
[a] 投资者已根据中国法律规定将该问题提交行政复议程序，  
[b] 自其提起行政复议程序之日起满三个月后，该争议仍存在。

Query_Text_en: a. The term `` aeronautical authorities '' means , in the case of Switzerland , the Federal Air Office and , in the case of the People 's Republic of China , the General Administration of Civil Aviation of China , or in either case any person or body authorised to exercise the functions presently assigned to the said authorities .
Translation: a. 本协定中“航空当局”一词，在瑞士指联邦民航局，在中华人民共和国指中国民用航空总局；若上述两国的职能已转由其他机构或个人行使，则分别指经授权行使该等职能的机构或个人。

Query_Text_en: c. The term `` air service '' means any scheduled air service performed by aircraft for the public transport of passengers , cargo and mail .
Translation: “航空服务”一词指通过航空器进行的、为公众提供旅客、货物和邮件运输的定期航空服务。

Query_Text_en: d. The term `` international air service '' means an air service which passes through the air space over the territory of more than one state .
Translation: d. 本法所称“国际航空服务”，是指飞经一个以上国家领土上空的领空的航空服务。

Query_Text_en: e. The term `` airline '' means any air transport enterprise operating an international air service .
Translation: “航空承运人”指从事国际航空运输业务的任何航空运输企业。

Query_Text_en: f. The term `` stop for non-traffic purposes '' means a landing for any purpose other than taking on or discharging passengers , cargo and mail .
Translation: f. ``非运输目的停靠''指除装卸旅客、货物和邮件外，因其他任何目的而进行的停靠。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 1 . Each Contracting Party grants to the other Contracting Party the right to operate scheduled air services [ hereinafter referred to as `` the agreed services '' ] on the routes specified in the Annex I to this Agreement [ hereinafter referred to as `` the specified routes '' ] for carriage of international traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail .
Translation:
第二条  
缔约各方应向另一缔约方授予在本协议附件一所列航线上经营定期航班服务的权利[以下简称“约定服务”]，用于运输国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The designated airline of each Contracting Party while operating the agreed services on the specified routes shall enjoy the right to overfly without landing the territory of the other Contracting Party after approval of its seasonal schedule has been obtained from the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约各方指定的航空公司在指定航线上运营协定服务时，在获得对方缔约方航空主管部门对其季节性航班时刻表的批准后，有权不降停飞越对方缔约方的领空。

Query_Text_en: b. to make stops at the points on the specified routes in the territory of the other Contracting Party for the purpose of putting down and taking on international traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail .
Translation: 在另一缔约方领土内的指定航线上停靠，以便装卸国际旅客、行李、货物和邮件。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall not enjoy the right to carry for remuneration or hire traffic in passengers , baggage , cargo and mail originating from or stopping over at apoint in the territory of the other Contracting Party , destined for another point in the same territory , except the personnel of the said airline as well as their families and baggage .
Translation: 缔约各方指定的空运企业不得享有在另一缔约方领土内某一点起运或经停，前往同一缔约方领土内另一点的旅客、行李、货物和邮件的运输权利，但该航空公司的工作人员及其家属和行李除外。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 1 . Each Contracting Party shall have the right to designate , through diplomatic channels , one airline for the purpose of operating the agreed services on the specified routes provided for in the Annex I to the present Agreement .
Translation:
第三条第一款  
每一缔约方有权通过外交途径指定一家航空公司，以运营本协定附件一所规定的指定航线上商定的服务。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Contracting Party which has received the note of designation shall , subject to the provisions of paragraph 3 and 4 of this Article , grant without delay to the designated airline of the other Contracting Party the necessary operating authorisation .
Translation: 收到指定通知书的缔约方应在本条第三款和第四款规定范围内，立即向另一缔约方指定的航空公司授予必要的运营许可。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Having received the operating authorisation , provided for under paragraph 2 of the present Article , the designated airline of each Contracting Party may begin at any time to operate the agreed services , provided that the other Contracting Party has been notified by the first Contracting Party at least 60 days in advance of the date of inauguration of such services .
Translation: 缔约各方指定的空运企业一旦获得本条第2款规定的运营许可，即可在另一缔约方已收到通知的前提下，随时开始运营协议规定的航空服务。首方须至少提前60天书面通知另一方拟开展服务的具体起始日期。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The substantial ownership and effective control of the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall be vested in the Contracting Party designating the airline or in its citizen [ s ] .
Translation: 指定航空公司的实质性所有权和有效控制权应属于指定该航空公司的缔约方或其公民。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Each Contracting Party shall have the right to revoke an operating authorisation or to suspend the exercise of the rights specified in Art . 2 of the present Agreement by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party or to impose such conditions as it may deem necessary on the exercise by such airline of these rights , in case of failure by that airline to comply with the laws and regulations of the first Contracting Party , or of failure to operate in accordance with the conditions prescribed under the present Agreement and its Annexes .
Translation: 第五条 如缔约一方指定空运企业未能遵守缔约另一方法律法规，或未按照本协定及其附件规定的条件开展运营，该缔约方有权撤销运营许可，或暂停该指定空运企业行使本协定第二条规定的权利，或施加其认为必要的运营条件。

Query_Text_en: However , unless immediate action is essential to prevent further infringements of laws or regulations , under normal circumstances , such right shall be exercised only after consultation with the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 除非采取紧急行动对于防止进一步违反法律法规是必要的，否则在正常情况下，该权利应仅在与另一缔约方协商后方可行使。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 1 . The designated airlines of the two Contracting Parties shall enjoy fair and equal opportunities in the operation of the agreed services on the specified routes .
Translation: 第四条第一款 两国缔约方指定的航空公司应在指定航线上运营约定服务时享有公平和平等的机会。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In operating the agreed services , the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall take into account the interests of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party so as not to affect unduly the services which the latter provides on the whole or part of the specified routes .
Translation: 在运营约定的航班业务时，每一缔约方指定的空运企业应顾及对方指定空运企业的利益，以免不当影响后者在整个或部分指定航线上提供的服务。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The agreed services provided by the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties shall bear close relationship to the require-ments of the public for transportation on the specified routes and shall have as their primary objective the provision of capacity adequate to satisfy the current and reasonably anticipated requirements for the carriage of passengers , baggage , cargo and mail originating from or destined for the territory of the Contracting Party which has designated the airline .
Translation: 协议规定的航空服务应与指定航线上公众的运输需求密切相关，其主要目标是提供充足的运力，以满足从或前往指定该航空公司的缔约方领土的乘客、行李、货物和邮件运输的当前及合理预期需求。

Query_Text_en: the requirements of through airline operations .
Translation: 直航运营的要求。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The terms and conditions in respect of the operation of the agreedservices shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties and shall be subject to the approval of their respective aeronautical authorities .
Translation: 关于协议服务运营的条款和条件，应由双方缔约国指定的航空公司协商确定，并须经各自航空主管部门批准。

Query_Text_en: 5 . In case of disagreement between the designated airlines of the Contracting Parties , the issues referred to in paragraph 4 above shall be resolved between the aeronautical authorities of the two Contracting Parties .
Translation: 如双方指定航空公司之间发生分歧，本条第四款所指相关事宜应由两国航空当局协商解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 1 . Each Contracting Party shall designate in its territory airport [ s ] and alternate airport [ s ] to be used by thedesignated airline of the other Contracting Party for the operation of the specified routes and provide the latter with communications , navigational , meteorological and other auxiliary services in its territory as are required for the operation of the agreed services .
Translation: 缔约各方应在各自领土内为另一缔约方指定空运企业执行指定航线运营，指定机场及备降机场，并在其领土内为其提供执行约定服务所需的通信、导航、气象及其他辅助服务。

Query_Text_en: Detailed arrangements for the above shall be provided for in Annex II to the present Agreement .
Translation: 上述内容的具体安排应载于本协议的附件二。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall be charged for the use of airports , equipment and technical services of the other Contracting Party at rates not higher than those paid by airlines of other States .
Translation: 每一缔约方指定的航空公司使用另一缔约方的机场、设备及技术服务时，应按照不高于其他国家航空公司所支付费率的标准收费。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 1 . Aircraft operated on the specified routes by the designatedairline of either Contracting Party , as well as their regularequipment , spare parts , fuel , oil , lubricants and aircraft stores , including food , beverages and tobacco , retained on board the aircraft shall be exempt , on a basis of reciprocity , from any customs duties , inspection fees and other charges by the other Contracting Party on arrival in and on departure from the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
第六条第一款  
缔约任何一方指定的空运企业在指定航线上运营的航空器及其存放在飞机上的常规设备、备件、燃料、油脂、润滑油及机上用品，包括食品、饮料和烟草，应根据互惠原则，在进出另一缔约方领土时，免受另一缔约方征收的关税、检验费及其他费用。

Query_Text_en: c. fuel and lubricants destined to supply aircraft operated oninternational air services by the designated airline of the other Contracting Party , even when these supplies are to be used on the part of the journey performed over the territory of the Contracting Party in which they are taken on board .
Translation: 用于供应另一缔约方指定的航空公司运营的国际航空服务所使用航空器的燃料和润滑油，即使这些物资将在其装载方领土领空内航段中使用。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The regular airborne equipment , as well as the materials and supplies retained on board the aircraft of the designated airline of either Contracting Party may be unloaded in the territory of the other Contracting Party only with the approval of the customs authorities of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 缔约任何一方指定航空公司的航空器上所载的常规机载设备，以及机上保留的物料和供应品，只有在另一缔约方海关当局批准后，方可在该缔约方领土内卸载。

Query_Text_en: In such case they may be placed under the supervision of said authorities , subject to any storage charges , up to such time as they are re-exported or otherwise disposed of in accordance with the regulations of such authorities .
Translation: 在此情况下，相关物品可置于上述机构监管之下，需承担仓储费用，直至其重新出口或根据相关机构的规定以其他方式处置为止。

Query_Text_en: Article 7The laws and regulations of each Contracting Party relating to the admission to , stay in , departure from and navigation in its territory of aircraft engaged in the operation of international air services as well as the laws and regulations relating to the admission to , stay in and departure from its territory of passengers , crew , baggage , cargo and mail shall be applicable to the aircraft of the airline designated by the other Contracting Party , its crew and passengers , baggage , cargo and mail carried by such aircraft , while in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
第七条  
各缔约国关于国际航空运输运营中航空器进入、停留、离开及其在领土内航行的相关法律和法规，以及关于旅客、机组人员、行李、货物和邮件进入、停留、离开其领土的相关法律和法规，均适用于另一缔约国指定航空公司运营的航空器及其机组人员、旅客、所载行李、货物和邮件，在该航空器处于首先提及的缔约国领土内时，上述法律和法规应予适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 8Passengers , baggage and cargo in transit across the territory of each Contracting Party and not leaving the area of the airport reserved for such purpose shall only be subject to a very simplified control .
Translation: 第八条 在各缔约方领土内过境且不离开机场内为此目的划定区域的旅客、行李及货物，仅接受极为简化的监管。

Query_Text_en: Article 9The revenue earned by the designated airline of each Contracting Party in the territory of the other Contracting Party shall be exempt from income tax in the territory of the other Contracting Party and such revenue shall be permitted to be transferred at the official rate of exchange .
Translation: 第九条缔约一方指定的航空公司在另一缔约方领土内所获收入，应在该另一缔约方领土内免征所得税，且该收入应准予按照官方汇率进行转移。

Query_Text_en: Article l0 1 . The tariffs to be charged on the agreed services shall be established at reasonable levels , due regard being paid to all relevant factors , including cost of operation , reasonable profit , characteristics of services as well as the tariffs of other airlines operating scheduled air services on the whole or any sector of the same or equivalent routes .
Translation: 第十条第一款 规定服务项目的收费水平应设定在合理范围内，需综合考量各项相关因素，包括运营成本、合理利润、服务特性以及在同一航线或同等航线全部或部分航段经营定期航班服务的其他航空公司的收费标准。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The tariffs on the agreed services shall be agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , and shall be submitted for approval to the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties at least thirty days before the proposed date of their introduction .
Translation: 双方指定航空公司应就约定服务的收费标准达成一致，并须在拟议实施该收费标准日期至少三十日前将相关方案提交缔约双方航空主管部门审批。

Query_Text_en: In special cases , this time limit may be reduced , subject to the agreement of the said authorities .
Translation: 在特殊情况下，本期限可缩短，但须经相关主管部门同意。

Query_Text_en: If the designated airlines can not agree on any of these tariffs , or if the aeronautical authorities of one Contracting Party is not satisfied with any tariff agreed upon between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall try to agree upon an appropriate tariff between themselves .
Translation: 如果指定航空公司无法就上述任何一项运价达成一致，或任一缔约方航空当局对双方指定航空公司商定的任何运价不满意，则双方航空当局应自行尽力达成适当的运价。

Query_Text_en: 3 . A tariff established in accordance with the provisions of this Article shall remain in force until a new tariff has been established .
Translation: 根据本条规定设立的关税税率应继续有效，直至新的关税税率得以确立。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 1 . The designated airline of each Contracting Party shall have the right on a basis of reciprocity to maintain representation [ s ] at the point [ s ] of call on the specified routes in the territory of the other Contracting Party . These representation [ s ] may include commercial , operational and technical staff .
Translation: 缔约各方指定的空运企业应在对等基础上享有权利，在另一缔约方领土内指定航线的停靠点设立代表机构。这些代表机构可包括商务、运营和技术人员。

Query_Text_en: The number of staff shall be agreed upon through consultation between the designated airlines of both Contracting Parties , and shall be subject to the approval of the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation: 机组人员数量应由双方缔约方指定的航空公司通过协商确定，并须经双方缔约方航空当局批准。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Unless agreed upon otherwise , the staff of such representation [ s ] shall be citizens of either Switzerland or the People 's Republic of China .
Translation: 除非另有约定，此类代表处的工作人员应为瑞士或中华人民共和国公民。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The staff of the representation [ s ] must observe the laws and regulations of the country where such representation [ s ] are located .
Translation: 代表处的工作人员必须遵守所在国的法律法规。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Each Contracting Party shall extend assistance and convenience to the representation [ s ] and their staff of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方应向另一缔约方指定航空公司的代表机构及其工作人员提供协助和便利。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Each Contracting Party shall endeavor to safeguard , to the extent possible , the security of airline operations of the other Contracting Party within its territory .
Translation: 每一缔约方应在可能范围内尽力保障在其领土内运营的另一缔约方航空活动的安全。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 1 . The aircraft of the designated airline of each Contracting Party operating on the specified routes shall bear its nationality and registration marks .
Translation: 第十二条第一款 每一缔约方指定航空公司在指定航线上运营的航空器应当标明其国籍标志和登记标志。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Certificates of airworthiness , certificates of competency and licences issued or rendered valid by each of the Contracting Parties shall , during the period of their validity , be recognized as valid by the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 各缔约方颁发或确认有效的适航证书、资格证书及执照，在其有效期内应由另一缔约方予以承认。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Contracting Party reserves its right , however , not to recognize as valid , for the purpose of flights over its own territory , certificates of competency and licences granted to its own citizens or rendered valid for them by the other Contracting Party or by any other State .
Translation: 各缔约方保留权利，不承认另一缔约方或任何其他国家为本国公民颁发或认可的合格证书和执照在其领空飞行的有效性。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The aircraft of the designated airline of each Contracting Party operating on the specified routes shall carry on board the documents as enumerated in the Annex II to the present Agreement .
Translation: 各缔约方指定的航空公司在指定航线上运营时，其航班应携带本协议附件二所列文件。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The requirements and procedures of operation and safety of flights , as well as the questions of assistance to aircraft in distress or aircraft having met an accident shall be carried out in accordance with Annex II to the present Agreement .
Translation: 飞行运行和安全的要求及程序，以及对遇险或发生事故的航空器提供协助的相关事宜，应按照本协议附件二的规定执行。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The crew members of the designated airline of each Contracting Party flying on the specified routes shall be citizens of such Contracting Party .
Translation: 各缔约方指定航空公司在指定航线上飞行的机组成员应当是该缔约方的公民。

Query_Text_en: In case the designated airline of one Contracting Party deems it desirable to utilize crew members of other nationalities for the operation of its aircraft on the specified routes , approval shall be obtained from the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 如某一缔约方指定的航空公司认为有必要在其指定航线上运营航空器时使用其他国籍的机组人员，须经另一缔约方批准。

Query_Text_en: Article 13Both Contracting Parties shall ensure the correct implementation of this Agreement in a spirit of close cooperation and mutual support . If any difference of opinion arises in respect of the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement , the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties shall settle it through consultation . If agreement still can not be reached , the Contracting Parties shall settle it through diplomatic channels .
Translation:
第十三条  
缔约双方应本着密切合作和相互支持的精神，确保本协定得到正确实施。如对本协定的解释或实施产生分歧，缔约双方的航空当局应通过协商予以解决。若仍不能达成一致，缔约双方应通过外交途径解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 14The aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties shall supply to each other , on request , periodic statistics or other similar information relating to the amount of traffic carried on the agreed services .
Translation: 第十四条 缔约各方的航空当局应当应对方要求，相互提供关于在协议规定的航空服务中运输的客货量的定期统计资料或其他相关信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 1 . If either of the Contracting Parties or its aeronautical authorities consider it desirable to modify or amend any provision of this Agreement , they may at any time request consultation with the other Contracting Party or with its aeronautical authorities and such consultation shall begin within a period of sixty days from the date of the request .
Translation:
第十五条  
任一缔约方或其航空当局如认为有必要对本协定的任何条款进行修改或修正，可随时要求与另一缔约方或其航空当局进行磋商，此类磋商应自请求之日起六十天内开始。

Query_Text_en: Any modification of the present Agreement shall enter into force when the two Contracting Parties have notified each other the fulfilment of their necessary legal formalities relating to the conclusion and the entering into force of international agreements .
Translation: 本协议的任何修改，应在缔约双方就关于国际协议缔结和生效的必要法律程序完成情况相互通知后生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Modifications to the Annexes of the present Agreement may be agreed directly between the aeronautical authorities of the Contracting Parties .
Translation: 本协议附件的修改可由缔约方航空当局直接商定。

Query_Text_en: They shall enter into force after having been confirmed by notifications to each other by the said aeronautical authorities .
Translation: 本条款应在双方航空当局相互通知确认后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 16Either Contracting Party may at any time give notice to the other Contracting Party of its desire to terminate the present Agreement .
Translation: 第十六条 任一缔约方均可随时通知另一方缔约方其终止本协定的意愿。

Query_Text_en: The present Agreement shall terminate twelve months after the date of notification by the first Contracting Party .
Translation: 本协议应自首先发出通知的缔约方发出通知之日起十二个月后终止。

Query_Text_en: If the first Contracting Party wishes to withdraw the above notice before the expiry of this period , this Agreement shall continue to be in force with the concurrence of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 若缔约一方拟在上述期限届满前撤回上述通知，则经另一缔约方同意后，本协议应继续有效。

Query_Text_en: Article 17The present Agreement shall be applied provisionally from the date of its signature ; it shall enter into force when the Contracting Parties will have notified each other the fulfilment of their necessary legal formalities with regard to the conclusion and the entering into force of international agreements .
Translation: 第十七条 本协议应自签署之日起暂行实施；本协议应于缔约双方就缔结和生效国际协议完成各自必要法律程序并相互通知之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Done at Berne in duplicate this 12 November 1973 in the French , Chinese and English languages , each of the three texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 本协定于1973年11月12日在伯尔尼签署，一式两份，分别以法语、中文和英语写成，三种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: In case of disagreement in interpretation the English text shall prevail .
Translation: 如对解释存在分歧，以英文文本为准。

Query_Text_en: For the Government of the People 's Republic of China : Annex I1 . Routes on which air services may be operated by the designated airline of Switzerland : Points in Switzerland - Vienna or Belgrade or Athens or Istanbul - Beirut or Cairo or Teheran or Kuweit - Kandahar or Karachi or Rawalpindi - Bombay or Delhi - Rangoon - Shanghai and\/or Peking - Tokyo - two points beyond to be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties , in both directions . 2 . Routes on which air services mast be operated by the designated airline of the People 's Republic of China : Points in China - Karachi or Kandahar or Teheran - Baghdad or Damascus or Beirut - Ankara or Cairo - Athens or Tirana or Bucharest - Rome or Belgrade or Vienna - Zurich and\/or Geneva - Paris - two points beyond to be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties , in both directions .
Translation: 对于中华人民共和国政府：附件一。  瑞士指定的航空公司可运营的航线：瑞士境内的航点——维也纳或贝尔格莱德或雅典或伊斯坦布尔——贝鲁特或开罗或德黑兰或科威特——坎大哈或卡拉奇或拉瓦尔品第——孟买或新德里——仰光——上海和/或北京——东京——通往两个更远航点的航线应由双方缔约国的航空当局协商确定，双向运行。  中华人民共和国指定的航空公司必须运营的航线：中国境内的航点——卡拉奇或坎大哈或德黑兰——巴格达或大马士革或贝鲁特——安卡拉或开罗——雅典或地拉那或布加勒斯特——罗马或贝尔格莱德或维也纳——苏黎世和/或日内瓦——巴黎——通往两个更远航点的航线应由双方缔约国的航空当局协商确定，双向运行。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The designated airline of each Contracting Party may , at its option , omit on the specified routes any or all of the intermediate points as well as of the points beyond the territory of the other Contracting Party , on any or all flights .
Translation: 各缔约方指定的航空公司可自行决定，在任何或所有航班的指定航线上，不经过其中部分或全部中途点以及另一缔约方领土以外的地点。

Query_Text_en: In such case the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party shall be notified to this effect as early in advance as practicable .
Translation: 在这种情况下，应尽早通知另一缔约方的航空当局。

Query_Text_en: 4 . In case the designated airline of one Contracting Party desires to operate special and charter flights to or from the territory of the other Contracting Party , the aeronautical authorities of the first Contracting Party shall submit a request to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party which shall give favorable consideration to the request and be responsible for attending to the clearance formalities as well as for giving reply to the former .
Translation: 缔约一方指定的航空公司如希望经营至缔约另一方领土的特殊和包机航班，该缔约方航空当局应向另一方航空当局提交申请，后者应予以优先考虑，并负责办理相关手续及答复前者。

Query_Text_en: 5 . In case the designated airline of one Contracting Party desires to operate additional flights on the specified routes , it shall , under normal circumstances , give notice to the aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party at least forty-eight hours prior to the departure of the aircraft in question , and the flight shall be operated only after approval has been obtained .
Translation: 缔约一方指定的空运企业如需在指定航线上增加航班，应至少在有关航班起飞前四十八小时通知缔约另一方的航空当局，经批准后方可运营。

Query_Text_en: Annex III . General provisionThe aeronautical authorities of either Contracting Party shall provide the aircraft of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party with communications , navigation and other services required for the operation ofthe agreed services in the territory of the first Contracting Party .
Translation:
附件三 一般规定  
双方缔约国的航空当局应为对方指定航空公司的飞机提供在本国领土内运营约定服务所需的通信、导航及其他服务。

Query_Text_en: 8 ] general declaration .
Translation: 八、总体宣言。

Query_Text_en: Each Contracting Party shall recognize the valid documents mentioned above of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 每一缔约方均应承认另一缔约方提交的上述有效文件。

Query_Text_en: 4 ] rules of the air .
Translation: 4. 航空规则。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Alterations or additions to the above-mentioned information , if any , shall be sent in time to the designated airline of the other Contracting Party in the form of NOTAM .
Translation: 如有对上述信息的任何更改或补充，应及时以航行通告形式发送至另一缔约方指定的航空公司。

Query_Text_en: Urgent NOTAMs shall be transmitted in a proper way , and where necessary , directly by radio to the aircraft concerned of the designated airline of the other Contracting Party and later on confirmed in writing .
Translation: 紧急航行通告应以适当方式传送，必要时需直接通过无线电向另一缔约方指定航空公司的相关航空器发送，并随后以书面形式确认。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Aeronautical information and NOTAMs shall be made available in English language .
Translation: 3. 航空情报和航行通告应以英文提供。

Query_Text_en: NOTAM code of international usage shall be used in the transmission of NOTAMs .
Translation: 航行通告的国际通用代码应在航行通告电报传输中使用。

Query_Text_en: 3 ] weather forecast and weather report of alternate [ s ] .
Translation: 交替的天气预报和天气报告。

Query_Text_en: The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party shall communicate to the aircraft SIGMET information , if any , occuring during its flight in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 另一缔约方的航空当局应当向航空器提供其在该缔约方领土内飞行期间发生的任何SIGMET信息。

Query_Text_en: 3 ] weather forecast and weather report of destination , important intermediate aerodromes and alternate [ s ] .
Translation: 3]目的地、重要经停机场及备降机场的天气预报和天气报告。

Query_Text_en: The aeronautical authorities of the other Contracting Party shall communicate to the aircraft SIGMET information , if any , occurring during its flight in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 另一缔约方的航空当局应向航空器通报在其飞越该缔约方领土期间发生的任何SIGMET情报（如有）。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Plain language in English or meteorological code of international usage shall be used by the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties in the preparation of the meteorological information .
Translation: 缔约双方的航空当局在编制气象信息时，应使用明语或国际通用的气象电码。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Prior to the departure of each flight the meteorological office at the aerodrome of departure shall provide meteorological briefing and a flight forecast folder to the pilot-in-command or his representative .
Translation: 在每次航班起飞前，出发机场的气象办公室应向机长或其代表提供气象简报和飞行预报文件夹。

Query_Text_en: V. Air Traffic Control1 . The crew members of the aircraft of the designated airline of each Contracting Party flying the specified routes shall be fully conversant and strictly compliant with the air traffic control procedures of the other Contracting Party .
Translation:
五、空中交通管制  
1. 每一缔约方指定航空公司执行指定航线的航空器的机组成员，应完全熟悉并严格遵守另一缔约方的空中交通管制程序。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Prior to departure the pilot-in-command or his representative shall file a flight plan to be approved by the air traffic control service of the aerodrome of departure , and the flight should proceed according to the approved flight plan .
Translation: 起飞前，机长或其代表应当向起飞机场的空中交通管制部门提交飞行计划并获得批准，飞行应按照批准的飞行计划执行。

Query_Text_en: in emergency where immediate deviation from the flight plan is required and there is not enough time for obtaining clearance from the air traffic control service concerned , the pilot-in-command shall have the right to deviate from the flight plan and concurrently notify the air traffic control service concerned of such deviation .
Translation: 在紧急情况下，若需立即偏离飞行计划且无法及时获得相关空中交通管制部门许可时，机长有权实施偏离操作，并应同时将该偏离情况通报相关空中交通管制部门。

Query_Text_en: The air traffic control service concerned shall do its best to cooperate with the pilot-in-command who , however , shall be responsible for any consequence arising therefrom .
Translation: 有关空中交通管制服务应尽力配合机长，但机长应对因此产生的任何后果负责。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Prior to each flight , the air traffic control service of the aeronautical authorities of each Contracting Party , shall , with the information available , brief the pilot-in-command of the aircraft or his representative concerning latest NOTAMs on the aerodrome of departure , aerodrome of first destination and alternate [ s ] along the specified routes , including radio communications and navigation facilities and others as may be required for the safe conduct of the flight .
Translation: 每次飞行前，各缔约国航空当局的空中交通管制服务部门应向机长或其代表提供简报，内容涉及指定航路上起飞机场、第一个目的地机场和备降机场的最新航行通告，包括无线电通信和导航设施以及其他为确保飞行安全所需的信息。

Query_Text_en: VI . Radio Communications and Navigational Services1 . The arrangements and procedures of the transmission of messages between the two countries for the purpose of operating the specified routes shall be agreed upon between the aeronautical authorities of both Contracting Parties .
Translation:
第六节 无线电通信与导航服务  
1. 为运营指定航线，两国间信息传递的安排与程序应由缔约双方的航空主管当局商定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Aircraft used in the operation of the specified routes by the designated airline of each Contracting Party shall be provided to the greatest possible extent with equipment fit for operation on the radio communications and navigation facilities provided in the territory of the other Contracting Party .
Translation: 各方指定航空公司运营指定航线所使用的航空器，应尽可能最大程度地配备适合在另一缔约方领土内提供的无线电通信和导航设施上运行的设备。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Pilot-in-command shall maintain a continuous two-way communication on the specified frequency with the designated air traffic control service .
Translation: 机长应当在指定频率上与指定的空中交通管制服务保持持续双向通信。

Query_Text_en: 5 . English language and aeronautical Q code of international usage shall be used by both Contracting Parties in the air-ground and point-to-point radio communications .
Translation: 缔约国双方应在空地无线电通信和点对点无线电通信中使用国际通用的英语语言及航空Q代码。

Query_Text_en: 8 ] communicate in writing to the first Contracting Party the results of the investigation .
Translation: 8 ] 书面通知第一缔约方调查结果。

Query_Text_en: `` Fund '' shall mean the African Development Fund established by this Agreement .
Translation: “基金”指根据本协议设立的非洲发展基金。

Query_Text_en: `` Bank '' shall mean the African Development Bank .
Translation: “银行”系指非洲开发银行。

Query_Text_en: `` Member '' shall mean a member of the Bank .
Translation: “会员”指本行的成员。

Query_Text_en: `` Participant '' shall mean the Bank and any State which shall become a party to this Agreement .
Translation: “参与者”指银行及成为本协议缔约方的任何国家。

Query_Text_en: `` State participant '' shall mean a participant other than the Bank .
Translation: “国家参与者”指除银行以外的参与者。

Query_Text_en: `` Original participant '' shall mean the Bank and each State participant which becomes a participant pursuant to article 57 [ 1 ] .
Translation: “原有参与方”指银行以及根据第五十七条成为参与方的每个成员国。

Query_Text_en: `` Subscription '' shall mean amounts subscribed by participants pursuant to articles 5 , 6 or 7 .
Translation: “认购”指根据第五条、第六条或第七条参与者认购的金额。

Query_Text_en: `` Unit of account '' shall mean a unit of account having a value of 0 . 81851265 gramme of fine gold .
Translation: 记账单位指价值相当于0.81851265克纯金的单位。

Query_Text_en: `` Freely convertible currency '' shall mean currency of a participant which the Fund determines , after consultation with the International Monetary Fund , is adequately convertible into other currencies for the purpose of the Fund 's operations .
Translation: “自由兑换货币”指基金在与国际货币基金组织协商后确定的、能够充分满足基金运作目的的、由参与者所持有的可兑换为其他货币的货币。

Query_Text_en: `` President '' , `` Board of Governors '' and `` Board of Directors '' shall mean respectively the President , Board of Governors and Board of Directors of the Fund and in the case of the governors and directors shall include alternate governors and alternate directors when acting as governors and directors respectively .
Translation: “总统”、“理事会”和“董事局”应分别指基金的总统、理事会和董事局，其中各理事和董事包括在担任理事和董事职务时的替代理事和替代董事。

Query_Text_en: `` Regional '' shall mean located in the continent of Africa or the African islands .
Translation: “地区”指位于非洲大陆或非洲岛屿的区域。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Reference to chapters , articles , paragraphs and schedules shall mean the chapters , articles and paragraphs of , or schedules to , this Agreement .
Translation: 本协议中提及的章节、条款、段落和附表应指本协议的章节、条款和段落，或所附的附表。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The headings of the chapters and articles are inserted for convenience of reference only and are not part of this Agreement .
Translation: 本协议各章及条款的标题仅为方便查阅而设，并非本协议的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 . PurposeThe purpose of the Fund shall be to assist the Bank in making an increasingly effective contribution to the economic and social development of the Bank 's members and to the promotion of co-operation [ including regional and sub-regional co-operation ] and increased international trade , particularly among such members .
Translation:
第二条 目的  
本基金的宗旨是协助本行更加有效地为成员国的经济社会发展作出贡献，并促进合作（包括区域和次区域合作）以及增加国际贸易，特别是成员国之间的贸易。

Query_Text_en: It shall provide finance on concessional terms for purposes which are of primary importance for and serve such development .
Translation: 它应为对发展至关重要并服务于此类发展的用途提供优惠融资。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 . Participation1 . The participants in the Fund shall be the Bank and those States which shall have become parties to this Agreement in accordance with its terms .
Translation:
第三条 参与  
一、基金的参与方应包括银行以及已按照本协定条款成为本协定缔约方的国家。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The original State participants shall be those States listed in schedule A which shall have become parties to this Agreement pursuant to article 57 [ 1 ] .
Translation: 初始缔约国应为根据第五十七条成为本协定缔约方，并列于附件A中的国家。

Query_Text_en: 3 . A State which is not an original participant may become a participant and a party to this Agreement upon such terms , not inconsistent with this Agreement , as the Board of Governors shall determine by a unanimous resolution adopted by the affirmative vote of the total voting power of the participants .
Translation: 非初始参与方的国家可通过理事会以全体参与方投票权赞成票通过的一致决议所确定的条款（且不与本协议相抵触）成为本协议的参与方及缔约方。

Query_Text_en: Such participation shall be open only to those States which are members of the United Nations or any of its specialized agencies or are parties to the Statute of the International Court of Justice .
Translation: 此类参与仅限于满足以下条件之一的国家：系联合国成员国、联合国下属任何专门机构的成员国，或是国际法院规约的当事国。

Query_Text_en: 4 . A State may authorize an entity or agency acting on its behalf to sign this Agreement and to represent it in all matters relating to this Agreement with the exception of the matters referred to in article 55 .
Translation: 4. 一国可授权代表其行事的实体或机构签署本协议，并在与本协议有关的一切事宜中代表该国，但本协定第55条所指事项除外。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] Other resources received by the Fund ; and [ iv ] Funds derived from operations or otherwise accruing to the Fund .
Translation:
[iii] 基金所接收的其他资源；以及  
[iv] 来源于运营活动或其他方式应归属于基金的资金。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 . Subscriptions by the BankThe Bank shall pay to the Fund as its initial subscription the amount , expressed in units of account , set forth opposite its name in schedule A , utilizing for that purpose the funds standing to the credit of the `` African Development Fund '' of the Bank .
Translation:
第五条 银行的认购  
银行应向该基金缴付其初始认购额，该金额以记账单位表示，载于附表A中该银行名称对面所列明的数额，并为此目的使用该行"非洲开发基金"项下相应的资金。

Query_Text_en: Payment shall be made on the same terms and conditions as are specified in article 6 [ 2 ] for the payment of the initial subscriptions of State participants .
Translation: 支付应按照第六条第二款所规定的国家参与者初始认购支付的条款和条件进行。

Query_Text_en: The Bank will thereafter subscribe such other amounts as the Board of Governors of the Bank may determine , on such terms and conditions as shall be agreed with the Fund .
Translation: 此后，该行将认购由其理事会决定的其他金额，具体条款和条件将与基金协商确定。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 .
Translation: 第六条

Query_Text_en: Initial Subscriptions of State Participants1 .
Translation: 国家参与者的初始认购

Query_Text_en: The initial subscription assigned to each original State participant shall be in the amount set forth opposite its name in schedule A , and shall be expressed in units of account and payable in freely convertible currency .
Translation: 各原始成员国的初始认缴额应为附表A中其名称旁列明的金额，并以记账单位表示，且须以自由兑换货币支付。

Query_Text_en: Payment shall be made in three equal annual instalments as follows :
Translation: 付款应分三年三期等额支付，如下所示：

Query_Text_en: the first such instalment shall be paid within thirty days after the Fund shall begin operations pursuant to article 60 or on the date on which the original State participant becomes a party to this Agreement , whichever is later ;
Translation: 首期款项应于基金根据第六十条启动运营之后的三十日内支付，或在原有国家参与方成为本协议缔约方之日后支付，以较晚发生者为准；

Query_Text_en: the second instalment within one year thereafter and the third instalment within one year after the payment or the due date of the second instalment , whichever is earlier .
Translation: 第二期款项应在之后一年内支付，第三期款项应于第二期款项支付日或到期日中的较早者起一年内支付。

Query_Text_en: The Fund may request earlier payment of either or both of the second and third instalments if the operations of the Fund shall require it , but such earlier payment shall be entirely voluntary on the part of each participant .
Translation: 基金如因运作需要，可要求各参与方提前偿付第二期和/或第三期款项，但此类提前偿付应完全由各参与方自愿决定。
3. 全球经济复苏进程中的结构性失衡问题日益凸显，主要经济体货币政策分化加剧了国际资本流动的波动性，对新兴市场国家的金融稳定构成严峻挑战。在此背景下，加强国际宏观经济政策协调，推动构建开放型世界经济，成为维护全球金融体系稳健运行的关键举措。

Query_Text_en: The initial subscriptions of State participants other than original participants shall also be expressed in units of account and payable in freely convertible currency .
Translation: 除原有参与者以外的其他成员国参与者的初始认缴额应以记账单位表示并以自由兑换货币支付。

Query_Text_en: The amount and terms of payment of such subscriptions shall be determined by the Fund pursuant to article 3 [ 3 ] .
Translation: 此类认缴款的金额和支付条件应由该基金根据第三条规定确定。

Query_Text_en: Except as the Fund may otherwise agree , each State participant shall maintain the free convertibility of its currency paid in by it pursuant to this article .
Translation: 除非基金组织另有约定，否则每个成员国应确保其根据本条缴纳的货币具有自由兑换性。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the foregoing provisions of this article , a State participant may defer for a period of not more than three months the making of any payment required by this article when budgetary or other circumstances necessitate such delay .
Translation: 尽管有本条上述规定，缔约国得在预算或其他特殊情况需要延迟时，将本条所要求的任何付款义务的履行推迟不超过三个月。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 .
Translation: 第七条。

Query_Text_en: Additional Subscriptions by State Participants1 .
Translation: 国家参与者的额外认购1.

Query_Text_en: The Fund shall at such time as it deems appropriate in the light of the schedule of payments of the initial subscriptions of original participants and of its own operations , and at appropriate intervals thereafter , review the adequacy of its resources and , if it deems it desirable , may authorize a general increase in the subscriptions of State participants on such terms and conditions as the Fund shall determine .
Translation: 基金应在适当考虑原始参与者初始认购款项的支付时间表及其自身运营情况后，认为适当时，对自身资源充足性进行审查，并可在此后适当间隔期再次进行审查；如基金认为必要，可授权提高成员国的认购额，具体条件由基金确定。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the foregoing , the Fund may authorize general or individual increases in such subscriptions at any time , provided that an individual increase shall be considered only at the request of the State participant involved .
Translation: 尽管有上述规定，基金组织仍可随时授权普遍提高或个别提高成员国的认缴额，但个别提高仅在相关成员国提出请求时予以考虑。

Query_Text_en: When any additional individual subscription is authorized pursuant to paragraph 1 , each State participant shall be given an opportunity to subscribe , under no less favourable conditions , reasonably determined by the Fund , than those prescribed under paragraph 1 , an amount which will enable it to maintain its relative voting power as among State participants .
Translation: 当根据第1款授权进行任何额外单独认缴时，每个成员国均应获得机会在基金合理确定的不逊于第1款规定的条件下认购相应金额，以保持其在成员国中的相对投票权比例。

Query_Text_en: No State participant shall be obliged to subscribe additional amounts in the case of general or individual increases in subscriptions .
Translation: 在认购普遍增加或个别增加的情况下，任何成员国均无义务认购额外出资额。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 .
Translation: 第八条。

Query_Text_en: Other Resources1 .
Translation: 其他资源1.

Query_Text_en: Subject to the following provisions of this article , the Fund may enter into arrangements to receive other resources , including grants and loans , from members , participants , States which are not participants and from any public or private entity or entities .
Translation: 根据本条以下规定，基金可安排接受其他资源，包括来自成员、参与者、非参与者国家以及任何公共或私人实体的赠款和贷款。

Query_Text_en: Such arrangements shall be on terms and conditions which are consistent with the Fund 's purposes , operations and policies and which will not impose an undue administrative or financial burden on the Fund or the Bank .
Translation: 此类安排的相关条款和条件应符合基金组织的目的、业务及政策，且不得给基金组织或世界银行造成不适当的行政或财务负担。

Query_Text_en: Such arrangements , other than those for grants for technical assistance , shall be on terms which will permit the Fund to comply with the requirements of article 15 [ 4 ] and [ 5 ] .
Translation: 除技术援助赠款外，此类安排应以确保基金组织能够遵守《基金协定》第十五条第四款和第五款规定的方式进行。

Query_Text_en: Such arrangements shall be approved by the Board of Directors , in the case of arrangements with a State which is not a member or a participant or with an agency of such State , by an eighty-five per cent majority of the total voting power of the participants .
Translation: 此类安排应由董事会批准。若涉及与非成员国或非参与方所在国或该国机构的安排，则需获得参与方总投票权85%的多数同意。

Query_Text_en: The Fund shall not accept any loan [ except temporary accommodations required for its operations ] which is not on concessional terms and shall not borrow in any market or , as a borrower , guarantor , or otherwise , participate in the issue of securities in any market and shall not issue negotiable or transferable obligations evidencing indebtedness for loans received pursuant to paragraph 1 .
Translation: 基金不得接受任何非优惠条件的贷款[除为运营所需临时资金外]，不得在任何市场举债，或作为借款人、担保人或以其他身份参与任何市场的证券发行，亦不得发行任何证明因根据第1段所获贷款而产生债务的可转让债务凭证。

Query_Text_en: Payment of SubscriptionsThe Fund shall accept any part of a participant 's subscription payable by the participant under articles 5 , 6 or 7 or under article 13 and not needed by the Fund in its operations , in the form of notes , letters of credit or similar obligations issued by the participant or the depository , if any , designated by the participant pursuant to article 33 .
Translation: 基金应接受参与者根据第五条、第六条、第七条或第十三条应支付的认缴款中基金在运营中不需要的部分，可由参与者或其根据第三十三条指定的保管人（如有）以票据、信用证或其他类似义务形式发行。

Query_Text_en: Such notes or other obligations shall be non-negotiable , non-interest-bearing and payable at their par value on demand to the account of the Fund in the designated depository or , if there is none , as the Fund shall direct .
Translation: 此类票据或其他债务凭证应为不可转让、无息，并应按面值随时支付至基金在指定托管机构的账户；若无指定托管机构，则按基金指示支付。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the issuance or acceptance of any such note , letter of credit or other obligation , the obligation of the participant under articles 5 , 6 and 7 and article 13 shall continue to subsist .
Translation: 即使签发或接受任何此类汇票、信用证或其他债务工具，参与者在第五、六、七条及第十三条项下的义务仍将继续有效。

Query_Text_en: Amounts held by the Fund in respect of subscriptions of participants which do not avail themselves of the provisions of this article may be deposited or invested by the Fund to produce income to help defray its administrative and other expenses .
Translation: 基金持有的未利用本条规定的参与者缴纳的款项，可由基金进行存款或投资以产生收入，帮助弥补其行政及其他费用。

Query_Text_en: The Fund shall draw down all subscriptions on a pro rata basis , as far as practicable over reasonable periods of time , to finance expenditures regardless of the form in which such subscriptions are made .
Translation: 基金应按比例提取全部认缴额，并在合理时间内尽可能完成拨款，以用于各项支出，且不考虑此类认缴款的具体形式。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 .
Translation: 第十条

Query_Text_en: Limitation on LiabilityNo participant shall be liable , by reason of its participation , for acts or obligations of the Fund .
Translation: 任何参与者均不因其参与而对基金的行为或义务承担责任。

Query_Text_en: CURRENCIES
Translation: 货币

Query_Text_en: Article 11 .
Translation: 第十一条

Query_Text_en: Use of Currencies1 .
Translation: 货币使用1.

Query_Text_en: Currencies received in payment of , or under article 13 in respect of , subscriptions made pursuant to article 5 and article 6 [ 2 ] may be used and exchanged by the Fund for any of its operations and , subject to the approval of the Board of Directors , for the temporary investment of funds not needed in its operations .
Translation: 根据第五条和第六条缴付的、或根据第十三条相关规定收到的支付货币，基金组织可将其用于各项业务操作，经董事会批准后亦可用于临时投资未在业务中使用的资金。

Query_Text_en: The use of currencies received in payment of , or under article 13 in respect of , subscriptions under article 6 [ 3 ] and article 7 [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] or as other resources under article 8 shall be governed by the terms and conditions pursuant to which such currencies are received or , in the case of currencies received under article 13 , the use shall be governed by the terms and conditions on which the currencies whose value is so maintained were received .
Translation: 根据第六条[3]、第七条[1]和[2]项下收到的认缴款偿付，或根据第十三条就此类认缴款或第八条项下的其他资源所收到的货币的使用，应受接收该等货币时所依据的条款和条件的约束；而根据第十三条收到的货币，其使用应受维持该等货币价值时所接收货币的条款和条件的约束。

Query_Text_en: All other currencies received by the Fund may be freely used and exchanged by the Fund for any of its operations and , subject to the approval of the Board of Directors , for the temporary investment of funds not needed in its operations .
Translation: 基金可自由使用和兑换其收到的其他货币，用于其各项业务，并经董事会批准后，可将其业务中暂时不需要使用的资金进行临时投资。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 .
Translation: 第十二条

Query_Text_en: Valuation of Currencies1 .
Translation: 货币估值1.

Query_Text_en: Whenever it shall be necessary under this Agreement to determine the value of any currency in terms of another currency or currencies or of the unit of account , such valuation shall be reasonably made by the Fund after consultation with the International Monetary Fund .
Translation: 根据本协议需要确定任何货币以另一种货币或多种货币以及记账单位表示的价值时，该估值应由基金在与国际货币基金组织协商后合理确定。

Query_Text_en: In the case of a currency which does not have a par value established with the International Monetary Fund , the value of such currency in terms of the unit of account shall be determined from time to time by the Fund pursuant to paragraph 1 of this article and the value so determined shall be treated as if it were the par value of such currency for the purpose of this Agreement , including , without limitation , article 13 [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] .
Translation: 对于在国际货币基金组织未确立平价的货币，该货币以记账单位表示的价值应由基金组织根据本条第1款不时确定，且经如此确定的价值应视为本协定项下该货币的平价，包括但不限于第十三条[1]和[2]。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 .
Translation: 第十三条

Query_Text_en: Whenever the par value of the currency of a State participant is increased in terms of the unit of account or its foreign exchange value has , in the opinion of the Fund , appreciated to a significant extent within that participant 's territory , the Fund shall return to that participant within a reasonable time an amount of such currency equal to the increase in the value of the amount of such currency to which the provisions of paragraph 1 are applicable .
Translation: 当某一成员国货币的面值按记账单位计算有所增加，或其外汇价值在基金组织看来在其境内已显著升值时，基金组织应当在合理时间内向该成员国返还相当于该货币价值增值部分的等额货币，具体适用范围以第1款规定为准。

Query_Text_en: The Fund may waive or declare inoperative the provisions of this article when a uniform change in the par value of the currencies of all State participants is made by the International Monetary Fund .
Translation: 当国际货币基金组织对所有成员国货币的平价作出统一调整时，本组织可豁免本条规定的适用或宣布本条停止生效。

Query_Text_en: CHAPTER V.
Translation: 第五章

Query_Text_en: OPERATIONS
Translation: 运营

Query_Text_en: Use of Resources1 .
Translation: 资源利用（一）

Query_Text_en: The Fund shall provide financing for projects and programs to further economic and social development in the territory of members .
Translation: 基金应为成员国境内的项目和计划提供融资，以促进其经济社会发展。

Query_Text_en: The Fund shall provide such financing for the benefit of those members whose economic situation and prospects require such financing to be on concessional terms .
Translation: 基金应向那些经济状况和前景需要以优惠条件获得融资的成员国提供此类融资。

Query_Text_en: Financing provided by the Fund shall be for purposes which in the opinion of the Fund are of high developmental priority in the light of the needs of the area or areas concerned and shall , except in special circumstances , be for specific projects or groups of projects , particularly those forming part of a national or regional or subregional program , including provision of financing for national development banks or other suitable institutions for relending for specific projects approved by the Fund .
Translation: 基金提供的融资应用于基金认为根据相关区域需求属于高发展优先级的领域，并且除特殊情况外，应针对具体项目或项目群，特别是那些构成国家级、区域级或次区域级规划组成部分的项目，包括为经基金批准的具体项目向国家发展银行或其他合适机构提供转贷融资。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 .
Translation: 第十五条

Query_Text_en: Conditions of Financing1 .
Translation:
融资条件  
1.

Query_Text_en: The Fund shall not provide financing for any project in the territory of a member if that member objects thereto , except that it shall not be necessary for the Fund to assure itself that individual members do not object in the case of financing provided to a public international , regional or sub-regional organization .
Translation: 基金不得向某一成员领土内的任何项目提供融资，如果该成员对此提出异议；但向国际、区域或次区域公共组织提供融资的情况下，基金无需自行确认相关成员未提出异议。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] In making financing available for entities other than members , the Fund shall take all necessary steps to ensure that the concessional benefits of its financing accrue only to members or other entities which should , taking into account all the relevant circumstances , receive some or all of those benefits .
Translation: 在向非成员实体提供融资时，基金组织应采取一切必要措施，确保其融资的优惠待遇仅流向成员或综合考虑所有相关情况后应获得部分或全部优惠待遇的其他实体。

Query_Text_en: Before financing is provided , the applicant shall have presented an adequate proposal through the President of the Bank and the President shall have presented to the Board of Directors of the Fund a written report recommending such financing , on the basis of a staff study of its merits .
Translation: 在提供融资之前，申请人应通过本行行长提交充分的提案，而行长应向基金董事会提交书面报告，推荐该融资项目，并基于工作人员对其优缺点的评估。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] The Fund shall impose no conditions that the proceeds of its financing shall be spent in the territories of any particular State participant or member , but such proceeds shall be used only for procurement in the territories of State participants or members , of goods produced in and services supplied from the territories of State participants or members , provided that , in the case of funds received pursuant to article 8 from a State which is not a participant or member , the territories of that State shall also be eligible sources of procurement from such funds , and may be eligible sources of procurement from such other funds received under that article as the Board of Directors shall determine .
Translation: 基金不得附加任何条件要求其融资所得资金须在某一特定成员国或成员领土内支用，但此类资金仅可用于采购各成员国或成员领土内生产的产品和提供的服务。但需注意，若根据第八条从非成员国或成员处获得资金，则该国领土亦可作为此类资金的采购合格来源，并可作为董事会决定的其他根据该条款获得资金的采购合格来源。

Query_Text_en: In making a loan , the Fund shall pay due regard to the prospects that the borrower and the guarantor , if any , will be able to meet their obligations .
Translation: 基金组织在发放贷款时，应充分考虑借款人及其担保人（如有）能否履行其义务的可能性。

Query_Text_en: The Fund shall adopt such measures as shall be required to ensure the effective application of this article .
Translation: 基金应采取必要措施，确保本条款的有效实施。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 .
Translation: 第十六条

Query_Text_en: Form and Terms of Financing1 .
Translation: 融资形式与条款1.

Query_Text_en: Financing by the Fund from resources provided under articles 5 , 6 and 7 , and from repayments of , and income arising from , such financing , shall take the form of loans .
Translation: 基金的融资应以贷款形式提供，其资金来源包括根据第五、六、七条提供的资源，以及此类融资的还款和由此产生的收入。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Subject to the provisions of the foregoing paragraph , financing by the Fund shall be on such concessional terms as may be appropriate .
Translation: 基金提供的融资应以适当的优惠条件进行，具体条件可根据情况确定。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Where the borrower is a member , or an inter-governmental body to which one or more members belong , the Fund shall , in establishing the terms of financing , take account primarily of the economic circumstances and prospects of the member or members for whose benefit the financing is being provided and , in addition , of the nature and requirements of the project or program concerned .
Translation: 当借款方为某一成员国或由一个或多个国家组成的政府间机构时，基金组织在确定融资条款时，应主要考虑该融资所惠及的成员国或成员国的经济状况及前景，同时还要考虑相关项目或计划的性质及其要求。

Query_Text_en: The Fund may provide financing for :
Translation: 该基金可提供融资：

Query_Text_en: [ a ] any member or any geographical or administrative subdivision or agency thereof ;
Translation: 任何成员或任何地理区域、行政区域及其下属机构或代理机构；

Query_Text_en: [ b ] any institution or undertaking in the territory of any member ;
Translation: 任何成员国境内的任何机构或实体；

Query_Text_en: All such financing shall , in the opinion of the Fund , be for the furtherance of the purposes of this Agreement .
Translation: 基金认为，所有此类融资均应以推进本协议的目标为宗旨。

Query_Text_en: The Fund may make foreign exchange available to meet local expenditure on a project when and to the extent which , in the opinion of the Fund , this is necessary or appropriate for the purposes of the loan , having regard to the economic position and prospects of the member or members for whose benefit the financing is being provided , and to the nature and requirements of the project .
Translation: 基金组织可根据贷款目的，在认为必要或适当的情况下，拨付外汇以满足项目的当地支出。这需考虑到该融资所惠及的成员国的经济状况和前景，以及项目的性质和要求。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 .
Translation: 第十七条

Query_Text_en: The President , with the agreement of the Board of Directors , shall make arrangements for carrying out this review and its results shall be reported through the President to the Board of Directors .
Translation: 经董事会批准，总裁应负责安排实施本项审查，其结果应由总裁向董事会报告。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 .
Translation: 第十八条

Query_Text_en: Co-operation with Other International Organizations , Other Institutions and StatesIn furtherance of its purposes , the Fund shall seek to co-operate , and may enter into arrangements for co-operation , with other international organizations , regional and sub-regional organizations , other institutions and States , provided that no such arrangement shall be made with a State which is not a member or a participant or with an agency of such State unless it shall have been approved by an eighty-five per cent majority of the total voting power of the participants .
Translation:
与其他国际组织、机构及国家的合作  
为推进其宗旨，基金应寻求与其他国际组织、区域及次区域组织、其他机构及国家开展合作，并可订立合作安排，但若合作对象为非成员国或非参与方的国家，或该国所属机构，则须经参与方总投票权的85%多数批准方可实施。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 .
Translation: 第十九条。

Query_Text_en: Technical AssistanceIn furtherance of its purposes , the Fund may provide technical assistance , but such assistance will normally be on a reimbursable basis if it is not provided from special technical assistance grants or other means made available to the Fund for the purpose .
Translation: 国际货币基金组织为实现其宗旨，可提供技术援助，但若此类援助未通过基金组织获得的专门技术援助赠款或其他指定用途资金提供，则通常应采取偿还性方式。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 .
Translation: 第二十条。

Query_Text_en: Miscellaneous OperationsIn addition to the powers provided for elsewhere in this Agreement , the Fund may undertake such other activities incidental to its operations as shall be necessary or desirable in furtherance of its purposes and consistent with the provisions of this Agreement .
Translation:
其他业务  
除本协议其他条款规定的权力外，基金可开展与其业务相关的其他活动，此类活动应为实现其宗旨所必需或适宜，并符合本协议的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 .
Translation: 第二十一条

Query_Text_en: Political Activity ProhibitedNeither the Fund , nor any officials or other persons acting on its behalf , shall interfere in the political affairs of any member ;
Translation:
禁止从事政治活动  
本机构及其任何代表其行事的官员或其他人员，均不得干涉任何成员国的政治事务。

Query_Text_en: nor shall they be influenced in their decisions by the political character of the member or members concerned .
Translation: 他们作出的决定也不应受到相关成员政治属性的影响。

Query_Text_en: Only considerations relevant to the economic and social development of members shall be relevant to such decisions , and these considerations shall be weighed impartially to achieve the purposes stated in this Agreement .
Translation: 此类决策所依据的考量因素应仅限于与成员国经济和社会发展相关的方面，且这些考量因素应得到公正权衡，以实现本协议所述目的。

Query_Text_en: CHAPTER VI .
Translation: 第六章

Query_Text_en: ORGANIZATION AND MANAGEMENT
Translation: 组织与管理

Query_Text_en: The Fund will utilise the officers , staff , organization , services and facilities of the Bank to carry out its functions and , if the Board of Directors recognizes that there is need for additional personnel , will have such personnel who shall be engaged by the President pursuant to article 30 [ 4 ] [ v ] .
Translation: 基金将利用银行的职员、员工、组织架构、服务及设施以履行其职能。如董事会认定需补充人员，此类人员将由总裁根据第三十条[4][v]聘用。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 .
Translation: 第二十三条

Query_Text_en: Board of Governors :
Translation: 管理委员会

Query_Text_en: Powers1 .
Translation: 权力1 。

Query_Text_en: The Board of Governors may delegate to the Board of Directors all its powers , except the power to :
Translation: 理事会可将其一切权力委托给执行董事会，但以下权力除外：

Query_Text_en: [ i ] Admit new participants and determine the terms of their admission ;
Translation: 接纳新参与者并确定其加入条件；

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] Authorize increases in subscription under article 7 and determine the terms and conditions relating thereto ;
Translation: 授权根据第七条增加认购，并确定相关条款和条件；

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] Suspend a participant ;
Translation: 暂停某参与者的资格；

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] Decide appeals from decisions made by the Board of Directors concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement ;
Translation: 裁决针对董事会作出的有关本协议解释或适用的决定所提出的上诉；

Query_Text_en: [ v ] Authorize the conclusion of general arrangements for co-operation with other international organizations , other than arrangements of a temporary or administrative character ;
Translation: 授权缔结与其他国际组织的总体合作安排，但临时性或行政性性质的安排除外。

Query_Text_en: [ vi ] Select external auditors to audit the accounts of the Fund and certify the balance sheet and statement of the income and expenditures of the Fund ;
Translation: 选聘外部审计师审计基金账目，并审核确认基金的资产负债表和收支报表；

Query_Text_en: [ vii ] Approve , after reviewing the report of the auditors , the balance sheet and the statement of the income and expenditures of the Fund ;
Translation: 经审议审计报告后，批准基金的资产负债表和收支报表。

Query_Text_en: [ ix ] Decide to terminate the operations of the Fund and distribute its assets ;
Translation: [ix] 决定终止本基金的运作并分配其资产；

Query_Text_en: and [ x ] Exercise such other powers as are expressly assigned to the Board of Governors in this Agreement .
Translation: 行使本协议中明确授予理事会的其他职权。

Query_Text_en: The Board of Governors may at any time revoke the delegation of any matter to the Board of Directors .
Translation: 管理委员会可随时撤销其委托给董事局的任何事项。

Query_Text_en: The governors and alternate governors of the Bank shall be ex officio governors and alternate governors respectively of the Fund .
Translation: 国际复兴开发银行的理事和副理事应当然成为国际货币基金组织的理事和副理事。

Query_Text_en: The President of the Bank shall notify to the Fund as necessary the names of such governors and alternates .
Translation: 银行行长应根据需要将此类董事及候补成员的姓名通知基金组织。

Query_Text_en: Each State participant which is not a member shall appoint one governor and one alternate governor who shall serve at the pleasure of the appointing participant .
Translation: 每个未成为正式成员的国家参与者应指派一名理事和一名候补理事，其任职由委派方随时决定。

Query_Text_en: No alternate may vote except in the absence of his principal .
Translation: 除非其正式代表缺席，否则替代代表不得投票。

Query_Text_en: The Board of Governors shall hold an annual meeting and such other meetings as may be provided for by the Board or called by the Board of Directors .
Translation: 管理委员会应举行年度会议，以及由该委员会规定或由董事会召集的其他会议。

Query_Text_en: The Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Bank shall be ex officio Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Fund .
Translation: 银行理事会主席应当然担任基金理事会主席。

Query_Text_en: The annual meeting of the Board of Governors shall be held in conjunction with the annual meeting of the Board of Governors of the Bank .
Translation: 理事会的年度会议应与本行理事会的年度会议同时召开。

Query_Text_en: A quorum for any meeting of the Board of Governors shall be a majority of the total number of governors , representing not less than three fourths of the total voting power of the participants .
Translation: 董事会任何会议的法定人数应由全体董事过半数组成，且其所代表的投票权不低于参与者总投票权的四分之三。

Query_Text_en: The Board of Governors may by regulation establish a procedure whereby the Board of Directors may , when it deems such action advisable , obtain a vote of the governors on a specific question without calling a meeting of the Board of Governors .
Translation: 治理委员会可通过制定规定，授权董事会在认为必要时，可不召开理事会会议，就特定问题对理事进行表决。

Query_Text_en: The Board of Governors , and the Board of Directors to the extent authorized by the Board of Governors , may establish such subsidiary committees as may be necessary or appropriate to conduct the business of the Fund .
Translation: 基金理事会及在其授权范围内的董事会可设立必要或适当的附属委员会，以处理基金事务。

Query_Text_en: The Board of Governors , and the Board of Directors to the extent authorized by the Board of Governors or by this Agreement , may adopt such regulations , not inconsistent with this Agreement , as shall be necessary or appropriate for the conduct of the business of the Fund .
Translation: 管理委员会及其根据管理委员会或本协议的授权范围内获准的董事会，可制定不与本协议相抵触的必要或适当的规章，以开展基金业务。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 .
Translation: 第二十六条

Query_Text_en: Board of Directors :
Translation: 董事会：

Query_Text_en: FunctionsWithout prejudice to the powers of the Board of Governors provided for in article 23 , the Board of Directors shall be responsible for the direction of the general operations of the Fund and for this purpose shall exercise any functions expressly given to it in this Agreement or delegated to it by the Board of Governors and , in particular , shall :
Translation: 根据第二十三条的规定，不妨碍理事会所享有的权力，执行董事会应负责指导基金的一般业务，并为此目的行使本协议中明确规定赋予其的职能或由理事会委托其行使的职能，尤其应当：

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] In conformity with the general directives of the Board of Governors , take decisions regarding individual loans and other forms of financing to be provided by the Fund under this Agreement ;
Translation: 根据执行董事会的一般指导方针，就基金根据本协议提供的具体贷款及其他形式的融资作出决定；

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] Adopt such rules , regulations or other measures as may be required to ensure that proper and adequate audited accounts and records are kept in relation to the operations of the Fund ;
Translation: 制定必要的规则、条例或其他措施，以确保基金运作保持完整且充分的经审计账目和相关记录。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] Ensure that the Fund is served in the most efficient and economical manner ;
Translation: （四）确保基金以最高效和经济的方式运作；

Query_Text_en: [ v ] Submit to the Board of Governors , for approval at each annual meeting , the accounts for each financial year in a form which distinguishes , to the extent necessary , between the accounts of the general operations of the Fund and of such operations as are financed from contributions made available to the Fund under article 8 ;
Translation: 提交执行董事会，供其在每年的会议上批准各财政年度的账目。此类账目应根据必要范围区分基金一般运营活动的账目和依据第八条向基金提供的捐款资助的运营活动的账目。

Query_Text_en: and [ vii ] Approve the budget and general lending program and policies of the Fund , in accordance with the resources respectively available for these purposes .
Translation: 批准基金组织的预算、普通贷款计划及政策，并根据分别可用于上述各项目的的资源情况予以确定。

Query_Text_en: Article 27 .
Translation: 第二十七条

Query_Text_en: Composition1 .
Translation: Composition1.

Query_Text_en: The State participants shall , pursuant to schedule B , select six directors and six alternate directors .
Translation: 国家参与者应根据附表B的规定，选出六名董事和六名候补董事。

Query_Text_en: The Bank shall , pursuant to schedule B , designate six directors and their alternates from the Board of Directors of the Bank .
Translation: 银行应根据附表B，从其董事会中指定六名董事及其各自的候补。

Query_Text_en: An alternate director of the Fund may attend all meetings of the Board of Directors but shall neither participate nor vote except in the absence of his principal .
Translation: 基金候补董事可列席董事会全体会议，但除其正董事缺席外，不得参与讨论或行使表决权。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] A director designated by the Bank shall hold office until his successor shall have been designated pursuant to schedule B and shall have assumed office .
Translation: 由银行指定的董事应任职至其继任者根据附表B被指定并就任时为止。

Query_Text_en: If a director designated by the Bank shall cease to be a director of the Bank he shall cease to be a director of the Fund .
Translation: 如果由某银行指派的董事不再担任该银行的董事，则其亦不再担任该基金的董事。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The term of office of directors selected by State participants shall be three years , but shall terminate whenever a general increase in subscriptions pursuant to article 7 [ 1 ] becomes effective .
Translation: 由国家出资方选出的董事的任期为三年，但遇根据第七条进行的普遍增资生效时，其任期即行终止。

Query_Text_en: Such directors shall be eligible for a further term or terms of office .
Translation: 此类董事可连任或继续担任多个任期。

Query_Text_en: They shall continue in office until their successors have been selected and have assumed office .
Translation: 他们将继续任职，直至其继任者选出并就职。

Query_Text_en: If the office of such a director shall become vacant before the expiration of his term of office , the vacancy shall be filled by a new director selected by the State participant or participants whose votes his predecessor was entitled to cast .
Translation: 如果此类董事的职位在其任期届满前出现空缺，该空缺应由其前任有权行使投票权的国家参与者选出的新董事予以填补。

Query_Text_en: Such successor director shall hold office for the remainder of the term of office of his predecessor .
Translation: 该继任董事应任职至其前任任期剩余部分结束。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] While the office of a director remains vacant the alternate of the former director shall exercise the powers of the latter except that of appointing an alternate , other than a temporary alternate to represent him at meetings when he can not be present .
Translation: 在董事职位空缺期间，原董事的替代人应行使后者的职权，但无权任命替代人，除非该替代人为临时替代人，以在本人无法出席时代表其参加会议。

Query_Text_en: If a State shall become a State participant pursuant to article 3 [ 3 ] , or a State participant shall increase its subscription , or if for any other reason the voting rights of individual State participants should change between the times provided for the selection of directors representing State participants :
Translation: 如果某一国家依据第三条[3]成为参与国，或参与国增加其认购额，或因其他原因导致参与国的投票权在两次代表参与国的董事选举之间发生变化：

Query_Text_en: [ i ] There shall be no change in directors as a result thereof , provided that if a director shall cease to have any voting rights , his term of office and that of his alternate shall terminate forthwith .
Translation: 因此不会导致董事职位发生变动。但如某位董事不再拥有任何投票权，其任期及其候补董事的任期应立即终止。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] Voting rights of State participants and of the directors selected by them shall be adjusted as of the effective date of the increase in subscription or the new subscription or other change in voting rights , as the case may be ;
Translation: 成员国参与者及其选出的董事的投票权，应自增加认购、新认购或其他投票权变更生效之日起进行调整，视具体情况而定。

Query_Text_en: and [ iii ] If such a new State participant shall have voting rights , it may designate a director then representing one or more State participants to represent it and cast its votes until the next general selection of State participant directors .
Translation: 若该新国家成员方享有投票权，则其可指派当时代表一个或多个成员方的董事代其行使投票权，直至下次国家成员方董事全体选举。
请提供需要翻译的具体文本内容。

Query_Text_en: Procedure1 .
Translation: 程序1.

Query_Text_en: A quorum for any meeting of the Board of Directors shall be a majority of the total number of directors having not less than three fourths of the total voting power of the participants .
Translation: 董事会会议的法定人数应由全体董事中多数成员组成，且这些成员的投票权不低于与会者总投票权的四分之三。

Query_Text_en: Article 29 .
Translation: 请提供具体的条款原文内容，以便进行准确翻译。

Query_Text_en: Voting1 .
Translation: 投票1.

Query_Text_en: The Bank , and the State participants as a group , shall each have 1 , 000 votes .
Translation: 银行以及作为整体的国家参与者各方应各自拥有1000票。

Query_Text_en: Each governor of the Fund who is a governor of the Bank shall have , and shall be entitled to cast , such proportionate share of the Bank 's votes as shall have been notified to the Fund by the President of the Bank .
Translation: 担任银行理事的基金组织每位理事应拥有其在银行投票权中的相应比例份额，并有权投出该份额，该比例份额应由银行行长通知基金组织。

Query_Text_en: Each State participant shall have a proportionate share of the aggregate votes of the State participants based on the subscriptions of such participant made pursuant to article 6 and , to the extent agreed by the State participants in connection with additional subscriptions authorized under article 7 [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] , on such additional subscriptions .
Translation: 各成员国应根据其依据第六条所作的认购以及经各成员国同意的范围内依据第七条授权的额外认购部分，在成员国总投票权中享有相应份额。

Query_Text_en: In voting in the Board of Governors , each governor representing a State participant shall be entitled to cast the votes of the participant he represents .
Translation: 在理事会投票时，每位代表成员国的董事均有权行使所代表参与者的投票权。

Query_Text_en: Each director selected by one or more State participants shall have the number of votes held by the participant or participants which selected him .
Translation: 由一个或多个成员国选任的每位董事，其投票权数额应等同于选任该董事的成员国所持有的投票权数额总和。

Query_Text_en: Each Bank director shall cast his votes as a unit .
Translation: 每位银行董事应整体行使表决权。

Query_Text_en: A director representing more than one State participant may cast separately the votes of the States he represents .
Translation: 代表多个成员国的董事可分别为其所代表的各成员国行使投票权。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding any of the other provisions of this Agreement :
Translation: 本协议其他条款的规定不影响：

Query_Text_en: [ i ] If a regional member shall be or become a State participant it shall not have or acquire any votes by reason of such participation and if a regional State participant becomes a member it shall cease as of the effective date of such membership to have any votes as a State participant ;
Translation: 如果某一区域成员成为国家参与者，其不得因此而获得或取得任何投票权；若某一国家参与者成为成员，则自其成员资格生效之日起终止其作为国家参与者的投票权。

Query_Text_en: and [ ii ] If a non-regional State shall be or become both a State participant and a member it shall , but solely for the purposes of this Agreement , be treated in all respects as if it were not a member .
Translation: （二）若某一非区域国家同时作为缔约国和成员方存在，则仅就本协议而言，该国在各方面应被视为非成员方。

Query_Text_en: Article 30 .
Translation: 第三十条 关于摄影作品和实用艺术作品的保护，缔约国可依其认为适宜之程度，将其保护范围仅限于该作品在原产国受到保护之情形。然而，若原产国将保护范围扩展至建筑作品，则此类限制不得适用。

Query_Text_en: The President1 .
Translation: 总统1。

Query_Text_en: The President of the Bank shall be ex officio President of the Fund .
Translation: 银行行长当然担任基金组织主席。

Query_Text_en: He shall be Chairman of the Board of Directors but shall have no vote .
Translation: 他应担任董事会主席，但不具有表决权。

Query_Text_en: Article PurposesThe purposes of the Association are to promote economic development increase productivity and thus raise standards of living in the less developed areas of the world included within the Association 's membership in particular by providing finance to meet their important developmental requirements on terms which are more flexible and bear less heavily on the balance of payments than those of conventional loans thereby furthering the developmental objectives of the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development hereinafter called the Bank and supplementing its activities The Association shall be guided in all its decisions by the provisions of this Article
Translation: 本协会之宗旨在于促进经济发展、提高生产效率，并因此提升会员国中欠发达地区的生活水平，尤其通过提供融资以满足其重要发展需求。此类融资条件更为灵活且对国际收支的影响较传统贷款更小，从而进一步推动国际复兴开发银行（以下简称"银行"）的发展目标，并补充其活动。本协会的各项决策均应遵循本条之规定。

Query_Text_en: a The original members of the Association shall be those members of the Bank listed in Schedule A hereto which on or before the date specified in Article Section 2 c accept membership in the Association
Translation: 协会的原始成员应为本协议附表A中所列银行成员中在根据第2(c)节规定的日期之前或当日接受协会会籍者。

Query_Text_en: b Membership shall be open to other members of the Bank at such times and in accordance with such terms as the Association may determine
Translation: b. 本组织的会员资格应向其他银行成员开放，具体开放时间及条件由本协会自行决定。

Query_Text_en: a Upon accepting membership each member shall subscribe funds in the amount assigned to it Such subscriptions are herein referred to as initial subscriptions
Translation: 在接纳成为会员后，各成员应认缴分配给其的金额。本文件中所称"初始认缴额"即指此项认缴。

Query_Text_en: b The initial subscription assigned to each original member shall be in the amount set forth opposite its name in Schedule A expressed in terms of United States dollars of the weight and fineness in effect on 1 January 1960
Translation: 每位原始会员的初始认购额应为附表A中其名称对应的金额，以1960年1月1日有效的黄金重量和纯度标准所折算的美元金额表示。

Query_Text_en: and twelve and one half percent each year thereafter at annual intervals until the ten percent portion of the initial subscription shall have been paid in full
Translation: 此后每年按年分期支付十二点五%，直至初始认购的百分之十部分全部缴清。

Query_Text_en: d The remaining ninety percent of the initial subscription of each original member shall be payable in gold or freely convertible currency in the case of members listed in Part of Schedule A and in the currency of the subscribing member in the case of members listed in Part of Schedule A This ninety percent portion of initial subscriptions of original members shall be payable in five equal annual instalments as follows :
Translation: 创始成员国初始认缴股本的剩余90%应按以下方式缴纳：对于列入A类附表第一部分的成员国，其90%部分应以黄金或可自由兑换货币支付；对于列入A类附表第二部分的成员国，则应以该认缴国的本国货币支付。创始成员国初始认缴股本的该90%部分应按以下五年等额分期方式缴纳：

Query_Text_en: the first such instalment within thirty days after the date on which the Association shall begin operations pursuant to Article Section 4 or on the date on which the original member becomes a member whichever shall be later ; the second instalment one year after the beginning of operations of the Association and succeeding instalments each year thereafter at annual intervals until the ninety percent portion of the initial subscription shall have been paid in full
Translation: 首期分期缴纳应于协会根据第四条开展运营之日或原有会员成为会员之日（以较晚者为准）起三十日内完成；第二次分期缴纳应于协会开始运营之日起一年后进行，此后每年以年度间隔进行后续分期缴纳，直至初始认缴额的百分之九十全额缴清。

Query_Text_en: e The Association shall accept from any member in place of any part of the member 's currency paid in or payable by the member under the preceding subsection d or under Section 2 of Article and not needed by the Association in its operations notes or similar obligations issued by the government of the member or the depository designated by such member which shall be non negotiable non interest bearing and payable at their par value on demand to the account of the Association in the designated depository
Translation: 本协会可接受任何会员以该会员政府或其指定的存款机构发行的、不可转让、不计息并按票面价值随时兑付的票据或类似债务凭证，作为该会员依据前款d项或本章程第二条所认缴或应缴货币中未被本协会运营所需的部分之替代。该等票据或债务凭证应兑付至本协会在指定存款机构的账户。

Query_Text_en: ii currency of a member which such member agrees on terms satisfactory to the Association to exchange for the currencies of other members for the purposes of the Association 's operations
Translation: 某一成员国同意按照协会满意的条件与其他成员国的货币进行兑换，以供协会业务运营之用的该成员国货币。

Query_Text_en: g Except as the Association may otherwise agree each member listed in Part of Schedule A shall maintain in respect of its currency paid in by it as freely convertible currency pursuant to subsection d of this Section the same convertibility as existed at the time of payment
Translation: 除非本组织另有约定，本组织《附件A》所列的每个会员国应确保其根据本条d款规定缴纳的作为可自由兑换货币的本国货币，在整个缴款期间维持与缴款时相同的可兑换性。

Query_Text_en: h The conditions on which the initial subscriptions of members other than original members may be made and the amounts and the terms of payment thereof shall be determined by the Association pursuant to Section 1 b of this Article
Translation: 非创始成员国的初始认缴条件、金额及支付条款应由本协会根据本条第1b款予以确定。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 Limitation on liabilityNo member shall be liable by reason of its membership for obligations of the Association
Translation: 第三条 责任限制 任何会员均不因会员身份而对协会的债务承担责任。

Query_Text_en: a The Association shall at such time as it deems appropriate in the light of the schedule for completion of payments on initial subscriptions of original members and at intervals of approximately five years thereafter review the adequacy of its resources and if it deems desirable shall authorize a general increase in subscriptions Notwithstanding the foregoing general or individual increases in subscriptions may be authorized at any time provided that an individual increase shall be considered only at the request of the member involved Subscriptions pursuant to this Section are herein referred to as additional subscriptions
Translation: 协会应根据创始成员国初始认缴款的缴清时间表，并在认为适当的时候，此后大约每五年一次审查其资源充足性；如认为必要，可授权进行一般性增资。前述规定不排除无论何时均可授权进行一般性或个别增资，但个别增资仅在相关会员提出请求时方可考虑。本条规定的认缴款在此称为追加认缴款。

Query_Text_en: b Subject to the provisions of paragraph c below when additional subscriptions are authorized the amounts authorized for subscription and the terms and conditions relating thereto shall be as determined by the Association
Translation: 本条款须受下述第c款规定的约束。当授权进行额外认购时，授权认购的金额及相关条款和条件应以协会的决定为准。

Query_Text_en: c When any additional subscription is authorized each member shall be given an opportunity to subscribe under such conditions as shall be reasonably determined by the Association an amount which will enable it to maintain its relative voting power but no member shall be obligated to subscribe
Translation: 当授权进行额外认购时，各会员应在协会合理确定的条件下获得认购机会，认购金额应足以使其维持原有投票权比例，但任何会员均无义务必须认购。

Query_Text_en: d All decisions under this Section shall be made by a two thirds majority of the total voting power
Translation: 本节规定的所有决定均须经代表全部投票权三分之二以上的多数通过。
