Query_Text_en: d The Fund , by an eighty five percent majority of the total voting power , may adopt periods other than those that apply in accordance with c above , which shall be the same for all members , for the repurchase of holdings of currency acquired by the Fund pursuant to a special policy on the use of its general resources
Translation: 基金组织可由总投票权的85%多数通过决议，为根据关于动用其一般资源的特别政策购回基金所持货币头寸之目的，对所有成员统一适用不同于上述c款规定的期限。

Query_Text_en: e A member shall repurchase , in accordance with policies that the Fund shall adopt by a seventy percent majority of the total voting power , the Fund 's holdings of its currency that are not acquired as a result of purchases and are subject to charges under Section 8 b ii of this Article
Translation: 成员国应根据基金组织以总投票权70%多数通过的政策，购回基金组织所持有的并非通过购入方式取得且根据本条第8bii款规定需缴纳费用的该国货币。

Query_Text_en: f A decision prescribing that under a policy on the use of the general resources of the Fund the period for repurchase under c or d above shall be shorter than the one in effect under the policy shall apply only to holdings acquired by the Fund subsequent to the effective date of the decision
Translation: 根据基金组织一般资源使用政策的规定，若某项决策要求上述c或d条款项下的购回期限短于该政策现行规定的期限，则该决策仅适用于该决定生效日期之后基金组织所获得的持有额。

Query_Text_en: g The Fund , on the request of a member , may postpone the date of discharge of a repurchase obligation , but not beyond the maximum period under c or d above or under policies adopted by the Fund under e above , unless the Fund determines , by a seventy percent majority of the total voting power , that a longer period for repurchase which is consistent with the temporary use of the general resources of the Fund is justified because discharge on the due date would result in exceptional hardship for the member
Translation: 基金组织应成员国的请求，可推迟履行回购义务的日期，但不得超过上述c或d项规定的最长期限，或基金组织根据上述e项制定的政策规定的期限，除非基金组织以总投票权的70%多数票认定，因在到期日履行义务将给该成员国造成特殊困难，故延长回购期限符合暂时使用基金组织一般资源的原则且具有正当合理性。

Query_Text_en: h The Fund 's policies under Section 3 d of this Article may be supplemented by policies under which the Fund may decide after consultation with a member to sell under Section 3 b of this Article its holdings of the member ' s currency that have not been repurchased in accordance with this Section 7 , without prejudice to any action that the Fund may be authorized to take under any other provision of this Agreement
Translation: 本条第3d款项下的基金政策可由补充规定予以完善，即基金经与会员国协商后，可依据本条第3b款出售该会员国未按本条规定完成回购的货币持有量，此行为不影响基金会在本协议其他条款下可能获授权采取的任何行动。

Query_Text_en: i All repurchases under this Section shall be made with special drawing rights or with the currencies of other members specified by the Fund The Fund shall adopt policies and procedures with regard to the currencies to be used by members in making repurchases that take into account the principles in Section 3 d of this Article The Fund ' holdings of a member 's currency that is used in repurchase shall not be increased by the repurchase above the level at which they would be subject to charges under Section 8 b ii of this Article
Translation: 本条项下的所有回购应使用特别提款权或基金指定的其他成员国货币。基金应制定相关政策和程序，规定成员国进行回购时所使用货币的选择，需考虑到本条第3(d)款规定的原则。基金通过回购所持有的成员国货币，其数额不得超过根据本条第8(b)(ii)款规定需缴纳费用的限额。

Query_Text_en: j i If a member 's currency specified by the Fund under i above is not a freely usable currency , the member shall ensure that the repurchasing member can obtain it at the time of the repurchase in exchange for a freely usable currency selected by the member whose currency has been specified An exchange of currency under this provision shall take place at an exchange rate between the two currencies equivalent to the exchange rate between them on the basis of Article , Section 7 a
Translation: 如果某一成员国的货币根据本条(i)款由基金指定后并非可自由使用货币，则该成员国应确保回购方成员国能够在回购时，以该指定货币所属成员国选定的可自由使用货币兑换获得该货币。本条款项下的货币兑换应按照两种货币之间的汇率进行结算，该汇率等同于根据本条第7a款规定确定的两种货币之间的基准汇率。

Query_Text_en: ii Each member whose currency is specified by the Fund for repurchase shall collaborate with the Fund and other members to enable repurchasing members , at the time of the repurchase , to obtain the specified currency in exchange for the freely usable currencies of other members
Translation: 基金组织指定其货币用于回购的成员，应与基金组织及其他成员协作，确保在回购时，回购方成员能够将其他成员的可自由使用货币兑换为指定货币。

Query_Text_en: iii An exchange under j i above shall be made with the member whose currency is specified unless that member and the repurchasing member agree on another procedure
Translation: iii 根据上述j i条款进行的交换应与指定货币的成员国进行，除非该成员国与回购方成员国就其他程序达成协议。

Query_Text_en: iv If a repurchasing member wishes to obtain , at the time of the repurchase , the freely usable currency of another member specified by the Fund under i above , it shall , if requested by the other member , obtain the currency from the other member in exchange for a freely usable currency at the rate of exchange referred to in j i above The Fund may adopt regulations on the freely usable currency to be provided in an exchange
Translation: 如果回购成员希望在回购时获得基金根据上述i项指定的另一成员的可自由使用货币，则在另一成员提出要求时，该成员应以上述j项所述汇率，使用可自由使用货币向该另一成员兑换该货币。基金可就可自由使用货币的兑换制定相关规定。

Query_Text_en: a i The Fund shall levy a service charge on the purchase by a member of special drawing rights or the currency of another member held in the General Resources Account in exchange for its own currency , provided that the Fund may levy a lower service charge on reserve tranche purchases than on other purchases The service charge on reserve tranche purchases shall not exceed one half of one percent
Translation: 基金组织应对会员国以本币交换特别提款权或普通资源账户中另一会员国货币的购买行为收取手续费，但基金组织可对储备限额购买收取低于其他购买的手续费。储备限额购买的手续费不得超过百分之零点五。

Query_Text_en: ii The Fund may levy a charge for stand by or similar arrangements The Fund may decide that the charge for an arrangement shall be offset against the service charge levied under i above on purchases under the arrangement
Translation: 国际货币基金组织可对备用或其他类似安排收取费用。基金组织可决定将该安排的费用抵减根据上述第i项对安排项下购买所收取的服务费。

Query_Text_en: ii exceed the amount of the member 's quota after excluding any balances referred to in i above The rates of charge normally shall rise at intervals during the period in which the balances are held
Translation: 对于在扣除上述第（一）款所述余额后超过该成员配额的金额，在余额持有期间，通常应分阶段提高费率。

Query_Text_en: c If a member fails to make a repurchase required under Section 7 of this Article , the Fund , after consultation with the member on the reduction of the Fund 's holdings of its currency , may impose such charges as the Fund deems appropriate on its holdings of the member 's currency that should have been repurchased
Translation: 如果成员国未能履行本条第七节规定的回购义务，基金组织在与该成员就其减少基金组织所持该国货币一事进行协商后，可对该国货币采取其认为适当的收费措施。

Query_Text_en: d A seventy percent majority of the total voting power shall be required for the determination of the rates of charge under a and b above , which shall be uniform for all members , and under c above
Translation: 确定上述a和b项下的收费费率，需获得总投票权的70%多数支持，该费率对所有成员应统一适用，以及上述c项下的情况。

Query_Text_en: e A member shall pay all charges in special drawing rights , provided that in exceptional circumstances the Fund may permit a member to pay charges in the currencies of other members specified by the Fund , after consultation with them , or in its own currency The Fund 's holdings of a member 's currency shall not be increased as a result of payments by other members under this provision above the level at which they would be subject to charges under b ii above
Translation: 成员国应以特别提款权缴纳各项费用，但遇特殊情况时，基金组织经与相关成员国协商后，可允许成员国以基金组织指定的其他成员国货币或本国货币缴纳费用。其他成员国根据本条款支付的货币，不得使基金组织持有的该成员国货币超过其根据上述b ii款应缴纳费用的水平。

Query_Text_en: a The Fund shall pay remuneration on the amount by which the percentage of quota prescribed under b or c below exceeds the Fund 's average daily balances of a member 's currency held in the General Resources Account other than balances acquired under a policy that has been the subject of an exclusion under Article c The rate of remuneration , which shall be determined by the Fund by a seventy percent majority of the total voting power , shall be the same for all members and shall be not more than , nor less than four fifths of , the rate of interest under Article , Section 3 In establishing the rate of remuneration , the Fund shall take into account the rates of charge under Article V , Section 8 b
Translation:
a. 基金组织应就以下情况支付补偿金：根据b或c款规定的配额比例，超出基金组织在普通资源账户中持有的某一成员货币的日均余额（不包括根据第c条被排除政策所获得的余额）的差额部分。  
b. 补偿金的利率由基金组织以占总投票权70%的多数票确定，该利率对所有成员统一适用，且不得超过也不得低于《章程》第X条第3款规定的利率的五分之四。  
c. 在确定补偿金利率时，基金组织应考虑第五条第八款b项规定的收费标准。

Query_Text_en: and minus iii the amounts it has received from the Fund in currency or special drawing rights under Article , Section 3 c since the date applicable under b i above
Translation: 减去（三）其自上述b(i)项所适用的日期以来根据本条第三款(c)项从基金组织获得的货币或特别提款权金额

Query_Text_en: ii one hundred percent for all members
Translation: II 完全致力于全体成员

Query_Text_en: d Remuneration shall be paid in special drawing rights , provided that either the Fund or the member may decide that the payment to the member shall be made in its own currency
Translation: 应计利息应以特别提款权支付，但可由基金组织或成员国决定以该国货币支付给成员国。

Query_Text_en: a The value of the Fund 's assets held in the accounts of the General Department shall be expressed in terms of the special drawing right
Translation: 存放在总务部门账户中的基金资产价值应以特别提款权表示。

Query_Text_en: b All computations relating to currencies of members for the purpose of applying the provisions of this Agreement , except Article and Schedule C , shall be at the rates at which the Fund accounts for these currencies in accordance with Section 11 of this Article
Translation: 根据本协议条款实施的目的，除本条和附件C外，涉及成员国货币的所有计算均应按照基金根据本条第11款规定核算的汇率进行。

Query_Text_en: c Computations for the determination of amounts of currency in relation to quota for the purpose of applying the provisions of this Agreement shall not include currency held in the Special Disbursement Account or in the Investment Account
Translation: 根据本协议条款进行适用时，确定与配额相关的货币金额的计算不应包括存放在特别拨款账户或投资账户中的货币。

Query_Text_en: a The value of the currencies of members held in the General Resources Account shall be maintained in terms of the special drawing right in accordance with exchange rates under Article , Section 7 a
Translation: 成员国存入普通资源账户的货币价值应以特别提款权为基础维持，并按照《章程》第7a款规定的汇率进行。

Query_Text_en: b An adjustment in the Fund 's holdings of a member 's currency pursuant to this Section shall be made on the occasion of the use of that currency in an operation or transaction between the Fund and another member and at such other times as the Fund may decide or the member may request Payments to or by the Fund in respect of an adjustment shall be made within a reasonable time , as determined by the Fund , after the date of adjustment , and at any other time requested by the member
Translation: 根据本条规定调整基金组织持有的成员国货币应当在基金组织与另一成员国进行涉及该货币的业务操作或交易之时进行，或其他由基金组织决定或成员国请求的其他时间。调整相关的支付应当在基金组织确定的调整日期之后的合理期限内完成，或在成员国要求的其他时间完成。

Query_Text_en: a The Fund shall be guided in all its policies and decisions under this Section by the objectives set forth in Article , Section 7 and by the objective of avoiding the management of the price , or the establishment of a fixed price , in the gold market
Translation: 本基金在本节项下的所有政策和决策中，均应遵循本章程第 条第7款所规定的目标，并应以避免在黄金市场操控价格或设定固定价格为目标。

Query_Text_en: b Decisions of the Fund to engage in operations or transactions under c , d , and e below shall be made by an eighty five percent majority of the total voting power
Translation: 基金在本条以下(c)、(d)和(e)款所述情况下进行操作或交易的决定，应由总投票权的85%多数票作出。

Query_Text_en: c The Fund may sell gold for the currency of any member after consulting the member for whose currency the gold is sold , provided that the Fund 's holdings of a member 's currency held in the General Resources Account shall not be increased by the sale above the level at which they would be subject to charges under Section 8 b ii of this Article without the concurrence of the member , and provided that , at the request of the member , the Fund at the time of sale shall exchange for the currency of another member such part of the currency received as :
Translation: 基金组织经相关会员国同意后，可将黄金出售换得任何会员国的货币，且需满足以下条件：基金组织持有的该会员国货币在普通资源账户中的份额，因出售黄金而增加的部分不得超过在未经该会员国同意的情况下即需缴纳费用的限额（依据本条第8bii款）；同时，若该会员国提出要求，基金组织应在出售黄金时，将其所获货币中的相应部分兑换成另一会员国的货币。

Query_Text_en: would prevent such an increase The exchange of a currency for the currency of another member shall be made after consultation with that member , and shall not increase the Fund 's holdings of that member 's currency above the level at which they would be subject to charges under Section 8 b ii of this Article The Fund shall adopt policies and procedures with regard to exchanges that take into account the principles applied under Section 7 i of this Article Sales under this provision to a member shall be at a price agreed for each transaction on the basis of prices in the market
Translation: 成员国之间进行货币兑换时，须经该成员国同意，且不得增加基金组织持有的该成员国货币超过根据本条第8(b)(ii)款需缴纳费用的水平。基金组织应就兑换事宜制定政策和程序，考虑本条第7(i)款所适用的原则。根据本条款向成员国出售货币的价格，应以市场价格为基准，每笔交易达成一致确定。

Query_Text_en: d The Fund may accept payments from a member in gold instead of special drawing rights or currency in any operations or transactions under this Agreement Payments to the Fund under this provision shall be at a price agreed for each operation or transaction on the basis of prices in the market
Translation: 根据本协议条款，本组织可接受成员国在任何业务或交易中以黄金形式支付，而非特别提款权或货币。根据本条款向本组织支付的款项应以双方就每次业务或交易达成的协议价格，且该价格须以市场价格为基础确定。

Query_Text_en: e The Fund may sell gold held by it on the date of the second amendment of this Agreement to those members that were members on August 31,1975 and that agree to buy it , in proportion to their quotas on that date If the Fund intends to sell gold under c above for the purpose of f ii below , it may sell to each developing member that agrees to buy it that portion of the gold which , if sold under c above , would have produced the excess that could have been distributed to it under f iii below The gold that would be sold under this provision to a member that has been declared ineligible to use the general resources of the Fund under Section 5 of this Article shall be sold to it when the ineligibility ceases , unless the Fund decides to make the sale sooner The sale of gold to a member under this subsection e shall be made in exchange for its currency and at a price equivalent at the time of sale to one special drawing right per 0 888 671 gram of fine gold
Translation:
基金组织可在本协议第二次修订之日，将其持有的黄金按其当时的配额比例出售给1975年8月31日时的成员中同意购买的成员。  
若基金组织拟根据本条款(c)项出售黄金以实现本条款(f)(ii)项所述目的，则可向每个同意购买的发展中国家成员出售其黄金中符合以下条件的部分：若根据本条款(c)项出售该部分黄金，其产生的超额部分可依据本条款(f)(iii)项向该成员进行分配。  
根据本条款规定应向某一成员出售的黄金，若该成员因本条第五款规定被宣布不符合使用基金组织一般资源资格，则应在该成员资格恢复时向其出售，除非基金组织决定提前出售。  
根据本款(e)项向某一成员出售黄金时，应以其本国货币交换，并按出售时每0.888671克纯金相当于1个特别提款权的价格进行交易。

Query_Text_en: f Whenever under c above the Fund sells gold held by it on the date of the second amendment of this Agreement , an amount of the proceeds equivalent at the time of sale to one special drawing fight per 0 888 671 gram of fine gold shall be placed in the General Resources Account and , except as the Fund may decide otherwise under g below , any excess shall be held in the Special Disbursement Account The assets held in the Special Disbursement Account shall be held separately from the other accounts of the General Department , and may be used at any time :
Translation: 根据上述c条款，当基金出售本协议第二次修订之日持有的黄金时，出售所得中相当于出售时每0.888671克纯金对应一个特别提款权的金额应存入普通资源账户；除非基金根据下述g条款另有决定，其余额应存入特别拨款账户。存放在特别拨款账户中的资产应与其他普通部账户的资产分开保存，并可随时动用。

Query_Text_en: i to make transfers to the General Resources Account for immediate use in operations and transactions authorized by provisions of this Agreement other than this Section ;
Translation: 本方可向普通资源账户拨付资金，以立即用于根据本协议本条款以外其他条款的规定授权的运营和交易。

Query_Text_en: ii for operations and transactions that are not authorized by other provisions of this Agreement but are consistent with the purposes of the Fund Under this subsection f ii balance of payments assistance may be made available on special terms to developing members in difficult circumstances , and for this purpose the ` Fund shall take into account the level of per capita income ;
Translation: （二）对于未获本协议其他条款授权但符合基金宗旨的运营和交易，在符合本款（f）项（二）的情况下，可按特殊条款向处境困难的发展中国家成员提供国际收支援助，为此，基金组织应考虑人均收入水平。

Query_Text_en: iii for distribution to those developing members that were members on August 31,1975 , in proportion to their quotas on that date , of such part of the assets that the Fund decides to use for the purposes of ii above as corresponds to the proportion of the quotas of these members on the date of distribution to the total of the quotas of all members on the same date , provided that the distribution under this provision to a member that has been declared ineligible to use the general resources of the Fund under Section 5 of this Article shall be made when the ineligibility ceases , unless the Fund decides to make the distribution sooner Decisions to use assets pursuant to i above shall be taken by a seventy percent majority of the total voting power , and decisions pursuant to ii and iii above shall be taken by an eighty five percent majority of the total voting power
Translation: 向1975年8月31日为成员国的发展中国家成员分配其在该日期所占配额比例对应的资产份额。具体而言，分配金额应与基金根据上述ii项目的用途决定使用的资产中，该等成员在分配日配额占全体成员国总配额比例相匹配。但若某成员因本条第5节规定被宣布无资格使用基金一般资源，则其分配应在其丧失资格终止时进行，除非基金决定提前进行分配。根据上述i项使用资产的决定，需经总投票权70%多数通过；根据上述ii、iii项作出的决定，则需经总投票权85%多数通过。

Query_Text_en: g The Fund may decide , by an eighty five percent majority of the total voting power , to transfer a part of the excess referred to in f above to the Investment Account for use pursuant to the provisions of Article , Section 6 f
Translation: 基金可经全体投票权85%多数通过，将其上述f项所述的超额部分转移至投资账户，并根据相关条款第X条第6f款的规定使用。

Query_Text_en: h Pending uses specified under f above , the Fund may invest a member 's currency held in the Special Disbursement Account in marketable obligations of that member or in marketable obligations of international financial organizations The income of investment and interest received under f ii above shall be placed in the Special Disbursement Account No investment shall be made without the concurrence of the member whose currency is used to make the investment The Fund shall invest only in obligations denominated in special drawing fights or in the currency used for investment
Translation: 根据上述f项规定，在特别提款权账户持有的成员国货币，基金组织可投资于该成员国发行的可流通债券或国际金融机构发行的可流通债券。根据f项ii款规定所获投资收益及利息收入，应存入特别提款权账户。未经该成员国同意，不得以其货币进行投资。基金组织仅可投资于以特别提款权计价或以投资货币计价的债券。

Query_Text_en: i The General Resources Account shall be reimbursed from time to time in respect of the expenses of administration of the Special Disbursement Account paid from the General Resources Account by transfers from the Special Disbursement Account on the basis of a reasonable estimate of such expenses
Translation: 普通资源账户应定期予以报销，报销依据为对相关费用的合理估算，具体方式是由特别拨款账户向普通资源账户划转资金，用以偿付从普通资源账户支付的特别拨款账户管理费用。

Query_Text_en: j The Special Disbursement Account shall be terminated in the event of the liquidation of the Fund and may be terminated prior to liquidation of the Fund by a seventy percent majority of the total voting power Upon termination of the account because of the liquidation of the Fund , any assets in this account shall be distributed in accordance with the provisions of Schedule K Upon termination prior to liquidation of the Fund , any assets in this account shall be transferred to the General Resources Account for immediate use in operations and transactions The Fund , by a seventy percent majority of the total voting power , shall adopt rules and regulations for the administration of the Special Disbursement Account
Translation: 特别拨款账户在基金清算时应当终止，或可在基金清算前经总投票权的70%多数决议终止。若因基金清算导致账户终止，该账户内资产应按照附表K的规定进行分配；若在基金清算前终止，则账户内资产应立即转入普通资源账户，用于运营和交易。基金应经总投票权的70%多数决议，制定特别拨款账户管理的相关规则与条例。

Query_Text_en: a A member may not use the Fund 's general resources to meet a large or sustained outflow of capital except as provided in Section 2 of this Article , and the Fund may request a member to exercise controls to prevent such use of the general resources of the Fund If , after receiving such a request , a member fails to exercise appropriate controls , the Fund may declare the member ineligible to use the general resources of the Fund
Translation: 除本条第二款另有规定外，会员国不得使用基金普通资源来应对大规模或持续的资本外流。若基金要求某会员国采取管制措施以阻止此类普通资源的使用，而在收到此类请求后该会员国未能采取相应管制措施，基金可宣布该会员国丧失使用基金普通资源的资格。

Query_Text_en: i to prevent the use of the general resources of the Fund for capital transactions of reasonable amount required for the expansion of exports or in the ordinary course of trade , banking , or other business ;
Translation: 本条款旨在防止基金组织的一般资源被用于合理金额的资本交易，此类交易可能涉及为扩大出口所需，或在贸易、银行业务或其他业务的常规运营中产生。

Query_Text_en: or ii to affect capital movements which are met out of a member 's own resources , but members undertake that such capital movements will be in accordance with the purposes of the Fund
Translation: 不影响成员国使用自身资源进行的资本流动，但成员国承诺此类资本流动应符合基金组织的宗旨。

Query_Text_en: Section 2 Special provisions for capital transfersA member shall be entitled to make reserve tranche purchases to meet capital transfers
Translation: 第二节 资本转移的特别规定。成员国应有权通过动用储备档配额来满足资本转移需求。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 Controls of capital transfersMembers may exercise such controls as are necessary to regulate international capital movements , but no member may exercise these controls in a manner which will restrict payments for current transactions or which will unduly delay transfers of funds in settlement of commitments , except as provided in Article , Section 3 b and in Article , Section 2
Translation:
第三条 资本转移的管制  
各成员方可采取必要措施规范国际资本流动，但任何成员方均不得以实施此类管制为由限制经常项目交易的支付，或不正当延误履行支付义务的资金划转，除非本条第3款b项及第2款另有规定。

Query_Text_en: i propose to the member that , on terms and conditions agreed between the Fund and the member , the latter lend its currency to the Fund or that , with the concurrence of the member , the Fund borrow such currency from some other source either within or outside the territories of the member , but no member shall be under any obligation to make such loans to the Fund or to concur in the borrowing of its currency by the Fund from any other source ;
Translation: 我建议会员国，在经基金与会员国协商确定的条款和条件下，由后者向基金提供其货币，或经会员国同意后，基金可从该会员国境内或境外的其他来源借款该货币，但任何会员国均无义务必须向基金提供此类贷款或同意基金从其他来源借款。

Query_Text_en: ii require the member , if it is a participant , to sell its currency to the Fund for special drawing rights held in the General Resources Account , subject to Article , Section 4 In replenishing with special drawing rights , the Fund shall pay due regard to the principles of designation under Article , Section 5
Translation: 根据《章程》第四节规定，若该成员为参与者，本组织要求其向基金出售货币以换取存入普通资源账户的特别提款权。在使用特别提款权进行补充时，基金应充分考虑《章程》第五节规定的指定原则。

Query_Text_en: Section 2 General scarcity of currencyIf the Fund finds that a general scarcity of a particular currency is developing , the Fund may so inform members and may issue a report setting forth the causes of the scarcity :
Translation:
第二部分 普遍性货币短缺  
如果基金组织发现某种货币出现普遍性短缺情况，可就此通知成员方，并发布报告阐述短缺原因：

Query_Text_en: rod containing recommendations designed to bring it to an end A representative of the member whose currency is involved shall participate in the preparation of the report
Translation: 包含旨在结束该问题的建议的报告，涉及该货币的成员方代表应参与报告的起草工作。

Query_Text_en: a If it becomes evident to the Fund that the demand for a member 's currency seriously threatens the Fund 's ability to supply that currency , the Fund , whether or not it has issued a report under Section 2 of this Article , shall formally declare such currency scarce and shall thenceforth apportion its existing and accruing supply of the scarce currency with due regard to the relative needs of members , the general international economic situation , and any other pertinent considerations The Fund shall also issue a report concerning its action
Translation: 如国际货币基金组织认定某会员国货币的需求严重威胁到其供应能力，无论该机构是否已根据本条第二款发布报告，均应正式宣布该货币短缺，并自此根据各会员国的实际需求、总体国际经济形势及其他相关因素合理分配现有及新增的短缺货币储备。国际货币基金组织还应就其采取的行动发布报告。

Query_Text_en: b A formal declaration under a above shall operate as an authorization to any member , after consultation with the Fund , temporarily to impose limitations on the freedom of exchange operations in the scarce currency Subject to the provisions of Article and Schedule C , the member shall have complete jurisdiction in determining the nature of such limitations , but they shall be no more restrictive than is necessary to limit the demand for the scarce currency to the supply held by , or accruing to , the member in question , and they shall be relaxed and removed as rapidly as conditions permit
Translation: 根据上述a项作出的正式声明，应构成授权各成员国在与基金组织协商后，临时对稀缺货币的兑换业务自由施加限制。受本条文及附件C条款约束，该成员国在确定此类限制的性质时拥有完全的管辖权，但此类限制不得比必要程度更严苛，其目的应仅限于将对稀缺货币的需求控制在该成员国所持有或可获得的供应量范围内，并应在条件允许时尽快放宽或取消此类限制。

Query_Text_en: Section 4 Administration of restrictionsAny member imposing restrictions in respect of the currency of any other member pursuant to the provisions of Section 3 b of this Article shall give sympathetic consideration to any representations by the other member regarding the administration of such restrictions
Translation: 根据本条第3b款规定对另一成员国货币实施限制措施的任何成员国，应对该另一成员国关于此类限制措施管理的申诉给予善意考虑。

Query_Text_en: Section 5 Effect of other international agreements on restrictionsMembers agree not to invoke the obligations of any engagements entered into with other members prior to this Agreement in such manner as will prevent the operation of the provisions of this Article
Translation: 各成员不得援引其在本协议生效前与其他成员缔结的任何协定所规定的义务，以免妨碍本条规定的实施。

Query_Text_en: Section 1 IntroductionIn addition to the obligations assumed under other articles of this Agreement , each member undertakes the obligations set out in this Article
Translation:
第一部分 引言  
除根据本协议其他条款所承担的义务外，各成员还应履行本条款中规定的所有义务。

Query_Text_en: a Subject to the provisions of Article , Section 3 b and Article , Section 2 , no member shall , without the approval of the Fund , impose restrictions on the making of payments and transfers for current international transactions
Translation: 根据本协定第条第3款b项和第条第2款的规定，任何成员国均不得在未经基金批准的情况下，对经常性国际交易的支付和转移实施限制。

Query_Text_en: b Exchange contracts which involve the currency of any member and which are contrary to the exchange control regulations of that member maintained or imposed consistently with this Agreement shall be unenforceable in the territories of any member In addition , members may , by mutual accord , cooperate in measures for the purpose of making the exchange control regulations of either member more effective , provided that such measures and regulations are consistent with this Agreement
Translation: 涉及任何会员国货币且违反该会员国根据本协定维持或实施的外汇管制法规的外汇合约，在任何会员国的领土内均不得强制执行。此外，会员国经双方同意后，可合作采取措施以增强任一会员国外汇管制法规的有效性，但此类措施和法规须符合本协定规定。

Query_Text_en: Section 3 Avoidance of discriminatory currency practicesNo member shall engage in , or permit any of its fiscal agencies referred to in Article , Section 1 to engage in , any discriminatory currency arrangements or multiple currency practices , whether within or outside margins under Article or prescribed by or under Schedule C , except as authorized under this Agreement or approved by the Fund ff such arrangements and practices are engaged in at the date when this Agreement enters into force , the member concerned shall consult with the Fund as to their progressive removal unless they are maintained or imposed under Article , Section 2 , in which case the provisions of Section 3 of that Article shall apply
Translation:
第三部分 避免歧视性货币做法  
任何会员国均不得从事，或允许其根据第X条第1款所述的财政机构从事任何歧视性货币安排或复汇率做法，无论此类安排或做法是否存在于本协定条款规定的幅度内，或根据附表C所规定的内容，除非经本协定授权或经基金批准。如果在本协定生效之日已存在此类安排或做法，相关会员国应与基金就逐步取消这些安排或做法进行磋商，除非这些安排或做法系根据第X条第2款维持或实施，此种情况下该条款第3款的规定应予适用。

Query_Text_en: or ii that their conversion is needed for making payments for current transactions The buying member shall have the option to pay either in special drawing rights , subject to Article , Section 4 , or in the currency of the member making the request
Translation: 或(ii)其转换系用于支付当前交易款项的，购汇会员可选择以特别提款权支付（须遵守《章程》第四节规定）或以请求方所在国货币支付。

Query_Text_en: or v the member requested to make the purchase is for any reason not entitled to buy currencies of other members from the Fund for its own currency
Translation: 或若要求进行购买的成员国因任何原因无权以其自身货币从基金购入其他成员国的货币。

Query_Text_en: and xii where official clearing arrangements exist , details of amounts awaiting clearance in respect of commercial and financial transactions , and of the length of time during which such arrears have been outstanding
Translation: 在存在官方清算安排的国家和地区，详细说明商业和金融交易中待清算金额的具体情况，以及此类拖欠款项的持续时间长度。

Query_Text_en: The General Conference of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization hereinafter referred to as UNESCO , meeting in Paris , from 29 September to 17 October 2003 , at its 32nd session , Referring to existing international human rights instruments , in particular to the Universal Declaration on Human Rights of 1948 , the International Covenant on Economic , Social and Cultural Rights of 1966 , and the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights of 1966 , Considering the importance of the intangible cultural heritage as a mainspring of cultural diversity and a guarantee of sustainable development , as underscored in the UNESCO Recommendation on the Safeguarding of Traditional Culture and Folklore of 1989 , in the UNESCO Universal Declaration on Cultural Diversity of 2001 , and in the Istanbul Declaration of 2002 adopted by the Third Round Table of Ministers of Culture , Considering the deep-seated interdependence between the intangible cultural heritage and the tangible cultural and natural heritage , Recognizing that the processes of globalization and social transformation , alongside the conditions they create for renewed dialogue among communities , also give rise , as does the phenomenon of intolerance , to grave threats of deterioration , disappearance and destruction of the intangible cultural heritage , in particular owing to a lack of resources for safeguarding such heritage , Being aware of the universal will and the common concern to safeguard the intangible cultural heritage of humanity , Recognizing that communities , in particular indigenous communities , groups and , in some cases , individuals , play an important role in the production , safeguarding , maintenance and recreation of the intangible cultural heritage , thus helping to enrich cultural diversity and human creativity , Noting the far-reaching impact of the activities of UNESCO in establishing normative instruments for the protection of the cultural heritage , in particular the Convention for the ? Protection of the World Cultural and Natural Heritage of 1972 , Noting further that no binding multilateral instrument as yet exists for the safeguarding of the intangible cultural heritage , Considering that existing international agreements , recommendations and resolutions concerning the cultural and natural heritage need to be effectively enriched and supplemented by means of new provisions relating to the intangible cultural heritage , Considering the need to build greater awareness , especially among the younger generations , of the importance of the intangible cultural heritage and of its safeguarding , Considering that the international community should contribute , together with the States ? Parties to this Convention , to the safeguarding of such heritage in a spirit of cooperation and mutual assistance , Recalling UNESCO 's programs relating to the intangible cultural heritage , in particular the ? Proclamation of Masterpieces of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity , Considering the invaluable role of the intangible cultural heritage as a factor in bringing human beings closer together and ensuring exchange and understanding among them , Adopts this Convention on this seventeenth day of October 2003 .
Translation: 联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会，以下简称联合国教科文组织，于2003年9月29日至10月17日期间在巴黎举行第32届会议，参考1948年《世界人权宣言》、1966年《经济、社会及文化权利国际公约》和1966年《公民权利和政治权利国际公约》等现有国际人权文书，注意到非物质文化遗产作为文化多样性的源泉以及可持续发展的保障的重要性，这一重要性在1989年《保护民间创作建议案》、2001年《世界文化多样性宣言》以及2002年第三届文化部长圆桌会议通过的《伊斯坦布尔宣言》中均有强调；意识到非物质文化遗产与物质文化遗产和自然遗产之间深厚的相互依存关系；承认全球化和社会变革进程，以及由此产生的社区间对话新机遇，同时也因不容异己的现象而带来非物质文化遗产退化、消失和毁坏的重大威胁，尤其由于缺乏保护此类遗产的资源；意识到保护人类非物质文化遗产是普世意志与共同关切；承认社区、尤其是原住民社区、群体以及在某些情况下个人，在非物质文化遗产的创造、保护、保存和创新中所发挥的重要作用，从而为丰富文化多样性和人类创造力作出贡献；注意到联合国教科文组织在制定文化遗产保护规范性文件方面取得的重大影响，尤其是1972年《保护世界文化和自然遗产公约》；注意到尚无具有约束力的多边文书专门用于保护非物质文化遗产；考虑到现有涉及文化遗产与自然遗产的国际协议、建议案和决议需要通过新增与非物质文化遗产相关的条款得到有效的充实和完善；考虑到有必要提升公众意识，尤其要增强青年一代对保护非物质文化遗产重要性的认识；考虑到国际社会应与本公约缔约国共同合作，在合作与互助精神下为保护此类遗产贡献力量；忆及联合国教科文组织关于非物质文化遗产的相关计划，尤其是《人类口头和非物质遗产杰作名录》；考虑到非物质文化遗产作为促进人类团结、交流与理解的宝贵因素；于2003年10月17日通过本公约。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] to provide for international cooperation and assistance .
Translation: [d] 促进国际合作与援助。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The `` intangible cultural heritage '' means the practices , representations , expressions , knowledge , skills -- as well as the instruments , objects , artefacts and cultural spaces associated therewith -- that communities , groups and , in some cases , individuals recognize as part of their cultural heritage .
Translation: 非物质文化遗产是指被社区、群体在某些情况下也包括个人视为其文化遗产组成部分的各种实践、表演形式、表现形式、知识、技能以及相关的工具、实物、工艺品和文化空间。

Query_Text_en: This intangible cultural heritage , transmitted from generation to generation , is constantly recreated by communities and groups in response to their environment , their interaction with nature and their history , and provides them with a sense of identity and continuity , thus promoting respect for cultural diversity and human creativity .
Translation: 这一非物质文化遗产世代相传，由社区和群体根据其生存环境、与自然的互动以及历史发展不断进行再创造，为传承者提供了身份认同与历史连续性的感知，从而促进对文化多样性和人类创造力的尊重。

Query_Text_en: For the purposes of this Convention , consideration will be given solely to such intangible cultural heritage as is compatible with existing international human rights instruments , as well as with the requirements of mutual respect among communities , groups and individuals , and of sustainable development .
Translation: 本公约的目的仅限于考虑那些与现有国际人权条约相一致、并与各社区、群体和个人之间的相互尊重要求以及可持续发展要求相契合的非物质文化遗产。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] traditional craftsmanship .
Translation: 传统工艺。

Query_Text_en: 3 . `` Safeguarding '' means measures aimed at ensuring the viability of the intangible cultural heritage , including the identification , documentation , research , preservation , protection , promotion , enhancement , transmission , particularly through formal and nonformal education , as well as the revitalization of the various aspects of such heritage .
Translation: "保护措施"指为确保非物质文化遗产持续传承和生命力所采取的各项行动，包括识别、记录、研究、保存、保护、宣传、提升、传承等活动，尤其通过正规和非正规教育途径开展传承，并振兴该遗产的各个方面。

Query_Text_en: 4 . `` States Parties '' means States which are bound by this Convention and among which this Convention is in force .
Translation: "缔约方"指受本公约约束并且本公约在它们之间生效的国家。

Query_Text_en: 5 . This Convention applies mutatis mutandis to the territories referred to in Article 33 which become Parties to this Convention in accordance with the conditions set out in that Article .
Translation: 本公约相应调整后适用于本公约第三十三条所指根据该条规定的条件成为本公约缔约方的领土。

Query_Text_en: To that extent the expression `` States Parties '' also refers to such territories .
Translation: 在此范围内，"缔约国"一词也指代此类领土。

Query_Text_en: or [ b ] affecting the rights and obligations of States Parties deriving from any international instrument relating to intellectual property rights or to the use of biological and ecological resources to which they are parties .
Translation: 不影响缔约国根据其为缔约方的任何涉及知识产权或生物及生态资源利用的国际协定所产生之权利与义务。

Query_Text_en: 1 . A General Assembly of the States Parties is hereby established , hereinafter referred to as `` the General Assembly '' .
Translation: 1. 现设立缔约方大会，以下简称"大会"。

Query_Text_en: The General Assembly is the sovereign body of this Convention .
Translation: 大会是本公约的最高权力机构。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The General Assembly shall meet in ordinary session every two years .
Translation: 大会应每两年举行一次例行会议。

Query_Text_en: It may meet in extraordinary session if it so decides or at the request either of the Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage or of at least one-third of the States Parties .
Translation: 该委员会可自行决定召开特别会议，或应保护非物质文化遗产政府间委员会或至少三分之一缔约国的请求召开。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The General Assembly shall adopt its own Rules of Procedure .
Translation: 大会应制定自身的议事规则。

Query_Text_en: 1 . An Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage , hereinafter referred to as `` the Committee '' , is hereby established within UNESCO .
Translation: 现于联合国教科文组织内设立保护非物质文化遗产政府间委员会，以下简称“委员会”。

Query_Text_en: It shall be composed of representatives of 18 States Parties , elected by the States Parties meeting in General Assembly , once this Convention enters into force in accordance with Article 34 .
Translation: 该机构应由18个缔约国的代表组成，其代表由缔约国在公约根据第三十四条生效后召开的缔约国大会上选举产生。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The number of States Members of the Committee shall be increased to 24 once the number of the States Parties to the Convention reaches 50 .
Translation: 一旦公约缔约国数量达到50个，委员会成员国的数量应增至24个。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The election of States Members of the Committee shall obey the principles of equitable geographical representation and rotation .
Translation: 选举委员会的国家成员应遵循公平的地域代表性及轮换原则。

Query_Text_en: 2 . States Members of the Committee shall be elected for a term of four years by States Parties to the Convention meeting in General Assembly .
Translation: 委员会成员国应由公约缔约国在缔约国大会上选举产生，任期四年。

Query_Text_en: 3 . However , the term of office of half of the States Members of the Committee elected at the first election is limited to two years .
Translation: 然而，首次选举产生的委员会半数成员国代表的任期限定为两年。

Query_Text_en: These States shall be chosen by lot at the first election .
Translation: 这些州将在首次选举中通过抽签方式选定。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Every two years , the General Assembly shall renew half of the States Members of the Committee .
Translation: 大会应每两年改选委员会半数成员国。

Query_Text_en: 5 . It shall also elect as many States Members of the Committee as required to fill vacancies .
Translation: 还应选举所需数量的委员会国家成员以填补空缺。

Query_Text_en: 6 . A State Member of the Committee may not be elected for two consecutive terms .
Translation: 6. 委员会成员国代表不得连任两届。

Query_Text_en: 7 . States Members of the Committee shall choose as their representatives persons who are qualified in the various fields of the intangible cultural heritage .
Translation: 委员会成员国应选定在非物质文化遗产各个领域具备资格的人员作为其代表。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] the granting of international assistance in accordance with Article 22 .
Translation: 根据第二十二条提供国际援助。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Committee shall be answerable to the General Assembly .
Translation: 委员会应向大会负责。

Query_Text_en: It shall report to it on all its activities and decisions .
Translation: 其应向其报告所有活动及决策。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Committee shall adopt its own Rules of Procedure by a two-thirds majority of its Members .
Translation: 委员会应以全体成员三分之二多数通过其议事规则。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Committee may establish , on a temporary basis , whatever ad hoc consultative bodies it deems necessary to carry out its task .
Translation: 委员会可根据需要，临时设立为履行其职责而认为必要的任何特别咨询机构。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Committee may invite to its meetings any public or private bodies , as well as private persons , with recognized competence in the various fields of the intangible cultural heritage , in order to consult them on specific matters .
Translation: 委员会可邀请在非物质文化遗产各领域具备公认专长的公共或私营机构及相关个人参加会议，以便就具体事项进行咨询。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Committee shall propose to the General Assembly the accreditation of nongovernmental organizations with recognized competence in the field of the intangible cultural heritage to act in an advisory capacity to the Committee .
Translation: 委员会应向大会提议，认可在非物质文化遗产领域具有公认专长的非政府组织以顾问身份为其提供咨询。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Committee shall also propose to the General Assembly the criteria for and modalities of such accreditation .
Translation: 委员会还应向大会提出此类认证的标准及具体实施方式的建议。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Committee shall be assisted by the UNESCO Secretariat .
Translation: 委员会应由联合国教科文组织秘书处提供协助。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Secretariat shall prepare the documentation of the General Assembly and of the Committee , as well as the draft agenda of their meetings , and shall ensure the implementation of their decisions .
Translation: 秘书处应负责准备大会和委员会的文件及会议议程草案，并确保其决定的落实。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] among the safeguarding measures referred to in Article 2 , paragraph 3 , identify and define the various elements of the intangible cultural heritage present in its territory , with the participation of communities , groups and relevant nongovernmental organizations .
Translation: 根据第二条第三款所述保护措施，应通过相关社区、群体及非政府组织的参与，识别和界定其领土范围内存在的各项非物质文化遗产要素。

Query_Text_en: 1 . To ensure identification with a view to safeguarding , each State Party shall draw up , in a manner geared to its own situation , one or more inventories of the intangible cultural heritage present in its territory . These inventories shall be regularly updated .
Translation: 为确保识别并开展保护工作，每个缔约国应根据自身情况制定在其领土范围内存在的非物质文化遗产的一个或多个名录。这些名录应定期更新。

Query_Text_en: 2 . When each State Party periodically submits its report to the Committee , in accordance with Article 29 , it shall provide relevant information on such inventories .
Translation: 各缔约国根据第29条向委员会提交定期报告时，应提供相关清单的有关信息。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] establishing documentation institutions for the intangible cultural heritage and facilitating access to them .
Translation: 建立非物质文化遗产档案机构并促进对其的利用。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] non-formal means of transmitting knowledge ;
Translation: [ iv ] 非正规知识传递方式；

Query_Text_en: [ c ] promote education for the protection of natural spaces and places of memory whose existence is necessary for expressing the intangible cultural heritage .
Translation: 推动教育工作，保护自然空间和承载记忆的场所，因其存在对于展现非物质文化遗产至关重要。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 15 Participation of communities , groups and individualsWithin the framework of its safeguarding activities of the intangible cultural heritage , each State Party shall endeavor to ensure the widest possible participation of communities , groups and , where appropriate , individuals that create , maintain and transmit such heritage , and to involve them actively in its management .
Translation: 第15条 非物质文化遗产保护中的社区、群体及个人参与 在非物质文化遗产保护活动中，各缔约国应努力确保最广泛地让创造、维护和传承此类遗产的社区、群体以及在适当情形下的个人参与其中，并积极邀其共同参与保护管理。

Query_Text_en: 1 . In order to ensure better visibility of the intangible cultural heritage and awareness of its significance , and to encourage dialogue which respects cultural diversity , the Committee , upon the proposal of the States Parties concerned , shall establish , keep up to date and publish a Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity .
Translation: 为提高非物质文化遗产的可见度及其重要性的认知，并促进尊重文化多样性的对话，委员会可根据相关缔约国的提议，建立并保持更新人类非物质文化遗产代表名录，同时予以公布。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Committee shall draw up and submit to the General Assembly for approval the criteria for the establishment , updating and publication of this Representative List .
Translation: 委员会应拟定并提交关于制定、更新和公布本代表名录的标准，供大会审议批准。

Query_Text_en: 1 . With a view to taking appropriate safeguarding measures , the Committee shall establish , keep up to date and publish a List of Intangible Cultural Heritage in Need of Urgent Safeguarding , and shall inscribe such heritage on the List at the request of the State Party concerned .
Translation: 为采取适当保护措施，委员会应建立、更新并公布《急需保护的非物质文化遗产名录》，并应有关缔约国请求将相关遗产列入名录。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Committee shall draw up and submit to the General Assembly for approval the criteria for the establishment , updating and publication of this List .
Translation: 委员会应制定并提交该清单制定、更新和公布的准则，供大会审议批准。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In cases of extreme urgency the objective criteria of which shall be approved by the General Assembly upon the proposal of the Committee the Committee may inscribe an item of the heritage concerned on the List mentioned in paragraph 1 , in consultation with the State Party concerned .
Translation: 在极端紧急情况下（其判定标准应由大会根据委员会的提议批准），委员会可经相关缔约国同意，将有关遗产项目列入本条第一款所述名录。

Query_Text_en: 1 . On the basis of proposals submitted by States Parties , and in accordance with criteria to be defined by the Committee and approved by the General Assembly , the Committee shall periodically select and promote national , subregional and regional programs , projects and activities for the safeguarding of the heritage which it considers best reflect the principles and objectives of this Convention , taking into account the special needs of developing countries .
Translation: 缔约国应根据提交的建议，并按照委员会制定并经大会批准的标准，定期遴选并推广国家级、次区域和区域层面的保护文化遗产的项目、计划和活动，这些内容应最能体现本公约的原则和目标，同时考虑到发展中国家的特殊需求。

Query_Text_en: 2 . To this end , it shall receive , examine and approve requests for international assistance from States Parties for the preparation of such proposals .
Translation: 2. 为此，它应受理、审查并批准缔约国为制定此类提案而提出的国际援助请求。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Committee shall accompany the implementation of such projects , programs and activities by disseminating best practices using means to be determined by it .
Translation: 委员会应通过推广最佳实践并采用其确定的方式，监督此类项目、方案和活动的实施。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of this Convention , international cooperation includes , inter alia , the exchange of information and experience , joint initiatives , and the establishment of a mechanism of assistance to States Parties in their efforts to safeguard the intangible cultural heritage .
Translation: 根据本公约，国际合作包括但不限于交流信息和经验、开展联合行动以及建立援助机制，以支持缔约国在保护非物质文化遗产方面的努力。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Without prejudice to the provisions of their national legislation and customary law and practices , the States Parties recognize that the safeguarding of intangible cultural heritage is of general interest to humanity , and to that end undertake to cooperate at the bilateral , subregional , regional and international levels .
Translation: 缔约各国确认，不影响其国家立法和习惯法及惯例的规定，承认保护非物质文化遗产对全人类具有普遍重要性，并为此目的承诺在双边、次区域、区域和国际层面开展合作。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] any other purpose the Committee may deem necessary .
Translation: （d）委员会认为必要的其他目的。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] other forms of financial and technical assistance , including , where appropriate , the granting of low-interest loans and donations .
Translation: 其他形式的财政和技术援助，包括在适当情况下提供低息贷款和捐赠等形式。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Committee shall establish the procedure for examining requests for international assistance , and shall specify what information shall be included in the requests , such as the measures envisaged and the interventions required , together with an assessment of their cost .
Translation: 委员会应制定审查国际援助请求的程序，并规定请求中应包含的信息，如拟采取的措施、所需采取的行动及相关费用评估。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In emergencies , requests for assistance shall be examined by the Committee as a matter of priority .
Translation: 在紧急情况下，援助请求应由委员会优先审议。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In order to reach a decision , the Committee shall undertake such studies and consultations as it deems necessary .
Translation: 为了作出决定，委员会应开展其认为必要的各项研究和磋商。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each State Party may submit to the Committee a request for international assistance for the safeguarding of the intangible cultural heritage present in its territory .
Translation: 每个缔约国均可向委员会提交一份请求，为其领土内的非物质文化遗产保护申请国际援助。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Such a request may also be jointly submitted by two or more States Parties .
Translation: 此类请求也可由两个或多个缔约方共同提交。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The request shall include the information stipulated in Article 22 , paragraph 1 , together with the necessary documentation .
Translation: 申请应包含第二十二条第一款规定的信息以及必要文件。

Query_Text_en: 1 . In conformity with the provisions of this Convention , the international assistance granted shall be regulated by means of an agreement between the beneficiary State Party and the Committee .
Translation: 根据本公约条款，所给予的国际援助应通过受援缔约国与委员会缔结的协议进行规范。

Query_Text_en: 2 . As a general rule , the beneficiary State Party shall , within the limits of its resources , share the cost of the safeguarding measures for which international assistance is provided .
Translation: 受益缔约国原则上应在其资源范围内分担国际援助所涉及的保护措施费用。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The beneficiary State Party shall submit to the Committee a report on the use made of the assistance provided for the safeguarding of the intangible cultural heritage .
Translation: 受益缔约国应向委员会提交所获援助用于保护非物质文化遗产的情况报告。

Query_Text_en: 1 . A `` Fund for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage '' , hereinafter referred to as `` the Fund '' , is hereby established .
Translation: 1. 现设立"非物质文化遗产保护基金"，以下简称"基金"。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Fund shall consist of funds-in-trust established in accordance with the Financial Regulations of UNESCO .
Translation: 该基金应由根据联合国教科文组织财务条例设立的信托基金组成。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] public or private bodies or individuals ;
Translation: [ Ⅲ ] 公共或私营机构以及个人；

Query_Text_en: [ f ] any other resources authorized by the Fund 's regulations , to be drawn up by the Committee .
Translation: 根据基金条例授权的其他资源，需由委员会制定。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The use of resources by the Committee shall be decided on the basis of guidelines laid down by the General Assembly .
Translation: 委员会对资源的使用应根据大会制定的指导原则作出决定。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The Committee may accept contributions and other forms of assistance for general and specific purposes relating to specific projects , provided that those projects have been approved by the Committee .
Translation: 委员会可接受用于一般和特定用途的捐赠及其他形式的援助，但前提是相关具体项目须经委员会批准。

Query_Text_en: 6 . No political , economic or other conditions which are incompatible with the objectives of this Convention may be attached to contributions made to the Fund .
Translation: 不得对基金的捐款附加任何与本公约目标相抵触的政治、经济或其他条件。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Without prejudice to any supplementary voluntary contribution , the States Parties to this Convention undertake to pay into the Fund , at least every two years , a contribution , the amount of which , in the form of a uniform percentage applicable to all States , shall be determined by the General Assembly .
Translation: 本公约缔约国在不影响任何补充自愿捐款的情况下，承诺至少每两年一次向基金缴纳费用。该费用金额将以统一适用于所有缔约国的固定百分比形式确定，具体比例由大会审议决定。

Query_Text_en: This decision of the General Assembly shall be taken by a majority of the States Parties present and voting which have not made the declaration referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article .
Translation: 本大会的此项决定应由未作出本条第二款所指声明的出席并投票的缔约国的多数票作出。

Query_Text_en: In no case shall the contribution of the State Party exceed 1 % of its contribution to the regular budget of UNESCO .
Translation: 缔约国缴纳的会费不得超过其对联合国教科文组织经常预算缴费额的1%。

Query_Text_en: 2 . However , each State referred to in Article 32 or in Article 33 of this Convention may declare , at the time of the deposit of its instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , that it shall not be bound by the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 2. 然而，本公约第32条或第33条所指的任何缔约国可在交存批准、接受、核准或加入文书时声明，不受本条第一款规定的约束。

Query_Text_en: 3 . A State Party to this Convention which has made the declaration referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article shall endeavor to withdraw the said declaration by notifying the Director-General of UNESCO .
Translation: 已作出本条第2款所述声明的本公约缔约国，应通过向联合国教科文组织总干事提交通知的方式撤回该声明。

Query_Text_en: However , the withdrawal of the declaration shall not take effect in regard to the contribution due by the State until the date on which the subsequent session of the General Assembly opens .
Translation: 然而，该声明的撤回对有关该国应缴纳的会费部分，直至随后一届大会开幕之日方才生效。

Query_Text_en: 4 . In order to enable the Committee to plan its operations effectively , the contributions of States Parties to this Convention which have made the declaration referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article shall be paid on a regular basis , at least every two years , and should be as close as possible to the contributions they would have owed if they had been bound by the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 为使委员会能够有效规划其工作，本公约缔约国如作出本条第2款所指声明，应定期缴纳会费，至少每两年一次，并应尽可能接近其若受本条第1款规定约束时应缴纳的数额。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Any State Party to this Convention which is in arrears with the payment of its compulsory or voluntary contribution for the current year and the calendar year immediately ? preceding it shall not be eligible as a Member of the Committee ; this provision shall not apply to the first election .
Translation: 本公约的任何缔约国，如果在当年及紧接其前的历年拖欠其应付的强制性会费或自愿捐款，即不具备当选委员会成员的资格；本规定不适用于首次选举。

Query_Text_en: The term of office of any such State which is already a Member of the Committee shall come to an end at the time of the elections provided for in Article 6 of this Convention .
Translation: 任何已经是委员会成员的此类国家的任期，应于本公约第六条规定的选举之时终止。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 27 Voluntary supplementary contributions to the FundStates Parties wishing to provide voluntary contributions in addition to those foreseen under Article 26 shall inform the Committee , as soon as possible , so as to enable it to plan its operations accordingly .
Translation: 第二十七条 对基金的自愿补充捐款缔约国希望在第二十六条规定的捐款之外向基金提供自愿补充捐款的，应当尽快通知委员会，以便其能够据此规划相关工作。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 28 International fund-raising campaignsThe States Parties shall , insofar as is possible , lend their support to international fund-raising campaigns organized for the benefit of the Fund under the auspices of UNESCO .
Translation: 第二十八条 国际募捐活动  缔约国应在力所能及的范围内，支持在联合国教育、科学及文化组织主持下为该基金举办的国际募捐活动。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 29 Reports by the States PartiesThe States Parties shall submit to the Committee , observing the forms and periodicity to be defined by the Committee , reports on the legislative , regulatory and other measures taken for the implementation of this Convention .
Translation: 缔约国应向委员会提交报告，报告的形式和提交周期由委员会规定，内容涉及为履行本公约而采取的立法、监管及其他措施。

Query_Text_en: 1 . On the basis of its activities and the reports by States Parties referred to in Article 29 , the Committee shall submit a report to the General Assembly at each of its sessions .
Translation: 委员会应根据其活动情况及根据第二十九条所述缔约国提交的报告，在其每次会议期间向大会提交一份报告。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The report shall be brought to the attention of the General Conference of UNESCO .
Translation: 该报告应提请联合国教科文组织大会审议。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Committee shall incorporate in the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity the items proclaimed `` Masterpieces of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity '' before the entry into force of this Convention .
Translation: 委员会应将本公约生效前被指定为“人类口头和非物质遗产代表作”的项目纳入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The incorporation of these items in the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity shall in no way prejudge the criteria for future inscriptions decided upon in accordance with Article 16 , paragraph 2 .
Translation: 将这些项目列入人类非物质文化遗产代表作名录，绝不应被视为预先判断未来列入标准，这些标准将根据《保护非物质文化遗产公约》第十六条第二款作出的决定。

Query_Text_en: 3 . No further Proclamation will be made after the entry into force of this Convention .
Translation: 本公约生效后，不再发布进一步的公告。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Convention shall be subject to ratification , acceptance or approval by States Members of UNESCO in accordance with their respective constitutional procedures .
Translation: 本公约应由联合国教科文组织成员国依照各自的宪法程序予以批准、接受或核准。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The instruments of ratification , acceptance or approval shall be deposited with the Director-General of UNESCO .
Translation: 批准书、接受书或认可书应交存于联合国教科文组织总干事处。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Convention shall be open to accession by all States not Members of UNESCO that are invited by the General Conference of UNESCO to accede to it .
Translation: 本公约应开放供所有未成为联合国教科文组织成员国且经该组织大会邀请的国家加入。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Convention shall also be open to accession by territories which enjoy full internal self-government recognized as such by the United Nations , but have not attained full independence in accordance with General Assembly resolution 1514 [ XV ] , and which have competence over the matters governed by this Convention , including the competence to enter into treaties in respect of such matters .
Translation: 本公约亦应开放供享有联合国承认的完全内部自治权、但尚未根据大会第1514（XV）号决议获得完全独立的领土加入，但此类领土须对其所管辖的本公约规范事项拥有管辖权，包括就此类事项缔结条约的权限。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The instrument of accession shall be deposited with the Director-General of UNESCO .
Translation: 加入书应交存联合国教科文组织总干事处。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 34 Entry into forceThis Convention shall enter into force three months after the date of the deposit of the thirtieth instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , but only with respect to those States that have deposited their respective instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval , or accession on or before that date .
Translation: 本公约应于第三十份批准、接受、核准或加入文书交存之日起三个月后生效，但仅对在该日期或之前已经交存其批准、接受、核准或加入文书的缔约国生效。

Query_Text_en: It shall enter into force with respect to any other State Party three months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation: 本公约对其他任何缔约国应于该国交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书之日起三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] with regard to the provisions of this Convention , the implementation of which comes under the jurisdiction of individual constituent States , countries , provinces or cantons which are not obliged by the constitutional system of the federation to take legislative measures , the federal government shall inform the competent authorities of such States , countries , provinces or cantons of the said provisions with its recommendation for their adoption .
Translation: 关于本公约条款中属于联邦成员单位、国家、省或州管辖范围内的实施事项，相关国家、省或州根据联邦宪法体系无需采取立法措施的，联邦政府应将上述条款通知相关成员单位、国家、省或州的主管机关，并提出建议供其采纳。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each State Party may denounce this Convention .
Translation: 每一缔约国均有权退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The denunciation shall be notified by an instrument in writing , deposited with the Director-General of UNESCO .
Translation: 终止通知应以书面形式提交，并存档于联合国教科文组织总干事处。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The denunciation shall take effect twelve months after the receipt of the instrument of denunciation .
Translation: 本声明退出应自收到撤销通知书之日起十二个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: It shall in no way affect the financial obligations of the denouncing State Party until the date on which the withdrawal takes effect .
Translation: 在退出生效之前，不会以任何方式影响声明退出的缔约方的财政义务。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 37 Depositary functionsThe Director-General of UNESCO , as the Depositary of this Convention , shall inform the States Members of the Organization , the States not Members of the Organization referred to in Article 33 , as well as the United Nations , of the deposit of all the instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession provided for in Articles 32 and 33 , and of the denunciations provided for in Article 36 .
Translation: 第三十七条 保管职能  联合国教科文组织总干事作为本公约的保管人，应就第三十二条和第三十三条所规定之所有批准、接受、赞同或加入文书的交存，以及第三十六条所规定的退出通知书，通知本组织成员国、第三十三条中所指的非本组织成员国，并通报联合国。

Query_Text_en: 1 . A State Party may , by written communication addressed to the Director-General , propose amendments to this Convention .
Translation: 缔约国可向总干事提交书面通知，提议对本公约进行修正。

Query_Text_en: The Director-General shall circulate such communication to all States Parties .
Translation: 总干事应将相关文件分发给所有缔约国。

Query_Text_en: If , within six months from the date of the circulation of the communication , not less than one half of the States Parties reply favourably to the request , the Director-General shall present such proposal to the next session of the General Assembly for discussion and possible adoption .
Translation: 如果在文件分发之日起六个月内，缔约国中至少半数表示同意该请求，总干事应将该提案提交大会下一次会议供讨论及可能通过。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Amendments shall be adopted by a two-thirds majority of States Parties present and voting .
Translation: 修正案应由出席并投票的缔约国以三分之二多数票通过。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Once adopted , amendments to this Convention shall be submitted for ratification , acceptance , approval or accession to the States Parties .
Translation: 一旦通过，本公约的修正案应提交各缔约国批准、接受、核准或加入。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Amendments shall enter into force , but solely with respect to the States Parties that have ratified , accepted , approved or acceded to them , three months after the deposit of the instruments referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article by two-thirds of the States Parties .
Translation: 本议定书的修正案应予生效，但仅适用于已批准、接受、核准或加入该修正案的缔约方。修正案应在本条第3款所述文件由三分之二缔约方交存后三个月生效。

Query_Text_en: Thereafter , for each State Party that ratifies , accepts , approves or accedes to an amendment , the said amendment shall enter into force three months after the date of deposit by that State Party of its instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation: 对于每一缔约国批准、接受、认可或加入修正案的情况，该修正案应自该缔约国交存其批准书、接受书、认可书或加入书之日起满三个月后对其生效。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The procedure set out in paragraphs 3 and 4 shall not apply to amendments to Article 5 concerning the number of States Members of the Committee .
Translation: 第三和第四段所述程序不适用于对涉及委员会成员国名额的第五条所作的修正。

Query_Text_en: These amendments shall enter into force at the time they are adopted .
Translation: 这些修正案应自通过之时起生效。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] as a Party to the unamended Convention in relation to any State Party not bound by the amendments .
Translation: 并作为缔约方，在与任何不受修正案约束的缔约国关系中，适用未经修正的公约。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 39 Authoritative textsThis Convention has been drawn up in Arabic , Chinese , English , French , Russian and Spanish , the six texts being equally authoritative .
Translation: 本公约以阿拉伯语、中文、英语、法语、俄语和西班牙语六种文本制定，六种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 40 RegistrationIn conformity with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations , this Convention shall be registered with the Secretariat of the United Nations at the request of the Director-General of UNESCO .
Translation: 根据联合国宪章第102条，本公约应按照联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事的请求，在联合国秘书处登记。

Query_Text_en: Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions [ October 20 , 2005 ] IntroductionThe General Conference of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization , meeting in Paris from 3 to 21 October 2005 at its 33rd session ,
Translation:
《保护和促进文化表现形式多样性公约》[2005年10月20日] 序言  
联合国教育、科学及文化组织大会第三十三届会议于2005年10月3日至21日在巴黎举行，

Query_Text_en: 21 . Referring to the provisions of the international instruments adopted by UNESCO relating to cultural diversity and the exercise of cultural rights , and in particular the Universal Declaration on Cultural Diversity of 2001 , Adopts this Convention on 20 October 2005 .
Translation: 参照联合国教科文组织通过的涉及文化多样性和文化权利行使的国际文件，特别是2001年的《文化多样性宣言》，于2005年10月20日通过本公约。

Query_Text_en: 9 . to strengthen international cooperation and solidarity in a spirit of partnership with a view , in particular , to enhancing the capacities of developing countries in order to protect and promote the diversity of cultural expressions .
Translation: 9. 加强国际合作与团结，秉持伙伴关系精神，特别是为了提升发展中国家的能力，以保护和促进文化表达多样性。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Principle of respect for human rights and fundamental freedomsCultural diversity can be protected and promoted only if human rights and fundamental freedoms , such as freedom of expression , information and communication , as well as the ability of individuals to choose cultural expressions , are guaranteed .
Translation:
尊重人权和基本自由的原则  
文化多样性唯有在人权和基本自由得到保障的情况下才能得到有效保护和促进，其中包括言论自由、信息自由、交流自由，以及个人选择文化表达形式的权利。

Query_Text_en: No one may invoke the provisions of this Convention in order to infringe human rights and fundamental freedoms as enshrined in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights or guaranteed by international law , or to limit the scope thereof .
Translation: 任何人不得援引本公约的规定，以侵犯《世界人权宣言》所载明或国际法所保障的人权和基本自由，或限制其范围。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Principle of sovereigntyStates have , in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations and the principles of international law , the sovereign right to adopt measures and policies to protect and promote the diversity of cultural expressions within their territory .
Translation: 主权原则：各国根据《联合国宪章》和国际法原则，享有在其境内采取措施和制定政策以保护和促进文化表现形式多样性的主权权利。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Principle of equal dignity of and respect for all culturesThe protection and promotion of the diversity of cultural expressions presuppose the recognition of equal dignity of and respect for all cultures , including the cultures of persons belonging to minorities and indigenous peoples .
Translation:
所有文化的平等尊严与尊重原则  
保护和促进文化表达多样性，以承认所有文化的平等尊严与尊重为前提，其中包括少数民族和原住民的文化。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Principle of international solidarity and cooperationInternational cooperation and solidarity should be aimed at enabling countries , especially developing countries , to create and strengthen their means of cultural expression , including their cultural industries , whether nascent or established , at the local , national and international levels .
Translation: 国际团结与合作原则应致力于帮助各国，特别是发展中国家，在地方、国家和国际层面创建并加强其文化表达手段，包括无论新兴还是已有的文化产业。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Principle of the complementarity of economic and cultural aspects of developmentSince culture is one of the mainsprings of development , the cultural aspects of development are as important as its economic aspects , which individuals and peoples have the fundamental right to participate in and enjoy .
Translation:
经济发展中经济与文化方面的互补性原则  
由于文化是发展的主要动力源泉之一，发展中的文化方面与经济方面同样重要，个人和民族均享有平等参与并从中受益的基本权利。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Principle of sustainable developmentCultural diversity is a rich asset for individuals and societies .
Translation:
6. 可持续发展原则  
文化多样性是个人和社会的宝贵财富。

Query_Text_en: The protection , promotion and maintenance of cultural diversity are an essential requirement for sustainable development for the benefit of present and future generations .
Translation: 保护、促进和传承文化多样性是惠及现在和子孙后代的可持续发展之必要条件。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Principle of equitable accessEquitable access to a rich and diversified range of cultural expressions from all over the world and access of cultures to the means of expressions and dissemination constitute important elements for enhancing cultural diversity and encouraging mutual understanding .
Translation: 公平获取世界各地丰富多样的文化表达形式，以及各国文化获取表达和传播手段的机会，是促进文化多样性和增进相互理解的重要因素。

Query_Text_en: 8 . Principle of openness and balanceWhen States adopt measures to support the diversity of cultural expressions , they should seek to promote , in an appropriate manner , openness to other cultures of the world and to ensure that these measures are geared to the objectives pursued under the present Convention .
Translation:
开放与平衡原则  
缔约方在采取措施支持文化表现形式多样性时，应以适当方式促进与其他文化的开放交流，并确保这些措施符合本公约所追求的目标。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 C Scope of applicationThis Convention shall apply to the policies and measures adopted by the Parties related to the protection and promotion of the diversity of cultural expressions .
Translation: 本公约适用于缔约方采取的与保护和促进文化表现形式多样性相关的政策和措施。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Cultural diversity `` Cultural diversity '' refers to the manifold ways in which the cultures of groups and societies find expression .
Translation: "文化多样性"指各类群体和社会的文化得以展现的多种多样的形式和途径。

Query_Text_en: These expressions are passed on within and among groups and societies .
Translation: 这些表达在群体内部以及不同社会之间得以传承。

Query_Text_en: Cultural diversity is made manifest not only through the varied ways in which the cultural heritage of humanity is expressed , augmented and transmitted through the variety of cultural expressions , but also through diverse modes of artistic creation , production , dissemination , distribution and enjoyment , whatever the means and technologies used .
Translation: 文化多样性不仅通过人类文化遗产以各种方式表达、丰富和传承的过程得以体现——这一过程依托于多样化的文化表现形式，同时也通过艺术创作、生产、传播、推广和欣赏的多种模式得以展现，无论采用何种技术手段。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Cultural content `` Cultural content '' refers to the symbolic meaning , artistic dimension and cultural values that originate from or express cultural identities .
Translation: “文化内容”指的是源自或体现特定文化身份的象征意义、艺术层面和文化价值。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Cultural expressions `` Cultural expressions '' are those expressions that result from the creativity of individuals , groups and societies , and that have cultural content .
Translation: 3. 文化表达  "文化表达"是指那些源于个人、群体和社会的创造力，并且具有文化内涵的表达形式。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Cultural activities , goods and services `` Cultural activities , goods and services '' refers to those activities , goods and services , which at the time they are considered as a specific attribute , use or purpose , embody or convey cultural expressions , irrespective of the commercial value they may have .
Translation: “文化活动、商品及服务”指在被视为具有特定属性、用途或目的时，体现或传达文化表达的活动、商品及服务，不论其可能具有的商业价值。

Query_Text_en: Cultural activities may be an end in themselves , or they may contribute to the production ofcultural goods and services .
Translation: 文化活动本身可能是目的，也可能促进文化产品和服务的生产。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Cultural industries `` Cultural industries '' refers to industries producing and distributing cultural goods or services as defined in paragraph 4 above .
Translation: “文化产业”是指如上文第4段所定义的文化产品的生产和分销，或文化服务的提供行业。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Cultural policies and measures `` Cultural policies and measures '' refers to those policies and measures relating to culture , whether at the local , national , regional or international level that are either focused on culture as such or are designed to have a direct effect on cultural expressions of individuals , groups or societies , including on the creation , production , dissemination , distribution of and access to cultural activities , goods and services .
Translation: "文化政策与措施"是指在地方、国家、区域或国际层面上与文化相关的各类政策与措施，具体包括：以文化本身为核心目标的政策与措施，或旨在直接作用于个人、群体或社会文化表达的政策与措施，其内容涉及文化活动、产品及服务的创作、生产、传播、分配以及获取渠道的建立。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Protection `` Protection '' means the adoption of measures aimed at the preservation , safeguarding and enhancement of the diversity of cultural expressions .
Translation: 7. 保护 "保护"是指采取旨在保存、保护和提升文化表现形式多样性的措施。

Query_Text_en: `` Protect '' means to adopt such measures .
Translation: “保护”系指采取此类措施。

Query_Text_en: 8 . Interculturality `` Interculturality '' refers to the existence and equitable interaction of diverse cultures and the possibility of generating shared cultural expressions through dialogue and mutual respect .
Translation: 跨国文化共存性是指多元文化的存在和平等互动，以及通过对话与相互尊重产生共同文化表达的可能性。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Parties , in conformity with the Charter of the United Nations , the principles of international law and universally recognized human rights instruments , reaffirm their sovereign right to formulate and implement their cultural policies and to adopt measures to protect and promote the diversity of cultural expressions and to strengthen international cooperation to achieve the purposes of this Convention .
Translation: 缔约方根据《联合国宪章》、国际法原则以及普遍认可的人权文书，重申其有权自主制定和实施文化政策，并采取措施保护和促进文化表现形式的多样性，同时加强国际合作以实现本公约的目标。

Query_Text_en: 2 . When a Party implements policies and takes measures to protect and promote the diversity of cultural expressions within its territory , its policies and measures shall be consistent with the provisions of this Convention .
Translation: 缔约方在其领土范围内实施保护和促进文化表现形式多样性的政策和措施时，其相关政策和措施应符合本公约的规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Within the framework of its cultural policies and measures as defined in Article 4 . 6 and taking into account its own particular circumstances and needs , each Party may adopt measures aimed at protecting and promoting the diversity of cultural expressions within its territory .
Translation: 每一缔约方可在第四条第六款所界定的文化政策和措施框架内，并考虑到自身的特殊情况和需求，采取旨在保护和促进其领土内文化表达多样性的措施。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] measures aimed at enhancing diversity of the media , including through public service broadcasting .
Translation: [8] 增强媒体多样性的措施，包括通过公共服务广播。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] to have access to diverse cultural expressions from within their territory as well as from other countries of the world .
Translation: 能够接触到来自其境内及世界各地的多样化文化表达形式。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Parties shall also endeavor to recognize the important contribution of artists , others involved in the creative process , cultural communities , and organizations that support their work , and their central role in nurturing the diversity of cultural expressions .
Translation: 缔约方还应努力认可艺术家、参与创作过程的其他人员、文化社群以及支持其工作的组织所作出的重要贡献，并肯定他们在培育文化表达多样性方面所发挥的核心作用。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Without prejudice to the provisions of Articles 5 and 6 , a Party may determine the existence of special situations where cultural expressions on its territory are at risk of extinction , under serious threat , or otherwise in need of urgent safeguarding .
Translation: 不影响第五条和第六条的规定，一缔约方可以认定在其领土内存在文化表现形式濒临灭绝、面临严重威胁或其他需要紧急保护的情形。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Parties may take all appropriate measures to protect and preserve cultural expressions in situations referred to in paragraph 1 in a manner consistent with the provisions of this Convention .
Translation: 缔约方可采取一切适当的措施，在本条第1款所述情形下，以符合本公约规定的方式保护和保存文化表现形式。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Parties shall report to the Intergovernmental Committee referred to in Article 23 all measures taken to meet the exigencies of the situation , and the Committee may make appropriate recommendations .
Translation: 缔约方应向第二十三条所指的政府间委员会报告为应对紧急情况所采取的各项措施，该委员会可提出适当建议。

Query_Text_en: 3 . share and exchange information relating to the protection and promotion of the diversity of cultural expressions .
Translation: 分享和交流关于保护和促进文化表达多样性的信息。

Query_Text_en: 3 . endeavor to encourage creativity and strengthen production capacities by setting up educational , training and exchange programs in the field of cultural industries . These measures should be implemented in a manner which does not have a negative impact on traditional forms of production .
Translation: 通过设立文化产业领域的教育、培训和交流项目，努力激发创造力、提升生产能力。这些措施应以不对其传统生产方式造成负面影响的方式实施。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 C Participation of civil societyParties acknowledge the fundamental role of civil society in protecting and promoting the diversity of cultural expressions .
Translation: 第11条C款 民间社会的参与缔约方确认民间社会在保护和促进文化表现形式多样性方面发挥的基础性作用。

Query_Text_en: Parties shall encourage the active participation of civil society in their efforts to achieve the objectives of this Convention .
Translation: 缔约方应鼓励民间社会在其为实现本公约目标所作的努力中积极参与。

Query_Text_en: 5 . encourage the conclusion of co-production and co-distribution agreements .
Translation: 5. 推动达成合拍与联合发行协议。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 C Integration of culture in sustainable developmentParties shall endeavor to integrate culture in their development policies at all levels for the creation of conditions conducive to sustainable development and , within this framework , foster aspects relating to the protection and promotion of the diversity of cultural expressions .
Translation:
第十三条C款 文化与可持续发展之融合  
缔约方应努力在其各层面的发展政策中融入文化元素，以创造有利于可持续发展的条件，并在此框架下促进与保护及促进文化表现形式多样性相关的方面。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] encouraging appropriate collaboration between developed and developing countries in the areas , inter alia , of music and film ;
Translation: [6] 鼓励发达国家与发展中国家在音乐、电影等领域开展适宜的合作（其中包括）。

Query_Text_en: 2 . capacity-building through the exchange of information , experience and expertise , as well as the training of human resources in developing countries , in the public and private sector relating to , inter alia , strategic and management capacities , policy development and implementation , promotion and distribution of cultural expressions , small - , medium - and micro-enterprise development , the use of technology , and skills development and transfer ;
Translation: 通过发展中国家公共和私营部门间的信息、经验及专业知识交流，以及人力资源培训，加强能力建设，涵盖但不限于战略与管理能力、政策制定与实施、文化产品推广与传播、中小企业及微型企业培育、技术应用、技能开发与转移等领域。

Query_Text_en: 3 . technology transfer through the introduction of appropriate incentive measures for the transfer of technology and know-how , especially in the areas of cultural industries and enterprises ;
Translation: 通过制定适当激励措施，推动技术及专有技术转让，特别是在文化产业和企业领域。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] other forms of financial assistance such as low interest loans , grants and other funding mechanisms .
Translation: [3] 其他形式的财政援助，例如低息贷款、补助金及其他资金机制。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 C Collaborative arrangementsParties shall encourage the development of partnerships , between and within the public and private sectors and non-profit organizations , in order to cooperate with developing countries in the enhancement of their capacities in the protection and promotion of the diversity of cultural expressions .
Translation:
第十五条之三 协作安排  
缔约方应当鼓励公共和私营部门内部和之间以及非营利组织之间建立伙伴关系，以加强发展中国家在保护和促进文化表达多样性方面的能力。

Query_Text_en: These innovative partnerships shall , according to the practical needs of developing countries , emphasize the further development of infrastructure , human resources and policies , as well as the exchange of cultural activities , goods and services .
Translation: 这些创新伙伴关系应根据发展中国家的实际需求，重点推进基础设施、人力资源和政策的进一步发展，以及促进文化交流活动和商品服务的交换。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 C Preferential treatment for developing countriesDeveloped countries shall facilitate cultural exchanges with developing countries by granting , through the appropriate institutional and legal frameworks , preferential treatment to artists and other cultural professionals and practitioners , as well as cultural goods and services from developing countries .
Translation:
第十六条之三 对发展中国家的优惠待遇  
发达国家应通过适当的制度和法律框架，对来自发展中国家的艺术家、其他文化专业人员及从业者，以及文化产品和服务，给予优惠待遇，以促进与发展中国家的文化交流。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 C International cooperation in situations of serious threat to cultural expressionsParties shall cooperate in providing assistance to each other , and , in particular to developing countries , in situations referred to under Article 8 .
Translation:
第十七条之三 文化表达面临严重威胁情形下的国际合作  
缔约国应相互提供援助，并特别向发展中国家提供援助，以应对本公约第八条所述情形。

Query_Text_en: 1 . An International Fund for Cultural Diversity , hereinafter referred to as the Fund , is hereby established .
Translation: 现设立国际文化多样性基金，以下简称"该基金"。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] any other resources authorized by the Fund 's regulations .
Translation: [6] 基金章程授权的其他任何资源。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The use of resources of the Fund shall be decided by the Intergovernmental Committee on the basis of guidelines determined by the Conference of Parties referred to in Article 22 .
Translation: 基金资源的使用应由政府间委员会根据缔约方大会在第22条中所提及的指导原则作出决定。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The Intergovernmental Committee may accept contributions and other forms of assistance for general and specific purposes relating to specific projects , provided that those projects have been approved by it .
Translation: 政府间委员会可接受用于一般及具体项目的捐款和其他形式的援助，前提是相关项目已获其批准。

Query_Text_en: 6 . No political , economic or other conditions that are incompatible with the objectives of this Convention may be attached to contributions made to the Fund .
Translation: 不得向对基金的出资附加任何与本公约目标不相容的政治、经济或其他条件。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Parties shall endeavor to provide voluntary contributions on a regular basis towards the implementation of this Convention .
Translation: 缔约方应定期提供自愿捐款，以履行本公约。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Parties agree to exchange information and share expertise concerning data collection and statistics on the diversity of cultural expressions as well as on best practices for its protection and promotion .
Translation: 各方同意就文化表现形式多样性的数据收集和统计工作，以及对其保护和推广的最佳实践交换信息、分享专长。

Query_Text_en: 2 . UNESCO shall facilitate , through the use of existing mechanisms within the Secretariat , the collection , analysis and dissemination of all relevant information , statistics and best practices .
Translation: 联合国教科文组织应通过教科文组织秘书处现有机制，促进收集、分析和传播所有相关的信息、统计数据及最佳实践。

Query_Text_en: 3 . UNESCO shall also establish and update a data bank on different sectors and governmental , private and non-profit organizations involved in the area of cultural expressions .
Translation: 联合国教科文组织还应建立并更新相关数据库，涵盖从事文化表现形式领域的不同行业及政府部门、私营机构及非营利组织。

Query_Text_en: 4 . To facilitate the collection of data , UNESCO shall pay particular attention to capacity-building and the strengthening of expertise for Parties that submit a request for such assistance .
Translation: 4. 为促进数据收集工作，联合国教科文组织应特别关注缔约方提出的能力建设及专业支持需求，并为其提供相应援助。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The collection of information identified in this Article shall complement the information collected under the provisions of Article 9 .
Translation: 本条所规定的信息收集应补充根据本公约第九条所收集的信息。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Parties recognize that they shall perform in good faith their obligations under this Convention and all other treaties to which they are parties .
Translation: 缔约方确认，其应根据本公约及作为缔约方的所有其他条约，以诚实信用原则履行义务。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] when interpreting and applying the other treaties to which they are parties or when entering into other international obligations , Parties shall take into account the relevant provisions of this Convention .
Translation: 缔约方在解释和适用其作为缔约方的其他条约或在缔结其他国际义务时，应考虑本公约的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Nothing in this Convention shall be interpreted as modifying rights and obligations of the Parties under any other treaties to which they are parties .
Translation: 本公约的任何规定均不得解释为修改缔约方在其他条约项下的权利和义务。
