Translation: 如果该罪行是在航空器登记国以外的另一国领土内实施的。

Query_Text_en: 3 Notwithstanding paragraph 2 of this Article , in the cases contemplated in subparagraphs a , b , c and e of paragraph 1 of Article 1 this Convention shall also apply if the offender or the alleged offender is found in the territory of a State other than the State of registration of the aircraft
Translation: 本公约亦应适用于本公约第一条第一款a、b、c和e项所规定的情形，即使犯罪者或涉嫌犯罪者位于航空器登记国以外的缔约国领土内，本条第2款规定不适用此类情况。

Query_Text_en: 4 With respect to the States mentioned in Article 9 and in the cases mentioned in subparagraphs a , b , c and e of paragraph 1 of Article 1 this Convention shall not apply if the places referred to in subparagraph a of paragraph 2 of this Article are situated within the territory of the same State where that State is one of those referred to in Article 9 , unless the offence is committed or the offender or alleged offender is found in the territory of a State other than that State
Translation: 本公约在涉及第九条所指国家以及第一条第一款a、b、c及e项所列情形时，若本条第二款a项所指地点位于同一国家境内且该国属于第九条所指国家，则本公约不适用，除非犯罪行为发生于或被指称的犯罪人发现于本公约第九条所指其他国家的领土内。

Query_Text_en: 5 In the cases contemplated in subparagraph d of paragraph 1 of Article 1 , this Convention shall apply only if the air navigation facilities are used in international air navigation
Translation: 在第一条第一款第（d）项所规定的情况下，本公约仅在航空导航设施用于国际航空运输时适用。

Query_Text_en: 6 The provisions of paragraphs 2 3 4 and 5 of this Article shall also apply in the cases contemplated in paragraph 2 of Article 1
Translation: 本条第2、3、4、5款的规定，同样适用于《本协议》第一条第2款所规定的情形。

Query_Text_en: d when the offence is committed against or on board an aircraft leased without crew to a lessee who has his principal place of business or , if the lessee has no such place of business , his permanent residence , in that State
Translation: 当犯罪行为针对或发生在由承租人以干租方式租赁的航空器上时，若该承租人的主要营业地位于该国，或承租人无主要营业地则其永久居所位于该国，则适用本条款。

Query_Text_en: 2 Each Contracting State shall likewise take such measures as may be necessary to establish its jurisdiction over the offences mentioned in Article 1 , paragraph 1 a , b and c , and in Article 1 , paragraph 2 , in so far as that paragraph relates to those offences , in the case where the alleged offender is present in its territory and it doesnot extradite him pursuant to Article 8 to any of the States mentioned in paragraph l of this Article
Translation: 每一缔约国应当同样采取必要措施，确立其对《公约》第一条第一款a、b、c项以及第一条第二款（涉及上述罪行的部分）所列罪行的管辖权。情形为：当被指控的犯罪行为人存在于其领土内，且该缔约国根据本条第1段所列国家未依据第八条将其引渡时。

Query_Text_en: 3 This Convention does not exclude any criminal jurisdiction exercised in accordance with national law
Translation: 本公约不排除任何根据国内法行使的刑事管辖权。

Query_Text_en: 1 Upon being satisfied that the circumstances so warrant , any Contracting State in the territory of which the offender or the alleged offender is present , shall take him into custody or take other measures to ensure his presence The custody and other measures shall be as provided in the law of that State but may only be continued for such time as is necessary to enable any criminal or extradition proceedings to be instituted
Translation: 缔约国确信情况确实需要时，若在其领土内发现罪犯或涉嫌犯罪者，应予以羁押或采取其他措施确保其到场。此类羁押及其他措施应依该国法律规定执行，但仅可维持至启动刑事诉讼或引渡程序所需时间。

Query_Text_en: 2 Such State shall immediately make a preliminary enquiry into the facts
Translation: 该国应立即对事实进行初步调查。

Query_Text_en: 3 Any person in custody pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article shall be assisted in communicating immediatelywiththenearestappropriate representativeoftheStateofwhich he is a national
Translation: 根据本条第一款被羁押的任何人员，应获得协助立即与所属国家最近的适当代表取得联系。

Query_Text_en: 4 When a State , pursuant to this Article , has taken a person into custody , it shall immediately notify the State mentioned in Article 5 , paragraph 1 , the State of nationality of the detained person and , if it considers it advisable , any other interested States of the fact that such person is in custody and of the circumstances which warrant his detention The State which makes the preliminary enquiry contemplated in paragraph 2 of this Article shall promptly report its findings to the said States and shall indicate whether it intends to exercise jurisdiction
Translation: 根据本条规定羁押某人的缔约国，应立即通知本公约第五条第一款所述国家、被羁押者的国籍国以及如其认为必要时其他有关国家，告知该人已被羁押及其羁押的依据情况。本条第二款规定的进行初步调查的缔约国，应将其调查结果及时通报上述国家，并表明是否拟行使管辖权。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 The Contracting State in the territory of which the alleged offender is found shall , if it does not extradite him , be obliged , without exception whatsoever and whether or not the offence was committed in its territory , to submit the case to its competent authorities for the purpose of prosecution Those authorities shall take their decision in the same manner as in the case of any ordinary offence of a serious nature under the law of that State
Translation: 第七条 被发现的缔约国如不将其引渡，无论该罪行是否在其境内实施，均须无一例外地将案件提交其主管机关进行侦查。该主管机关应当按照该国法律对于普通刑事罪中的严重犯罪作出同样处理。

Query_Text_en: 1 The offences shall be deemed to be included as extraditable offences in any extradition treaty existing between Contracting States Contracting States undertake to include the offences as extraditable offences in every extradition treaty to be concluded between them
Translation: 本条所指罪行应视为已包含在缔约国之间现存的任何引渡条约中作为可引渡的罪行。缔约国承诺在其间缔结的每一项引渡条约中将此类罪行列为可引渡的罪行。

Query_Text_en: 2 If a Contracting State which makes extradition conditional on the existence of a treaty receives a request for extradition from another Contracting State with which it has no extradition treaty , it may at its option consider this Convention as the legal basis for extradition in respect of the offences Extradition shall be subject to the other conditions provided by the law of the requested State
Translation: 如果某一将引渡以存在协约为条件的缔约国收到与其没有引渡条约的另一缔约国提出的引渡请求，其可自行决定将本公约视为针对相关犯罪行为的引渡法律依据。引渡应受被请求国法律规定的其他条件约束。

Query_Text_en: 3 Contracting States which do not make extradition conditional on the existence of a treaty shall recognize the offences as extraditable offences between themselves subject to the conditions provided by the law of the requested State
Translation: 不以存在引渡条约为引渡条件的缔约国，应在彼此间将相关罪行视为可引渡的犯罪，但须遵守被请求国法律规定的条件。

Query_Text_en: 4 Each of the offences shall be treated , for the purpose of extradition between Contracting States , as if it had been committed not only in the place in which it occurred but also in the territories of the States required to establish their jurisdiction in accordance with Article 5 , paragraph 1 b , c and d
Translation: 在缔约国之间进行引渡时，每一项罪行均应被视为不仅发生在其实际发生地，同时也发生在根据第五条第一款b、c、d项规定应确立管辖权的缔约国领土内。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 The Contracting States which establish joint air transport operating organizations or international operating agencies , which operate aircraft which are subject to joint or international registration shall , by appropriate means , designate for each aircraft the State among them which shall exercise the jurisdiction and have the attributes of the State of registration for the purpose of this Convention and shall give notice thereof to the International Civil Aviation Organization which shall communicate the notice to all States Parties to this Convention
Translation: 第九条 建立联合航空运输经营机构或国际经营机构并运营适用联合或国际登记的航空器的缔约国，对于每架航空器，应通过适当方式指定其中一国行使本公约规定的管辖权并具备登记国的属性，并应将此指定通知国际民用航空组织，该组织应将通知转告所有公约缔约国。

Query_Text_en: 1 Contracting States shall in accordance with international and national law , endeavor to take all practicable measures for the purpose of preventing the offences mentioned in Article 1
Translation: 缔约国应根据国际法和国内法，采取一切可行措施，以防止第一条所列的犯罪行为。

Query_Text_en: 2 When due to the commission of one of the offences mentioned in Article 1 , a flight has been delayed or interrupted , any Contracting State in whose territory the aircraft or passengers or crew are present shall facilitate the continuation of the journey of the passengers and crew as soon as practicable and shall without delay return the aircraft and its cargo to the persons lawfully entitled to possession
Translation: 当由于实施了第一条所列罪行而导致航班延误或中断时，航空器或其乘客、机组人员所在领土的任何缔约国均应尽快协助继续行程，并立即向合法拥有权人归还航空器及其货物。

Query_Text_en: 1 Contracting States shall afford one another the greatest measure of assistance in connection with criminal proceedings brought in respect of the offences The law of the State requested shall apply in all cases
Translation: 缔约国应相互提供最大程度的协助，涉及有关犯罪行为提起的刑事诉讼事项。被请求国的法律应适用于所有案件。

Query_Text_en: 2 The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall not affect obligations under any other treaty , bilateral or multilateral , which governs or will govern , in whole or in part , mutual assistance in criminal matters
Translation: 本条第一款的规定不应影响任何其他双边或多边条约下的义务，这些条约目前或将来在全部或部分范围内规定刑事事项中的相互法律协助。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 Any Contracting State having reason to believe that one of the offences mentioned in Article 1 will be committed shall in accordance with its national law furnish any relevant information in its possession to those States which it believes would be the States mentioned in Article 5 paragraph 1
Translation: 第十二条 任何有理由相信本公约第一条所列罪行即将实施的缔约国，应当根据其国内法，向其认为可能是公约第五条第一款所指的国家提供其掌握的相关信息。

Query_Text_en: c the measures taken in relation to the offender or the alleged offender and , in particular , the results of any extradition proceedings or other legal proceedings
Translation: 所采取的针对犯罪者或涉嫌犯罪者的措施，特别是有关引渡程序或其他法律程序的结果

Query_Text_en: 1 Any dispute between two or more Contracting States concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention which can not be settled through negotiation , shall , at the request of one of them , be submitted to arbitration If within six months from the date of the request for arbitration the Parties are unable to agree on the organization of the arbitration , any one of those Parties may refer the dispute to the International Court of Justice by request in conformity with the Statute of the Court
Translation: 本公约缔约国之间因解释或适用本公约所产生的争端，如经谈判未能解决，应根据其中一方请求提交仲裁。自仲裁请求提出之日起六个月内，若缔约各方未能就仲裁组织形式达成一致，相关缔约任何一方得按照该法院规约的规定，通过请求方式将争端提交国际法院。

Query_Text_en: 2 Each State may at the time of signature or ratification of this Convention or accession thereto , declare that it does not consider itself bound by the preceding paragraph The other Contracting States shall not be bound by the preceding paragraph with respect to any Contracting State having made such a reservation
Translation: 各缔约国可在签署、批准或加入本公约时声明，其不受前款约束。对于作出上述保留的任何缔约国，其他缔约国亦不得视为受前款约束。

Query_Text_en: 3 Any Contracting State having made a reservation in accordance with the preceding paragraph may at any time withdraw this reservation by notification to the Depositary Governments
Translation: 任何已根据前款作出保留的缔约国均可随时通过通知保存国政府撤回此项保留。

Query_Text_en: 1 This Convention shall be open for signature at Montreal on 23 September 1971 by States participating in the International Conference on Air Law held at Montreal from 8 to 23 September 197l hereinafter referred to as the Montreal Conference After 10 October 1971 , the Convention shall be open to all States for signature in Moscow , London and Washington Any State which does not sign this Convention before its entry into force in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article may accede to it at any time
Translation: 本公约应于1971年9月23日在蒙特利尔向参加1971年9月8日至23日在蒙特利尔召开的国际航空法会议的各国开放签署。以下简称该会议为蒙特利尔会议。1971年10月10日之后，本公约可于莫斯科、伦敦和华盛顿向所有国家开放签署。任何未在本公约生效前按照本条第3款规定签署本公约的国家，可随时加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: 2 This Convention shall be subject to ratification by the signatory States Instruments of ratification and instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Governments of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics , the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland , and the United States of America , which are hereby designated the Depositary Governments
Translation: 本公约应由缔约国批准。批准书及加入书应交存于苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟、大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国以及美利坚合众国政府，现指定上述三国政府为保存国政府。

Query_Text_en: 3 This Convention shall enter into force thirty days following the date of the deposit of instruments of ratification by ten States signatory to this Convention which participated in the Montreal Conference
Translation: 本公约应在十个参加了蒙特利尔会议的本公约签署国交存批准书之日起三十天后生效。

Query_Text_en: 4 For other States , this Convention shall enter into force on the date of entry into force of this Convention in accordance with paragraph 3 of this Article , or thirty days following the date of deposit of their instruments of ratification or accession , whichever is later
Translation: 本公约应于根据本条第3款规定本公约生效之日，或各该国交存批准书或加入书后的第三十天生效，以较晚者为准。

Query_Text_en: 5 The Depositary Governments shall promptly inform all signatory and acceding States of the date of each signature the date of deposit of each instrument of ratification or accession , the date of entry into force of this Convention , and other notices
Translation: 保存国政府应迅速通知所有签署国和加入国每项签字的日期、每项批准或加入书交存的日期、本公约生效的日期以及其他通知。

Query_Text_en: 6 As soon as this Convention comes into force , it shall be registered by the Depositary Governments pursuant to Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations and pursuant to Article 83 of the Convention on International Civil Aviation Chicago ,1944
Translation: 本公约生效后，保存国政府应根据《联合国宪章》第102条以及1944年《芝加哥国际民用航空公约》第83条的规定对其进行登记。

Query_Text_en: 1 Any Contracting State may denounce this Convention by written notification to the Depositary Governments
Translation: 任何缔约国均可通过向保存国政府递交书面通知的方式退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: 2 Denunciation shall take effect six months following the date on which notification is received by the Depositary Governments IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned Plenipotentiaries , being duly authorized thereto by their Governments , have signed this Convention DONE at Montreal this twenty third day of September , one thousand nine hundred and seventy one , in three originals , each being drawn up in four authentic texts in the English , French , Russian and Spanish languages
Translation:
本公约的退出通知应自保管国政府收到之日起六个月后生效。  

下列各该国政府正式授权的全权代表签署本公约。  

本公约于一千九百七十一年九月二十三日在蒙特利尔签订，共三份正本，每份均以英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文写成，四种文本同等作准。

Query_Text_en: Article 1The High Contracting Parties undertake to respect and to ensure respect for the present Convention in all circumstances .
Translation: 第一条 缔约各方承诺遵守并确保本公约在一切情况下得到遵守。

Query_Text_en: Article 2In addition to the provisions which shall be implemented in peace-time , the present Convention shall apply to all cases of declared war or of any other armed conflict which may arise between two or more of the High Contracting Parties , even if the state of war is not recognized by one of them .
Translation: 除和平时期实施的规定外，本公约适用于缔约国之间爆发的任何宣战状态或武装冲突，即使其中一方不承认战争状态。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] the passing of sentences and the carrying out of executions without previous judgment pronounced by a regularly constituted court , affording all the judicial guarantees which are recognized as indispensable by civilized peoples .
Translation: 未经依法设立的法庭依法宣判并提供文明国家普遍认为必不可少的司法保障，即行宣判刑罚并执行处决。

Query_Text_en: Article 4Persons protected by the Convention are those who , at a given moment and in any manner whatsoever , find themselves , in case of a conflict or occupation , in the hands of a Party to the conflict or Occupying Power of which they are not nationals .
Translation: 公约所保护的人，是指在发生武装冲突或占领的情况下，于某一时刻以任何方式处于冲突方或占领国控制之下且不属于该冲突方或占领国国籍的人。

Query_Text_en: Nationals of a State which is not bound by the Convention are not protected by it .
Translation: 未缔结该公约的国家的公民不受其保护。

Query_Text_en: Nationals of a neutral State who find themselves in the territory of a belligerent State , and nationals of a co-belligerent State , shall not be regarded as protected persons while the State of which they are nationals has normal diplomatic representation in the State in whose hands they are .
Translation: 中立国的国民若身处交战国领土内，以及共同交战国的国民，在其国籍国在扣押他们的国家设有正常外交代表机构期间，不应被视为受保护的人。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of Part II are , however , wider in application , as defined in Article 13 .
Translation: 然而，第二部分的条款适用范围更广，如第13条所界定的。

Query_Text_en: Persons protected by the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of 12 August 1949 , or by the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of Wounded , Sick and Shipwrecked Members of Armed Forces at Sea of 12 August 1949 , or by the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of 12 August 1949 , shall not be considered as protected persons within the meaning of the present Convention .
Translation: 根据1949年8月12日《改善战地武装部队伤病者境遇的日内瓦公约》、《改善海上武装部队伤病人员及遇船难者境遇的日内瓦公约》或《关于战俘待遇的日内瓦公约》所保护的人，不应被视为本公约意义上的受保护人。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Where in the territory of a Party to the conflict , the latter is satisfied that an individual protected person is definitely suspected of or engaged in activities hostile to the security of the State , such individual person shall not be entitled to claim such rights and privileges under the present Convention as would , if exercised in the favor of such individual person , be prejudicial to the security of such State .
Translation: 在冲突一方的领土内，如该方确信某受保护的人确实涉嫌或参与危害国家安全部活动，则该人不得主张本公约中那些若由其主张可能损害该国安全的权利和优惠。

Query_Text_en: Where in occupied territory an individual protected person is detained as a spy or saboteur , or as a person under definite suspicion of activity hostile to the security of the Occupying Power , such person shall , in those cases where absolute military security so requires , be regarded as having forfeited rights of communication under the present Convention .
Translation: 在被占领土内，凡受保护人因间谍或破坏活动，或因涉嫌从事危害占领国安全之敌对行为而被拘留者，如绝对军事安全确实需要，该人应被视为已丧失本公约规定的通信权利。

Query_Text_en: In each case , such persons shall nevertheless be treated with humanity and , in case of trial , shall not be deprived of the rights of fair and regular trial prescribed by the present Convention .
Translation: 在任何情况下，此类人员应受到人道对待；在受审时，不得被剥夺本公约规定之公正和合法审判的权利。

Query_Text_en: They shall also be granted the full rights and privileges of a protected person under the present Convention at the earliest date consistent with the security of the State or Occupying Power , as the case may be .
Translation: 他们还应根据本公约，在符合国家或占领国安全的最早日期，被授予受保护人员的全部权利和待遇。

Query_Text_en: Article 6The present Convention shall apply from the outset of any conflict or occupation mentioned in Article 2 .
Translation: 本公约应自本公约第二条所提及的任何武装冲突或占领发生之时起适用。

Query_Text_en: In the territory of Parties to the conflict , the application of the present Convention shall cease on the general close of military operations .
Translation: 在冲突各方领土内，本公约的适用应于军事行动全面结束后终止。

Query_Text_en: Protected persons whose release , repatriation or re-establishment may take place after such dates shall meanwhile continue to benefit by the present Convention .
Translation: 可能在上述日期之后获释、遣返或重新安置的受保护人在此期间仍应继续受本公约保护。

Query_Text_en: Article 7In addition to the agreements expressly provided for in Articles 11 , 14 , 15 , 17 , 36 , 108 , 109 , 132 , 133 and 149 , the High Contracting Parties may conclude other special agreements for all matters concerning which they may deem it suitable to make separate provision .
Translation: 除本条约第11条、第14条、第15条、第17条、第36条、第108条、第109条、第132条、第133条及第149条明确规定外，缔约各方就其认为有必要另行作出规定的所有事项，可缔结其他特别协定。

Query_Text_en: No special agreement shall adversely affect the situation of protected persons , as defined by the present Convention , not restrict the rights which it confers upon them .
Translation: 任何特殊协议均不得对本公约所界定的受保护人员的情况产生不利影响，也不得限制本公约赋予他们的权利。

Query_Text_en: Protected persons shall continue to have the benefit of such agreements as long as the Convention is applicable to them , except where express provisions to the contrary are contained in the aforesaid or in subsequent agreements , or where more favourable measures have been taken with regard to them by one or other of the Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 受保护人员在公约对其适用期间应继续享有此类协议规定的权益，除非上述协议或后续协议中存在明确相反的规定，或冲突各方中的一方或双方已针对其采取更为有利的措施。

Query_Text_en: Article 8Protected persons may in no circumstances renounce in part or in entirety the rights secured to them by the present Convention , and by the special agreements referred to in the foregoing Article , if such there be .
Translation: 第八条 受保护的人在任何情况下均不得部分或全部放弃本公约及前条所指的特别协议（如有）赋予他们的权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 9The present Convention shall be applied with the cooperation and under the scrutiny of the Protecting Powers whose duty it is to safeguard the interests of the Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 第九条 本公约应通过保护国的合作并在其监督下实施，保护国的职责是保护冲突各方的利益。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , the Protecting Powers may appoint , apart from their diplomatic or consular staff , delegates from amongst their own nationals or the nationals of other neutral Powers .
Translation: 为实现此目的，保护国除外交或领事馆工作人员外，还可从本国国民或其他中立国国民中任命代表。

Query_Text_en: The said delegates shall be subject to the approval of the Power with which they are to carry out their duties .
Translation: 上述代表须经其履行职责的有关方批准。

Query_Text_en: The Parties to the conflict shall facilitate to the greatest extent possible the task of the representatives or delegates of the Protecting Powers .
Translation: 冲突各方应尽最大可能为保护国代表或代表团的任务提供便利。

Query_Text_en: Article 10The provisions of the present Convention constitute no obstacle to the humanitarian activities which the International Committee of the Red Cross or any other impartial humanitarian organization may , subject to the consent of the Parties to the conflict concerned , undertake for the protection of civilian persons and for their relief .
Translation: 本公约各项规定不妨碍红十字国际委员会或其他任何中立人道组织在冲突各方同意的前提下，为保护平民并为其提供救济而开展的人道主义活动。

Query_Text_en: Article 11The High Contracting Parties may at any time agree to entrust to an international organization which offers all guarantees of impartiality and efficacy the duties incumbent on the Protecting Powers by virtue of the present Convention .
Translation: 第11条 缔约国可随时协议，将根据本公约应由保护国承担的职责，委托给具备公正和有效一切保障的国际组织。

Query_Text_en: When persons protected by the present Convention do not benefit or cease to benefit , no matter for what reason , by the activities of a Protecting Power or of an organization provided for in the first paragraph above , the Detaining Power shall request a neutral State , or such an organization , to undertake the functions performed under the present Convention by a Protecting Power designated by the Parties to a conflict .
Translation: 当本公约所保护的人无法享受或不再享受保护国或上述第一款所指组织的活动所提供的便利时，无论原因如何，拘留国应请求中立国或此类组织承担冲突各方指定的保护国根据本公约所执行的职责。

Query_Text_en: Any neutral Power or any organization invited by the Power concerned or offering itself for these purposes , shall be required to act with a sense of responsibility towards the Party to the conflict on which persons protected by the present Convention depend , and shall be required to furnish sufficient assurances that it is in a position to undertake the appropriate functions and to discharge them impartially .
Translation: 任何被有关方邀请或主动提出参与的中立的国家或组织，均须以负责任的态度对待本公约所保护的人员所依赖的冲突方，并须提供充分保证，证明其具备承担相应职能并公正履行职责的能力。

Query_Text_en: Whenever in the present Convention mention is made of a Protecting Power , such mention applies to substitute organizations in the sense of the present Article .
Translation: 凡本公约提及保护国时，均应按照本条规定适用于替代机构。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of this Article shall extend and be adapted to cases of nationals of a neutral State who are in occupied territory or who find themselves in the territory of a belligerent State in which the State of which they are nationals has not normal diplomatic representation .
Translation: 本条之规定应适用于并调整为以下情况：中立国国民位于被占领土，或身处其国籍国未在该国设立正常外交代表机构的交战国领土。

Query_Text_en: Article 12In cases where they deem it advisable in the interest of protected persons , particularly in cases of disagreement between the Parties to the conflict as to the application or interpretation of the provisions of the present Convention , the Protecting Powers shall lend their good offices with a view to settling the disagreement .
Translation:
第十二条  
在保护国认为有必要维护受保护人利益的情况下，尤其当冲突各方就本公约条款的适用或解释存在分歧时，保护国应提供斡旋协助，以解决争端。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , each of the Protecting Powers may , either at the invitation of one Party or on its own initiative , propose to the Parties to the conflict a meeting of their representatives , and in particular of the authorities responsible for protected persons , possibly on neutral territory suitably chosen .
Translation: 为实现此目的，各保护国可应冲突一方邀请或自行决定，提议冲突各方举行代表会议，特别是召集负责保护受保护人员的主管机构代表参加，必要时可在选定的中立领土上举行。

Query_Text_en: The Protecting Powers may , if necessary , propose for approval by the Parties to the conflict a person belonging to a neutral Power , or delegated by the International Committee of the Red Cross , who shall be invited to take part in such a meeting .
Translation: 保护国如必要时，可提议一名属于中立国或由红十字国际委员会委派的人员，并经冲突各方批准后，邀请其参加此类会议。

Query_Text_en: Article 13The provisions of Part II cover the whole of the populations of the countries in conflict , without any adverse distinction based , in particular , on race , nationality , religion or political opinion , and are intended to alleviate the sufferings caused by war .
Translation: 第二部分的规定适用于冲突各国的全体民众，不得基于种族、国籍、宗教或政治见解等任何原因进行不利区分，其目的在于缓解战争所造成的苦难。

Query_Text_en: Article 14In time of peace , the High Contracting Parties and , after the outbreak of hostilities , the Parties thereto , may establish in their own territory and , if the need arises , in occupied areas , hospital and safety zones and localities so organized as to protect from the effects of war , wounded , sick and aged persons , children under fifteen , expectant mothers and mothers of children under seven .
Translation: 第十四条在和平时期，各缔约国以及战争爆发后冲突各方，可在其领土内并根据需要在占领区设立组织完善的医院和安全区及特定地点，以保护战争影响下的伤员、病患、老年人、十五岁以下儿童、孕妇及七岁以下儿童的母亲。

Query_Text_en: Upon the outbreak and during the course of hostilities , the Parties concerned may conclude agreements on mutual recognition of the zones and localities they have created .
Translation: 在冲突爆发之时及冲突期间，有关各方可就其划定的区域和地点达成相互承认的协议。

Query_Text_en: The Protecting Powers and the International Committee of the Red Cross are invited to lend their good offices in order to facilitate the institution and recognition of these hospital and safety zones and localities .
Translation: 邀请保护国和红十字国际委员会提供斡旋协助，以便促进这些医院和安全区及地点的设立和承认。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] civilian persons who take no part in hostilities , and who , while they reside in the zones , perform no work of a military character .
Translation: 不参与敌对行动且在居住于该区域期间不从事任何具有军事性质工作的平民。

Query_Text_en: When the Parties concerned have agreed upon the geographical position , administration , food supply and supervision of the proposed neutralized zone , a written agreement shall be concluded and signed by the representatives of the Parties to the conflict . The agreement shall fix the beginning and the duration of the neutralization of the zone .
Translation: 有关各方就拟议中立区的地理位置、管理、粮食供应及监督达成一致后，冲突各方的代表应缔结并签署书面协议。该协议应确定中立区中立化的起始时间和持续期限。

Query_Text_en: Article 16The wounded and sick , as well as the infirm , and expectant mothers , shall be the object of particular protection and respect .
Translation: 第十六条 伤病员、老弱者以及孕妇应受到特别保护和尊重。

Query_Text_en: As far as military considerations allow , each Party to the conflict shall facilitate the steps taken to search for the killed and wounded , to assist the shipwrecked and other persons exposed to grave danger , and to protect them against pillage and ill-treatment .
Translation: 在军事考虑允许的范围内，冲突各方应协助采取措施搜寻死者和伤员，救助遇险人员及其他处于严重危险中的人，并保护其免遭劫掠和虐待。

Query_Text_en: Article 17The Parties to the conflict shall endeavor to conclude local agreements for the removal from besieged or encircled areas , of wounded , sick , infirm , and aged persons , children and maternity cases , and for the passage of ministers of all religions , medical personnel and medical equipment on their way to such areas .
Translation: 冲突各方应努力达成地方性协议，以便从被围困或封锁的地区撤离伤病者、老弱病残、儿童及孕妇，并允许各宗教的宗教人员、医护人员及医疗设备前往上述地区。

Query_Text_en: Article 18Civilian hospitals organized to give care to the wounded and sick , the infirm and maternity cases , may in no circumstances be the object of attack but shall at all times be respected and protected by the Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 第十八条 专门组织以收治伤病员、病患者和孕妇的民用医院，不得成为攻击目标，而应受到冲突各方的尊重和保护。

Query_Text_en: States which are Parties to a conflict shall provide all civilian hospitals with certificates showing that they are civilian hospitals and that the buildings which they occupy are not used for any purpose which would deprive these hospitals of protection in accordance with Article 19 .
Translation: 冲突各方的缔约国应向所有民用医院发放证书，证明这些医院为民用医院，并且其占用的建筑物未被用于任何可能使这些医院失去保护的用途，具体依据第十九条规定。

Query_Text_en: Civilian hospitals shall be marked by means of the emblem provided for in Article 38 of the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of 12 August 1949 , but only if so authorized by the State .
Translation: 民用医院应当以1949年8月12日《改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约》第三十八条规定的标志标明，但须经国家授权。

Query_Text_en: The Parties to the conflict shall , in so far as military considerations permit , take the necessary steps to make the distinctive emblems indicating civilian hospitals clearly visible to the enemy land , air and naval forces in order to obviate the possibility of any hostile action .
Translation: 冲突各方应在军事情况许可的范围内，采取必要措施，确保标明平民医院的显著标志对敌方陆、海、空军部队清晰可见，以避免敌方采取任何敌对行动。

Query_Text_en: In view of the dangers to which hospitals may be exposed by being close to military objectives , it is recommended that such hospitals be situated as far as possible from such objectives .
Translation: 鉴于医院可能因靠近军事目标而面临危险，建议此类医院应尽可能远离这些目标。

Query_Text_en: Article 19The protection to which civilian hospitals are entitled shall not cease unless they are used to commit , outside their humanitarian duties , acts harmful to the enemy .
Translation: 第十九条 平民医院所享有的保护权不得终止，除非这些医院被用于实施超出其人道主义职责范围、对敌方有害的行为。

Query_Text_en: Protection may , however , cease only after due warning has been given , naming , in all appropriate cases , a reasonable time limit and after such warning has remained unheeded .
Translation: 保护措施仅在已给予正当警告（在适用情况下明确规定合理期限）且该警告未被遵守之后方可终止。

Query_Text_en: The fact that sick or wounded members of the armed forces are nursed in these hospitals , or the presence of small arms and ammunition taken from such combatants and not yet been handed to the proper service , shall not be considered to be acts harmful to the enemy .
Translation: 在这些医院照料武装部队伤病成员，或从此类战斗人员处缴获且尚未移交给相关部门的小型武器和弹药的存在，均不应被视为对敌方的有害行为。

Query_Text_en: Article 20Persons regularly and solely engaged in the operation and administration of civilian hospitals , including the personnel engaged in the search for , removal and transporting of and caring for wounded and sick civilians , the infirm and maternity cases shall be respected and protected .
Translation: 第二十条 专门从事民用医院运营和管理的人员，包括搜寻、转移、运送及照料平民伤患、病弱者和孕妇的人员，应受到尊重和保护。

Query_Text_en: In occupied territory and in zones of military operations , the above personnel shall be recognizable by means of an identity card certifying their status , bearing the photograph of the holder and embossed with the stamp of the responsible authority , and also by means of a stamped , water-resistant armlet which they shall wear on the left arm while carrying out their duties .
Translation: 在被占领土及军事行动区域内，上述人员应通过载有持证人照片并加盖主管部门印章的身份证明文件，以及在执行任务时需佩戴于左臂的印有标识的防水臂章，以表明其身份。

Query_Text_en: This armlet shall be issued by the State and shall bear the emblem provided for in Article 38 of the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of 12 August 1949 .
Translation: 本臂章由国家颁发，并应印有1949年8月12日《改善战地武装部队伤者病者待遇的日内瓦公约》第三十八条规定的标志。

Query_Text_en: Other personnel who are engaged in the operation and administration of civilian hospitals shall be entitled to respect and protection and to wear the armlet , as provided in and under the conditions prescribed in this Article , while they are employed on such duties .
Translation: 其他从事民用医院运营和管理工作的人员，在履行职责期间，应按照本条规定的情形和条件，享有受到尊重和保护的权利，并有权佩戴臂章。

Query_Text_en: The identity card shall state the duties on which they are employed .
Translation: 身份卡应载明其任职的职责。

Query_Text_en: The management of each hospital shall at all times hold at the disposal of the competent national or occupying authorities an up-to-date list of such personnel .
Translation: 各医院管理部门应随时向相关国家主管部门或占领当局提供一份最新的此类人员名单。

Query_Text_en: Article 21Convoys of vehicles or hospital trains on land or specially provided vessels on sea , conveying wounded and sick civilians , the infirm and maternity cases , shall be respected and protected in the same manner as the hospitals provided for in Article 18 , and shall be marked , with the consent of the State , by the display of the distinctive emblem provided for in Article 38 of the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of 12 August 1949 .
Translation: 第二十一条 陆地上的运输车队或医院列车，以及海上的专门提供的船只，若用于运送平民伤员、病患、老弱者及孕妇，应以与第十八条所规定的医院相同的方式受到尊重和保护，并须经国家同意，以1949年8月《战地武装力量伤病员待遇日内瓦公约》第三十八条规定的特殊标志进行标明。

Query_Text_en: Article 22Aircraft exclusively employed for the removal of wounded and sick civilians , the infirm and maternity cases or for the transport of medical personnel and equipment , shall not be attacked , but shall be respected while flying at heights , times and on routes specifically agreed upon between all the Parties to the conflict concerned .
Translation: 专门用于撤离平民伤病员、老弱病残者和孕妇或运输医护人员及医疗设备的航空器，不得受到攻击，而在冲突各方商定的具体高度、时间和航线上飞行时应受到尊重。

Query_Text_en: They may be marked with the distinctive emblem provided for in Article 38 of the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of 12 August 1949 .
Translation: 它们可使用1949年8月12日改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约第三十八条规定的特殊标志。

Query_Text_en: Unless agreed otherwise , flights over enemy or enemy occupied territory are prohibited .
Translation: 除非另有协议，否则飞越敌方或敌方占领领土上空的飞行活动被禁止。

Query_Text_en: Such aircraft shall obey every summons to land .
Translation: 此类航空器必须遵守所有着陆指令。

Query_Text_en: Article 23Each High Contracting Party shall allow the free passage of all consignments of medical and hospital stores and objects necessary for religious worship intended only for civilians of another High Contracting Party , even if the latter is its adversary .
Translation: 第二十三条 每一缔约国应准予专门用于另一缔约国平民的医疗用品、医院器械及宗教礼拜所需物品的所有运输自由通过，即使该另一缔约国是其敌对国。

Query_Text_en: It shall likewise permit the free passage of all consignments of essential foodstuffs , clothing and tonics intended for children under fifteen , expectant mothers and maternity cases .
Translation: 应准许所有专供十五岁以下儿童、孕妇及产妇使用的必需食品、衣物和营养剂物资自由通行。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] that the consignments may be diverted from their destination , [ b ] that the control may not be effective , or [ c ] that a definite advantage may accrue to the military efforts or economy of the enemy through the substitution of the above-mentioned consignments for goods which would otherwise be provided or produced by the enemy or through the release of such material , services or facilities as would otherwise be required for the production of such goods .
Translation: [ a ] 货物可能被转移出原定目的地，[ b ] 相关管控措施可能无法有效实施，或[ c ] 敌方通过以上述货物替代其本应自行提供或生产的物资，或通过释放本应用于生产此类物资的材料、服务及设施，从而使其军事行动或经济获得明确优势。

Query_Text_en: The Power which allows the passage of the consignments indicated in the first paragraph of this Article may make such permission conditional on the distribution to the persons benefited thereby being made under the local supervision of the Protecting Powers .
Translation: 授权准予本条第一款所述运输货物过境的一方，可将此项许可附带条件，即相关受益人所获物资的分发须在保护国当地代表的监督下进行。

Query_Text_en: Such consignments shall be forwarded as rapidly as possible , and the Power which permits their free passage shall have the right to prescribe the technical arrangements under which such passage is allowed .
Translation: 此类运输物资应尽快转运，准予其自由通过的国家有权规定此类物资通过时的具体安排。

Query_Text_en: Article 24The Parties to the conflict shall take the necessary measures to ensure that children under fifteen , who are orphaned or are separated from their families as a result of the war , are not left to their own resources , and that their maintenance , the exercise of their religion and their education are facilitated in all circumstances .
Translation: 冲突各方应采取必要措施，确保因战乱成为孤儿或与家人失散的十五岁以下儿童不致自行谋生，并确保其生活保障、宗教信仰的实践以及教育在任何情况下均得到保障。

Query_Text_en: Their education shall , as far as possible , be entrusted to persons of a similar cultural tradition .
Translation: 他们的教育应尽可能委托给具有相似文化传统的人来承担。

Query_Text_en: The Parties to the conflict shall facilitate the reception of such children in a neutral country for the duration of the conflict with the consent of the Protecting Power , if any , and under due safeguards for the observance of the principles stated in the first paragraph .
Translation: 冲突各方应协助将此类儿童安置于中立国，在冲突持续期间，经有关保护国同意（如有），并在适当保障措施下确保遵守本条第一款所述原则。

Query_Text_en: They shall , furthermore , endeavor to arrange for all children under twelve to be identified by the wearing of identity discs , or by some other means .
Translation: 此外，他们应进一步努力确保所有十二岁以下儿童通过佩戴身份标识牌或其他方式予以标识。

Query_Text_en: Article 25All persons in the territory of a Party to the conflict , or in a territory occupied by it , shall be enabled to give news of a strictly personal nature to members of their families , wherever they may be , and to receive news from them .
Translation: 第二十五条 在冲突一方领土内或在其所占领土内的所有人员，应可向其家庭成员发送严格个人性质的消息，无论其身处何地，并可接收来自他们的消息。

Query_Text_en: This correspondence shall be forwarded speedily and without undue delay .
Translation: 本文件应迅速转送，不得延误。

Query_Text_en: If , as a result of circumstances , it becomes difficult or impossible to exchange family correspondence by the ordinary post , the Parties to the conflict concerned shall apply to a neutral intermediary , such as the Central Agency provided for in Article 140 , and shall decide in consultation with it how to ensure the fulfilment of their obligations under the best possible conditions , in particular with the cooperation of the National Red Cross [ Red Crescent , Red Lion and Sun ] Societies .
Translation: 如果由于特殊情况，通过普通邮政交换家庭信件变得困难或不可能，冲突各方应向中立中介机构（如第140条规定的中央机构）申请，并应与其协商决定如何在尽可能有利的条件下履行其义务，特别是要与各国红十字会[红新月会、红狮与日会]等机构合作。

Query_Text_en: If the Parties to the conflict deem it necessary to restrict family correspondence , such restrictions shall be confined to the compulsory use of standard forms containing twenty-five freely chosen words , and to the limitation of the number of these forms despatched to one each month .
Translation: 如冲突各方认为有必要限制家庭通信，此类限制应仅限于强制使用包含二十五个自行选择词语的标准格式表格，并将此类表格的每月寄送数量限制为一份。

Query_Text_en: Article 26Each Party to the conflict shall facilitate enquiries made by members of families dispersed owing to the war , with the object of renewing contact with one another and of meeting , if possible .
Translation:
第二十六条  
冲突各方应协助因战争离散的家庭成员进行查询，旨在使他们能够重新建立联系并会面，如有可能。

Query_Text_en: It shall encourage , in particular , the work of organizations engaged on this task provided they are acceptable to it and conform to its security regulations .
Translation: 特别是对于在其认可范围内并遵守其安全规定的从事此项任务的机构，应予以鼓励其工作。

Query_Text_en: Article 27Protected persons are entitled , in all circumstances , to respect for their persons , their honor , their family rights , their religious convictions and practices , and their manners and customs .
Translation: 第二十七条 受保护的人在任何情况下均有权获得对其人身、名誉、家庭权利、宗教信仰及宗教活动以及风俗习惯的尊重。

Query_Text_en: They shall at all times be humanely treated , and shall be protected especially against all acts of violence or threats thereof and against insults and public curiosity .
Translation: 他们应始终受到人道对待，并应特别防止遭受任何形式的暴力行为或暴力威胁，以及侮辱和公众围观。

Query_Text_en: Women shall be especially protected against any attack on their honor , in particular against rape , enforced prostitutiOn , or any form of indecent assault .
Translation: 妇女应受到特别保护，使其免受对其名誉的任何侵害，尤其是强奸、强迫卖淫或任何形式的猥亵侵犯。

Query_Text_en: Without prejudice to the provisions relating to their state of health , age and sex , all protected persons shall be treated with the same consideration by the Party to the conflict in whose power they are , without any adverse distinction based , in particular , on race , religion or political opinion .
Translation: 不受关于受保护人健康状况、年龄和性别的相关规定影响，冲突方应平等对待其管辖下的所有受保护人，不得基于种族、宗教或政治观点等任何因素进行不利区别。

Query_Text_en: However , the Parties to the conflict may take such measures of control and security in regard to protected persons as may be necessary as a result of the war .
Translation: 然而，冲突各方可针对受保护人员因战争需要采取必要的管控和安全措施。

Query_Text_en: Article 28The presence of a protected person may not be used to render certain points or areas immune from military operations .
Translation: 受保护人员的存在不得被用于使某些地点或区域免受军事行动。

Query_Text_en: Article 29The Party to the conflict in whose hands protected persons may be , is responsible for the treatment accorded to them by its agents , irrespective of any individual responsibility which may be incurred .
Translation:
第二十九条  
冲突中受保护人可能处于其控制下的冲突当事方，应对其所属机构或人员对待受保护人的行为承担责任，不论是否产生个人责任。

Query_Text_en: Article 30Protected persons shall have every facility for making application to the Protecting Powers , the International Committee of the Red Cross , the National Red Cross [ Red Crescent , Red Lion and Sun ] Society of the country where they may be , as well as to any organization that might assist them .
Translation: 第三十条 受保护人应获得向保护国、红十字国际委员会、其所在地国家的红十字[红新月、红狮与日]会以及任何可能向其提供援助的组织提出申请的一切便利。

Query_Text_en: These several organizations shall be granted all facilities for that purpose by the authorities , within the bounds set by military or security considerations .
Translation: 这些机构应由主管部门在军事或安全考虑的范围内为其提供一切必要的便利。

Query_Text_en: Apart from the visits of the delegates of the Protecting Powers and of the International Committee of the Red Cross , provided for by Article 143 , the Detaining or Occupying Powers shall facilitate , as much as possible , visits to protected persons by the representatives of other organizations whose object is to give spiritual aid or material relief to such persons .
Translation: 除根据第143条的规定允许保护国和红十字国际委员会代表团的访问外，拘留国或占领国应尽可能便利其他组织的代表对受保护人员进行访问，这些组织的宗旨是向此类人员提供精神抚慰或物质救济。

Query_Text_en: Article 31No physical or moral coercion shall be exercised against protected persons , in particular to obtain information from them or from third parties .
Translation: 第三十一条 不得对受保护之人施以身体或精神胁迫，尤其是为了从其本人或第三方获取信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 32The High Contracting Parties specifically agree that each of them is prohibited from taking any measure of such a character as to cause the physical suffering or extermination of protected persons in their hands .
Translation: 缔约国特别约定，各方均不得采取任何可能导致受保护者在其权力下遭受肉体痛苦或遭致灭绝的措施。

Query_Text_en: This prohibition applies not only to murder , torture , corporal punishments , mutilation and medical or scientific experiments not necessitated by the medical treatment of a protected person , but also to any other measures of brutality whether applied by civilian or military agents .
Translation: 本禁令不仅适用于谋杀、酷刑、体罚、残害以及并非出于对受保护者进行医疗救治所需的医学或科学实验，还包括任何其他形式的残暴手段，无论此类行为由民事人员或军事人员实施。

Query_Text_en: Article 33No protected person may be punished for an offence he or she has not personally committed .
Translation: 第三十三条 受保护之人不得因其未亲自实施的罪行而受到处罚。

Query_Text_en: Collective penalties and likewise all measures of intimidation or of terrorism are prohibited .
Translation: 集体处罚以及一切威胁或恐怖主义措施均被禁止。

Query_Text_en: Pillage is prohibited .
Translation: 禁止劫掠。

Query_Text_en: Reprisals against protected persons and their property are prohibited .
Translation: 禁止对受保护的人及其财产采取报复措施。

Query_Text_en: Article 34The taking of hostages is prohibited .
Translation: 第三十四条 禁止劫持人质。

Query_Text_en: Article 35All protected persons who may desire to leave the territory at the outset of , or during a conflict , shall be entitled to do so , unless their departure is contrary to the national interests of the State .
Translation: 第三十五条 在武装冲突开始时或冲突期间，任何希望离开领土的受保护人员均有权这样做，除非其离境与国家利益相悖。

Query_Text_en: The applications of such persons to leave shall be decided in accordance with regularly established procedures and the decision shall be taken as rapidly as possible .
Translation: 此类人员的离职申请应按照既定程序进行审批，相关决定应尽快作出。

Query_Text_en: Those persons permitted to leave may provide themselves with the necessary funds for their journey and take with them a reasonable amount of their effects and articles of personal use .
Translation: 获准离境者可自行准备旅程所需资金，并携带其个人财物及生活用品的合理数量。

Query_Text_en: If any such person is refused permission to leave the territory , he shall be entitled to have refusal reconsidered , as soon as possible by an appropriate court or administrative board designated by the Detaining Power for that purpose .
Translation: 如此类人员被拒绝离境许可，其有权要求对其离境申请的拒绝决定进行重新审议，拘留方应尽快为此指定适当法院或行政委员会予以审理。

Query_Text_en: Upon request , representatives of the Protecting Power shall , unless reasons of security prevent it , or the persons concerned object , be furnished with the reasons for refusal of any request for permission to leave the territory and be given , as expeditiously as possible , the names of all persons who have been denied permission to leave .
Translation: 应请求，除非因安全原因无法提供，或有关人员提出异议，保护国代表应被告知拒绝离境请求的理由，并尽快获知所有被拒绝离境人员的姓名。

Query_Text_en: Article 36Departures permitted under the foregoing Article shall be carried out in satisfactory conditions as regards safety , hygiene , sanitation and food .
Translation: 第三十六条 根据前款规定准予离境的，应当在安全、卫生、环境卫生和食品等方面具备符合要求的条件。

Query_Text_en: All costs in connection therewith , from the point of exit in the territory of the Detaining Power , shall be borne by the country of destination , or , in the case of accommodation in a neutral country , by the Power whose nationals are benefited .
Translation: 与之相关的所有费用，自羁押国领土的出境点起，应由目的地国承担；若安置于中立国，则由因此受益的国家承担。

Query_Text_en: The practical details of such movements may , if necessary , be settled by special agreements between the Powers concerned .
Translation: 此类行动的具体实施细节，如有必要，可通过有关各方之间的特别协议予以确定。

Query_Text_en: The foregoing shall not prejudice such special agreements as may be concluded between Parties to the conflict concerning the exchange and repatriation of their nationals in enemy hands .
Translation: 不得损害冲突各方之间可能达成的关于交换和遣返被敌方扣留的本国公民的特殊协议。

Query_Text_en: Article 37Protected persons who are confined pending proceedings or serving a sentence involving loss of liberty , shall during their confinement be humanely treated .
Translation: 第三十七条 因等待审判或因被判处剥夺自由而服刑的受保护人，在羁押期间应受到人道待遇。

Query_Text_en: As soon as they are released , they may ask to leave the territory in conformity with the foregoing Articles .
Translation: 一经释放，即可依照前款规定申请离开该区域。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] children under fifteen years , pregnant women and mothers of children under seven years shall benefit by any preferential treatment to the same extent as the nationals of the State concerned .
Translation: 十五岁以下儿童、孕妇以及七岁以下儿童的母亲应与有关缔约国国民同等享受各项优惠待遇。

Query_Text_en: Article 39Protected persons who , as a result of the war , have lost their gainful employment , shall be granted the opportunity to find paid employment .
Translation: 因战争失去原有工作的受保护人员应获得寻找有偿工作的机会。

Query_Text_en: That opportunity shall , subject to security considerations and to the provisions of Article 40 , be equal to that enjoyed by the nationals of the Power in whose territory they are .
Translation: 该机会应等同于他们在其领土内的缔约方国民所享有的机会，但需受安全因素及第四十条规定之限制。

Query_Text_en: Where a Party to the conflict applies to a protected person methods of control which result in his being unable to support himself , and especially if such a person is prevented for reasons of security from finding paid employment on reasonable conditions , the said Party shall ensure his support and that of his dependents .
Translation: 冲突中的一方若对受保护人员采取导致其无法维持生计的控制措施，尤其是因安全原因阻碍其在合理条件下获得有薪工作时，该方应确保其本人及其家属的生活保障。

Query_Text_en: Protected persons may in any case receive allowances from their home country , the Protecting Power , or the relief societies referred to in Article 30 .
Translation: 受保护人可从其所属国、保护国或第三十条所指的救济团体获得津贴。

Query_Text_en: Article 40Protected persons may be compelled to work only to the same extent as nationals of the Party to the conflict in whose territory they are .
Translation: 受保护人仅得被强制从事劳动的程度，与冲突方在其领土内的本国公民相同。

Query_Text_en: If protected persons are of enemy nationality , they may only be compelled to do work which is normally necessary to ensure the feeding , sheltering , clothing , transport and health of human beings and which is not directly related to the conduct of military operations .
Translation: 如果受保护人员具有敌方国籍，他们仅可被强迫从事确保人类基本生存需求（包括饮食、住宿、衣物、交通和健康保障）且不直接涉及军事行动开展的必要工作。

Query_Text_en: In the cases mentioned in the two preceding paragraphs , protected persons compelled to work shall have the benefit of the same working conditions and of the same safeguards as national workers in particular as regards wages , hours of labor , clothing and equipment , previous training and compensation for occupational accidents and diseases .
Translation: 在前两款所述情况下，被迫从事劳动的受保护人员应享有与本国工人相同的劳动条件和保障措施，特别是关于工资、工作时间、服装装备、事先培训以及职业事故和职业病赔偿等方面。

Query_Text_en: If the above provisions are infringed , protected persons shall be allowed to exercise their right of complaint in accordance with Article 30 .
Translation: 如上述规定遭到违反，受保护人员应有权根据第三十条行使申诉权。

Query_Text_en: Article 41Should the Power , in whose hands protected persons may be , consider the measures of control mentioned in the present Convention to be inadequate , it may not have recourse to any other measure of control more severe than that of assigned residence or internment , in accordance with the provisions of Articles 42 and 43 .
Translation:
第四十一条  
如果受保护人所在之缔约国认为本公约所规定的管制措施不足时，除按照第四十二条和第四十三条的规定采取指定居所或羁押措施外，不得采取任何更为严厉的管制手段。

Query_Text_en: In applying the provisions of Article 39 , second paragraph , to the cases of persons required to leave their usual places of residence by virtue of a decision placing them in assigned residence elsewhere , the Detaining Power shall be guided as closely as possible by the standards of welfare set forth in Part III , Section IV of this Convention .
Translation: 在适用第三十九条第二款规定处理因根据决定将其安置于指定居所而被要求离开惯常居住地的人员相关案件时，羁押国应尽可能严格参照本公约第三部分第四章所规定的福利标准。

Query_Text_en: Article 42The internment or placing in assigned residence of protected persons may be ordered only if the security of the Detaining Power makes it absolutely necessary .
Translation: 第四十二条 仅可在拘留国的安全利益绝对需要的情况下，方可命令对受保护人实施监禁或安置于指定居所。

Query_Text_en: If any person , acting through the representatives of the Protecting Power , voluntarily demands internment , and if his situation renders this step necessary , he shall be interned by the Power in whose hands he may be .
Translation: 任何人士通过保护国代表自愿要求拘留，且其处境确实需要采取这一措施时，其所处之国应予以拘留。

Query_Text_en: Article 43Any protected person who has been interned or placed in assigned residence shall be entitled to have such action reconsidered as soon as possible by an appropriate court or administrative board designated by the Detaining Power for that purpose .
Translation: 任何被拘留或被安置在指定居所的受保护人，均有权要求由拘留国为此指定的相应法院或行政委员会尽快对其所采取的行动进行复核。

Query_Text_en: If the internment or placing in assigned residence is maintained , the court or administrative board shall periodically , and at least twice yearly , give consideration to his or her case , with a view to the favourable amendment of the initial decision , if circumstances permit .
Translation: 如果继续实施拘禁或指定居所安置，法院或行政机关应定期、至少每年两次审查其案件，并在情况允许时，以有利于修改原决定为目标。

Query_Text_en: Unless the protected persons concerned object , the Detaining Power shall , as rapidly as possible , give the Protecting Power the names of any protected persons who have been interned or subjected to assigned residence , or who have been released from internment or assigned residence .
Translation: 除非有关受保护人员提出异议，拘留国应尽快向保护国提供所有被监禁、被安置在指定居所或已获释的受保护人员的姓名。

Query_Text_en: The decisions of the courts or boards mentioned in the first paragraph of the present Article shall also , subject to the same conditions , be notified as rapidly as possible to the Protecting Power .
Translation: 本条第一款所提及法院或委员会的裁决，在相同条件下，也应尽快通知保护国。

Query_Text_en: Article 44In applying the measures of control mentioned in the present Convention , the Detaining Power shall not treat as enemy aliens exclusively on the basis of their nationality de jure of an enemy State , refugees who do not , in fact , enjoy the protection of any government .
Translation:
第四十四条  
在适用本公约所述管制措施时，拘留国不得仅以难民的法定国籍属于敌对国家为由，将未实际享有任何政府保护的难民视为敌国公民。

Query_Text_en: Article 45Protected persons shall not be transferred to a Power which is not a party to the Convention .
Translation: 第四十五条 受保护的人不得被转移至非公约缔约国的国家。

Query_Text_en: This provision shall in no way constitute an obstacle to the repatriation of protected persons , or to their return to their country of residence after the cessation of hostilities .
Translation: 本条款绝不应构成妨碍受保护人员遣返，或在敌对行动停止后返回其居住国的障碍。

Query_Text_en: Protected persons may be transferred by the Detaining Power only to a Power which is a party to the present Convention and after the Detaining Power has satisfied itself of the willingness and ability of such transferee Power to apply the present Convention .
Translation: 受保护人仅可由拘留国转移至亦为本公约缔约国的国家，且拘留国须先确认该接收国愿意并有能力适用本公约。

Query_Text_en: If protected persons are transferred under such circumstances , responsibility for the application of the present Convention rests on the Power accepting them , while they are in its custody .
Translation: 在上述情况下被转移的受保护人员，只要仍在其看管之下，本公约的适用责任应由接受方承担。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , if that Power fails to carry out the provisions of the present Convention in any important respect , the Power by which the protected persons were transferred shall , upon being so notified by the Protecting Power , take effective measures to correct the situation or shall request the return of the protected persons . Such request must be complied with .
Translation: 然而，如果该缔约国在任何重要方面未能履行本公约的规定，曾转移受保护人员的缔约国在收到保护国的通知后，应采取有效措施纠正该情况，或要求返还受保护人员。此类要求必须予以遵守。

Query_Text_en: In no circumstances shall a protected person be transferred to a country where he or she may have reason to fear persecution for his or her political opinions or religious beliefs .
Translation: 绝不允许受保护者被遣送至其可能因政治观点或宗教信仰而有遭受迫害之虞的国家。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of this Article do not constitute an obstacle to the extradition , in pursuance of extradition treaties concluded before the outbreak of hostilities , of protected persons accused of offences against ordinary criminal law .
Translation: 本条之规定不妨碍根据敌对行动爆发前缔结的引渡条约，引渡被指控犯有普通刑事法律所规定之罪行的受保护人。

Query_Text_en: Article 46In so far as they have not been previously withdrawn , restrictive measures taken regarding protected persons shall be canceled as soon as possible after the close of hostilities .
Translation: 第四十六条 凡未在此之前撤销的针对受保护人员所采取的限制性措施，应在敌对行动结束后尽快取消。

Query_Text_en: Restrictive measures affecting their property shall be canceled , in accordance with the law of the Detaining Power , as soon as possible after the close of hostilities .
Translation: 涉及其财产的限制性措施应根据羁押国法律，在敌对行动结束后尽快取消。

Query_Text_en: Article 47Protected persons who are in occupied territory shall not be deprived , in any case or in any manner whatsoever , of the benefits of the present Convention by any change introduced , as the result of the occupation of a territory , into the institutions or government of the said territory , nor by any agreement concluded between the authorities of the occupied territories and the Occupying Power , nor by any annexation by the latter of the whole or part of the occupied territory .
Translation: 第四十七条 在任何情况下或以任何方式，均不得因被占领土的机构或政府因占领而发生的变化，或占领国与被占领土当局之间缔结的任何协定，或占领国吞并被占领土的全部或部分领土，而剥夺被占领土内的受保护人员根据本公约应享有的利益。

Query_Text_en: Article 48Protected persons who are not nationals of the Power whose territory is occupied , may avail themselves of the right to leave the territory subject to the provisions of Article 35 , and decisions thereon shall be taken according to the procedure which the Occupying Power shall establish in accordance with the said Article .
Translation: 第四十八条 受保护人如非占领地区所属国国民，有权在遵守第三十五条之规定的前提下离开该领土，有关决定应按照占领国根据上述条款所规定的程序作出。

Query_Text_en: Article 49Individual or mass forcible transfers , as well as deportations of protected persons from occupied territory to the territory of the Occupying Power or to that of any other country , occupied or not , are prohibited , regardless of their motive .
Translation: 第四十九条 禁止将受保护人员从被占领土强制转移（无论个人还是集体），或将其驱逐至占领国领土或其他国家领土（无论该国是否被占领），此项禁令不因其动机而有所例外。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , the Occupying Power may undertake total or partial evacuation of a given area if the security of the population or imperative military reasons so demand .
Translation: 占领国可以在居民安全或存在紧迫军事需要时，采取全部或部分疏散特定区域的措施。

Query_Text_en: Such evacuations may not involve the displacement of protected persons outside the bounds of the occupied territory except when for material reasons it is impossible to avoid such displacement .
Translation: 此类撤离不得涉及将受保护人员迁移至被占领土之外，除非因实质性原因无法避免此类迁移。

Query_Text_en: Persons thus evacuated shall be transferred back to their homes as soon as hostilities in the area in question have ceased .
Translation: 一旦相关地区的敌对行动停止，即应立即将上述疏散人员送回其住所。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power undertaking such transfers or evacuations shall ensure , to the greatest practicable extent , that proper accommodation is provided to receive the protected persons , that the removals are effected in satisfactory conditions of hygiene , health , safety and nutrition , and that members of the same family are not separated .
Translation: 占领国在实施此类转移或疏散时，应确保在最大程度上切实可行：为受保护人员提供适当的住宿条件；转移行动在卫生、健康、安全和营养等方面符合要求；并确保同一家庭成员不致分离。

Query_Text_en: The Protecting Power shall be informed of any transfers and evacuations as soon as they have taken place .
Translation: 保护国应在任何转移和撤离行动一经发生后立即被告知。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power shall not detain protected persons in an area particularly exposed to the dangers of war unless the security of the population or imperative military reasons so demand .
Translation: 占领国不得将受保护的人羁押在特别容易受到战争危险威胁的地区，除非出于保障平民安全或存在不可或却的军事原因需要时。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power shall not deport or transfer parts of its own civilian population into the territory it occupies .
Translation: 占领国不得将其自身平民人口的一部分迁入其所占领的领土内。

Query_Text_en: Article 50The Occupying Power shall , with the cooperation of the national and local authorities , facilitate the proper working of all institutions devoted to the care and education of children .
Translation: 第五十条 占领国应当在国家和地方当局的配合下，确保所有专门从事儿童保育和教育的机构正常运作。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power shall take all necessary steps to facilitate the identification of children and the registration of their parentage .
Translation: 占领当局应采取一切必要措施，便利确认儿童身份并登记其亲子关系。

Query_Text_en: It may not , in any case , change their personal status , nor enlist them in formations or organizations subordinate to it .
Translation: 不得在任何情况下改变其个人身份，也不得将其编入下属编制单位或机构中。

Query_Text_en: Should the local institutions be inadequate for the purpose , the Occupying Power shall make arrangements for the maintenance and education , if possible by persons of their own nationality , language and religion , of children who are orphaned or separated from their parents as a result of the war and who can not be adequately cared for by a near relative or friend .
Translation: 如果当地机构不足以完成任务，占领国应当作出安排，尽可能由与他们具有相同国籍、语言和宗教的人负责抚养和教育因战争而成为孤儿或与父母分离、且无法由近亲或朋友妥善照料的儿童。

Query_Text_en: A special section of the Bureau set up in accordance with Article 136 shall be responsible for taking all necessary steps to identify children whose identity is in doubt .
Translation: 根据第136条设立的专门部门应负责采取必要措施，识别身份存疑的儿童。

Query_Text_en: Particulars of their parents or other near relatives should always be recorded if available .
Translation: 如相关信息可获取，应记录其父母或其他近亲属的详细信息。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power shall not hinder the application of any preferential measures in regard to food , medical care and protection against the effects of war which may have been adopted prior to the occupation in favor of children under fifteen years , expectant mothers , and mothers of children under seven years .
Translation: 占领国不得妨碍在占领前已采取的、针对十五岁以下儿童、孕妇以及七岁以下儿童母亲在食物供应、医疗保障以及防范战争影响的保护措施方面的任何优待政策的实施。

Query_Text_en: Article 51The Occupying Power may not compel protected persons to serve in its armed or auxiliary forces .
Translation: 第51条 占领国不得强迫受保护人员为其武装或辅助部队服役。

Query_Text_en: No pressure or propaganda which aims at securing voluntary enlistment is permitted .
Translation: 不得以招募自愿入伍为目的施加压力或进行宣传。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power may not compel protected persons to work unless they are over eighteen years of age , and then only on work which is necessary either for the needs of the army of occupation , or for the public utility services , or for the feeding , sheltering , clothing , transportation or health of the population of the occupied country .
Translation: 占领国不得强迫受保护人员工作，除非其年龄已满十八岁，且只能从事占领国军队所需、公共事业服务所需，或被占领国居民饮食、住宿、衣物、交通或健康所需之必要工作。

Query_Text_en: Protected persons may not be compelled to undertake any work which would involve them in the obligation of taking part in military operations .
Translation: 受保护的人不得被迫从事任何会使其承担参与军事行动义务的工作。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power may not compel protected persons to employ forcible means to ensure the security of the installations where they are performing compulsory labor .
Translation: 占领国不得强迫受保护人员使用武力手段确保其被迫从事强制劳动地点的设施安全。

Query_Text_en: The work shall be carried out only in the occupied territory where the persons whose services have been requisitioned are .
Translation: 此项工作应仅在被征用服务的人员所在的被占领土进行。

Query_Text_en: Every such person shall , so far as possible , be kept in his usual place of employment .
Translation: 所有此类人员应尽可能留在其惯常的工作岗位。

Query_Text_en: Workers shall be paid a fair wage and the work shall be proportionate to their physical and intellectual capacities .
Translation: 劳动者应获得合理报酬，工作量应与其体力和智力能力相适应。

Query_Text_en: The legislation in force in the occupied country concerning working conditions , and safeguards as regards , in particular , such matters as wages , hours of work , equipment , preliminary training and compensation for occupational accidents and diseases , shall be applicable to the protected persons assigned to the work referred to in this Article .
Translation: 被占领国现行有关劳动条件的立法以及关于工资、工作时间、设备、岗前培训和职业事故及职业病补偿等事项的保障措施，应适用于本条所述工作中被指派的受保护人员。

Query_Text_en: In no case shall requisition of labor lead to a mobilization of workers in an organization of a military or semi-military character .
Translation: 不得因强制征用劳动力而导致人员被动员至军事或准军事性质的组织中。

Query_Text_en: Article 52No contract , agreement or regulation shall impair the right of any worker , whether voluntary or not and wherever he may be , to apply to the representatives of the Protecting Power in order to request the said Power 's intervention .
Translation: 第五十二条 不得因任何合同、协议或规定损害任何工人（无论其是否自愿参与或身处何地）向保护国代表提出申请、请求该国进行干预的权利。

Query_Text_en: All measures aiming at creating unemployment or at restricting the opportunities offered to workers in an occupied territory , in order to induce them to work for the Occupying Power , are prohibited .
Translation: 任何旨在在被占领土制造失业或限制工人就业机会，以迫使他们为占领国工作的措施，均被禁止。

Query_Text_en: Article 53Any destruction by the Occupying Power of real or personal property belonging individually or collectively to private persons , or to the State , or to other public authorities , or to social or cooperative organizations , is prohibited , except where such destruction is rendered absolutely necessary by military operations .
Translation: 第五十三条 占领国破坏私人所有或集体所有的不动产或动产，或者国家、其他公共当局、社会或合作组织所有的财产的行为一律禁止，除非此类破坏由军事行动所绝对必要而造成。

Query_Text_en: Article 54The Occupying Power may not alter the status of public officials or judges in the occupied territories , or in any way apply sanctions to or take any measures of coercion or discrimination against them , should they abstain from fulfilling their functions for reasons of conscience .
Translation: 第五十四条 占领国不得因公职人员或法官因良知原因拒绝履行职责，而以任何方式改变其地位，或对其施加制裁、采取强制措施或歧视性措施。

Query_Text_en: This prohibition does not prejudice the application of the second paragraph of Article 51 .
Translation: 本禁令不影响《第五十一条》第二款的适用。

Query_Text_en: It does not affect the right of the Occupying Power to remove public officials from their posts .
Translation: 这不影响占领国撤换公职人员的权利。

Query_Text_en: it should , in particular , bring in the necessary foodstuffs , medical stores and other articles if the resources of the occupied territory are inadequate .
Translation: 如果被占领土的资源不足，应特别进口必要的食品、医药用品和其他物资。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power may not requisition foodstuffs , articles or medical supplies available in the occupied territory , except for use by the occupation forces and administration personnel , and then only if the requirements of the civilian population have been taken into account .
Translation: 占领国不得征用被占领土内可供使用的粮食、物资或医药用品，但可征用其中供占领区军队和行政管理人员使用的部分，但需以平民需求已得到满足为前提。

Query_Text_en: Subject to the provisions of other international Conventions , the Occupying Power shall make arrangements to ensure that fair value is paid for any requisitioned goods .
Translation: 除其他国际公约另有规定外，占领国应采取措施，确保为征用的物资支付合理价值。

Query_Text_en: The Protecting Power shall , at any time , be at liberty to verify the state of the food and medical supplies in occupied territories , except where temporary restrictions are made necessary by imperative military requirements .
Translation: 保护国可随时核实被占领土内食品和医疗物资的状况，但因紧迫的军事需求而必须采取临时限制措施的情况除外。

Query_Text_en: Article 56To the fullest extent of the means available to it , the Occupying Power has the duty of ensuring and maintaining , with the cooperation of national and local authorities , the medical and hospital establishments and services , public health and hygiene in the occupied territory , with particular reference to the adoption and application of the prophylactic and preventive measures necessary to combat the spread of contagious diseases and epidemics .
Translation: 占领当局应尽最大可能，在国家和地方当局的合作下，确保并维持被占领土内的医疗机构、卫生服务及公共卫生和卫生状况，特别是采取并实施必要的预防性措施，以防止传染病和流行病的传播。

Query_Text_en: Medical personnel of all categories shall be allowed to carry out their duties .
Translation: 应允许各类医疗人员履行其职责。

Query_Text_en: If new hospitals are set up in occupied territory and if the competent organs of the occupied State are not operating there , the occupying authorities shall , if necessary , grant them the recognition provided for in Article 18 .
Translation: 如果在被占领土设立新医院，且被占领国的主管机关无法在该地区运作，占领当局如有必要应当给予其根据第十八条规定的承认。

Query_Text_en: In similar circumstances , the occupying authorities shall also grant recognition to hospital personnel and transport vehicles under the provisions of Articles 20 and 21 .
Translation: 在类似情况下，占领当局亦应根据第二十条和第二十一条的规定，对医疗人员及运输车辆予以承认。

Query_Text_en: In adopting measures of health and hygiene and in their implementation , the Occupying Power shall take into consideration the moral and ethical susceptibilities of the population of the occupied territory .
Translation: 占领国在采取卫生防疫措施以及实施过程中，应当考虑被占领地区居民的道德伦理观念。

Query_Text_en: Article 57 The Occupying Power may requisition civilian hospitals of hospitals only temporarily and only in cases of urgent necessity for the care of military wounded and sick , and then on condition that suitable arrangements are made in due time for the care and treatment of the patients and for the needs of the civilian population for hospital accommodation .
Translation: 第五十七条 占领国仅可在因救治军事伤员而出现紧急必要情况时，临时征用民用医院，但需同时满足及时作出适当安排以确保原有病患得到救治，并保障平民人口对医院床位的需求。

Query_Text_en: The material and stores of civilian hospitals can not be requisitioned so long as they are necessary for the needs of the civilian population .
Translation: 只要平民医院的物资和储备仍为平民所需，就不得征用。

Query_Text_en: Article 58The Occupying Power shall permit ministers of religion to give spiritual assistance to the members of their religious communities .
Translation: 第五十八条 占领国应准许宗教神职人员向其所属宗教团体成员提供精神协助。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power shall also accept consignments of books and articles required for religious needs and shall facilitate their distribution in occupied territory .
Translation: 占领国还应接收用于宗教需求的书籍和物品，并便利其在被占领土内的分发。

Query_Text_en: Article 59If the whole or part of the population of an occupied territory is inadequately supplied , the Occupying Power shall agree to relief schemes on behalf of the said population , and shall facilitate them by all the means at its disposal .
Translation: 如果被占领土的全部或部分人口供应不足，占领国应同意为上述人口实施救济方案，并应利用一切可支配的手段提供便利。

Query_Text_en: Such schemes , which may be undertaken either by States or by impartial humanitarian organizations such as the International Committee of the Red Cross , shall consist , in particular , of the provision of consignments of foodstuffs , medical supplies and clothing .
Translation: 此类方案可由各国或红十字国际委员会等中立人道主义组织实施，应特别包括提供食品、医疗用品和衣物等物资的供应。

Query_Text_en: All Contracting Parties shall permit the free passage of these consignments and shall guarantee their protection .
Translation: 所有缔约方应准许这些运输物资自由通行，并保证其保护。

Query_Text_en: A Power granting free passage to consignments on their way to territory occupied by an adverse Party to the conflict shall , however , have the right to search the consignments , to regulate their passage according to prescribed times and routes , and to be reasonably satisfied through the Protecting Power that these consignments are to be used for the relief of the needy population and are not to be used for the benefit of the Occupying Power .
Translation: 一国准予物资运往冲突一方所占领土途中自由通行时，有权对上述物资进行检查，按照规定的时限和路线对其通行进行规范，并通过保护国合理确信这些物资确系用于救济需要援助的平民，而非服务于占领方的利益。

Query_Text_en: Article 60Relief consignments shall in no way relieve the Occupying Power of any of its responsibilities under Articles 55 , 56 and 59 .
Translation: 救济物资的供应不得以任何方式免除占领国根据第五十五条、第五十六条和第五十九条所承担的任何责任。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power shall in no way whatsoever divert relief consignments from the purpose for which they are intended , except in cases of urgent necessity , in the interests of the population of the occupied territory and with the consent of the Protecting Power .
Translation: 占领国不得以任何方式改变救济物资的预定用途，除非因紧急需要且为了被占领地区居民的利益，并经保护国同意。

Query_Text_en: Article 61The distribution of the relief consignments referred to in the foregoing Articles shall be carried out with the cooperation and under the supervision of the Protecting Power .
Translation: 第六十一条前款规定的救济物资分发应在保护国的合作与监督下进行。

Query_Text_en: This duty may also be delegated , by agreement between the Occupying Power and the Protecting Power , to a neutral Power , to the International Committee of the Red Cross or to any other impartial humanitarian body .
Translation: 此项职责亦可经占领国与保护国协商一致后，委托给中立国、红十字国际委员会或其他公正的人道组织。

Query_Text_en: Such consignments shall be exempt in occupied territory from all charges , taxes or customs duties unless these are necessary in the interests of the economy of the territory .
Translation: 在被占领土内的此类货物应免缴各项费用、税收或关税，除非因该地区经济利益需要而必须征收。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power shall facilitate the rapid distribution of these consignments .
Translation: 占领当局应确保这些物资的快速分发。

Query_Text_en: All Contracting Parties shall endeavor to permit the transit and transport , free of charge , of such relief consignments on their way to occupied territories .
Translation: 所有缔约方应努力确保此类救济物资在运往被占领土途中的过境和运输得以免费进行。

Query_Text_en: Article 62Subject to imperative reasons of security , protected persons in occupied territories shall be permitted to receive the individual relief consignments sent to them .
Translation: 第六十二条 除非因安全原因必需，被占领土内的受保护人应准许接收寄送给他们的个人救济物资。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] recognized National Red Cross [ Red Crescent , Red Lion and Sun ] Societies shall be able to pursue their activities in accordance with Red Cross principles , as defined by the International Red Cross Conferences .
Translation: 经国际红十字大会承认的各国红十字会（红新月会、红狮与太阳会等）应依据国际红十字大会所界定的红十字原则开展活动。

Query_Text_en: Article 64The penal laws of the occupied territory shall remain in force , with the exception that they may be repealed or suspended by the Occupying Power in cases where they constitute a threat to its security or an obstacle to the application of the present Convention .
Translation: 第六十四条 被占领土的刑法应继续有效，但占领国得在该等法律构成对其安全的威胁或妨碍本公约适用时，予以废除或暂停施行。

Query_Text_en: Subject to the latter consideration and to the necessity for ensuring the effective administration of justice , the tribunals of the occupied territory shall continue to function in respect of all offences covered by the said laws .
Translation: 在考虑到上述因素并确保司法有效实施的前提下，被占领土的司法机关应继续行使职能，处理上述法律所涵盖的所有违法行为。

Query_Text_en: The Occupying Power may , however , subject the population of the occupied territory to provisions which are essential to enable the Occupying Power to fulfil its obligations under the present Convention , to maintain the orderly government of the territory , and to ensure the security of the Occupying Power , of the members and property of the occupying forces or administration , and likewise of the establishments and lines of communication used by them .
Translation: 占领国可以对被占领领土的居民采取必要措施，但这些措施必须是为履行本公约规定的义务、维持被占地区的有序管理、确保占领国及其驻军或行政人员的安全、保护其财产，以及保障其使用的设施和通讯线路所必需的。

Query_Text_en: Article 65The penal provisions enacted by the Occupying Power shall not come into force before they have been published and brought to the knowledge of the inhabitants in their own language .
Translation: 第六十五条 占领国制定的刑罚条款，不得在未以当地居民的语言公布并使其知晓之前生效。

Query_Text_en: The effect of these penal provisions shall not be retroactive .
Translation: 这些处罚条款的效力不得溯及既往。

Query_Text_en: Article 66In case of a breach of the penal provisions promulgated by it by virtue of the second paragraph of Article 64 the Occupying Power may hand over the accused to its properly constituted , non-political military courts , on condition that the said courts sit in the occupied country .
Translation: 第六十六条 若违反本公约第六十四条第二款规定颁布的刑事条款，占领国可将涉案人员移交其依法设立的非政治性军事法庭审判，条件是该法庭须在被占领国境内设立并审理案件。

Query_Text_en: Courts of appeal shall preferably sit in the occupied country .
Translation: 上诉法院应尽可能在被占领国设立。

Query_Text_en: Article 67The courts shall apply only those provisions of law which were applicable prior to the offence , and which are in accordance with general principles of law , in particular the principle that the penalty shall be proportionate to the offence .
Translation: 第六十七条 法院应当仅适用犯罪行为发生前已生效的法律规定，并且这些规定须符合法律的一般原则，尤其是罪刑相适应原则。

Query_Text_en: The General Conference of the International Labor Organisation , Having been convened at Geneva by the Governing Body of the International Labor Office , and having met in its thirty-fourth session on 6 June 1951 , and Having decided upon the adoption of certain proposals with regard to the principle of equal remuneration for men and women workers for work of equal value , which is the seventh item on the agenda of the session , and Having determined that these proposals shall take the form of an international Convention , Adopts this twenty-ninth day of June of the year one thousand nine hundred and fifty-one the following Convention , which may be cited as the Equal Remuneration Convention , 1951 :
Translation: 国际劳工组织大会，由国际劳工局执行局召集，于日内瓦举行第三十四届会议，于1951年6月6日开幕，鉴于决定采纳关于男女工人同工同酬原则的若干建议案，此为本届会议议程第七项，鉴于决定将此等建议案以国际公约形式通过，于1951年6月29日通过下列公约，可称之为《1951年同工同酬公约》。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The term `` equal remuneration for men and women workers for work of equal value '' refers to rates of remuneration established without discrimination based on sex .
Translation: “男女工人同等价值工作的同等报酬"指在根据工作价值确定报酬标准时，不因性别而进行歧视。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 . Each Member shall , by means appropriate to the methods in operation for determining rates of remuneration , promote and , in so far as is consistent with such methods , ensure the application to all workers of the principle of equal remuneration for men and women workers for work of equal value .
Translation: 第二十一条 每个会员国应采取适合现行确定报酬标准的方法，促进并确保在符合这些方法的前提下，所有工人适用男女职工同等价值工作同酬的原则。

Query_Text_en: or [ d ] A combination of these various means .
Translation: 或 [d] 这些各种手段的综合运用。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 . Where such action will assist in giving effect to the provisions of this Convention , measures shall be taken to promote objective appraisal of jobs on the basis of the work to be performed .
Translation: 第三十一条 如采取此类行动有助于实施本公约的规定，应采取措施，以需履行的工作职责为依据，促进工作职位的客观评估。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The methods to be followed in this appraisal may be decided upon by the authorities responsible for the determination of rates of remuneration , or , where such rates are determined by collective agreements , by the parties thereto .
Translation: 本评估所采用的方法可由负责确定薪酬标准的主管部门决定；若此类标准通过集体协议确定，则由相关方决定。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Differential rates between workers , which correspond , without regard to sex , to differences , as determined by such objective appraisal , in the work to be performed , shall not be considered as being contrary to the principle of equal remuneration for men and women workers for work of equal value .
Translation: 基于客观评估所确定的所从事工作的实际差异而产生的工资差异（不考虑性别因素），不应被视为违反男女工人从事同等价值工作时应获同等报酬的原则。

Query_Text_en: Article 4Each Member shall co-operate as appropriate with the employers ' and workers , organizations concerned for the purpose of giving effect to the provisions of this Convention .
Translation: 第四条 每一会员国应适当与有关雇主组织和工人组织合作，以实施本公约的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 5The formal ratification of this Convention shall be communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office for registration
Translation: 本公约的正式批准应送交国际劳工组织总干事办理登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 61 . This Convention shall be binding only upon those Members of the International Labor Organisation whose ratifications have been registered with the Director-General .
Translation: 本公约仅对那些其批准书已向总干事登记的国际劳工组织成员国具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: 2 . It shall come into force twelve months after the date on which the ratifications of two Members have been registered with the Director-General .
Translation: 本协定应自两个成员的批准书向总干事登记之日起满十二个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] The territories in respect of which it reserves its decisions pending further consideration of the position .
Translation: 其暂予保留决定权、有待进一步考虑立场的领土。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The undertakings referred to in subparagraphs [ a ] and [ b ] of paragraph I of this article shall be deemed to be an integral part of the ratification and shall have the force of ratification .
Translation: 本条第I段[a]和[b]款所指的承诺应被视为批准的不可分割部分，并具有批准的效力。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any member may at any time by a subsequent declaration cancel in whole or in part any reservation made in its original declaration by virtue of subparagraphs [ b ] , [ c ] or [ d ] of paragraph I of this article .
Translation: 任何成员均可随时通过后续声明，全部或部分撤销其根据本条第一款[ b ]、[ c ]或[ d ]项在其最初声明中所作的保留。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Any Member may , at any time at which the Convention is subject to denunciation in accordance with the provisions of article 9 , communicate to the Director-General a declaration modifying in any other respect the terms of any former declaration and stating the present position in respect of such territories as it may specify .
Translation: 任何缔约方均可在公约依据第九条规定可被终止的任何时间，向总干事提交声明，对先前声明的条款进行其他方面的修改，并就其指定的领土阐明当前立场。

Query_Text_en: Article 81 . Declarations communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office in accordance with paragraphs 4 and 5 of article 35 of the Constitution of the International Labor Organisation shall indicate whether the provisions of the Convention will be applied in the territory concerned without modification or subject to modification ; when the declaration indicates that the provisions of the Convention will be applied subject to modification , it shall give details of the said modifications .
Translation: 根据国际劳工组织章程第三十五条第四款和第五款向国际劳工局局长提交的声明，应表明本公约的规定将在相关领土内适用时是否不作任何修改或附带修改；若声明指出本公约规定将附带修改适用，则应说明具体修改内容。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Member , Members or international authority concerned may at any time by a subsequent declaration renounce in whole or in part the right to have recourse to any modification indicated in any former declaration .
Translation: 有关成员或国际机构可随时通过后续声明，全部或部分放弃就先前声明中所载任何修改提出诉求的权利。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Member , Members or international authority concerned may , at any time at which this Convention is subject to denunciation in accordance with the provisions of article 9 , communicate to the Director-General a declaration modifying in any other respect the terms of any former declaration and stating the present position in respect of the application of the Convention .
