Query_Text_en: Article 9The rights set out in Article 5 which are registered in one of the Contracting States in accordance with the national law of such State , and the priority thereby obtained , shall be recognized in all other Contracting States .
Translation: 根据某一缔约国国内法在该国注册的第五条所规定之权利及其因此获得的优先权，应在所有其他缔约国中得到承认。

Query_Text_en: Article 10No contracting State shall permit , except in the case of forced sale , the deregistration of the rights set out in Article 5 without the written consent of the holders of such rights .
Translation: 第十条 除强制出售的情形外，缔约国不得在未经相关权利持有人书面同意的情况下，准许对第五条所述权利进行除权登记。

Query_Text_en: A vessel which is being or has been constructed in a Contracting State shall not be eligible for registration in another Contracting State unless a certificate has been issued by the former State to the effect that the rights registered pursuant to Article 5 have been deregistered or that such rights will be deregistered on the day when the vessel is registered .
Translation: 正在建造或已经建造完成的船舶，若其建造地为某一缔约国，则不得在另一缔约国办理注册，除非原缔约国已签发证明书，明确该船舶根据第五条登记的权利业已注销，或该等权利将在船舶办理注册当日予以注销。

Query_Text_en: Article 11Any dispute between two or more contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention which can not be settled through negotiation , shall , at the request of one of them , be submitted to arbitration .
Translation: 第十一款 缔约各方之间因本公约的解释或适用产生的任何争端，如不能通过谈判解决，应其中一方请求，应提交仲裁。

Query_Text_en: If within six months from the date of the request for arbitration the Parties are unable to agree on the organization of the arbitration , any one of those Parties may refer the dispute to the International Court of Justice by request in conformity with the Statute of the Court .
Translation: 自仲裁请求提出之日起六个月内，如各方未能就仲裁机构的组成达成一致，任何一方均可按照国际法院规约的规定，向国际法院提出申请提起诉讼。

Query_Text_en: Article 121 . Each contracting Party may at the time of signature or ratification of this Convention or accession thereto , declare that it does not consider itself bound by Article 11 of the Convention .
Translation: 第121条 缔约方可在签署、批准或加入本公约时声明，其不受本公约第11条的约束。

Query_Text_en: The other contracting Parties shall not be bound by this Article with respect to any contracting Party having made such a reservation .
Translation: 其他缔约方对于任何作出此类保留的缔约方，均不承担本条规定的义务。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any contracting Party having made a reservation in accordance with paragraph 1 may at any time withdraw this reservation by notification to the Belgian Government .
Translation: 任何已根据第1款作出保留的缔约方均可随时通过向比利时政府发出通知撤回此项保留。

Query_Text_en: Article 13This Convention shall be open for signature by the States represented at the twelfth session of the Diplomatic Conference on Maritime Law .
Translation: 本公约应开放供出席海事法第十二届外交大会的国家签署。

Query_Text_en: Article 14This Convention shall be ratified and the instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the Belgian Government .
Translation: 第十四条 本公约应予批准，批准书应交存于比利时政府。

Query_Text_en: Article 151 . This Convention shall come into force three months after the date of the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification .
Translation: 第151条 本公约应自第五份批准书交存之日起三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . This Convention shall come into force in respect of each signatory State which ratifies it after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification , three months after the date of the deposit of the instrument of ratification .
Translation: 本公约应于第五份批准书交存后，对每一在其后批准本公约的缔约国，在该国批准书交存之日起三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 161 . States , Members of the United Nations or Members of the specialized agencies , not represented at the twelfth session of the Diplomatic Conference on Maritime Law , may accede to this Convention .
Translation: 第一百六十一条 未派代表参加海洋法外交会议第十二届会议的联合国会员国或专门机构成员国，可以加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Belgian Government .
Translation: 加入的正式文件应向比利时政府交存。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Convention shall come into force in respect of the acceding State three months after the date of deposit of the instrument of accession of that State , but not before the date of entry into force of the Convention as established by Article 15 [ 1 ] .
Translation: 本公约应于该加入国交存加入书之日起满三个月后对该国生效，但不得早于根据第十五条确定的本公约生效日期。

Query_Text_en: Article 17Each Contracting Party shall have the right to denounce this Convention at any time after the coming into force thereof in respect of such Contracting Party .
Translation: 第十七条 每一缔约方在本公约对其生效后，有权随时退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , this denunciation shall only take effect one year after the date on which notification thereof has been received by the Belgian Government .
Translation: 然而，本废除应仅在比利时政府收到通知之日起一年后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 181 . Any Contracting Party may at the time of signature , ratification or accession to this Convention or at any time thereafter declare by written notification to the Belgian Government which , among the territories under its sovereignty or for whose international relations it is responsible , are those to which the present Convention applies .
Translation: 第十八条 任何缔约方可在签署、批准或加入本公约时，或在其后任何时间，以书面形式通知比利时政府，声明本公约适用于其主权管辖下的领土或其负责国际关系的领土中的哪些地区。

Query_Text_en: The Convention shall three months after the date of the receipt of such notification by the Belgian Government , extend to the territories named therein .
Translation: 本公约应于比利时政府收到本通知之日起三个月后，扩展至通知中所述领土。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any Contracting Party which has made a declaration under paragraph [ 1 ] of this Article may at any time thereafter declare by notification given to the Belgian Government that the Convention shall cease to extend to such territories .
Translation: 根据本条第1款作出声明的任何缔约方，此后可随时通过向比利时政府发出通知的方式声明公约不再适用于该领土。

Query_Text_en: This denunciation shall take effect one year after the date on which notification thereof has been received by the Belgian Government .
Translation: 本废止应自比利时政府收到该废止通知之日起满一年后生效。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The denunciations received in accordance with Article 17 .
Translation: 根据第十七条所收到的控告。

Query_Text_en: Article 20Any Contracting Party may three years after the coming into force of this Convention , in respect of such Contracting Party , or any time thereafter request that a Conference be convened in order to consider amendments to this Convention .
Translation: 第二十条 任何缔约方可在本公约对其生效满三年后，或此后任何时间，请求召开会议以审议对本公约的修正。

Query_Text_en: Any Contracting Party proposing to avail itself of this right shall notify the Belgian Government which , provided that one-third of the Contracting Parties are in agreement , shall convene the Conference within six months thereafter .
Translation: 任何拟行使此项权利的缔约方应通知比利时政府，如获缔约方三分之一同意，比利时政府应于其后六个月内召开会议。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned plenipotentiaries , duly authorized , have signed this Convention .
Translation: 为此，下列全权代表经正式授权，签署本公约。

Query_Text_en: DONE at Brussels , this 27th day of May 1967 , in the French and English languages , both texts being equally authentic , in a single copy , which shall remain deposited in the archives of the Belgian Government , which shall issue certified copies .
Translation: 本协议于1967年5月27日在布鲁塞尔签订，法文和英文文本具有同等法律效力，正本一份存置于比利时政府档案馆，由比利时政府出具经认证的副本。

Query_Text_en: [ viii ] `` distribution '' is the operation by which a distributor transmits derived signals to the general public or any section thereof .
Translation: "发行"是指发行商向公众或其任何部分传输衍生信号的行为。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 [ 1 ] Each Contracting State undertakes to take adequate measures to prevent the distribution on or from its territory of any program Ccarrying signal by any distributor for whom the signal emitted to or passing through the satellite is not intended .
Translation: 第二条 [1] 每一缔约国承诺采取充分措施，防止在其领土内或从其领土向任何分发商传播任何节目信号，其中该信号并非旨在发送给该分发商或经过卫星传输。

Query_Text_en: This obligation shall apply where the originating organization is a national of another Contracting State and where the signal distributed is a derived signal .
Translation: 本义务应适用于以下情形：当原属机构为另一缔约国的法人实体且所分发的信号为派生信号时。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] In any Contracting State in which the application of the measures referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] is limited in time , the duration thereof shall be fixed by its domestic law .
Translation: 在任何对本条第[1]款所指措施的适用规定有期限限制的缔约国中，其期限应由该国国内法确定。

Query_Text_en: The Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations shall be notified in writing of such duration at the time of ratification , acceptance or accession , or if the domestic law comes into force or is changed thereafter , within six months of the coming into force of that law or of its modification .
Translation: 缔约国应于批准、接受或加入时以书面形式通知该期限；如此后国内法生效或修改，则应在该法律生效或修改后六个月内完成书面通知。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The obligation provided for in paragraph [ 1 ] shall not apply to the distribution of derived signals taken from signals which have already been distributed by a distributor for whom the emitted signals were intended .
Translation: 本条第[1]款规定的义务不适用于从已由该信号原定接收的分销商分发的信号中派生的信号的分发。

Query_Text_en: Article 3This Convention shall not apply where the signals emitted by or on behalf of the originating organization are intended for direct reception from the satellite by the general public .
Translation: 本公约不适用于下列情形：当由原发送机构或其代表发射的信号旨在由公众直接从卫星接收时。

Query_Text_en: Article 4No Contracting State shall be required to apply the measures referred to in Article 2 [ 1 ] where the signal distributed on its territory by a distributor for whom the emitted signal is not intended [ i ] carries short excerpts of the program carried by the emitted signal , consisting of reports of current events , but only to the extent justified by the informatory purpose of such excerpts , or [ ii ] carries , as quotations , short excerpts of the program carried by the emitted signal , provided that such quotations are compatible with fair practice and are justified by the informatory purpose of such quotations , or [ iii ] carries , where the said territory is that of a Contracting State regarded as a developing country in conformity with the established practice of the General Assembly of the United Nations , a program carried by the emitted signal , provided that the distribution is solely for the purpose of teaching , including teaching in the framework of adult education , or scientific research .
Translation:
第四条  
任何缔约国均无义务对第二条所述措施[1]加以适用，若以下情形成立：  
[i] 某一境内信号传播商所分发的信号中包含原始传输信号承载的节目短时段内容，且该内容为时事报道——但仅限于符合此类内容信息报道目的的必要范围；  
[ii] 某一境内信号传播商以引用形式使用原始传输信号承载的节目短时段内容，且此类引用需符合合理惯例并出于信息报道目的；  
[iii] 当相关领土属于联合国大会既定实践中被认定为发展中国家的缔约国时，若该信号传播行为专门用于教学目的（包括成人教育框架内的教学）或科学研究，则可分发原始传输信号承载的节目。

Query_Text_en: Article 5No Contracting State shall be required to apply this Convention with respect to any signal emitted before this Convention entered into force for that State .
Translation: 第五条 任何缔约国均不得要求对本公约对该国生效前发出的任何信号适用本公约。

Query_Text_en: Article 6This Convention shall in no way be interpreted to limit or prejudice the protection secured to authors , performers , producers of phonograms , or broadcasting organizations , under any domestic law or international agreement .
Translation: 本公约不得被解释为限制或损害作者、表演者、录音制品制作者或广播组织依据任何国内法律或国际协议所获得的保护。

Query_Text_en: Article 7This Convention shall in no way be interpreted as limiting the right of any Contracting State to apply its domestic law in order to prevent abuses of monopoly .
Translation: 本公约不得被解释为限制任何缔约国为防止垄断滥用而适用其国内法的权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 [ 1 ] Subject to paragraphs [ 2 ] and [ 3 ] , no reservation to this Convention shall be permitted .
Translation: 第八条 [1] 除本条第2款和第3款另有规定外，不得对本公约提出保留。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Any Contracting State whose domestic law , on May 21 , 1974 , so provides may , by a written notification deposited with the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations , declare that , for its purposes , the words `` where the originating organization is a national of another Contracting State '' appearing in Article 2 [ 1 ] shall be considered as if they were replaced by the words `` where the signal is emitted from the territory of another Contracting State .
Translation: 任何在1974年5月21日已根据其国内法作出相关规定之缔约国，可通过向联合国秘书长递交一份书面声明，宣布其将本条约第二条中出现的"当原始发播组织属于另一缔约国国民"的表述视为已替换为"当该信号由另一缔约国领土内发出"。

Query_Text_en: '' [ 3 ] [ a ] Any Contracting State which , on May 21 , 1974 , limits or denies protection with respect to the distribution of program Ccarrying signals by means of wires , cable or other similar communications channels to subscribing members of the public may , by a written notification deposited with the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations , declare that , to the extent that and as long as its domestic law limits or denies protection , it will not apply this Convention to such distributions .
Translation: 任何缔约国如于1974年5月21日时，对通过电线、电缆或其他类似通信渠道向订阅用户提供节目信号的传输行为存在限制或拒绝保护，可向联合国秘书长提交书面声明，声明在其国内法限制或拒绝保护的范围内及期间内，不将本公约适用于此类传输。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any State that has deposited a notification in accordance with subparagraph [ a ] shall notify the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations in writing , within six months of their coming into force , of any changes in its domestic law whereby the reservation under that subparagraph becomes inapplicable or more limited in scope .
Translation: 根据子段落[ a ]提交通知的任何缔约国，应在其国内法律发生变更导致该子段落下的保留条款不再适用或范围进一步缩小之日起六个月内，以书面形式将变更情况通知联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 [ 1 ] This Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations .
Translation: 第九条 [1] 本公约应交存于联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: It shall be open until March 31 , 1975 , for signature by any State that is a member of the United Nations , any of the Specialized Agencies brought into relationship with the United Nations , or the International Atomic Energy Agency , or is a party to the Statute of the International Court of Justice .
Translation: 本条约应开放供签署，直至1975年3月31日。签署国范围包括：任何联合国会员国；任何与联合国建立关系的专门机构成员；国际原子能机构成员；或是国际法院规约的当事国。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] This Convention shall be subject to ratification or acceptance by the signatory States .
Translation: 本公约应经缔约国批准或接受。

Query_Text_en: It shall be open for accession by any State referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] .
Translation: 本协定应向本条第1款所指的任何国家开放加入。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Instruments of ratification , acceptance or accession shall be deposited with the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations .
Translation: 批准书、认可书或加入书应交存于联合国秘书长处。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] It is understood that , at the time a State becomes bound by this Convention , it will be in a position in accordance with its domestic law to give effect to the provisions of the Convention .
Translation: 应理解为，当一国受本公约约束时，该国应已根据其国内法具备实施公约条款的条件。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 [ 1 ] This Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification , acceptance or accession .
Translation: 第十条（一）本公约应自第五份批准书、接受书或加入书交存之日起三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] For each State ratifying , accepting or acceding to this Convention after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification , acceptance or accession , this Convention shall enter into force three months after the deposit of its instrument .
Translation: 对于在第五份批准书、接受书或加入书交存之后批准、接受或加入本公约的每一国家，本公约应在其交存批准书、接受书或加入书之日起三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 [ 1 ] Any Contracting State may denounce this Convention by written notification deposited with the Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations .
Translation: 第十一款 [1] 任何缔约国均可通过向联合国秘书长交存书面通知的方式退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Denunciation shall take effect twelve months after the date on which the notification referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] is received .
Translation: 废约应自收到第一条所指通知之日起满十二个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 [ 1 ] This Convention shall be signed in a single copy in English , French , Russian and Spanish , the four texts being equally authentic .
Translation: 第十二条 [1] 本公约应以英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文四种文字签订，每种文本具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Official texts shall be established by the Director CGeneral of the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Director General of the World Intellectual Property Organization , after consultation with the interested Governments , in the Arabic , Dutch , German , Italian and Portuguese languages .
Translation: 官方文本应由联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事和世界知识产权组织总干事在与有关国家政府协商后，以阿拉伯语、荷兰语、德语、意大利语和葡萄牙语制定。

Query_Text_en: [ v ] the receipt of notifications of denunciation .
Translation: 收到废除通知。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The Secretary CGeneral of the United Nations shall transmit two certified copies of this Convention to all States referred to in Article 9 [ 1 ] .
Translation: 联合国秘书长应将本公约的两份认证副本递交《公约》第九条所指各国。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The wounded , sick and shipwrecked shall be collected and cared for .
Translation: 伤者、病者和遇船难者应予收容并妥善照料。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 In case of hostilities between land and naval forces of Parties to the conflict , the provisions of the present Convention shall apply only to forces on board ship .
Translation: 第四条 在冲突各方的陆海军部队之间发生敌对行动时，本公约的规定仅适用于舰上部队。

Query_Text_en: Forces put ashore shall immediately become subject to the provisions of the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of August 12 , 1949 .
Translation: 登陆的部队应立即受1949年8月12日《改善战地武装力量伤病者状况公约》条款的约束。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Neutral Powers shall apply by analogy the provisions of the present Convention to the wounded , sick and shipwrecked , and to members of the medical personnel and to chaplains of the armed forces of the Parties to the conflict received or interned in their territory , as well as to dead persons found .
Translation: 中立国应类推适用本公约的规定，处理接收或拘留于其领土内的冲突各方伤病员和遇船难者、武装力量的医疗人员及随军牧师，以及发现的遗体。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 In addition to the agreements expressly provided for in Articles 10 , 18 , 31 , 38 , 39 , 40 , 43 and 53 , the High Contracting Parties may conclude other special agreements for all matters concerning which they may deem it suitable to make separate provision .
Translation: 除本公约第10条、第18条、第31条、第38条、第39条、第40条、第43条及第53条明确规定之协定外，缔约国对于认为需要另行作出规定之各项事宜，可缔结其他特殊协定。

Query_Text_en: No special agreement shall adversely affect the situation of wounded , sick and shipwrecked persons , of members of the medical personnel or of chaplains , as defined by the present Convention , nor restrict the rights which it confers upon them .
Translation: 任何特别协议均不得对本公约所界定的伤者、病者、遇船难者以及医疗人员或随军牧师的情况产生不利影响，亦不得限制本公约赋予他们的权利。

Query_Text_en: Wounded , sick and shipwrecked persons , as well as medical personnel and chaplains , shall continue to have the benefit of such agreements as long as the Convention is applicable to them , except where express provisions to the contrary are contained in the aforesaid or in subsequent agreements , or where more favourable measures have been taken with regard to them by one or other of the Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 战伤者、患病者和遇难者，以及医疗人员和随军牧师，只要《公约》对他们适用，应继续享有此类协议规定的待遇，除非上述协议或后续协议中有明确相反的规定，或冲突各方中的一方已针对其采取了更为有利的措施。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 Wounded , sick and shipwrecked persons , as well as members of the medical personnel and chaplains , may in no circumstances renounce in part or in entirety the rights secured to them by the present Convention , and by the special agreements referred to in the foregoing Article , if such there be .
Translation: 第七条 受伤、患病及遇船难者，以及医疗人员和随军牧师，不得在任何情况下部分或全部放弃本公约以及前款所提及的专门协定所赋予他们的权利，如有此类协定。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 The present Convention shall be applied with the cooperation and under the scrutiny of the Protecting Powers whose duty it is to safeguard the interests of the Parties to the conflict .
Translation: 本公约应通过保护国的合作并在其监督下实施，保护国的职责在于保护冲突各方的利益。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 The provisions of the present Convention constitute no obstacle to the humanitarian activities which the International Committee of the Red Cross or any other impartial humanitarian organization may , subject to the consent of the Parties to the conflict concerned , undertake for the protection of wounded , sick and shipwrecked persons , medical personnel and chaplains , and for their relief .
Translation: 本公约的各项规定不妨碍红十字国际委员会或其他任何中立的人道组织，在经有关冲突各方同意后，为保护伤病员、遇船难人员、医疗人员和宗教人员以及为其提供救济而开展的人道活动。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 The High Contracting Parties may at any time agree to entrust to an organization which offers all guarantees of impartiality and efficacy the duties incumbent on the Protecting Powers by virtue of the present Convention .
Translation: 第十条 缔约国可随时协议决定，将本公约规定由保护国承担的职责，委托给具备公正性和有效性保障的组织履行。

Query_Text_en: When wounded , sick and shipwrecked , or medical personnel and chaplains do not benefit or cease to benefit , no matter for what reason , by the activities of a Protecting Power or of an organization provided for in the first paragraph above , the Detaining Power shall request a neutral State , or such an organization , to undertake the functions performed under the present Convention by a Protecting Power designated by the Parties to a conflict .
Translation: 当伤者、病者、遇船难者以及医务人员和随军牧师因保护国或本条第一款所述组织的活动未能获得利益或停止获得利益，无论出于何种原因时，拘留国应请求中立国或此类组织承担冲突各方指定的保护国根据本公约所履行的职能。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 In cases where they deem it advisable in the interest of protected persons , particularly in cases of disagreement between the Parties to the conflict as to the application or interpretation of the provisions of the present Convention , the Protecting Powers shall lend their good offices with a view to settling the disagreement .
Translation: 第十一款 在保护国认为有必要维护受保护人利益的情况下，尤其是当冲突各方就本公约条款的适用或解释发生分歧时，保护国应提供斡旋协助，以期解决分歧。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , each of the Protecting Powers may , either at the invitation of one Party or on its own initiative , propose to the Parties to the conflict a meeting of their representatives , in particular of the authorities responsible for the wounded , sick and shipwrecked , medical personnel and chaplains , possibly on neutral territory suitably chosen .
Translation: 为此，每一保护国可应冲突一方邀请或自行主动提议，召集冲突各方代表举行会议，特别是召集负责伤者、病者、遇船难者、医务人员和随军牧师的当局代表参加，会议地点可选择在适当选定的中立领土上。

Query_Text_en: The Protecting Powers may , if necessary , propose for approval by the Parties to the conflict , a person belonging to a neutral Power or delegated by the International Committee of the Red Cross , who shall be invited to take part in such a meeting .
Translation: 保护国如必要，可提议由冲突各方批准一名来自中立国或由红十字国际委员会指派的人员，并邀请其参加此类会议。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 Members of the armed forces and other persons mentioned in the following Article , who are at sea and who are wounded , sick or shipwrecked , shall be respected and protected in all circumstances , it being understood that the term `` shipwreck '' means shipwreck from any cause and includes forced landings at sea by or from aircraft .
Translation: 第十二条 在海上遭遇受伤、患病或遇难的武装部队成员以及本以下条文所提及的其他人员，应在一切情况下受到尊重和保护。此处"遇难"一词指因任何原因发生的海难，并包括航空器在海上因故迫降的情形。

Query_Text_en: Such persons shall be treated humanely and cared for by the Parties to the conflict in whose power they may be , without any adverse distinction founded on sex , race , nationality , religion , political opinions , or any other similar criteria .
Translation: 此类人员应由实际控制他们的冲突各方予以人道对待和妥善照料，不得有任何基于性别、种族、国籍、宗教、政治观点或其他任何类似标准的不利区别。

Query_Text_en: in particular , they shall not be murdered or exterminated , subjected to torture or to biological experiments ; they shall not wilfully be left without medical assistance and care , nor shall conditions exposing them to contagion or infection be created .
Translation: 他们不得被杀害或灭绝，不得遭受酷刑或进行生物实验；不得故意不给予医疗救治和护理，亦不得故意制造使其遭受传染或感染的环境。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] Inhabitants of a non-occupied territory who , on the approach of the enemy , spontaneously take up arms to resist the invading forces , without having had time to form themselves into regular armed units , provided they carry arms openly and respect the laws and customs of war .
Translation: [6] 凡未被占领地区的居民，在敌人逼近时自发武装抵抗入侵部队，且尚未组织成为正规武装单位者，只要其公开携带武器并遵守战争法规和惯例。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 All warships of a belligerent Party shall have the right to demand that the wounded , sick or shipwrecked on board military hospital ships , and hospital ships belonging to relief societies or to private individuals , as well as merchant vessels , yachts and other craft shall be surrendered , whatever their nationality , provided that the wounded and sick are in a fit state to be moved and that the warship can provide adequate facilities for necessary medical treatment .
Translation: 第十四条 交战国一方的所有军舰均有权要求移交载有伤病员及遇船难者的军用医疗船、救济团体或私人所有的医疗船，以及商船、游艇及其他船只上的伤病员，无论其国籍如何，只要该伤病员处于适合转移的状态且军舰能够提供必要的医疗救治设施。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 If wounded , sick or shipwrecked persons are taken on board a neutral warship or a neutral military aircraft , it shall be ensured , where so required by international law , that they can take no further part in operations of war .
Translation: 第十五条 如果伤者、病者或遇船难者被接载到中立国军舰或中立国军用飞机上，根据国际法规定，应确保其不得再参与作战行动。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Subject to the provisions of Article 12 , the wounded , sick and shipwrecked of a belligerent who fall into enemy hands shall be prisoners of war , and the provisions of international law concerning prisoners of war shall apply to them .
Translation: 第十六条 除第十二条另有规定外，交战国一方的伤者、病者和遇船难者若落入敌方手中，应视为战俘，国际法中关于战俘的规定应适用于他们。

Query_Text_en: The captor may decide , according to circumstances , whether it is expedient to hold them , or to convey them to a port in the captor 's own country , to a neutral port or even to a port in enemy territory .
Translation: 捕获方可根据具体情况决定是否适宜扣押相关物品，或将其运送至捕获方本国某一港口、中立港口，甚至敌方领土的港口。

Query_Text_en: In the last case , prisoners of war thus returned to their home country may not serve for the duration of the war .
Translation: 在这种情况下，被遣返回本国的战俘在战争期间不得继续服役。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 Wounded , sick or shipwrecked persons who are landed in neutral ports with the consent of the local authorities , shall , failing arrangements to the contrary between the neutral and the belligerent Powers , be so guarded by the neutral Power , where so required by international law , that the said persons can not again take part in operations of war .
Translation: 第十七条 经当地当局同意被送上中立国港口的伤员、病员或遇难者，在中立国与交战国之间没有相反安排的情况下，应由中立国根据国际法规定予以看管，确保这些人不能再参与作战行动。

Query_Text_en: The costs of hospital accommodation and internment shall be borne by the Power on whom the wounded , sick or shipwrecked persons depend .
Translation: 受伤者、患病者或海难遇险者的住院费用和收容费用，应由其所属国承担。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 After each engagement , Parties to the conflict shall , without delay , take all possible measures to search for and collect the shipwrecked , wounded and sick , to protect them against pillage and ill-treatment , to ensure their adequate care , and to search for the dead and prevent their being despoiled .
Translation: 冲突各方应在每次战斗结束后立即采取一切可能措施，搜寻并收容遇船难者、伤员和病患者，保护其免遭劫掠和虐待，确保其获得适当医护，并搜寻死者遗体，防止其被掠夺。

Query_Text_en: Whenever circumstances permit , the Parties to the conflict shall conclude local arrangements for the removal of the wounded and sick by sea from a besieged or encircled area and for the passage of medical and religious personnel and equipment on their way to that area .
Translation: 在条件允许的情况下，冲突各方应就从被围困或包围地区通过海路撤离伤员和病患，以及为前往该地区的医疗及宗教人员和设备的通行事宜达成地方性安排。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 The Parties to the conflict shall record as soon as possible , in respect of each shipwrecked , wounded , sick or dead person of the adverse Party falling into their hands , any particulars which may assist in his identification .
Translation: 冲突各方应尽快对于落入其控制下的敌方遇难、受伤、患病或死亡人员，记录有助于辨认其身份的详细情况。

Query_Text_en: As soon as possible the above-mentioned information shall be forwarded to the information bureau described in Article 122 of the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of August 12 , 1949 , which shall transmit this information to the Power on which these persons depend through the intermediary of the Protecting Power and of the Central Prisoners of War Agency .
Translation: 上述信息应尽快转交《1949年8月12日关于战俘待遇的日内瓦公约》第122条所规定的战俘信息局，并将此信息通过保护国及中央战俘事务局转交给这些人所属的国家。

Query_Text_en: They shall likewise collect and forward through the same bureau one half of the double identity disc , or the identity disc itself if it is a single disc , last wills or other documents of importance to the next of kin , money and in general all articles of an intrinsic or sentimental value , which are found on the dead .
Translation: 他们还应通过同一机构收集并转交以下物品：若为双份身份牌则提交其一半，若为单份身份牌则提交完整牌证；遗嘱或其他对近亲具有重要意义的文件；现金以及死者身上发现的所有具有内在价值或情感价值的物品。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 Parties to the conflict shall ensure that burial at sea of the dead , carried out individually as far as circumstances permit , is preceded by a careful examination , if possible by a medical examination , of the bodies , with a view to confirming death , establishing identity and enabling a report to be made .
Translation: 冲突各方应确保在条件允许的情况下进行的遗体海葬须在此之前对遗体进行仔细检查，如有可能由医务人员进行，以确认死亡、确定身份并能够作出报告。

Query_Text_en: Where a double identity disc is used , one half of the disc should remain on the body .
Translation: 使用双身份圆盘时，圆盘的一半应保留在主体上。

Query_Text_en: If dead persons are landed , the provisions of the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of August 12 , 1949 shall be applicable .
Translation: 若阵亡者遗体得到处理，则应适用1949年8月12日《日内瓦公约关于战地武装力量伤病者救治改善的条款》之规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 The Parties to the conflict may appeal to the charity of commanders of neutral merchant vessels , yachts or other craft , to take on board and care for wounded , sick or shipwrecked persons , and to collect the dead .
Translation: 冲突各方可向中立国商船、游艇或其他船只的指挥官请求善意协助，接载并照料伤员、病员或遇难人员，并收殓死者遗体。

Query_Text_en: Vessels of any kind responding to this appeal , and those having of their own accord collected wounded , sick or shipwrecked persons , shall enjoy special protection and facilities to carry out such assistance .
Translation: 响应本项呼吁的各类船只，以及自行收集伤者、病者或遇船难者的船只，应享受特殊保护并获得便利条件以开展此类救援工作。

Query_Text_en: but , in the absence of any promise to the contrary , they shall remain liable to capture for any violations of neutrality they may have committed .
Translation: 但若无相反承诺，其仍需对可能违反中立义务的行为承担被采取强制措施的责任。

Query_Text_en: Article 22 Military hospital ships , that is to say , ships built or equipped by the Powers specially and solely with a view to assisting the wounded , sick and shipwrecked , to treating them and to transporting them , may in no circumstances be attacked or captured , but shall at all times be respected and protected , on condition that their names and descriptions have been notified to the Parties to the conflict ten days before those ships are employed .
Translation: 第二十二条 军用医院船，即由各方专门建造或装备、其唯一目的是为了救助、治疗和运送伤员、病患者和遇船难者的船舶，在任何情况下均不得受到攻击或扣押，而应始终受到尊重和保护。此规定的条件是这些船只的名称和描述需在投入使用前至少十天通知冲突各方。

Query_Text_en: The characteristics which must appear in the notification shall include registered gross tonnage , the length from stem to stern and the number of masts and funnels .
Translation: 通知中必须载明的特征应包括注册总吨位、首尾长度以及桅杆和烟道的数量。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 Establishments ashore entitled to the protection of the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of August 12 , 1949 shall be protected from bombardment or attack from the sea .
Translation: 第二十三条 有权享受1949年8月12日《改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约》保护的岸上设施，不得受到来自海上的轰炸或攻击。

Query_Text_en: Article 24 Hospital ships utilized by National Red Cross Societies , by officially recognized relief societies or by private persons shall have the same protection as military hospital ships and shall be exempt from capture , if the Party to the conflict on which they depend has given them an official commission and in so far as the provisions of Article 22 concerning notification have been complied with .
Translation: 第二十四条 由各国红十字会、经正式认可的救济团体或私人个体使用的医院船，如果其所属冲突方已对其授予正式委托，并且已遵守关于通知的第二十二条之规定，则应享有与军用医院船同等的保护并免于被扣押。

Query_Text_en: These ships must be provided with certificates from the responsible authorities , stating that the vessels have been under their control while fitting out and on departure .
Translation: 这些船舶必须由主管部门签发证书，证明相关船舶在舾装及离港期间始终处于其监管之下。

Query_Text_en: Article 25 Hospital ships utilized by National Red Cross Societies , officially recognized relief societies , or private persons of neutral countries shall have the same protection as military hospital ships and shall be exempt from capture , on condition that they have placed themselves under the control of one of the Parties to the conflict , with the previous consent of their own governments and with the authorization of the Party to the conflict concerned , in so far as the provisions of Article 22 concerning notification have been complied with .
Translation: 第二十五条 各国红十字会、经正式承认的救济团体或中立国私人所使用的医院船，应与军用医院船享有同等保护并免受扣押，但须满足以下条件：此类船只须经本国政府事先同意，并获得冲突有关方的授权后，置于冲突一方的控制之下；且须符合第二十二条关于通知的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 The protection mentioned in Articles 22 , 24 and 25 shall apply to hospital ships of any tonnage and to their lifeboats , wherever they are operating .
Translation: 第二十六条 本公约第二十二条、第二十四条和第二十五条规定的保护应适用于不论吨位大小的医院船及其救生艇，无论其在何处执行任务。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , to ensure the maximum comfort and security , the Parties to the conflict shall endeavor to utilize , for the transport of wounded , sick and shipwrecked over long distances and on the high seas , only hospital ships of over 2,000 tons gross .
Translation: 冲突各方应努力使用总吨位超过2000吨的医院船，以确保伤者、病者和海难遇险者在长途运输和公海运输过程中获得最大程度的舒适与安全。

Query_Text_en: Article 27 Under the same conditions as those provided for in Articles 22 and 24 , small craft employed by the State or by the officially recognized lifeboat institutions for coastal rescue operations , shall also be respected and protected , so far as operational requirements permit .
Translation: 第二十七条 在符合第二十二条和第二十四条所规定条件的情况下，国家或官方认可的救生艇机构用于沿海救援行动的小型船只也应受到尊重和保护，但需在实际需要允许的范围内。

Query_Text_en: The same shall apply so far as possible to fixed coastal installations used exclusively by these craft for their humanitarian missions .
Translation: 对于这些船只专门用于其人道主义任务的固定沿海设施，也应尽可能适用相同规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 Should fighting occur on board a warship , the sick-bays shall be respected and spared as far as possible .
Translation: 第二十八条 若战舰上发生战斗，应尽可能尊重并豁免医疗舱。

Query_Text_en: Sick-bays and their equipment shall remain subject to the laws of warfare , but may not be diverted from their purpose so long as they are required for the wounded and sick .
Translation: 战地医院及其设备仍应受战争法规约，但只要其仍在救治伤员时需要使用，不得改变其用途。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , the commander into whose power they have fallen may , after ensuring the proper care of the wounded and sick who are accommodated therein , apply them to other purposes in case of urgent military necessity .
Translation: 所属部队落入其手中的指挥官可在确保收容在内的伤员和病患者得到妥善照料后，于军事紧急需要情况下将其（设施）用于其他用途。

Query_Text_en: Article 29 Any hospital ship in a port which falls into the hands of the enemy shall be authorized to leave the said port .
Translation: 第二十九条 如果某一港口落入敌方手中，则该港口内的任何医院船均应获准离港。

Query_Text_en: Article 30 The vessels described in Articles 22 , 24 , 25 and 27 shall afford relief and assistance to the wounded , sick and shipwrecked without distinction of nationality .
Translation: 第三十条 本公约第二十二条、第二十四条、第二十五条和第二十七条规定的船舶，应向伤者、病者和遇船难者提供救援和救助，并不得因国籍不同而有所区别。

Query_Text_en: The High Contracting Parties undertake not to use these vessels for any military purpose .
Translation: 缔约各方承诺不将这些船只用于任何军事目的。

Query_Text_en: Such vessels shall in no wise hamper the movements of the combatants .
Translation: 此类船只绝不得以任何方式妨碍交战方的行动自由。

Query_Text_en: During and after an engagement , they will act at their own risk .
Translation: 在合作项目期间及之后，他们将自行承担风险。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 The Parties to the conflict shall have the right to control and search the vessels mentioned in Articles 22 , 24 , 25 and 27 .
Translation: 第三十一条 冲突各方有权对第二十二条、第二十四条、第二十五条和第二十七条所提到的船只进行检查和搜查。

Query_Text_en: They can refuse assistance from these vessels , order them off , make them take a certain course , control the use of their wireless and other means of communication , and even detain them for a period not exceeding seven days from the time of interception , if the gravity of the circumstances so requires .
Translation: 如情况严重性需要，可拒绝相关船只提供援助，命令其撤离，要求其驶向特定航向，控制其无线电及其他通讯设备的使用，甚至扣留其船只，扣留时间自拦截之时起不得超过七日。

Query_Text_en: They may put a commissioner temporarily on board whose sole task shall be to see that orders given in virtue of the provisions of the preceding paragraph are carried out .
Translation: 他们可临时派驻一名专员，其唯一职责是确保根据前文所述条款所作出的指示得到执行。

Query_Text_en: As far as possible , the Parties to the conflict shall enter in the log of the hospital ship in a language he can understand , the orders they have given the captain of the vessel .
Translation: 冲突各方应尽可能以冲突各方能够理解的语言，将其向该船船长下达的命令记录在医疗船的航海日志中。

Query_Text_en: Parties to the conflict may , either unilaterally or by particular agreements , put on board their ships neutral observers who shall verify the strict observation of the provisions contained in the present Convention .
Translation: 冲突各方可单方面或通过特别协议的方式，在其船上安排中立观察员，负责核实本公约所载条款的严格遵守情况。

Query_Text_en: Article 32 Vessels described in Articles 22 , 24 , 25 and 27 are not classed as warships as regards their stay in a neutral port .
Translation: 第三十二条 根据第二十二条、第二十四条、第二十五条和第二十七条所述的船舶，在中立港口停留期间不视为军舰。

Query_Text_en: Article 33 Merchant vessels which have been transformed into hospital ships can not be put to any other use throughout the duration of hostilities .
Translation: 第三十三条 在敌对行动期间，被改造为医院船的商船不得用于其他任何用途。

Query_Text_en: Article 34 The protection to which hospital ships and sick-bays are entitled shall not cease unless they are used to commit , outside their humanitarian duties , acts harmful to the enemy .
Translation: 第三十四条 医院船和伤病船舱应享有的保护不应停止，除非其超出人道主义任务范围被用于对敌方有害的行为。

Query_Text_en: Protection may , however , cease only after due warning has been given , naming in all appropriate cases a reasonable time limit , and after such warning has remained unheeded .
Translation: 保护措施仅可在履行必要程序发出正式警告（在适当情况下明确设定合理期限）且该警告未予纠正之后方可终止。

Query_Text_en: In particular , hospital ships may not possess or use a secret code for their wireless or other means of communication .
Translation: 特别是，医院船不得拥有或使用无线或其他通信手段的秘密代码。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The transport of equipment and of personnel intended exclusively for medical duties , over and above the normal requirements .
Translation: 超出正常需求的专门用于医疗任务的设备和人员运输。

Query_Text_en: they may not be captured during the time they are in the service of the hospital ship , whether or not there are wounded and sick on board .
Translation: 在医院船上服务期间，无论船上是否有伤病人员，均不得予以俘获。

Query_Text_en: they may continue to carry out their duties as long as this is necessary for the care of the wounded and sick .
Translation: 只要继续履行职责对伤病者的医护工作是必要的，他们可继续履行职责。

Query_Text_en: They shall afterwards be sent back as soon as the Commander-in-Chief , under whose authority they are , considers it practicable .
Translation: 待其所属权限内的最高指挥官认为可行时，应将其送回。

Query_Text_en: They may take with them , on leaving the ship , their personal property .
Translation: 在离开船只时，他们可以携带自己的个人物品。

Query_Text_en: If , however , it prove necessary to retain some of this personnel owing to the medical or spiritual needs of prisoners of war , everything possible shall be done for their earliest possible landing .
Translation: 然而，如果由于战俘的医疗或精神需求确实需要保留部分人员，则应采取一切可能措施，确保他们尽快登陆。

Query_Text_en: Retained personnel shall be subject , on landing , to the provisions of the Geneva Convention for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded and Sick in Armed Forces in the Field of August 12 , 1949 .
Translation: 被保留人员在抵达时应遵守1949年8月12日《改善战地武装部队伤者病者境遇之日内瓦公约》的相关规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 38 Ships chartered for that purpose shall be authorized to transport equipment exclusively intended for the treatment of wounded and sick members of armed forces or for the prevention of disease , provided that the particulars regarding their voyage have been notified to the adverse Power and approved by the latter .
Translation: 第三十八条 为该目的而租用的船只获准专门运输武装部队伤员病员救治或疾病预防用途的器材，其航行详情须已通知敌对国并获后者批准。

Query_Text_en: The adverse Power shall preserve the right to board the carrier ships , but not to capture them or seize the equipment carried .
Translation: 敌对一方有权登临运载船只，但无权捕获这些船只或没收其所载设备。

Query_Text_en: By agreement amongst the Parties to the conflict , neutral observers may be placed on board such ships to verify the equipment carried .
Translation: 经冲突各方协议，可向此类船只派驻中立观察员以核实所载设备。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , free access to the equipment shall be given .
Translation: 为此目的，应提供设备的无限制使用权。

Query_Text_en: Article 39 Medical aircraft , that is to say , aircraft exclusively employed for the removal of the wounded , sick and shipwrecked , and for the transport of medical personnel and equipment , may not be the object of attack , but shall be respected by the Parties to the conflict , while flying at heights , at times and on routes specifically agreed upon between the Parties to the conflict concerned .
Translation: 第三十九条 专门用于运送伤员、病员、遇船难者以及医疗人员和设备的医疗飞机，不得作为攻击目标，而应受到冲突各方的尊重。此类飞机在飞行时，其飞行高度、时间及路线应由相关冲突各方事先特别商定。

Query_Text_en: They shall be clearly marked with the distinctive emblem prescribed in Article 41 , together with their national colors , on their lower , upper and lateral surfaces . They shall be provided with any other markings or means of identification which may be agreed upon between the Parties to the conflict upon the outbreak or during the course of hostilities .
Translation: 它们应按照第41条规定的醒目标志，并标有本国颜色，清晰标明于下、上及侧面表面。冲突各方可在冲突爆发时或冲突期间商定的其他标识或识别方式亦应予配备。

Query_Text_en: Medical aircraft shall obey every summons to alight on land or water .
Translation: 医疗飞行器应当服从所有在陆地或水面降落的指令。

Query_Text_en: In the event of having thus to alight , the aircraft with its occupants may continue its flight after examination , if any .
Translation: 如需因此降落，载有乘客的飞机经检查（如有）后可继续飞行。

Query_Text_en: In the event of alighting involuntarily on land or water in enemy or enemy-occupied territory , the wounded , sick and shipwrecked , as well as the crew of the aircraft shall be prisoners of war .
Translation: 在敌方或敌方占领的领土上陆地或水上迫降时，伤员、病员和遇船难者以及机组人员均应视为战俘。

Query_Text_en: The medical personnel shall be treated according to Articles 36 and 37 .
Translation: 医护人员应依照第三十六条和第三十七条的规定处理。

Query_Text_en: Article 40 Subject to the provisions of the second paragraph , medical aircraft of Parties to the conflict may fly over the territory of neutral Powers , land thereon in case of necessity , or use it as a port of call .
Translation: 除本条第二款规定外，冲突各方的医疗飞机得飞越中立国领土，因必要需在其中降落，或将其用作停靠港。

Query_Text_en: They shall give neutral Powers prior notice of their passage over the said territory , and obey every summons to alight , on land or water .
Translation: 他们应事先通知中立国有关通过所述领土的情况，并服从任何降落命令，无论是在陆地还是水域。

Query_Text_en: Unless otherwise agreed between the neutral Powers and the Parties to the conflict , the wounded , sick or shipwrecked who are disembarked with the consent of the local authorities on neutral territory by medical aircraft shall be detained by the neutral Power , where so required by international law , in such a manner that they can not again take part in operations of war .
Translation: 除非中立国与冲突各方另有约定，经医疗飞行器运送并在中立国领土上经当地当局同意登陆的伤者、病者或遇船难者，如国际法规定应被拘留，中立国应以使其不能再参与作战行动的方式予以拘留。

Query_Text_en: Article 41 Under the direction of the competent military authority , the emblem of the red cross on a white ground shall be displayed on the flags , armlets and on all equipment employed in the Medical Service .
Translation: 第四十一条 在有管辖权的军事当局指导下，白底红十字标志应显示于旗帜、臂章以及医疗部门使用的全部设备上。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , in the case of countries which already use as emblem , in place of the red cross , the red crescent or the red lion and sun on a white ground , these emblems are also recognized by the terms of the present Convention .
Translation: 然而，对于那些已经采用红新月标志或白底红狮日标志代替红十字标志的国家，这些标志也根据本公约条款予以承认。

Query_Text_en: Article 42 The personnel designated in Articles 36 and 37 shall wear , affixed to the left arm , a water-resistant armlet bearing the distinctive emblem , issued and stamped by the military authority .
Translation: 第四十二条 根据第三十六条和第三十七条指定的人员应当佩戴由军事当局颁发并加盖印章的防水臂章，该臂章应佩戴在左臂，并带有显著标志。

Query_Text_en: Such personnel , in addition to wearing the identity disc mentioned in Article 19 , shall also carry a special identity card bearing the distinctive emblem .
Translation: 此类人员除按照本条例第十九条规定佩戴身份牌外，还应当携带印有特定标识的特殊身份卡。

Query_Text_en: The card shall bear the photograph of the owner and also either his signature or his fingerprints or both .
Translation: 该卡应载有持卡人照片及其签名或指纹，或两者兼具。

Query_Text_en: In case of loss they shall be entitled to receive duplicates of the cards and to have the insignia replaced .
Translation: 如遇遗失，他们有权获得卡片副本并更换徽章。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] All exterior surfaces shall be white .
Translation: 所有外露表面均应为白色。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] One or more dark red crosses , as large as possible , shall be painted and displayed on each side of the hull and on the horizontal surfaces , so placed as to afford the greatest possible visibility from the sea and from the air .
Translation: 应在船体每一侧及水平表面上涂绘并设置一个或多个尽可能大的深红色十字，其位置应确保从海上和空中均可获得最佳可见度。

Query_Text_en: All hospital ships shall make themselves known by hoisting their national flag and further , if they belong to a neutral state , the flag of the Party to the conflict whose direction they have accepted .
Translation: 所有医院船应通过悬挂本国国旗表明身份，此外，如果属于中立国，还需悬挂其接受管辖的冲突方的国旗。

Query_Text_en: A white flag with a red cross shall be flown at the mainmast as high as possible .
Translation: 带有红色十字的白旗应悬挂于主桅杆尽可能高的位置。

Query_Text_en: Lifeboats of hospital ships , coastal lifeboats and au small craft used by the Medical Service shall be painted white with dark red crosses prominently displayed and shall , in general , comply with the identification system prescribed above for hospital ships .
Translation: 医院船的救生艇、沿海救生艇以及医疗部门使用的各类小型船只应漆成白色，并在显眼位置标有深红色十字标志，原则上应遵循上文对医院船规定的识别系统。

Query_Text_en: The above-mentioned ships and craft , which may wish to ensure by night and in times of reduced visibility the protection to which they are entitled , must , subject to the assent of the Party to the conflict under whose power they are , take the necessary measures to render their painting and distinctive emblems sufficiently apparent .
Translation: 上述船舶及船只如需在夜间或能见度受限时确保其依法享有的保护，须经冲突方中对其拥有管辖权的一方同意后，采取必要措施使船体涂装和识别标志足够醒目。

Query_Text_en: Hospital ships which , in accordance with Article 31 , are provisionally detained by the enemy , must haul down the flag of the Party to the conflict in whose service they are or whose direction they have accepted .
Translation: 根据第31条被敌方暂时扣押的医院船，必须降下其所属冲突一方或接受其指挥的交战方的旗帜。

Query_Text_en: Coastal lifeboats , if they continue to operate with the consent of the Occupying Power from a base which is occupied , may be allowed , when away from their base , to continue to fly their own national colors along with a flag carrying a red cross on a white ground , subject to prior notification to all the Parties to the conflict concerned .
Translation: 沿海救生艇若继续经占领当局同意从被占领地区基地开展活动，当其远离基地执行任务时，可获准同时悬挂本国国旗及白底红十字标志旗，但须事先通知相关冲突各方。

Query_Text_en: All the provisions in this Article relating to the red cross shall apply equally to the other emblems mentioned in Article 41 .
Translation: 本条中所有关于红十字的规定，应同样适用于《公约》第41条所提到的其他标志。

Query_Text_en: Parties to the conflict shall at all times endeavor to conclude mutual agreements in order to use the most modern methods available to facilitate the identification of hospital ships .
Translation: 冲突各方应始终努力达成相互协议，以便利用现有最先进的方法，便于识别医院船。

Query_Text_en: Article 44 The distinguishing signs referred to in Article 43 can only be used , whether in time of peace or war , for indicating or protecting the ships therein mentioned , except as may be provided in any other international Convention or by agreement between all the Parties to the conflict concerned .
Translation: 第四十四条 本条所述识别标志仅可用于标明或保护所述船只，无论平时还是战时，除非另有国际公约规定或有关冲突各方之间达成协议。

Query_Text_en: Article 45 The High Contracting Parties shall , if their legislation is not already adequate , take the measures necessary for the prevention and repression , at all times , of any abuse of the distinctive signs provided for under Article 43 .
Translation: 缔约国如其现有立法尚不充分，应随时采取必要措施，以预防和惩治对第四十三条所规定的特殊标志的任何滥用。

Query_Text_en: Article 46 Each Party to the conflict , acting through its Commanders-in-Chief , shall ensure the detailed execution of the preceding Articles and provide for unforeseen cases , in conformity with the general principles of the present Convention .
Translation: 第四十六条 冲突各方应通过其最高统帅，确保严格履行前款规定，并为意外情况作出规定，同时符合本公约的基本原则。

Query_Text_en: Article 47 Reprisals against the wounded , sick and shipwrecked persons , the personnel , the vessels or the equipment protected by the Convention are prohibited .
Translation: 禁止对受本公约保护的伤者、病者、遇船难者、人员、船只或设备进行报复。

Query_Text_en: Article 48 The High Contracting Parties undertake , in time of peace as in time of war , to disseminate the text of the present Convention as widely as possible in their respective countries , and , in particular , to include the study thereof in their programs of military and , if possible , civil instruction , so that the principles thereof may become known to the entire population , in particular to the armed fighting forces , the medical personnel and the chaplains .
Translation: 第四十八条 缔约各国承诺无论平时还是战时，在其境内尽可能广泛地宣传本公约文本，并特别将其纳入军事教育计划，如有可能亦纳入平民教育计划，以便本公约原则广为人知，尤其使全体民众中的武装部队、医务人员和牧师知晓。

Query_Text_en: Article 49 The High Contracting Parties shall communicate to one another through the Swiss Federal Council and , during hostilities , through the Protecting Powers , the official translations of the present Convention , as well as the laws and regulations which they may adopt to ensure the application thereof .
Translation: 第四十九条 缔约各国应通过瑞士联邦委员会相互交换本公约的官方译本；在敌对行动期间，则通过保护国进行交换，同时应提交为确保本公约实施而可能制定的法律和规章。

Query_Text_en: Article 50 The High Contracting Parties undertake to enact any legislation necessary to provide effective penal sanctions for persons committing , or ordering to be committed , any of the grave breaches of the present Convention defined in the following Article .
Translation: 缔约各方承诺制定一切必要的立法，对实施或命令实施本公约下列条款所界定的严重破坏行为之人，提供有效的刑事处罚。

Query_Text_en: In all circumstances , the accused persons shall benefit by safeguards of proper trial and defense , which shall not be less favourable than those provided by Article 105 and those following of the Geneva Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War of August 12 , 1949 .
Translation: 在任何情况下，被指控者均应享有公正审判和辩护的保障措施，这些措施不得低于1949年8月12日《关于战俘待遇的日内瓦公约》第105条及以下条款所规定的水平。

Query_Text_en: Article 52 No High Contracting Party shall be allowed to absolve itself or any other High Contracting Party of any liability incurred by itself or by another High Contracting Party in respect of breaches referred to in the preceding Article .
Translation: 任何缔约国均不得免除自身或另一缔约国因前条所述违反行为而产生的责任，无论该责任由其自身或另一缔约国承担。

Query_Text_en: Article 53 At the request of a Party to the conflict , an enquiry shall be instituted , in a manner to be decided between the interested Parties , concerning any alleged violation of the Convention .
Translation: 第五十三条 应冲突一方的请求，有关各方应就任何涉嫌违反公约的行为，以协商确定的方式成立调查。

Query_Text_en: If agreement has not been reached concerning the procedure for the enquiry , the Parties should agree on the choice of an umpire , who will decide upon the procedure to be followed .
Translation: 如各方就审议程序未达成协议，则各方应就仲裁人的选择达成一致，由其决定应遵循的程序。

Query_Text_en: Article 54 The present Convention is established in English and in French .
Translation: 第五十四条 本公约以英文和法文文本制定。

Query_Text_en: Article 55 The present Convention , which bears the date of this day , is open to signature until February 12 , 1950 , in the name of the Powers represented at the Conference which opened at Geneva on April 21 , 1949 ; furthermore , by Powers not represented at that Conference , but which are parties to the Xth Hague Convention of October 13 , 1907 for the adaptation to Maritime Warfare of the Principles of the Geneva Convention of 1906 , or to the Geneva Conventions of 1864 , 1906 or 1929 for the Relief of the Wounded and Sick in Armies in the Field .
Translation:
本公约签署于本日，开放供下列国家签署，直至1950年2月12日为止：  
一、出席1949年4月21日在日内瓦开幕之会议的各国；  
二、未出席该会议但系下列公约缔约国的其他国家：  
（甲）1907年10月13日海牙第十公约（关于将1906年日内瓦公约原则适用于海战）；  
（乙）1864年、1906年或1929年日内瓦公约（关于战地伤病员救护）。

Query_Text_en: Article 56 The present Convention shall be ratified as soon as possible and the ratifications shall be deposited at Berne .
Translation: 本公约应尽快得到批准，批准书应存放在伯尔尼。

Query_Text_en: Article 57 The present Convention shall come into force six months after not less than two instruments of ratification have been deposited .
Translation: 本公约应于不少于两项批准书交存之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 58 The present Convention replaces the Xth Hague Convention of October 18 , 1907 , for the adaptation to Maritime Warfare of the principles of the Geneva Convention of 1906 , in relations between the High Contracting Parties .
Translation: 第五十八条 本公约在缔约国之间取代关于将1906年日内瓦公约原则适用于海上战争的1907年10月18日第十海牙公约。

Query_Text_en: Article 59 From the date of its coming into force , it shall be open to any Power in whose name the present Convention has not been signed , to accede to this Convention .
Translation: 自本公约生效之日起，未签署本公约的任何国家均可随时加入本公约。

Query_Text_en: Article 60 Accessions shall be notified in writing to the Swiss Federal Council , and shall take effect six months after the date on which they are received .
Translation: 第六十条 加入书应以书面形式通知瑞士联邦委员会，并自收到之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 61 The situations provided for in Articles 2 and 3 shall give immediate effect to ratifications deposited and accessions notified by the Parties to the conflict before or after the beginning of hostilities or occupation .
Translation: 第六十一条 第二条和第三条所规定的情况，应立即对冲突各方在敌对行动或占领开始之前或之后存档的批准书和已通知的加入产生效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 62 Each of the High Contracting Parties shall be at liberty to denounce the present Convention .
Translation: 第62条 每一缔约国均有权随时退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: However , a denunciation of which notification has been made at a time when the denouncing Power is involved in a conflict shall not take effect until peace has been concluded , and until after operations connected with the release and repatriation of the persons protected by the present Convention have been terminated .
Translation: 然而，若宣告退出的缔约国在冲突期间发出退出通知，则该退出声明不得生效，直至和平协议缔结完毕且与本公约所保护人员的释放及遣返相关的行动终止之后。

Query_Text_en: Article 63 The Swiss Federal Council shall register the present Convention with the Secretariat of the United Nations .
Translation: 第六十三条 瑞士联邦委员会应将本公约提交联合国秘书处登记。

Query_Text_en: The Swiss Federal Council shall also inform the Secretariat of the United Nations of all ratifications , accessions and denunciations received by it with respect to the present Convention .
Translation: 瑞士联邦委员会应将其就本公约所收到的所有批准、加入和退出通知，告知联合国秘书处。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned , having deposited their respective full powers , have signed the present Convention .
Translation: 为此，签署方在各自提交了全权证书后，特签署本公约如下。

Query_Text_en: DONE at Geneva this twelfth day of August 1949 , in the English and French languages .
Translation: 于1949年8月12日在日内瓦签订，用英文和法文写成。

Query_Text_en: The original shall be deposited in the Archives of the Swiss Confederation .
Translation: 原件应存档于瑞士联邦档案馆。

Query_Text_en: THE STATES signatory to the present Convention , MEETING under the auspices of the Customs Cooperation Council , in consultation with the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe [ ECE ] and the United Nations Educational , Scientific and Cultural Organization [ UNESCO ] , HAVING REGARD to proposals made by representatives of international trade and other interests , DESIRING to facilitate the display of goods at exhibitions , fairs , meetings , or similar events of a commercial , technical , religious , educational , scientific , cultural or charitable nature , CONVINCED that the adoption of general rules on the Customs treatment of such goods would afford considerable advantages to international trade and promote the international exchange of ideas and knowledge , HAVE AGREED as follows :
Translation: 缔约国，鉴于在海关合作理事会主持下举行会议，与联合国欧洲经济委员会（ECE）和联合国教育、科学及文化组织（UNESCO）进行磋商，考虑到国际贸易和其他利益方代表提出的建议，鉴于希望便利货物在展览会、交易会、会议或其他具有商业、技术、宗教、教育、科学、文化或慈善性质的类似活动中的展出，深信制定此类货物海关待遇的一般规则将为国际贸易带来重大益处，并促进国际间思想和知识的交流，现达成协议如下：

Query_Text_en: except exhibitions organised for private purposes in shops or business premises with a view to the sale of foreign goods ;
Translation: 除在商店或营业场所内为私人目的组织并旨在销售外国商品的展览外；

Query_Text_en: [ b ] the term `` import duties '' means Customs duties and all other duties and taxes payable on , or in connection with importation and shall include all internal taxes and excise duties chargeable on imported goods , but shall not include fees and charges which are limited in amount to the approximate cost of services rendered and do not represent an indirect protection to domestic products or a taxation of imports for fiscal purposes ;
Translation: “进口税”一词指关税以及与进口相关的所有其他应纳税费和税款，并包括对进口商品征收的所有国内税和消费税，但不包括那些金额仅限于所服务的大致成本、且不隐含保护国内产品或出于财政目的对进口商品征税的费用和收费。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] the term `` temporary admission '' means temporary importation free of import duties and free of import prohibitions and restrictions , subject to re-exportation ;
Translation: 暂准进口"指在免缴进口关税及不受进口禁令和限制的前提下，进行的暂时进口行为，但须以重新出口为条件。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] the term `` the Council '' means the Organisation set up by the Convention establishing a Customs Cooperation Council , done at Brussels on 15 December 1950 ;
Translation: “理事会”一词指由1950年12月15日于布鲁塞尔签署的《海关合作理事会成立公约》设立的组织。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] the term `` person '' means both natural and legal persons , unless the context otherwise requires .
Translation: “人”一词既指自然人，也指法人，除非上下文另有要求。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] equipment including interpretation apparatus , sound recording apparatus and films of an educational , scientific or cultural character intended for use at international meetings , conferences or congresses .
Translation: 专用于国际会议、研讨会或代表大会的教育、科学或文化性质的口译设备、录音设备及影像资料。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] the Customs authorities of the country of temporary importation are satisfied that the conditions of the present Convention shall be fulfilled .
Translation: 临时进口国的海关当局确认本公约的各项条件将得到满足。

Query_Text_en: or [ b ] be removed from the place of the event .
Translation: 或[ b ]被从事件发生地移除。

Query_Text_en: Article 41 . Goods granted temporary admission shall be re-exported within six months from the date of importation .
Translation: 暂准进口的货物应自进口之日起六个月内复运出境。

Query_Text_en: However , Customs authorities of the country of temporary importation may , with due regard to the circumstances and in particular the duration and nature of the event , require that the goods be re-exported within a shorter period which shall , nevertheless , extend at least one month after the termination of the event .
Translation: 进口国海关当局可根据具体情况，尤其是活动的持续时间和性质，要求货物在较短时间内重新出口，但该期限应至少延续至活动结束后一个月。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article the Customs authorities shall allow such goods which are to be displayed or used at a subsequent event to remain within the country of temporary importation , subject to compliance with such conditions as may be required by the laws and regulations of that country and provided that the goods are re-exported within one year of the date of importation .
Translation: 本条第一款另有规定外，海关当局允许拟在后续活动中展示或使用的货物暂留进口国境内，但须遵守进口国法律法规规定的条件，并确保货物自进口之日起一年内重新出口。

Query_Text_en: 3 . For valid reasons the Customs authorities may , within the limits laid down by the laws and regulations of the country of temporary importation , either grant longer periods than those provided for in paragraphs 1 and 2 of the present Article or extend the initial period .
Translation: 根据暂准进口国法律法规规定，在符合相关法定条件的情况下，海关 authorities 有权在本条第一款和第二款规定期限基础上，延长相关期限或给予更长的临时准予期限。

Query_Text_en: 4 . When goods granted temporary admission can not be re-exported as a result of a seizure , other than a seizure made at the suit of private persons , the requirement of re-exportation provided for in this Article shall be suspended for the duration of the seizure .
Translation: 根据本条关于复运出境的规定，若因非私人诉讼引起的扣押导致临时进口货物无法按期复运出境，则该货物的复运出境要求应暂停至扣押结束。

Query_Text_en: or [ c ] are destroyed , under official supervision , without expense to the Exchequer of the country into which they were temporarily imported ; as the Customs authorities may require .
Translation: 若[ C ]类货物系临时进口，则应在官方监督下予以销毁，且不产生任何费用由进口国国库承担；具体操作应按照海关当局的要求进行。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Goods granted temporary admission may be disposed of otherwise than by re-exportation , and in particular may be taken into home use , subject to compliance with the conditions and formalities applicable under the laws and regulations of the country of temporary importation in respect of such goods imported directly from abroad .
Translation: 获准暂时进口的货物除可重新出口外，还可通过其他方式处置，特别是可转为国内使用，但须遵守进口国针对直接从国外进口此类货物所适用的条件和手续规定。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] they are supplied free of charge from abroad and are used solely for distribution free of charge to the visiting public at the event , for individual use or consumption by the persons to whom they are distributed , [ ii ] they are identifiable as advertising samples and are individually of little value , [ iii ] they are unsuitable for commercial purposes and are , where appropriate , packed in quantities appreciably smaller than the smallest retail package , [ iv ] samples of foods and beverages which are not distributed in packs as provided for in [ iii ] above are consumed at the event , and [ v ] the aggregate value and quantity of the samples are , in the opinion of the Customs authorities of the country of importation , reasonable having regard to the nature of the event , the number of visitors to it and the extent of the exhibitor 's participation therein ;
Translation:
[一]此类物品系从境外免费提供，并仅用于在活动期间向参观公众免费分发，供领取人个人使用或消费；  
[二]此类物品可明确识别为广告样品且单件价值较低；  
[三]此类物品不具备商业用途属性，必要时以明显少于最小零售包装数量进行分装；  
[四]不符合上述[三]款包装规定的食品及饮料样品，须在活动期间被实际消耗；  
[五]进口国海关当局认为，样品的总价值和数量综合考虑活动性质、参观人数及参展商的参展规模后，应属合理范畴。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] they are supplied free of charge from abroad and are used solely for distribution free of charge to the visiting public at the event , and [ ii ] the aggregate value and quantity of such goods are , in the opinion of the Customs authorities of the country of importation , reasonable having regard to the nature of the event , the number of visitors to it and the extent of the exhibitor 's participation therein .
Translation: [一]此类货物系从境外免费提供，且仅用于在活动期间向参观公众免费分发；[二]进口国海关当局认为，此类货物的总价值及数量结合活动性质、参观人数及参展商参与规模等因素考量后属合理范围。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall not be applicable to alcoholic beverages , tobacco goods and fuels .
Translation: 本条第一款的规定不适用于酒精类饮料、烟草制品和燃料。

Query_Text_en: Article 7Files , records , forms and other documents which are imported for use as such at or in connection with international meetings , conferences or congresses , shall be admitted free of import duties and free of any import prohibition or restriction .
Translation: 在国际会议、研讨会或代表大会期间或与其有关联而专为使用目的进口的文件、记录、表格及其他文书，应免征进口关税且不受任何进口禁止或限制。

Query_Text_en: Article 8Each Contracting Party shall reduce to a minimum the Customs formalities required in connection with the facilities provided for in the present Convention .
Translation: 第八条 每一缔约方应尽可能简化与本公约规定的便利措施相关的海关手续。

Query_Text_en: All regulations concerning such formalities shall be promptly published .
Translation: 所有涉及此类手续的规定应当及时公布。

Query_Text_en: Article 91 . In cases where a Contracting Party requires security for compliance with the conditions governing the granting of facilities provided for in the present Convention , the amount of such security shall not exceed the amount of the import duties chargeable by more than 10 percent .
Translation: 第九十一条 在公约缔约方要求为提供本公约规定之便利的履约条件提供担保的情况下，此类担保的金额不得超过所征收进口关税金额的10%。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Such Contracting Parties shall endeavor to accept whenever possible a general security from the organiser of the event or from any other person approved by the Customs authorities , in place of individual security which might be required under paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 缔约方应尽可能接受活动主办方或海关当局批准的其他人员提供的总担保，以替代根据本条第1款可能要求的个别担保。

Query_Text_en: Article 101 . Customs examination and clearance on the importation and re-exportation of goods which are to be , or have been , displayed or used at any event shall , whenever possible and appropriate , be effected at that event .
Translation: 第一百零一条 对在任何活动中展示或使用过的进口或复出口货物，海关查验和放行手续应尽可能在该活动场所办理。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Contracting Party shall endeavor , wherever it deems it appropriate in view of the importance and size of the event , to establish a Customs office for a reasonable period within the premises of an event held within its territory .
Translation: 每一缔约方应当努力在认为活动的重要性和规模等因素适宜的情况下，在其领土内举办活动的场所内设立为期合理期限的海关机构。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Goods granted temporary admission may be re-exported in one or several consignments and through any Customs office open for such operations , and such re-exportation shall not be confined to the Customs office of importation , except in cases where , with a view to benefiting from a simplified procedure , the importer undertakes to re-export his goods through the Customs office of importation .
Translation: 根据临时进口许可进口的货物可分一批或分多批再出口，并可通过任何开放此类业务的海关机构办理，此类再出口手续不得限定于货物进口时的海关机构。但以下情况除外：进口商为享受简化程序而承诺通过货物进口时的海关机构办理再出口手续。

Query_Text_en: Article 11Products obtained incidentally during the event from temporarily imported goods , as a result of the demonstration of displayed machinery or apparatus , shall be subject to the provisions of the present Convention .
Translation: 第十一款 在展会期间通过暂时进口货物附带获得的产品，若系展示的机器或设备演示过程中产生，应受本公约条款的约束。

Query_Text_en: Article 12The provisions of the present Convention set out the minimum facilities to be accorded .
Translation: 本公约的各项规定列明了应予提供的最低限度设施。

Query_Text_en: They do not prevent the application of greater facilities which certain Contracting Parties grant or may grant in future by unilateral provisions or in virtue of bilateral and multilateral agreements .
Translation: 这不妨碍某些缔约方目前或未来通过单边规定或根据双边、多边协议可能给予的更优惠待遇的适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 13For the purpose of the present Convention the territories of Contracting Parties which form a Customs or economic union may be taken to be a single territory .
Translation: 根据本公约的规定，凡缔约方领土组成关税同盟或经济联盟的，可视为单一领土。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] prohibitions or restrictions imposed under national laws and regulations on grounds of public morality or order , public security , public hygiene or health , or for veterinary or phytopathological considerations , or relating to the protection of patents , trade marks and copyrights .
Translation: 根据国家法律法规，基于公共道德或公共秩序、公共安全、公共卫生或公共健康、兽医或植物病理学方面的考虑，或涉及专利、商标和版权保护而采取的禁止或限制措施。

Query_Text_en: Article 15Any breach of the provisions of the present Convention , any substitution , false declaration or act having the effect of causing a person or goods improperly to benefit from the facilities provided for in the present Convention , may render the offender liable in the country where the offence was committed to the penalties prescribed by the laws and regulations of that country and to payment of any import duties chargeable .
Translation: 第十五条任何违反本公约规定的行为，以及任何替换、虚假申报或导致人员或货物不正当受益于本公约规定便利措施的行为，均应在违法行为发生国，依该国法律对违法者追究责任，并责令补缴应缴税款。

Query_Text_en: Article 161 . The Contracting Parties shall meet together when necessary in order to consider the operation of the present Convention and , in particular , in order to consider measures to secure uniformity in the interpretation and application of the present Convention .
Translation: 缔约方应视需要举行会议，以审议本公约的执行情况，特别是考虑采取确保本公约解释和适用统一性的措施。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Such meetings shall be convened by the Secretary General of the Council at the request of any Contracting Party .
Translation: 此类会议应由理事会秘书长应任何缔约方的要求召集。

Query_Text_en: Unless the Contracting Parties otherwise decide , the meetings shall be held at the Headquarters of the Council .
Translation: 除非缔约方另有决定，会议应于理事会总部举行。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Contracting Parties shall lay down the rules of procedure for their meetings .
Translation: 缔约各方应制定其会议的议事规则。

Query_Text_en: Decisions of the Contracting Parties shall be taken by a majority of not less than two-thirds of the Contracting Parties present at the meeting and voting .
Translation: 缔约方的决定应由参加会议并投票的缔约方中不少于三分之二的多数作出。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Contracting Parties shall not take a decision on any matter unless more than half of them are present .
Translation: 缔约方不得对任何事项作出决定，除非有超过半数的缔约方到会。

Query_Text_en: Article 171 . Any dispute between Contracting Parties concerning the interpretation or application of the present Convention shall so far as possible be settled by negotiation between them .
Translation: 第171条 缔约方之间关于本公约解释或适用的任何争端，应尽可能通过谈判解决。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any dispute which is not settled by negotiation shall be referred by the Contracting Parties in dispute to the Contracting Parties , meeting in conformity with Article 16 of the present Convention , which shall thereupon consider the dispute and make recommendations for its settlement .
Translation: 凡通过谈判未能解决的争端，有关缔约方应将其提交缔约方会议审议。缔约方会议应根据本公约第十六条召开会议，审议该争端并提出解决建议。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Contracting Parties in dispute may agree in advance to accept the recommendations of the Contracting Parties as binding .
Translation: 缔约方中的争议方可以事先同意将缔约方的建议视为具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: or [ c ] by acceding to it .
Translation: 或[c]加入本协定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The present Convention shall be open until 31 March 1962 for signature at the Headquarters of the Council in Brussels , by the States referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 本公约应开放供本条第1款所提及的国家于1962年3月31日前在布鲁塞尔理事会总部签署。

Query_Text_en: Thereafter , it shall be open for their accession .
Translation: 此后，其将开放供其加入。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In the case envisaged in paragraph 1 [ b ] of this Article , the present Convention shall be subject to ratification by the signatory States in accordance with their constitutional procedures .
Translation: 在本条第1款（b）项所述情形下，本公约应由缔约国按照各自的宪法程序予以批准。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Any State , not being a Member of the Organisations referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article , to which an invitation to that effect has been addressed by the Secretary General of the Council at the request of the Contracting Parties , may become a Contracting Party to the present Convention by acceding thereto after its entry into force .
Translation: 根据本条第1款规定，任何不属于所涉组织成员国且已收到理事会秘书长就此发出加入邀请的国家，可在本公约生效后通过加入成为公约缔约国，该邀请应由缔约方提出请求。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The instruments of ratification or accession shall be deposited with the Secretary General of the Council .
Translation: 批准书或加入书应交存于理事会秘书长处。

Query_Text_en: Article 191 . The present Convention shall enter into force three months after five of the States referred to in paragraph 1 of Article 18 thereof have signed it without reservation of ratification or have deposited their instruments of ratification or accession .
Translation: 第191条。本公约应于第十八条第一款所指国家中五个国家签署本公约且不附保留条款，或交存其批准书或加入书之日起三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . For any State ratifying or acceding to the present Convention after five States have signed it without reservation of ratification or have deposited their instruments of ratification or accession , the present Convention shall enter into force three months after the said State has deposited its instrument of ratification or accession .
Translation: 对于在本公约已有五个国家无保留签署或已递交批准书或加入书之后再行批准或加入本公约的任何国家，本公约应在该国递交批准书或加入书之日起三个月后对其生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 201 . The present Convention is of unlimited duration but any Contracting Party may denounce it at any time after the date of its entry into force under Article 19 thereof .
Translation: 第二百零一条 本公约无限期有效，但自本公约根据第十九条生效之日起，任何缔约方均可随时退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The denunciation shall be notified by an instrument in writing , deposited with the Secretary General of the Council .
Translation: 终止应以书面形式通知，并将文件交存于理事会秘书长处。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The denunciation shall take effect six months after the receipt of the instrument of denunciation by the Secretary General of the Council .
Translation: 本退约声明应于理事会秘书长收到退约通知书之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 211 . The Contracting Parties meeting in conformity with Article 16 of the present Convention may recommend amendments thereto .
Translation: 第二百一十一条 缔约方根据本公约第十六条举行会议时，可建议对本公约进行修正。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The text of any amendment so recommended shall be communicated by the Secretary General of the Council to all Contracting Parties , to all other signatory or acceding States , to the Secretary General of the United Nations , and to UNESCO .
Translation: 经建议的任何修正案文本应由理事会秘书长通知各缔约方、所有其他签署国或加入国、联合国秘书长以及联合国教科文组织。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Within a period of six months from the date on which the recommended amendment is to communicated , any Contracting Party may inform the Secretary General of the Council :
Translation: 自建议修正案应予提交之日起六个月内，任何缔约方均可通知理事会秘书长：

Query_Text_en: [ a ] that it has an objection to the recommended amendment , or [ b ] that , although it intends to accept the recommended amendment , the conditions necessary for such acceptance are not yet fulfilled in its country .
Translation: 其 [a] 对建议的修正案持有异议，或 [b] 尽管其有意接受建议的修正案，但其国家内接受该修正案所需条件尚未得到满足。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If a Contracting Party sends the Secretary General of the Council a communication as provided for in paragraph 3 [ b ] of this Article , it may , so long as it has not notified the Secretary General of its acceptance of the recommended amendment , submit an objection to that amendment within a period of nine months following the expiry of the six-month period referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article .
Translation: 缔约方如根据本条第3款[b]项向理事会秘书长提交相关通知，只要其尚未通知秘书长接受建议的修正案，可在本条第3款所指六个月期满后的九个月期间内，就该修正案提交反对意见。

Query_Text_en: 5 . If an objection to the recommended amendment is stated in accordance with the terms of paragraphs 3 and 4 of this Article , the amendment shall be deemed not to have been accepted and shall be of no effect .
Translation: 如果按照本条第3款和第4款的规定对建议的修正提出反对意见，则该修正案视为未获通过，不产生效力。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] the date by which all the Contracting Parties which sent such communications have notified the Secretary General of the Council of their acceptance of the recommended amendment , provided that , if all the acceptances were notified before the expiry of the period of six months referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article , that date shall be taken to be the date of expiry of the said six-month period , [ ii ] the date of expiry of the nine-month period referred to in paragraph 4 of this Article .
Translation:
[i] 所有提交此类通知的缔约方均已向理事会秘书长提交接受该建议修正案的通知之日，但若所有接受通知均在本条第3款所述六个月期限届满前提交，则该日期应视为该六个月期限届满之日；  
[ii] 本条第4款所述九个月期限届满之日。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Any amendment deemed to be accepted shall enter into force six months after the date on which it was deemed to be accepted .
Translation: 任何被视为接受的修正案应自视为接受之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 8 . The Secretary General of the Council shall , as soon as possible , notify all Contracting Parties of any objection to the recommended amendment made in accordance with paragraph 3 [ a ] , and of any communication received in accordance with paragraph 3 [ b ] , of this Article .
Translation: 理事会秘书长应尽快通知所有缔约方根据第3[a]款提出的对建议修正案的任何反对意见，以及根据第3[b]款收到的任何通信。

Query_Text_en: He shall subsequently inform all the Contracting Parties whether the Contracting Party or Parties which have sent such communication raise an objection to the recommended amendment or accept it .
Translation: 他应随后通知所有缔约方，提交该通知的缔约方是否对建议的修正案提出异议或表示接受。

Query_Text_en: 9 . Any State ratifying or acceding to the present Convention shall be deemed to have accepted any amendments thereto which have entered into force at the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification or accession .
Translation: 任何缔约国在交存批准书或加入书时，应视为已接受该公约在其交存文件之日业已生效的任何修正案。

Query_Text_en: Article 221 . Any State may , at the time of signing the present Convention without reservation of ratification , or of depositing its instrument of ratification or accession or at any time thereafter , declare by notification given to the Secretary General of the Council that the present Convention shall extend to all or any of the territories for whose international relations it is responsible and the Convention shall extend to the territories named in the notification three months after the date of the receipt thereof by the Secretary General of the Council but not before the Convention has entered into force for the State concerned .
Translation: 第二百二十一款 任何国家可在签署本公约时不附保留批准，或在交存批准书或加入书时，或在此之后任何时间，通过向理事会秘书长提交声明，宣布本公约应适用于其负责国际关系的所有或部分领土。该公约应自理事会秘书长收到该声明之日起三个月后扩展至所列领土，但不得早于该公约对相关国家生效之日。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any State which has made a declaration under paragraph 1 of this Article extending the present Convention to any territory for whose international relations it is responsible may notify the Secretary General of the Council , in accordance with the provisions of Article 20 of the present Convention , that the territory in question will no longer apply the Convention .
Translation: 任何根据本条第1款作出声明，将本公约扩大适用至其负责国际关系的任何领土的国家，可按照本公约第20条的规定，向理事会秘书长通知该领土将不再适用本公约。

Query_Text_en: Article 231 . Any State may declare at the time of signing , ratifying or acceding to the present Convention , or notify the Secretary General of the Council after becoming a Contracting Party to the Convention , that it does not consider itself bound by the provisions of Article 6 , paragraph 1 [ a ] , of the present Convention .
Translation: 第二百三十一条 任何国家可以在签署、批准或加入本公约时声明，或在成为本公约缔约国后通知理事会秘书长，其不视为受本公约第六条第一款（a）项规定的约束。

Query_Text_en: Such declarations or notifications shall stipulate the specific goods in respect of which the reservation is made .
Translation: 此类声明或通知应明确规定该保留所涉及的具体货物。

Query_Text_en: Notifications addressed to the Secretary General shall take effect on the ninetieth day after their receipt by the Secretary General .
Translation: 提交给秘书长的通知应自秘书长收到该通知之日起第九十日生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If a Contracting Party enters a reservation under paragraph 1 of this Article , the other Contracting Parties shall not be bound , in relation to that Contracting Party , by Article 6 , paragraph 1 [ a ] , of the present Convention in respect of the goods specified in that reservation .
Translation: 如果一缔约方根据本条第一款提出保留，其他缔约方对该缔约方而言，就本公约第六条第一款（a）项所列明的货物，不受该条款的约束。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any Contracting Party having entered a reservation as provided for in paragraph 1 of this Article may at any time withdraw such reservation by notifying the Secretary General of the Council .
Translation: 根据本条第一款作出保留的任何缔约方，可通过通知理事会秘书长随时撤回该保留。

Query_Text_en: 4 . No other reservation to the present Convention shall be permitted .
Translation: 对本公约不得提出任何其他保留。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] declarations and notifications made in accordance with Article 23 , paragraphs 1 and 3 , and the date on which reservations or withdrawals of reservations enter into force .
Translation: 按照第二十三条第一款和第三款作出的声明和通知，以及保留或撤销保留生效的日期。

Query_Text_en: Article 25In accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations , the present Convention shall be registered with the Secretariat of the United Nations at the request of the Secretary General of the Council .
Translation: 第二十五条 根据《联合国宪章》第一百零二条，本公约应安全理事会秘书长的请求向联合国秘书处登记。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned plenipotentiaries have signed the present Convention .
Translation: 兹证明下列全权代表签署本公约。

Query_Text_en: DONE at Brussels this eighth day of June nineteen hundred and sixty-one , in the English and French languages , both texts being equally authentic , in a single original which shall be deposited with the Secretary General of the Council who shall transmit certified copies to all the States referred to in Article 18 , paragraph 1 , of the present Convention .
Translation: 本公约于一九六一年六月八日在布鲁塞尔签订，正本为英文本和法文本两种文本，具有同等效力。正本一份存置于理事会秘书长处，由其将认证副本分送本公约第十八条第一款所指各国。

Query_Text_en: the term `` container '' shall include the accessories and equipment of the container , appropriate for the type concerned , provided that such accessories and equipment are carried with the container .
Translation: “集装箱”一词应包括适合该类型所需的集装箱附属设备和装置，前提是此类附属设备和装置随集装箱一同运输。

Query_Text_en: [ f ] The term `` operator '' of a container shall mean the person who , whether or not its owner , has effective control of its use .
Translation: 容器的“操作员”一词指实际控制其使用的人，无论其是否为该容器的所有人。

Query_Text_en: Article 2In order to benefit from the facilities provided for in the present Convention , containers shall be marked in the manner prescribed in Annex I.
