Translation: 第二条 为享受本公约规定的便利，集装箱应当按照附件一所规定的方式进行标记。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 . Subject to the conditions laid down in Articles 4 to 9 , each Contracting Party shall grant temporary admission to containers , whether loaded with goods or not .
Translation: 第三十一条 在本公约第四条至第九条规定的条件下，每一缔约方应准予集装箱临时进口，无论是否装载货物。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Contracting Party reserves the right not to grant temporary admission to containers which have been the subject of purchase , hire-purchase , lease or a contract of a similar nature , concluded by a person resident or established in its territory .
Translation: 缔约方有权拒绝给予作为购买、分期付款购买、租赁或类似性质合同标的物的集装箱临时准入。

Query_Text_en: Article 41 . Containers granted temporary admission shall be re-exported within three months from the date of importation .
Translation: 第四十一条 经准予暂时进口的集装箱，应当自进口之日起三个月内复运出境。

Query_Text_en: However , this period may be extended by the competent Customs authorities .
Translation: 不过，这一期限可由主管海关部门延长。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Containers granted temporary admission may be re-exported through any competent Customs office , even if that office is different from the one of temporary admission .
Translation: 获准临时进口的集装箱可以通过任何主管海关复运出境，即使该海关并非最初办理临时进口手续的主管海关。

Query_Text_en: or [ c ] destroyed , under official supervision , at the expense of the parties concerned , any parts or materials salvaged being subjected to the import duties and taxes to which they are liable at the time when , and in the condition in which , they are presented .
Translation: 在官方监管下，由相关方承担费用进行销毁，任何被抢救的部分或材料在提交时应缴纳进口关税和税款，具体以提交时的状况及时间为准。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If , as a result of a seizure , a container granted temporary admission can not be re-exported , the requirement of re-exportation laid down in Article 4 , paragraph 1 , shall be suspended for the duration of the seizure .
Translation: 若由于扣押原因导致暂准进口的集装箱无法再出口，则本条例第四条第一款规定的再出口要求在扣押期间暂停适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 6Without prejudice to the provisions of Articles 7 and 8 , containers temporarily imported under the terms of the present Convention shall be granted temporary admission without the production of Customs documents being required on their importation and re-exportation and without the furnishing of a form of security .
Translation: 第六条 在不影响本公约第七条和第八条规定的情况下，根据本公约条款暂时进口的集装箱应准予暂准进口，且在进出口和复出口时无需提交海关文件，亦无需提供担保形式。

Query_Text_en: Article 7Each Contracting Party may require that the temporary admission of containers be subject to compliance with all , or part of , the provisions of the procedure for temporary admission of containers , set out in Annex 2 .
Translation: 第七条 每一缔约方有权要求集装箱的暂时进口须遵守附件二载明的集装箱暂时进口程序中的全部或部分内容的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 8Each Contracting Party shall return the right , when the provisions of Article 6 can not be applied , to require the furnishing of a form of security and\/or the production of Customs documents on the importation or re-exportation of the container .
Translation: 第八条 当第六条的规定无法适用时，每一缔约方保留要求提交担保和/或在集装箱进口或复出口时出具海关文件的权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 91 . Contracting Parties shall permit containers granted temporary admission under the terms of the present Convention to be used for the carriage of goods in internal traffic , in which case each Contracting Party shall be entitled to impose one or more of the conditions set out in Annex 3 .
Translation: 缔约方应当允许根据本公约规定获准暂时进口的集装箱用于国内货物运输，各缔约方在此情况下有权规定一项或多项附件3中所列条件。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The facility provided for in paragraph 1 shall be granted without prejudice to the regulations in force in the territory of each Contracting Party regarding vehicles either drawing or carrying containers .
Translation: 本条第一款规定的便利措施应予以提供，但不得影响缔约各方领土内关于拖挂或装载集装箱的车辆现行有效的法规。

Query_Text_en: Article 101 . Temporary admission shall be granted to component parts intended for the repair of temporarily admitted containers .
Translation: 第一百零一条 对用于维修暂时进口集装箱的零部件，应准予暂时进口。

Query_Text_en: or [ c ] destroyed , under official supervision , at the expense of the parties concerned .
Translation: 或[c]在有关部门监督下销毁，相关方承担费用。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of Articles 6 , 7 and 8 shall be applicable mutatis mutandis to temporary admission of component parts , referred to in paragraph 1 .
Translation: 本公约第六条、第七条和第八条的规定应相应调整后适用于本条第1款所指零部件的临时进口。

Query_Text_en: Article 111 . The Contracting Parties agree to grant temporary admission to accessories and equipment of temporarily admitted containers , which are either imported with a container to be re-exported separately or with another container , or imported separately to be re-exported with a container .
Translation: 第一百一十一条 缔约各方同意给予暂时进口集装箱的附属设备和工具临时入境待遇。这些设备和工具无论是随集装箱进口后单独复运出境或与其他集装箱一同复运，或是单独进口后随集装箱复运出境，均适用本规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of Article 3 , paragraph 2 , and Articles , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 and 8 shall be applicable mutatis mutandis to the temporary admission of accessories and equipment of containers , referred to in paragraph 1 .
Translation: 本条第2款以及第4条、第5条、第6条、第7条和第8条的规定，应相应调整后适用于本条第1款所述集装箱的附件及设备的暂时进口。

Query_Text_en: Such accessories and equipment may be used in internal traffic under the terms of Article 9 , paragraph 1 , when carried with a container covered by the provisions of the said paragraph .
Translation: 此类配件和设备在随附本款规定集装箱时，可根据本条第一款的规定用于国内运输。

Query_Text_en: Article 121 . To qualify for approval for transport of goods under Customs seal , containers shall comply with the provisions of the Regulations set out in Annex 4 .
Translation: 第一百二十一条 申请经海关封志监管运输货物批准的，集装箱应当符合附件4中列明的《规定》各项要求。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Approval shall be granted under one the procedures laid down in Annex 5 .
Translation: 批准应依据附件5所列程序之一予以办理。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Containers approved by a Contracting Party for the transport of goods under Customs seal shall be accepted by the other Contracting Parties for any system of international carriage involving such sealing .
Translation: 缔约方批准的用于经海关封志运输货物的集装箱，应由其他缔约方接受，适用于涉及此类封志的任何国际运输方式。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Each Contracting Party reserves the right to refuse to recognize the validity of the approval of containers which are found not to meet the conditions set forth in Annex 4 .
Translation: 每一缔约方均有权拒绝承认经审查不符合附件4规定条件的集装箱的批准有效性。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , Contracting Parties shall avoid delaying traffic when the defects found are of minor importance and do not involve any risk of smuggling .
Translation: 然而，缔约方在发现的缺陷属于次要问题且不涉及任何走私风险时，应避免延误交通。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Before it is used again for the transport of goods under Customs seal , any container , the approval of which is no longer recognized , shall be either restored to the condition which had justified its approval or presented for reapproval .
Translation: 任何不再被认可批准的集装箱，在再次用于运输海关封志监管的货物前，应当恢复至最初获批时的状态，或重新申请批准。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Where a defect appears to have existed when the container was approved , the competent authority responsible for that approval shall be informed .
Translation: 如果在集装箱获得批准时已存在缺陷，负责该批准的主管部门应当予以通报。

Query_Text_en: 7 . If it is found that containers approved for the transport of goods under Customs seal in accordance with the procedures described in Annex 5 , paragraph 1 [ a ] and [ b ] , do not in fact comply with the technical conditions of Annex 4 , the authority which granted the approval shall take such steps as are necessary to bring the containers up to the required technical condition or to withdraw the approval .
Translation: 如果发现根据附件5第1段[a]和[b]所述程序批准用于海关封志监管下货物运输的集装箱，实际上不符合附件4规定的技术条件，那么作出批准的主管部门应当采取必要措施，使相关集装箱达到规定的技 术条件，或撤销相关批准。

Query_Text_en: Article 13The explanatory notes set out in Annex 6 interpret some provisions of the present Convention and its Annexes .
Translation: 附件六中载明的解释性说明，阐释了本公约及其附件的某些条款。

Query_Text_en: Article 14The present Convention shall not prevent the application of greater facilities which Contracting Parties grant or may wish to grant either by unilateral provisions or in virtue of bilateral or multilateral agreements provided that such facilities do not impede the application of the provisions of the present Convention .
Translation: 本公约不妨碍缔约方通过单边规定或依据双边或多边协定所给予或可能给予的更优惠待遇，只要此类优惠不阻碍本公约条款的实施。

Query_Text_en: Article 15Any contravention of the provisions of the present Convention , and any substitution , false declaration , or act having the effect of causing a person or an article improperly to benefit from the provisions of the present Convention , may render the offender liable , in the country where the offence was committed , to the penalties prescribed by the laws of that country .
Translation: 违反本公约规定，或实施替换、虚假申报、或导致他人或物品不当享受本公约规定利益的行为，可在犯罪行为发生国使行为人依法承担该国法律规定的刑罚。

Query_Text_en: Article 16The Contracting Parties shall communicate to one another , on request , the information necessary for implementing the provisions of the present Convention , and more particularly information relating to the approval of containers and to the technical characteristics of their design .
Translation: 第十六条 缔约方应应请求相互提供为实施本公约条款所需的信息，尤其是关于集装箱的批准及其设计技术特性方面的信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 17The Annexes to the present Convention and the Protocol of Signature form an integral part of the Convention .
Translation: 第十七条 本公约的附件和签字议定书构成公约的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 Signature , ratification , acceptance , approval and accession1 . The present Convention shall be open for signature until 15 January 1973 at the Office of the United Nations at Geneva and subsequently from 1 February 1973 until 31 December 1973 inclusive at the Headquarters of the United Nations at New York by all States Members of the United Nations or of any of the specialized agencies or of the International Atomic Energy Agency or parties to the Statute of the International Court of Justice , and by any other State invited by the General Assembly of the United Nations to become a Party to the present Convention .
Translation:
第十八条 签署、批准、接受、核准和加入  
1. 现行公约应自本日起至1973年1月15日止在日内瓦联合国办事处开放签署；随后自1973年2月1日起至同年12月31日止（包括该日），在纽约联合国总部开放签署。签署国应包括：  
（一）联合国或任何专门机构或国际原子能机构的成员国；  
（二）国际法院规约的当事国；  
（三）经联合国大会邀请成为本公约缔约国的其他国家。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The present Convention is subject to ratification , acceptance or approval by States which have signed it .
Translation: 本公约须经签署国批准、接受或核准。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The present Convention shall remain open for accession by any State referred to in paragraph 1 .
Translation: 本公约应继续对第1款所述的任何国家开放加入。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Instruments of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession shall be deposited with the Secretary-General of the United Nations .
Translation: 批准、接受、核准或加入书应予交存联合国秘书长处。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 Entry into force1 . The present Convention shall enter into force nine months from the date of the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation: 本公约应自第五份批准、接受、赞同或加入书交存之日起满九个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . For each State ratifying , accepting , approving or acceding to the present Convention after the deposit of the fifth instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , the present Convention shall enter into force six months after the date of the deposit by such State of its instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession .
Translation: 对于在第五份批准、接受、核准或加入文书交存之后批准、接受、核准或加入本公约的每一国家，本公约应于该国交存其批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书之日起满六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession deposited after the entry into force of an amendment to the present Convention shall be deemed to apply to the Convention as amended .
Translation: 本公约任何修正案生效后交存的批准、接受、核准或加入文书，均应视为适用于经修正的本公约。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Any such instrument deposited after an amendment has been accepted but before it has entered into force shall be deemed to apply to the Convention as amended on the date when the amendment enters into force .
Translation: 在修正案已被接受但尚未生效之后存档的任何此类文书，均视为适用于该修正案生效之日的修正后的公约。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 Termination of the operation of the Customs Convention on Containers [ 1956 ] 1 . Upon its entry into force , the present Convention shall terminate and replace , in relations between the Parties to the present Convention , the Customs Convention on Containers , opened for signature at Geneva on 18 May 1956 .
Translation:
第二十条 关于终止《1956年集装箱海关公约》实施  
1. 本公约生效后，在本公约缔约方之间，本公约应终止并取代于1956年5月18日在日内瓦开放签署的《集装箱海关公约》。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 12 , paragraphs 1 , 2 and 4 , containers approved under the provisions of the Customs Convention on Containers [ 1956 ] or under the agreements arising therefrom concluded under the auspices of the United Nations , shall be accepted by any Contracting Party for the transport of goods under Customs seal , provided that they continue to comply with the relevant conditions under which they were originally approved .
Translation: 尽管《1956年海关集装箱公约》第十二条第一、二、四款有相关规定，但根据该公约或在联合国主持下据此达成的协议批准的集装箱，各缔约方应接受其用于海关封志下的货物运输，前提是这些集装箱持续符合最初批准时的相关条件。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose certificates of approval issued under the provisions of the Customs Convention on Containers [ 1956 ] could be replaced by an approval plate prior to the expiry of their validity .
Translation: 根据《海关集装箱公约（1956）》相关规定签发的批准证书，可在其有效期届满前替换为批准牌照。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 Procedures for amending the present Convention including its Annexes1 . Any Contracting Party may propose one or more amendments to the present Convention .
Translation: 第二十一条 本公约及其附件的修正程序。1. 任何缔约方均有权向本公约提出一项或多项修正案。

Query_Text_en: The text of any proposed amendment shall be notified to the Customs Co-operation Council which shall communicate it to all Contracting Parties and inform the States referred to in Article 18 which are not Contracting Parties .
Translation: 任何拟议修正案的文本应提交至海关合作理事会，该理事会应将其转达所有缔约方，并通知第十八条所指的非缔约方国家。

Query_Text_en: The Customs Co-operation Council shall also , in accordance with the rules of procedure set out in Annex 7 , convene an Administrative Committee .
Translation: 海关合作理事会应当根据附件七规定的议事规则召开行政委员会。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any amendment proposed in accordance with the preceding paragraph , or prepared during the meeting of the Committee , and adopted by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting in the Committee , shall be communicated to the Secretary-General of the United Nations .
Translation: 根据前款规定提出的任何修正案，或在委员会会议期间拟定的修正案，经委员会出席会议并投票成员的三分之二多数通过后，应提交联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall communicate the amendment to the Contracting Parties for their acceptance , and to the States referred to in Article 18 which are not Contracting Parties for their information .
Translation: 联合国秘书长应将修正案通知缔约国供其批准，并将该修正案通知第十八条所指的非缔约国以便其知悉。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Any proposed amendment communicated in accordance with the preceding paragraph shall be deemed to be accepted if no Contracting Party expressed an objection within a period of 12 months following the date of communication of the proposed amendment by the Secretary-General of the United Nations .
Translation: 根据前款规定提交的任何拟议修正案，如在联合国秘书长提交该修正案之日起12个月内未有任何缔约方提出反对，则应视为已被接受。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall , as soon as possible , notify all Contracting Parties and the States referred to in Article 18 which are not Contracting Parties whether an objection to the proposed amendment has been expressed .
Translation: 联合国秘书长应尽快通知所有缔约方以及第十八条所指的非缔约国，有关对拟议修正案提出异议的情况。

Query_Text_en: If an objection to the proposed amendment has been communicated to the Secretary-General of the United Nations the amendment shall be deemed not to have been accepted and shall be of no effect whatever .
Translation: 如果对所提议的修正案提出的反对意见已向联合国秘书长提交，则该修正案应视为未获接受，并不得产生任何效力。

Query_Text_en: If no such objection has been communicated to the Secretary-General of the United Nations the amendment shall enter into force for all Contracting Parties three months after the expiry of the period of 12 months referred to in the preceding paragraph , or on such later date as may have been determined by the Administrative Committee at the time of its adoption .
Translation: 如未向联合国秘书长提出此类反对意见，则修正案应在前款所述12个月期间期满后三个月对所有缔约方生效；或在行政委员会于通过该修正案时所确定的较晚日期生效。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Any Contracting Party may , by notification to the Secretary-General of the United Nations , request that a conference by convened for the purpose of reviewing the present Convention .
Translation: 任何缔约方均可通过通知联合国秘书长，请求召开会议审议本公约。

Query_Text_en: The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall notify all Contracting Parties of the request and a revision conference shall be convened by the Secretary-General of the United Nations if , within a period of four months following the date of notification by the Secretary-General of the United Nations , not less than one-third of the Contracting Parties notify him of their concurrence with the request . Such conference shall also be convened by the Secretary-General of the United Nations upon notification of a request by the Administrative Committee . The Administrative Committee shall make such a request if agreed to by a majority of those present and voting in the Committee .
Translation: 联合国秘书长应将请求通知所有缔约国。自联合国秘书长发出通知之日起四个月内，若不少于三分之一的缔约国向其表示同意该请求，联合国秘书长应召集修订会议。同样，若行政委员会提出请求，联合国秘书长亦应召集此类会议。行政委员会在委员会出席会议并投票的成员中过半数同意时，可提出此项请求。

Query_Text_en: If a conference is convened in accordance with this paragraph , the Secretary-General of the United Nations shall invite to it all States referred to in Article 18 .
Translation: 如果根据本段规定召开会议，联合国秘书长应邀请所有第十八条中提及的国家参加会议。

Query_Text_en: Article 22 Special procedure for amending Annexes 1 , 4 , 5 and 61 . Independently of the amendment procedures set out in Article 21 , Annexes 1 , 4 , 5 and 6 may be amended as provided for in this Article and in accordance with the rules of procedure set out in Annex 7 .
Translation:
第二十二条 附件1、4、5和6的特别修订程序  
独立于第二十一条规定的修订程序之外，附件1、4、5和6可按照本条的规定进行修订，并遵循附件7所规定的程序规则。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any Contracting Party shall communicate proposed amendments to the Customs Co-operation Council .
Translation: 任何缔约方应将其拟议修正案通知海关合作理事会。

Query_Text_en: The Customs Co-operation Council shall bring them to the attention of the Contracting Parties and of the States referred to in Article 18 which are not Contracting Parties , and shall convene the Administrative Committee .
Translation: 海关合作理事会应将此事通知缔约方以及根据第十八条所述的非缔约方国家，并召集行政委员会。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any amendment proposed in accordance with the preceding paragraph or prepared during the meeting of the Committee , and adopted by a two-thirds majority of those present and voting in the Committee , shall be communicated to the Secretary-General of the United Nations .
Translation: 根据前款提出的修正案，或在委员会会议期间拟定的修正案，经委员会出席并投票成员的三分之二多数通过后，应通知联合国秘书长。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall communicate the amendment to the Contracting Parties for their acceptance , and to the States referred to in Article 18 which are not Contracting Parties for their information .
Translation: 联合国秘书长应将修正案通知缔约方以便其接受，并将该修正案通知第十八条所指的非缔约国，供其知悉。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The amendment shall be deemed to have been accepted unless one-fifth or five of the Contracting Parties , whichever number is less , have notified the Secretary-General of the United Nations , within a period of 12 months from the date on which the proposed amendment has been communicated by the Secretary-General of the United Nations to the Contracting Parties , that they object to the proposal .
Translation: 本修正案应视为已被接受，除非缔约方中反对的国家数量达到缔约方总数的五分之一或五国（以较少者为准），且这些国家在联合国秘书长将拟议修正案通知各缔约方之日起十二个月内，向联合国秘书长提交书面反对通知。

Query_Text_en: A proposed amendment which is not accepted shall be of no effect whatever .
Translation: 未获通过的修正案自始不产生任何效力。

Query_Text_en: 6 . If an amendment is accepted , it shall enter into force , for all Contracting Parties which did not object to the proposed amendment , three months after the expiry of the period of 12 months referred to in the preceding paragraph , or on such later date as may have been determined by the Administrative Committee at the time of its adoption .
Translation: 若修正案获得通过，对于未对拟议修正案提出异议的所有缔约方，该修正案应于前款所述12个月期满后的三个月后开始生效，或生效时间可由行政委员会在通过该修正案时确定的更晚日期为准。

Query_Text_en: At the time of adoption of an amendment , the Committee may also provide that , during a transitional period , the existing Annexes shall remain in force , wholly or in part , concurrently with such amendment .
Translation: 在通过修正案时，委员会可规定在一段过渡期内，现有附件应继续有效，全部或部分与该修正案同时生效。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall notify the date of the entry into force of the amendment to the Contracting Parties and inform the States referred to in Article 18 which are not Contracting Parties .
Translation: 联合国秘书长应将修正案生效日期通知缔约国，并告知第十八条所指的非缔约国各方。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 DenunciationAny Contracting Party may denounce the present Convention by effecting the deposit of an instrument with the Secretary-General of the United Nations .
Translation:
第二十三条 退出  
任何缔约方均可通过向联合国秘书长递交通知书的方式退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: The denunciation shall take effect one year from the date of such deposit with the Secretary-General of the United Nations .
Translation: 本废约应自交存联合国秘书长之日起满一年后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 24 TerminationThe present Convention shall cease to be in force if the number of Contracting Parties is less than five for any period of twelve consecutive months .
Translation: 第二十四条 终止 本公约在缔约方数量少于五个的连续十二个月期间内停止生效。

Query_Text_en: each party to the dispute shall appoint an arbitrator and these two arbitrators shall appoint a third arbitrator , who shall be Chairman .
Translation: 争议双方应各自指定一名仲裁员，这两名仲裁员应共同指定第三名仲裁员，该仲裁员应担任主席。

Query_Text_en: If three months after receipt of a request one of the parties has failed to appoint an arbitrator of if the arbitrators have failed to elect the Chairman , any of the parties may request the Secretary-General of the United Nations to appoint an arbitrator or the Chairman of the arbitration tribunal .
Translation: 自收到请求之日起三个月后，若一方未能任命仲裁员或仲裁员未能选举出主席，任何一方均可请求联合国秘书长任命仲裁员或仲裁庭主席。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The decision of the arbitration tribunal established under the provisions of paragraph 1 shall be binding on the parties to the dispute .
Translation: 根据本条第一款规定设立的仲裁庭所作决定，应约束争议各方。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The arbitration tribunal shall determine its own rules of procedure .
Translation: 仲裁庭应自行制定其程序规则。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Decisions of the arbitration tribunal , both as to its procedure and its place of meeting and as to any controversy laid before it , shall be taken by majority vote .
Translation: 仲裁庭的决定，无论是关于其程序和会议地点，还是关于提交给它的任何争议，均应以多数票作出。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Any controversy which may arise between the parties to the dispute as regards the interpretation and execution of the award may be submitted by any of the parties for judgement to the arbitration tribunal which made the award .
Translation: 任何与裁决的解释或执行相关的争议，各方均可将其提交作出该裁决的仲裁庭作出裁决。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 Reservations1 . Reservations to the present Convention shall be permitted , excepting those relating to the provisions of Articles 1-8 , 12-17 , 20 , 25 and of the present Article , and those relating to the provisions contained in the Annexes on condition that such reservations are communicated in writing and , if communicated before the deposit of the instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval or accession , are confirmed in that instrument .
Translation:
第二十六条 保留  
本公约的保留应予准许，但下列条款除外：第1至8条、第12至17条、第20条、第25条以及本条，以及涉及附件所载条款的保留，但须以书面形式提出此类保留。若在交存批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书前提出保留，则应在该文件中予以确认。

Query_Text_en: The Secretary-General of the United Nations shall communicate such reservations to all States referred to in Article 18 .
Translation: 联合国秘书长应将此类保留条款通知《公约》第十八条所指各缔约国。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] modifies those provisions to the same extent for the other Contracting Parties in their relations with the Contracting Party which entered the reservation .
Translation: 并[ b ]条款相应调整其他缔约方在与提出保留的缔约方关系中涉及的这些规定。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any Contracting Party which has communicated a reservation under paragraph 1 may withdraw it at any time by notification to the Secretary-General of the United Nations .
Translation: 任何根据第一款提交保留条款的缔约方均可随时通过通知联合国秘书长撤回该保留。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] the termination of the present Convention under Article 24 .
Translation: 根据第二十四条终止本公约。

Query_Text_en: IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned Plenipotentiaries , being duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments , have signed the present Convention .
Translation: 鉴此，下列各全权代表经各自政府正式授权，谨此签署本公约。

Query_Text_en: DONE at Geneva this second day of December one thousand nine hundred and seventy-two .
Translation: 本协议于1972年12月2日在日内瓦签署。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the identification of the owner or principal operator ; [ b ] the identification marks and numbers of the container , given by the owner or operator ; and [ c ] the tare weight of the container , including all its permanently fixed equipment .
Translation:
a) 所有者或主要经营者的身份识别；  
b) 集装箱的识别标志和编号（由所有者或经营者提供）；  
c) 集装箱的皮重，包括其所有永久固定设备。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The country to which the container belongs may be shown either in full or by the distinguishing sign used to indicate the country of registration of motor vehicles in international road traffic .
Translation: 集装箱所属国家可以标明其全称，或使用国际公路运输中用于标明机动车登记国的识别标志。

Query_Text_en: Each country may subject the use of its name or distinguishing sign on the container to its national legislation .
Translation: 每个国家可根据其国内立法规定处理在其集装箱上使用本国名称或区别标识事宜。

Query_Text_en: The identity of the owner or operator may be shown either by his full name or his initials , provided the latter constitute an established identification , symbols such as emblems or flags being excluded .
Translation: 所有者或运营者身份可通过其全名或首字母缩写予以表明，但后者须构成公认的标识方式，且不包括徽章或旗帜等标志符号。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the manufacturer 's serial number [ manufacturer 's number ] ; and [ b ] if they have been approved by design type , the identification numbers or letters of the type .
Translation: [a] 制造商序列号[制造商编号]；以及[b]如经设计类型批准，则应标明该类型的识别编号或字母。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of applying the provisions of Article 7 of the present Convention , each Contracting Party shall use , for checking movements of containers granted temporary admission , the records kept by the owners or operators or their representatives .
Translation: 根据本公约第七条之规定，每一缔约方应使用由集装箱所有人、运营方或其代表保存的记录，用于核查获得临时准入集装箱的流动情况。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] to pay such import duties and taxes as may be required in cases where the conditions of temporary admission had not been fulfilled .
Translation: [ ii ] 在未履行暂时进口条件的情况下，需缴纳应缴的进口关税和税款。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] the container will be used only once in internal traffic before being re-exported .
Translation: 该集装箱将在重新出口前仅用于境内流通一次。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] all spaces capable of holding goods are readily accessible for Customs inspection .
Translation: 所有可能藏匿货物的空间均应便于海关查验。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the constituent parts of the container [ sides , floor , doors , roof , uprights , frames , cross-pieces , etc ] shall be assembled either by means of devices which can not be removed and replaced from the outside without leaving visible traces or by such method as will produce a structure which can not be modified without leaving visible traces .
Translation: 集装箱的构成部件（包括侧壁、底板、门、顶板、立柱、框架、横梁等）应通过以下方式之一进行组装：要么采用不可从外部拆卸或更换（否则将留下可见痕迹）的装置，要么采用无法在不留下可见痕迹的情况下进行修改的结构方法。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] doors and all other closing systems [ including stopcocks , manhole-covers flanges , etc ] shall be fitted with a device on which Customs seals can be fixed .
Translation: 所有门和其他关闭系统[包括截止阀、人孔盖、法兰等]应配备可安装海关封志的装置。

Query_Text_en: This device must be such that it can not be removed and replaced from outside the container without leaving visible traces , or the door or fastening be opened without breaking the Customs seals .
Translation: 该设备必须确保无法从集装箱外部拆卸或更换而不留明显痕迹，或在不破坏海关封志的情况下开启门锁。

Query_Text_en: The latter shall be adequately protected .
Translation: 后者应得到充分保护。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] apertures for ventilation and drainage shall be provided with a device preventing access to the interior of the container .
Translation: 通风和排水的开口应当配备防止进入集装箱内部的装置。

Query_Text_en: This device must be such that it can not be removed and replaced from outside the container without leaving visible traces .
Translation: 该设备必须设计为从容器外部进行移除或更换时不会留下可见痕迹。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 1 [ c ] of these Regulations , constituent parts of the container which , for practical reasons , have to include empty spaces [ for example , between the partitions of a double wall ] shall be permitted .
Translation: 根据本规定第1条[c]款的规定，集装箱的组成部分因实际需要必须设置空隙（例如双层壁隔板之间空间）的，应予准许。

Query_Text_en: or [ ii ] the number of the said spaces shall be kept to a minimum and these spaces shall be readily accessible for Customs inspection .
Translation: 或[ ii ] 上述区域的数量应保持最低限度，并且这些区域应便于海关检查。

Query_Text_en: in addition , they shall be fitted with a bolting system which locks the various parts together once the container has been erected .
Translation: 此外，集装箱还应配备一套螺栓系统，在安装完成后将各部分锁紧。

Query_Text_en: This bolting system must be capable of being sealed by the Customs if it is on the outside of the container when the latter has been erected .
Translation: 当集装箱安装完毕后，若该紧固系统位于集装箱外部，必须能够由海关施加封志。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 Sheeted containers1 . Where applicable , the provisions of Articles 1 , 2 and 3 of these Regulations shall apply to sheeted containers .
Translation: 第四条 带衬垫的容器1. 适用时，本规定第一条至第三条的规定适用于带衬垫的容器。

Query_Text_en: In addition , these containers shall conform to the provisions of this Article .
Translation: 此外，这些集装箱应符合本条的规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The sheet shall be either of strong canvas or of plastic-covered or rubberized cloth , which shall be of sufficient strength and unstretchable .
Translation: 该布料应为坚固帆布或塑料覆层布料或橡胶涂布布料中的一种，且该材料应具备足够的强度且不可伸长。

Query_Text_en: It shall be in good condition and made up in such a way that once the closing device has been secured , it is impossible to gain access to the load without leaving visible traces .
Translation: 该装置应处于良好状态，并构造为一旦闭锁装置被锁紧，除非留下明显痕迹，否则无法接触货物。

Query_Text_en: 3 . If the sheet is made up of several pieces , their edges shall be folded into one another and sewn together with two seams at least 15mm apart .
Translation: 如果该片材由多块拼接而成，其边缘需相互折叠并通过间距不小于15毫米的两道缝线缝合。

Query_Text_en: however , where in the case of certain parts of the sheet [ such as flaps at the rear and reinforced corners ] it is not possible to assemble the pieces in that way , it shall be sufficient to fold the edge of the top section and make the seams as shown in sketch No. 2 appended to these Regulations .
Translation: 然而，对于纸板的某些部位（如后部的襟翼和加固的角落），若无法按上述方式组装部件，则只需将顶部边缘折叠，并按照本规定附图2所示制作接缝即可。

Query_Text_en: One of the seams shall be visible only from the inside and the color of the thread used for that seam shall be clearly different from the color of the sheet itself and from the color of the thread used for the other seam . All seams shall be machine-sewn .
Translation: 其中一条缝线仅能从内部看到，该缝线所用线的颜色需明显区别于布料本身的颜色以及另一条缝线所用线的颜色。所有缝线均须采用机器缝制。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If the sheet is of plastic-covered cloth , and is made up of several pieces , the pieces may alternatively be welded together in the manner shown in sketch No. 3 appended to these Regulations .
Translation: 如该板材为塑料覆层布且由数块拼接而成时，各拼接部分亦可按本条例所附图示3所示方式焊接固定。

Query_Text_en: The edges of the pieces shall overlap by at least 15mm .
Translation: 各部件的边缘应至少重叠15毫米。

Query_Text_en: The pieces shall be fused together over the whole width of the overlap .
Translation: 部件必须在整个重叠宽度范围内熔合在一起。

Query_Text_en: The edge of the outer sheet shall be covered with a band of plastic material at least 7 mm wide , affixed by the same welding process .
Translation: 外层板的边缘应覆盖宽度至少为7毫米的塑料材料带，并通过相同的焊接工艺固定。

Query_Text_en: The plastic band and a width of at least 3 mm on each side shall have a well-marked uniform relief stamped on it .
Translation: 塑料带两侧各至少3毫米宽的区域应压印有清晰均匀的凸起图案。

Query_Text_en: The pieces shall be welded in such a way that they can not be separated and rejoined without leaving visible traces .
Translation: 零件应以不可拆卸后重新连接而不留可见痕迹的方式进行焊接。

Query_Text_en: all seams shall be machine-sewn .
Translation: 所有接缝均应采用机器缝制。

Query_Text_en: When a sheet which has been damaged near the edges is repaired by replacing the damaged part by a patch , the seam can also be made in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 3 of this article and sketch No. 1 appended to these Regulations .
Translation: 当板材边缘附近受损时，其修复可按照本条第三款规定及附于本规定之后的附图1制作接缝。

Query_Text_en: Sheets of plastic-covered cloth may alternatively be repaired in accordance with the method described in paragraph 4 of this Article , but in that case the weld must be made on both sides of the sheet , the patch being fitted on the inside of the sheet .
Translation: 塑料覆层织物可按照本条第4款所述方法进行修复，但此时必须在织物两侧进行焊接，且补丁需装设于织物内侧。

Query_Text_en: 6 . [ a ] The sheet shall be fixed to the container in strict compliance with the conditions set forth in Article 1 [ a ] and [ b ] of these Regulations .
Translation: 该覆盖物应牢固固定于集装箱，并严格遵守本条例第一条（一）项和（二）项所规定之条件。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] a fastening passing through the rings above the sheets and visible from the outside for its entire length .
Translation: 穿过位于衬板上方的环且其全长均可从外部观察到的固定件。

Query_Text_en: The sheet shall overlap solid parts of the container by at least 250mm , measured from the center of the securing rings , unless the system of construction of the container by itself prevents all access to the goods .
Translation: 衬垫必须从固定环中心测量起，至少超出容器的固体部分250毫米，除非容器的结构设计本身能够完全阻止接触货物。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] When the edge of a sheet is to be permanently secured to a container , the joint shall be continuous and effected by means of solid devices .
Translation: 当板材边缘需要永久固定到容器上时，接缝应连续，并通过坚固装置实现。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The interval between rings and between eyelets shall not exceed 200mm .
Translation: 环与环之间以及眼孔之间的间距均不得超过200毫米。

Query_Text_en: The eyelets shall be reinforced .
Translation: 孔眼应予以加固。

Query_Text_en: or [ b ] a rope of hemp or sisal of at least 8mm diameter encased in a transparent unstretchable plastic sheath .
Translation: 由大麻或剑麻制成的直径不小于8毫米的绳索，包裹于透明且不可伸缩的塑料护套中。

Query_Text_en: Wire ropes may have a transparent unstretchable plastic sheath .
Translation: 钢丝绳可能配备透明且不可拉伸的塑料护套。

Query_Text_en: 9 . Each rope shall be in one piece and have a hard metal end-piece at each end .
Translation: 每根绳索应为整根连续无接头，并在两端配备硬质金属端件。

Query_Text_en: The fastener of each metal end-piece shall include a hollow rivet passing through the rope so as to allow the introduction of the thread or the strap of the Customs seal .
Translation: 每个金属端件的紧固件应包含一个穿过绳索的空心铆钉，以便穿入海关封志的线或带子。

Query_Text_en: The rope shall remain visible on either side of the hollow rivet so that it is possible to ensure that the rope is in one piece [ see sketch No. 5 appended to these Regulations ] .
Translation: 绳索应在空心铆钉两侧保持可见，以便能够确保绳索完整无损[见本规定所附图5]。

Query_Text_en: 10 . At the openings in the sheet , used for loading and unloading , the two edges of the sheet shall have an adequate overlap .
Translation: 在板材上用于装卸的开口处，板材的两侧边缘必须保持充分重叠。

Query_Text_en: the thong shall be secured inside the sheet and fitted with an eyelet to take the rope mentioned in paragraph 8 of this Article .
Translation: 该带子应固定在衬垫内侧，并配备眼环以容纳本条第8款所述的绳索。

Query_Text_en: A flap shall not be required if a special device , such as a baffle plate , is fitted , which prevents access to the goods without leaving visible traces .
Translation: 若安装了特殊装置（如隔板），且该装置可防止货物在不留下明显痕迹的情况下被接触，则无需设置挡板。

Query_Text_en: 11 . The identification marks , which must appear on the container in accordance with Annex 1 and the approval plate provided for in Annex 5 , shall in no circumstances be covered by the sheet .
Translation: 根据附件1的规定出现在容器上的识别标记以及附件5规定的批准牌，不得被遮盖物遮盖。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Transitional provisionsUntil 1 January 1977 , end-pieces shall be allowed which conform to sketch No. 5 appended to these Regulations , even if they include hollow rivets of a type previously accepted with holes of dimensions less than those given in the sketch . Query_Text_en: or [ b ] at a stage subsequent to manufacture , either individually or in respect of a specified number of containers of the same type [ procedure for approval at a stage subsequent to manufacture ] .
Translation: 或选项[b]在制造后的阶段，可单独进行，或针对一定数量的同类容器类型，[制造后阶段的审批程序]。

Query_Text_en: Provisions common to both approval procedures2 . The competent authority responsible for granting approval shall issue to the applicant , after approval , a certificate of approval valid , as the case may be , either for an unlimited series of containers of the approval type or for a specified number of containers .
Translation: 两种审批程序的共同条款。负责审批的主管部门应在审批通过后，向申请人签发审批证书。该证书视具体情况，适用于无限量的获批类型集装箱系列，或适用于限定数量的集装箱。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The beneficiary of approval shall affix an approval plate to the approved container or containers before their use for the transport of goods under Customs seal .
Translation: 被许可方应在经批准的集装箱投入使用运输海关封志监管货物前，加贴批准标识。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The approval plate shall be affixed permanently and in a clearly visible place adjacent to any other approval plate issued for official purposes .
Translation: 批准牌应永久固定于明显可见的位置，并靠近因公颁发的其他批准牌。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The approval plate , conforming to model No. 1 reproduced in appendix 1 to this Annex , shall take the form of a metal plate measuring not less than 20 cm by 10 cm .
Translation: 批准牌照应采用金属板形式，其样式须符合本附件第1号附图所示，并且尺寸不得小于20厘米×10厘米。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] if the container has been approved by type , the identification numbers or letters of the type of container .
Translation: 如果该容器已通过类型批准，则需注明其类型识别编号或字母。

Query_Text_en: 6 . If a container no longer complies with the technical conditions prescribed for its approval , it shall , before it can be used for the transport of goods under Customs seal , be restored to the condition which had justified its approval , so as to comply again with the said technical conditions .
Translation: 当集装箱不再符合其批准时规定的技术条件时，在重新用于海关封志货物运输前，必须恢复至最初获得批准时的状态，以再次满足上述技术条件。

Query_Text_en: 7 . If the essential characteristics of a container are changed , the container shall cease to be covered by the approval and shall be reapproved by the competent authority before it can be used for the transport of goods under Customs seal .
Translation: 如果集装箱的基本特征发生变更，该集装箱将不再适用已获得的批准，须经主管部门重新批准后，方可用于海关封志监管下的货物运输。

Query_Text_en: Special provisions for approval by design type at the manufacturing stage8 . Where the containers are manufactured by type series , the manufacturer may apply to the competent authority of the country of manufacture for approval by design type .
Translation: 第八条 以系列类型生产容器的，制造商可向制造国主管部门申请设计型式批准。

Query_Text_en: 9 . The manufacturer shall state in his application the identification numbers or letters which he assigns to the type of container to which his application for approval relates .
Translation: 制造商应在申请中说明其为申请批准所涉及的容器类型指定的识别编号或字母。

Query_Text_en: 10 . The application shall be accompanied by drawings and a detailed design specification of the container type to be approved .
Translation: 申请须附图纸及待批准集装箱类型的详细设计规范。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] keep a record of containers manufactured to the approved design type .
Translation: 做好按照批准设计型号生产的集装箱的记录。

Query_Text_en: 12 . The competent authority shall state what changes , if any , must be made to the proposed design type so that approval may be granted .
Translation: 主管部门应当说明拟议的设计方案如有必要需要进行哪些修改，以便予以批准。

Query_Text_en: 13 . No type-approval by design type shall be granted unless the competent authority has satisfied itself by examination of one or more containers manufactured to the design type concerned that containers of that type comply with the technical conditions prescribed in Annex 4 .
Translation: 除非主管机关通过审查按照该设计类型制造的一个或多个容器，确认该类型容器符合附件4规定的技术条件，否则不得授予该设计类型的型式批准。

Query_Text_en: 14 . When a container type is approved there shall be issued to the applicant a single certificate of approval conforming to model No. II reproduced in appendix 2 to this Annex and valid for all containers manufactured in conformity with the specifications of the type so approved .
Translation: 当某一集装箱类型获得批准后，应向申请人签发符合本附录附录2中重印的第二种模式的单份批准证书，该证书适用于所有按照经批准类型规格制造的集装箱。

Query_Text_en: Such certificate shall entitle the manufacturer to affix to every container of the type series an approval plate in the form prescribed in paragraph 5 of this Annex .
Translation: 该证书应授权制造商按照本附件第5段规定的格式，在该型号系列的每个容器上加贴批准标牌。

Query_Text_en: Special provisions for approval at a stage subsequent to manufacture15 . If approval has not been applied for at the manufacturing stage , the owner , the operator , or the representative of either , may apply for approval to the competent authority to which he is able to produce the container or containers , and for which he seeks approval .
Translation: 制造阶段之后的审批特别规定15。若未在制造阶段申请审批，所有者、运营者或其代表可向其能够生产相关容器的主管部门提出审批申请。

Query_Text_en: 16 . An application for approval submitted under paragraph 15 of this Annex shall state the serial number [ manufacturer 's number ] placed on each container by the manufacturer .
Translation: 根据本附件第15段提交的批准申请应载明制造商在每个容器上标注的序列号[制造商编号]。

Query_Text_en: 17 . When the competent authority has ascertained that the container or containers comply with the technical conditions prescribed in Annex 4 , by examination of as many containers as it considers necessary , it shall issue a certificate or approval conforming to model No. III reproduced in appendix 3 to this Annex and valid solely for the number of containers approved .
Translation: 当主管部门经检查确认集装箱符合附件4规定的技术条件后，应签发符合本附件第3号附录中载明的第III号格式的证书或批准文件，且该证书或批准文件仅对该批准的集装箱数量有效。

Query_Text_en: Such certificate , which shall bear the manufacturer 's serial number or numbers assigned to the container or containers to which it relates , shall entitle the applicant to affix to each container so approved the approval plate prescribed in paragraph 5 of this Annex .
Translation: 该证书应载明与之相关的容器所对应的制造商序列号或多个序列号，并据此赋予申请人按照本附件第5款规定，在每只获准容器上粘贴批准标识牌的权利。

Query_Text_en: Explanatory Notes Introduction [ i ] In accordance with the provisions of Article 13 of the present Convention , the explanatory notes interpret some provisions of the present Convention and of its Annexes .
Translation: 说明性注释导言 [i] 根据本公约第十三条的规定，说明性注释对本公约及其附件的某些条款进行解释。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] The explanatory notes do not modify the provisions of the present Convention or of its Annexes but make their contents , meaning and scope more precise .
Translation: 解释性说明并不修改本公约及其附件的规定，而是使其内容、含义和范围更加明确。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] In particular , having regard to the principles laid down by the provisions of Article 12 of the present Convention and of Annex 4 thereto for the approval of containers for transport under Customs seal , the explanatory notes specify , where appropriate , the construction techniques to be accepted by the Contracting Parties as complying with those provisions .
Translation: 根据本公约第12条及附件4所规定的原则，关于运输用海关封志集装箱的审批事宜，说明性注释在适当情况下明确了缔约方应予认可的、符合上述规定的集装箱构造技术。

Query_Text_en: The explanatory notes may also specify which construction techniques , if any , do not comply with those provisions .
Translation: 说明条款也可具体指出，如有任何施工技术不符合上述规定。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] The explanatory notes provide a means of applying the provisions of the present Convention and of its Annexes according to the development of technology and economic requirements .
Translation: 解释性条款为根据技术和经济需求的发展适用本公约及其附件的规定提供了方式。

Query_Text_en: 0 . Main Text of the Convention 0 . 1 Article 1 , Sub-paragraph [ c ] [ i ] - Partially enclosed containers0 . 1 [ c ] [ i ] -1 The term `` partially enclosed '' , as applied to equipment in Article 1 , sub-paragraph [ c ] [ i ] , relates to equipment generally consisting of a floor and a superstructure marking off a loading space equivalent to that of a closed container . The superstructure is generally made up of metal members forming the frame of a container .
Translation: 《公约》主体文本0.1 条款 [c][i] 之 （一）部分封闭容器0.1.[c][i].1 根据第1条第[c][i]项，"部分封闭"这一术语适用于某种设备，该设备通常由地板和构成封闭集装箱等效装载空间的上层结构组成。该上层结构通常由构成集装箱框架的金属构件组成。

Query_Text_en: Containers of this type may also comprise one or more lateral or frontal walls .
Translation: 此类容器还可包含一个或多个侧壁或前壁。

Query_Text_en: In some cases there is only a roof attached to the floor by uprights .
Translation: 在某些情况下，屋顶仅通过立柱与地面相连。

Query_Text_en: This type of container is used in particular for the carriage of bulky goods [ motor cars , for example ] .
Translation: 这种集装箱特别用于运输大件货物（例如汽车）。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] internal partitions , pallets , shelves , supports , hooks , and similar devices used for stowing goods .
Translation: 内部隔板、托盘、货架、支撑架、挂钩及其它用于存放货物的装置。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Annex 4 4 . 2 Article 2 , Sub-paragraph 1 [ a ] - Assembly of constituent parts4 . 2 . 1 . [ a ] -1 [ a ] Where joining devices [ rivets , screws , bolts and nuts etc ] are used , a sufficient number of such devices shall be inserted from outside , traverse the assembled constituent parts , protrude inside and there be firmly secured [ eg . riveted , welded , bushed , bolted , and riveted or welded on the nut ] .
Translation: 4.2.1.[a]-1[a] 使用连接装置（如铆钉、螺丝、螺栓和螺母等）时，应从外部插入足够数量的此类装置，贯穿已组装的部件，向内突出并牢固固定（例如通过铆接、焊接、加衬套、螺栓固定，或在螺母处铆接或焊接）。

Query_Text_en: However , conventional rivets [ ie . rivets whose placing requires handling from both sides of the assembly of constituent parts ] may also be inserted from the inside .
Translation: 然而，传统铆钉（即需要在组件装配的两侧进行操作的铆钉）也可从内部进行安装。

Query_Text_en: Notwithstanding the above , container floors may be secured by means of self-tapping screws , or self-drilling rivets or rivets inserted by means of an explosive charge , when placed from inside and passing at right-angles through the floor and the metallic cross-pieces underneath , on condition , except in the case of self-tapping screws , that some of their ends be flush with the level of the outside part of the cross-piece or be welded on to it .
Translation: 集装箱地板可通过自攻螺钉、自钻铆钉或通过爆炸药荷安装的铆钉进行固定，当从内部安装并垂直穿过地板及下方的金属横梁时，除自攻螺钉外，其他固定件的末端应与横梁外侧表面齐平或焊接固定。

Query_Text_en: they shall do so by making sure that the constituent parts so assembled can not be displaced without leaving visible traces .
Translation: 他们应通过确保已组装的组件无法在不留下明显痕迹的情况下被拆卸来做到这一点。

Query_Text_en: The choice and placing of other joining devices are not subject to any restriction .
Translation: 其他连接装置的选择及其安装位置不受任何限制。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Joining devices which can be removed and replaced from one side without leaving visible traces , ie . without requiring handling from both sides of the constituent parts to be assembled , shall not be allowed under sub-paragraph [ a ] of this note .
Translation: 根据本注释的[a]分段，不得允许使用可从一侧拆卸和更换且不留可见痕迹的连接装置，即无需从待组装部件的两侧进行操作的连接方式。

Query_Text_en: Examples of such devices are expansion rivets , blind rivets and the like .
Translation: 此类装置的例子包括膨胀铆钉、盲铆钉等。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] The assembly methods described above shall apply to special containers , for example to insulated containers , refrigerated containers and tank containers in so far as they are not incompatible with the technical requirements which such containers must fulfil having regard to their use .
Translation: 上述组装方法应适用于特殊集装箱，例如保温集装箱、冷藏集装箱和罐式集装箱，只要这些方法不与这类集装箱根据其用途必须满足的技术要求相抵触。

Query_Text_en: Where , due to technical reasons , it is not practicable to secure parts in the manner described in sub-paragraph [ a ] of this note , the constituent parts may be joined by means of the devices mentioned in sub-paragraph [ c ] of this note provided that the joining devices used on the inner face of the wall can not be tampered with from the outside .
Translation: 由于技术原因无法按照本条款[a]所述方式固定部件时，组成部分可采用本条款[c]中提到的装置进行连接，但前提是安装在墙体内侧的连接装置须确保从外部无法进行篡改。

Query_Text_en: or [ iii ] incorporate holes of not less than 11 mm in diameter or slots of at least 11 mm in length by 3 mm in width .
Translation: 或[ⅲ] 设置直径不小于11毫米的孔洞，或设置长度不小于11毫米、宽度不小于3毫米的槽。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Butt hinges , strap hinges , hinge-pins and other devices for hanging doors and the like must be secured in conformity with the requirements of sub-paragraph [ a ] of this note .
Translation: 门用铰链、带状铰链、铰链销及其他悬挂门等装置，必须按照本注释第[a]款的要求进行安装。

Query_Text_en: 1 Man is both creature and moulder of his environment which gives him physical sustenance and affords him the opportunity for intellectual moral social and spiritual growth In the long and tortuous evolution of the human race on this planet a stage has been reached when through the rapid acceleration of science and technology mail has acquired the power to transform his environment in countless ways and on an unprecedented scale Both aspects of man 's environment the natural and the manmade are essential to his well being and to the enjoyment of basic human rights the right to life itself
Translation: 人类既是环境的产物，又是环境的塑造者。环境为人类提供物质滋养，也为智力、道德、社会及精神成长提供了机会。在人类漫长而曲折的地球进化历程中，一个关键阶段已然到来：随着科学技术的迅猛发展，人类已获得以前所未有的规模和方式改造环境的能力。人类生存环境的两个方面——自然环境与人工环境——对其福祉和享有基本人权（包括生存权本身）至关重要。

Query_Text_en: 2 The protection and improvement of the human environment is a major issue which affects the well being of peoples and economic development throughout the world ; it is the urgent desire of the peoples of the whole world and the duty of all Governments
Translation: 人类环境的保护和改善是关系到各国人民福祉和全球经济发展的重大问题；这是全世界各国人民的迫切愿望，也是各国政府的责任。

Query_Text_en: 3 Man has constantly to sum up experience and go on discovering inventing creating and advancing In our time man 's capability to transform his surroundings if used wisely carl bring to all peoples the benefits of development and the opportunity to enhance the quality of life Wrongly or heedlessly applied the same power can do incalculable harm to human beings and the human environment We see around us growing evidence of man made harm in many regions of the earth : dangerous levels of pollution in water air earth and living beings ; major and undesirable disturbances to the ecological balance of the biosphere ; destruction and depletion of irreplaceable resources ; and gross deficiencies harmful to the physical mental and social health of man in tho man made environment particularly in the living and working environment
Translation: 人类必须不断总结经验，持续推进探索、发明、创造与进步。在当代，若人类改造环境的能力得到合理运用，便能为全人类带来发展的惠益，并为提升生活质量创造机遇；若错误或轻率地运用，同样的力量则会对人类及其生存环境造成不可估量的伤害。我们如今可见地球许多地区因人类活动导致的危害日益增多：水、空气、土壤及生物体中存在危险的污染水平；对生物圈生态平衡造成重大且不利的干扰；不可替代资源的破坏与枯竭；以及在人造环境中——尤其是生活和工作环境中——对人类身体健康、心理健康及社会福祉造成严重损害的缺陷。

Query_Text_en: 4 In the developing countries most of the environmental problems are caused by under development Millions continue to live far below the minimum levels required for a decent human existence deprived of adequate food and clothing shelter and education health and sanitation Therefore the developing countries must direct their efforts to development bearing in mind their priorities and the need to safeguard and improve the environment For the same purpose the industrialized countries should make efforts to reduce the gap themselves and the developing countries In the industrialized countries environmental problems are generally related to industrialization and technological development
Translation: 发展中国家的大多数环境问题源于欠发展。数亿人口仍生活在远低于体面人类生存所需的基本水平之下，缺乏足够的食物衣物、住所教育、医疗及卫生设施。因此，发展中国家必须致力于发展，同时考虑优先事项和保护与改善环境的需要。出于相同目的，工业国家应努力缩小自身与发展中国家之间的差距。在工业国家，环境问题通常与工业化及技术发展密切相关。

Query_Text_en: 5 The natural growth of population continuously presents problems for the preservation of the environment and adequate policies and measures should be adopted as appropriate to face these problems of all things in the world people are the most precious It is the people that propel social progress create social wealth develop science and technology and through their hard work continuously transform the human environment Along with social progress and the advance of production science and technology the capability of man to improve the environment increases with each passing day
Translation: 人口的自然增长持续给环境保护带来挑战，应根据实际情况采取适当政策和措施应对这些问题。人是万物之本，正是人民群众推动社会进步、创造社会财富、发展科学技术，并通过辛勤劳动不断改造人类生存环境。随着社会进步和生产科学技术的发展，人类改善环境的能力与日俱增。

Query_Text_en: 6 A point has been reached in history when we must shape our actions throughout the world with a more prudent care for their environmental consequences Through ignorance or indifference we can do massive and irreversible harm to the earthly environment on which our life and well being depend Conversely through fuller knowledge and wiser action we can achieve for ourselves and our posterity a better life in an environment more in keeping with human needs and hopes There are broad vistas for the enhancement of environmental quality and the creation of a good life What is needed is an enthusiastic but calm state of mind and intense but orderly work For the purpose of attaining freedom in the world of nature man must use knowledge to build in collaboration with nature a better environment To defend and improve the human environment for present and future generations has become an imperative goal for mankind a goal to be pursued together with and in harmony with the established and fundamental goals of peace and of worldwide economic and social development
Translation: 在人类历史进程中已到了这样一个关头：我们必须在全球范围内以更加审慎的态度关注自身行为的环境后果。由于无知或漠视，我们可能对维系人类生存与福祉的地球环境造成巨大且不可逆的破坏；反之，通过深化认知与明智行动，我们完全可以在与自然和谐共生中，为当代及后代营造更契合人类需求与期望的优质生活。环境质量提升与美好生活缔造蕴含着广阔前景。我们需要以热忱而沉稳的心态、热烈而有序的工作状态推进这一进程。为在自然界中实现自由，人类须运用知识协同自然之力构建更优环境。捍卫并改善当代及后代生存环境，已成为全人类必须共同追求的迫切目标，这一目标须与和平事业以及全球经济发展与社会进步的根本目标相协调、共推进。

Query_Text_en: 7 To achieve this environmental goal will demand the acceptance of responsibility by citizens and communities and by enterprises and institutions at every level all sharing equitably in common efforts Individuals in all walks of life as well as organizations in many fields by their values and the sum of their actions will shape the world environment of the future Local and national governments will bear the greatest burden for large scale environmental policy and action within their jurisdictions International cooperation is also needed in order to raise resources to support the developing countries in carrying out their responsibilities in this field A growing class of environmental problems because they are regional or global in extent or because they affect the common international realm will require extensive cooperation among nations and action by international organizations in the common interest The Conference calls upon Governments and peoples to exert common efforts for the preservation and improvement of the human environment for the benefit of all the people and for their posterity Principles States the common conviction that :
Translation: 实现这一环境目标需要公民、社区以及各层级的企业和机构公平分担共同责任。各行各业的个人及各领域的组织，其价值观与行为总和将塑造未来的世界环境。地方和国家政府需在其管辖范围内承担主要责任，推动大规模环境政策与行动。为支持发展中国家履行其责任，需通过国际合作筹集资源。由于部分环境问题因涉及区域或全球范围，或影响国际共有领域，各国需加强广泛合作，由国际组织采取行动以维护共同利益。会议呼吁各国政府和人民共同努力，保护和改善人类环境，造福全人类并惠及子孙后代。原则阐明共同信念如下：

Query_Text_en: Principle 1 Man has the fundamental right to freedom equality and adequate conditions of life in an environment of a quality that permits a life of dignity and well being and he bears a solemn responsibility to protect and improve the environment for present and future generations In this respect policies promoting or perpetuating apartheid racial segregation discrimination colonial and other forms of oppression and foreign domination stand condemned and must be eliminated
Translation: 第一条 人类享有在能够保障尊严和福祉的环境中，享有自由、平等及充足生活条件的基本权利，并负有庄严责任为当代和子孙后代保护和改善环境。在此方面，推行或延续种族隔离、种族歧视、殖民主义以及其他形式的压迫和外国统治的政策必须受到谴责并予以消除。

Query_Text_en: Principle 2 The natural resources of the earth including the air water land flora and fauna and especially representative samples of natural ecosystems must be safeguarded for the benefit of present and future generations through careful planning or management as appropriate
Translation: 原则二：地球上的自然资源，包括大气、水、土地、动植物以及具有代表性的自然生态系统的样本，必须通过适当的规划或管理措施得到妥善保护，以造福当代和子孙后代。

Query_Text_en: Principle 3 The capacity of the earth to produce vital renewable resources must be maintained and wherever practicable restored or improved
Translation: 原则三：必须维持地球生产重要可再生资源的能力，并在可行的情况下予以恢复或提升。

Query_Text_en: Principle 4 Man has a special responsibility to safeguard and wisely manage the heritage of wildlife and its habitat which are now gravely imperiled by a combination of adverse factors Nature conservation including wildlife must therefore receive importance in planning for economic development
Translation: 第四原则 人类肩负着特殊责任，需保护和妥善管理正面临多种不利因素严重威胁的野生动植物及其栖息地遗产。因此，在制定经济发展规划时，必须高度重视包括野生动物在内的自然保护工作。

Query_Text_en: Principle 5 The non renewable resources of the earth must be employed in such a way as to guard against the danger of their future exhaustion and to ensure that benefits from such employment are shared by all mankind
Translation: 原则五：必须以防止不可再生资源未来枯竭并确保其利用收益为全人类共享的方式加以利用。

Query_Text_en: Principle 6 The discharge of toxic substances or of other substances and the release of heat in such quantities or concentrations as to exceed the capacity of the environment to render them harmless must be halted in order to ensure that serious or irreversible damage is not inflicted upon ecosystems The just struggle of the peoples of ill countries against pollution should be supported
Translation: 第六原则 必须停止排放有毒物质或其他物质以及释放热能，其数量或浓度若超过环境的自净能力，以确保不造成生态系统遭受严重或不可逆转的损害。应支持发展中国家人民反对污染的正义斗争。

Query_Text_en: Principle 7 States shall take all possible steps to prevent pollution of the seas by substances that are liable to create hazards to human health to harm living resources and marine life to damage amenities or to interfere with other legitimate uses of the sea
Translation: 第七条 各国应采取一切可能措施，防止有害物质污染海洋。此类物质可能对人类健康构成危害、损害生物资源和海洋生物、破坏海滨环境或妨碍海洋的其他合法用途。

Query_Text_en: Principle 8 Economic and social development is essential for ensuring a favorable living and working environment for man and for creating conditions on earth that are necessary for the improvement of the quality of life
Translation: 第八项原则：经济社会发展是确保人类拥有良好的生产生活环境、为提高生活质量创造必要条件的根本保障。

Query_Text_en: Principle 9 Environmental deficiencies generated by the conditions of under development and natural disasters pose grave problems and can best be remedied by accelerated development through the transfer of substantial quantities of financial and technological assistance as a supplement to the domestic effort of the developing countries and such timely assistance as may be required
Translation: 原则九：欠发达状况和自然灾害引发的环境问题构成了严峻挑战，最有效的解决途径是通过转移大量资金和技术援助，作为发展中国家国内努力的补充，并提供所需的及时援助以加速发展进程。

Query_Text_en: Principle 10 For the developing countries stability of prices and adequate earnings for primary commodities and raw materials are essential to environmental management since economic factors as well as ecological processes must be taken into account
Translation: 原则10 对于发展中国家而言，稳定的价格和初级产品及原材料的充足收益是环境管理不可或缺的要素，因为必须同时考虑经济因素和生态过程。

Query_Text_en: Principle 11 The environmental policies of all States should enhance and not adversely affect the present or future development potential of developing countries nor should they hamper the attainment of better living conditions for all and appropriate steps should be taken by States and international organizations with a view to reaching agreement on meeting the possible national and international economic consequences resulting from the application of environmental measures
Translation: 原则十一 各国的环境政策不应损害发展中国家当前或未来的发展潜力，也不应阻碍提高全体人民生活水平的目标。各国及国际组织应采取适当措施，力求达成协议，以应对环境措施实施可能带来的国内和国际经济后果。

Query_Text_en: Principle 12 Resources should be made available to preserve and improve the environment taking into account the circumstances and particular requirements of developing countries and any costs which may emanate from their incorporating environmental safeguards into their development planning and the need for making available to them upon their request additional international technical and financial assistance for this purpose
Translation: 原则第十二条 应当调配资源以保护和改善环境，同时充分考虑发展中国家的具体情况和特殊需求，以及其在发展规划中纳入环境保障措施所产生的相关成本，并应根据其请求向其提供额外的国际技术及资金援助以实现这一目标。

Query_Text_en: Principle 13 In order to achieve a more rational management of resources and thus to improve the environment States should adopt an integrated and coordinated approach lo their development planning so as to ensure that development is compatible with the need to protect and improve environment for the benefit of their population
Translation: 第十三条原则：为实现资源管理的更加合理化并从而改善环境，各国应在发展规划中采取综合协调的方式，确保发展与保护和改善环境的需要相协调，以造福其人民。

Query_Text_en: Principle 14 Rational planning constitutes all essential t001 for reconciling any conflict between the needs of development and the need to protect and improve the environment
Translation: 原则十四：合理规划是协调发展需求与保护及改善环境需求之间任何冲突的必要手段。

Query_Text_en: Principle 15 Planning must be applied to human settlements and urbanization with a view to avoiding adverse effects on the environment and obtaining maximum social economic and environmental benefits for a11 In this respect projects which arc designed for colonialist and racist domination must be abandoned
Translation: 原则十五：在人类聚居区和城市化进程中必须进行规划，以避免对环境造成不利影响，并为全体人民获取最大程度的社会、经济和环境效益。就此而言，所有旨在推行殖民主义和种族主义统治的项目必须废除。

Query_Text_en: Principle 16 Demographic policies which are without prejudice to basic human rights and which are deemed appropriate by Governments concerned should be applied in those regions where the rate of population growth or excessive population concentrations are likely t0 have adverse effects on the environment of the human environment and impede development
Translation: 第十六条 在人口增长率过高或人口过度集中可能对环境和人类居住环境产生不利影响并阻碍发展的地区，应采取不损害基本人权且经有关政府认为适宜的人口政策。

Query_Text_en: Principle 17 Appropriate national institutions must be entrusted with the task of planning managing or controlling the 9 environmental resources of States with a view to enhancing environmental quality
Translation: 原则十七：必须委托适当的国家机构负责规划、管理和控制国家环境资源，以提升环境质量。

Query_Text_en: Principle 18 Science and technology as part of their contribution to economic and social development must be applied to the identification avoidance and control of environmental risks and the solution of environmental problems and for the common good of mankind
Translation: 第十八条 科学技术作为其对经济社会发展所作贡献的一部分，必须应用于环境风险的识别、规避与控制，以及环境问题的解决，并服务于全人类的共同福祉。

Query_Text_en: Principle 19 Education in environmental matters for the younger generation as well as adults giving due consideration to the underprivileged is essential in order to broaden the basis for an enlightened opinion and responsible conduct by individuals enterprises and communities in protecting and improving the environment in its full human dimension It is also essential that mass media of communications avoid contributing to the deterioration of the environment but on the contrary disseminates information of an educational nature on the need to project and improve the environment in order to enable mal to develop in every respect
Translation: 第十九项原则 对年轻一代及成年人开展环境教育，充分考虑弱势群体的需求，这对于扩大公众的知情共识和负责任行为的基础至关重要，以促进个人、企业及社区在人类生存环境的全方位保护与改善中发挥积极作用。大众传播媒介也应避免对环境造成负面影响，而应传播具有教育意义的信息，阐明保护与改善环境的必要性，从而促进人类在各方面得到发展。

Query_Text_en: Principle 20 Scientific research and development in the context of environmental problems both national and multinational must be promoted in all countries especially the developing countries In this connection the free flow of up to date scientific information and transfer of experience must be supported and assisted to facilitate the solution of environmental problems ; environmental technologies should be made available to developing countries on terms which would encourage their wide dissemination without constituting all economic burden on the developing countries
Translation: 原则二十：各国，尤其是发展中国家，必须在国家层面和跨国层面推动环境问题背景下的科研与开发。在此方面，最新科学信息的自由流动及技术转移必须得到支持和协助，以促进环境问题的解决；环保技术应以鼓励其广泛传播且不构成经济负担的方式向发展中国家提供。

Query_Text_en: Principle 21 States have in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations and the principles of international law the sovereign right to exploit their own resources pursuant to their own environmental policies and the responsibility to ensure that activities within their jurisdiction or control do not cause damage to the environment of other States or of areas beyond the limits of national jurisdiction
Translation: 原则二十一 各国根据《联合国宪章》和国际法原则享有主权，有权按照本国环境政策开发本国资源，并负有确保其管辖范围或控制下的活动不损害其他国家环境或国家管辖范围以外区域环境的责任。

Query_Text_en: Principle 22 States shall cooperate to develop further the international law regarding liability and compensation for the victims of pollution and other environmental damage caused by activities within the jurisdiction or control of such States to areas beyond their jurisdiction
Translation: 第二十二条原则 各国应当合作进一步发展和完善关于责任与赔偿的国际法，以保障因各国有管辖权或控制范围内的活动导致其管辖范围以外区域污染和其他环境损害的受害者权益。

Query_Text_en: Principle 23 Without prejudice to such criteria as may be agreed upon by the international community or to standards which will have to be determined nationally it will be essential in all cases to consider the systems of Values prevailing in each country and the extent of the applicability of standards which are valid for the most advanced countries but which may be inappropriate and of unwarranted social cost for the developing countries
Translation: 原则二十三 在不妨碍国际社会可能达成一致的标准或各国需自行确定的国家标准的情况下，必须在所有情形下考虑各国盛行的价值体系，并评估适用于发达国家的标准对发展中国家的适用程度——这些标准可能对发展中国家不具适用性且会带来不合理的社会成本。

Query_Text_en: Principle 24 International matters concerning the protection and improvement of the environment should be handled in a cooperative spirit by all countries big and small on an equal footing . Cooperation through multilateral or bilateral arrangements or other appropriate means is essential to effectively control prevent reduce and eliminate adverse environmental effects resulting from activities conducted in all spheres in such a way that due account is taken of the sovereignty and interests of all States
Translation: 原则24 涉及环境保护与改善的国际事务应由所有大小国家以平等地位、合作精神共同处理。通过多边或双边安排或其他适当方式开展合作，是有效控制、预防、减少和消除各类活动所导致的不利环境影响的关键所在，同时须充分考虑各国的主权和利益。

Query_Text_en: Principle 25 States shall ensure that international organizations play a coordinated efficient and dynamic role for the protection and improvement of the environment
Translation: 原则二十五 各国应确保国际组织在保护和改善环境方面发挥协调、高效且富有活力的作用。

Query_Text_en: Principle 26 Man and his environment must be spared the effects of nuclear weapons and all other means of mass destruction States must strive to reach prompt agreement in the relevant international organs on the elimination and complete destruction of such weapons
Translation: 第二十六条 人类和其生存环境必须免受核武器及其他一切大规模毁灭性武器的影响。各国必须努力在相关国际机构尽快达成协议，以消除并彻底销毁此类武器。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 Discrimination against women , denying or limiting as it does their equality of rights with men , is fundamentally unjust and constitutes an offence against human dignity .
Translation: 第一条 对妇女的歧视，即否认或限制妇女与男子享有平等权利，从根本上说是不公正的，构成对人的尊严的侵犯。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The international instruments of the United Nations and the specialized agencies relating to the elimination of discrimination against women shall be ratified or acceded to and fully implemented as soon as practicable .
Translation: 联合国及其专门机构关于消除对妇女歧视的国际文书应尽快予以批准或加入，并全面实施。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 All appropriate measures shall be taken to educate public opinion and to direct national aspirations towards the eradication of prejudice and the abolition of customary and all other practices which are based on the idea of the inferiority of women .
Translation: 第三条 应采取一切适当措施，教育公众，引导国家意志，消除偏见，并废除传统习俗以及其他一切基于妇女低人一等观念的做法。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The right to hold public office and to exercise all public functions .
Translation: 享有担任公职和行使一切公共职能的权利。

Query_Text_en: Such rights shall be guaranteed by legislation .
Translation: 此类权利应通过立法予以保障。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Women shall have the same rights as men to acquire , change or retain their nationality .
Translation: 妇女享有与男子平等的取得、变更或保留国籍的权利。

Query_Text_en: Marriage to an alien shall not automatically affect the nationality of the wife either by rendering her stateless or by forcing upon her the nationality of her husband .
Translation: 与外国人结婚不应自动导致妻子成为无国籍人或强制其取得丈夫的国籍。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The same rights as men with regard to the law on the movement of persons .
Translation: 在人员流动法律方面享有与男性同等的权利。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Women shall have equal rights with men during marriage and at its dissolution .
Translation: 妇女在婚姻关系存续期间以及婚姻解除时，享有同男子平等的权利。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Parents shall have equal rights and duties in matters relating to their children .
Translation: 父母在涉及子女的事项中应当享有平等的权利和义务。

Query_Text_en: In all cases the interest of the children shall be paramount .
Translation: 在任何情况下，儿童的利益应居于首位。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Child marriage and the betrothal of young girls before puberty shall be prohibited , and effective action , including legislation , shall be taken to specify a minimum age for marriage and to make the registration of marriages in an official registry compulsory .
Translation: 禁止童婚及青春期前少女的订婚，应采取有效措施（包括立法）明确规定最低结婚年龄，并规定婚姻登记必须在官方机构进行。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 All provisions of penal codes which constitute discrimination against women shall be repealed .
Translation: 第七条 刑法中涉及歧视妇女的相关条款应当废止。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 All appropriate measures , including legislation , shall be taken to combat all forms of traffic in women and exploitation of prostitution of women .
Translation: 第八条 应采取一切必要措施，包括制定法律，以打击一切形式的拐卖妇女行为以及剥削妇女卖淫的行为。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] Access to educational information to help in ensuring the health and well-being of families .
Translation: 获取教育信息以确保家庭健康与福祉。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] The right to receive family allowances on equal terms with men .
Translation: 享有与男性同等条件领取家庭津贴的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In order to prevent discrimination against women on account of marriage or maternity and to ensure their effective right to work , measures shall be taken to prevent their dismissal in the event of marriage or maternity and to provide paid maternity leave , with the guarantee of returning to former employment , and to provide the necessary social services , including child-care facilities .
Translation: 为防止因婚姻或生育原因对女性进行歧视并保障其工作权益，应采取措施禁止其因结婚或生育而被解雇，提供带薪产假并保证返回原工作岗位，同时提供必要的社会服务，包括托儿设施。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Measures taken to protect women in certain types of work , for reasons inherent in their physical nature , shall not be regarded as discriminatory .
Translation: 为保护女性从事特定工作而采取的措施，基于其生理特征的固有特性，不应视为具有歧视性。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 1 . The principle of equality of rights of men and women demands implementation in all States in accordance with the principles of the Charter of the United Nations and of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights .
Translation: 第11条 第1款 男女平等权利的原则要求所有国家根据联合国宪章和世界人权宣言的原则予以实施。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Governments , non-governmental organizations and individuals are urged , therefore , to do all in their power to promote the implementation of the principles contained in this Declaration .
Translation: 因此，敦促各国政府、非政府组织和个人竭尽全力推动落实本宣言所载原则。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 Scope The present articles apply to activities not prohibited by international law which involve a risk of causing significant transboundary harm through their physical consequences
Translation:
第一条 适用范围  
本条款适用于国际法未禁止的、因其物理后果可能导致重大跨境损害的活动。

Query_Text_en: f States concerned means the State of origin and the State likely to be affected
Translation: 相关国家指原属国及可能受影响的国家。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Prevention The State of origin shall take all appropriate measures to prevent significant transboundary harm or at any event to minimize the risk thereof
Translation: 第三条 预防 原属国应当采取一切适当措施，防止造成重大跨界损害；或在任何情况下，尽量减少此类风险。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 Cooperation States concerned shall cooperate in good faith and , as necessary , seek the assistance of one or more competent international organizations in preventing significant transboundary harm or at any event in minimizing the risk thereof
Translation:
第四条 合作义务  
相关缔约国应当真诚合作，并在必要时寻求一个或多个相关国际组织的协助，以防止重大跨界损害的发生，或在任何情况下尽力降低此类损害的风险。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Implementation States concerned shall take the necessary legislative , administrative or other action including the establishment of suitable monitoring mechanisms to implement the provisions of the present articles
Translation: 第五条 有关缔约方应采取必要立法、行政或其他措施，包括建立适当的监督机制，以履行本公约条款的规定。

Query_Text_en: c Any plan to change an activity which may transform it into one falling within the scope of the present articles
Translation: 任何可能使某项活动变为属于本条款所规定范围的改变计划。

Query_Text_en: 2 The requirement of authorization established by a State shall be made applicable in respect of all pre existing activities within the scope of the present articles Authorizations already issued by the State for pre existing activities shall be reviewed in order to comply with the present articles
Translation: 缔约方确立的授权要求应适用于本条款适用范围内的所有既存活动。缔约方已针对既存活动颁发的授权文件，应重新审查以确保符合本条款的规定。

Query_Text_en: 3 In case of a failure to conform to the terms of the authorization , the State of origin shall take such actions as appropriate , including where necessary terminating the authorization
Translation: 如未能遵守授权条款，原属国应采取适当措施，包括必要时终止授权。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 Assessment of risk Any decision in respect of the authorization of an activity within the scope of the present articles shall , in particular , be based on an assessment of the possible transboundary harm caused by that activity , including any environmental impact assessment
Translation:
第七条 风险评估  
本条款所规定的任何活动的授权决定，尤其应当基于对该活动可能造成的跨界损害的评估，包括环境影响评估。

Query_Text_en: 1 If the assessment referred to in article 7 indicates a risk of causing significant transboundary harm the State of origin shall provide the State likely to be affected with timely notification of the risk and the assessment and shall transmit to it the available technical and all other relevant information on which the assessment is based ,
Translation: 根据第七条所述评估显示存在造成重大跨境损害风险时，来源国应当及时向可能受影响的国家通报相关风险及评估结果，并应向其提交评估所依据的可用技术及其他相关全部信息。

Query_Text_en: 2 The State of origin shall not take any decision on authorization of the activity pending the receipt within a period not exceeding six months , of the response from the State likely to be affected
Translation: 在收到可能受影响的国家的答复之前，原属国不得就该活动的授权作出任何决定，且答复的接收期限不得超过六个月。

Query_Text_en: 1 The States concerned shall enter into consultations , at the request of any of them , with a view to achieving acceptable solutions regarding measures to be adopted in order to prevent significant transboundary harm or at any event to minimize the risk thereof The States concerned shall agree , at the commencement of such consultations , on a reasonable time frame for the consultations
Translation: 有关国家应根据任何一方请求进行磋商，以就采取措施防止重大跨界危害或至少减少其风险达成可接受的解决方案。有关国家应在磋商开始时商定磋商的合理期限。

Query_Text_en: 2 The States concerned shall seek solutions based on an equitable balance of interests in the light of article 10
Translation: 有关国家应根据第10条的规定，基于公平合理平衡各方利益的原则寻求解决方案。

Query_Text_en: 3 If the consultations referred to in paragraph 1 fail to produce an agreed solution , the State of origin shall nevertheless take into account the interests of the State likely to be affected in case it decides to authorize the activity to be pursued , without prejudice to the rights of any State likely to be affected
Translation: 如第一款所述磋商未能达成一致解决方案，原属国若决定授权开展相关活动时，仍应顾及可能受到影响的国家的利益，且不得损害任何可能受到影响的国家的权利。

Query_Text_en: f The standards ofpreventionwhichtheStatelikelytobe affected applies to the same or comparable activities and the standards applied in comparable regionalorinternational practice
Translation: 适用于可能受影响的国家对相同或类似活动所采取的预防标准，以及区域或国际实践中可比标准。

Query_Text_en: 1 If a State has reasonable grounds to believe that an activity planned or carried out in the State of origin may involve a risk of causing significant transboundary harm to it , it may request the State of origin to apply the provision of article 8 111e request shall be accompanied by a documented explanation setting forth its grounds
Translation: 如果一国如有合理理由认为，活动发起国计划或实施的活动可能造成对其构成重大跨境环境损害的风险，该国可要求活动发起国适用第八条相关规定。此类请求应附有书面说明，详细说明理由依据。

Query_Text_en: 2 In the event that the State of origin nevertheless finds that it is not under an obligation to provide a notification under article 8 , it shall so inform the requesting State within a reasonable time , providing a documented explanation setting forth the reasons for such finding If this find ng does not satisfy that State , at its request , the two States shall promptly enter into consultations in the manner indicated in article 9
Translation: 如原属国仍认定其并无义务根据第八条提供通知，应于合理时间内将此情况告知请求国，并提交书面说明阐明理由。若该认定结果未能令该国满意，应其请求，双方国家应立即按照第九条规定的程序进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: 3 During the course of the consultations , the State of origin sha ] l , if so requested by the other State , arrange to introduce appropriate and feasible measures to minimize the risk and , where appropriate , to suspend the activity in question for a reasonable period
Translation: 在磋商过程中，若另一国提出请求，原属国应采取适当且可行的措施以降低相关风险，并在必要情况下暂停该活动的实施，暂停期限应合理。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 Exchange of information While the activity is being carried out the States concerned shall exchange in a timely manner all available information concerning that activity relevant to preventing significant transboundary harm or at any event minimizing the risk there of Such an exchange of information shall continue until such time as the States concerned consider it appropriate even after the activity is terminated
Translation:
第十二条 信息交换  
在活动实施期间，相关缔约方应当及时交换与该活动有关、涉及防止重大跨界损害或至少降低此类风险的所有可获取信息。此类信息交换应持续至相关缔约方认为适当之时，即使在活动终止后亦同。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 Information tO the public States concerned shall , by such means as are appropriate , provide the public likely to be affected by an activity within the scope of the present articles with relevant information relating to that activity the risk involved and the harm which might result and ascertain their views
Translation:
第三条 信息公开  
相关缔约方应通过适当方式，向可能受到本条款所涉活动影响的公众提供与该活动相关的、包括所涉风险及可能造成危害在内的信息，并征询其意见。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 National security and industrial secrets Data and in formation vital to the national security of the State of origin or to the protection of industrial secrets or concerning intellectual property may be withheld , but the State of origin shall cooperate in good faith with the State likely to be affected in providing as much information as possible under the circumstances
Translation:
第十四条 国家安全与商业秘密  
涉及原属国国家安全、商业秘密保护或知识产权的相关数据和信息可以不予提供，但原属国应秉持善意与可能受到影响的国家进行合作，并在具体情况下尽可能提供更多信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 Non discrimination Unless the States concerned have agreed otherwise for the protection of the interests of persons , natural or juridical , who may be or are exposed to the risk of significant transboundary harm as a result of an activity within the scope of the present articles a State shall not discriminate on the basis of nationality or residence or place where the injury might occur , in granting to such persons , in accordance with its legal system , access to judicial or other procedures to seek protection or other appropriate redress
Translation:
第十五条 非歧视  
除非相关缔约方另有约定以保护可能或已经面临因本条款所述活动导致重大跨界损害风险的自然人或法人的权益，否则任何缔约方在依据其法律体系为上述人员提供获得司法或其他程序的途径、以寻求保护或采取其他适当补救措施时，不得以国籍、住所或损害可能发生地为由进行歧视。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Emergency preparedness The State of origin shall develop contingency plans for responding to emergencies , in cooperation , where appropriate , with the State likely to be affected and competent international organizations
Translation:
第十六条 应急准备  
来源国应当制定应对突发事件的应急预案，并在适当情况下与可能受影响的国家和相关国际组织进行合作。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 Notification of an emergency The State of origin shall , without delay and by the most expeditious means , at its disposal , notify the State likely to be affected of an emergency concerning an activity within the scope of the present articles and provide it with all relevant and available information
Translation:
第十七条 紧急情况通报  
原属国应立即通过其可支配的最快捷方式，就涉及本条款范围内的活动的紧急情况，通知可能受影响的国家，并提供所有相关和可获得的信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 Relationship to other rules of international law The present articles are without prejudice to any obligation incurred by States under relevant treaties or rules of customary international law
Translation:
第十八条 与其他国际法规范的关系  
本公约各项规定不影响各国根据相关条约或习惯国际法所承担的任何义务。

Query_Text_en: 1 Any dispute concerning the interpretation or application of the present articles shall be settled expeditiously through peaceful means of settlement chosen by mutual agreement of the parties to the dispute , including negotiations , mediation , conciliation , arbitration or judicial settlement
Translation: 本协定条款的解释或适用所产生的任何争端，应由争端各方通过协商一致选定的和平解决方式迅速解决，包括谈判、调解、斡旋、仲裁或司法解决。
