Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Transmittal Fee in Case of Indirect Filing ] The Office of any Contracting Party may require that the applicant pay a transmittal fee to it for its own benefit in respect of any international application filed through it
Translation: 受理局可要求申请人向其支付转递费，以供其自身在申请人通过该受理局提交任何国际申请时使用。

Query_Text_en: vii any other prescribed particulars
Translation: vii 其他规定事项

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Additional Mandatory Contents of the International Application ] a Any Contracting Party whose Office is an Examining Office and whose law at the time it becomes party to this Act requires that an application for the grant of protection to an industrial design contain any of the elements specified in subparagraph b in order for that application to be accorded a filing date under that law may in a declaration notify the Director General of those elements
Translation: 对于作为审查机构所在缔约方，如果某缔约方的法律规定在其加入本条约时，工业设计保护申请需包含本款b项所述任何要素才能获得申请日，该缔约方可通过声明向总干事通知这些要素。

Query_Text_en: iii a claim
Translation: III 一项主张

Query_Text_en: ? c Where the international application contains the designation of a Contracting Party that has made a notification under subparagraph a it shall also contain in the prescribed manner any element that was the subject of that notification
Translation: 在国际申请中包含了根据子段(a)提交了通知的缔约方指定时，该申请还应按照规定格式包含所述通知所涉及的任何要素。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Other Possible Contents of the International Application ] The international application may contain or be accompanied by such other elements as are specified in the Regulations
Translation: 国际申请可以包含或附带在细则中所规定的内容。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 [ Several Industrial Designs in the Same International Application ] Subject to such conditions as may be prescribed an international application may include two or more industrial designs
Translation: 在符合相关规定的情况下，一项国际申请可包含两项或以上工业设计。

Query_Text_en: ? 5 [ Request for Deferred Publication ] The international application may contain a request for deferment of publication
Translation: ? 5 [ 延迟公开请求 ] 国际申请中可包含延迟公开的请求。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Claiming of Priority ] a The international application may contain a declaration claiming under Article 4 of the Paris Convention the priority of one or more earlier applications filed in or for any country party to that Convention or any Member of the World Trade Organization
Translation: 根据《巴黎公约》第4条提出主张优先权的声明  国际申请可包含一项根据《巴黎公约》第4条主张一项或多项较早申请优先权的声明，此类较早申请可是在该公约任一缔约国或任一世界贸易组织成员境内或向其提交的。

Query_Text_en: ? b The Regulations may provide that the declaration referred to in subparagraph a may be made after the filing of the international application In such case the Regulations shall prescribe the latest time by which such declaration may be made
Translation: 涉及本条款(b)子项之声明，得以于国际申请提交之后作出。但于此种情形下，规则应明定该声明得以最迟于何时提出。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ International Application Serving as a Basis for Claiming Priority ] The international application shall as from its filing date and whatever may be its subsequent fate be equivalent to a regular filing within the meaning of Article 4 of the Paris Convention
Translation: 自该国际申请的申请日起，无论其后续结局如何，均视为符合《巴黎公约》第4条规定的正式申请。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Prescribed Designation Fee ] The prescribed fees shall inelude subject to paragraph 2 a designation fee for each designated Contracting Party
Translation: 规定费用应包括每个已指定的缔约方的指定费用，但需遵守第2款的规定。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Individual Designation Fee ] Any Contracting Party whose Office is an Examining Office and any Contracting Party that is an intergovernmental organization may in a declaration notify the Director General that in connection with any international application in which It is designated and in connection with the renewal of any international registration resulting from such an international application the prescribed designation fee referred to in paragraph 1 shall be replaced by an individual designation fee whose amount shall be indicated in the declaration and can be changed in further declarations The said amount may be fixed by the said Contracting Party for the initial term of protection and for each term of renewal or for the maximum period of protection allowed by the Contracting Party concerned However it may not be higher than the equivalent of the amount which the Office of that Contracting Party would be entitled to receive from an applicant for a grant of protection for an equivalent period to the same number of industrial designs that amount being diminished by the savings resulting from the international procedure
Translation: 根据第1款规定的指定费用，任何作为审查办公室的缔约方以及任何作为政府间组织的缔约方，均可通过书面声明通知总干事：在任何将其列为指定成员的国际申请中，以及在由此类国际申请衍生的国际注册续展时，上述指定费可用单独指定费替代。该单独指定费的具体金额应在声明中明确列示，并可通过后续声明进行调整。该金额可由相关缔约方针对其首次保护期限、每次续展期限或其法律允许的最长保护期限分别设定，但不得高于以下金额：若申请人在该缔约方境内为相同数量的工业设计申请同等保护期时，该缔约方所属办公机构本应收取的费用金额，减去因采用国际程序而节省的成本后剩余的部分。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Transfer of Designation Fees ] The designation fees referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 shall be transferred by the International Bureau to the Contracting Parties in respect of which those fees were paid
Translation: 根据第一款和第二款所提及的指定费用，应由国际局转移给相关缔约方，这些费用即为此类缔约方所缴纳的费用。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Examination of the International Application ] If the International Bureau finds that the international application does not at the time of its receipt by the International Bureau fulfill the requirements of this Act and the Regulations it shall invite the applicant to make the required corrections within the prescribed time limit
Translation: 对国际申请的审查：国际局在收到国际申请时，若发现其未满足本法及规定的相关要求，应邀请申请人在规定的期限内进行必要的更正。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Irregularities Not Corrected ] a If the applicant does not comply with the invitation within the prescribed time limit the international application shall subject to subparagraph b be considered abandoned
Translation: a 如果申请人在规定的期限内未遵守邀请，则该国际申请应被视为撤回，但需以本款b项规定为准。

Query_Text_en: ? b In the case of an irregularity which relates to Article 5 2 or to a special requirement notified to the Director General by a Contracting Party in accordance with the Regulations if the applicant does not comply with the invitation within the prescribed time limit the international application shall be deemed not to contain the designation of that Contracting Party
Translation: 如果国际申请中存在涉及《实施细则》第五条第二款或缔约方根据《实施细则》向总干事通报的特别要求的不规则情况，而申请人未在规定时间内对邀请作出回应，则该国际申请应视为未指定该缔约方。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ International Application Filed Directly ] Where the international application is filed directly with the International Bureau the filing date shall subject to paragraph 3 be the date on which the International Bureau receives the international application
Translation: 当国际申请直接向国际局提交时，其申请日应根据第三款的规定，为国际局收到该国际申请的日期。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Internation al Application Filed Indirectly ] Where the international application is filed through the Office of the applicant 's Contracting Party the filing date shall be determined as prescribed
Translation: 如果国际申请是通过申请人所属缔约方的受理局提交的，其申请日应按相关规定确定。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ International Application with Certain Irregularities ] Where the international application has on the date on which it is received by the International Bureau an irregularity which is prescribed as an irregularity entailing a postponement of the filing date of the international application the filing date shall be the date on which the correction of such irregularity is received by the International Bureau
Translation: 如果国际申请在提交至国际局的收到日期存在某种规定应导致该国际申请的申请日推迟的缺陷，则申请日应为国际局收到该缺陷更正的日期。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ International Registration ] The International Bureau shall register each industrial design that is the subject of an international application immediately upon receipt by it of the international application or where corrections are invited under Article 8 immediately upon receipt of the required corrections The registration shall be effected whether or not publication is deferred under Article 11
Translation: 国际局应立即对每一项作为国际申请主题的工业设计进行注册，无论是在收到该国际申请时，还是在收到根据第八条规定要求的必要更正后。即使根据第11条推迟了公布，注册也应照常办理。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Date of the International Registration ] a Subject to subparagraph b the date of the international registration shall be the filing date of the international application
Translation: ?2[国际注册日期] a 但受b款制约，国际注册日期应为国际申请的提交日期。

Query_Text_en: ? b Where the international application has on the date on which it is received by the International Bureau an irregularity which relates to Article 5 2 the date of the international registration shall be the date on which the correction of such irregularity is received by the International Bureau or the filing date of the international application whichever is the later
Translation: 如果国际申请在被国际局收到时存在与《第5条第2款》相关的不规范之处，国际注册日期应为国际局收到对上述不规范之处的更正之日或该国际申请的提交日期，以较晚的日期为准。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Publication ] a The international registration shall be published by the International Bureau Such publication shall be deemed in all Contracting Parties to be sufficient publicity and no other publicity may be required of the holder
Translation: 国际注册应由国际局予以公布。此项公布在所有缔约方范围内被视为充分公示，持有方不得被要求履行其他公示义务。

Query_Text_en: ? b The International Bureau shall send a copy of the publication of the international registration to each designated Office
Translation: 国际局应将国际注册公告的副本发送至每个指定的主管局。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 [ Maintenance of Confidentiality Before Publication ] Subject to paragraph 5 and Article 11 4 b the International Bureau shall keep in confidence each international application and each international registration until publication
Translation: 除第五款及第11条第4款b项外，国际局应对每一项国际申请和国际注册在出版前予以保密。

Query_Text_en: ? 5 [ Confidential Copies ] a The International Bureau shall immediately after registration has been effected send a copy of the international registration along with any relevant statement document or specimen accompanying the international application to each Office that has notified the International Bureau that it wishes to receive such a copy and has been designated in the international application
Translation: 国际局应在注册完成后立即向每个已通知国际局希望接收此类副本且在国际申请中被指定的主管局发送国际注册副本以及随附于国际申请的任何相关声明文件或样本。

Query_Text_en: ? b The Office shall until publication of the international registration by the International Bureau keep in confidence each international registration of which a copy has been sent to it by the International Bureau and may use the said copy only for the purpose of the examination of the international registration and of applications for the protection of industrial designs filed in or for the Contracting Party for which the Office is competent In particular it may not divulge the contents of any such international registration to any person outside the Office other than the holder of that international registration except for the purposes of an administrative or legal proceeding involving a conflict over entitlement to file the international application on which the international registration is based In the ease of such an administrative or legal proceeding the contents of the international registration may only be disclosed in confidence to the parties involved in the proceeding who shall be bound to respect the confidentiality of the disclosure
Translation: 办公室应在国际局公布国际注册之前对每项国际注册保密，并仅可将该副本用于对国际注册进行审查以及针对该办公室负责的缔约方领土内或向其提交的工业设计保护申请的审查。特别是，除国际注册所依据的国际申请提交权存在争议而引发的行政或司法程序外，该办公室不得向该国际注册持有人以外的任何局外人透露该类国际注册的任何内容。在发生此类行政或司法程序的情况下，国际注册的内容仅可向程序参与方进行保密披露，且相关方应遵守披露内容的保密义务。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Provisions of Laws of Contracting Parties Concerning Deferment of Publication ] a Where the law of a Contracting Party provides for the deferment of the publication of an industrial design for a period which is less than the prescribed period that Contracting Party shall in a declaration notify the Director General of the allowable period of deferment
Translation: 缔约各方关于延迟公开的规定：  a) 如果某一缔约方的法律规定对工业设计的公开延迟期限短于规定的期限，则该缔约方应以声明的形式通知总干事其允许的延迟期限。

Query_Text_en: ? b Where the law of a Contracting Party does not provide for the deferment of the publication of an industrial design the Contracting Party shall in a declaration notify the Director General of that fact
Translation: 当某一缔约方的法律没有规定可延期工业设计公告时，该缔约方应通过声明向总干事通报这一情况。

Query_Text_en: ? i where none of the Contracting Parties designated in the international application has made a declaration under paragraph 1 at the expiry of the prescribed period or ii where any of the Contracting Parties designated in the international application has made a declaration under paragraph 1 a at the expiry of the period notified in such declaration or where there is more than one such designated Contracting Party at the expiry of the shortest period notified in their declarations
Translation: i. 在国际申请中指定的缔约方均未在规定的期限届满时根据第1段作出声明；  或ii. 在国际申请中指定的缔约方中的任何一方在所述声明中指定期限届满时根据第1(a)段作出声明；  或者，如有多个此类指定缔约方，该期限为他们在声明中指定期限的最短期限届满时。

Query_Text_en: ii where instead of containing reproductions of the industrial design the international application was accompanied by specimens of the industrial design the International Bureau shall disregard the designation of the said Contracting Party and shall notify the applicant accordingly
Translation: 如果国际申请未包含工业设计复制品，而是附有工业设计实物样品，国际局应不予考虑该缔约方的指定，并据此通知申请人。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 [ Request for Earlier Publication or for Special Access to the International Registration ] a At any time during the period of deferment applicable under paragraph 2 the holder may request publication of any or all of the industrial designs that are the subject of the international registration in which case the period of deferment in respect of such industrial design or designs shall be considered to have expired on the date of receipt of such request by the International Bureau
Translation: 4 [ 关于国际注册的提前公布或特别访问请求 ] a 在根据第2段适用的延期期间内，持有人可随时请求公布国际注册中涉及的任何一项或全部工业设计。在这种情况下，对于此类工业设计或工业设计群组而言，国际局收到该请求之日即视为延期期限届满。

Query_Text_en: ? b The holder may also at any time during the period of deferment applicable under paragraph 2 request the International Bureau to provide a third party specified by the holder with an extract from or to allow such a party access to any or all of the industrial designs that are the subject of the international registration
Translation: 在依照第2款适用的延期期间内，持有人还可以随时请求国际局向其指定的第三方提供该国际注册涵盖的工业设计的摘录，或允许该第三方查阅其中任何一项或全部工业设计。

Query_Text_en: ? 5 [ Renunciation and Limitation ] a If at any time during the period of deferment applicable under paragraph 2 the holder renounces the international registration in respect of all the designated Contracting Parties the industrial design or designs that are the subject of the international registration shall not be published
Translation: 根据本条第二款适用的延期期间内，若持有人放弃该国际注册在所有指定缔约方的效力，则该国际注册项下的工业设计不得予以公布。

Query_Text_en: ? b If at any time during the period of deferment applicable under paragraph 2 the holder limits the international registration in respect of all of the designated Contracting Parties to one or some of the industrial designs that are the subject of the international registration the other industrial design or designs that are the subject of the international registration shall not be published
Translation: 根据本款规定适用的延期期间，如果在任何时间内，国际注册持有人将该国际注册在所有指定缔约方范围内限缩至其中一个或部分工业设计，则国际注册中涉及的其他工业设计不得予以公布。

Query_Text_en: ? 6 [ Publication and Furnishing of Reproductions ] a At the expiration of any period of deferment applicable under the provisions of this Article the International Bureau shall subject to the payment of the prescribed fees publish the international registration If such fees are not paid as prescribed the international registration shall be canceled and publication shall not take place
Translation: 根据本条相关规定适用的任何延期期间届满时，在缴付规定的费用后，国际局应对国际注册进行公告及提供复制件。若未按规定缴付费用，则国际注册将被取消且不得公告。

Query_Text_en: ? b Where the international application was accompanied by one or more specimens of the industrial design in accordance with Article 5 1 iii the holder shall submit the prescribed number of copies of a reproduction of each industrial design that is the subject of that application to the International Bureau within the prescribed time limit To the extent that the holder does not do so the international registration shall be canceled and publication shall not take place
Translation: 根据《海牙协定》第5条第1款第iii项的规定，如果国际申请已附有工业设计的样品或模型，该申请的权利人应当在规定期限内，向国际局提交每项工业设计所要求的复制品副本（数量需符合规定）。若权利人未能按时完成上述要求，则该国际注册将被取消，且不会进行相关公告。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Right to Refuse ] The Office of any designated Contracting Party may where the conditions for the grant of protection under the law of that Contracting Party are not met in respect of any or all of the industrial designs that are the subject of an international registration refuse the effects in part or in whole of the international registration in the territory of the said Contracting Party provided that no Office may refuse the effects in part or in whole of any international registration on the ground that requirements relating to the form or contents of the international application that are provided for in this Act or the Regulations or are additional to or different from those requirements have not been satisfied under the law of the Contracting Party concerned
Translation: 【拒绝权】任何指定缔约方的主管部门可针对国际注册中所涉及的一项或全部工业设计，若未满足该缔约方法律规定授予保护的条件，则可在其领土内全部或部分拒绝该国际注册的效力。但规定任何主管部门不得以国际申请的形式或内容不符合本法或实施细则的要求，或不符合相关缔约方超出或不同于上述要求的附加条件或不同标准为理由，对任何国际注册予以全部或部分拒绝。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Notification of Refusal ] a The refusal of the effects of an international registration shall be communicated by the Office to the International Bureau in a notification of refusal within the prescribed period
Translation: 宣告国际注册效力拒绝的决定，该局应于规定期限内通过拒绝通知书向国际局通报。

Query_Text_en: ? b Any notification of refusal shall state all the grounds on which the refusal is based
Translation: “任何拒绝通知应列明该拒绝所依据的所有理由。”

Query_Text_en: Remedies ] a The International Bureau shall without delay transmit a copy of the notification of refusal to the holder
Translation: 补救措施] 国际局应立即向持有人转交拒绝通知的副本。

Query_Text_en: ? b The holder shall enjoy the same remedies as if any industrial design that is the subject of the international registration had been the subject of an application for the grant of protection under the law applicable to the Office that communicated the refusal Such remedies shall at least consist of the possibility of a re examination or a review of the refusal or an appeal against the refusal
Translation: 该持有人应享有如同下列情况的同等救济途径：即如同其曾提出过一项申请，要求根据该受理机构适用的法律，对国际注册所涉及的任何工业设计授予保护。此类救济途径至少应包括针对拒绝决定的重新审查、复审或提出上诉的可能性，无论是针对该拒绝的重新审查、复审还是上诉。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 [ Withdrawal of Refusal ] Any refusal may be withdrawn in part or in whole at any time by the Office that communicated it
Translation: 任何拒绝均可能由作出该决定的机构在任何时间部分或全部撤回。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Notification of Special Requirements ] Any Contracting Party whose law at the time it becomes party to this Act requires that designs that are the subject of the same application conform to a requirement of unity of design unity of production or unity of use or belong to the same set or composition of items or that only one independent and distinct design may be claimed in a single application may in a declaration notify the Director General accordingly However no such declaration shall affect the right of an applicant to include two or more industrial designs in an international application in accordance with Article 5 4 even if the application designates the Contracting Party that has made the declaration
Translation: 根据法律规定，任何缔约方在加入本法时若要求同一项申请中的设计需符合设计统一性、生产统一性或用途统一性，或属于同一套或同一组合的物品，或仅可在一个申请中主张一项独立且不同的设计，可通过声明通知总干事。然而，此类声明不得影响申请人根据第5.4条在国际申请中包含两项或以上工业设计的权利，即使该申请指定提交了声明的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Effect of Declaration ] Any such declaration shall enable the Office of the Contracting Party that has made it to refuse the effects of the international registration pursuant to Article 12 1 pending compliance with the requirement notified by that Contracting Party
Translation: [声明的影响] 针对任何此类声明，作出该声明的缔约方主管机构可依据第12条第（1）款，在满足该缔约方所通知的特定要求前，拒绝给予国际注册的效力。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Further Fees Payable on Division of Registration ] Where following a notification of refusal in accordance with paragraph 2 an international registration is divided before the Office concerned in order to overcome a ground of refusal stated in the notification that Office shall be entitled to charge a fee in respect of each additional international application that would have been necessary in order to avoid that ground of refusal
Translation: 根据第2段所述的驳回通知，若在相关主管局处对国际注册进行分割以规避该通知中所列驳回理由，则该主管局有权就每一项原本必需的附加国际申请收取费用。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Effect as Application Under Applicable Law ] The international registration shall from the date of the international registration have at least the same effect in each designated Contracting Party as a regularly filed application for the grant of protection of the industrial design under the law of that Contracting Party
Translation: 国际注册应自国际注册之日起，在每个指定的缔约方境内至少具有同等效力，如同根据该缔约方关于工业品外观设计保护的法律规定提交的正常申请。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Effect as Grant of Protection Under Applicable Law ] a In each designated Contracting Party the Office of which has not communicated a refusal in accordance with Article 12 the international registration shall have the same effect as a grant of protection for the industrial design under the law of that Contracting Party at the latest from the date of expiration of the period allowed for it to communicate a refusal or where a Contracting Party has made a corresponding declaration under the Regulations at the latest at the time specified in that declaration
Translation: 在每个指定的缔约方（其主管机关未根据第12条提出拒绝通知），国际注册应具有与该缔约方法律下工业设计保护授予相同的效力，最迟自其被允许提出拒绝通知的期限届满之日生效；或当缔约方根据《实施细则》作出相应声明时，最迟自该声明中规定的时间起生效。

Query_Text_en: ? b Where the Office of a designated Contracting Party has communicated a refusal and has subsequently withdrawn in part or in whole that refusal the international registration shall to the extent that the refusal is withdrawn have the same effect in that Contracting Party as a grant of protection for the industrial design under the law of the said Contracting Party at the latest from the date on which the refusal was withdrawn
Translation: 国际注册在被撤回拒绝的范围内，应具有相当于该缔约方国内法律授予工业设计保护的同等效力，且最迟应自该指定缔约方主管机关撤回其拒绝通知之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: ? c The effect given to the international registration under this paragraph shall apply to the industrial design or designs that are the subject of that registration as received from the International Bureau by the designated Office or where applicable as amended in the procedure before that Office
Translation: 根据本段的规定，国际注册所产生的效力应适用于该注册所涉及的工业设计（或设计），这些设计是以国际局转交给指定局的形式收到的，或在适用情况下，以在该局程序中经修改后的版本为准。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Declaration Concerning Effect of Designation of Applicant ' s Contracting Party ] a Any Contracting Party whose Office is an Examining Office may in a declaration notify the Director General that where it is the applicant 's Contracting Party the designation of that Contracting Party in an international registration shall have no effect
Translation: 关于申请人所属缔约方指定效力的声明：任何担任审查局的缔约方均可通过声明通知总干事，若该缔约方为申请人的所属缔约方，则在国际注册中指定该缔约方的行为将不产生效力。

Query_Text_en: ? b Where a Contracting Party having made the declaration referred to in subparagraph a is indicated in an international application both as the applicant 's Contracting Party and as a designated Contracting Party the International Bureau shall disregard the designation of that Contracting Party
Translation: 如果缔约方根据本款(a)项规定作出了声明，并且在国际申请中同时被列为申请人的缔约方和指定缔约方，则国际局应视为未指定该缔约方。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Requirement of Opportunity of Defense ] Invalidation by the competent authorities of a designated Contracting Party of the effects in part or in whole in the territory of that Contracting Party of the international registration may not be pronounced without the holder having in good time been afforded the opportunity of defending his rights
Translation: 未经权利持有人及时获得陈述和辩护的机会，该指定缔约方的主管部门不得在该缔约方领土内全部或部分地宣告国际注册无效。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Notification of Invalidation ] The Office of the Contracting Party in whose territory the effects of the international registration have been invalidated shall where it is aware of the invalidation notify it to the International Bureau
Translation: 宣告该国际注册无效的缔约方所在国主管机关，应在知晓该无效宣告后，将此情况通知国际局。

Query_Text_en: ? v any limitation by the holder of the international registration in respect of any or all of the designated Contracting Parties to one or some of the industrial designs that are the subject of the international registration vi any invalidation by the competent authorities of a designated Contracting Party of the effects in the territory of that Contracting Party of the international registration in respect of any or all of the industrial designs that are the subject of the international registration vii any other relevant fact identified in the Regulations concerning the rights in any or all of the industrial designs that are the subject of the international registration
Translation: 国际注册持有人针对国际注册所涉及的任何或全部工业设计，对任何或所有指定缔约方采取的任何限制；某一指定缔约方主管机关针对国际注册所涉及的任何或全部工业设计，对该国际注册在该缔约方领土内效力作出的任何无效宣告；根据《国际注册条例》规定可能影响国际注册所涉任何或全部工业设计权利的其他相关事实。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Effect of Recording in International Register ] Any recording referred to in items i ii iv v vi and vii of paragraph 1 shall have the same effect as if it had been made in the Register of the Office of each of the Contracting Parties concerned except that a Contracting Party may in a declaration notify the Director General that a recording referred to in item i of paragraph 1 shall not have that effect in that Contracting Party until the Office of that Contracting Party has received the statements or documents specified in that declaration
Translation: 第一段第i、ii、iv、v、vi和vii项所述的任何记录，在各相关缔约方的官方法律注册簿中应具有同等效力，但缔约方可以在声明中通知总干事，第一段第i项所述的记录在该缔约方收到声明中指定的陈述或文件前，不产生该效力。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Fees ] Any recording made under paragraph 1 may be subject to the payment of a fee
Translation: 根据第一款进行的任何记录可能需支付费用。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 [ Publication ] The International Bureau shall publish a notice concerning any recording made under paragraph 1 It shall send a copy of the publication of the notice to the Office of each of the Contracting Parties concerned
Translation: 国际局应就根据本条第1款进行的备案发布公告。其应将该通知的公布版本发送给相关缔约方各方的主管局。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Initial Term of the International Registration ] The international registration shall be effected for an initial term of five years counted from the date of the international registration
Translation: 国际注册的有效期自注册之日起为期五年。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Renewal of the International Registration ] The international registration may be renewed for additional terms of five years in accordance with the prescribed procedure and subject to the payment of the prescribed fees
Translation: 根据规定的程序并在缴纳规定的费用后，国际注册可续期五年。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Duration of Protection in Designated Contracting Parties ] a Provided that the international registration is renewed and subject to subparagraph b the duration of protection shall in each of the designated Contracting Parties be 15 years counted from the date of the international registration
Translation: 根据国际注册的续展情况，并受第(b)款限制，在每一指定缔约方，保护期限应为自国际注册之日起计算的十五年。

Query_Text_en: ? b Where the law of a designated Contracting Party provides for a duration of protection of more than 15 years for an industrial design for which protection has been granted under that law the duration of protection shall provided that the international registration is renewed be the same as that provided for by the law of that Contracting Party
Translation: 如果指定缔约方的法律为已依其法律获得保护的工业设计规定了超过15年的保护期，则在该国际注册经续展的情况下，其保护期限应与该缔约方法律所规定的保护期限相同。

Query_Text_en: ? c Each Contracting Party shall in a declaration notify the Director General of the maximum duration of protection provided for by its law
Translation: 每个缔约方应在其声明中通知总干事其法律规定的最长保护期限。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 [ Possibility of Limited Renewal ] The renewal of the international registration may be effected for any or all of the designated Contracting Parties and for any or all of the industrial designs that are the subject of the international registration
Translation: 国际注册的续展可适用于指定的任何一个或全部缔约方，以及作为该国际注册对象的任何一个或全部工业设计。

Query_Text_en: ? 5 [ Recording and Publication of Renewal ] The International Bureau shall record renewals in the International Register and publish a notice to that effect It shall send a copy of the publication of the notice to the Office of each of the Contracting Parties concerned
Translation: 国际局应当在国际注册簿中登记续展并发布有关通知，并应向每个有关缔约方的局处发送该通知的副本。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Access to Information ] The International Bureau shall supply to any person applying therefor upon the payment of the prescribed fee extracts from the International Register or information concerning the contents of the International Register in respect of any published international registration
Translation: 1 [信息获取] 国际局应向任何申请并支付规费的人提供国际注册簿的摘录或就任何已公布的国际注册向其提供国际注册簿内容的相关信息

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Exemption from Legalization ] Extracts from the International Register supplied by the International Bureau shall be exempt from any requirement of legalization in each Contracting Party
Translation: ? 2 [ 免除认证要求 ] 国际局提供的国际注册证副本，在各缔约方均免除任何形式的认证要求。

Query_Text_en: ? i that a common Office shall be substituted for the national Office of each of them and ii that the whole of their respective territories to which the unified legislation applies shall be deemed to be a single Contracting Party for the purposes of the application of Articles 1 3 to 18 and 31 of this Act
Translation: i 所有国家办事处应被统一办事处替代，以及 ii 根据本法条款，适用统一立法的其各自全部领土范围，在适用本法第1条、第3至18条及第31条时，应被视为单一缔约方。

Query_Text_en: ii in the case of States party to this Act at any time after the unification of their domestic legislation has been effected
Translation: ii. 本法缔约国在其完成国内立法统一后的任何时间

Query_Text_en: ii in the case of States party to this Act three months after the date of the communication thereof by the Director General to the other Contracting Parties or at any later date indicated in the notification
Translation: 对于本公约缔约国而言，自总干事将此通知送达其他缔约方之日起三个月后，或通知中所指明的任何较晚日期。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 Membership of the Hague UnionThe Contracting Parties shall be members of the same Union as the States party to the 1934 Act or the 1960 Act
Translation:
第二十条 海牙联盟成员资格  
缔约各方应成为与1934年公约或1960年公约缔约国属于同一联盟的成员。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Composition ] a The Contracting Parties shall be members of the same Assembly as the States bound by Article 2 of the Complementary Act of 1967
Translation: ? 1 [组成] a 缔约各方应成为与受1967年补充法案第二条约束的国家同属同一议会的成员。

Query_Text_en: ? b Each member of the Assembly shall be represented in the Assembly by one delegate who may be assisted by alternate delegates advisors and experts and each delegate may represent only one Contracting Party
Translation: 议会每一成员应由一名代表代表,该代表可由替代代表、顾问和专家协助，且每位代表仅能代表一个缔约方。

Query_Text_en: ? c Members of the Union that are not members of the Assembly shall be admitted to the meetings of the Assembly as observers
Translation: ? c 不属于议会成员的联盟成员国应获准作为观察员出席议会会议。

Query_Text_en: ? x take any other appropriate action to further the objectives of the Union and perform any other functions as are appropriate under this Act
Translation: 可采取其他适当措施以推进联盟的目标，并履行本法下其他适当的职能。

Query_Text_en: ? b With respect to matters which are also of interest to other Unions administered by the Organization the Assembly shall make its decisions after having heard the advice of the Coordination Committee of the Organization
Translation: 关于涉及本组织管理的其他联盟也感兴趣的事项，大会应在听取本组织协调委员会的建议后作出决定。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Quorum ] a One half of the members of the Assembly which are States and have the right to vote on a given matter shall constitute a quorum for the purposes of the vote on that matter
Translation: 第3条[法定人数] 大会中作为国家的成员且有投票权的一半成员，应构成对该事项进行投票的法定人数。

Query_Text_en: ? b Notwithstanding the provisions of subparagraph a if in any session the number of the members of the Assembly which are States have the right to vote on a given matter and are represented is less than one half but equal to or more than one third of the members of the Assembly which are States and have the right to vote on that matter the Assembly may make decisions but with the exception of decisions concerning its own procedure all such decisions shall take effect only if the conditions set forth hereinafter are fulfilled The International Bureau shall communicate the said decisions to the members of the Assembly which are States have the right to vote on the said matter and were not represented and shall invite them to express in writing their vote or abstention within a period of three months from the date of the communication If at the expiration of this period the number of such members having thus expressed their vote or abstention attains the number of the members which was lacking for attaining the quorum in the session itself such decisions shall take effect provided that at the same time the required majority still obtains
Translation: 尽管有本款a项的规定，如遇大会某次会议上，有权对特定事项投票并出席的国家成员不足半数但不少于三分之一，则除涉及大会自身程序的决议外，大会仍可作出决议，但此类决议仅在满足下列条件后方可生效：国际局应将相关决议通报该事项中未出席的有权投票的国家成员，并邀请其在收到通知之日起3个月内以书面形式表达其表决意见或弃权。若该期限届满时，上述成员就此作出表决或弃权的成员数量已补足该次会议实际举行时未能达到法定人数所缺少的成员人数，则决议应予生效，但须同时满足所需多数票仍存续的条件。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 [ Taking Decisions in the Assembly ] a The Assembly shall endeavor to take its decisions by consensus
Translation: 大会应努力通过共识达成决议。

Query_Text_en: ? b Where a decision can not be arrived at by consensus the matter at issue shall be decided by voting In such a case
Translation: 若无法通过共识达成决定，待议事项应通过投票方式进行决议。在这种情形下，

Query_Text_en: ? i each Contracting Party that is a State shall have one vote and shall vote only in its own name and ii any Contracting Party that is an intergovernmental organization may vote in place of its Member States with a number of votes equal to the number of its Member States which are party to this Act and no such intergovernmental organization shall participate in the vote if any one of its Member States exercises its right to vote and vice versa
Translation: （一）作为国家的每一缔约方仅能以其自身名义行使一票投票权；  （二）任何政府间组织作为缔约方时，可代表其成员国进行投票，其投票权数量等同于其作为本公约缔约方的成员国数目；但若该组织的任一成员国已行使投票权，则该政府间组织不得参与投票，反之亦然。

Query_Text_en: ? c On matters concerning only States that are bound by Article 2 of the Complementary Act of 1967 Contracting Parties that are not bound by the said Article shall not have the right to vote whereas on matters concerning only Contracting Parties only the latter shall have the right to vote
Translation: 对于仅涉及受1967年补充议定书第2条约束的缔约方的事务，不受该条款约束的缔约方无权投票；而对于仅涉及缔约方的事务，则仅后者（即受该条款约束的缔约方）享有投票权。

Query_Text_en: ? 5 [ Majorities ] a Subject to Articles 24 2 and 26 2 the decisions of the Assembly shall require two thirds of the votes cast
Translation: [ 多数 ] 的决定应符合《公约》第 24 条第 2 款和第 26 条第 2 款的规定，大会的决定需获得投票数的三分之二多数票。

Query_Text_en: ? b Abstentions shall not be considered as votes
Translation: 弃权不视为投票。

Query_Text_en: ? 6 [ Sessions ] a The Assembly shall meet once in every second calendar year in ordinary session upon convocation by the Director General and in the absence of exceptional circumstances during the same period and at the same place as the General Assembly of the Organization
Translation: 大会应在总干事召集下，每两年召开一次通常会议，除非在此期间存在特殊情况，否则应与本组织大会同时期同地举行。

Query_Text_en: ? b The Assembly shall meet in extraordinary session upon convocation by the Director General either at the request of one fourth of the members of the Assembly or on the Director General 's own initiative
Translation: 大会应在总干事召集下召开特别会议，该召集可基于大会四分之一成员的请求，或由总干事自行发起。

Query_Text_en: ? c The agenda of each session shall be prepared by the Director General
Translation: 各次会议的议程应由总干事制定。

Query_Text_en: ? 7 [ Rules of Procedure ] The Assembly shall adopt its own rules of procedure
Translation: 大会应制定自己的议事规则。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Administrative Tasks ] a International registration and related duties as well as all other administrative tasks concerning the Union shall be performed by the International Bureau
Translation: 国际注册及有关职责，以及涉及联盟的其他一切行政任务，均由国际局执行。

Query_Text_en: ? b In particular the International Bureau shall prepare the meetings and provide the secretariat of the Assembly and of such committees of experts and working groups as may be established by the Assembly
Translation: 特别是，国际局应负责准备会议，并为大会以及由大会设立的专家委员会和工作组提供秘书处服务。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Director General ] The Director General shall be the chief executive of the Union and shall represent the Union
Translation: 总干事应为本联盟的首席执行官，并代表本联盟。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Meetings Other than Sessions of the Assembly ] The Director General shall convene any committee and working group established by the Assembly and all other meetings dealing with matters of concern to the Union
Translation: 总干事应召集大会设立的任何委员会及工作组，以及所有涉及联盟事务的其他会议。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 [ Role of the International Bureau in the Assembly and Other Meetings ] a The Director General and persons designated by the Director General shall participate without the right to vote in all meetings of the Assembly the committees and working groups established by the Assembly and any other meetings convened by the Director General under the aegis of the Union
Translation: 总干事及由总干事指定的人员有权出席大会及其设立的委员会和工作组的所有会议，以及总干事在联盟框架下召开的其他会议，但无表决权。

Query_Text_en: ? b The Director General or a staff member designated by the Director General shall be ex officio secretary of the Assembly and of the committees working groups and other meetings referred to in subparagraph a
Translation: 总干事或由总干事指定的工作人员应担任大会、委员会、工作组以及其他在子段(a)中所提及的会议的当然秘书。

Query_Text_en: ? 5 [ Conferences ] a The International Bureau shall in accordance with the directions of the Assembly make the preparations for any revision conferences
Translation: 国际局应按照大会的指示，为任何修订会议进行准备工作。

Query_Text_en: ? b The International Bureau may consult with intergovernmental organizations and international and national non governmental organizations concerning the said preparations
Translation: 国际局可以就上述筹备工作与政府间组织以及国际和国家级非政府组织进行商议。

Query_Text_en: ? c The Director General and persons designated by the Director General shall take part without the right to vote in the discussions at revision conferences
Translation: 总干事及由其指定的人员应出席修订会议的讨论，但无表决权。

Query_Text_en: ? 6 [ Other Tasks ] The international Bureau shall carry out any other tasks assigned to it in relation to this Act
Translation: 国际局应履行根据本法指定的其他任何任务。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Budget ] a The Union shall have a budget
Translation: ? 1 [ 预算 ] a. 联盟应拥有预算

Query_Text_en: ? b The budget of the Union shall include the income and expenses proper to the Union and its contribution to the budget of expenses common to the Unions administered by the Organization
Translation: 该联盟的预算应当包括属于该联盟自身的收入与支出，以及其对由本组织管理的各联盟共同支出预算所作的贡献。

Query_Text_en: ? c Expenses not attributable exclusively to the Union but also to one or more other Unions administered by the Organization shall be considered to be expenses common to the Unions The share of the Union in such common expenses shall be in proportion to the interest the Union has in them
Translation: 不属于某一工会单独承担，同时也涉及该组织管理的一个或多个其他工会的费用，应视为各工会的共同费用。某一工会在这些共同费用中的分摊比例，应与其在这些费用中的利益相关程度成正比。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Coordination with Budgets of Other Unions ] The budget of the Union shall be established with due regard to the requirements of coordination with the budgets of the other Unions administered by the Organization
Translation: 联合组织的预算应当在制定时充分考虑与其他由该组织管理的工会预算相协调的要求。

Query_Text_en: ? v rents interests and other miscellaneous income
Translation: ? V 租金、利息及其他杂项收入

Query_Text_en: Level of the Budget ] a The amounts of the fees referred to in paragraph 3 i shall be fixed by the Assembly on the proposal of the Director General Charges referred to in paragraph 3 ii shall be established by the Director General and shall be provisionally applied subject to approval by the Assembly at its next session
Translation: 根据第3(i)款所述的费用金额，应由大会在总干事提议的基础上确定。第3(ii)款所述的费用金额由总干事制定，并暂行实施，但须经大会下次会议批准。

Query_Text_en: ? b The amounts of the fees referred to in paragraph 3 i shall be so fixed that the revenues of the Union from fees and other sources shall be at least sufficient to cover all the expenses of the International Bureau concerning the Union
Translation: 根据本条第3款(i)项所述费用的数额应确定如下：本联盟来自费用和其他来源的收入至少应足以覆盖国际局与联盟有关的所有开支。

Query_Text_en: ? c If the budget is not adopted before the beginning of a new financial period it shall be at the same level as the budget of the previous year as provided in the financial regulations
Translation: 如果预算未在新财政年度开始前获得批准，则应保持与上一年度预算相同的水平，根据财务条例的规定。

Query_Text_en: ? 5 [ Working Capital Fund ] The Union shall have a working capital fund which shall be constituted by the excess receipts and if such excess does not suffice by a single payment made by each member of the Union If the fund becomes insufficient the Assembly shall decide to increase it The proportion and the terms of payment shall be fixed by the Assembly on the proposal of the Director General
Translation: 联盟应设有工作资金基金，该基金由盈余收入组成。若盈余收入不足，则由联盟各成员通过一次性支付方式补充。若基金出现不足，大会应决定增补资金。缴纳比例及支付条款应由大会根据总干事的提议确定。

Query_Text_en: ? 6 [ Advances by Host State ] a In the headquarters agreement concluded with the State on the territory of which the Organization has its headquarters it shall be provided that whenever the working capital fund is insufficient such State shall grant advances The amount of those advances and the conditions on which they are granted shall be the subject of separate agreements in each case between such State and the Organization
Translation: 在该组织总部所在的缔约国缔结的总部协议中应规定：每当营运资金库不足以支付所需款项时，该缔约国应提供预支款项。此类预支款项的具体金额及条件应通过个案单独协议在该国与该组织之间另行达成。

Query_Text_en: ? b The State referred to in subparagraph a and the Organization shall each have the right to denounce the obligation to grant advances by written notification Denunciation shall take effect three years after the end of the year in which it has been notified
Translation: 本款a项所指国家及该组织均有权通过书面通知宣布废除提供预付款项的义务。该废除决定应自通知所在的年份结束后的第三年起生效。

Query_Text_en: ? 7 [ Auditing of Accounts ] The auditing of the accounts shall be effected by one or more of the States members of the Union or by external auditors as provided in the financial regulations They shall be designated with their agreement by the Assembly
Translation: 根据财务条例，联盟账目的审计应由一个或多个成员国或外部审计机构进行。这些审计机构须经其同意后由议会指定。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Subject Matter ] The Regulations shall govern the details of the implementation of this Act They shall in particular include provisions concerning
Translation: 本法的实施细则应由本法制定。其尤其应包含关于……的规定

Query_Text_en: iii any administrative requirements matters or procedures
Translation: 任何行政要求事项或程序

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Amendment of Certain Provisions of the Regulations ] a The Regulations may specify that certain provisions of the Regulations may be amended only by unanimity or only by a four fifths majority
Translation: 本规定可具体说明，某些条款的修订仅可通过全体一致同意或五分之四多数票进行。

Query_Text_en: ? b In order for the requirement of unanimity or a four fifths majority no longer to apply in the future to the amendment of a provision of the Regulations unanimity shall be required
Translation: 为了使未来在修改《规定》中某一项条款时，不再适用一致同意或五分之四多数的要求，必须达成一致同意。

Query_Text_en: ? c In order for the requirement of unanimity or a four fifths majority to apply in the future to the amendment of a provision of the Regulations a four fifths majority shall be required
Translation: 为使未来修改条例中某条款的要求适用全体一致或五分之四多数的通过程序，必须达到五分之四多数的同意。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Conflict Between This Act and the Regulations ] In the case of conflict between the provisions of this Act and those of the Regulations the former shall prevail
Translation: 第三条 [本法与条例之间的冲突] 如本法规定与条例规定发生冲突时，前者应优先适用。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Revision Conferences ] This Act may be revised by a conference of the Contracting Parties
Translation: 1 [ 修订会议 ] 本议定书可经缔约方会议进行修订。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Revision or Amendment of Certain Articles ] Articles 21 22 23 and 26 may be amended either by a revision conference or by The Assembly according to the provisions of Article 26 Article 26 Amendment of Certain Articles by the Assembly
Translation: 第21、22、23条和第26条可由修订会议或根据第26条规定通过大会进行修订或修改。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 [ Proposals for Amendment ] a Proposals for the amendment by the Assembly of Articles 21 22 23 and this Article may be initiated by any Contracting Party or by the Director General
Translation: 第二十一条、第二十二条、第二十三条和本条的修正提议可由任何缔约方或总干事发起。

Query_Text_en: ? b Such proposals shall be communicated by the Director General to the Contracting Parties at least six months in advance of their consideration by the Assembly
Translation: 这些提议应至少在大会审议前六个月由总干事传达给缔约方。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 [ Majorities ] Adoption of any amendment to the Articles referred to in paragraph 1 shall require a three fourths majority except that adoption of any amendment to Article 21 or to the present paragraph shall require a four fifths majority
Translation: 2 [ 多数决 ] 对第一款所指条款的任何修正案的通过应经四分之三多数同意，但对第21条或本款的任何修正案的通过则需经五分之四多数同意。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 [ Entry into Force ] a Except where subparagraph b applies any amendment to the Articles referred to in paragraph 1 shall enter into force one month after written notifications of acceptance effected in accordance with their respective constitutional processes have been received by the Director General from three fourths of those Contracting Parties which at the time the amendment was adopted were members of the Assembly and had the right to vote on that amendment
Translation: ? 3 [ 生效 ]  a 除非b款适用，根据第一条所指的议事规则修正案，在总干事收到以下缔约方按照各自宪法程序完成的接受书面通知后一个月生效。这些缔约方需满足：在修正案通过时属于大会成员且具有对该修正案的表决权，并且此类通知需来自满足上述条件的缔约方中的四分之三。

Query_Text_en: 1 The rights and obligations arising out of a payment order shall be governed by the law chosen by the parties In the absence of agreement the law of the state of the receiving bank shall apply
Translation: 因支付指令产生的权利与义务适用双方选定的法律；若双方未作选择，则适用收款银行所在国的法律。

Query_Text_en: 2 The second sentence of paragraph 1 shall not affect the determination of which law governs the question whether the actual sender of the payment order had the authority to bind the purported sender
Translation: 本条第一款第二句的规定不影响对以下问题所适用法律的确定，即实际支付指令发送人是否有权约束名义发送人。

Query_Text_en: a where a State comprises several territorial units having different rules of law each territorial unit shall be considered to be a separate State ;
Translation: 如果一个国家由多个实行不同法律制度的领土单位组成，则每个此类领土单位应被视为独立的国家。

Query_Text_en: b branches and separate offices of a bank in different States are separate banks
Translation: 位于不同州的银行分行和独立营业机构被视为独立的银行实体。

Query_Text_en: This law does not deal with issues related to the protection of consumers
Translation: 本法不涉及消费者权益保护相关事宜。

Query_Text_en: 1 This law applies to credit transfers where any sending bank and its receiving bank are in different States
Translation: 本法适用于汇出银行与接收银行分属不同国家的信用转账。

Query_Text_en: 2 This law applies to other entities that as an ordinary part of their business engage in executing payment orders in the same manner as it applies to banks
Translation: 本法适用于其他机构，这些机构如同银行一样，作为其常规业务的一部分从事处理支付指令的活动。

Query_Text_en: 3 For the purpose of determining the sphere of application of this law branches and separate offices of a bank in different States are separate banks
Translation: 为了确定本法的适用范围，银行在不同国家的分支机构和独立办事处应视为独立的银行。

Query_Text_en: a Credit transfer means the series of operations beginning with the originator 's payment order made for the purpose of placing funds at the disposal of a beneficiary The term includes any payment order issued by the originator 's bank or any intermediary bank intended to carry out the originator 's payment order A payment order issued for the purpose of effecting payment for such an order is considered to be part of a different credit transfer ;
Translation: 信用转账指一系列以发起人出于向收款人提供资金目的而发出的支付指令为开端的操作。该术语包括为执行发起人支付指令而由发起人银行或任何中介银行签发的任何支付指令。任何出于为上述指令完成支付目的而签发的支付指令应被视为另一不同信用转账的一部分。

Query_Text_en: ii the instruction does not provide that payment is to be made at the request of the beneficiary Nothing in this paragraph prevents an instruction from being a payment order merely because it directs the beneficiary 's bank to hold until the beneficiary requests payment funds for a beneficiary that does not maintain an account with it ;
Translation: ii 本条款并未规定付款需以受益人提出请求为前提。本段内容并不妨碍一项指示仅因其要求受益人银行暂存款项直至受益人提出支付请求（即使该受益人未在该行开立账户）而被视为非支付指令。

Query_Text_en: m Interest means the time value of the funds or money involved which unless otherwise agreed is calculated at the rate and on the basis customarily accepted by the banking community for the funds or money involved
Translation: 利息指所涉资金或货币的时间价值，除非另有约定，否则应按照银行业通常接受的利率及计算方式确定。

Query_Text_en: 1 When an instruction is not a payment order because it is subject to a condition but a bank that has received the instruction executes it by issuing an unconditional payment order thereafter the sender of the instruction has the same rights and obligations under this law as the sender of a payment order and the beneficiary designated in the instruction shall be treated as the beneficiary of a payment order
Translation: 当一项指令因附有条件而不构成支付命令，但接收该指令的银行此后通过签发无条件支付命令予以执行的，该指令的发送方根据本法享有与支付命令发送方相同的权利并承担相应的义务，指令中指定的受益人应视为支付命令的受益人。

Query_Text_en: 2 This law does not govern the time of execution of a conditional instruction received by a bank nor does it affect any right or obligation of the sender of a conditional instruction that depends on whether the condition has been satisfied
Translation: 本法不对银行收到的附条件指令的执行时间作出规范，亦不影响附条件指令发送方因条件是否得到满足而产生的任何权利或义务。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 Variation by agreementExcept as otherwise provided in this law the rights and obligations of parties to a credit transfer may be varied by their agreement
Translation:
第四条 协议变更  
除非本法另有规定，信贷转让的当事人可通过协议变更其权利和义务。

Query_Text_en: 1 A sender is bound by a payment order or an amendment or revocation of a payment order if it was issued by the sender or by another person who had the authority to bind the sender
Translation: 若支付指令、对支付指令的修改或撤销是由发送方或有权代表发送方行事的其他人发出的，则发送方应受其约束。

Query_Text_en: b the receiving bank complied with the authentication
Translation: 接收行履行了验证程序。

Query_Text_en: 3 the parties are not permitted to agree that a purported sender is bound under paragraph 2 if the authentication is not commercially reasonable in the circumstances
Translation: 如果认证在具体情况下不具备商业合理性，则各方不得约定声称的发送方需根据本条第二款承担义务。

Query_Text_en: b a person whose relationship with the purported sender enabled that person to gain access to the authentication procedure The preceding sentence does not apply if the receiving bank proves that the payment order resulted from the actions of a person who had gained access to the authentication procedure through the fault of the purported sender
Translation: 通过与假定发令人之间的关系而得以接触认证程序的人。前文所述规定不适用，若接收银行能证明该支付命令系因某人通过假定发令人自身的过错接触认证程序而产生。

Query_Text_en: 5 A sender who is bound by a payment order is bound by the terms of the order as received by the receiving bank However the sender is not bound by an erroneous duplicate of or an error or discrepancy in a payment order if
Translation: 汇款人应按接收行收到的支付指令内容承担相应责任。但若支付指令存在错误副本，或支付指令中存在错误或差异，汇款人对此不承担责任。

Query_Text_en: b use of the procedure by the receiving bank revealed or would have revealed the erroneous duplicate error or discrepancy If the error or discrepancy that the bank would have detected was that the sender instructed payment of an amount greater than the amount intended by the sender the sender is bound only to the extent of the amount that was intended Paragraph 5 applies to an error or discrepancy in an amendment or a revocation order as it applies to an error or discrepancy in a payment order
Translation: 如果接收银行按照程序使用该流程，能够发现或本应发现重复错误或差异，则：如果银行本应发现的错误或差异是发送方指示支付的金额大于其实际意图金额，则发送方仅需对意图金额范围内承担责任。第5段对修改或撤销指令中的错误或差异的适用，与对支付指令中的错误或差异的适用方式相同。

Query_Text_en: 6 a sender becomes obligated to pay the receiving bank for the payment order when the receiving bank accepts it but payment is not due until the beginning of the execution period
Translation: 付款方在接收行接受支付指令时即承担支付义务，但实际付款直至执行期开始时方需履行。

Query_Text_en: c if neither subparagraph a nor b applies as otherwise provided by law
Translation: （三）如不适用本款（一）、（二）项规定，依法律另有规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 The provisions of this article apply to a receiving bank other than the beneficiary 's bank
Translation: 本条款适用于除受益人银行外的接收行。

Query_Text_en: or e when the time for giving notice of rejection under paragraph 3 has elapsed without notice having been given
Translation: 或者当根据第三款规定的拒绝通知期限已届满而未予通知时

Query_Text_en: c there is insufficient information to identify the sender
Translation: 无法获取足够的信息以识别发件人。

Query_Text_en: 4 A payment order ceases to have effect if it is neither accepted nor rejected under this article before the close of business on the fifth banking day following the end of the execution period
Translation: 如果支付指令在执行期届满后的第五个营业日营业结束前仍未根据本条规定被接受或拒绝，则该支付指令失效。

Query_Text_en: 2 A receiving bank that accepts a payment order is obligated under that payment order to issue a payment order within the time required by article 11 either to the beneficiary 's bank or to an intermediary bank that is consistent with the contents of the payment order received by the receiving bank and that contains the instructions necessary to implement the credit transfer in an appropriate manner
Translation: 接收行在收到支付指令后，应根据该指令内容，在第11条规定的期限内，向受益人银行或中间行发出支付指令。该支付指令需与接收行所收到的支付指令内容保持一致，并包含必要指示以确保信贷转账得以适当执行。

Query_Text_en: 3 A receiving bank that determines that it is not feasible to follow an instruction of the sender specifying an intermediary bank or funds transfer system to be used in carrying out the credit transfer or that following such an instruction would cause excessive costs or delay in completing the credit transfer shall be taken to have complied with paragraph 2 if before the end of the execution period it inquires of the sender what further actions it should take
Translation: 接收行若认定无法遵循发端行关于指定中介银行或资金转账系统用于执行信用转账的指示，或遵循该指示会导致信用转账产生过高成本或延误，只要其在执行期限届满前向发端行查询应采取的后续措施，则视为已遵守第2段规定。

Query_Text_en: 4 When an instruction is received that appears to be intended to be a payment order but does not contain sufficient data to be a payment order or being a payment order it can not be executed because of insufficient data but the sender can be identified the receiving bank shall give notice to the sender of the insufficiency within the time required by article 11
Translation: 当接收银行收到一项看似属于支付指令但不具备必要数据，或虽为支付指令但因数据不足而无法执行且能够确认发件人身份时，接收银行应当在第11条规定的时限内，将数据不足情况通知发件人。

Query_Text_en: 5 When a receiving bank detects that there is an inconsistency in the information relating to the amount of money to be transferred it shall within the time required by article 11 give notice to the sender of the inconsistency if the sender can be identified Any interest payable under article 17 4 for failing to give the notice required by this paragraph shall be deducted from any interest payable under article 17 1 for failing to comply with paragraph 2 of this article
Translation: 当收款银行发现有关应转移资金金额的信息存在不一致时，如果能够确认发款人身份，应在第11条规定的时限内通知发款人该不一致情况。根据本款要求未发出通知而依据第17条第4款应付的利息，应从因未遵守本条第2款规定而依据第17条第1款应付的利息中扣除。

Query_Text_en: 6 For the purposes of this article branches and separate offices of a bank even if located in the same State are separate banks
Translation: 本条所称银行的分支机构及独立营业机构，即使位于同一州，亦视为独立银行。

Query_Text_en: or h when the time for giving notice of rejection under paragraph 2 has elapsed without notice having been given
Translation: 或者，当根据第2款规定提出拒绝通知的期限已过而未提出通知时

Query_Text_en: 3 A payment order ceases to have effect if it is neither accepted nor rejected under this article before the close of business on the fifth banking day following the end of the execution period
Translation: 如果根据本条规定，在执行期结束后第五个银行营业日的营业结束前既未被接受亦未被拒绝，则该支付指令失效。

Query_Text_en: 1 The beneficiary 's bank is upon acceptance of a payment order obligated to place the funds at the disposal of the beneficiary or otherwise to apply the credit in accordance with the payment order and the law governing the relationship between the bank and the beneficiary
Translation: 受益人银行在收到付款指令后，有义务确保资金由受益人支配，或根据付款指令和管辖银行与受益人之间关系的法律条款执行信用证。

Query_Text_en: 2 When an instruction is received that appears to be intended to be a payment order but does not contain sufficient data to be a payment order or being a payment order it can not be executed because of insufficient data but the sender can be identified the beneficiary 's bank shall give notice to the sender of the insufficiency within the time required by article 11
Translation: 当受益人开户行收到一项看似旨在作为支付指令的指示，但该指示缺乏构成支付指令所需充分数据，或虽构成支付指令但因数据不足而无法执行，且能够识别该指示的发送人时，受益人开户行应根据第11条规定的时间要求，向发送人通报数据不足的情况。

Query_Text_en: 3 When the beneficiary 's bank detects that there is an inconsistency in the information relating to the amount of money to be transferred it shall within the time required by article 11 give notice to the sender of the inconsistency if the sender can be identified
Translation: 受益人开户银行在发现应转账金额相关信息存在不一致时，应在第11条规定的期限内，如能确认汇款人身份，应向汇款人通报相关不一致情况。

Query_Text_en: 4 When the beneficiary 's bank detects that there is an inconsistency in the information intended to identify the beneficiary it shall within the time required by article 11 give notice to the sender of inconsistency if the sender can be identified
Translation: 当受益人的银行发现用于识别受益人的信息存在不一致时，如果能够识别发件人，应当在第11条规定的期限内通知发件人该不一致情况。

Query_Text_en: 5 Unless the payment order states otherwise the beneficiary 's bank shall within the time required for execution under article 11 give notice to a beneficiary who does not maintain an account at the bank that it is holding funds for its benefit if the bank has sufficient information to give such notice
Translation: 除非付款指令另有规定，受益人开户行应在根据第11条规定的执行期限内，如果该银行具备提供此类通知的充分信息，应通知在该银行无账户的受益人其正在保管该受益人的资金。

Query_Text_en: 1 In principle a receiving bank that is obligated to execute a payment order is obligated to do so on the banking day it is received If it does not it shall do so on the banking day after the order is received Nevertheless if
Translation: 原则上，接收银行若有义务执行支付指令，应在收到该指令的银行业务日当天执行。若未能在该日执行，则应在下一个银行业务日执行。然而，如果……

Query_Text_en: b the payment order specifies a date when the funds are to be placed at the disposal of the beneficiary and that date indicates that later execution is appropriate in order for the beneficiary 's bank to accept a payment order and execute it on that date the order shall be executed on that date
Translation: 支付指令指定了资金将被置于受益人支配的日期，该日期表明，为了使受益人银行能够接受该支付指令并在该日期执行，后续执行是适当的。该指令应于该日期执行。

Query_Text_en: 2 If the receiving bank executes the payment order on the banking day after it is received except when complying with subparagraph a or b of paragraph 1 the receiving bank must execute for value as of the day of receipt
Translation: 接收行除因遵守第1段a项或b项规定外，若在收到支付指令后的下一个营业日执行该指令，则必须自收到之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: b where payment is to be made by other means payment has been made
Translation: b) 在以其他方式支付的情况下，款项已支付完毕。

Query_Text_en: 4 A notice required to be given under article 8 4 or 5 or article 10 2 3 or 4 shall be given on or before the banking day following the end of the execution period
Translation: 根据第八条第四款或第五款，或第十条第二款、第三款或第四款规定需要发出的通知，应在执行期结束后的第一个营业日当天或之前发出。

Query_Text_en: 5 A receiving bank that receives a payment order after the receiving bank 's cut off time for that type of payment order is entitled to treat the order as having been received on the next day the bank executes that type of payment order
Translation: 接收行在收到某类支付指令时，若该指令提交时间晚于该类支付指令的接收行截止时限，则有权将该指令视为在银行处理该类支付指令的下一个工作日收到。

Query_Text_en: 6 If a receiving bank is required to perform an action on a day when it does not perform that type of action it must perform the required action on the next day it performs that type of action
Translation: 如果接收行被要求在不处理该类型业务的日期执行相关操作，则必须在下一个办理该类型业务的营业日完成所需操作。

Query_Text_en: 7 For the purposes of this article branches and separate offices of a bank even if located in the same State are separate banks
Translation: 就本条而言，银行的分支机构和独立办事处即使位于同一州，也应视为独立的银行。

Query_Text_en: 1 A payment order may not be revoked by the sender unless the revocation order is received by a receiving bank other than the beneficiary 's bank at a time and in a manner sufficient to afford the receiving bank a reasonable opportunity act before the later of the actual time of execution and the beginning of the day on which the payment order ought to have been executed under subparagraph a or b of article 11 1
Translation: 支付指令的发送方不得撤销该指令，除非撤销指令由非受益人开户行的接收银行收到，且该撤销指令的接收时间及方式应足以使接收银行在以下较晚时间前获得采取行动的合理机会：支付指令依据第11.1条第(a)或(b)项本应执行的实际执行时间，或该执行日的起始时间。

Query_Text_en: 2 A payment order may not be revoked by the sender unless the revocation order is received by the beneficiary 's bank at a time and in a manner sufficient to afford the bank a reasonable opportunity to act before the later of the time the credit transfer is completed and the beginning of the day when the funds are to be placed at the disposal of the beneficiary
Translation: 支付指令不得由发出方撤销，除非撤销指令在信贷转账完成时间与受益人可支配资金日开始时间中的较晚时间之前，以合理方式送达受益人开户银行，确保该银行有充分时间采取行动。

Query_Text_en: 3 Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 the sender and the receiving bank may agree that payment orders issued by the sender to the receiving bank are to be irrevocable or that a revocation order is effective only if it is received earlier than the time specified in paragraph 1 or 2
Translation: 尽管本条第1款和第2款有相关规定，但汇款人与接收银行仍可约定由汇款人向接收银行发出的支付指令为不可撤销性质，或仅在撤销指令比本条第1款或第2款所规定时间更早送达接收银行的情况下方为有效。

Query_Text_en: 4 A revocation order must be authenticated
Translation: 4. 撤销令须经认证。

Query_Text_en: 5 A receiving bank other than the beneficiary 's bank that executes or a beneficiary 's bank that accepts a payment order in respect of which an effective revocation order has been or is subsequently received is not entitled to payment for that payment order If the credit transfer is completed the bank shall refund any payment received by it
Translation: 除受益人之外的银行执行或受益人银行接受某项付款指令时，若该付款指令的有效撤销指令已收到或后续收到，则该银行无权获得该付款指令项下的款项。如果汇款已完成，银行应当退还其收到的任何款项。

Query_Text_en: 6 It the recipient of a refund is not the originator of the credit transfer it shall pass on the refund to its sender
Translation: 如果退款的接收方并非信贷转账的发起人，则其应当将退款转交给原发送方。

Query_Text_en: 7 A bank that is obligated to make a refund to its sender is discharged from that obligation to the extent that it makes the refund direct to a prior sender Any bank subsequent to that prior sender is discharged to the same extent
Translation: 7 承担向其发款方退款义务的银行，若直接向该发款方的前手退款，即可在其退款金额的范围内解除该义务。该前手之后的任何银行亦按相同程度解除责任。

Query_Text_en: 8 An originator entitled to a refund under this article may recover from any bank obligated to make a refund hereunder to the extent that the bank has not previously refunded A bank that is obligated to make a refund is discharged from that obligation to the extent that it makes the refund direct to the originator Any other bank that is obligated is discharged to the same extent
Translation: 本条款下有权获得退款的发起人，可向任何未先前进行退款的负有退款义务的银行追讨款项。任何负有退款义务的银行，若直接向发起人退还相关金额，则在该金额范围内免除其退款责任。其他负有退款义务的银行同样在此范围内免除责任。

Query_Text_en: 9 Paragraphs 7 and 8 do not apply to a bank if they would affect the bank 's rights or obligations under any agreement or any rule of a funds transfer system
Translation: 第7段和第8段不适用于某银行，如果这些条款会影响该银行根据任何协议或资金转账系统规则享有的权利或承担的义务。

Query_Text_en: 10 If the credit transfer is completed but a receiving bank executes a payment order in respect of which an effective revocation order has been or is subsequently received the receiving bank has such rights to recover from the beneficiary the amount of the credit transfer as may otherwise be provided by law
Translation: 如果信用转移已完成，但接收行执行了涉及已生效或后续收到的撤销指令的支付指令，则接收行有权向受益人追回信用转移金额，该权利应依法律规定确定。

Query_Text_en: 11 The death insolvency bankruptcy or incapacity of either the sender or the originator does not of itself operate to revoke a payment order or terminate the authority of the sender
Translation: 发送方或发起方的死亡、无力偿债、破产或无行为能力本身并不因此自动导致支付指令被撤销或终止发送方的授权。

Query_Text_en: 12 The principles contained in this article apply to an amendment of a payment order
Translation: 本条文中包含的原则适用于支付令的修改。

Query_Text_en: 13 For the purposes of this article branches and separate offices of a bank even if located in the same State axe separate banks
Translation: 就本条而言，银行的分支机构及独立营业机构，即使位于同一国家，也视为独立银行。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 AssistanceUntil the credit transfer is completed each receiving bank is requested to assist the originator and each subsequent sending bank and to seek the assistance of the next receiving bank in completing the banking procedures of the credit transfer
Translation:
第十三条 协助义务  
在信用证转账完成前，各接收行应协助开证申请人及后续转递行，并请求下一接收行协助完成相关银行手续。

Query_Text_en: 1 If the credit transfer is not completed the originator 's bank is obligated to refund to the originator any payment received from it with interest from the day of payment to the day of refund The originator 's bank and each subsequent receiving bank is entitled to the return of any funds it has paid to its receiving bank with interest from the day of payment to the day of refund
Translation: 如果信贷转账未完成，发起方的银行有义务向发起方退还其收到的任何款项，并加付自付款日起至退款日止的利息。发起方的银行以及后续每个接收银行均有权要求其支付给接收银行的资金予以返还，并加付自付款日起至退款日止的利息。

Query_Text_en: 2 The provisions of paragraph 1 may not be varied by agreement except when a prudent originator 's bank would not have otherwise accepted a particular payment order because of a significant risk involved in the credit transfer
Translation: 本条第一款的规定不得通过协议变更，除非审慎的发起行因信贷转移中存在重大风险而原本不会接受某项特定支付指令。

Query_Text_en: 3 A receiving bank is not required to make a refund under paragraph 1 if it is unable to obtain a refund because an intermediary bank through which it was directed to effect the credit transfer has suspended payment or is prevented by law from making the refund A receiving bank is not considered to have been directed to use the intermediary bank unless the receiving bank proves that it does not systematically seek such directing in similar cases The sender that fnst specified the use of that intermediary bank has the right to obtain the refund from the intermediary bank
Translation: 如果收汇行根据第1段无法办理退款，且该未能力退款系因所指定用于执行信用转账的中间银行已暂停支付或被法律禁止进行退款，则收汇行无义务进行退款。除非收汇行能证明其在类似案例中并未系统性地寻求此类指定，否则不得视为该行曾被指示使用该中间银行。最初指定使用该中间银行的汇款人有权向该中间行要求退款。

Query_Text_en: 4 A bank that is obligated to make a refund to its sender is discharged from that obligation to the extent that it makes the refund direct to a prior sender Any bank subsequent to that prior sender is discharged to the same extent
Translation: 第四条，任何有义务向其汇款人退款的银行，若直接向此前的汇款人作出退款，则相应范围内免除该项义务。位于该前手汇款人之后的任何银行，亦可免除相同范围的义务。

Query_Text_en: 5 An originator entitled to a refund under this article may recover from any bank obligated to make a refund hereunder to the extent that the bank has not previously refunded A bank that is obligated to make a refund is discharged from that obligation to the extent that is makes the refund direct to the originator Any other bank that is obligated is discharged to the same extent
Translation: 根据本条规定有权获得退款的开证人，可向任何负有退款义务的银行追索应得退款，前提是该银行此前尚未完成退款。任何负有退款义务的银行，若已直接将退款支付给开证人，则在其已退款的范围内免除该退款义务。其他任何负有退款义务的银行在其相同退款范围内亦相应免除义务。

Query_Text_en: 6 Paragraphs 4 and 5 do not apply to a bank if they would affect the bank 's rights or obligations under any agreement or any rule of a funds transfer system
Translation: 如果本文件第四款和第五款的规定会影响某银行在任何协议或资金转账系统规则下的权利或义务，则这些条款不适用于该银行。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 Correction of underpaymentIf the amount of the payment order executed by a receiving bank is less than the amount of the payment order it accepted other than as a result of the deduction of its charges it is obligated to issue a payment order for the difference
Translation:
第十五条 少付补正  
如果接收行执行的支付指令金额少于其接受的支付指令金额，且该差额并非由于扣除其费用所致，则其有义务签发补足差额的支付指令。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Restitution of overpaymentIf the credit transfer is completed but the amount of the payment order executed by a receiving bank is greater than the amount of the payment order it accepted it has such rights to recover the difference from the beneficiary as may otherwise be provided by law
Translation:
第十六条 超额支付的返还  
若信用转账已完成，但接收银行实际执行的支付金额超过其接受的金额，则该接收银行有权根据法律的其他相关规定要求受益人返还差额部分。

Query_Text_en: 1 A receiving bank that does not comply with its obligations under article 8 2 is liable to the beneficiary if the credit transfer is completed The liability of the receiving bank is to pay interest on the amount of the payment order for the period of delay caused by the receiving bank 's non compliance If the delay concerns only part of the amount of the payment order the liability shall be to pay interest on the amount that has been delayed
Translation: 根据第八条第二款未履行其义务的接收银行，若信贷转账已完成，则需对受益人承担责任。接收银行的责任是就支付命令的金额，支付因自身不合规行为导致延误期间的利息。若延误仅涉及支付命令金额的一部分，则仅需就该被延误的金额支付利息。

Query_Text_en: 2 The liability of a receiving bank under paragraph 1 may be discharged by payment to its receiving bank or by direct payment to the beneficiary If a receiving bank receives such payment but is not the beneficiary the receiving bank shall pass on the benefit of the interest to the next receiving bank or if it is the beneficiary 's bank to the beneficiary
Translation: 第二条 接收行根据第一条规定应承担的责任可通过向其接收行付款或直接向受益人支付来解除。如果接收行收到此类付款但并非受益人，该接收行应将利息的权益转交给下一接收行，或若其是受益人的银行，则应转交给受益人。

Query_Text_en: 3 An originator may recover the interest the beneficiary would have been entitled to but did not receive in accordance with paragraphs 1 and 2 to the extent the originator has paid interest to the beneficiary on account of a delay in the completion of the credit transfer The originator 's bank and each subsequent receiving bank that is not the bank liable under paragraph 1 may recover interest paid to its sender from its receiving bank or from the bank liable under paragraph 1
Translation: 发起人有权在其已因信贷转账完成延迟而向受益人支付利息的范围内，收回受益人本应根据第1款和第2款获得却未实际收到的利息。发起人的银行以及后续各接收银行（不包括根据第1款应承担责任的银行），可向其对应的下一接收银行或根据第1款应承担责任的银行追偿已支付给其发送方的利息。

Query_Text_en: 4 A receiving bank that does not give a notice required under article 8 4 or 5 shall pay interest to the sender on any payment that it has received from the sender under article 5 6 for the period during which it retains the payment
Translation: 未按规定发出第八条第四款或第五款所要求通知的接收行，应当对其根据第五条第六款从汇款人处收到的任何支付款项，在其保留该笔款项期间向汇款人支付利息。

Query_Text_en: 5 A beneficiary 's bank that does not give a notice required under article 10 2 3 or 4 shall pay interest to the sender on any payment that it has received from the sender under article 5 6 from the day of payment until the day that it provides the required notice
Translation: 根据《跟单信用证统一惯例》（UCP600）相关规定，受益人开户行若未按第10条第2款第3或4项要求发出必要通知，则应自收到款项之日起至其提交所需通知之日止，就其依据第5条第6款从汇款人处收到的任何款项，向汇款人支付利息。

Query_Text_en: 6 The beneficiary 's bank is liable to the beneficiary to the extent provided by the law governing the relationship between the beneficiary and the bank for its failure to perform one of the obligations under article 10 1 or 5
Translation: 在受益人与银行关系受相关法律调整的范围内，若受益人银行未能履行第10条第1款或第5款规定的义务，则该银行应向受益人承担相应责任。

Query_Text_en: 7 the provisions of this article may be varied by agreement to the extent that the liability of one bank to another bank is increased or reduced Such an agreement to reduce liability may be contained in a bank 's standard terms of dealing A bank may agree to increase its liability to an originator or beneficiary that is not a bank but may not reduce its liability to such an originator or beneficiary In particular it may not reduce its liability by an agreement fixing the rate of interest
Translation: 本条的规定可根据协议进行调整，但仅限于影响一家银行对另一家银行的责任增减的情况。减少责任的此类协议可包含在银行的标准交易条款中。银行可同意增加其对非银行发起人或受益人的责任，但不得降低此类发起人或受益人的责任。尤其不得通过固定利率的约定来降低责任。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 Exclusivity of remediesThe remedies in article 17 shall be exclusive and no other remedy arising out of other doctrines of law shall be available in respect of non compliance with articles 8 or 10 except any remedy that may exist when a bank has improperly executed or failed to execute a payment order a with the specific intent to cause loss or b recklessly and with actual knowledge that loss would be likely to result
Translation: 第十八条 救济措施的排他性第十七条规定的救济措施应具有排他性，对于未遵守第八条或第十条的情形，不得以其他法律原则为基础主张其他救济措施，但以下情形除外：当银行因特定意图造成损失而不当执行或未执行支付命令（a），或因鲁莽行事且明知可能导致损失而发生不当执行或未执行支付命令（b）时，现有救济措施仍可适用。

Query_Text_en: If a credit transfer was for the purpose of discharging an obligation of the originator to the beneficiary that can be discharged by credit transfer to the account indicated by the originator the obligation is discharged when the beneficiary 's bank accepts the payment order and to the extent that it would be discharged by payment of the same amount in cash
Translation: 当信用转账旨在履行发起人对受益人的可通过向发起人指定账户进行信用转账方式解除的义务时，该义务在受益人银行接受支付指令时即视为履行，且履行的范围应与以相同金额现金支付时的履行范围一致。

Query_Text_en: 1 A credit transfer is completed when the beneficiary 's bank accepts a payment order for the benefit of the beneficiary When the credit transfer is completed the beneficiary 's bank becomes indebted to the beneficiary to the extent of the payment order accepted by it Completion does not otherwise affect the relationship between the beneficiary and the beneficiary 's bank
Translation: 信用转账完成之时即为受益人银行接受该笔支付指令以使受益人受益之时。当信用转账完成后，受益人银行将在其接受的支付指令范围内对受益人承担支付义务。完成信用转账本身不会影响受益人与其银行之间的既有关系。

Query_Text_en: 2 A credit transfer is completed notwithstanding that the amount of the payment order accepted by the beneficiary 's bank is less than the amount of the originator 's payment order because one or more receiving banks have deducted charges The completion of the credit transfer shall not prejudice any right of the beneficiary under the applicable law governing the underlying obligation to recover the amount of those charges from the originator
Translation: 即使受益人银行接受的付款指令金额少于原付款人的付款指令金额，但信贷转账仍因有一家或多家接收银行扣除费用而完成。信贷转账的完成不应损及受益人根据适用于基础义务的相关法律追讨这些费用金额的权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 Powers of arrest1 A ship may be arrested or released from arrest only under the authority of a Court of the State Party in which the arrest is effected2 A ship may only be arrested in respect of a maritime claim but in respect of no other claim3 A ship may be arrested for the purpose of obtaining security notwithstanding thatby virtue of a jurisdiction clause or arbitration clause in any relevant contractor otherwisethe maritime claim in respect of which the arrest is effected is to be adjudicated in a State other than the State where the arrest is effectedor is to be arbitratedor is to be adjudicated subject to the law of another State4 Subject to the provisions of this Conventionthe procedure relating to the arrest of a ship or its release shall be governed by the law of the State in which the arrest was effected or applied for
Translation:
第二条 扣押权  
1. 船舶的扣押或释放仅可在实施扣押的缔约国法院授权下进行。  
2. 船舶仅可因海事请求被扣押，不得因其他请求扣押。  
3. 为获取担保目的可扣押船舶，即使根据相关合同中的管辖条款或仲裁条款，或以其他方式，该扣押所针对的海事请求应由扣押实施地以外的另一国审理，或应通过仲裁解决，或应依另一国法律审理。  
4. 除本公约另有规定外，有关船舶扣押或释放的程序应适用扣押实施地或申请地所在国的法律。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 Release from arrest1 A ship which has been arrested shall be released when sufficient security has been provided in a satisfactory formsave in cases in which a ship has been arrested in respect of any of the maritime claims enumerated in article 1paragraphs 1 s and tIn such casesthe Court may permit the person in possession of the ship to continue trading the shipupon such person providing sufficient securityor may otherwise deal with the operation of the ship during the period of the arrest2 In the absence of agreement between the parties as to the sufficiency and form of the securitythe Court shall determine its nature and the amount thereofnot exceeding the value of the arrested ship
Translation: 被扣押的船舶获释条款  1. 当以可接受的形式提供了充分担保时，被扣押的船舶应当获释。     但若船舶因《海事请求》第1条第（s）或（t）项所列的海事请求而被扣押，则法院可允许该船舶的持有者在提供充分担保后继续营运该船舶，或可在扣押期间以其他方式处理船舶的运营。  2. 若当事人就担保的充分性及形式未达成一致，法院应确定担保的性质及金额，但金额不得超过被扣押船舶的价值。

Query_Text_en: 3 Any request for the ship to be released upon security being provided shall not be construed as an acknowledgement of liability nor as a waiver of any defense or any right to limit liability
Translation: 任何要求在提供担保后释放船舶的请求，均不应视为对责任的承认，也不应视为放弃任何抗辩权或限制责任的权利。

Query_Text_en: 4 If a ship has been arrested in a non party State and is not released although security in respect of that ship has been provided in a State Party in respect of the same claimthat security shall be ordered to be released on application to the Court in the State Party
Translation: 如果一艘船舶在非缔约国被扣押，且尽管就同一索赔事项已在缔约国提供了担保却仍未获释，经缔约国法院申请，该担保应被责令释放。

Translation:
第七条 案件实体管辖权  
1. 在船舶被扣押或为释放船舶提供担保的缔约国领土内设立的法院，对该案件享有实体管辖权，除非当事人已有效达成协议或先前有效协议约定将争议提交另一接受管辖的缔约国法院，或提交仲裁。  
2. 尽管有本条第1款规定，在以下情形下，在船舶被扣押或为释放船舶提供担保的缔约国领土内设立的法院可拒绝行使该管辖权：该国法律允许此种拒绝，且另一缔约国法院已接受管辖。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Application1 This Convention shall apply to any ship within the jurisdiction of any State Partywhether or not that ship is flying the flag of a State Party
Translation:
第八条 适用范围  
本公约应适用于任何缔约国管辖范围内的船舶，无论该船只是否悬挂某一缔约国的国旗。

Query_Text_en: 2 This Convention shall not apply to any warshipnaval auxiliary or other ships owned or operated by a State and usedfor the time beingonly on government non commercial service
Translation: 本公约不适用于任何国家所有或运营的军舰、海军辅助舰船或其他目前仅用于政府非商业服务的船舶。

Query_Text_en: 3 This Convention does not affect any rights or powers vested in any Government or its departmentsor in any public authorityor in any dock or harbor authorityunder any international convention or under any domestic law or regulationto detain or otherwise prevent from sailing any ship within their jurisdiction
Translation: 本公约不影响任何政府、其部门、任何公共机构或任何码头或港口当局根据任何国际公约或国内法律、法规所享有的权利或权力，即在其管辖范围内扣留或以其他方式阻止任何船只航行。

Query_Text_en: 4 This Convention shall not affect the power of any State or Court to make orders affecting the totality of a debtor 's assets
Translation: 本公约不得影响任何国家或法院作出涉及债务人全部资产命令的权力。

Query_Text_en: 5 Nothing in this Convention shall affect the application of international conventions providing for limitation of liabilityor domestic law giving effect theretoin the State where an arrest is effected
Translation: 本公约的任何规定均不影响在扣押行为实施的国家内，有关责任限制的国际公约的适用，或国内法据此制定的法律的适用。

Query_Text_en: 6 Nothing in this Convention shall modify or affect the rules of law in force in the States Parties relating to the arrest of any ship physically within the jurisdiction of the State of its flag procured by a person whose habitual residence or principal place of business is in that Stateor by any other person who has acquired a claim from such person by subrogationassignment or otherwise
Translation: 本公约的任何规定均不得影响或改变缔约国现行的法律规则，包括涉及船旗国管辖范围内实际存在的任何船舶的扣押事宜，无论该扣押系由在该国有惯常居所或主要营业地的人所进行，或由通过代位、转让或其他方式从上述人处取得请求权的其他人所进行。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 Non creation of maritime liensNothing in this Convention shall be construed as creating a maritime lien
Translation:
第九条 不创设船舶优先权  
本公约的任何规定均不得解释为创设船舶优先权。

第十一款 保管人  
本公约应交存于联合国秘书长。

2. 各国可通过以下方式表示接受本公约约束：

Query_Text_en: Article 13 States with more than one system of law1 If a State has two or more territorial units in which different systems of law are applicable in relation to matters dealt with in this Conventionit may at the time of signatureratificationacceptanceapproval or accession declare that this Convention shall extend to all its territorial units or only to one or more of them and may modify this declaration by submitting another declaration at any time2 Any such declaration shall be notified to the depositary and shall state expressly the territorial units to which the Convention applies3 In relation to a State Party which has two or more systems of law with regard to arrest of ships applicable in different territorial unitsreferences in this Convention to the Court of a State and the law of a State shall be respectively construed as referring to the Court of the relevant territorial unit within that State and the law of the relevant territorial unit of that State
Translation:
**第十三条 法律体系的适用**  
1. 若一国有两个或多个领土单位，且涉及本公约所规定事项的法律体系在这些单位内适用不同，则该国可在签署、批准、接受、核准或加入时声明本公约适用于其所有领土单位或仅适用于其中一或数个，并可通过随时提交另一项声明修改此项声明。  
2. 任何此类声明均应通知保存国，并明确列明本公约适用的领土单位。  
3. 对于在不同领土单位内有关船舶扣押适用不同法律体系的公约缔约国，本公约中提及“一国法院”及“一国法律”的内容，应分别解释为指该国相关领土单位的法院及该国相关领土单位的法律。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 Entry into force1 This Convention shall enter into force six months following the date on which 10 States have expressed their consent to be bound by it2 For a State which expresses its consent to be bound by this Convention after the conditions for entry into force thereof have been metsuch consent shall take effect three months after the date of expression of such consent
Translation:
第十四条 生效  
第一款 本公约应于第十份表示同意受其约束之文书交存后第六个月开始生效。  
第二款 对于在本公约生效条件满足后表示同意受其约束的国家，其同意应于表示同意之日起满三个月后生效。
