Query_Text_en: Article 15 Revision and amendment1 A conference of States Parties for the purpose of revising or amending this Convention shall be convened by the Secretary General of the United Nations at the request of one third of the States Parties2 Any consent to be bound by this Conventionexpressed after the date of entry into force of an amendment to this Conventionshall be deemed to apply to the Conventionas amended
Translation:
第十五条 修订与修正  
1. 应缔约国三分之一之请求，联合国秘书长应召开缔约国会议，以修订或修正本公约。  
2. 本公约修正案生效日期之后表示同意受本公约约束者，应视为适用于经修正的本公约。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Denunciation1 This Convention may be denounced by any State Party at any time after the date on which this Convention enters into force for that State2 Denunciation shall be effected by deposit of an instrument of denunciation with the depositary3 A denunciation shall take effect one yearor such longer period as may be specified in the instrument of denunciationafter the receipt of the instrument of denunciation by the depositary
Translation:
第十六条 退出  
一、本公约对其生效之日起，任何缔约国可随时退出本公约。  
二、退出应通过向保存国提交退出通知书的方式办理。  
三、退出自保存国收到退出通知书之日起经过一年或通知书上指明的更长期限后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 LanguagesThis Convention is established in a single original in the ArabicChineseEnglishFrenchRussian and Spanish languageseach text being equally authenticDONE AT Geneva this twelfth day of Marchone thousand nine hundred and ninety nineIN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned being duly authorized by their respective Governments for that purpose have signed this Convention
Translation: 本公约以阿拉伯文、中文、英文、法文、俄文和西班牙文写成，各文本具有同等效力。  于1999年3月12日在日内瓦缔结。  为此，下列各署名经其所属政府正式授权，特签署本公约。

Query_Text_en: `` invasive '' means the puncture or incision of the skin or insertion of an instrument or foreign material into the body or the examination of a body cavity .
Translation: “侵入性”指穿刺或切开皮肤、向体内插入器械或异物，或对体腔进行检查的行为。

Query_Text_en: `` WHO IHR Contact Point '' means the unit within WHO which shall be accessible at all times for communications with the National IHR Focal Point .
2 . Unless otherwise specified or determined by the context , reference to these Regulations includes the annexes thereto .
Translation: 除非另有规定或依上下文另有界定，提及本规定时，均包括其附件。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 ? ? Purpose and scopeThe purpose and scope of these Regulations are to prevent , protect against , control and provide a public health response to the international spread of disease in ways that are commensurate with and restricted to public health risks , and which avoid unnecessary interference with international traffic and trade .
Translation: 第二条 目的和适用范围  本条例的目的和适用范围是以与公共卫生风险相称并限于公共卫生风险为前提，通过预防、防范、控制以及作出公共卫生应对措施，防止疾病国际传播，并避免对国际交通和贸易造成不必要的干扰。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 ? Principles1 . The implementation of these Regulations shall be with full respect for the dignity , human rights and fundamental freedoms of persons .
Translation: 第一款 ? 本条例的实施应充分尊重个人的尊严、人权及基本自由。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The implementation of these Regulations shall be guided by the Charter of the United Nations and the Constitution of the World Health Organization .
Translation: 本条例的实施应以《联合国宪章》和《世界卫生组织组织法》为指导。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The implementation of these Regulations shall be guided by the goal of their universal application for the protection of all people of the world from the international spread of disease .
Translation: 本条例的实施应以保护全球各国人民免受传染病国际传播之危害为目标，以实现其普遍适用。

Query_Text_en: 4 . States have , in accordance with the Charter of the United Nations and the principles of international law , the sovereign right to legislate and to implement legislation in pursuance of their health policies .
Translation: 各国根据《联合国宪章》和国际法原则，拥有为推进其卫生政策而制定和实施法律法规的主权权利。

Query_Text_en: In doing so they should uphold the purpose of these Regulations .
Translation: 在执行过程中，他们应维护这些规定的宗旨。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 Responsible authorities1 . Each State Party shall designate or establish a National IHR Focal Point and the authorities responsible within its respective jurisdiction for the implementation of health measures under these Regulations .
Translation:
第四条 负责机构  
1. 各缔约国应指定或设立国家卫生条例联络点，并在其管辖范围内确定负责实施根据本条例采取的卫生措施的机构。

Query_Text_en: 2 . National IHR Focal Points shall be accessible at all times for communications with the WHO IHR Contact Points provided for in paragraph 3 of this Article .
Translation: 国家《国际卫生条例》联系点应随时保持可联系状态，以便与本条第3款规定的世卫组织《国际卫生条例》联络点进行联络。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] disseminating information to , and consolidating input from , relevant sectors of the administration of the State Party concerned , including those responsible for surveillance and reporting , points of entry , public health services , clinics and hospitals and other government departments .
Translation: 向相关缔约国行政部门的相关部门发布信息，并汇总其意见，包括负责监测和报告、入境口岸、公共卫生服务、诊所和医院以及其他政府部门的机构。

Query_Text_en: 3 . WHO shall designate IHR Contact Points , which shall be accessible at all times for communications with National IHR Focal Points .
Translation: 3. 世界卫生组织应指定《国际卫生条例》联络点，这些联络点应随时可用，以便与国家《国际卫生条例》联络点进行沟通。

Query_Text_en: WHO IHR Contact Points shall send urgent communications concerning the implementation of these Regulations , in particular under Articles 6 to 12 , to the National IHR Focal Point of the States Parties concerned .
Translation: 世界卫生组织《国际卫生条例》联系点应将关于本条例实施情况的紧急通讯，尤其是涉及第6至12条的内容，发送至相关缔约国的国家《国际卫生条例》联络点。

Query_Text_en: WHO IHR Contact Points may be designated by WHO at the headquarters or at the regional level of the Organization .
Translation: 世界卫生组织可在其总部或区域层面指定《国际卫生条例》联络点。

Query_Text_en: 4 . States Parties shall provide WHO with contact details of their National IHR Focal Point and WHO shall provide States Parties with contact details of WHO IHR Contact Points .
Translation: 缔约国应向世卫组织提供其国家卫生条例联络点的联系方式，世卫组织应向缔约国提供其卫生条例联络点的联系方式。

Query_Text_en: These contact details shall be continuously updated and annually confirmed .
Translation: 这些联系方式应持续更新并每年确认。

Query_Text_en: WHO shall make available to all States Parties the contact details of National IHR Focal Points it receives pursuant to this Article .
Translation: 世界卫生组织应向所有缔约国提供其根据本条规定收到的国家《国际卫生条例》联络点的联系方式。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Surveillance1 . Each State Party shall develop , strengthen and maintain , as soon as possible but no later than five years from the entry into force of these Regulations for that State Party , the capacity to detect , assess , notify and report events in accordance with these Regulations , as specified in Annex 1 .
Translation:
第五条 监测  
1. 各缔约国应尽快但不得晚于本条例对该缔约国生效后五年，建立、加强并维持按照本条例规定，并参照附件一所列内容检测、评估、通报和报告事件的能力。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Following the assessment referred to in paragraph 2 , Part A of Annex 1 , a State Party may report to WHO on the basis of a justified need and an implementation plan and , in so doing , obtain an extension of two years in which to fulfil the obligation in paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 根据附件1第A部分第2款所述评估，缔约国可基于正当理由的需求和实施方案向世界卫生组织提交报告，从而申请延长两年期限以履行本条第一款规定的义务。

Query_Text_en: In exceptional circumstances , and supported by a new implementation plan , the State Party may request a further extension not exceeding two years from the Director-General , who shall make the decision , taking into account the technical advice of the Committee established under Article 50 [ hereinafter the `` Review Committee '' ] .
Translation: 在特殊情况下，并附有新的实施方案，缔约国可向总干事申请不超过两年的延期。总干事将作出决定时，需考虑根据第五十条设立的"审查委员会"提出的技术建议。

Query_Text_en: After the period mentioned in paragraph 1 of this Article , the State Party that has obtained an extension shall report annually to WHO on progress made towards the full implementation .
Translation: 在本条第一款规定的期限届满后，获得延期的缔约国应每年向世界卫生组织提交报告，说明其在全面实施方面所取得的进展。

Query_Text_en: 3 . WHO shall assist States Parties , upon request , to develop , strengthen and maintain the capacities referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 世界卫生组织应缔约国请求，协助其发展、强化和保持本条第一款所述能力。

Query_Text_en: 4 . WHO shall collect information regarding events through its surveillance activities and assess their potential to cause international disease spread and possible interference with international traffic .
Translation: 世界卫生组织应通过其监测活动收集与突发事件相关的信息，并评估这些事件可能引发国际疾病传播以及干扰国际交通的潜在风险。

Query_Text_en: Information received by WHO under this paragraph shall be handled in accordance with Articles 11 and 45 where appropriate .
Translation: 世界卫生组织根据本条款收到的信息，在适用时应按照第11条和第45条的规定进行处理。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Notification1 . Each State Party shall assess events occurring within its territory by using the decision instrument in Annex 2 .
Translation:
第六条 通知  
1. 各缔约国应使用附件二中的决策工具，对其领土内发生的情况进行评估。

Query_Text_en: Each State Party shall notify WHO , by the most efficient means of communication available , by way of the National IHR Focal Point , and within 24 hours of assessment of public health information , of all events which may constitute a public health emergency of international concern within its territory in accordance with the decision instrument , as well as any health measure implemented in response to those events .
Translation: 各缔约国应当通过国家《国际卫生条例》联络点，在评估公共卫生信息后24小时内，使用可获得的最有效通讯手段，向世界卫生组织通报在其境内依据决策工具判定的可能构成国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的所有情况，以及针对这些事件所采取的任何卫生措施。

Query_Text_en: If the notification received by WHO involves the competency of the International Atomic Energy Agency [ IAEA ] , WHO shall immediately notify the IAEA .
Translation: 如果世界卫生组织收到的通报涉及国际原子能机构的职权范围，世卫组织应立即通报国际原子能机构。

Query_Text_en: and report , when necessary , the difficulties faced and support needed in responding to the potential public health emergency of international concern .
Translation: 必要时报告在应对可能的国际关注的突发公共卫生事件过程中面临的困难和所需的支持。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 Information-sharing during unexpected or unusual public health eventsIf a State Party has evidence of an unexpected or unusual public health event within its territory , irrespective of origin or source , which may constitute a public health emergency of international concern , it shall provide to WHO all relevant public health information .
Translation:
第七条 突发或非典型公共卫生事件期间的信息共享  
缔约国若在其境内发现突发或非典型公共卫生事件的证据，无论其来源或起源，且可能构成国际关注的突发公共卫生事件，应向世界卫生组织提供所有相关公共卫生信息。

Query_Text_en: In such a case , the provisions of Article 6 shall apply in full .
Translation: 在这种情况下，本公约第六条的规定应完全适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 ConsultationIn the case of events occurring within its territory not requiring notification as provided in Article 6 , in particular those events for which there is insufficient information available to complete the decision instrument , a State Party may nevertheless keep WHO advised thereof through the National IHR Focal Point and consult with WHO on appropriate health measures .
Translation:
第八条 咨询  
对于缔约国境内发生且无需按照第六条规定进行通报的事件，尤其是因信息不足而无法完成决策工具所需评估的事件，缔约国仍可通过国家IHR联络点向世卫组织通报情况，并就适当的卫生措施进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: Such communications shall be treated in accordance with paragraphs 2 to 4 of Article 11 .
Translation: 此类通信应依照第11条第2款至第4款的规定进行处理。

Query_Text_en: The State Party in whose territory the event has occurred may request WHO assistance to assess any epidemiological evidence obtained by that State Party .
Translation: 发生事件的缔约国可要求世卫组织协助评估该缔约国所获取的任何流行病学证据。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 Other reports1 . WHO may take into account reports from sources other than notifications or consultations and shall assess these reports according to established epidemiological principles and then communicate information on the event to the State Party in whose territory the event is allegedly occurring .
Translation:
第九条 其他报告  
世界卫生组织可考虑非正式通知或磋商以外来源的报告，并应根据既定流行病学原则评估此类报告，随后将有关事件的信息通报给据称发生该事件的缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Before taking any action based on such reports , WHO shall consult with and attempt to obtain verification from the State Party in whose territory the event is allegedly occurring in accordance with the procedure set forth in Article 10 .
Translation: 在根据此类报告采取任何行动之前，世卫组织应按照《条例》第10条规定的程序，与该事件据称正在其领土内发生的缔约国进行协商并力求获取核实。

Query_Text_en: To this end , WHO shall make the information received available to the States Parties and only where it is duly justified may WHO maintain the confidentiality of the source .
Translation: 世界卫生组织应当向缔约国提供所收到的信息，仅在确有正当理由的情况下，方可保留信息来源的保密性。

Query_Text_en: This information will be used in accordance with the procedure set forth in Article 11 .
Translation: 本信息将按照第十一条规定所述程序使用。

Query_Text_en: or [ c ] goods that are contaminated .
Translation: 或[c]受污染的货物。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 Verification1 . WHO shall request , in accordance with Article 9 , verification from a State Party of reports from sources other than notifications or consultations of events which may constitute a public health emergency of international concern allegedly occurring in the State 's territory .
Translation:
第十条 核实  
1. 世卫组织应根据第九条，要求某一缔约国对其领土内据称发生的、可能构成国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的非通过通报或磋商途径获得的报告进行核实。

Query_Text_en: In such cases , WHO shall inform the State Party concerned regarding the reports it is seeking to verify .
Translation: 在这种情况下，世界卫生组织应就其拟核实的报告通知相关缔约国。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] information to WHO in the context of an assessment under Article 6 , including relevant information as described in that Article .
Translation: 并在第六条规定的评估框架下向世卫组织提供[ c ]类信息，包括该条款所述的相关信息。

Query_Text_en: 3 . When WHO receives information of an event that may constitute a public health emergency of international concern , it shall offer to collaborate with the State Party concerned in assessing the potential for international disease spread , possible interference with international traffic and the adequacy of control measures .
Translation: 当世卫组织收到可能构成国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的信息时，应主动提供协助与相关缔约国共同评估疾病国际传播的可能性、可能对国际交通造成的干扰以及防控措施的有效性。

Query_Text_en: Such activities may include collaboration with other standard-setting organizations and the offer to mobilize international assistance in order to support the national authorities in conducting and coordinating on-site assessments .
Translation: 此类活动可能包括与其他标准制定机构开展合作，并提议调动国际援助，以支持国家当局开展并协调现场评估工作。

Query_Text_en: When requested by the State Party , WHO shall provide information supporting such an offer .
Translation: 应缔约国请求，世卫组织应提供支持该提议的相关信息。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If the State Party does not accept the offer of collaboration , WHO may , when justified by the magnitude of the public health risk , share with other States Parties the information available to it , whilst encouraging the State Party to accept the offer of collaboration by WHO , taking into account the views of the State Party concerned .
Translation: 如缔约国不接受合作提议，世卫组织可根据公共卫生风险的严重性判断，在考虑相关缔约国意见的前提下，与其他缔约国分享其掌握的相关信息，同时鼓励该缔约国接受世卫组织提供的合作提议。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 Provision of information by WHO1 . Subject to paragraph 2 of this Article , WHO shall send to all States Parties and , as appropriate , to relevant intergovernmental organizations , as soon as possible and by the most efficient means available , in confidence , such public health information which it has received under Articles 5 to 10 inclusive and which is necessary to enable States Parties to respond to a public health risk .
Translation:
第十一条规定世界卫生组织提供信息  
1. 本条第二款另有规定除外，世界卫生组织应向所有缔约国以及适当时向相关政府间组织，尽快通过最有效的方式保密地发送其根据本公约第五条至第十条所收到的、为使缔约国能够对公共卫生风险作出反应所必需的公共卫生信息。

Query_Text_en: WHO should communicate information to other States Parties that might help them in preventing the occurrence of similar incidents .
Translation: 世卫组织应向其他缔约国提供可能有助于其防止类似事件发生的信息。

Query_Text_en: or [ d ] the nature and scope of the international movement of travellers , baggage , cargo , containers , conveyances , goods or postal parcels that may be affected by the infection or contamination requires the immediate application of international control measures .
Translation: 旅行者、行李、货物、集装箱、交通工具、物品或邮包的国际流动的性质和范围，若可能受到感染或污染影响，则需立即采取国际卫生控制措施。

Query_Text_en: 3 . WHO shall consult with the State Party in whose territory the event is occurring as to its intent to make information available under this Article .
Translation: 世界卫生组织应就其根据本条提供相关信息的意向，与事件发生领土所在缔约国进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: 4 . When information received by WHO under paragraph 2 of this Article is made available to States Parties in accordance with these Regulations , WHO may also make it available to the public if other information about the same event has already become publicly available and there is a need for the dissemination of authoritative and independent information .
Translation: 根据本条第2款收到的信息按照本条例提供给缔约国时，如果同一事件的其他信息已公开且需要传播权威和独立的信息，世界卫生组织也可将其公开。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 ? Determination of a public health emergency of international concern1 . The Director-General shall determine , on the basis of the information received , in particular from the State Party within whose territory an event is occurring , whether an event constitutes a public health emergency of international concern in accordance with the criteria and the procedure set out in these Regulations .
Translation: 第12条 国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的认定  1. 总干事应依据收到的信息，尤其是事件发生地所在缔约国提供的信息，按照本条例规定的标准和程序，确定某一事件是否构成国际关注的突发公共卫生事件。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If the Director-General considers , based on an assessment under these Regulations , that a public health emergency of international concern is occurring , the Director-General shall consult with the State Party in whose territory the event arises regarding this preliminary determination .
Translation: 如果总干事根据本条例进行评估后认为发生国际关注的突发公共卫生事件，总干事应当就该初步判定与事件发生地所在缔约国进行磋商。

Query_Text_en: If the Director-General and the State Party are in agreement regarding this determination , the Director-General shall , in accordance with the procedure set forth in Article 49 , seek the views of the Committee established under Article 48 [ hereinafter the `` Emergency Committee '' ] on appropriate temporary recommendations .
Translation: 如果总干事与缔约国就这一认定达成一致意见，总干事应按照第四十九条规定的程序，就适当的临时建议措施征求根据第四十八条设立的"紧急委员会"的意见。

Query_Text_en: 3 . If , following the consultation in paragraph 2 above , the Director-General and the State Party in whose territory the event arises do not come to a consensus within 48 hours on whether the event constitutes a public health emergency of international concern , a determination shall be made in accordance with the procedure set forth in Article 49 .
Translation: 如根据上述第2款进行磋商后，总干事与发生事件的缔约国在48小时内未能就该事件是否构成国际关注的突发公共卫生事件达成一致意见，则应按照第49条规定的程序作出决定。

Query_Text_en: and [ e ] an assessment of the risk to human health , of the risk of international spread of disease and of the risk of interference with international traffic .
Translation: 对人类健康危害、疾病国际传播风险以及国际交通妨碍风险的评估。

Query_Text_en: 5 . If the Director-General , following consultations with the State Party within whose territory the public health emergency of international concern has occurred , considers that a public health emergency of international concern has ended , the Director-General shall take a decision in accordance with the procedure set out in Article 49 .
Translation: 如果总干事在与发生国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的缔约国进行磋商后，认为该国际关注的突发公共卫生事件已经结束，总干事应当按照第四十九条规定的程序作出决定。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 ? ? Public health response1 . Each State Party shall develop , strengthen and maintain , as soon as possible but no later than five years from the entry into force of these Regulations for that State Party , the capacity to respond promptly and effectively to public health risks and public health emergencies of international concern as set out in Annex 1 .
Translation: 《国际卫生条例》  第十三条 ? ? ? 公共卫生应对  1. 每一缔约国应建立、加强和维持其能力，以便对附件一所述的公共卫生风险和国际关注的突发公共卫生事件作出迅速有效的应对；此能力应尽快建立，且最迟不得晚于本条例对该缔约国生效后的五年期限。

Query_Text_en: WHO shall publish , in consultation with Member States , guidelines to support States Parties in the development of public health response capacities .
Translation: 世界卫生组织应与成员国磋商后发布指南，以支持缔约国发展公共卫生应对能力。

Query_Text_en: In exceptional circumstances and supported by a new implementation plan , the State Party may request a further extension not exceeding two years from the Director-General , who shall make the decision , taking into account the technical advice of the Review Committee .
Translation: 在特殊情况下，并在新的实施计划支持下，缔约国可向总干事申请不超过两年的进一步延期，总干事将根据审查委员会的技术建议作出决定。

Query_Text_en: 3 . At the request of a State Party , WHO shall collaborate in the response to public health risks and other events by providing technical guidance and assistance and by assessing the effectiveness of the control measures in place , including the mobilization of international teams of experts for on-site assistance , when necessary .
Translation: 应缔约国请求，世卫组织应协作应对公共卫生风险及其他事件，通过提供技术指导和援助，并评估现有防控措施的有效性，必要时可协调组建国际专家团队进行现场支援。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If WHO , in consultation with the States Parties concerned as provided in Article 12 , determines that a public health emergency of international concern is occurring , it may offer , in addition to the support indicated in paragraph 3 of this Article , further assistance to the State Party , including an assessment of the severity of the international risk and the adequacy of control measures .
Translation: 如根据《条例》第12条与相关缔约国进行协商后，世卫组织认定国际关注的突发公共卫生事件正在发生，则除本条第3款所述支持外，还可向缔约国提供进一步援助，包括对国际传播风险严重程度及防控措施充分性的评估。

Query_Text_en: Such collaboration may include the offer to mobilize international assistance in order to support the national authorities in conducting and coordinating on-site assessments .
Translation: 此类协作可能包括提供调动国际援助的提议，以支持国家当局开展并协调现场评估工作。

Query_Text_en: 5 . When requested by WHO , States Parties should provide , to the extent possible , support to WHO-coordinated response activities .
Translation: 应世界卫生组织请求，缔约国应在能力范围内为其协调的应对行动提供支持。

Query_Text_en: 6 . When requested , WHO shall provide appropriate guidance and assistance to other States Parties affected or threatened by the public health emergency of international concern .
Translation: 应要求，世卫组织应向受国际关注的突发公共卫生事件影响或面临威胁的其他缔约国提供相应的指导和援助。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 ? ? Cooperation of WHO with intergovernmental organizations and international bodies1 . WHO shall cooperate and coordinate its activities , as appropriate , with other competent intergovernmental organizations or international bodies in the implementation of these Regulations , including through the conclusion of agreements and other similar arrangements .
Translation: 第14条 世界卫生组织与政府间组织及国际机构的合作  1．世界卫生组织应当在实施本条例时，根据需要与其他相关政府间组织或国际机构合作并协调其活动，包括通过缔结协议或其他类似安排的方式。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In cases in which notification or verification of , or response to , an event is primarily within the competence of other intergovernmental organizations or international bodies , WHO shall coordinate its activities with such organizations or bodies in order to ensure the application of adequate measures for the protection of public health .
Translation: 在某一事件的通报、核实或应对主要属于其他政府间组织或国际机构职责的情况下，世卫组织应与这些组织或机构协调其活动，以确保采取充分措施保护公众健康。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the foregoing , nothing in these Regulations shall preclude or limit the provision by WHO of advice , support , or technical or other assistance for public health purposes .
Translation: 本条例不排除或限制世界卫生组织为公共卫生目的提供建议、支持或技术及其他援助。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 ? Temporary recommendations1 . If it has been determined in accordance with Article 12 that a public health emergency of international concern is occurring , the Director-General shall issue temporary recommendations in accordance with the procedure set out in Article 49 .
Translation: 根据第15条?临时建议1.如根据第12条判定存在国际关注的突发公共卫生事件，总干事应按照第49条规定的程序发布临时建议。

Query_Text_en: Such temporary recommendations may be modified or extended as appropriate , including after it has been determined that a public health emergency of international concern has ended , at which time other temporary recommendations may be issued as necessary for the purpose of preventing or promptly detecting its recurrence .
Translation: 此类临时建议可根据需要进行调整或延长，包括在确定国际关注的突发公共卫生事件结束后，此时可根据需要发布其他临时建议，以预防此类事件再次发生或及时发现其复发。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Temporary recommendations may include health measures to be implemented by the State Party experiencing the public health emergency of international concern , or by other States Parties , regarding persons , baggage , cargo , containers , conveyances , goods and\/or postal parcels to prevent or reduce the international spread of disease and avoid unnecessary interference with international traffic .
Translation: 2. 临时建议可能包括要求发生国际关注的突发公共卫生事件的缔约国或其它缔约国针对人员、行李、货物、集装箱、交通工具、物品及/或邮寄包裹所采取的卫生措施，以防止或减少疾病国际传播并避免对国际交通造成不必要的干扰。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Temporary recommendations may be terminated in accordance with the procedure set out in Article 49 at any time and shall automatically expire three months after their issuance .
Translation: 临时建议可随时按照第49条规定的程序终止，并自发布之日起三个月后自动失效。

Query_Text_en: They may be modified or extended for additional periods of up to three months .
Translation: 可进行修改或延长，每次延长期限最长不超过三个月。

Query_Text_en: Temporary recommendations may not continue beyond the second World Health Assembly after the determination of the public health emergency of international concern to which they relate .
Translation: 临时建议不得延续至与其相关的国际关注的突发公共卫生事件被确定后的第二届世界卫生大会之后。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 ? Standing recommendationsWHO may make standing recommendations of appropriate health measures in accordance with Article 53 for routine or periodic application .
Translation: 第16条 常设建议  世界卫生组织可根据第53条制定适当的卫生措施常设建议，用于常规或定期实施。

Query_Text_en: Such measures may be applied by States Parties regarding persons , baggage , cargo , containers , conveyances , goods and\/or postal parcels for specific , ongoing public health risks in order to prevent or reduce the international spread of disease and avoid unnecessary interference with international traffic .
Translation: 缔约国可针对人员、行李、货物、集装箱、运输工具、商品和/或邮包采取相关措施，以应对具体且持续的公共卫生风险，从而防止或减少疾病的国际传播，并避免对国际交通造成不必要的干扰。

Query_Text_en: WHO may , in accordance with Article 53 , modify or terminate such recommendations , as appropriate .
Translation: 世界卫生组织可根据《条例》第五十三条，视情况需要修改或终止相关建议措施。

Query_Text_en: and [ g ] other appropriate and specific information relevant to the event .
Translation: 以及[g]其他与事件相关的适当具体信息。

Query_Text_en: With respect to temporary recommendations , the consideration by the Director-General of subparagraphs [ e ] and [ f ] of this Article may be subject to limitations imposed by urgent circumstances .
Translation: 关于临时建议，总干事对本条第(e)和(f)项的审议可能受紧急情况所限。

Query_Text_en: and - implement exit screening and\/or restrictions on persons from affected areas .
Translation: 并对来自受疫情影响地区的人员实施出境筛查和／或限制措施。

Query_Text_en: and - refuse departure or entry .
Translation: 并拒绝离境或入境。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] furnish to WHO , as far as practicable , when requested in response to a specific potential public health risk , relevant data concerning sources of infection or contamination , including vectors and reservoirs , at its points of entry , which could result in international disease spread .
Translation: 缔约国应在可行范围内，在应对此类潜在公共卫生风险时应世界卫生组织要求，向其提供入境口岸感染或污染源相关数据，包括病媒和储存宿主等信息，此类信息可能导致国际疾病传播。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 ? Airports and ports1 . States Parties shall designate the airports and ports that shall develop the capacities provided in Annex 1 .
Translation: 第二十条 航空港和港口1. 缔约各国应指定需根据附件一发展相关能力的机场和港口。

Query_Text_en: 2 . States Parties shall ensure that Ship Sanitation Control Exemption Certificates and Ship Sanitation Control Certificates are issued in accordance with the requirements in Article 39 and the model provided in Annex 3 .
Translation: 2. 缔约国应确保船舶卫生控制豁免证书和船舶卫生控制证书的签发符合第39条的要求以及附件3中规定的格式。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] extension of the Ship Sanitation Control Exemption Certificate for a period of one month until the arrival of the ship in the port at which the Certificate may be received .
Translation: 并将船舶卫生控制免验证书的延期期限设定为一个月，直至船舶抵达可接收该证书的港口。

Query_Text_en: Each State Party shall inform WHO of any changes which may occur to the status of the listed ports .
Translation: 每一缔约国应立即将所列口岸状态发生的变化通知世卫组织。

Query_Text_en: WHO shall publish the information received under this paragraph .
Translation: 世界卫生组织应公布根据本款规定收到的信息。

Query_Text_en: 4 . WHO may , at the request of the State Party concerned , arrange to certify , after an appropriate investigation , that an airport or port in its territory meets the requirements referred to in paragraphs 1 and 3 of this Article .
Translation: 4. 世卫组织应有关缔约国的请求，在进行适当调查后，可安排确认该缔约国境内的机场或港口符合本条第1款和第3款规定的要求。

Query_Text_en: These certifications may be subject to periodic review by WHO , in consultation with the State Party .
Translation: 这些认证可能需由世卫组织定期审查，并经缔约方协商。

Query_Text_en: 5 . WHO , in collaboration with competent intergovernmental organizations and international bodies , shall develop and publish the certification guidelines for airports and ports under this Article .
Translation: 世界卫生组织应与相关政府间组织和国际机构合作，制定并发布本条规定的机场和港口认证指南。

Query_Text_en: WHO shall also publish a list of certified airports and ports .
Translation: 世卫组织还将公布经认证的机场和港口名单。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] the public health risks existing in areas in which the international traffic originates , or through which it passes , prior to arrival at a particular ground crossing .
Translation: （二）在抵达特定陆地边境前，国际交通始发或途经地区的公共卫生风险。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] joint designation of adjacent ground crossings for the capacities in Annex 1 in accordance with paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 根据本条第1款共同指定附件一所列通行能力对应的相邻地面口岸。

Query_Text_en: and [ i ] communicate with the National IHR Focal Point on the relevant public health measures taken pursuant to these Regulations .
Translation: 并与[我]国国家IHR联系点通报根据本条例采取的相关公共卫生措施。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Health measures recommended by WHO for travellers , baggage , cargo , containers , conveyances , goods , postal parcels and human remains arriving from an affected area may be reapplied on arrival , if there are verifiable indications and\/or evidence that the measures applied on departure from the affected area were unsuccessful .
Translation: 世界卫生组织为来自受影响地区的旅行者、行李、货物、集装箱、运输工具、邮包及灵柩建议的健康措施，可在抵达时重新实施。但需满足前提条件，即出发时实施的措施未能奏效，且需具备可验证的迹象或证据。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Disinsection , deratting , disinfection , decontamination and other sanitary procedures shall be carried out so as to avoid injury and as far as possible discomfort to persons , or damage to the environment in a way which impacts on public health , or damage to baggage , cargo , containers , conveyances , goods and postal parcels .
Translation: 灭虫、灭鼠、消毒、净化及其他卫生处理程序应以避免对人员造成伤害、尽量减少对人员的不适、防止以影响公共卫生的方式损害环境，以及避免损坏行李、货物、集装箱、运输工具、商品和邮包的方式实施。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] inspection of baggage , cargo , containers , conveyances , goods , postal parcels and human remains .
Translation: 行李、货物、集装箱、运输工具、物品、邮包及遗体的检查。

Query_Text_en: 2 . On the basis of evidence of a public health risk obtained through the measures provided in paragraph 1 of this Article , or through other means , States Parties may apply additional health measures , in accordance with these Regulations , in particular , with regard to a suspect or affected traveller , on a case-by-case basis , the least intrusive and invasive medical examination that would achieve the public health objective of preventing the international spread of disease .
Translation: 缔约国可根据本条规定所采取措施获取的公共卫生风险证据，或其他途径所获证据，在符合本条例规定，特别是针对受染嫌疑者或受染者时，可采取补充卫生措施，应遵循个案处理原则，采取干预程度最低、侵入性最小的医学检查以实现防控疾病国际传播的公共卫生目标。

Query_Text_en: 3 . No medical examination , vaccination , prophylaxis or health measure under these Regulations shall be carried out on travellers without their prior express informed consent or that of their parents or guardians , except as provided in paragraph 2 of Article 31 , and in accordance with the law and international obligations of the State Party .
Translation: 本条例规定的任何医学检查、疫苗接种、预防措施或卫生干预措施，不得在未获得旅行者本人或其父母或监护人明确书面知情同意的情况下对其实施，除非依照第三十一条第二款的规定，并须符合缔约国的法律及其国际义务。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Travellers to be vaccinated or offered prophylaxis pursuant to these Regulations , or their parents or guardians , shall be informed of any risk associated with vaccination or with non-vaccination and with the use or non-use of prophylaxis in accordance with the law and international obligations of the State Party .
Translation: 根据本条例的规定，需接种疫苗或接受预防措施的旅行者及其父母或监护人，应当依法并根据缔约国的国际义务，被告知与疫苗接种或未接种相关的风险，以及使用或不使用预防措施相关的风险。

Query_Text_en: States Parties shall inform medical practitioners of these requirements in accordance with the law of the State Party .
Translation: 缔约国应根据本国法律向医疗从业人员告知这些要求。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Any medical examination , medical procedure , vaccination or other prophylaxis which involves a risk of disease transmission shall only be performed on , or administered to , a traveller in accordance with established national or international safety guidelines and standards so as to minimize such a risk .
Translation: 涉及疾病传播风险的任何医疗检查、医疗程序、疫苗接种或其他预防措施，仅可在旅行者身上实施或使用，并须严格按照既定的国家或国际安全指南和标准操作，以最大限度降低此类风险。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] permanently keep conveyances for which they are responsible free of sources of infection or contamination , including vectors and reservoirs .
Translation: 并[ c ]应始终保持其负责的运输工具无感染或污染源，包括传播媒介和储存宿主。

Query_Text_en: The application of measures to control sources of infection or contamination may be required if evidence is found .
Translation: 如发现证据，可能需要采取控制感染源或污染源的措施。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Specific provisions pertaining to conveyances and conveyance operators under this Article are provided in Annex 4 .
Translation: 本条关于运输工具及运营者的规定详见附件4。

Query_Text_en: Specific measures applicable to conveyances and conveyance operators with regard to vector-borne diseases are provided in Annex 5 .
Translation: 涉及虫媒传染病的交通工具及其运营者应采取的具体措施详见附件五。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] a ship not coming from an affected area which passes through a maritime canal or waterway in the territory of that State Party on its way to a port in the territory of another State .
Translation: 一艘未来自受感染地区的船舶，在前往另一国家某一港口途中，经过该缔约国境内的海运运河或水道。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] an aircraft in transit at an airport within its jurisdiction , except that the aircraft may be restricted to a particular area of the airport with no embarking and disembarking or loading and discharging .
Translation: 一国在其管辖范围内的机场对过境航空器享有管辖权，但可将该航空器限制在机场特定区域，禁止上下客或装卸货物。

Query_Text_en: However , any such aircraft shall be permitted to take on , under the supervision of the competent authority , fuel , water , food and supplies .
Translation: 但是，任何此类航空器应被允许在主管部门监督下补充燃料、水、食品和物资。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 ? ? Civilian lorries , trains and coaches in transitSubject to Articles 27 and 43 or unless authorized by applicable international agreements , no health measure shall be applied to a civilian lorry , train or coach not coming from an affected area which passes through a territory without embarking , disembarking , loading or discharging .
Translation: 第二十六条 过境的民用货车、火车和客车  除非适用第二十七条和第四十三条，或经相关国际协议授权，否则对于未来自受染地区且在过境时不进行上下客或装卸货物的民用货车、火车或客车，不得采取卫生措施。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] decide in each case the technique employed to secure an adequate level of control of the public health risk as provided in these Regulations .
Translation: 并由[ b ]根据本条例规定，在每种情况下决定采用何种技术以达到对公共健康风险的适当控制水平。

Query_Text_en: Where there are methods or materials advised by WHO for these procedures , these should be employed , unless the competent authority determines that other methods are as safe and reliable .
Translation: 对于世界卫生组织建议的用于相关程序的方法或材料，应予以采用，除非主管机构认定存在其他同样安全可靠的方法。

Query_Text_en: The competent authority may implement additional health measures , including isolation of the conveyances , as necessary , to prevent the spread of disease .
Translation: 主管部门可根据需要采取包括隔离交通工具在内的额外卫生措施，以防止疾病传播。

Query_Text_en: ? b securities account means an account maintained by an intermediary to which securities may be credited or debited ;
Translation: B证券账户是指由中介机构维护的账户，可向其中记入或冲减证券。

Query_Text_en: ? c intermediary means a person that in the course of a business or other regular activity maintains securities accounts for others or both for others and for its own account and is acting in that capacity ;
Translation: 在商业活动或其他常规业务中管理他人证券账户，或同时管理他人及自身证券账户并以该身份行事的人员称为C类中介。

Query_Text_en: ? d account holder means a person in whose name an intermediary maintains a securities account ;
Translation: 账户持有人指中介以其名义维持证券账户的人。

Query_Text_en: ? e account agreement means in relation to a securities account the agreement with the relevant intermediary governing that securities account ;
Translation: 账户协议指与证券账户相关的、规范该证券账户的相关中介机构之间的协议；

Query_Text_en: ? f securities held with an intermediary means the rights of an account holder resulting from a credit of securities to a securities account ;
Translation: "通过中介机构持有的证券，是指账户持有人由于证券被记入其证券账户而享有的权利。"

Query_Text_en: ? g relevant intermediary means the intermediary that maintains the securities account for the account holder ;
Translation: 相关中介机构指为账户持有人维护证券账户的中介机构；

Query_Text_en: ? h disposition means any transfer of title whether outright or by way of security and any grant of a security interest whether possessory or non possessory ;
Translation: 本条款中，“处分”是指任何形式的产权转让（无论是直接转让还是作为担保方式），以及任何形式的担保物权设立（无论该担保物权是否为占有型）；

Query_Text_en: ? i perfection means completion of any steps necessary to render a disposition effective against persons who are not parties to that disposition ;
Translation: 完善是指完成所有必要步骤以确保该项处分对非当事人具有约束力；

Query_Text_en: ? j office means in relation to an intermediary a place of business at which any of the activities of the intermediary are carded on excluding a place of business which is intended to be merely temporary and a place of business of any person other than the intermediary ;
Translation: “J办公室”就中介而言，指中介开展任何业务活动的营业地点，但排除仅为临时性质的营业地点以及属于中介以外任何他人的营业地点。

Query_Text_en: ? k insolvency proceeding means a collective judicial or administrative proceeding including an interim proceeding in which the assets and affairs of the debtor are subject to control or supervision by a court or other competent authority for the purpose of reorganization or liquidation ;
Translation: 破产程序系指一项集体性质的司法或行政程序（包括临时程序），其中债务人的资产及事务由法院或其他有权机关置于其控制或监管之下，旨在实现债务人的重整或清算；

Query_Text_en: ? l insolvency administrator means a person authorised to administer the reorganization or liquidation including one authorised on an interim basis and includes a debtor in possession if permitted by the applicable insolvency law ;
Translation: 破产管理人是指被授权负责重整或清算的人员，包括暂定授权的人员，以及在适用的破产法允许情况下持有资产的债务人。

Query_Text_en: ? m Multi unit State means a State within which two or more territorial units of that State or both the State and one or more of its territorial units have their own rules of law in respect of any of the issues specified in Article 2 i ;
Translation: “多单位国家”系指一国境内存在两个或多个该国领土单位，或国家与其一个或多个领土单位，在《第2条i款》所述任何事项上拥有各自的法律规则。

Query_Text_en: and ? n writing and written mean a record of information including information communicated by teletransmission which is in tangible or other form and is capable of being reproduced in tangible form on a subsequent occasion
Translation: “以书面形式和书面的”（in writing and written）指信息的记录，包括通过电信传输的信息，无论其以有形形式或其他形式存在，且能够在后续场合以有形形式再现。

Query_Text_en: and ? c a lien by operation of law in favor of the account holder 's intermediary in respect of any claim arising in connection with the maintenance and operation of a securities account
Translation: 并根据法律行为，在与证券账户维护及运营相关的任何索赔事项中，账户持有者的中介方将获得留置权。

Query_Text_en: or ? b it records in its own books details of securities credited to securities accounts maintained by an intermediary in the names of other persons for whom it acts as manager or agent or otherwise in a purely administrative capacity
Translation: 或者（B）它在自己的账簿上记录证券的详细信息，这些证券被记入由中介机构在他人名下开立并维护的证券账户中。该中介机构仅为这些账户持有人提供管理人、代理人或纯粹的行政服务角色。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 Subject to paragraph 5 a person shall be regarded as an intermediary for the purposes of this Convention in relation to securities which are credited to securities accounts which it maintains in the capacity of a central securities depository or which are otherwise transferable by book entry across securities accounts which it maintains
Translation: 根据本公约的规定，除第五款另有规定外，凡涉及下列有价证券，该主体应被视为中间人：（一）该主体作为中央证券存管机构所维护的证券账户中记入的有价证券；（二）或其他可通过账面划转方式在其所维护的证券账户间转让的有价证券。

Query_Text_en: ? 5 In relation to securities which are credited to securities accounts maintained by a person in the capacity of operator of a system for the holding and transfer of such securities on records of the issuer or other records which constitute the primary record of entitlement to them as against the issuer the Contracting State under whose law those securities are constituted may at any time make a declaration that the person which operates that system shall not be an intermediary for the purposes of this Convention
Translation: 对于根据发行人在其记录中或根据构成该等证券相对于发行人之主要权益记录的其他记录设立的证券账户内所记载的证券，证券依据其法律设立的缔约国可随时声明该系统运营机构不应作为本公约项下的中介人。

Query_Text_en: and ? g whether a disposition of securities held with an intermediary extends to entitlements to dividends income or other distributions or to redemption sale or other proceeds
Translation: 证券持有中介的证券处置是否包括对股息收入或其他分配的权益，以及赎回、出售或其他所得款项？

Query_Text_en: ? 2 This Convention determines the law applicable to the issues referred to in paragraph 1 in relation to a disposition of or interest in securities held with an intermediary even where the rights resulting from the credit of those securities to a securities account are determined in accordance with paragraph 1 a to be contractual in nature
Translation: 本公约确定与通过中介持有的证券的处置或证券利益相关的、第1款所述问题所应适用的法律；即使根据第1(a)款确定该等证券记入证券账户所产生的权利具有合同性质，亦适用本公约规定。

Query_Text_en: ? c the rights and duties of an issuer of securities or of an issuer 's registrar or transfer agent whether in relation to the holder of the securities or any other person
Translation: 证券发行人或证券发行人之注册机构或过户代理人的权利与义务，无论是针对该证券之持有人还是任何其他人士。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Internationality ? This Convention apples in all cases involving a choice between the laws of different States
Translation: 第三条 国际性。本公约适用于所有涉及不同国家法律选择的案件。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 The law applicable to all the issues in Article 2 1 is the law in force in the State expressly agreed in the account agreement as the State whose law governs the account agreement or if the account agreement expressly provides that another law is applicable to all such issues that other law The law designated in accordance with this provision applies only if the relevant intermediary has at the time of the agreement an office in that State which
Translation: 账户协议第二条第1款所涉及的所有问题，应适用在账户协议中明确约定的、作为治理账户协议所属国家的法律；若账户协议明确规定另一法律适用于所有此类问题，则适用该另一法律。根据本条款指定的法律仅在相关中介机构在该国设有办公机构时方适用。

Query_Text_en: or ? d if it engages solely in representational functions or administrative functions other than those related to the opening or maintenance of securities accounts and does not have authority to make any binding decision to enter into any account agreement
Translation: 如果它仅限于执行代表职能或行政职能（而非与证券账户开立或维护有关的职能），并且无权就任何账户协议的签订做出任何具有约束力的决定，那么选d。

Query_Text_en: and ? c the securities account for the purposes of Article 5 2 and 3 is the securities account to which the securities are credited immediately prior to the disposition
Translation: 就第5条第2款和第3款而言，证券账户是指在处置行为前证券直接记入的该证券账户。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 If the applicable law is not determined under Article 4 but it is expressly and unambiguously stated in a written account agreement that the relevant intermediary entered into the account agreement through a particular office then the law applicable to all the issues specified in Article 2 1 is the law in force in the State or the territorial unit of a Multi unit State in which that office was then located provided that such office then satisfied the conditions referred to in the second sentence of Article 4 1 In determining whether an account agreement expressly and unambiguously states that the relevant intermediary entered into the account agreement through a particular office none of the following shall be considered
Translation: 根据第四条无法确定适用法律，但书面账户协议中明确且无歧义地规定，相关中介通过特定营业机构签订该账户协议的，适用于第二条第1款所列所有事宜的法律，应为该营业机构当时所在地国家或该多单元国家的领土单位内所施行的法律，但前提是该营业机构当时须满足第四条第1款第二句所提及的条件。在确定账户协议是否明确且无歧义地规定相关中介通过特定营业机构签订该协议时，以下各项均不得予以考虑。

Query_Text_en: and ? e a provision that any operation or function is to be carried on or performed by the relevant intermediary at that office
Translation: 并规定任何操作或功能均应由相关中介机构在该办公室继续进行或执行。

Query_Text_en: ? b where sub paragraph a does not apply the law in force in the State or the territorial unit of a Multi unit State in which the relevant intermediary has its place of business or if the relevant intermediary has more than one place of business its principal place of business at the time the written account agreement is entered into or if there is no such agreement at the time the securities account was opened
Translation: 当分段落a不适用于中介相关方开展业务所在州或单一制国家所属领土单位现行法律，或相关中介在书面账户协议签订时拥有多个营业场所的，则以主要营业场所为准，若无相关协议，则以证券账户开设时的情况为准。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 If in a case to which paragraph 2 a applies the relevant intermediary is incorporated or otherwise organised under the laws of a Multi unit State and not those of one of its territorial units the applicable law is the law in force in the territorial unit of that Multi unit State in which the relevantintermediary has its place of business or if the relevant intermediary has more than one place of business its principal place of business at the time the written account agreement is entered into or if there is no such agreement at the time the securities account was opened
Translation: 如果适用第2段所述情况，且相关中介根据多单元国家的法律而非其某一领土单位的法律注册成立或以其他方式组织，则适用法律应为该多单元国家中与相关中介签订书面账户协议时其营业地所在领土单位的法律（如有多个营业地则为主营业地所在领土单位的法律）。若未签订此类书面账户协议，则适用开设证券账户时相关中介营业地或主营业务所在地的领土单位法律（以同样遵循多单元国家内部营业地规则为准）。

Query_Text_en: or ? d the place where any intermediary other than the relevant intermediary is located
Translation: 除相关中介机构外的任何其他中介机构所在地的地方。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 This Article applies where an account agreement is amended so as to change the applicable law in accordance with this Convention
Translation: 本条款适用于根据本公约修改账户协议以变更适用法律的情形。

Query_Text_en: ? a the new law means the law applicable under this Convention after the change ;
Translation: "新法律"指根据本公约在变更后适用的法律；

Query_Text_en: ? b the old law means the law applicable under this Convention prior to the change
Translation: 旧法是指本公约在修改前适用的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 Subject to paragraph 4 the new law governs all the issues specified in Article 2 1
Translation: 受第4款约束，新法律规范了第2条第1款规定的所有事项。

Query_Text_en: and ? iii determination of the issues specified in Article 2 1 with respect to an insolvency administrator in an insolvency proceeding opened after the change of law ;
Translation: 关于法律变更后启动的破产程序中破产管理人第2条第1款所规定事项的确定；

Query_Text_en: and ? c priority as between parties whose interests arose before the change of law
Translation: 以及涉及在法律变更前利益已产生的各方之间的优先权，以及C优先权？

Query_Text_en: ? 5 Paragraph 4 c does not preclude the application of the new law to the priority of an interest that arose under the old law but is perfected under the new law
Translation: 第5条第4款c项并不妨碍将新法适用于在旧法下产生但根据新法完成完善的权益的优先权。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 Notwithstanding the opening of an insolvency proceeding the law applicable under this Convention governs the issues specified in Article 2 1 with respect to any event that has occurred before the opening of that insolvency proceeding
Translation: 根据本公约确定的法律，仍将管辖破产程序启动前发生之事件所涉的第2条1款规定事项，即便该破产程序已实际启动。

Query_Text_en: ? b the enforcement of rights after the opening of an insolvency proceeding
Translation: 在破产程序启动后权利的执行

Query_Text_en: Article 9 General applicability of the Convention ? This Convention applies whether or not the applicable law is that of a Contracting State
Translation: 本公约的适用，不以其所适用的法律是否为缔约国法律为条件。

Query_Text_en: ? Article 10 Exclusion of choice of law rules renvoi In this Convention the term law means the law in force in a State other than its choice of law rules
Translation: 本公约中，"法律"一词指一国国内法，但不包括其冲突法规则。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 The application of the law determined under this Convention may be refused only if the effects of its application would be manifestly contrary to the public policy of the forum
Translation: 根据本公约确定的法律的适用，仅可因其适用效果明显违反受理法院所在地公共政策而被拒绝。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 This Convention does not prevent the application of those provisions of the law of the forum which irrespective of rules of conflict of laws must be applied even to international situations
Translation: 本公约不排除适用法院地法中的那些规定，这些规定即使在不考虑冲突规范的情况下，也必须适用于国际情形。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 This Article does not permit the application of provisions of the law of the forum imposing requirements with respect to perfection or relating to priorities between competing interests unless the law of the forum is the applicable law under this Convention
Translation: 本公约不允许适用法院地法中关于完善担保权益的要求或规定 competing interests 之间优先权的相关条款，除非该法院地法是本公约所规定适用的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? b the references to that State in the second sentence of Article 4 1 are to the Multi unit State itself
Translation: 第四条第一款第二句中所提及的该国是指多单元国家本身。

Query_Text_en: ? b if the law in force in a territorial unit of a Multi unit State designates the law of another territorial unit of that State to govern perfection by public filing recording or registration the law of that other territorial unit governs that issue
Translation: 如果一个多实体国家某一领土单位现行的法律指定该国另一领土单位的法律来管辖通过公开存档、记录或注册程序完成的完善事宜，则该另一领土单位的法律应适用于该问题。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 A Multi unit State may at the time of signature ratification acceptance approval or accession make a declaration that if under Article 5 the applicable law is that of the Multi unit State or one of its territorial units the internal choice of law rules in force in that Multi unit State shall determine whether the substantive rules of law of that Multi unit State or of a particular territorial unit of that Multi unit State shall apply A Multi unit State that makes such a declaration shall communicate information concerning the content of those internal choice of law rules to the Permanent Bureau of the Hague Conference on Private International Law
Translation: 一个多法域国家可在签署、批准、接受、认可或加入时作出声明，规定若根据第五条，适用法律为该多法域国家或其某一领土单位的法律，则该多法域国家适用的内部法律选择规则将决定应适用该多法域国家的实体法规范或其特定领土单位的实体法规范。作出此类声明的多法域国家应将该内部法律选择规则的内容相关信息通报海牙国际私法会议常设局。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 A Multi unit State may at any time make a declaration that if the applicable law under Article 4 is that of one of its territorial units the law of that territorial unit only applies if the relevant intermediary has an office within that territorial unit which satisfies the requirements of the second sentence of Article 4 1 Such a declaration shall have no effect on dispositions made before that declaration becomes effective
Translation: 一个多法域国家可在任何时间发表声明，表明若第4条适用的法律为其某一领土区域的法律，则仅当相关中介方在该领土区域内设有符合第4条第一款第二句要求的营业场所时，该领土区域的法律方适用。  该声明对在声明生效前已作出的处置不产生任何效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 Uniform interpretation ? In the interpretation of this Convention regard shall be had to its international character and to the need to promote uniformity in its application
Translation: 第十三条 统一解释：在对本公约进行解释时，应顾及其国际性质，并需注意促进其适用的统一性。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 Review of practical operation of this Convention ? The Secretary General of the Hague Conference on Private International Law shall at regular intervals convene a Special Commission to review the practical operation of this Convention and to consider whether any amendments to this Convention are desirable
Translation: 第十四条 对本公约的实践操作进行审查  海牙国际私法会议的秘书长应定期召集特别委员会，对本公约的实践操作进行审查，并考虑是否有必要对本公约进行任何修订。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 Priority between pre Convention and post Convention interests ? In a Contracting State the law applicable under this Convention determines whether a person 's interest in securities held with an intermediary acquired after this Convention entered into force for that State extinguishes or has priority over another person 's interest acquired before the entry into force for that State
Translation: 公约生效后的缔约国境内，根据本公约确定的准据法将判定：因证券存管于中介机构而产生的某人权益，若该权益是在该国公约生效后取得，是否会导致他人在公约生效前所取得的权益消灭，或是否享有优先于后者之权利。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 References in this Convention to an account agreement include an account agreement entered into before this Convention entered into force in accordance with Article 19 1 References in this Convention to a securities account include a securities account opened before this Convention entered into force in accordance with Article 19 1
Translation: 1. 本公约中对账户协议的任何援引包括根据第19条本公约生效前已缔结的账户协议  2. 本公约中对证券账户的任何援引包括根据第19条本公约生效前已开立的证券账户

Query_Text_en: ? 2 Unless an account agreement contains an express reference to this Convention the courts of a Contracting State shall apply paragraphs 3 and 4 in applying Article 4 1 with respect to account agreements entered into prior to entry into force of this Convention in that State in accordance with Article 19 2 A Contracting State may at the time of signature ratification acceptance approval or accession make a declaration that its courts shall not apply those paragraphs with respect to account agreements entered into after the entry into force of this Convention in accordant with Article 19 1 but prior to the entry into force of this Convention in that State in accordance with Article 19 2 If the Contracting State is a Multi unit State it may make such a declaration with respect to any of its territorial units
Translation: 除非账户协议中明确提及本公约，否则缔约国法院在根据第四条第1款适用缔约前的账户协议时，应适用第3和第4款。缔约国可在签署、批准、接受、认可或加入时作出声明，表明其法院不适用上述条款中的账户协议。这些协议是在本公约根据第19条第1款对缔约国生效之后，但根据第19条第2款在该国生效之前缔结的。若缔约国为联邦国家，可为其任何组成领土单位作出此类声明。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 Any express terms of an account agreement which would have the effect under the rules of the State whose law governs that agreement that the law in force in a particular State or a territorial unit of a particular Multi unit State apples to any of the issues specified in Article 2 1 shall have the effect that such law governs all the issues specified in Article 2 1 provided that the relevant intermediary had at the time the agreement was entered into an office in that State which satisfied the conditions referred to in the second sentence of Article 4 1 A Contracting State may at the time of signature ratification acceptance approval or accession make a declaration that its courts shall not apply this paragraph with respect to an account agreement described in this paragraph in which the parties have expressly agreed that the securities account is maintained in a different State If the Contracting State is a Multi unit State it may make such a declaration with respect to any of its territorial units
Translation: 账户协议中的明示条款若依据该协议所适用之国家的法律规则，使特定国家或某一多辖区国家的某一辖区单位的法律适用于第2（1）条所述的任何事项，则该法律应适用于第2（1）条所列明的所有事项，前提是相关中介机构在协议签订时在该国设有满足第4（1）条第二句所规定条件的办事处。某一缔约国可在签署、批准、接受、认可或加入时作出声明，表明其法院将不适用本款的规定，但前提是该账户协议涉及的当事人已明示约定证券账户设于其他国家或地区。若缔约国属于多辖区国家，则其可针对其某一辖区单位作出此类声明。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 If the parties to an account agreement other than an agreement to which paragraph 3 applies have agreed that the securities account is maintained in a particular State or a territorial unit of a particular Multi unit State the law in force in that State or territorial unit is the law applicable to all the issues specified in Article 2 1 provided that the relevant intermediary had at the time the agreement was entered into an office in that State which satisfied the conditions referred to in the second sentence of Article 4 1 Such an agreement may be express or implied from the terms of the contract considered as a whole or from the surrounding circumstances
Translation: 如果账户协议的各方（不包括适用第3款的协议）约定该证券账户应设立于某一特定国家或某一特定多单元国家的某个领土单位，则该国家或领土单位现行的法律应适用于第2条第1款所规定的全部事项，前提是相关中介机构在协议订立时于该国家或领土单位内设有满足第4条第1款第二句所述条件的营业场所。此类协议可以是明示约定，或根据合同整体条款或相关情况推定形成。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 This Convention shall be open for signature by all States
Translation: 本公约应向所有国家开放签署。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 This Convention is subject to ratification acceptance or approval by the signatory States
Translation: 本公约须经各缔约国批准、接受或认可。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 Any State which does not sign this Convention may accede to it at any time
Translation: 任何未签署本公约的国家均可随时加入。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 The instruments of ratification acceptance approval or accession shall be deposited with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands Depositary of this Convention
Translation: 核准或加入的文书应交存于荷兰王国外交部，其为本公约之保存处。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 A Regional Economic Integration Organisation which is constituted by sovereign States and has competence over certain matters governed by this Convention may similarly sign accept approve or accede to this Convention The Regional Economic Integration Organisation shall in that case have the rights and obligations of a Contacting State to the extent that that Organisation has competence over matters governed by this Convention Where the number of Contracting States is relevant in this Convention the Regional Economic Integration Organisation shall not count as a Contracting State in addition to its Member States which are Contracting States
Translation: 区域经济一体化组织若由主权国家构成并负责管理本公约所规范的部分事项，则可同样签署、接受、批准或加入本公约。在该组织对本公约所规范事项具有管辖权的范围内，该组织应享有本公约缔约国的权利并承担相应义务。如本公约中涉及缔约国数量问题，则区域经济一体化组织不得在其作为缔约国的成员国数目之外另行计算为一个缔约国。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 The Regional Economic Integration Organisation shall at the time of signature acceptance approval or accession notify the Depositary in writing specifying the matters governed by this Convention in respect of which competence has been transferred to that Organisation by its Member States The Regional Economic Integration Organisation shall promptly notify the Depositary in writing of any changes to the distribution of competence specified in the notice in accordance with this paragraph and any new transfer of competence
Translation: 区域经济一体化组织应在签署、接受、批准或加入时，以书面形式通知保管国，明确说明其成员国已转移给该组织的、受本公约管辖的事项。区域经济一体化组织应按照本段规定，立即以书面形式通知保管国任何对其在通知中所列权限分配情况的变更，以及任何新的权限转移。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 Any reference to a Contracting State or Contracting States in this Convention applies equally to a Regional Economic Integration Organisation where the context so requires
Translation: 在本公约中对缔约国的任何提及，若相关上下文有此要求，则同样适用于区域经济一体化组织。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 This Convention shall enter into force on the first day of the month following the expiration of three months after the deposit of the third instrument of ratification acceptance approval or accession referred to in Article 17
Translation: 本公约应于交存第三份批准书、接受书、核准书或加入书三个月期满后的次月第一天生效，所涉内容见第十七条。

Query_Text_en: ? a for each State or Regional Economic Integration Organisation referred to in Article 18 subsequently ratifying accepting approving or acceding to it on the first day of the month following the expiration of three months after the deposit of its instrument of ratification acceptance approval or accession ;
Translation: 对于根据第十八条所指的每一国家或区域经济一体化组织而言，本议定书应于该国或该组织交存批准、接受、核准或加入文件后的第三个月的第一天生效。

Query_Text_en: ? b for a territorial unit to which this Convention has been extended in accordance with Article 20 1 on the first day of the month following the expiration of three months after the written notification of the declaration referred to in that Article
Translation: 对于根据第二十条第一款将本公约扩展适用的领土单位，应在该条所提声明的书面通知发出后经过三个月期满后的次月第一天。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 A Multi unit State may at the time of signature ratification acceptance approval or accession make a declaration that this Convention shall extend to all its territorial units or only to one or more of them
Translation: 一、复合制国家可在签署、批准、接受、核准或加入本公约时声明，本公约应适用于其所有领土单位，或仅适用于其中一个或多个领土单位。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 Any such declaration shall state expressly the territorial units to which this Convention applies
Translation: 任何此类声明应当明确规定本公约适用的领土单位。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 If a State makes no declaration under paragraph 1 this Convention extends to all territorial units of that State
Translation: 如果一国未根据第一款作出声明，则本公约将适用于该国所有的领土单位。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 Reservations ? No reservation to this Convention shall be permitted
Translation: 第二十一条 保留？ 不得对本公约提出任何保留。

Query_Text_en: any declaration made at a subsequent time and any new declaration shall take effect on the first day of the month following the expiration of three months after the date on which the Depositary made the notification in accordance with Article 24 ;
Translation: 嗣后作出的任何声明以及任何新的声明，应于保存国按照第二十四条的规定发出通知之日起满三个月后的次月第一日生效；

Query_Text_en: ? e a withdrawal shall take effect on the first day of the month following the expiration of six months after the date on which the Depositary made the notification in accordance with Article 24
Translation: 退出应在保管方按照第24条作出通知之日起六个月期满后的次月第一天生效。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 A Contracting State may denounce this Convention by a notification in writing addressed to the Depositary The denunciation may be limited to certain territorial units of a Multi unit State to which this Convention applies
Translation: 缔约国可通过向保存国递交书面通知的方式退出本公约。此类退出可仅针对该公约适用的某一多元成员国家内的特定领土单位。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 The denunciation shall take effect on the first day of the month following the expiration of twelve months after the date on which the notification is received by the Depositary Where a longer period for the denunciation to take effect is specified in the notification the denunciation shall take effect upon the expiration of such longer period after the date on which the notification is received by the Depositary
Translation: 退出应于保存国收到通知之日起满十二个月后的次月第一天生效。如果通知中指定了更长的生效期限，则退出应自保存国收到通知之日起满该更长期限后生效。

Query_Text_en: ? e the denunciations referred to in Article 23 ? In witness whereof the undersigned being duly authorised thereto have signed this Convention ? Done at The Hague on the day of 20 in the English and French languages both texts being equally authentic in a single copy which shall be deposited in the archives of the Government of the Kingdom of the Netherlands and of which a certified copy shall be sent through diplomatic channels to each of the States Members of the Hague Conference on Private International Law as of the date of its Nineteenth Session and to each State which participated in that Session
Translation: 根据第二十三条规定的除名通知。  兹证明下列经正式授权之人已签署本公约。  本公约于一九九六年十二月二十日在海牙签订，使用英文和法文两种文本，两种文本具有同等效力，正本一份将存档于荷兰王国政府档案处，另以认证副本通过外交渠道送达海牙国际私人法律会议第十九次会议时的各成员国以及参与该次会议的各国家。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 This Convention determines the law applicable to succession to the estates of deceased persons
Translation: 本公约确定适用于死者遗产继承的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? d property rights interests or assets created or transferred otherwise than by succession such as in joint ownership with right of survival pension plans insurance contracts or arrangements of a similar nature
Translation: 不是通过继承而创设或转移的财产权利、权益或资产，例如生存者有权的共同共有、养老金计划、保险合同以及类似性质的安排等。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 The Convention applies even if the applicable law is that of a non Contracting State
Translation: 本公约应予适用，即使相关法律为非缔约国法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 Succession is governed by the law of the State in which the deceased at the time of his death was habitually resident if he was then a national of that State
Translation: 如果死亡时的死者是该国国民，则其继承事宜应适用死者死亡时惯常居住地所在国家的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 Succession is also governed by the law of the State in which the deceased at the time of his death was habitually resident if he had been resident there for a period of no less than five years immediately preceding his death However in exceptional circumstances if at the time of his death he was manifestly more closely connected with the State of which he was then a national the law of that State applies
Translation: 继承也受死者死亡时其惯常居住地所在国法律管辖，前提是其死亡前五年期间一直在该国居住。但在例外情况下，若死者死亡时显然与其当时国籍所属国的联系更为密切，则适用该国籍国法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 In other cases succession is governed by the law of the State of which at the time of his death the deceased was a national unless at that time the deceased was more closely connected with another State in which case the law of the latter State applies
Translation: 在其他情况下，遗产继承应适用被继承人死亡时其国籍所属国家的法律，除非被继承人死亡时与另一国家存在更密切的联系，如此则适用该另一国家的法律。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 If the law applicable according to Article 3 is that of a non Contracting State and if the choice of law rules of that State designate with respect to the whole or part of the succession the law of another non Contracting State which would apply its own law the law of the latter State applies
Translation: 根据第三条确定的准据法为某一非缔约国法律时，如果该国法律冲突规则就整个或部分遗产继承事项指定应适用另一非缔约国法律，则该后一国家的法律予以适用。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 A person may designate the law of a particular State to govern the succession to the whole of his estate The designation will be effective only if at the time of the designation or of his death such person was a national of that State or had his habitual residence there
Translation: 一个人可指定其遗产继承适用某一特定国家的法律，该指定仅在其作出指定时或死亡时具有该国国籍或在该国有惯常居所的情形下方为有效。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 This designation shall be expressed in a statement made in accordance with the formal requirements for dispositions of property upon death The existence and material validity of the act of designation are governed by the law designated If under that law the designation is invalid the law governing the succession is determined under Article 3
Translation: 该指定应以符合遗产处分正式要求的声明形式作出。指定行为的存在及其实质有效性依所指定的法律判定。若根据该法律指定无效，则继承准据法的确定依第三条规定。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 The revocation of such a designation by its maker shall comply with the rules as to form applicable to the revocation of dispositions of property upon death
Translation: 此类指定的制定者撤销该指定时，应当遵守适用于撤销死后财产处置规定的相关形式要求。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 For the purposes of this Article a designation of the applicable law in the absence of an express contrary provision by the deceased is to be construed as governing succession to the whole of the estate of the deceased whether he died intestate or wholly or partially testate
Translation: 本条文中，在被继承人未明确作出相反规定的情况下，对适用法律的指定应解释为适用于其全部遗产的继承，无论被继承人是死亡时未立遗嘱、完全依遗嘱，还是部分依遗嘱。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 A person may designate the law of one or more States to govern the succession to particular assets in his estate However any such designation is without prejudice to the application of the mandatory rules of the law applicable according to Article 3 or Article 5 paragraph 1
Translation: 个人可以在其遗产范围内，指定一个或多个国家的法律来管理特定资产的继承。然而，任何此类指定均不得损害根据第三条或第五条第一款所确定的适用法律中的强制性规则的执行。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 subject to Article 6 the applicable law under Articles 3 and 5 paragraph 1 governs the whole of the estate of the deceased wherever the assets are located
Translation: 受第六条约束，根据第三条和第五条第一款规定的适用法律，管辖整个遗产，无论其资产位于何处。

Query_Text_en: ? e the material validity of testamentary dispositions
Translation: 遗嘱处分的实质有效性

Query_Text_en: ? 3 Paragraph 2 does not preclude the application in a Contracting State of the law applicable under this Convention to other matters which are considered by that State to be governed by the law of succession
Translation: 本公约第二条并不排除缔约国在涉及其他事项时依据本公约适用之法律进行适用，而这些事项被该缔约国视为应受继承法管辖的范围。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 For the purposes of this Chapter an agreement as to succession is an agreement created in writing or resulting from mutual wills which with or without consideration creates varies or terminates rights in the future estate or estates of one or more persons parties to such agreement
Translation: 本章所称继承协议，指以书面形式或基于共同遗嘱所形成的协议，无论是否支付对价，该协议旨在设立、变更或终止协议一方或多方当事人未来财产的权利。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 Where the agreement involves the estate of one person only its material validity the effects of the agreement and the circumstances resulting in the extinction of the effects are determined by the law which under Article 3 or 5 paragraph 1 would have been applicable to the succession to the estate of that person if that person had died on the date of the agreement
Translation: 当协议仅涉及某人遗产时，其实质有效性、协议的效力以及导致该效力灭失的情形，应根据第三条或第五条第一款所确定的法律来判定，即假设该人在协议订立之日去世时，本应适用于其遗产继承的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 If under that law the agreement is invalid it is nevertheless valid if it is valid under the law which at the time of death is the law applicable to the succession to the estate of that person according to Article 3 or 5 paragraph 1 The same law then governs the effects of the agreement and the circumstances resulting in the extinction of the effects
Translation: 如果根据该国法律协议无效，但如果根据该人去世时根据第三条或第五条第一款适用于其遗产继承的法律，该协议是有效的，则该协议仍然有效。同一条法则适用于该协议的影响及其效力终止的情形。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 Where the agreement involves the estates of more than one person the agreement is materially valid only if it is so valid under all the laws which according to Article 3 or 5 paragraph 1 would have governed the succession to the estates of all those persons if each such person had died on the date of the agreement
Translation: 当协议涉及多人的遗产时，该协议仅在根据第三条或第五条第一款规定应适用于各该人遗产继承的法律（假设每人均于协议订立之日去世）均承认其实质有效性的情况下，方为有效。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 The effects of the agreement and the circumstances resulting in the extinction of the effects are those recognized by all of those laws
Translation: 协议的效力以及导致该等效力灭失的情形，应为该等法律所承认。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 The parties may agree by express designation to subject the agreement so far as its material validity the effects of the agreement and the circumstances resulting in the extinction of the effects are concerned to the law of a State in which the person or any one of the persons whose future estate is involved has his habitual residence or of which he is a national at the time of the conclusion of the agreement
Translation: 第十一条 当事人可就协议的实质有效性、协议效果以及导致效果终止的情形，通过明确约定使协议受某一国法律约束。该国应为协议所涉未来财产利益相关方（或其中任何一方）在协议订立时的惯常居所所在国或其国籍国。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 The material validity of an agreement valid under the law applicable according to Article 9 10 or 11 may not be contested on the ground that the agreement would be invalid under the law applicable according to Article 3 or 5 paragraph 1
Translation: 根据依第九条、第十条或第十一条适用之法律具有实质有效性的协议，不得以该协议在依第三条或第五条第一款适用的法律下本应无效为由予以否定。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 However the application of the law applicable according to Article 9 10 or 11 shall not affect the rights of anyone not party to the agreement who under the law applicable to the succession by virtue of Article 3 or 5 paragraph 1 has an indefeasible interest in the estate or another right of which he can not be deprived by the person whose estate is in question
Translation: 然而，根据第9条、第10条或第11条所适用的法律，不应影响任何非协议当事方的权益。这些非协议当事方依据第3条或第5条第1款所确定的继承法，已对遗产享有不可剥夺的利益，或存在其他无法由遗产所属当事人剥夺的权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 Where two or more persons whose successions are governed by different laws die in circumstances in which it is uncertain in what order their deaths occurred and where those laws provide differently for this situation or make no provision at all none of the deceased persons shall have any succession rights to the other or others
Translation: 第十三条 当两个或两个以上其继承事宜受不同法律管辖的自然人在死亡顺序无法确定的情况下死亡，且相关法律对此种情况规定不同或未作规定时，各被继承人均不得相互继承。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 Where a trust is created in a disposition of property upon death the application to the succession of the law determined by the Convention does not preclude the application of another law to the trust ? Conversely the application to a trust of its governing law does not preclude the application to the succession of the law governing succession by virtue of the Convention
Translation: 1. 当财产在死亡时的处置设立信托时，根据公约确定的法律适用于遗产继承，并不妨碍其他法律适用于该信托。反之，信托适用其管辖法的事实，亦不影响遗产继承根据公约规定的继承法的适用。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 The same rules apply by analogy to foundations and corresponding institutions created by dispositions of property upon death
Translation: 相同的规则类推适用于因死亡财产处分而设立的基金会及相关机构。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 The law applicable under the Convention does not affect the application of any rules of the law of the State where certain immovables enterprises or other special categories of assets are situated which rules institute a particular inheritance regime in respect of such assets because of economic family or social considerations
Translation: 公约所适用的法律不影响位于某一缔约国境内的不动产企业或其他特殊类别资产因经济、家庭或社会因素而由该国法律规定特殊继承制度的规则的适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Where under the law applicable by virtue of the Convention there is no heir devisee or legatee under a disposition of property upon death and no physical person is an heir by operation of law the application of the law so determined does not preclude a State or an entity appointed thereto by that State from appropriating the assets of the estate that are situated in its territory
Translation: 第十六条 根据公约适用的法律，若某人死亡时其财产处分未指定继承人、受遗赠人或遗嘱受益人，且无自然人依法律规定成为继承人，则依此确定的法律适用并不妨碍该国或由该国指定的实体，有权征收位于其境内的该遗产资产。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 In this Convention and subject to Article 4 law means the law in force in a State other than its choice of law rules
Translation: 第十七条 在本公约中，并受第四条限制，"法律"一词指一国现行有效的法律，但不包括其法律选择规则。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 The application of any of the laws determined by the Convention may be refused only where such application would be manifestly incompatible with public policy ordre public
Translation: 第十八条 仅在公约确定的任何法律的适用将明显违背公共政策或公共秩序时，方可拒绝适用该法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 For the purposes of identifying the law applicable under this Convention where a State comprises two or more territorial units each of which has its own system of law or its own rules of law in respect of succession the provisions of this Article apply
Translation: 根据本公约确定法律适用之目的，如果某一国家包含两个或多个各自拥有继承法相关法律体系或法规的领土单位，则应适用本条之规定。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 If there are rules in force in such a State identifying which law among the laws of the two or more units is to apply in any circumstance for which this Article provides the law of that unit applies In the absence of such rules the following paragraphs of this Article apply
Translation: 如果该国有现行规则能够确定在本条所规定的任何情况下应适用其两个或两个以上法律单位中的哪一法律，则该法律单位的法律即适用。若该国不存在此类规则，则本条以下段落适用。

Query_Text_en: ? a the law of the State of the habitual residence of the deceased at the time of designation or of his death means the law of that unit of the State in which at the relevant time the deceased had his habitual residence ;
Translation: 死者惯常居所地法，指在指定时间或死亡时死者有惯常居所的该国的辖属区域的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? b the law of the State of the nationality of the deceased at the time of designation or of his death means the law of that unit of the State in which at the relevant time the deceased had his habitual residence and in the absence of such an habitual residence the law of the unit with which he had his closest connection
Translation: 指该国籍国在相关时间死者惯常居所所在地区的法律；若无惯常居所存在，则适用与该死者具有最密切联系的地区的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 4 For the purposes of any reference in this Convention the law of the State of closest connection means the law of that unit of the State with which the deceased was most closely connected
Translation: 就本公约中的任何提及而言，最密切联系的州的法律是指被继承人与其联系最为密切的该国区域的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 5 Subject to Article 6 for the purposes of any designation pursuant to this Convention whereby the deceased designates the law of a unit of the State of which at the time of designation or of his death
Translation: 除第六条规定外，根据本公约进行任何指定之目的，若被继承人指定某一国家组成单位的法律为适用法律时，须以该指定时间或其死亡时，该被继承人与该国家组成单位之间存在充分关联为前提。

Query_Text_en: ? b he was not a national the designation is valid only if he then had his habitual residence in that unit or if he was not then habitually resident in that unit but was so resident in that State he had had an habitual residence in that unit at some time
Translation: 只有当满足以下条件时该指定才有效：他当时在该单位有惯常居所，或者虽然当时并未在该单位惯常居住，但曾在此前某一时间段内在此单位有惯常居所，且其惯常居所变更至该州的情况。

Query_Text_en: ? 6 For the purposes of any designation under Article 6 with regard to particular assets whereby the deceased designates the law of a State it is presumed that subject to evidence of contrary intent the designation means the law of each unit in which the assets are situated
Translation: 根据第六条，若被继承人指定特定资产适用某一国家的法律，则除非有相反意图的证据，该指定应视为指每项资产所在地区的法律。

Query_Text_en: ? 7 For the purposes of Article 3 paragraph 2 the required period of residence is attained when the deceased for the five years immediately preceding his death had his residence in that State notwithstanding that during that period he resided in more than one of the units of that State When the period has been attained and the deceased had an habitual residence in that State at that time but no habitual residence in any particular unit of that State the applicable law is the law of that unit in which the deceased last resided unless at that time he had a closer connection with another unit of the State in which case the law of the latter unit applies
Translation: 根据第三条第二款的规定，若死者在其去世前的五年内于某缔约国境内拥有住所（即使该期间内曾在该国多个区域居住），则视为已满足所需居住期限。当该期限已满足且死者在死亡时在该国拥有惯常居所，但却未在该国特定某一区域形成惯常居所时，适用法律应为死者在该国最后一个居住区域的法律；除非在该时点其与该国另一区域存在更紧密的联系，如此则适用该另一区域的法律。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 For purposes of identifying the law applicable under this Convention where a State has two or more legal systems applicable to the succession of deceased persons for different categories of persons any reference to the law of such State shall be construed as referring to the legal system determined by the rules in force in that State In the absence of such rules the reference shall be construed as referring to the legal system with which the deceased had the closest connection
Translation: 第二十条 为确定本公约项下适用法律之目的，当一国对不同类别的被继承人的遗产继承适用两个或多个法律体系时，对"该国法律"的任何援引应解释为指该国现行规则所确定的法律体系。若无此类规则，则应解释为指与被继承人具有最密切联系的法律体系。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 A Contracting State in which different systems of law or sets of rules of law apply to succession shall not be bound to apply the rules of the Convention to conflicts solely between the laws of such different systems or sets of rules of law
Translation: 第二十一条 若缔约国境内存在适用于继承的不同法律体系或法律规则体系，则该缔约国无义务将本公约的规定适用于仅存在于这些不同法律体系或规则体系之间的法律冲突。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 The Convention applies in a Contracting State to the succession of any person whose death occurs after the Convention has entered into force for that State
Translation: 本公约适用于任何缔约国，在该公约对该国生效后死亡的任何人的继承事项。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 Where at a time prior to the entry into force of the Convention in that State the deceased has designated the law applicable to his succession that designation is to be considered valid there if it Complies with Article 5
Translation: 在公约对该国生效前，若被继承人已指定其遗产继承所适用的法律，且该指定符合第五条规定，则在该国被视为有效。

Query_Text_en: ? 3 Where at a time prior to the entry into force of the Convention in that State the parties to an agreement as to succession have designated the law applicable to that agreement that designation is to be considered valid there if it complies with Article 11
Translation: 在公约对该国生效之前，如果有关继承的协议各方已指定适用于该协议的法律，且该指定符合第11条的规定，则在该国应视为有效。

Query_Text_en: ? 1 The Convention does not affect any other international instrument to which Contracting States are or become Parties and which contains provisions on matters governed by this Convention unless a contrary declaration is made by the States Parties to such instrument
Translation: 本公约不影响缔约国已是或将成为当事方的任何其他国际法律文件中的相关规定，除非该法律文件的当事国作出相反声明。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 Paragraph 1 of this Article also applies to uniform laws based on special ties of a regional or other nature between the States concerned
Translation: 本条第一款同样适用于相关国家之间基于区域或其他性质的特殊联系所形成的统一法律。

Query_Text_en: ? a that it will not apply the Convention to agreements as to succession as defined in Article 8 and therefore that it will not recognize a designation made under Article 5 if the designation is not expressed in a statement made in accordance with the requirements for a testamentary disposition ;
Translation: 该声明表明其将不适用该公约关于第八条所界定的继承协议，并因此不会承认根据第五条所作出的指定，如果该指定未以符合遗嘱处分要求的形式在声明中明确表达。

Query_Text_en: ? b that it will not apply Article 4 ;
Translation: ？其不会适用第四条；

Query_Text_en: ? c that it will not recognize a designation made under Article 5 by a person who at the time of his death was not or was no longer either a national of or habitually resident in the State whose law he had designated but at that time was a national of and habitually resident in the reserving State ;
Translation: ? C该保留条款的含义为：当一个人死亡时，若其并非或已不再是其所指定法律所属国家的国民，亦非在该国惯常居住，但此时其是保留国的国民并在保留国惯常居住，则该国将不承认其根据第五条所作的指定。

Query_Text_en: ? d that it will not recognize a designation made under Article 5 if all of the following conditions are met ? the law of the State making the reservation would have been the applicable law under Article 3 if there had been no valid designation made under Article 5 ? the application of the law designated under Article 5 would totally or very substantially deprive the spouse or a child of the deceased of an inheritance or family provision to which the spouse or child would have been entitled under the mandatory rules of the law of the State making this reservation ? that spouse or child is habitually resident in or a national of that State
Translation: 只要满足以下所有条件，它将不承认根据第5条所作的指定：(1) 如果未根据第5条作出有效的指定，则提出保留的国家的法律本应根据第3条成为适用法律；(2) 而根据第5条所指定的法律的应用，将完全或非常严重地剥夺死者配偶或子女依据提出该保留的国家法律中的强制性规定所应获得的继承权或家庭供养利益；(3) 该配偶或子女通常居住在或具有该国国籍。

Query_Text_en: ? 2 No other reservation shall be permitted
Translation: ? 2 不得有任何其他保留

Query_Text_en: ? 3 Any Contracting State may at any time withdraw a reservation which it has made ;
Translation: 任何缔约国均可随时撤回其提出的保留。
