Query_Text_en: Rule 24 Supporting DocumentationSupporting documentation shall ordinarily be filed together with the instrument to which it relates , and in any case within the time limit fixed for the filing of such instrument .
Translation:
第24条 支持性文件  
支持性文件一般应与相关文件一并提交，且最迟不得超过该文件提交规定的期限。

Query_Text_en: Rule 25 Correction of ErrorsAn accidental error in any instrument or supporting document may , with the consent of the other party or by leave of the Tribunal , be corrected at any time before the award is rendered .
Translation:
第二十五条 误缮更正  
在裁决作出前，经另一方当事人同意或仲裁庭许可，仲裁文件或相关材料中的偶然错误可随时予以更正。

Query_Text_en: Rule 26 Time Limits [ 1 ] Where required , time limits shall be fixed by the Tribunal by assigning dates for the completion of the various steps in the proceeding .
Translation: 第二十六条 时间限制 [1] 在必要情况下，仲裁庭应通过确定各程序步骤的完成日期来设定时间限制。

Query_Text_en: The Tribunal may delegate this power to its President .
Translation: 该委员会可将其此项权力授权予其主席。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The Tribunal may extend any time limit that it has fixed .
Translation: 仲裁庭有权延长其已设定的任何期限。

Query_Text_en: If the Tribunal is not in session , this power shall be exercised by its President .
Translation: 如果法庭未在会期中，此项权力应由其主席行使。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Any step taken after expiration of the applicable time limit shall be disregarded unless the Tribunal , in special circumstances and after giving the other party an opportunity of stating its views , decides otherwise .
Translation: 在规定的期限届满后采取的任何步骤均应不予考虑，除非仲裁庭在特殊情况下，并在给予另一方陈述意见的机会后，决定另作处理。

Query_Text_en: Rule 27 WaiverA party which knows or should have known that a provision of the Administrative and Financial Regulations , of these Rules , of any other rules or agreement applicable to the proceeding , or of an order of the Tribunal has not been complied with and which fails to state promptly its objections thereto , shall be deemed subject to Article 45 of the Convention-to have waived its right to object .
Translation:
第27条豁免  
任何已知或应知行政财务法规、本规则、适用于该程序的其他任何规则或协议，或仲裁庭所作命令中的相关规定未获遵守，且未及时提出异议的一方，应视为根据公约第45条放弃其提出异议的权利。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] with respect to any part of the proceeding , that the related costs [ as determined by the Secretary-General ] shall be borne entirely or in a particular share by one of the parties .
Translation: 关于程序的任何部分，由秘书长确定的相关费用应由一方完全承担或按特定比例承担。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Promptly after the closure of the proceeding , each party shall submit to the Tribunal a statement of costs reasonably incurred or borne by it in the proceeding and the Secretary-General shall submit to the Tribunal an account of all amounts paid by each party to the Centre and of all costs incurred by the Centre for the proceeding .
Translation: 程序结束后立即，各方应向仲裁庭提交其在程序中合理发生或承担的费用清单，秘书长应向仲裁庭提交一份账目明细，列明各方支付给中心的所有款项以及中心为该程序所发生的各项费用。

Query_Text_en: The Tribunal may , before the award has been rendered , request the parties and the Secretary-General to provide additional information concerning the cost of the proceeding .
Translation: 仲裁庭可在裁决作出前，要求双方及秘书长提供有关诉讼费用的补充信息。

Query_Text_en: a written procedure followed by an oral one .
Translation: 书面程序后进行口头程序。

Query_Text_en: Rule 30 Transmission of the RequestAs soon as the Tribunal is constituted , the Secretary-General shall transmit to each member a copy of the request by which the proceeding was initiated , of the supporting documentation , of the notice of registration and of any communication received from either party in response thereto .
Translation:
第三十条 请求的转交  
仲裁庭一经组成，秘书长应立即将启动该程序的请求书、支持性文件、登记通知以及双方当事人就此提供的任何书面材料各一份转交各成员。

Query_Text_en: and [ d ] a rejoinder by the other party .
Translation: 以及 [d] 另一方的反驳。

Query_Text_en: however , the parties may instead agree that one of them shall , for the purposes of paragraph [ 1 ] , be considered as the requesting party .
Translation: 然而，各方也可以约定，在第[1]款所述情形下，其中一方应被视为请求方。

Query_Text_en: and the submissions .
Translation: 以及提交的文件。

Query_Text_en: Rule 32 The Oral Procedure [ 1 ] The oral procedure shall consist of the hearing by the Tribunal of the parties , their agents , counsel and advocates , and of witnesses and experts .
Translation:
规则第三十二条 口头程序  
[1] 口头程序应包括仲裁庭对当事人及其代理人、法律顾问、辩护人以及证人和专家的听证。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The Tribunal shall decide , with the consent of the parties , which other persons besides the parties , their agents , counsel and advocates , witnesses and experts during their testimony , and officers of the Tribunal may attend the hearings .
Translation: 仲裁庭经各方同意后，应决定除当事方、其代理人、法律顾问、代理律师、正在作证的证人和专家以及仲裁庭工作人员之外，其他可以列席听证会的人员。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The members of the Tribunal may , during the hearings , put questions to the parties , their agents , counsel and advocates , and ask them for explanations .
Translation: 仲裁庭成员可以在听证会上向各方当事人及其代理人、法律顾问及其他代表提问，并要求其作出解释。

Query_Text_en: Rule 33 Marshaling of EvidenceWithout prejudice to the rules concerning the production of documents , each party shall , within time limits fixed by the Tribunal , communicate to the Secretary-General , for transmission to the Tribunal and the other party , precise information regarding the evidence which it intends to produce and that which it intends to request the Tribunal to call for , together with an indication of the points to which such evidence will be directed .
Translation:
第三十三条 证据整理  
不影响关于文件提交的其他规则，各方应在仲裁庭规定的期限内，向秘书处提交其拟提交的证据的具体信息以及其拟请求仲裁庭调取的证据，并说明该证据所指向的具体事项，以便转交仲裁庭及对方当事人。

Query_Text_en: General Principles [ 1 ] The Tribunal shall be the judge of the admissibility of any evidence adduced and of its probative value .
Translation: 仲裁庭有权判定任何提出的证据的可采性及其证明价值。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] visit any place connected with the dispute or conduct inquiries there .
Translation: 或进入与争议有关的任何地点，或在该等地点进行调查。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The parties shall cooperate with the Tribunal in the production of the evidence and in the other measures provided for in paragraph [ 2 ] .
Translation: 各方应配合仲裁庭提交证据，并履行本条第2款规定的其他措施。

Query_Text_en: The Tribunal shall take formal note of the failure of a party to comply with its obligations under this paragraph and of any reasons given for such failure .
Translation: 仲裁庭应正式载明一方未能履行本段规定的义务，并记录该方就此所陈述的理由。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Expenses incurred in producing evidence and in taking other measures in accordance with paragraph [ 2 ] shall be deemed to constitute part of the expenses incurred by the parties within the meaning of Article 61 [ 2 ] of the Convention .
Translation: 根据本条第[2]款规定为提供证据及采取其他措施所产生的费用，应视为属于《公约》第六十一条第[2]款所指当事人费用的一部分。

Query_Text_en: Rule 35 Examination of Witnesses and Experts [ 1 ] Witnesses and experts shall be examined before the Tribunal by the parties under the control of its President . Questions may also be put to them by any member of the Tribunal .
Translation:
第三十五条 证人和专家的质询  
[1] 证人和专家应由各方当事人在法庭主席的监督下接受法庭质询。法庭的任何成员均可向其提问。

Query_Text_en: `` I solemnly declare upon my honor and conscience that I shall speak the truth , the whole truth and nothing but the truth .
Translation: 我以名誉和良知庄严宣誓，将陈述事实的全部真相，绝无隐瞒。

Query_Text_en: `` I solemnly declare upon my honor and conscience that my statement will be in accordance with my sincere belief ''
Translation: 我庄严声明，以我的名誉和良知担保，我的陈述内容将完全符合我的真诚信念。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] with the consent of both parties , arrange for the examination of a witness or expert otherwise than before the Tribunal itself .
Translation: （B）经双方同意，可安排对证人或专家的询问，而非由法庭直接进行。

Query_Text_en: The Tribunal shall define the subject of the examination , the time limit , the procedure to be followed and other particulars .
Translation: 仲裁庭应确定审查事项、期限、应遵循的程序以及其他具体事项。

Query_Text_en: The parties may participate in the examination .
Translation: 各方可参与审查。

Query_Text_en: Rule 37 Visits and InquiriesIf the Tribunal considers it necessary to visit any place connected with the dispute or to conduct an inquiry there , it shall make an order to this effect .
Translation:
第三十七条 现场查勘与调查  
仲裁庭认为有必要对与争议有关的地点进行现场查勘或调查时，应当作出相应决定。

Query_Text_en: The order shall define the scope of the visit or the subject of the inquiry , the time limit , the procedure to be followed and other particulars .
Translation: 令应当规定访问范围或调查事项、时限、应遵循的程序以及其他具体事项。

Query_Text_en: The parties may participate in any visit or inquiry .
Translation: 各方有权参加任何核查或调查。

Query_Text_en: Rule 38 Closure of the Proceeding [ 1 ] When the presentation of the case by the parties is completed , the proceeding shall be declared closed .
Translation:
第三十八条 程序终结  
[1] 当事人的陈述完成后，程序应予终结。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] Exceptionally , the Tribunal may , before the award has been rendered , reopen the proceeding on the ground that new evidence is forthcoming of such a nature as to constitute a decisive factor , or that there is a vital need for clarification on certain specific points .
Translation: 例外情况下，在裁决作出前，仲裁庭可基于以下理由重新审理：新证据即将出现且具有决定性作用，或有必要对某些具体问题进行澄清。

Query_Text_en: Rule 39 Provisional Measures [ 1 ] At any time during the proceeding a party may request that provisional measures for the preservation of its rights be recommended by the Tribunal .
Translation: 第三十九条 临时措施 [1] 在仲裁程序进行期间，任何一方均可请求仲裁庭建议采取临时措施以保全其权利。

Query_Text_en: The request shall specify the rights to be preserved , the measures the recommendation of which is requested , and the circumstances that require such measures .
Translation: 请求应明确需保留的权利、需提出建议的措施以及需要采取此类措施的情形。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The Tribunal shall give priority to the consideration of a request made pursuant to paragraph [ 1 ] .
Translation: 仲裁庭应优先审议依本条第[1]款提出的请求。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The Tribunal may also recommend provisional measures on its own initiative or recommend measures other than those specified in a request .
Translation: 仲裁庭还可自行决定建议采取临时措施，或建议请求中未明确规定的其他措施。

Query_Text_en: It may at any time modify or revoke its recommendations .
Translation: 其可随时修改或撤销其建议。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The Tribunal shall only recommend provisional measures , or modify or revoke its recommendations , after giving each party an opportunity of presenting its observations .
Translation: 仲裁庭仅得在听取各当事方陈述意见后，方得建议采取临时措施，或修改或撤销其建议。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] Nothing in this Rule shall prevent the parties , provided that they have so stipulated in the agreement recording their consent , from requesting any judicial or other authority to order provisional measures , prior to the institution of the proceeding , or during the proceeding , for the preservation of their respective rights and interests .
Translation: 本规则中的任何规定均不得妨碍双方，只要他们在记录其同意的协议中对此有约定，即可在提起仲裁程序之前或程序进行期间，请求司法或其他主管机关裁定采取临时措施，以保全各自的权利和利益。

Query_Text_en: Rule 40 Ancillary Claims [ 1 ] Except as the parties otherwise agree , a party may present an incidental or additional claim or counter-claim arising directly out of the subject-matter of the dispute , provided that such ancillary claim is within the scope of the consent of the parties and is otherwise within the jurisdiction of the Centre .
Translation:
附属请求规则  
[1] 除非当事人另有约定，一方可在争议标的范围内提出直接源于该争议的附属或追加请求及反请求，但此类附属请求须在当事人合意范围内，并且属于中心的管辖范畴。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] An incidental or additional claim shall be presented not later than in the reply and a counter-claim no later than in the counter-memorial , unless the Tribunal , upon justification by the party presenting the ancillary claim and upon considering any objection of the other party , authorizes the presentation of the claim at a later stage in the proceeding .
Translation: 附带或新增请求应不迟于答辩书提交时提出，反请求不得晚于反诉状提交，除非仲裁庭经提出附带请求一方合理说明并考虑对方异议后，授权其在后续程序阶段提交该请求。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The Tribunal shall fix a time limit within which the party against which an ancillary claim is presented may file its observations thereon .
Translation: 仲裁庭应设定时限，被提出附属请求的一方可在该期限内提交其相关意见。

Query_Text_en: Rule 41 Objections to Jurisdiction [ 1 ] Any objection that the dispute or any ancillary claim is not within the jurisdiction of the Centre or , for other reasons , is not within the competence of the Tribunal shall be made as early as possible .
Translation: 第四十一条 管辖权异议 [1] 对于争议或任何相关请求不属于本中心管辖范围，或因其他原因不属于仲裁庭权限范围内的异议，应尽早提出。

Query_Text_en: A party shall file the objection with the Secretary-General no later than the expiration of the time limit fixed for the filing of the counter-memorial , or , if the objection relates to an ancillary claim , for the filing of the rejoinder-unless the facts on which the objection is based are unknown to the party at that time .
Translation: 一方应向秘书长提出异议，不得晚于为提交答辩书所设定的期限届满之时；如果异议涉及附属请求，则不得晚于提交反驳书的期限届满之时——除非异议所依据的事实为该方在当时未知。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The Tribunal may on its own initiative consider , at any stage of the proceeding , whether the dispute or any ancillary claim before it is within the jurisdiction of the Centre and within its own competence .
Translation: 仲裁庭有权在程序的任何阶段自行决定，其所受理的争议或相关请求是否属于中心的管辖范围以及是否在其职权范围内。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Upon the formal raising of an objection relating to the dispute , the proceeding on the merits shall be suspended .
Translation: 当正式提出与争端相关的异议时，实质性审理应暂停。

Query_Text_en: The President of the Tribunal , after consultation with its other members , shall fix a time limit within which the parties may file observations on the objection .
Translation: 仲裁庭庭长在与其他成员协商后，应确定各方就异议提交意见的期限。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The Tribunal shall decide whether or not the further procedures relating to the objection shall be oral .
Translation: 仲裁庭应决定是否就异议所涉进一步程序采取口头方式进行。

Query_Text_en: It may deal with the objection as a preliminary question or join it to the merits of the dispute .
Translation: 其可将该异议作为预先问题先行处理，或将其与案件的实质问题一并审理。

Query_Text_en: If the Tribunal overrules the objection or joins it to the merits , it shall once more fix time limits for the further procedures .
Translation: 如果仲裁庭驳回该异议或决定合并审理，应再次为后续程序设定时限。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] If the Tribunal decides that the dispute is not within the jurisdiction of the Centre or not within its own competence , it shall render an award to that effect .
Translation: 如果仲裁庭认定争议不属于中心的管辖范围，或者超出其自身权限，应作出相应裁决。

Query_Text_en: Rule 42 Default [ 1 ] If a party [ in this Rule called the `` defaulting party '' ] fails to appear or to present its case at any stage of the proceeding , the other party may , at any time prior to the discontinuance of the proceeding , request the Tribunal to deal with the questions submitted to it and to render an award .
Translation: 第四十二条 缺席 [1] 如果一方当事人（本条规定中称为"缺席方"）在程序的任何阶段未出席或未陈述其案情，另一方可在程序终止前的任何时间，请求仲裁庭处理所提交的问题并作出裁决。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The Tribunal shall promptly notify the defaulting party of such a request .
Translation: 仲裁庭应及时将该请求通知违约方。

Query_Text_en: or [ b ] if that party had failed to appear or present its case at a hearing , fix a new date for the hearing .
Translation: 或者（b）如果一方未出席听证会或未陈述其案情，则重新确定听证会的新日期。

Query_Text_en: The period of grace shall not , without the consent of the other party , exceed 60 days .
Translation: 未经另一方同意，宽限期不得超过60天。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] After the expiration of the period of grace or when , in accordance with paragraph [ 2 ] , no such period is granted , the Tribunal shall resume the consideration of the dispute .
Translation: 宽限期届满后，或根据第[2]款未给予此类宽限期时，仲裁庭应恢复对争端的审议。

Query_Text_en: Failure of the defaulting party to appear or to present its case shall not be deemed an admission of the assertions made by the other party .
Translation: 未出庭或未陈述案情的一方，其行为不得视为对另一方主张的承认。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The Tribunal shall examine the jurisdiction of the Centre and its own competence in the dispute and , if it is satisfied , decide whether the submissions made are well-founded in fact and in law .
Translation: 仲裁庭应审查中心的管辖权及仲裁庭在争议中的权限，如其确认，应裁定所提主张在事实上和法律上是否有充分依据。

Query_Text_en: To this end , it may , at any stage of the proceeding , call on the party appearing to file observations , produce evidence or submit oral explanations .
Translation: 为此，可在诉讼的任何阶段要求出庭的一方提交书面意见、提供证据或作出口头说明。

Query_Text_en: Rule 43 Settlement and Discontinuance [ 1 ] If , before the award is rendered , the parties agree on a settlement of the dispute or otherwise to discontinue the proceeding , the Tribunal , or the Secretary-General if the Tribunal has not yet been constituted , shall , at their written request , in an order take note of the discontinuance of the proceeding .
Translation:
规则43 和解与程序终止  
[1] 若在裁决作出前，双方就争议达成和解或同意终止程序，仲裁庭（如仲裁庭尚未组成，则由秘书长）应其书面请求，应以书面命令形式载明程序终止事宜。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] If the parties file with the Secretary-General the full and signed text of their settlement and in writing request the Tribunal to embody such settlement in an award , the Tribunal may record the settlement in the form of its award .
Translation: 如果各方将完整且经签署的和解文本提交给秘书长，并以书面形式请求仲裁庭将该和解载入裁决书，仲裁庭可将该和解内容以裁决书形式记录在案。

Query_Text_en: Rule 44 Discontinuance at Request of a PartyIf a party requests the discontinuance of the proceeding , the Tribunal , or the Secretary-General if the Tribunal has not yet been constituted , shall in an order fix a time limit within which the other party may state whether it opposes the discontinuance .
Translation:
规则44 当事人申请终止程序  
若一方当事人申请终止程序，仲裁庭或（如仲裁庭尚未成立）秘书长应当通过裁决规定期限，由另一方陈述其是否反对终止。

Query_Text_en: If no objection is made in writing within the time limit , the other party shall be deemed to have acquiesced in the discontinuance and the Tribunal , or if appropriate the Secretary-General , shall in an order take note of the discontinuance of the proceeding .
Translation: 如在指定期限内未以书面形式提出异议，则另一方应视为已默示同意终止该程序，仲裁庭或在必要时由秘书长应以书面命令记录该程序的终止。

Query_Text_en: If objection is made , the proceeding shall continue .
Translation: 如有异议，程序应当继续进行。

Query_Text_en: Rule 45 Discontinuance for Failure of Parties to ActIf the parties fail to take any steps in the proceeding during six consecutive months or such period as they may agree with the approval of the Tribunal , or of the Secretary-General if the Tribunal has not yet been constituted , they shall be deemed to have discontinued the proceeding and the Tribunal , or if appropriate the Secretary-General , shall , after notice to the parties , in an order take note of the discontinuance .
Translation:
第四十五条 当事人未采取行动的终止程序  
若当事人在连续六个月期间内或经仲裁庭批准的其他期限内未在程序中采取任何行动（如仲裁庭尚未成立，则由秘书长批准），则视为其已终止该程序。仲裁庭或在必要时由秘书长应向各方发出通知后，以裁定方式记录该终止。

Query_Text_en: Rule 46 Preparation of the AwardThe award [ including any individual or dissenting opinion ] shall be drawn up and signed within 60 days after the closure of the proceeding .
Translation:
第四十六条 裁决书的拟定  
裁决书[包括任何个人意见或异议意见]应当在程序终结后六十日内起草并签署完毕。

Query_Text_en: The Tribunal may , however , extend this period by a further 30 days if it would otherwise be unable to draw up the award .
Translation: 仲裁庭可再延长该期限30天，否则将无法作出裁决。

Query_Text_en: and [ j ] any decision of the Tribunal regarding the cost of the proceeding .
Translation: [ j ] 仲裁庭关于审理费用的任何决定。

Query_Text_en: the date of each signature shall be indicated .
Translation: 每个签名的日期应予以标明。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Any member of the Tribunal may attach his individual opinion to the award , whether he dissents from the majority or not , or a statement of his dissent .
Translation: 仲裁庭任何成员均可在裁决书中附具个人意见，无论其是否同意多数意见，或提交异议声明。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] dispatch a certified copy of the award [ including individual opinions and statements of dissent ] to each party , indicating the date of dispatch on the original text and on all copies .
Translation: 并（b）向每一方当事人发送裁决书的认证副本（包括各成员的个别意见及异议声明），并在原件及所有副本上注明发送日期。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The award shall be deemed to have been rendered on the date on which the certified copies were dispatched .
Translation: 本裁决应以认证副本发出之日视为已作出。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The Secretary-General shall , upon request , make available to a party additional certified copies of the award .
Translation: 秘书长应一方请求，向其提供裁决书的额外认证副本。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] The Centre shall not publish the award without the consent of the parties .
Translation: 未经当事人同意，中心不得公布裁决。

Query_Text_en: The Centre may , however , include in its publications excerpts of the legal rules applied by the Tribunal .
Translation: 但该中心可在其出版物中收录仲裁庭所适用的法律规则的摘录。

Query_Text_en: Rule 49 Supplementary Decisions and Rectification [ 1 ] Within 45 days after the date on which the award was rendered , either party may request , pursuant to Article 49 [ 2 ] of the Convention , a supplementary decision on , or the rectification of , the award .
Translation:
第四十九条 补充裁决与更正  
[1] 裁决作出之日起45天内，任何一方均可依据公约第四十九条，就裁决提出补充裁决请求或更正请求。

Query_Text_en: Such a request shall be addressed in writing to the Secretary-General .
Translation: 此类请求应以书面形式提交至秘书长。

Query_Text_en: and [ d ] be accompanied by a fee for lodging the request .
Translation: 并[d]需缴纳提交申请的费用。

Query_Text_en: and [ d ] transmit to each member of the Tribunal a copy of the notice of registration , together with a copy of the request and of any accompanying documentation .
Translation: 并应[d]向仲裁庭每位成员发送一份注册通知副本，连同申请书副本及所有随附文件的副本。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] The President of the Tribunal shall consult the members on whether it is necessary for the Tribunal to meet in order to consider the request .
Translation: 仲裁庭庭长应就是否需要召开会议以审议该请求征求成员意见。

Query_Text_en: The Tribunal shall fix a time limit for the parties to file their observations on the request and shall determine the procedure for its consideration .
Translation: 仲裁庭应为各方设定提交书面意见的时限，并确定对该事项的审议程序。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Rules 46-48 shall apply , mutatis mutandis , to any decision of the Tribunal pursuant to this Rule .
Translation: [4] 根据本条规定作出的仲裁庭裁决，适用规则46至48，经必要修改后。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] If a request is received by the Secretary-General more than 45 days after the award was rendered , he shall refuse to register the request and so inform forthwith the requesting party .
Translation: 若秘书长在裁决作出之日起45日后收到请求，应不予登记该请求，并立即通知请求方。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] in an application for revision , pursuant to Article 51 [ 1 ] of the Convention , the change sought in the award , the discovery of some fact of such a nature as decisively to affect the award , and evidence that when the award was rendered that fact was unknown to the Tribunal and to the applicant , and that the applicant 's ignorance of that fact was not due to negligence ;
Translation: 根据《公约》第51条就修订所提申请，申请人对裁决所作变更、发现某一足以重大影响裁决的事实，以及证明该事实在裁决作出时对仲裁庭及申请人而言均属未知，且申请人对该事实的未知并非因疏忽所致；

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] in an application for annulment , pursuant to Article 52 [ 1 ] of the Convention , the grounds on which it is based .
Translation: [iii] 在根据《公约》第52条第1款提出的撤销申请中，所依据的理由。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] be accompanied by the payment of a fee for lodging the application .
Translation: 提交申请时需缴纳费用。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] in the case of corruption on the part of a member of the Tribunal , within 120 days after discovery thereof , and in any event within three years after the date on which the award was rendered [ or any subsequent decision or correction ] .
Translation: [Ⅱ] 如涉及仲裁庭成员腐败，应在发现之日起120日内提出，且无论如何最迟不超过裁决作出之日[或任何后续决定或更正]起三年。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] If the Secretary-General refuses to register an application for revision , or annulment , he shall forthwith notify the requesting party of his refusal .
Translation: 如果秘书长拒绝登记修订或撤销的申请，应当立即通知申请方其拒绝的决定。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] request each member of the Tribunal to inform him within a specified time limit whether that member is willing to take part in the consideration of the application .
Translation: [b] 要求仲裁庭的每一位成员在规定期限内向其告知是否愿意参与对该申请的审议。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] If all members of the Tribunal express their willingness to take part in the consideration of the application , the Secretary-General shall so notify the members of the Tribunal and the parties .
Translation: 如果仲裁庭全体成员均表明其参与审议申请的意愿，秘书长应当就此通知仲裁庭成员及有关当事方。

Query_Text_en: Upon dispatch of these notices the Tribunal shall be deemed to be reconstituted .
Translation: 一经送达本通知，仲裁庭即视为重组完毕。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] If the Tribunal can not be reconstituted in accordance with paragraph [ 2 ] , the Secretary-General shall so notify the parties and invite them to proceed , as soon as possible , to constitute a new Tribunal , including the same number of arbitrators , and appointed by the same method , as the original one .
Translation: 如仲裁庭无法按照第[2]款重组，秘书长应就此通知各方，并邀请其尽快以相同数量的仲裁员及相同任命方式组建新的仲裁庭，该庭构成应与原仲裁庭一致。

Query_Text_en: Further Procedures [ 1 ] Upon registration of an application for the annulment of an award , the Secretary-General shall forthwith request the Chairman of the Administrative Council to appoint an ad hoc Committee in accordance with Article 52 [ 3 ] of the Convention .
Translation: 撤销裁决申请受理后，秘书长应立即根据《公约》第五十二条[3]之规定，请求行政理事会主席指定特别委员会。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The Committee shall be deemed to be constituted on the date the Secretary-General notifies the parties that all members have accepted their appointment .
Translation: 委员会应视为自秘书长通知各方所有成员已接受任命之日起成立。

Query_Text_en: Before or at the first session of the Committee , each member shall sign a declaration conforming to that set forth in Rule 6 [ 2 ] .
Translation: 在委员会第一次会议前或会议期间，每位成员应签署一份符合规则6所述内容的声明。

Query_Text_en: Rule 53 Rules of ProcedureThe provisions of these Rules shall apply mutatis mutandis to any procedure relating to the interpretation , revision or annulment of an award and to the decision of the Tribunal or Committee .
Translation:
程序规则第五十三条  
本规则之规定应相应调整适用于涉及裁决解释、修订或撤销的任何程序，以及仲裁庭或委员会作出的决定。

Query_Text_en: Rule 54 Stay of Enforcement of the Award [ 1 ] The party applying for the interpretation , revision or annulment of an award may in its application , and either party may at any time before the final disposition of the application , request a stay in the enforcement of part or all of the award to which the application relates .
Translation:
第54条 裁决执行的中止  
（1）申请解释、修改或撤销裁决的一方可在其申请中，或任何一方均可在申请最终处理前的任何时间，请求中止执行该申请所涉裁决的部分或全部内容。

Query_Text_en: The Tribunal or Committee shall give priority to the consideration of such a request .
Translation: 仲裁庭或委员会应优先审议此类请求。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] If an application for the revision or annulment of an award contains a request for a stay of its enforcement , the Secretary-General shall , together with the notice of registration , inform both parties of the provisional stay of the award .
Translation: 如果申请修订或撤销裁决的申请书中包含暂缓执行裁决的请求，秘书长应当连同注册通知一并告知双方该裁决的临时暂缓。

Query_Text_en: unless it decides to continue the stay , it shall automatically be terminated .
Translation: 除非决定继续延长，否则将自动终止。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] If a stay of enforcement has been granted pursuant to paragraph [ 1 ] or continued pursuant to paragraph [ 2 ] , the Tribunal or Committee may at any time modify or terminate the stay at the request of either party .
Translation: 若根据第[1]款授予或根据第[2]款延续了中止执行措施，仲裁庭或委员会可应任何一方当事人的请求，随时修改或终止该中止。

Query_Text_en: All stays shall automatically terminate on the date on which a final decision is rendered on the application , except that a Committee granting the partial annulment of an award may order the temporary stay of enforcement of the unannulled portion in order to give either party an opportunity to request any new Tribunal constituted pursuant to Article 52 [ 6 ] of the Convention to grant a stay pursuant to Rule 55 [ 3 ] .
Translation: 本条款规定，除非裁决部分撤销的委员会可裁定暂时中止执行未被撤销部分，以给予任何一方机会请求根据《公约》第52条[6]组成的新的仲裁庭依据规则第55条[3]授予中止令，否则所有中止措施均自申请最终裁决作出之日起自动终止。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] A request pursuant to paragraph [ 1 ] , [ 2 ] [ second sentence ] or [ 3 ] shall specify the circumstances that require the stay or its modification or termination .
Translation: 根据本条第（一）、（二）项第二款或（三）项提出请求时，应当明确说明需要暂停、修改或终止该措施的具体情形。

Query_Text_en: A request shall only be granted after the Tribunal or Committee has given each party an opportunity of presenting its observations .
Translation: 请求应仅在仲裁庭或委员会已给予各方陈述意见的机会后方可准予。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] The Secretary-General shall promptly notify both parties of the stay of enforcement of any award and of the modification or termination of such a stay , which shall become effective on the date on which he dispatches such notification .
Translation: 秘书长应当立即通知双方有关任何裁决的暂缓执行及其修改或终止，该通知自秘书长发出之日起生效。

Query_Text_en: Rule 55 Resubmission of Dispute after an Annulment [ 1 ] If a Committee annuls part or all of an award , either party may request the resubmission of the dispute to a new Tribunal .
Translation: 第五十五条 裁决被撤销后的争议重新提交 [1] 如果委员会撤销裁决的全部或部分内容，任何一方均可请求将争议重新提交新的仲裁庭。

Query_Text_en: and [ d ] invite the parties to proceed , as soon as possible , to constitute a new Tribunal , including the same number of arbitrators , and appointed by the same method , as the original one .
Translation: 并敦促各方尽快采取行动，成立一个与原仲裁庭在仲裁员人数和任命方式上相同的新的仲裁庭。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] If the original award had only been annulled in part , the new Tribunal shall not reconsider any portion of the award not so annulled .
Translation: 如果原裁决仅被部分撤销，新仲裁庭不得对未被撤销的部分进行重新审议。

Query_Text_en: It may , however , in accordance with the procedures set forth in Rule 54 , stay or continue to stay the enforcement of the unannulled portion of the award until the date its own award is rendered .
Translation: 然而，其可根据第54条规定的程序，在自身裁决作出之日之前，中止或继续中止未被撤销部分裁决的执行。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Except as otherwise provided in paragraphs [ 1 ] - [ 3 ] , these Rules shall apply to a proceeding on a resubmitted dispute in the same manner as if such dispute had been submitted pursuant to the Institution Rules .
Translation: 除非本规则第[1]至[3]款另有规定，否则本规则应适用于对重新提交的争议所进行的程序，如同该争议系根据《机构规则》提交的一样。

Query_Text_en: Rule 56 Final Provisions [ 1 ] The texts of these Rules in each official language of the Centre shall be equally authentic .
Translation:
第五十六条 最终条款  
[1] 本规则的文本在中心的每种官方语言中均具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] These Rules may be cited as the `` Arbitration Rules '' of the Centre .
Translation: 本规则可称为本中心的《仲裁规则》。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 An agreement in which the parties undertake to submit to arbitral decision any differences that may arise or have arisen between them with respect to a commercial transaction is valid .
Translation: 第一条 凡约定将各方涉及商业交易可能产生或已经产生的任何争议提交仲裁裁决的协议，其效力有效。

Query_Text_en: The agreement shall be set forth in an instrument signed by the parties , or in the form of an exchange of letters , telegrams , or telex communications .
Translation: 本协议应以书面形式由各方签署，或通过交换函电、电报或电传等方式达成。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 1 . Arbitrators shall be appointed in the manner agreed upon by the parties .
Translation: 第二条第一款 仲裁员应按照当事人约定的方式任命。

Query_Text_en: Their appointment may be delegated to a third party , whether a natural or juridical person .
Translation: 其任命可委托给第三方，无论是自然人还是法人。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Arbitrators may be nationals or foreigners .
Translation: 仲裁员可以是本国公民或外国人。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 In the absence of an express agreement between the parties , the arbitration shall be conducted in accordance with the rules of procedure of the Inter-American Commercial Arbitration Commission .
Translation: 第三条 在当事人之间没有明确约定的情况下，仲裁应按照美洲国家间商业仲裁委员会的程序规则进行。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 An arbitral decision or award that is not appealable under the applicable law or procedural rules shall have the force of a final judicial judgment .
Translation: 第四条 根据相关法律规定或程序规则不可上诉的仲裁裁决，应具有终局司法判决的效力。

Query_Text_en: Its execution or recognition may be ordered in the same manner as that of decisions handed down by national or foreign ordinary courts , in accordance with the procedural laws of the country where it is to be executed and the provisions of international treaties .
Translation: 其执行或认可可依需执行地国的程序法及国际条约规定，以国内或外国普通法院作出的裁决相同方式予以裁定。

Query_Text_en: a. That the parties to the agreement were subject to some incapacity under the applicable law or that the agreement is not valid under the law to which the parties have submitted it , or , if such law is not specified under the law of the State in which the decision was made ;
Translation: 根据适用法律，协议方存在某种无行为能力，或该协议不符合当事人选定法律的规定；若未明确选定法律，则依作出裁决的国家法律判定协议无效。

Query_Text_en: or b. That the party against which the arbitral decision has been made was not duly notified of the appointment of the arbitrator or of the arbitration procedure to be followed , or was unable , for any other reason , to present his defense ;
Translation: 仲裁裁决所针对的一方未被适当通知仲裁员的任命或拟遵循的仲裁程序，或因其他原因未能陈述其辩护理由。

Query_Text_en: nevertheless , if the provisions of the decision that refer to issues submitted to arbitration can be separated from those not submitted to arbitration , the former may be recognized and executed ;
Translation: 然而，如果裁决中涉及提交仲裁事项的条款能够与未提交仲裁的条款相分离，则前者可以得到承认和执行。

Query_Text_en: or d. That the constitution of the arbitral tribunal or the arbitration procedure has not been carried out in accordance with the terms of the agreement signed by the parties or , in the absence of such agreement , that the constitution of the arbitral tribunal or the arbitration procedure has not been carried out in accordance with the law of the State where the arbitration took place ;
Translation: 仲裁庭的组成或仲裁程序未按照当事方签订的协议条款进行；或者在没有此类协议的情况下，仲裁庭的组成或仲裁程序未按照仲裁进行地所在国的法律进行。

Query_Text_en: or e. That the decision is not yet binding on the parties or has been annulled or suspended by a competent authority of the State in which , or according to the law of which , the decision has been made .
Translation: 该决定尚未对各方产生约束力，或已被该决定作出地所属国家或根据其法律作出该决定的国家的有权机关撤销或中止。

Query_Text_en: or b. That the recognition or execution of the decision would be contrary to the public policy [ `` ordre public '' ] of that State .
Translation: （或b）承认或执行该裁决将违背该国的公共政策（‘ordre public’）。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 If the competent authority mentioned in Article 5 . 1 . e has been requested to annul or suspend the arbitral decision , the authority before which such decision is invoked may , if it deems it appropriate , postpone a decision on the execution of the arbitral decision and , at the request of the party requesting execution , may also instruct the other party to provide appropriate guaranties .
Translation: 第六条 如果第五条第一款e项所述的主管机关已被请求撤销或中止仲裁裁决，受理该裁决援引的机关可认为适当的情况下，推迟作出执行仲裁裁决的裁定；应请求执行裁决的一方请求，该机关还可要求另一方提供适当的担保。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 This Convention shall be open for signature by the Member States of the Organization of American States .
Translation: 第七条 本公约应开放供美洲国家组织成员国签署。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 This Convention is subject to ratification .
Translation: 本公约须经批准。

Query_Text_en: The instruments of ratification shall be deposited with the General Secretariat of the Organization of American States .
Translation: 批准书应交存于美洲国家组织总秘书处。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 This Convention shall remain open for accession by any other State .
Translation: 本公约应继续对其他国家开放加入。

Query_Text_en: The instruments of accession shall be deposited with the General Secretariat of the Organization of American States .
Translation: 加入文书应交存于美洲国家组织总秘书处。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 1 . This Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the date of deposit of the second instrument of ratification .
Translation: 第十条第一款 本公约应于第二份批准书交存后的第三十天起生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 . For each State ratifying or acceding to the Convention after the deposit of the second instrument of ratification , the Convention shall enter into force on the thirtieth day after deposit by such State of its instrument of ratification or accession .
Translation: 本公约应于第二份批准书或加入书交存后，对该交存批准书或加入书的缔约国自该交存之日起第三十日开始生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 1 . If a State Party has two or more territorial units in which different systems of law apply in relation to the matters dealt with in this Convention , it may , at the time of signature , ratification or accession , declare that this Convention shall extend to all its territorial units or only to one or more of them .
Translation: 第一条 第一款 缔约国如在其两个或多个领土单位内对本公约所涉事项适用不同的法律体系，可在签署、批准或加入时声明本公约适用于其所有领土单位或仅适用于其中一部分。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Such declaration may be modified by subsequent declarations , which shall expressly indicate the territorial unit or units to which the Convention applies .
Translation: 此类声明可由后续声明进行修改，后者应明确指明公约适用的领土单位或单位。

Query_Text_en: Such subsequent declarations shall be transmitted to the General Secretariat of the Organization of American States , and shall become effective thirty days after the date of their receipt .
Translation: 此类后续声明应提交至美洲国家组织秘书处，并自收到之日起三十日后生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 This Convention shall remain in force indefinitely , but any of the States Parties may denounce it .
Translation: 第十二条 本公约应无限期有效，但各缔约国可以退出。

Query_Text_en: The instrument of denunciation shall be deposited with the General Secretariat of the Organization of American States .
Translation: 声明退出的文书应递交至美洲国家组织总秘书处。

Query_Text_en: After one year from the date of deposit of the instrument of denunciation , the Convention shall no longer be in effect for the denouncing State , but shall remain in effect for the other States Parties .
Translation: 自声明退出的缔约国递交废约通知书之日起满一年后，本公约对其不再具有约束力，但对其余缔约国继续有效。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 The original instrument of this Convention , the English , French , Portuguese and Spanish texts of which are equally authentic , shall be deposited with the General Secretariat of the Organization of American States .
Translation: 第十三条 本公约的原本，其英文、法文、葡萄牙文和西班牙文本具有同等效力，应交存于美洲国家组织一般秘书处。

Query_Text_en: The Secretariat shall notify the Member States of the Organization of American States and the States that have acceded to the Convention of the signatures , deposits of instruments of ratification , accession , and denunciation as well as of reservations , if any .
Translation: 秘书处应将有关签署、批准、加入及退出的文书交存情况，以及任何保留条款（如有），通知美洲国家组织成员国及加入该公约的国家。

Query_Text_en: It shall also transmit the declarations referred to in Article 11 of this Convention . IN WITNESS WHEREOF the undersigned Plenipotentiaries , being duly authorized thereto by their respective Governments , have signed this Convention .
Translation: 本公约第11条所指的声明文件亦应由其转交。下列签字全权代表，经各该国政府授权批准，特签署本公约。

Query_Text_en: DONE AT PANAMA CITY , Republic of Panama , this thirtieth day of January one thousand nine hundred and seventy-five .
Translation: 订立于巴拿马共和国巴拿马城，一九七五年一月三十日。

Query_Text_en: e ] To develop production , exports and imports of jute and jute products as regards quantity so as to meet the requirements of world demand and supply .
Translation: 发展黄麻及黄麻制品的生产、进出口数量，以满足全球市场需求与供给。

Query_Text_en: c ] Consideration of important issues concerning jute and jute products , such as the questions of stabilization of prices and supplies and of competition with synthetics and substitutes .
Translation: 关于黄麻及黄麻制品的重要问题的讨论，包括价格与供应稳定措施以及与合成材料及替代品的竞争问题。

Query_Text_en: 9 ] `` Simple distributed majority vote '' means a vote requiring more than half of the total votes of exporting members present and voting and more than half of the total votes of the importing members present and voting counted separately .
Translation: “分散多数票表决”指出口成员在场且投票成员的总票数中超过半数、且进口成员在场且投票成员的总票数中超过半数，两部分票数需分别单独计算的表决。

Query_Text_en: and 13 ] `` Freely usable currencies '' means the Deutsche mark , the French franc , the Japanese yen , the pound sterling , the United States dollar and any other currency which has been designated from time to time by a competent international monetary organization as being in fact widely used to make payments for international transactions and widely traded in the principal exchange markets .
Translation: 【and 13】"可自由使用货币"指德国马克、法国法郎、日本 yen（日元）、英镑、美元，以及不时被有权的国际货币组织指定为在事实上被广泛用于国际交易支付，并在主要外汇市场广泛流通交易的任何其他货币。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 Establishment , headquarters and structure of the International Jute Organization 1 - The International Jute Organization is hereby established to administer the provisions and supervise the operation of this Agreement .
Translation:
第三条 国际黄麻组织的设立、总部及组织结构  
一、国际黄麻组织现予设立，负责管理和执行本协定条款，并监督其实施。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Organization shall function through the International Jute Council and the Committee on Projects as permanent bodies , and the Executive Director and the staff .
Translation: 该组织应通过国际黄麻理事会和项目委员会作为常设机构，以及执行主任和工作人员开展工作。

Query_Text_en: The Council may , by special vote , establish for specific purposes committees and working groups with specified terms of reference .
Translation: 理事会可经特别表决，为特定目的设立具有明确职权范围的委员会和工作组。

Query_Text_en: 3 - The headquarters of the Organization shall be in Dacca , Bangladesh .
Translation: 该组织的总部应设于孟加拉国达卡。

Query_Text_en: 4 - The headquarters of the Organization shall at all times be located in the territory of a member .
Translation: 4. 该组织的总部应始终设在某一成员国的领土内。

Query_Text_en: 2 - A member may change its category of membership on such conditions as the Council shall establish .
Translation: 2. 会员可依据理事会将制定的条件变更其会员类别。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 Membership by intergovernmental organizations 1 - Any reference in this Agreement to ? Governments ? shall be construed as including the European Economic Community and any other intergovernmental organization having responsibilities in respect of the negotiation , conclusion and application of international agreements , in particular commodity agreements .
Translation: 《协定》第5条 政府间组织的成员资格  1 - 本协定中对"政府"的任何提及均应视为包括欧洲经济共同体以及其他负责谈判、签订和实施国际协定（尤其是商品协定）的任何其他政府间组织。

Query_Text_en: Accordingly , any reference in this Agreement to signature , ratification , acceptance or approval , or to notification of provisional application , or to accession shall , in the case of such intergovernmental organizations be construed as including a reference to signature , ratification , acceptance or approval , or to notification of provisional application , or to accession , by such intergovernmental organizations .
Translation: 据此，本协议中提及的签署、批准、接受或核准，或临时适用通知，或加入等用语，在涉及此类政府间组织时，应视为包括该类政府间组织进行的签署、批准、接受或核准，或临时适用通知，或加入等行为。

Query_Text_en: 2 - In the case of voting on matters within their competence , such intergovernmental organizations shall vote with a number of votes equal to the total number of votes attributable to their member States in accordance with article 10 .
Translation: 在对其职权范围内的事项进行表决时，这些政府间组织应以相当于其成员国根据第10条所拥有票数总和的票数进行投票。

Query_Text_en: In such cases , the member States of such intergovernmental organizations shall not be entitled to exercise their individual voting rights .
Translation: 在这种情况下，此类政府间组织的成员国不得行使各自的投票权。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Composition of the International Jute Council 1 - The highest authority of the Organization shall be the International Jute Council , which shall consist of all the members of the Organization .
Translation: 第六条 国际黄麻理事会的组成：本组织的最高权力机构为国际黄麻理事会，由本组织全体成员组成。

Query_Text_en: 2 - Each member shall be represented in the Council by one delegate , and may designate alternates and advisers to attend sessions of the Council .
Translation: 每个成员在理事会中应由一名代表出席，并可指定候补代表和顾问参加理事会会议。

Query_Text_en: 3 - An alternate delegate shall be empowered to act and vote on behalf of the delegate during the latter 's absence or in special circumstances .
Translation: 三、候补代表有权在正式代表缺席时或在特殊情况下代行其权利并参与表决。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 Powers and functions of the Council 1 - The Council shall exercise all such powers and perform or arrange for the performance of all such functions as are necessary to carry out the provisions of this Agreement .
Translation:
第七条 理事会的权力和职能  
一、理事会应行使各项权力，并履行或安排履行所有必要职能，以执行本协议的各项规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Council shall , by special vote , adopt such rules and regulations as are necessary to carry out the provisions of this Agreement and are consistent therewith , including its own rules of procedure and the financial and staff regulations of the Organization .
Translation: 理事会应通过特别表决，采纳为实施本协议条款所必需并与之保持一致的各项规则和条例，包括其自身的议事规则以及该组织的财务和人员条例。

Query_Text_en: Such financial rules and regulations shall govern , inter alia , the receipt and expenditure of funds under the Administrative and Special Accounts .
Translation: 本财务规则和制度应规范行政和专项账户的资金收支等事项。

Query_Text_en: The Council may , in its rules of procedure , provide for a procedure whereby it may , without meeting , decide specific questions .
Translation: 理事会可在其议事规则中规定无需召开会议即可决定具体事项的程序。

Query_Text_en: 3 - The Council shall keep such records as are required for the performance of its functions under this Agreement .
Translation: 理事会应保存为履行本协议规定的职能所需的记录。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Chairman and Vice-Chairman of the Council 1 - The Council shall elect for each jute year a Chairman and a Vice-Chairman , who shall not be paid by the Organization .
Translation:
第八条 理事会主席和副主席  
第一条 理事会应为每个黄麻年度选举一名主席和一名副主席，他们不得由本组织支付薪酬。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Chairman and the Vice-Chairman shall be elected , one from among the representatives of exporting members and the other from among the representatives of importing members .
Translation: 主席和副主席应由出口成员代表和进口成员代表中各选举一人产生。

Query_Text_en: These offices shall alternate each year between the two categories of members , provided , however , that this shall not prohibit the reelection of either or both , under exceptional circumstances , by special vote of the Council .
Translation: 这些职位应每年在两类成员间轮流产生。不过，此规定不妨碍在特殊情况下经安理会特别投票重新选举其中一方或双方。

Query_Text_en: 3 - In the temporary absence of the Chairman , the Vice-Chairman shall act in his place .
Translation: 3 - 在主席暂时缺席期间，副主席应代行其职务。

Query_Text_en: In the temporary absence of both the Chairman and the Vice-Chairman or the permanent absence of one or both of them , the Council may elect new officers from among the representatives of the exporting members and\/or from among the representatives of the importing members , as the case may be , on a temporary or permanent basis .
Translation: 在主席和副主席均暂时缺席，或其中一方或双方永久缺席的情况下，理事会可从出口成员国的代表和/或进口成员国的代表中选出新官员，视情况而定以临时或永久任职为基础。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 Sessions of the Council 1 - As a general rule , the Council shall hold one regular session in each half of the jute year .
Translation:
第九条 理事会会议  
1 - 原则上，理事会应在每个黄麻年度的每半年举行一次例行会议。

Query_Text_en: or c ] Members holding at least 500 votes .
Translation: 或C] 持有至少500票的成员。

Query_Text_en: 3 - Sessions of the Council shall be held at the headquarters of the Organization unless the Council , by special vote , decides otherwise .
Translation: 理事会会议应于本组织总部举行，除非理事会以特别表决方式决定其他地点。

Query_Text_en: If on the invitation of any member the Council meets elsewhere than at the headquarters of the Organization , that member shall pay the additional cost of holding the meeting away from headquarters .
Translation: 如果理事会应任何成员国邀请在本组织总部以外的地点举行会议，该成员国应当承担由此产生的额外费用。

Query_Text_en: 4 - Notice of any session and the agenda for the session shall be communicated to members by the Executive Director at least 30 days in advance , except in cases of emergency when notice shall be communicated at least seven days in advance .
Translation: 执行主任应至少提前30天向成员通报任何会议的通知及该会议的议程；但遇紧急情况除外，此时仍须至少提前7天发出通知。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 Distribution of votes 1 - The exporting members shall together hold 1,000 votes and the importing members shall together hold 1,000 votes .
Translation:
第十条 投票权分配  
1. 出口成员方合计持有1000票，进口成员方合计持有1000票。

Query_Text_en: the remaining votes shall be distributed in proportion to the average volume of their net exports of jute and jute products during the preceding three jute years , provided that the maximum number of votes of any exporting member shall note exceed 450 .
Translation: 剩余票数应根据各出口成员方在过去三个黄麻年度内黄麻及黄麻产品净出口量的平均数值按比例分配，但任何出口成员方的票数不得超过450票。

Query_Text_en: The surplus votes in excess of the maximum shall be distributed to all exporting members having less than 250 votes individually , in proportion to their trade shares .
Translation: 超过最大限额部分的剩余票数应分配给所有各自所持票数不足250票的出口成员，并按照其贸易份额比例进行分配。

Query_Text_en: each importing member shall have up to five initial votes provided that the total of initial votes shall not exceed 125 .
Translation: 每个进口成员初始投票权最多为五票，条件是初始投票权总数不得超过125票。

Query_Text_en: The remaining votes shall be distributed in proportion to the annual average of the volume of their respective net imports of jute and jute products during the three-year period commencing four calendar years prior to the distribution of votes .
Translation: 剩余票数应根据投票分配前四年开始的三年期间内各成员黄麻及黄麻产品净进口量的年度平均值按比例进行分配。

Query_Text_en: 4 - The Council shall distribute the votes for each financial year at the beginning of the first session of that year in accordance with the provisions of this article .
Translation: 理事会应按照本条规定，在每个财政年度首次会议开始时分配该年度的投票权。

Query_Text_en: Such distribution shall remain in effect for the rest of that year , except as provided for in paragraph 5 of this article .
Translation: 该分配方案在该年度剩余时间内继续有效，除非按照本条第5款的规定。

Query_Text_en: 5 - Whenever the membership of the Organization changes or when any member has its voting rights suspended or restored under any provision of this Agreement , the Council shall redistribute the votes within the affected category or categories of members in accordance with the provisions of this article .
Translation: 当本组织成员构成发生变动，或任何成员根据本协议条款被暂停或恢复投票权时，理事会应根据本条相关规定，在受影响的成员类别或类别内重新分配投票权。

Query_Text_en: The Council shall decide the date on which the redistribution of votes shall become effective .
Translation: 理事会将决定投票权重新分配生效的日期。

Query_Text_en: 6 - There shall be no fractional votes .
Translation: 6 - 不得出现分数票。

Query_Text_en: 7 - In rounding to the nearest whole vote , any fraction less than 0 . 5 shall be rounded downward and any fraction greater than or equal to 0 . 5 shall be rounded upward .
Translation: 在四舍五入到最接近的整票数时，小于0.5的分数部分应向下取整，大于或等于0.5的分数部分应向上取整。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 Voting procedure of the Council 1 - Each member shall be entitled to cast the number of votes it holds and no member shall be entitled to divide its votes .
Translation: 第11条 理事会投票程序 第1款：每个成员有权投出其所持有的票数，且任何成员均无权分割其投票权。

Query_Text_en: A member may , however , cast differently from such votes an votes which it is authorized to cast under paragraph 2 of this article .
Translation: 然而，会员国仍可不同于上述投票权及根据本条第2款获授权行使的投票权进行投票。

Query_Text_en: 2 - By written notification to the Chairman of the Council , any exporting member may authorize any other exporting member , and any importing member may authorize any other importing member , to represent its interests and to cast its votes at any meeting or session of the Council .
Translation: 任何出口成员均可授权其他任何出口成员，任何进口成员均可授权其他任何进口成员，代表其利益并在理事会的任何会议或会议上代其投票。

Query_Text_en: 3 - A member authorized by another member to cast the votes held by the authorizing member under article 10 shall cast such votes in accordance with the instructions of the authorizing member .
Translation: 由另一会员国授权的会员国，代表授权会员国在第10条项下持有的投票权进行投票时，必须按照授权会员国的指示行使投票权。

Query_Text_en: 4 - When abstaining , a member shall be deemed not to have cast its votes .
Translation: 当成员弃权时，应视为其未行使投票权。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 Decisions and recommendations of the Council 1 - The Council shall endeavor to take all decisions , and make all recommendations , by consensus .
Translation:
第十二条 理事会的决策和建议  
理事会应努力通过协商一致的方式作出所有决策和提出所有建议。

Query_Text_en: If a consensus is not arrived at , all decisions of the Council shall be taken , and all recommendations shall be made , by a simple distributed majority vote , unless this Agreement provides for a special vote .
Translation: 如果未能达成一致意见，除本协议另有规定需采取特别表决程序外，理事会的所有决定应以简单多数票作出，所有建议应以简单多数票提出。

Query_Text_en: 2 - Where a member avails itself of the provisions of article 11 , paragraph 2 , and its votes are cast at a meeting of the Council , such member shall , for the purposes of paragraph 1 of this article , be considered as present and voting .
Translation: 根据本条第1款的规定，如某一成员援引第11条第2款，并在理事会会议上行使投票权，则该成员应被视为出席会议并投票。

Query_Text_en: 3 - All decisions and recommendations of the Council shall be consistent with the provisions of this Agreement .
Translation: 理事会的所有决定和建议均须与本协议的规定保持一致。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 Quorum for the Council 1 - The quorum for any meeting of the Council shall be the presence of a majority of exporting members and a majority of importing members , provided that such members hold at least two thirds of the total votes in their respective categories .
Translation:
第十三条 理事会会议法定人数  
理事会任何会议的法定人数应为出口成员过半数及进口成员过半数出席，且此类成员在其各自类别中所持投票权不低于总数的三分之二。

Query_Text_en: 2 - If there is no quorum in accordance with paragraph 1 of this article on the day fixed for the meeting and on the following day , the quorum on the third day and thereafter shall be the presence of a majority of exporting members and a majority of importing members , provided that such members hold a majority of the total votes in their respective categories .
Translation: 若根据本条第一款规定，会议召开日及次日均未达到法定人数，则自第三日起的法定人数应为出口成员过半数及进口成员过半数到场，且此类成员在其各自类别中所持投票权需占多数。

Query_Text_en: 3 - Representation in accordance with article 11 , paragraph 2 , shall be considered as presence .
Translation: 根据第11条第2款设立的代表处应视为存在。

Query_Text_en: In the event that their facilities , services and expertise are considered by the Council to be deficient or inadequate for the effective functioning of the Organization , the Council shall decide , where circumstances so warrant , to take the necessary action to have the work carried out effectively , if necessary by the Organization on its own .
Translation: 如理事会认定相关设施、服务和专长得不到保障或无法满足本组织有效运转需求时，理事会应在情形需要的情况下决定采取必要措施确保相关工作得到有效落实，必要时由本组织自行实施。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Council shall make whatever arrangements are appropriate for consultation or co-operation with the United Nations and its organs , in particular UNCTAD , and with FAO and such other specialized agencies of the United Nations and intergovernmental and nongovernmental organizations as may be appropriate .
Translation: 理事会应当根据需要作出适当安排，与联合国及其机构（尤其是联合国贸发会议）、联合国粮农组织以及其他适当的联合国专门机构、政府间和非政府组织开展磋商或合作。

Query_Text_en: 3 - The Council , bearing in mind the particular role of UNCTAD in the field of international commodity trade , shall , as appropriate , keep that organization informed of its activities and programs of work .
Translation: 考虑到联合国贸发会议在国际大宗商品贸易领域所发挥的特殊作用，理事会应酌情向该组织通报其活动及工作计划。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 Admission of observers The Council may invite any non-member country or any of the organizations referred to in article 14 and article 31 concerned with international trade in jute and jute products or with the jute industry to attend as observers any of the meetings of the Council .
Translation:
第十五条 观察员的接纳  
理事会可邀请任何非成员国或第十四条及第三十一条所指与黄麻及其制品国际贸易或黄麻产业相关的任何组织，以观察员身份出席理事会的任何会议。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Executive Director and staff 1 - The Council shall , by special vote , appoint the Executive Director .
Translation: 第十六条 执行主任和工作人员。一、理事会应通过特别表决程序任命执行主任。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The terms and conditions of appointment of the Executive Director shall be determined by the Council .
Translation: 执行董事的任职条款和条件应由理事会确定。

Query_Text_en: 3 - The Executive Director shall be the chief administrative officer of the Organization and shall be responsible to the Council for the administration and operation of this Agreement in accordance with the decisions of the Council .
Translation: 执行主任应为本组织的首席行政官，并对理事会负责，按照理事会的决定负责本协议的行政管理和运作。

Query_Text_en: 4 - The Executive Director shall appoint the staff in accordance with the regulations established by the Council .
Translation: 执行董事应根据理事会制定的规定任命工作人员。

Query_Text_en: The Council shall at its first session decide on the number of executive and professional staff the Executive Director may appoint for the initial five-year period .
Translation: 理事会应在首次会议上决定执行主任在初始五年期内可任命的行政和专业人员数量。

Query_Text_en: Such staff shall be recruited in stages .
Translation: 此类人员应分阶段招聘。

Query_Text_en: Any changes in the number of executive and professional staff shall be decided by the Council by special vote . The staff shall be responsible to the Executive Director .
Translation: 执行人员和专业技术人员数量的任何变动，须由理事会通过特别表决决定。上述人员应对执行总监负责。

Query_Text_en: 5 - Neither the Executive Director nor any member of the staff shall have any financial interest in the jute industry or trade , or associated commercial activities .
Translation: 执行董事或任何工作人员均不得在黄麻产业、贸易或相关商业活动中持有任何经济利益。

Query_Text_en: 6 - In the performance of their duties , the Executive Director and other staff shall not seek or receive instruction from any member or from any other authority external to the Organization .
Translation: 在履行职责时，执行主任和其他工作人员不得接受任何成员国或本组织以外其他机构的指示。

Query_Text_en: They shall , refrain from any action which might reflect on their positions as international officials ultimately responsible to the Council .
Translation: 他们不得从事任何可能有损于其作为对安理会最终负责的国际官员身份的行为。

Query_Text_en: Each member shall respect the exclusively international character of the responsibilities of the Executive Director and other staff and shall not seek to influence them in the discharge of their responsibilities .
Translation: 每个成员方应尊重执行董事以及其他工作人员职责的纯粹国际性，不应寻求影响其在履行职责过程中的行为。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 Privileges and immunities 1 - The Organization shall have legal personality . It shall in particular have the capacity to contract , to acquire and dispose of movable and immovable property and to institute legal proceedings .
Translation:
第十七条 特权与豁免权  
1. 本组织应具有法人资格。其尤其应具备缔约能力、取得和处置动产及不动产的能力以及提起法律诉讼的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Organization shall , as soon as possible after the entry into force of this Agreement , seek to conclude with the Government of the country in which the headquarters of the Organization is to be situated [ hereinafter referred to as ? the host Government ? an agreement [ hereinafter referred to as the ? Headquarters Agreement ? relating to such status , privileges and immunities of the Organization , of its Executive Director , its staff and experts , and of delegates of members , as are reasonably necessary for the purpose of discharging their functions .
Translation: 该组织应尽快在本协议生效后，与该组织总部所在地国家的政府[以下简称“东道国政府”]缔结一项协议[以下简称“总部协议”]，以确定该组织、其执行主任、其工作人员及专家以及成员国代表为履行其职能所合理必需的相应地位、特权与豁免权。

Query_Text_en: 3 - Pending the conclusion of the Headquarters Agreement referred to in paragraph 2 of this article , the Organization shall request the host Government to grant , within the limits of its national legislation , exemption from taxation on remuneration paid by the Organization to its employees , and on the assets , income and other property of the Organization .
Translation: 在总部协定第二款所述协定达成前，该组织应请求东道国政府在其国家法律允许范围内，对组织支付给员工的薪酬以及组织的资产、收入和其他财产，免除税收。

Query_Text_en: 4 - The Organization may also conclude , with one or more countries , agreements to be approved by the Council relating to such privileges and immunities as may be necessary for the proper functioning of this Agreement .
Translation: 本组织还可与一个或多个国家缔结由理事会批准的协议，以规定确保本协议有效运行所需享有的特权和豁免权。

Query_Text_en: 5 - If the headquarters of the Organization is moved to another country which is a member of the Organization , that member shall , as soon as possible , conclude with the Organization a headquarters agreement to be approved by the Council .
Translation: 如果该组织的总部迁往另一成员国，该成员国应尽快与该组织缔结一份总部协议，并经理事会批准。

Query_Text_en: 6 - The Headquarters Agreement shall be independent of this Agreement .
Translation: 第六条 总部协议应独立于本协议。

Query_Text_en: or c ] In the event of the Organization ceasing to exist .
Translation: 如果本组织终止存在。

Query_Text_en: and b ] The Special Account .
Translation: 以及专项账户（b]）。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Executive Director shall be responsible for the administration of these accounts and the Council shall make provision in its rules of procedure therefor .
Translation: 执行主任应负责管理这些账户，理事会应在议事规则中对此作出规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 Forms of payment 1 - Contributions to the Administrative Account shall be payable in freely unable currencies and shall be exempt from foreign exchange restrictions .
Translation: 第十九条 支付形式 1 - 缴入管理账户的款项应以可自由使用货币支付，并免受外汇管制。

Query_Text_en: 2 - Financial contributions to the Special Account shall be payable in freely usable currencies and shall be exempt from foreign exchange restrictions .
Translation: 对特别账户的资金缴款应以可自由使用货币进行支付，并免受外汇限制。

Query_Text_en: 3 - The Council may also decide to accept other forms of contributions to the Special Account , including scientific and technical equipment or manpower , to meet the requirements of approved projects .
Translation: 理事会可决定接受其他形式的贡献至特别账户，包括科学技术设备或人力资源，以满足获批项目的需要。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 Audit and publication of accounts 1 - The Council shall appoint auditors for the purpose of auditing its books of account .
Translation:
第二十条 审计与账目公布  
1. 理事会应任命审计员，负责审计其账目。

Query_Text_en: 2 - An independently audited statement of the Administrative Account and of the Special Account shall be made available to members as soon as possible after the close of each jute year , but not later than six months after that date , and be considered for approval by the Council at its next session , as appropriate .
Translation: 每个黄麻年度结束后，应尽快向成员提供行政账户和特别账户的独立审计报告，但不得晚于该日期后六个月，并应在适当时由理事会于其下次会议审议批准。

Query_Text_en: A summary of the audited accounts and balance sheet shall thereafter be published .
Translation: 经审计的财务报表和资产负债表摘要应予公布。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 Administrative Account 1 - The expenses necessary for the administration of this Agreement shall brought into the Administrative Account and shall be met by annual contributions from members in accordance with their respective constitutional or institutional procedures assessed in accordance with paragraphs 3 , 4 and 5 of this article .
Translation:
第二十一条 行政账户一  
本协议管理所必需的费用应计入行政账户一，并由各成员根据各自的宪法或机构程序，按照本条第3、4、5款的规定评估后，通过年度分摊缴款予以承担。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The expenses of delegations to the Council , the Committee on Projects and to the committees and working groups referred to in article 3 , paragraph 2 , shall be met by the members concerned .
Translation: 向理事会、项目委员会以及本公约第三条第二款所述委员会和工作组派遣代表团的费用，应由相关成员承担。

Query_Text_en: In cases where a member requests special services from the Organization , the Council shall require that member to pay the costs of such services .
Translation: 在会员向本组织请求提供特别服务的情况下，理事会应要求该会员承担相关服务的费用。

Query_Text_en: 3 - During the second half of each financial year , the Council shall approve the administrative budget of the Organization for the following financial year and shall assess the contribution of each member to that budget .
Translation: 在每个财政年度的下半年，理事会应当批准本组织下一年度的行政预算，并确定各会员国应承担的份额。

Query_Text_en: 4 - The contribution of each member to the administrative budget for each financial year shall be in the proportion which the number of its votes at the time the administrative budget for that financial year is approved bears to the total votes of all the members .
Translation: 各成员在每一年度行政预算中的缴纳会费比例，应按照该财政年度行政预算获得批准时该成员所持有的投票权数量与全体成员总投票权数量的比例确定。

Query_Text_en: In assessing contributions , the votes of each member shall be calculated without regard to the suspension of any member 's voting rights or any redistribution of votes resulting therefrom .
Translation: 在评估认缴份额时，各成员的投票权应按其原有票数计算，不因任何成员投票权暂停或由此导致的投票权重新分配而受影响。

Query_Text_en: 5 - The initial contribution of any member joining the Organization after the entry into force of this Agreement shall be assessed by the Council on the basis of the number of votes to be held by it and the period remaining in the current financial year , but the assessment made upon other members for the current financial year shall not thereby be altered .
Translation: 本协议生效后加入组织的任何会员国初始会费，应由理事会根据其持有的投票权数量及当前财政年度剩余期限进行评定，但不得因此改变对其他会员国当前财政年度会费的原有评定结果。

Query_Text_en: 6 - Contributions to the first administrative budget shall become due on a date to be decided by the Council at its first session .
Translation: 6 - 首次行政预算的缴纳款项应于理事会首次会议确定的日期缴纳。

Query_Text_en: Contributions to subsequent administrative budgets shall become due on the first day of each financial year .
Translation: 后续行政预算的缴纳应于每个财政年度首日到期。

Query_Text_en: Contributions of members in respect of the financial year in which they join the Organization shall be due on the date on which they become members .
Translation: 会员加入本组织所在财政年度的应缴款项，应于其成为会员之日缴纳。

Query_Text_en: 7 - If a member has note paid its full contribution to the administrative budget within two months after such contribution becomes due in accordance with paragraph 6 of this article , the Executive Director shall request that member to make payment as quickly as possible .
Translation: 如果某一成员未在该供款到期后两个月内缴纳其全部供款，则执行主任应要求该成员尽快支付。

Query_Text_en: If the member has still not paid its contribution within two months after such request , it shall be requested to state the reasons for its inability to make payment .
Translation: 如会员在收到催缴通知后两个月内仍未缴纳会费，应要求其说明无法缴费的原因。

Query_Text_en: If at the expiry of six months from the due date of contribution that member has still not paid its contribution , its voting rights shall be suspended unless the Council , by special vote , decides otherwise .
Translation: 如会员国在应缴日期起满六个月仍未缴纳会费，应暂停其表决权，除非理事会通过特别表决作出其他决定。

Query_Text_en: If that member still fails to pay its contribution at the expiry of a period of one month from the date of suspension of its voting rights , all rights of that member under this Agreement shall be suspended by the Council until such time as it has paid in full its contribution , unless the Council , by special vote , decides otherwise .
Translation: 如该会员在其投票权被暂停之日起满一个月时仍未缴纳应缴款项，则其在本协议项下的所有权利应由理事会暂停，直至其全额缴纳应缴款项为止，除非理事会以特别表决方式决定另行处理。

Query_Text_en: 8 - A member whose rights have been suspended under paragraph 7 of this article shall in particular remain liable to pay its contribution .
Translation: 根据本条第7款被暂停权利的会员，仍需继续履行缴纳会费的义务。

Query_Text_en: and b ] The Project Sub-Account .
Translation: 以及b] 项目子账户。

Query_Text_en: 2 - All expenditures for the Pre-Project Sub-Account shall be reimbursed from the Project Sub-Account if projects are subsequently approved and funded .
Translation: 如果项目后续获得批准并获得资金，项目前期子账户的所有支出应从项目子账户报销。

Query_Text_en: If within six months of the entry into force of this Agreement the Council does not receive any funds for the Pre-Project Sub-Account , it shall review the situation and take appropriate action .
Translation: 如果在本协议生效后六个月内，理事会未收到预项目子账户的任何资金，应审查相关情况并采取适当措施。

Query_Text_en: 3 - All receipts pertaining to specific identifiable projects shall be brought into the Special Account .
Translation: 3 - 所有与特定可识别项目相关的收入应转入专项账户。

Query_Text_en: All expenditures incurred on such projects , including remuneration and travel expenses of consultants and experts , shall be charged to the Special Account .
Translation: 在这些项目上发生的所有支出，包括咨询顾问和专家的报酬及差旅费用，均应计入特别账户。

Query_Text_en: ; and c ] Voluntary contributions .
Translation: ；以及c] 自愿捐款

Query_Text_en: 5 - The Council shall , by special vote , establish terms and conditions on which it would , when and where appropriate , sponsor projects for loan financing , where a member or members have voluntarily assumed full obligations and responsibilities for such loans .
Translation: 理事会应通过特别表决，制定相关条款和条件，以便在适当的时候和情况下，资助贷款融资项目，前提是某一成员或多个成员自愿承担此类贷款的全部义务和责任。

Query_Text_en: The Organization shall have no obligations for such loans .
Translation: 该机构不承担此类贷款的任何义务。

Query_Text_en: 6 - The Council may nominate and sponsor any entity with the consent of that entity , including a member or members , to receive loans for the financing of approved projects and to undertake all the obligations involved , except that the Organization shall reserve to itself the right to monitor the use of resources and to follow up on the implementation of projects so financed .
Translation: 理事会可经该实体同意，提名并资助任何实体（包括一个或多个成员），为其获取获批项目融资贷款并承担相关义务，但本组织应保留监督资源使用及跟进相关项目实施情况的权利。

Query_Text_en: However , the Organization shall not be responsible for guarantees given by individual members or other entities .
Translation: 然而，本组织不对个别成员或其他实体所作的担保承担责任。

Query_Text_en: 7 - No member shall be responsible by reason of its membership in the Organization for any liability arising from borrowing or lending by any other member or entity in connection with projects .
Translation: 任何成员均不因属于本组织成员而需对其他成员或实体与项目相关的借贷行为所产生的责任承担责任。

Query_Text_en: 8 - In the event that voluntary unearmarked funds are offered to the Organization , the Council may accept such funds .
Translation: 如本组织收到自愿提供的非指定用途资金，理事会可接受此类资金。

Query_Text_en: Such funds may be utilised for pre-project activities as well as for approved projects .
Translation: 此类资金可用于项目前期准备工作以及已批准的项目。

Query_Text_en: 9 - The Executive Director shall endeavor to seek , on such terms and conditions as the Council may decide , adequate and assured finance for projects approved by the Council .
Translation: 执行主任应按照理事会决定的条款和条件，努力为理事会批准的项目寻求充足可靠的经费保障。

Query_Text_en: 10 - The resources of the Special Account shall be used only for approved projects or for Pre-Project activities .
Translation: 专项账户的资金仅限用于经批准的项目或项目前期工作。

Query_Text_en: 11 - Contributions for specified approved projects shall be used only for the projects for which they were originally intended unless otherwise decided by the Council in agreement with the contributor .
Translation: 指定核准项目的捐款仅限用于最初指定用途，除非经管理机构与捐助方协商一致另作决定。

Query_Text_en: After the complection of a project , the Organization shall return to each contributor for specific projects the balance of any funds remaining pro rata to each contributor 's share in the total of the contributions originally made available for financing that project , unless otherwise agreed to by the contributor .
Translation: 项目完成后，除非出资方另有约定，组织应按各出资方对该项目最初出资总额的比例，将剩余资金的余额退还给各出资方。

Query_Text_en: 12 - The Council may , when appropriate , review the financing of the Special Account .
Translation: 理事会可在适当时候审查特别账户的资金情况。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 Projects 1 - In order to achieve the objectives set out in article 1 , the Council shall , on a continuing basis and in accordance with the provisions of article 14 , paragraph 1 , identify , arrange for the preparation and implementation of , and , with a view to ensuring their effectiveness , follow up projects in the fields of research and development , market promotion and cost reduction and other relevant projects approved by the Council .
Translation: 为实现第一条所规定的目标，理事会应根据第十四条第一款的规定，持续开展研发、市场推广、成本降低及其他理事会批准的相关项目的识别、组织筹备和执行工作，并通过跟进措施确保其有效性。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Executive Director shall submit proposals on projects referred to in paragraph 1 of this article to the Committee on Projects .
Translation: 执行主任应就本条第1款所述项目向项目委员会提交提案。

Query_Text_en: Such proposals shall be circulated to all members at least two months before the session of the Committee at which they are to be considered .
Translation: 此类提案应在委员会审议前至少提前两个月分发给所有成员。

Query_Text_en: On the basis of these proposals , the Committee shall decide which pre-project activities shall be undertaken .
Translation: 根据这些提案，委员会应决定应开展哪些项目前期活动。

Query_Text_en: Such pre-project activities shall be arranged by the Executive Director in accordance with rules and regulations to be adopted by the Council .
Translation: 此类项目前期工作应由执行主任根据理事会将制定的规章制度负责安排。

Query_Text_en: 3 - The results of the pre-project activities , including detailed coatings , possible benefits , duration , location and possible executing agencies , shall be submitted by the Executive Director to the Committee after circulation to all members at least two months before the session of the Committee at which they are to be considered .
Translation: 项目前期活动的成果，包括详细规划、可能的效益、持续时间、地点及可能的执行机构，应由执行主任在向所有成员传阅后，至少在委员会会议召开前两个月提交给委员会审议。

Query_Text_en: 4 - The Committee shall consider the results of such pre-project activities and make recommendations on the projects to the Council .
Translation: 4. 委员会应审议此类项目前期活动的成果，并向理事会提出项目建议。

Query_Text_en: 5 - The Council shall consider the recommendations and shall , by special vote , decide on the proposed projects for financing in accordance with article 22 and article 27 .
Translation: 理事会应审议相关建议，并以特别投票方式根据第二十二条和第二十七条的规定，决定拟议的融资项目。

Query_Text_en: 6 - The Council shall decide on the relative priorities of projects .
Translation: 理事会应确定项目的相对优先顺序。

Query_Text_en: 7 - Initially , the Council shall give priority to projects prepared by FAO and ITC for the Preparatory Meetings on Jute and Jute Products under the Integrated Programme for Commodities and to such other viable projects as the Council may approve .
Translation: 初期，委员会应优先考虑粮农组织和国际贸易中心为综合商品方案下的黄麻及黄麻制品筹备会议所准备的项目，以及委员会可能批准的其他可行项目。

Query_Text_en: 8 - The Council shall obtain the approval of a member before approving a project in the territory of that member .
Translation: 理事会应在某一成员境内批准项目之前，先获得该成员的批准。

Query_Text_en: 9 - The Council may , by special vote , terminate its sponsorship of any project .
Translation: 9 - 理事会可通过特别表决终止其对任何项目的资助。

Query_Text_en: c ] Finding new end-uses and improving existing products .
Translation: 开发新的应用领域并改进现有产品。

Query_Text_en: Article 25 Market promotion Projects relating to market promotion should , inter alia , be aimed at the maintenance and expansion of markets for existing products and finding markets for new products .
Translation: 第二十五条 与市场推广相关的项目应包括但不限于旨在维护现有产品市场、拓展其规模，并为新产品开拓市场。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 Cost reduction The projects relating to cost reduction should , inter alia , be aimed at , in so far as appropriate , improving processes and techniques relating to agricultural productivity and fiber quality , as well as improvement of processes and techniques relating to labor , material and capital costs in the jute manufacturing industry , and developing and maintaining , for the use of members , information on the most efficient processes and techniques currently available to the jute economy .
Translation:
第二十六条 成本削减  
与成本削减相关的项目应以以下目标为导向（其中包括但不限于）：在可行范围内，改进与农业生产力及纤维质量相关的生产流程和技术；优化黄麻制造业中涉及劳动力、材料和资本成本的生产流程与技术；同时为成员国开发并维护当前黄麻经济领域内最高效工艺技术的相关信息，供其使用。

Query_Text_en: e ] They shall have the potential for improving the general competitiveness or market prospects of jute and jute products .
Translation: 其应具备提升黄麻及黄麻制品整体竞争力或市场前景的潜力。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 Committee on Projects 1 - A Committee on Projects [ hereinafter referred to as ? the Committee ? is hereby established .
Translation: 第二十八条 项目一委员会 - 现成立项目委员会[以下简称"委员会"]。

Query_Text_en: It shall be responsible to , and work under the general director of , the Council .
Translation: 它应对接理事会总干事负责，并在其领导下开展工作。

Query_Text_en: 2 - Participation in the Committee shall be open to all members .
Translation: 委员会的参与应向全体成员开放。

Query_Text_en: The rules of procedure as well as the distribution of votes and voting procedure of the Committee shall be those of the Council mutatis mutandis .
Translation: 委员会的议事规则、投票权分配及投票程序应与理事会的相应规则相同，并作必要调整。

Query_Text_en: The Committee shall , unless it decides otherwise , meet four times a year or at the request of the Council .
Translation: 委员会应每年举行四次会议，除非另有决定，或应理事会要求召开。

Query_Text_en: and c ] To make recommendations to the Council relating to projects .
Translation: [C] 就项目向理事会提出建议。

Query_Text_en: Article 29 Relationship with the Common Fund for Commodities When the Common Fund becomes operational , the Organization shall take full advantage of the facilities of the Common Fund according to the principles set out in the Agreement establishing the Common Fund for Commodities .
Translation:
第二十九条 与共同商品基金的关系  
当共同商品基金正式运作时，本组织应根据《共同商品基金协定》中规定的原则，充分利用该基金提供的各项资源。

Query_Text_en: Article 30 Consideration of stabilization , competition with synthetics and other issues 1 - The Council shall continue consideration of the questions of stabilization of prices and supplies of jute and jute products for export with a view to finding solutions therefor .
Translation:
第三十条 稳定、与合成材料竞争及其他问题  
1. 理事会应继续审议用于出口的黄麻及黄麻制品价格和供应稳定问题，以寻求解决方案。

Query_Text_en: Following such consideration , any solution agreed upon that entails measures not already explicitly provided for in this Agreement may only be implemented by an amendment of this Agreement pursuant to article 42 .
Translation: 经此考量后，凡达成之任何解决方案若涉及本协议未明确规定之措施，均须通过修订本协议的方式予以实施，具体程序应遵循第四十二条之规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Council shall consider issues relating to competition between jute and jute products on the one hand , and synthetics and substitutes on the other .
Translation: 理事会应审议黄麻及黄麻制品与合成材料及替代品之间的竞争问题。

Query_Text_en: 3 - The Council shall make arrangements for the continuing consideration of other important issues relevant to jute and jute products .
Translation: 理事会应作出安排，对与黄麻及黄麻制品相关的其他重要议题进行持续审议。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 Statistics , studies and information 1 - The Council shall establish close relationships with appropriate international organizations , in particular FAO , in order to help ensure the availability of recent and reliable data and information on all factors affecting jute and jute products .
Translation: 第三十一条 统计、研究与信息 一、理事会应与相关国际组织，尤其是粮农组织，建立密切联系，以确保获取影响黄麻及黄麻制品的所有因素的最新可靠数据和信息。

Query_Text_en: The Organization shall collect , collate and as necessary publish such statistical information on production , trade , supply , stocks , consumption and prices of jute , jute products , synthetics and substitutes as is necessary for the operation of this Agreement .
Translation: 本组织应收集、整理并视情发布为实施本协议所需之黄麻、黄麻制品、合成纤维及替代品的生产、贸易、供应、库存、消费及价格等统计信息。

Query_Text_en: 2 - Members shall furnish statistics and information within a reasonable time to the fullest extent possible not inconsistent with their national legislation .
Translation: 成员方应在合理时间内尽可能充分地提供统计资料和信息，且不与其国内立法相抵触。

Query_Text_en: 3 - The Council shall arrange to have studies undertaken of the trends and of the short - and longterm problems of the world jute economy .
Translation: 理事会应安排对世界黄麻经济发展趋势以及短期和长期问题开展研究。

Query_Text_en: 4 - The Council shall ensure that no information published shall prejudice the confidentiality of the operations of persons or companies producing , processing or marketing jute , jute products , synthetics and substitutes .
Translation: 理事会应确保已发布的任何信息均不得损害从事黄麻、黄麻制品、合成材料及其替代品生产、加工或销售的个人或企业的运营保密性。

Query_Text_en: Article 32 Annual report and report on assessment and review 1 - The Council shall , within six months of the close of each jute year , publish an annual report on its activities and such other information as it considers appropriate .
Translation:
第三十二条 年度报告及评估审查报告  
理事会应在每个黄麻年度结束后六个月内，发布关于其活动的年度报告，并可包含其认为适当的其他信息。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Council shall annually assess and review the world jute situation and outlook , including the state of competition with synthetics and substitutes , and shall inform members of the results of the review .
Translation: 理事会应每年评估并审议全球黄麻形势及前景展望，包括与合成材料及替代品的竞争态势，并向成员通报审议结果。

Query_Text_en: 3 - The review shall be carried out in the light of information supplied by members in relation to national production , stocks , exports and imports , consumption and prices , of jute and jute products and synthetics and substitutes and such other information as may be available to the Council either directly or through the appropriate organizations in the United Nations system , including UNCTAD and FAO , and appropriate intergovernmental and non-governmental organizations .
Translation: 审查应根据成员国提供的与黄麻及黄麻制品、合成材料及替代品相关的国内生产、库存、进出口、消费及价格等信息进行，并可利用理事会直接获取或通过联合国系统内相关组织（包括联合国贸发会议和粮农组织）以及适当政府间和非政府组织所掌握的其他相关信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 33 Complaints and disputes Any complaint that a member has failed to fulfil its obligations under this Agreement and any dispute concerning the interpretation or application of this Agreement shall be referred to the Council for decision .
Translation:
第三十三条 投诉与争端  
任何关于成员未履行本协议义务的投诉，以及涉及本协议解释或适用的争端，均应提交理事会裁决。

Query_Text_en: Decisions of the Council on these matters shall be final and binding .
Translation: 理事会就这些事项作出的决定应为最终决定，并具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: Article 34 General obligations of members 1 - Members shall for the duration of this Agreement use their best endeavors and co-operate to promote the attainment of its objectives and to avoid action in contradiction to them .
Translation: 第三十四条 成员方一般义务 第一款 各成员方应在本协议有效期内尽最大努力并进行合作，以促进实现本协议的目标，并避免采取与之相悖的行动。

Query_Text_en: 2 - Members undertake to accept as binding decisions of the Council under the provisions of this Agreement , and shall seek to refrain from implementing measures which would have the effect of limiting or running counter to them .
Translation: 成员国承诺接受根据本协议规定由理事会作出的决定为具有约束力，并应避免采取任何可能限制或抵触这些决定的措施。

Query_Text_en: Article 35 Relief from obligations 1 - Where it is necessary on account of exceptional circumstances emergency or force majeure not expressly provided for in this Agreement , the Council may , by special vote , relieve a member of an obligation under this Agreement if it is satisfied by an explanation from that member regarding the reasons why the obligation can not be met .
Translation:
第三十五条 义务豁免第一款  
因本协议未明确规定的特殊情况、紧急状态或不可抗力需要时，理事会可在收到该成员关于无法履行义务原因的说明并认可后，通过特别表决免除其相关义务。

Query_Text_en: 2 - The Council , in granting relief to a member under paragraph 1 of this article , shall state explicitly the terms and conditions on which , and the period for which , the member is relieved of such obligation and the reasons for which the relief is granted .
Translation: 理事会根据本条第一款为成员提供减免时，应当明确载明该成员获得减免的具体条款和条件、减免期限以及减免理由。
