Query_Text_en: [ the enacting State lists the relevant public authorities of the host country that may enter into concession contracts by way of an exhaustive or indicative list of public authorities , a list of types or categories of public authority or a combination thereof ] .
Translation: 缔约国应以详尽清单、指示性清单、公共机构的类型或类别清单，或上述清单形式的组合，列出东道国可签订特许合同的相关公共机构。

Query_Text_en: [ the enacting State indicates the relevant sectors by way of an exhaustive or indicative list ] .
Translation: 立法国可通过详尽或指示性清单的形式指明相关行业。

Query_Text_en: 6II . Selection of the concessionaireModel provision 5 . Rules governing the selection proceedings [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 14 and chap . III , paras . 1-33 ] The selection of the concessionaire shall be conducted in accordance with model provisions 6-27 and , for matters not provided herein , in accordance with [ the enacting State indicates the provisions of its laws that provide for transparent and efficient competitive procedures for the award of government contracts ] .
Translation:
6. II 特许经营商选定程序规则  
示范条款5. 选定程序的规范要求（见立法指南第14项建议及第三章第1-33段）  
特许经营商的选定应按照示范条款6至27的规定进行；对于本条款未涵盖的事项，则应依据[执行国应指明其法律中关于政府合同授予的透明高效竞争程序的相关规定]执行。

Query_Text_en: 71 . Pre-selection of biddersModel provision 6 . Purpose and procedure of pre-selection [ see the Legislative Guide , chap . III , paras . 34-50 ] 1 . The contracting authority shall engage in pre-selection proceedings with a view to identifying bidders that are suitably qualified to implement the envisaged infrastructure project .
Translation:
6. 投标人预选的目的与程序[参见《立法指南》第三章第34至50段]  
采购方应开展投标人预选程序，以确定具备适当资格实施拟议基础设施项目的投标人。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The invitation to participate in the pre-selection proceedings shall be published in accordance with [ the enacting State indicates the provisions of its laws governing publication of invitation to participate in proceedings for the pre-qualification of suppliers and contractors ] .
Translation: 参与预选程序的邀请应按照[缔约方应指明其关于供应商和承包商预审程序参与邀请发布的法律规定条款]的规定予以发布。

Query_Text_en: and [ e ] The manner an ? place for solicitation of the pre-selection documents .
Translation: 以及 [e] 预选文件的索取方式和地点。

Query_Text_en: 5 . For matters not provided for in this model provision , the pre-selection proceedings shall be conducted in accordance with [ the enacting State indicates the provisions of its laws on government procurement governing the conduct of proceedings for the pre-qualification of suppliers and contractors ] .
Translation: 对于本示范条款未作规定的事项，预选程序应按照有关实施实体应指明其政府采购法律中关于供应商和承包商预审程序实施的相关规定执行。

Query_Text_en: 11Model provision 7 . Pre-selection criteria [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 15 and chap . III , paras . 34-40 , 43 and 44 ] In order to qualify for the selection proceedings , interested bidders must meet objectively justifiable criteria that the contracting authority considers appropriate in the particular proceedings , as stated in the pre-selection documents .
Translation:
第11条 模板条款7. 预选标准[参见立法指南第15项建议及第三章第34至40段、第43段和第44段]  
有意投标方必须满足合同授予方认为在特定招标程序中适当的、具有客观合理性的标准，这些标准已在预选文件中列明。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Appropriate managerial and organizational capability , reliability and experience , including previous experience in operating similar infrastructure facilities .
Translation: 具备适当的管理及组织能力、可靠性及经验，包括在运营同类基础设施项目方面的先前经验。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 8 . Participation of consortia [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 16 and chap . III , paras . 41 and 42 ] 1 . The contracting authority , when first inviting the participation of bidders in the selection proceedings , shall allow them to form bidding consortia . The information required from members of bidding consortia to demonstrate their qualifications in accordance with model provision 7 shall relate to the consortium as a whole as well as to its individual participants .
Translation: 第8款 投标联合体参与  招投标程序首次邀请投标人参与时，采购实体应允许其组建投标联合体。根据第7款模型条款要求各投标联合体成员提交的资格证明材料，既需涉及联合体整体，也需涵盖其各参与方。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Unless otherwise [ authorized by . . . [ the enacting State indicates the relevant authority ] and ] stated in the pre-selection documents , each member of a consortium may participate , either directly or indirectly , in only one consortium at the same time .
Translation: 除非经[缔约国指明的相关机构]授权并在预选文件中另有规定，联合体的每个成员均可参与，且在同一时间仅能直接或间接参与一个联合体。

Query_Text_en: A violation of this rule shall cause the disqualification of the consortium and of the individual members .
Translation: 违反本条规定将导致该联合体及其各成员方被取消资格。

Query_Text_en: 3 . When considering the qualifications of bidding consortia , the contracting authority shall consider the capabilities of each of the consortium members and assess whether the combined qualifications of the consortium members are adequate to meet the needs of all phases of the project .
Translation: 在考虑投标联合体的资格时，采购方应评估各成员的能力，并综合判断联合体成员的资格是否能够满足项目各阶段的需求。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 9 . Decision on pre-selection [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 17 [ for para . 2 ] and chap . III , paras . 47-50 ] 1 . The contracting authority shall make a decision with respect to the qualifications of each bidder that has submitted an application for pre-selection .
Translation:
示范条款9. 预选决策（参见《立法指南》建议17[第2段]及第三章第47至50段）  
1. 采购方应对提交预选申请的每位投标人的资格作出决定。

Query_Text_en: In reaching that decision , the contracting authority shall apply only the criteria that are set forth in the pre-selection documents .
Translation: 在作出该决定时，合同授予机构应仅适用预选文件中列明的标准。

Query_Text_en: All pre-selected bidders shall thereafter be invited by the contracting authority to submit proposals in accordance with model provisions 10-17 .
Translation: 所有预选的投标人均应由采购单位随后邀请，按照示范条款10至17提交建议书。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding paragraph 1 , the contracting authority may , provided that it has made an appropriate statement in the pre-selection documents to that effect , reserve the right to request proposals upon completion of the pre-selection proceedings only from a limited number14 of bidders that best meet the pre-selection criteria .
Translation: 尽管第1款有相关规定，采购方仍可在预选文件中作出相应声明的前提下，保留仅要求在预选程序完成后，从最符合预选标准的有限数量（14）的投标方中征集建议的权利。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , the contracting authority shall rate the bidders that meet the pre-selection criteria on the basis of the criteria applied to assess their qualifications and draw up the list of bidders that will be invited to submit proposals upon completion of the pre-selection proceedings .
Translation: 为此，采购单位应根据用于评估投标人资格的评审标准，对符合预选标准的投标人进行评分，并在预选程序结束后拟定邀请提交建议书的投标人名单。

Query_Text_en: In drawing up the list , the contracting authority shall apply only the manner of rating that is set forth in the pre-selection documents .
Translation: 在制定名单时，采购方仅能采用预选文件中载明的评分方式。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Procedures for requesting proposalsModel provision 10 . Single-stage and two-stage procedures for requesting proposals [ see the Legislativ ? Guide , recommendations 18 [ for para . 1 ] and 19 [ for paras . 2 and 3 ] and chap . III , paras . 51-58 ] 1 . The contracting authority shall provide a set of the request for proposals and related documents issued in accordance with model provision 11 to each pre-selected bidder that pays the price , if any , charged for those documents .
Translation: 10. 征求建议书的单阶段和双阶段程序 [参见立法指南，第18条建议（针对第1段）、第19条建议（针对第2段和第3段）及第三章第51至58段]  1. 采购机构应向支付费用（如有）的预选投标人，根据第11示范条款免费提供一套建议书征求文件及相关文件副本。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding the above , the contracting authority may use a two-stage procedure to request proposals from pre-selected bidders when the contracting authority does not deem it to be feasible to describe in the request for proposals the characteristics of the project such as project specifications , performance indicators , financial arrangements or contractual terms in a manner sufficiently detailed and precise to permit final proposals to be formulated .
Translation: 采购机构在认为无法以足够详细和精确的方式在建议征集中描述项目特征（如项目规格、绩效指标、财务安排或合同条款）从而使最终建议书得以制定时，可采用两阶段程序向预选的投标人征求建议。

Query_Text_en: 15 [ b ] The contracting authority may convene meetings and hold discussions with any of the bidders to clarify questions concerning the initial request for proposals or the initial proposals and accompanying documents submitted by the bidders .
Translation: 合同授予机构可与任何投标方召集会议并进行讨论，以便澄清有关初始建议征求书的问题，或投标方提交的初始建议书及随附文件中的问题。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Following examination of the proposals received , the contracting authority may review and , as appropriate , revise the initial request for proposals by deleting or modifying any aspect of the initial project specifications , performance indicators , financing requirements or other characteristics of the project , including the main contractual terms , and any criterion for evaluating and comparing proposals and for ascertaining the successful bidder , as set forth in the initial request for proposals , as well as by adding characteristics or criteria to it .
Translation: 在收到的提案经审查后，采购方有权对初始招标公告进行审查并视情修订，包括删除或修改初始项目规范、绩效指标、融资要求或项目其他特征（含主要合同条款），以及初始招标公告中所述的用于评估比较提案和确定中标方的任何标准，并可向其中增加相关特征或标准。

Query_Text_en: The contracting authority shall indicate in the record of the selection proceedings to be kept pursuant to model provision 26 the justification for any revision to the request for proposals .
Translation: 采购方应在根据第26号标准条款保存的资格预审程序记录中注明对建议征询书修订的依据。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] In the second stage of the proceedings , the contracting authority shall invite the bidders to submit final proposals with respect to a single set of project specifications , performance indicators or contractual terms in accordance with model provisions 11-17 .
Translation: 在招标程序第二阶段，采购方应要求投标方根据标准条款11至17，针对统一的项目要求、绩效指标或合同条款提交最终方案。

Query_Text_en: and the manner in which the criteria and thresholds are to be applied in the evaluation and rejection of proposals .
Translation: 以及在评估和拒绝提案过程中具体应用标准和门槛的方式。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 12 . Bid securities [ see the Legislative Guide , chap . III , para . 62 ] 1 . The request for proposals shall set forth the requirements with respect to the issuer and the nature , form , amount and other principal terms and conditions of the required bid security .
Translation:
示范条款12 投标担保要求  
[ 参见《立法指南》第三章第62段 ]  
1. 招标文件应明确规定投标担保的出具方以及所需投标担保的性质、形式、金额及其他主要条款和条件。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] Failure to provide required security for the fulfilment of the concession contract after the proposal has been accepted or to comply with any other condition prior to signing the concession contract specified in the request for proposals .
Translation: 在提案被接受后未能提供特许经营合同履约担保，或未满足招标文件中规定的签署特许经营合同前的其他任何条件。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 13 . Clarifications and modifications [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 21 and chap . III , paras . 71 and 72 ] The contracting authority may , whether on its own initiative or as a result of a request for clarification by a bidder , review and , as appropriate , revise any element of the request for proposals as set forth in model provision 11 .
Translation:
第十三条 澄清与修改（参见立法指南建议21及第三章第71、72段）  
采购实体可自行决定或应投标人提出的澄清请求，对根据示范条款11制定的采购建议书中的任何要素进行审查并根据需要进行修改。

Query_Text_en: Any such deletion , modification or addition shall be communicated to the bidders in the same manner as the request for proposals at a reasonable time prior to the deadline for submission of proposals .
Translation: 任何此类删除、修改或补充均应以征集建议书相同的方式，在提交建议书截止日期前的合理时间内通知投标人。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Quality of services and measures to ensure their continuity .
Translation: [d] 服务质量及确保其持续性的措施。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] The social and economic development potential offered by the proposals .
Translation: 建议中所蕴含的社会和经济发展潜力。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 15 . Comparison and evaluation of proposals [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 24 and chap . III , paras . 78-82 ] 1 . The contracting authority shall compare and evaluate each proposal in accordance with the evaluation criteria , the relative weight accorded to each such criterion and the evaluation process set forth in the request for proposals .
Translation:
第15条 提案比选与评审（参见《立法指南》第24项建议及第三章第78至82段）  
1. 采购单位应当按照采购要约中载明的评审标准、各标准所赋予的权重及评审程序，对各份提案进行比选和评审。

Query_Text_en: 2 . For the purposes of paragraph 1 , the contracting authority may establish thresholds with respect to quality , technical , financial and commercial aspects .
Translation: 根据第1款规定，缔约方得就质量、技术、财务及商业方面设定相关门槛。

Query_Text_en: Proposals that fail to achieve the thresholds shall be regarded as non-responsive and rejected from the selection procedure .
Translation: 未达到要求标准的提案将被视为非实质性响应，并从遴选程序中予以排除。

Query_Text_en: 22Model provision 16 . Further demonstration of fulfilment of qualification criteria [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 25 and chap . III , paras . 78-82 ] The contracting authority may require any bidder that has been pre-selected to demonstrate again its qualifications in accordance with the same criteria used for pre-selection . The contracting authority shall disqualify any bidder that fails to demonstrate again its qualifications if requested to do so . 231 . The contracting authority shall rank all responsive proposals on the basis of the evaluation criteria and invite for final negotiation of the concession contract the bidder that has attained the best rating . Final negotiations shall not concern those contractual terms , if any , that were stated as non-negotiable in the final request for proposals .
Translation: 合同授予机构可要求任何已通过预选的投标方依照预选时使用的相同标准，再次证明其资格（参见立法指南，建议25和第三章第78至82段）。若投标方被要求后仍无法再次证明其资格，合同授予机构应取消其参选资格。合同授予机构应依据评估标准对所有符合要求的建议书进行排序，并邀请获得最佳评分的投标方进行特许经营合同的最终谈判。如存在任何非协商条款，最终谈判不得涉及招标文件中已明确列为不可协商的合同条款。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If it becomes apparent to the contracting authority that the negotiations with the bidder invited will not result in a concession contract , the contracting authority shall inform the bidder of its intention to terminate the negotiations and give the bidder reasonable time to formulate its best and final offer .
Translation: 如果采购方认为与受邀投标方的谈判无法达成特许经营合同，采购方应当通知投标方其终止谈判的意向，并给予投标方合理期限提交其最优且最终报价。

Query_Text_en: If the contracting authority does not find that proposal acceptable , it shall terminate the negotiations with the bidder concerned .
Translation: 如果采购方认为该方案不可接受，应终止与相关投标方的谈判。

Query_Text_en: The contracting authority shall then invite for negotiations the other bidders in the order of their ranking until it arrives at a concession contract or rejects all remaining proposals .
Translation: 合同授权机构应随后按其排名顺序依次邀请其他投标人进行谈判，直至达成特许经营合同或拒绝所有剩余提案。

Query_Text_en: The contracting authority shall not resume negotiations with a bidder with which negotiations have been terminated pursuant to this paragraph .
Translation: 采购单位不得与根据本款规定终止谈判的投标人重新进行谈判。

Query_Text_en: 26 [ g ] In other cases where the [ the enacting State indicates the relevant authority ] authorizes such an exception for compelling reasons of public interest .
Translation: 在其他情况下，如果立法国指明相关主管机关出于公共利益的有力理由授权作出此类例外规定。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Establish evaluation criteria against which proposals shall be evaluated and ranked .
Translation: 制定评估标准，依据该标准对建议进行评估和排序。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Unsolicited proposals30Model provision 20 . Admissibility of unsolicited proposals [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 30 and chap . III , paras . 97-109 ] As an exception to model provisions 6 to 17 , the contracting authority31 is authorized to consider unsolicited proposals pursuant to the procedures set forth in model provisions 21 to 23 , provided that such proposals do not relate to a project for which selection procedures have been initiated or announced .
Translation:
第20条 非招标建议书的可受理性[参见《立法指南》建议30及第三章第97至109段]  
作为对示范条款6至17的例外情形，采购实体有权根据第21至23条规定的程序审议非招标建议书，前提是此类建议书不涉及已启动或公告了选择程序的项目。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 21 . Procedures for determining the admissibility of unsolicited proposals [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendations 31 [ for paras . 1 and 2 ] and 32 [ for para . 3 ] and chap . III , paras . 110-112 ] 1 . Following receipt and preliminary examination of an unsolicited proposal , the contracting authority shall promptly inform the proponent whether or not the project is considered to be potentially in the public interest .
Translation:
示范条款21. 非征招建议书准入判定程序[参见立法指南第31项建议（对应第1、2段）及第32项建议（对应第3段），以及第三章第110-112段]  
1. 缔约方在收到并初步审查非征招建议书后，应立即通知提议方该项目是否被认为具有潜在公共利益。

Query_Text_en: 322 . If the project is considered to be potentially in the public interest under paragraph 1 , the contracting authority shall invite the proponent to submit as much information on the proposed project as is feasible at this stage to allow the contracting authority to make a proper evaluation of the proponent 's qualifications33 and the technical and economic feasibility of the project and to determine whether the project is likely to be successfully implemented in the manner proposed in terms acceptable to the contracting authority .
Translation: 如果根据第1款认定某项目可能符合公共利益，采购单位应邀请提案方在此阶段尽可能提供有关拟议项目的相关信息，以便采购单位能够对提案方的资格33和技术经济可行性进行适当评估，并确定该项目是否可能以采购单位可接受的方式成功实施。

Query_Text_en: For this purpose , the proponent shall submit a technical and economic feasibility study , an environmental impact study and satisfactory information regarding the concept or technology contemplated in the proposal .
Translation: 为此，提案方应提交技术经济可行性研究报告、环境影响评估报告以及提案中拟议概念或技术的满意信息。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In considering an unsolicited proposal , the contracting authority shall respect the intellectual property , trade secrets or other exclusive rights contained in , arising from or referred to in the proposal .
Translation: 在考虑非应邀提案时，合同当局应当对提案中包含的、源于提案的或提案中提及的知识产权、商业秘密或其他专有权利予以尊重和保护。

Query_Text_en: Therefore , the contracting authority shall not make use of information provided by or on behalf of the proponent in connection with its unsolicited proposal other than for the evaluation of that proposal , except with the consent of the proponent .
Translation: 因此，采购方不得将提案方提供或代表提案方提供的与非应邀建议书相关的任何信息用于除对该建议书进行评估以外的其他用途，除非获得提案方同意。

Query_Text_en: Except as otherwise agreed by the parties , the contracting authority shall , if the proposal is rejected , return to the proponent the original and any copies of documents that the proponent submitted and prepared throughout the procedure .
Translation: 除非双方另有约定，若提案被拒绝，合同授予方应将提案方在程序过程中提交和准备的所有文件的原件及副本退还给提案方。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] The proposed concept or technology is not truly unique or new .
Translation: [b] 所提出的概念或技术并非真正独特或新颖。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The proponent shall be invited to participate in the selection proceedings initiated by the contracting authority pursuant to paragraph 1 and may be given an incentive or a similar benefit in a manner described by the contracting authority in the request for proposals in consideration for the development and submission of the proposal .
Translation: 提议方应受邀参与由采购方根据第1款启动的遴选程序，并可依据建议征询书中所述方式，因其开发并提交建议书的行为，获得采购方提供的激励措施或类似利益。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 23 . Unsolicited proposals involving intellectual property , trade secrets or other exclusive rights [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendations 34 [ for paras . 1 and 2 ] and 35 [ for paras . 3 and 4 ] and chap . III , paras . 115-117 ] 1 . If the contracting authority determines that the conditions of model provision 22 , paragraph 1 [ a ] and [ b ] , are not met , it shall not be required to carry out a selection procedure pursuant to model provisions 6 to 17 .
Translation:
**模型条款23. 未邀请提案涉及知识产权、商业秘密或其他专有权利**  
（参见《立法指南》建议34[适用于第1段和第2段]和建议35[适用于第3段和第4段]以及第三章第115至117段）  
1. 若采购方确定未满足模型条款22第1款[a]和[b]项的条件，则其无需按照模型条款6至17的规定启动选择程序。

Query_Text_en: However , the contracting authority may still seek to obtain elements of comparison for the unsolicited proposal in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 2 to 4 of this model provision .
Translation: 不过，采购方仍可依据本条款第2至4款的规定，要求获取未邀请建议书的比较要素。

Query_Text_en: 342 . Where the contracting authority intends to obtain elements of comparison for the unsolicited proposal , the contracting authority shall publish a description of the essential output elements of the proposal with an invitation for other interested parties to submit proposals within [ a reasonable period ] [ the enacting State indicates a certain amount of time ] .
Translation: 当合同授权机构拟为非主动提出的建议书获取比较要素时，该机构应发布该建议书的基本产出要素描述，并邀请其他有兴趣的当事人在[合理期限]内提交建议书，[实施国可规定具体时限]。

Query_Text_en: 3 . If no proposals in response to an invitation issued pursuant to paragraph 2 of this model provision are received within [ a reasonable period ] [ the amount of time specified in paragraph 2 above ] , the contracting authority may engage in negotiations with the original proponent .
Translation: 3. 如果根据本条款第2段发出的邀请未在[合理期限]或[本条款上述第2段规定的期限]内收到任何响应建议书，采购方可以与原建议方进行谈判。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If the contracting authority receives proposals in response to an invitation issued pursuant to paragraph 2 , the contracting authority shall invite the proponents to negotiations in accordance with the provisions set forth in model provision 19 .
Translation: 缔约机关如收到对根据第二款发出的邀请函作出响应的建议书，应当按照第19款示范条款的规定，邀请提案方进行谈判。

Query_Text_en: In the event that the contracting authority receives a sufficiently large number of proposals , which appear prima facie to meet its infrastructure needs , the contracting authority shall request the submission of proposals pursuant to model provisions 10 to 17 , subject to any incentive or other benefit that may be given to the person who submitted the unsolicited proposal in accordance with model provision 22 , paragraph 2 .
Translation: 若缔约授权机构收到足够数量的提案，且经初步审查符合其基础设施需求，则应根据第10至17款范本要求提交提案，但需依据第22款第2段范本的规定，向提交非主动提案的人员提供激励或其他利益的情况除外。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Miscellaneous provisionsModel provision 24 . Confidentiality [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 36 and chap . III , para . 118 ] The contracting authority shall treat proposals in such a manner as to avoid the disclosure of their content to competing bidders .
Translation: 第24条 保密义务[参见《立法指南》建议36及第三章第118段] 采购方应以适当方式处理提案，避免其内容泄露给其他竞标者。

Query_Text_en: Any discussions , communications and negotiations between the contracting authority and a bidder pursuant to model provisions 10 , paragraph 3 , 17 , 18 , 19 or 23 , paragraphs 3 and 4 , shall be confidential .
Translation: 根据示范条款第10条第3款、第17条、第18条、第19条或第23条第3款和第4款的规定，采购方与投标方之间进行的任何磋商、沟通及谈判均应保密。

Query_Text_en: Unless required by law or by a court order or permitted by the request for proposals , no party to the negotiations shall disclose to any other person any technical , price or other information in relation to discussions , communications and negotiations pursuant to the aforementioned provisions without the consent of the other party . Model provision 25 . Notice of contract award [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 37 and chap . III , para . 119 ] Except for concession contracts awarded pursuant to model provision 18 , subparagraph [ c ] , the contracting authority shall cause a notice of the contract award to be published in accordance with [ the enacting State indicates the provisions of its laws on procurement proceedings that govern the publication of contract award notices ] . The notice shall identify the concessionaire and include a summary of the essential terms of the concession contract .
Translation: 除非法律要求、法院命令或征求建议书允许，否则谈判各方在未经对方同意的情况下，不得向任何其他人员披露根据上述条款进行的讨论、沟通和谈判中涉及的任何技术、价格或其他信息。范本条款25. 合同授予通知[参见立法指南，建议37及第三章第119段]  除根据范本条款18之子条款[c]授予的特许合同外，缔约机关应当按照[立法国应注明其采购程序法中有关合同授予通知发布的法律规定]发布合同授予通知。该通知应注明特许经营商，并包含特许合同主要条款的摘要。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 26 . Record of selection and award proceedings [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 38 and chap . III , paras . 120-126 ] The contracting authority shall keep an appropriate record of information pertaining to the selection ? nd award proceedings in accordance with [ the enacting State indicates the provisions of its laws on public procurement that govern record of procurement proceedings ] .
Translation: 示范条款26：招标与授标程序记录的保存  [参见《立法指南》，建议38及第三章第120至126段]  合同授权机构应根据[立法国指明其公共采购法律中关于采购程序记录保存的相关规定]，妥善保存与招标及授标程序相关的档案信息。

Query_Text_en: 35Model provision 27 . Review procedures [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 39 and chap . III , paras . 127-131 ] A bidder that claims to have suffered , or that may suffer , loss or injury due to a breach of a duty imposed on the contracting authority by the law may seek review of the contracting authority 's acts or failures to act in accordance with [ the enacting State indicates the provisions of its laws governing the review of decisions made in procurement proceedings ] .
Translation:
第三十五条 第二十七条 审查程序（参见《立法指南》第39项建议及第三章第127至131段）  
因采购方违反法律规定义务而导致损失或损害的投标人，或可能遭受此类损失或损害的投标人，可依据[缔约国应指明其法律中关于采购程序决定审查的相关规定]，对采购方的行为或不作为申请审查。

Query_Text_en: [ s ] The rights and obligations of the parties with respect to confidential information [ see model provision 24 ] .
Translation: 各方关于保密信息的权利与义务（见范本条款第24条）。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 29 . Governing law [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 41 and chap . IV , paras . 5-8 ] The concession contract is governed by the law of [ the enacting State ] unless otherwise provided in the concession contract .
Translation: 示范条款29. 适用法律[参见立法指南建议41及第四章第5至8段] 本特许权合同应适用[制定法律的国家]的法律，除非合同另有规定。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 30 . Organization of the concessionaire [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendations 42 and 43 and chap . IV , paras . 12-18 ] The contracting authority may require that the successful bidder establish a legal entity incorporated under the laws of [ the enacting State ] , provided that a statement to that effect was made in the pre-selection documents or in the request for proposals , as appropriate .
Translation:
特许权授予条款30 经营实体组织[参见立法指南第42条和43条及第四章第12-18段]  
缔约方可要求中标方依据[立法国]法律成立法人实体，前提是相关声明已在预选文件或建议邀请书中作出，视情况而定。

Query_Text_en: Any requirement relating to the minimum capital of such a legal entity and the procedures for obtaining the approval of the contracting authority to its statute and by-laws and significant changes therein shall be set forth in the concession contract consistent with the terms of the request for proposals .
Translation: 涉及此类法人实体最低注册资本的要求，及其章程和内部规章的制定程序、对其中重大变更的批准程序等内容，应在特许权协议中明确规定，并需符合招标文件中的相关条款。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 31 . Ownership of assets39 [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 44 and chap . IV , paras . 20-26 ] The concession contract shall specify , as appropriate , which assets are or shall be public property and which assets are or shall be the private property of the concessionaire .
Translation:
条款31. 资产所有权[ 参见《立法指南》第44项建议及第四章第20至26段 ]  
特许权合同应明确规定哪些资产属于国有资产或应成为国有资产，哪些资产属于或应属于特许权人的私有财产。

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] Assets , if any , that the concessionaire may retain or dispose of upon expiry or termination of the concession contract .
Translation: [ c ] 特许经营商在特许经营合同到期或终止时可保留或处置的资产（如有）。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 32 . Acquisition of rights related to the project site [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 45 and chap . IV , paras . 27-29 ] 1 . The contracting authority or other public authority under the terms of the law and the concession contract shall make available to the concessionaire or , as appropriate , shall assist the concessionaire in obtaining such rights related to the project site , including title thereto , as may be necessary for the implementation of the project .
Translation:
示范条款32 项目场地相关权利的取得以及（参见《立法指南》建议45及第四章第27至29段）  
1. 根据法律规定和特许合同条款，缔约机关或其他公共机关应向特许经营者提供为实施项目所需的相关权利，包括产权，或根据具体情况协助其取得此类权利。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 33 . Easements40 [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendation 45 and chap . IV , para . 30 ] Variant A1 . The contracting authority or other public authority under the terms of the law and the concession contract shall make available to the concessionaire or , as appropriate , shall assist the concessionaire to enjoy the right to enter upon , transit through or do work or fix installations upon property of third parties , as appropriate and required for the implementation of the project in accordance with [ the enacting State indicates the provisions of its laws that govern easements and other similar rights enjoyed by public utility companies and infrastructure operators under its laws ] .
Translation:
示范条款33. 地役权40  
[参见立法指南第45项建议及第四章第30段]  
变体A1. 根据法律规定及特许权合同条款，缔约机关或其他公共机关应向特许经营者提供进入、通行或在第三方财产上进行工作或安装设施的权利，或视情况协助特许经营者享有此类权利，以符合项目实施需求。具体依据为[实施国应指明其法律中关于地役权及其他类似权利的规定，这些权利由其法律赋予公用事业公司和基础设施运营商享有]。

Query_Text_en: Variant B1 . The concessionaire shall have the right to enter upon , transit through or do work or fix installations upon property of third parties , as appropriate and required for the implementation of the project in accordance with [ the enacting State indicates the provisions of its laws that govern easements and other similar rights enjoyed by public utility companies and infrastructure operators under its laws ] .
Translation: 特许权授予方有权根据项目实施的需要和实际情况，进入、通行或在第三方财产上进行施工或安装设施，具体操作应依据[ 执行国应指明其法律中关于地役权及其他类似权利的规定，这些权利由公共事业公司和基础设施运营商依据其法律规定享有 ]。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any easements that may be required for the implementation of the project shall be created in accordance with [ the enacting State indicates the provisions of its laws that govern the creation of easements for reasons of public interest ] .
Translation: 因实施本项目所需设立的地役权，应按照[制定法规的缔约国应指明其法律中关于因公共利益需要而设立地役权的相关规定]的规定设立。

Query_Text_en: Model provision 34 . Financial arrangements [ see the Legislative Guide , recommendations 46 , 47 and 48 and chap . IV , paras . 33-51 ] 1 . The concessionaire shall have the right to charge , receive or collect tariffs or fees for the use of the facility or its services in accordance with the concession contract , which shall provide for methods and formulas for the establishment and adjustment of those tariffs or fees [ in accordance with the rules established by the competent regulatory agency ] .
Translation: 34.财务安排[参见立法指南，建议46、47和48及第四章第33-51段]  1. 特许经营者有权依据特许权协议收取、获得或收取设施及其服务使用的费用或关税，该协议应规定这些费用或关税设立及调整的方法和公式[依据相关监管机构制定的规则]。

Query_Text_en: 412 . The contracting authority shall have the power to agree to make direct payments to the concessionaire as a substitute for , or in addition to , tariffs or fees for the use of the facility or its services .
Translation: 缔约机关有权同意直接向特许经营者支付款项，作为设施或其服务使用费的替代或补充。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Requests the Secretary-General to arrange for the widest possible distribution of the Arbitration Rules .
Translation: 要求秘书长确保仲裁规则得到尽可能广泛的分发。

Query_Text_en: -------------------- 1 \/ Official Records of the General Assembly , Thirty-first Session , Supplement No. 17 [ A\/31\/17 ] , chap . V , sect . C.

Article 1 1 . Where the parties to a contract have agreed in writing \* that disputes in relation to that contract shall be referred to arbitration under the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules , then such disputes shall be settled in accordance with these Rules subject to such modification as the parties may agree in writing .
Translation: 如果合同当事人已以书面形式约定，与该合同相关的争议应依据联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则提交仲裁，则此类争议应按照本规则的规定予以解决，除非双方以书面形式另有约定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . These Rules shall govern the arbitration except that where any of these Rules is in conflict with a provision of the law applicable to the arbitration from which the parties can not derogate , that provision shall prevail . -------------------- \* MODEL ARBITRATION CLAUSEAny dispute , controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this contract , or the breach , termination or invalidity thereof , shall be settled by arbitration in accordance with the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules as at present in force . Note - Parties may wish to consider adding : [ a ] The appointing authority shall be . . . [ name of institution or person ] ; [ b ] The number of arbitrators shall be . . . [ one or three ] ; [ c ] The place of arbitration shall be . . . [ town or country ] ; [ d ] The language [ s ] to be used in the arbitral proceedings shall be . . .
Translation: 2. 除非本规则中的任何规定与适用于该仲裁且当事人不可偏离的法律规定相冲突，否则本规则应管辖仲裁程序。  **标准仲裁条款范本**  因本合同产生、涉及本合同或与本合同的违约、终止、无效有关的任何争议、争议或索赔，均应根据现行有效的联合国国际贸易法委员会仲裁规则通过仲裁解决。  ***注：双方可考虑补充以下内容：***  [a] 指定机构应为……[机构名称或人士姓名]；  [b] 仲裁员人数应为……[一至三人]；  [c] 仲裁地应为……[城市或国家]；  [d] 仲裁程序中使用的语言应为……[语言名称]**。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 1 . For the purposes of these Rules , any notice , including a notification , communication or proposal , is deemed to have been received if it is physically delivered to the addressee or if it is delivered at his habitual residence , place of business or mailing address , or , if none of these can be found after making reasonable inquiry , then at the addressee's last-known residence or place of business .
Translation: 本规则所称通知（包括告知、通信或提议等），若实际交付至收件人，或送至其惯常居所、营业场所或邮寄地址，即视为已送达；若经合理查询仍无法找到上述任何地址，则送至收件人最后已知的居所或营业场所即视为已送达。

Query_Text_en: Notice shall be deemed to have been received on the day it is so delivered .
Translation: 通知应视为已在送达之日收到。

Query_Text_en: 2 . For the purposes of calculating a period of time under these Rules , such period shall begin to run on the day following the day when a notice , notification , communication or proposal is received .
Translation: 根据本规则计算期间时，该期间应自收到通知、告知、通信或提议的次日起开始起算。

Query_Text_en: If the last day of such period is an official holiday or a non-business day at the residence or place of business of the addressee , the period is extended until the first business day which follows .
Translation: 若本期间的最后一日恰逢收件人住所或营业地的法定节假日或非营业日，则该期间应顺延至之后的首个营业日。

Query_Text_en: Official holidays or non-business days occurring during the running of the period of time are included in calculating the period .
Translation: 在计算该时间段时，若其间发生法定节假日或非工作日，这些日期均计入该时间段的计算中。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 1 . The party initiating recourse to arbitration [ hereinafter called the `` claimant '' ] shall give to the other party [ hereinafter called the `` respondent '' ] a notice of arbitration .
Translation: 第三条第一款 提起仲裁的一方（以下简称"申请人"）应向另一方（以下简称"被申请人"）提交仲裁通知。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Arbitral proceedings shall be deemed to commence on the date on which the notice of arbitration is received by the respondent .
Translation: 仲裁程序应视为自被申请人收到仲裁通知之日起开始。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] A proposal as to the number of arbitrators [ i. e. one or three ] , if the parties have not previously agreed thereon .
Translation: 关于仲裁员人数的提议（即一名或三名），如果各方此前未就此达成一致。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The statement of claim referred to in article 18 .
Translation: 第十八条所指的索赔声明。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 The parties may be represented or assisted by persons of their choice .
Translation: 第四条 各方可由其选定的人员进行代表或协助。

Query_Text_en: such communication must specify whether the appointment is being made for purposes of representation or assistance .
Translation: 此类沟通必须明确说明该任命的目的在于代表还是协助。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 If the parties have not previously agreed on the number of arbitrators [ i. e. one or three ] , and if within fifteen days after the receipt by the respondent of the notice of arbitration the parties have not agreed that there shall be only one arbitrator , three arbitrators shall be appointed .
Translation: 第五条 如果双方当事人先前未就仲裁员人数（即一名或三名）达成一致，且自被申请人收到仲裁通知之日起十五日内，双方未就仅指定一名仲裁员达成一致，则应指定三名仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] If no appointing authority has been agreed upon by the parties , the name or names of one or more institutions or persons , one of whom would serve as appointing authority .
Translation: 如各方未就任命机构达成一致，则应列明一个或多个机构或个人的名称，其中一名将担任任命机构。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If within thirty days after receipt by a party of a proposal made in accordance with paragraph 1 the parties have not reached agreement on the choice of a sole arbitrator , the sole arbitrator shall be appointed by the appointing authority agreed upon by the parties .
Translation: 如一方收到根据第1款提出的建议后三十日内，双方未能就独任仲裁员人选达成一致，则独任仲裁员应由双方约定的指定机构任命。

Query_Text_en: If no appointing authority has been agreed upon by the parties , or if the appointing authority agreed upon refuses to act or fails to appoint the arbitrator within sixty days of the receipt of a party 's request therefor , either party may request the Secretary-General of the Permanent Court of Arbitration at The Hague to designate an appointing authority .
Translation: 如果各方未就指定机构达成一致，或已达成一致的指定机构拒绝履行职责或未在收到某方请求之日起六十日期满时任命仲裁员，则任何一方均可请求海牙常设仲裁法院秘书长指定一名指定机构。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The appointing authority shall , at the request of one of the parties , appoint the sole arbitrator as promptly as possible .
Translation: 任命机构应一方当事人的请求，尽快指定独任仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: 4 . In making the appointment , the appointing authority shall have regard to such considerations as are likely to secure the appointment of an independent and impartial arbitrator and shall take into account as well the advisability of appointing an arbitrator of a nationality other than the nationalities of the parties .
Translation: 在进行任命时，任命机构应当考虑确保任命独立公正的仲裁员所需的各种因素，并应同时考虑任命不同于各方国籍的第三方国籍仲裁员的必要性。

Query_Text_en: Article 7 1 . If three arbitrators are to be appointed , each party shall appoint one arbitrator .
Translation: 如需任命三名仲裁员，每一方应各任命一名仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: The two arbitrators thus appointed shall choose the third arbitrator who will act as the presiding arbitrator of the tribunal .
Translation: 经任命的两位仲裁员应共同选定第三位仲裁员，其将担任仲裁庭首席仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: or [ b ] If no such authority has been previously designated by the parties , or if the appointing authority previously designated refuses to act or fails to appoint the arbitrator within thirty days after receipt of a party 's request therefor , the first party may request the Secretary-General of the Permanent Court of Arbitration at The Hague to designate the appointing authority .
Translation: 如各方此前未指定此类机构，或此前指定的任命机构拒绝履职，或在收到某一方就此提出的请求后三十日内未任命仲裁员，则首先提出请求的一方可以请求海牙常设仲裁法院秘书长指定任命机构。

Query_Text_en: The first party may then request the appointing authority so designated to appoint the second arbitrator .
Translation: 第一方可以随后请求指定的任命机构任命第二位仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: In either case , the appointing authority may exercise its discretion in appointing the arbitrator .
Translation: 在任何情况下，指定机构均可在指定仲裁员时行使自由裁量权。

Query_Text_en: 3 . If within thirty days after the appointment of the second arbitrator the two arbitrators have not agreed on the choice of the presiding arbitrator , the presiding arbitrator shall be appointed by an appointing authority in the same way as a sole arbitrator would be appointed under article 6 .
Translation: 如果在第二名仲裁员被任命后的三十天内，两位仲裁员未能就首席仲裁员的选择达成一致，则首席仲裁员应由指定机构按照第六条规定任命单一仲裁员的方式予以任命。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 1 . When an appointing authority is requested to appoint an arbitrator pursuant to article 6 or article 7 , the party which makes the request shall send to the appointing authority a copy of the notice of arbitration , a copy of the contract out of or in relation to which the dispute has arisen and a copy of the arbitration agreement if it is not contained in the contract .
Translation: 第八条 1. 当任命机构根据第六条或第七条被要求指定仲裁员时，提出请求的一方应向任命机构提交仲裁通知副本、争议产生于或相关的合同副本，以及仲裁协议副本（如仲裁协议未包含在合同中）。

Query_Text_en: The appointing authority may require from either party such information as it deems necessary to fulfil its function .
Translation: 任命机构可要求任何一方提供其认为履行职能所必要的信息。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Where the names of one or more persons are proposed for appointment as arbitrators , their full names , addresses and nationalities shall be indicated , together with a description of their qualifications .
Translation: 当提议任命一人或多人为仲裁员时，应列明其全名、地址及国籍，并附资格说明。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 A prospective arbitrator shall disclose to those who approach him in connexion with his possible appointment any circumstances likely to give rise to justifiable doubts as to his impartiality or independence . An arbitrator , once appointed or chosen , shall disclose such circumstances to the parties unless they have already been informed by him of these circumstances .
Translation: 第九条 拟任仲裁员在与其就可能的任命事宜进行接触时，应向有关各方披露可能导致对其公正性或独立性产生合理怀疑的任何情况。仲裁员一经选定，亦应向有关各方披露此类情况，除非有关各方已被告知该等情形。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 1 . Any arbitrator may be challenged if circumstances exist that give rise to justifiable doubts as to the arbitrator's impartiality or independence .
Translation: 第十条第一款 任何仲裁员如有情况导致对其公正性或独立性存在正当理由的怀疑，均可被提出回避。

Query_Text_en: 2 . A party may challenge the arbitrator appointed by him only for reasons of which he becomes aware after the appointment has been made .
Translation: 一方仅能在其获知该理由的时间晚于任命作出之时的情况下，对其所指定的仲裁员提出异议。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 1 . A party who intends to challenge an arbitrator shall send notice of his challenge within fifteen days after the appointment of the challenged arbitrator has been notified to the challenging party or within fifteen days after the circumstances mentioned in articles 9 and 10 became known to that party .
Translation: 第十一章 第一条 一方当事人拟对仲裁员提出异议的，应当自被申请人仲裁员的指定通知送达该当事人之日起十五日内，或者自该当事人知晓本规则第九条和第十条所述情形之日起十五日内，提交提出异议的书面通知。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The challenge shall be notified to the other party , to the arbitrator who is challenged and to the other members of the arbitral tribunal .
Translation: 本质疑应通知对方当事人、被质疑的仲裁员以及仲裁庭其他成员。

Query_Text_en: The notification shall be in writing and shall state the reasons for the challenge .
Translation: 通知应以书面形式提交，并说明提出异议的理由。

Query_Text_en: 3 . When an arbitrator has been challenged by one party , the other party may agree to the challenge .
Translation: 当一方对仲裁员提出挑战时，另一方可以同意接受该挑战。

Query_Text_en: The arbitrator may also , after the challenge , withdraw from his office .
Translation: 仲裁员在遭到挑战后，也可辞去职务。

Query_Text_en: In neither case does this imply acceptance of the validity of the grounds for the challenge .
Translation: 无论哪种情况，均不表明承认挑战理由的有效性。

Query_Text_en: In both cases the procedure provided in article 6 or 7 shall be used in full for the appointment of the substitute arbitrator , even if during the process of appointing the challenged arbitrator a party had failed to exercise his right to appoint or to participate in the appointment .
Translation: 在两种情况下，替代仲裁员的指定均须完整适用第六条或第七条所规定的程序，即使在指定被质疑的仲裁员过程中，某一方未能行使指定权利或参与指定程序。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] In all other cases , by the appointing authority to be designated in accordance with the procedure for designating an appointing authority as provided for in article 6 .
Translation: 其他情形下，由依照第六条规定程序指定的任命机关进行指定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If the appointing authority sustains the challenge , a substitute arbitrator shall be appointed or chosen pursuant to the procedure applicable to the appointment or choice of an arbitrator as provided in articles 6 to 9 except that , when this procedure would call for the designation of an appointing authority , the appointment of the arbitrator shall be made by the appointing authority which decided on the challenge .
Translation: 如果任命机构维持对仲裁员的挑战，替代仲裁员应按照第六至第九条规定的仲裁员任命或选定程序进行指定或选定，但若该程序需要指定任命机构，则应由作出挑战决定的任命机构指定仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 1 . In the event of the death or resignation of an arbitrator during the course of the arbitral proceedings , a substitute arbitrator shall be appointed or chosen pursuant to the procedure provided for in articles 6 to 9 that was applicable to the appointment or choice of the arbitrator being replaced .
Translation: 第十三条第一款 在仲裁程序进行期间，如遇仲裁员死亡或辞职，应当按照第六条至第九条中适用于被替换仲裁员任命或选任的程序，任命或选任一名替补仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In the event that an arbitrator fails to act or in the event of the de jure or de facto impossibility of his performing his functions , the procedure in respect of the challenge and replacement of an arbitrator as provided in the preceding articles shall apply .
Translation: 在仲裁员未能履行职责，或其履行职责存在法律上或事实上的不可能性时，应按照前文所述条款规定的程序对仲裁员提出异议并予以更换。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 If under articles 11 to 13 the sole or presiding arbitrator is replaced , any hearings held previously shall be repeated ; if any other arbitrator is replaced , such prior hearings may be repeated at the discretion of the arbitral tribunal .
Translation: 第十四条 根据第十一至第十三条的规定，如更换独任仲裁员或首席仲裁员，则此前已进行的所有听证应当重新进行；如更换其他仲裁员，此前听证是否重新进行由仲裁庭自行决定。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 1 . Subject to these Rules , the arbitral tribunal may conduct the arbitration in such manner as it considers appropriate , provided that the parties are treated with equality and that at any stage of the proceedings each party is given a full opportunity of presenting his case .
Translation: 第十五条第一款 在遵守本规则的前提下，仲裁庭可以采取其认为适当的方式进行仲裁，但须平等对待双方当事人，并确保在程序的任何阶段均给予每一方当事人充分陈述其案情的机会。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If either party so requests at any stage of the proceedings , the arbitral tribunal shall hold hearings for the presentation of evidence by witnesses , including expert witnesses , or for oral argument .
Translation: 如果任何一方在程序的任何阶段提出请求，仲裁庭应举行听证会，以便证人（包括专家证人）提交证据或进行口头辩论。

Query_Text_en: In the absence of such a request , the arbitral tribunal shall decide whether to hold such hearings or whether the proceedings shall be conducted on the basis of documents and other materials .
Translation: 若未收到相关申请，仲裁庭应决定是否举行听证会，或是否基于书面材料和其他证据进行审理程序。

Query_Text_en: 3 . All documents or information supplied to the arbitral tribunal by one party shall at the same time be communicated by that party to the other party .
Translation: 一方当事人向仲裁庭提交的所有文件或信息，应当同时向另一方当事人提交。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 1 . Unless the parties have agreed upon the place where the arbitration is to be held , such place shall be determined by the arbitral tribunal , having regard to the circumstances of the arbitration .
Translation: 除非当事人就仲裁地达成合意，否则仲裁地应由仲裁庭根据仲裁的具体情况确定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The arbitral tribunal may determine the locale of the arbitration within the country agreed upon by the parties .
Translation: 仲裁庭可以在双方约定的国家境内确定仲裁地点。

Query_Text_en: It may hear witnesses and hold meetings for consultation among its members at any place it deems appropriate , having regard to the circumstances of the arbitration .
Translation: 仲裁庭可根据仲裁的具体情况，自行决定在任何其认为适当的地点听取证人陈述并举行成员间的磋商会议。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The arbitral tribunal may meet at any place it deems appropriate for the inspection of goods , other property or documents .
Translation: 仲裁庭可以在其认为合适的任何地点进行货物、其他财产或文件的查验。

Query_Text_en: The parties shall be given sufficient notice to enable them to be present at such inspection .
Translation: 各方应获得充分的通知，以确保其能够到场参与相关查验。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The award shall be made at the place of arbitration .
Translation: 裁决应在仲裁地作出。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 1 . Subject to an agreement by the parties , the arbitral tribunal shall , promptly after its appointment , determine the language or languages to be used in the proceedings .
Translation: 第十七条第一款 除非当事人另有约定，仲裁庭应在组成后尽快确定仲裁程序中使用的语言或语言。

Query_Text_en: This determination shall apply to the statement of claim , the statement of defense , and any further written statements and , if oral hearings take place , to the language or languages to be used in such hearings .
Translation: 本决定应适用于诉状、答辩状及任何进一步的书面陈述；如举行口头听证，则适用于该等听证中所使用的语言。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The arbitral tribunal may order that any documents annexed to the statement of claim or statement of defense , and any supplementary documents or exhibits submitted in the course of the proceedings , delivered in their original language , shall be accompanied by a translation into the language or languages agreed upon by the parties or determined by the arbitral tribunal .
Translation: 仲裁庭可裁定任何附于诉状或答辩状的文件，以及在程序中提交的补充文件或证据材料，若以原文本形式提交，则须附有当事人约定的语言或由仲裁庭确定的语言译本。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 1 . Unless the statement of claim was contained in the notice of arbitration , within a period of time to be determined by the arbitral tribunal , the claimant shall communicate his statement of claim in writing to the respondent and to each of the arbitrators .
Translation: 第十八条 除非仲裁请求已包含在仲裁通知中，申请人应自仲裁庭确定的期限内将其仲裁请求书面提交被申请人及每位仲裁员。

Query_Text_en: A copy of the contract , and of the arbitration agreement if not contained in the contract , shall be annexed thereto .
Translation: 合同副本以及未包含在合同内的仲裁协议副本应作为附件附于此。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] The relief or remedy sought .
Translation: 所寻求的救济或补救措施。

Query_Text_en: The claimant may annex to his statement of claim all documents he deems relevant or may add a reference to the documents or other evidence he will submit .
Translation: 申请人可在诉状中附上其认为相关的所有文件，或注明拟提交的文件及其他证据。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 1 . Within a period of time to be determined by the arbitral tribunal , the respondent shall communicate his statement of defense in writing to the claimant and to each of the arbitrators .
Translation: 第十九条第一款 被申请人应于仲裁庭确定的期限内，以书面形式向申请人及每位仲裁员提交答辩书。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The statement of defense shall reply to the particulars [ b ] , [ c ] and [ d ] of the statement of claim [ article 18 , para . 2 ] . The respondent may annex to his statement the documents on which he relies for his defense or may add a reference to the documents or other evidence he will submit .
Translation: 答辩状应答复起诉状所述的[b]、[c]和[d]项内容（第十八条第二款）。答辩人可将其所依据的文件作为附件附于答辩状中，或注明将提交的文件或其他证据。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In his statement of defense , or at a later stage in the arbitral proceedings if the arbitral tribunal decides that the delay was justified under the circumstances , the respondent may make a counter-claim arising out of the same contract or rely on a claim arising out of the same contract for the purpose of a set-off .
Translation: 被申请人可在其答辩陈述中，或在仲裁程序后续阶段（如仲裁庭认定延迟具有正当理由时），基于同一合同提出反请求，或主张抵销请求以实现债务抵销。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The provisions of article 18 , paragraph 2 , shall apply to a counter-claim and a claim relied on for the purpose of a set-off .
Translation: 本法第十八条第二款的规定应适用于反诉及用于抵消的债权主张。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 During the course of the arbitral proceedings either party may amend or supplement his claim or defense unless the arbitral tribunal considers it inappropriate to allow such amendment having regard to the delay in making it or prejudice to the other party or any other circumstances .
Translation: 第二十条 在仲裁程序进行过程中，除非仲裁庭考虑到延迟提出此类修改或对另一方当事人造成不利影响或其他情形而认为不宜允许此类修改，否则任何一方均可对其主张或答辩进行修改或补充。

Query_Text_en: However , a claim may not be amended in such a manner that the amended claim falls outside the scope of the arbitration clause or separate arbitration agreement .
Translation: 然而，不得以修改后的主张超出仲裁条款或单独仲裁协议范围的方式对主张进行修改。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 1 . The arbitral tribunal shall have the power to rule on objections that it has no jurisdiction , including any objections with respect to the existence or validity of the arbitration clause or of the separate arbitration agreement .
Translation: 第二十一条第一款 仲裁庭有权裁定其无管辖权的异议，包括对仲裁条款或独立仲裁协议的存在或有效性提出的异议。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The arbitral tribunal shall have the power to determine the existence or the validity of the contract of which an arbitration clause forms a part .
Translation: 仲裁庭有权裁定其中包含仲裁条款的合同是否存在或有效。

Query_Text_en: For the purposes of article 21 , an arbitration clause which forms part of a contract and which provides for arbitration under these Rules shall be treated as an agreement independent of the other terms of the contract .
Translation: 根据第二十一条的规定，作为合同组成部分的仲裁条款如规定根据本规则进行仲裁，则应视为独立于合同其他条款的协议。

Query_Text_en: 3 . A plea that the arbitral tribunal does not have jurisdiction shall be raised not later than in the statement of defense or , with respect to a counter-claim , in the reply to the counter-claim .
Translation: 对仲裁庭无管辖权的异议应当在答辩状中提出；或者在反请求的情形下，在对反请求的答复中提出。

Query_Text_en: 4 . In general , the arbitral tribunal should rule on a plea concerning its jurisdiction as a preliminary question . However , the arbitral tribunal may proceed with the arbitration and rule on such a plea in their final award .
Translation: 通常，仲裁庭应将关于其管辖权的请求作为先决问题先行裁定。但仲裁庭也可继续进行仲裁程序，并在最终裁决中一并作出裁定。

Query_Text_en: Article 22 The arbitral tribunal shall decide which further written statements , in addition to the statement of claim and the statement of defense , shall be required from the parties or may be presented by them and shall fix the periods of time for communicating such statements .
Translation: 第二十二条 仲裁庭应决定除申诉书和答辩书外，要求当事人提交或由当事人提交的其他书面陈述，并确定提交此类陈述的期限。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 The periods of time fixed by the arbitral tribunal for the communication of written statements [ including the statement of claim and statement of defense ] should not exceed forty-five days .
Translation: 第二十三条 仲裁庭规定的提交书面陈述的期限[包括诉状和答辩状]不应超过四十五日。

Query_Text_en: However , the arbitral tribunal may extend the time-limits if it concludes that an extension is justified .
Translation: 不过，如果仲裁庭认为延期具有正当理由，它可以延长相关期限。

Query_Text_en: Article 24 1 . Each party shall have the burden of proving the facts relied on to support his claim or defense .
Translation: 每一方当事人应当就其所依据的事实承担举证责任，以支持其主张或抗辩。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The arbitral tribunal may , if it considers it appropriate , require a party to deliver to the tribunal and to the other party , within such a period of time as the arbitral tribunal shall decide , a summary of the documents and other evidence which that party intends to present in support of the facts in issue set out in his statement of claim or statement of defense .
Translation: 仲裁庭如认为必要，可要求一方当事人在仲裁庭决定的期限内，向仲裁庭及另一方提交其拟在诉状或答辩状中列明的争议事实所依据的文件和其他证据的摘要。

Query_Text_en: 3 . At any time during the arbitral proceedings the arbitral tribunal may require the parties to produce documents , exhibits or other evidence within such a period of time as the tribunal shall determine .
Translation: 在仲裁程序进行期间的任何时候，仲裁庭可要求双方在指定的期限内提交文件、书证或其他证据。

Query_Text_en: Article 25 1 . In the event of an oral hearing , the arbitral tribunal shall give the parties adequate advance notice of the date , time and place thereof .
Translation: 第二十五条第一款 如需举行口头听证，仲裁庭应当提前充分通知各方当事人听证会的日期、时间及地点。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If witnesses are to be heard , at least fifteen days before the hearing each party shall communicate to the arbitral tribunal and to the other party the names and addresses of the witnesses he intends to present , the subject upon and the languages in which such witnesses will give their testimony .
Translation: 如需传唤证人，每一方当事人应至少在听证会十五日前向仲裁庭及另一方当事人提交拟出庭证人的姓名、地址、作证内容及所用语言。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The arbitral tribunal shall make arrangements for the translation of oral statements made at a hearing and for a record of the hearing if either is deemed necessary by the tribunal under the circumstances of the case , or if the parties have agreed thereto and have communicated such agreement to the tribunal at least fifteen days before the hearing .
Translation: 仲裁庭可根据案件情况，如认为有必要对听证会上的口头陈述安排口译服务或对听证会进行记录；或双方已达成合意并在听证会至少十五日前将此合意通知仲裁庭时，应作出相应安排。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Hearings shall be held in camera unless the parties agree otherwise .
Translation: 听证会应当私下进行，除非各方另有约定。

Query_Text_en: The arbitral tribunal may require the retirement of any witness or witnesses during the testimony of other witnesses .
Translation: 仲裁庭可在其他证人作证期间，要求任何证人退庭。

Query_Text_en: The arbitral tribunal is free to determine the manner in which witnesses are examined .
Translation: 仲裁庭有权决定询问证人的方式。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Evidence of witnesses may also be presented in the form of written statements signed by them .
Translation: 证人证词也可通过其签署的书面陈述形式提交。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The arbitral tribunal shall determine the admissibility , relevance , materiality and weight of the evidence offered .
Translation: 仲裁庭有权决定提交的证据的可采性、关联性、重要性及证明力。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 1 . At the request of either party , the arbitral tribunal may take any interim measures it deems necessary in respect of the subject-matter of the dispute , including measures for the conservation of the goods forming the subject-matter in dispute , such as ordering their deposit with a third person or the sale of perishable goods .
Translation: 第二十六条 一方当事人请求时，仲裁庭可就争议事项采取其认为必要的临时措施，包括对作为争议标的的货物采取保全措施，例如责令委托第三人保管或变卖易腐货物等。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Such interim measures may be established in the form of an interim award .
Translation: 此类临时措施可以采取临时裁决的形式设立。

Query_Text_en: The arbitral tribunal shall be entitled to require security for the costs of such measures .
Translation: 仲裁庭有权要求就相关措施的费用提供担保。

Query_Text_en: 3 . A request for interim measures addressed by any party to a judicial authority shall not be deemed incompatible with the agreement to arbitrate , or as a waiver of that agreement .
Translation: 任何一方请求司法机关采取临时措施，不应视为与仲裁协议不相容，或视为放弃该仲裁协议。

Query_Text_en: Article 27 1 . The arbitral tribunal may appoint one or more experts to report to it , in writing , on specific issues to be determined by the tribunal .
Translation: 仲裁庭可以任命一名或多名专家，就仲裁庭指定的具体问题向其提交书面报告。

Query_Text_en: A copy of the expert 's terms of reference , established by the arbitral tribunal , shall be communicated to the parties .
Translation: 仲裁庭制定的专家职权范围副本应提交各方当事人。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The parties shall give the expert any relevant information or produce for his inspection any relevant documents or goods that he may require of them .
Translation: 各方应向专家提供其要求的任何相关资料，或出示供其查验的任何相关文件或货物。

Query_Text_en: Any dispute between a party and such expert as to the relevance of the required information or production shall be referred to the arbitral tribunal for decision .
Translation: 关于所需信息或文件的相关性，一方与专家之间产生的任何争议，均应提交仲裁庭裁决。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Upon receipt of the expert 's report , the arbitral tribunal shall communicate a copy of the report to the parties who shall be given the opportunity to express , in writing , their opinion on the report .
Translation: 仲裁庭收到专家报告后，应向各方当事人传达报告副本，并应给予各方当事人以书面形式就该报告发表意见的机会。

Query_Text_en: A party shall be entitled to examine any document on which the expert has relied in his report .
Translation: 任何一方均有权查阅专家在其报告中所依据的任何文件。

Query_Text_en: 4 . At the request of either party the expert , after delivery of the report , may be heard at a hearing where the parties shall have the opportunity to be present and to interrogate the expert .
Translation: 应任何一方请求，鉴定人在提交报告后，可在听证会上陈述意见，届时各方有权出席并就鉴定事项进行质询。

Query_Text_en: At this hearing either party may present expert witnesses in order to testify on the points at issue .
Translation: 在此次听证会上，任何一方均可提交专家证人，以便就争议焦点作证。

Query_Text_en: The provisions of article 25 shall be applicable to such proceedings .
Translation: 本法第二十五条的规定应适用于此类程序。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 1 . If , within the period of time fixed by the arbitral tribunal , the claimant has failed to communicate his claim without showing sufficient cause for such failure , the arbitral tribunal shall issue an order for the termination of the arbitral proceedings .
Translation: 第二十八条第一款：如申诉方在仲裁庭规定的时间内未能陈述其诉求且未说明充分理由，仲裁庭应当作出终止仲裁程序的决定。

Query_Text_en: If , within the period of time fixed by the arbitral tribunal , the respondent has failed to communicate his statement of defense without showing sufficient cause for such failure , the arbitral tribunal shall order that the proceedings continue .
Translation: 如被申请人未在仲裁庭规定的期限内提交答辩状且未说明正当理由，仲裁庭应当裁定继续进行仲裁程序。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If one of the parties , duly notified under these Rules , fails to appear at a hearing , without showing sufficient cause for such failure , the arbitral tribunal may proceed with the arbitration .
Translation: 如果一方当事人经本规则依法通知后未出席听证会且未说明正当理由，仲裁庭可继续进行仲裁程序。

Query_Text_en: 3 . If one of the parties , duly invited to produce documentary evidence , fails to do so within the established period of time , without showing sufficient cause for such failure , the arbitral tribunal may make the award on the evidence before it .
Translation: 若一方当事人经依法传唤提交书面证据后，未在规定期限内提交且未说明正当理由，仲裁庭可依据现有证据作出裁决。

Query_Text_en: Article 29 1 . The arbitral tribunal may inquire of the parties if they have any further proof to offer or witnesses to be heard or submissions to make and , if there are none , it may declare the hearings closed .
Translation: 仲裁庭可询问双方是否有进一步的证据提交、证人传唤或陈述作出，如无，则可宣布听证会结束。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The arbitral tribunal may , if it considers it necessary owing to exceptional circumstances , decide , on its own motion or upon application of a party , to reopen the hearings at any time before the award is made .
Translation: 仲裁庭如认为存在特殊情况有必要，可在裁决作出前主动或根据一方申请决定重新开庭审理。

Query_Text_en: Article 30 A party who knows that any provision of , or requirement under , these Rules has not been complied with and yet proceeds with the arbitration without promptly stating his objection to such non-compliance , shall be deemed to have waived his right to object .
Translation: 一方知晓本规则的任何条款或要求未获遵守，却在未及时对上述不合规行为提出异议的情况下继续进行仲裁程序，应视为已放弃其异议权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 1 . When there are three arbitrators , any award or other decision of the arbitral tribunal shall be made by a majority of the arbitrators .
Translation: 第三十一条第一款 仲裁庭由三名仲裁员组成的，其裁决或其他决定应由仲裁员的多数票作出。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In the case of questions of procedure , when there is no majority or when the arbitral tribunal so authorizes , the presiding arbitrator may decide on his own , subject to revision , if any , by the arbitral tribunal .
Translation: 在程序问题上，若无法形成多数意见或经仲裁庭授权，首席仲裁员有权自行作出决定，仲裁庭可予以修订。

Query_Text_en: Article 32 1 . In addition to making a final award , the arbitral tribunal shall be entitled to make interim , interlocutory , or partial awards .
Translation: 第三十二条第一款 除作出最终裁决外，仲裁庭有权作出临时、中间或部分裁决。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The award shall be made in writing and shall be final and binding on the parties . The parties undertake to carry out the award without delay .
Translation: 本裁决应以书面形式作出，并对各方具有终局性和约束力。各方承诺立即履行该裁决。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The arbitral tribunal shall state the reasons upon which the award is based , unless the parties have agreed that no reasons are to be given .
Translation: 仲裁庭应当说明裁决所依据的理由，除非当事人约定不陈述理由。

Query_Text_en: 4 . An award shall be signed by the arbitrators and it shall contain the date on which and the place where the award was made . Where there are three arbitrators and one of them fails to sign , the award shall state the reason for the absence of the signature .
Translation: 4. 裁决书应当由仲裁员签署，并载明裁决作出的日期和地点。如有三名仲裁员而其中一人未能签署，裁决书应当注明未署名的原因。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The award may be made public only with the consent of both parties .
Translation: 该裁决须经双方同意后方可予以公开。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Copies of the award signed by the arbitrators shall be communicated to the parties by the arbitral tribunal .
Translation: 仲裁庭应将由仲裁员签署的裁决书副本送达当事人。

Query_Text_en: 7 . If the arbitration law of the country where the award is made requires that the award be filed or registered by the arbitral tribunal , the tribunal shall comply with this requirement within the period of time required by law .
Translation: 如果裁决作出国的仲裁法要求仲裁庭对裁决进行登记或注册，仲裁庭应当在法定期限内履行此项要求。

Query_Text_en: Article 33 1 . The arbitral tribunal shall apply the law designated by the parties as applicable to the substance of the dispute .
Translation: 第三十三条第一款 仲裁庭应当适用当事人指定的、适用于争议实体问题的法律。

Query_Text_en: Failing such designation by the parties , the arbitral tribunal shall apply the law determined by the conflict of laws rules which it considers applicable .
Translation: 如当事人未作指定，仲裁庭应适用其认定的应适用冲突法规则所确定的法律。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The arbitral tribunal shall decide as amiable compositeur or ex aequo et bono only if the parties have expressly authorized the arbitral tribunal to do so and if the law applicable to the arbitral procedure permits such arbitration .
Translation: 仲裁庭仅可在当事人明确授权其以友好调解人身份或根据公平和良善原则作出裁决，并且仲裁程序适用的法律允许采取此种仲裁方式时，方得如此行事。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In all cases , the arbitral tribunal shall decide in accordance with the terms of the contract and shall take into account the usages of the trade applicable to the transaction .
Translation: 在任何情况下，仲裁庭均应依据合同条款作出裁决，并考虑适用于该交易的贸易惯例。

Query_Text_en: Article 34 1 . If , before the award is made , the parties agree on a settlement of the dispute , the arbitral tribunal shall either issue an order for the termination of the arbitral proceedings or , if requested by both parties and accepted by the tribunal , record the settlement in the form of an arbitral award on agreed terms . The arbitral tribunal is not obliged to give reasons for such an award .
Translation: 如果在裁决作出前，双方就争议达成和解协议，仲裁庭应当终止仲裁程序。如双方提出请求且获得仲裁庭同意，也可将和解协议内容以裁决书形式记录。根据本条款，仲裁庭无需对裁决书做理由说明。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If , before the award is made , the continuation of the arbitral proceedings becomes unnecessary or impossible for any reason not mentioned in paragraph 1 , the arbitral tribunal shall inform the parties of its intention to issue an order for the termination of the proceedings . The arbitral tribunal shall have the power to issue such an order unless a party raises justifiable grounds for objection .
Translation: 2 ．如果在裁决作出前，由于第1款未提及的任何原因导致仲裁程序的继续变得没有必要或不可能，仲裁庭应通知各方其拟终止程序的意向。仲裁庭有权作出此类终止令，除非一方提出正当异议理由。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Copies of the order for termination of the arbitral proceedings or of the arbitral award on agreed terms , signed by the arbitrators , shall be communicated by the arbitral tribunal to the parties .
Translation: 仲裁庭应将仲裁员签署的终止仲裁程序的命令或和解条款仲裁裁决书的副本提交各当事人。

Query_Text_en: Where an arbitral award on agreed terms is made , the provisions of article 32 , paragraphs 2 and 4 to 7 , shall apply .
Translation: 当作出双方达成一致的仲裁裁决时，第三十二条第二款以及第四款至第七款的规定应予适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 35 1 . Within thirty days after the receipt of the award , either party , with notice to the other party , may request that the arbitral tribunal give an interpretation of the award .
Translation: 第三十五条第一款 自收到裁决书之日起三十日内，任何一方均可向仲裁庭提出对裁决书作出解释的请求，但须事先通知另一方。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The interpretation shall be given in writing within forty-five days after the receipt of the request . The interpretation shall form part of the award and the provisions of article 32 , paragraphs 2 to 7 , shall apply .
Translation: 解释应在收到请求之日起四十五天内以书面形式作出。该解释应成为裁决书的一部分，第三十二条第二款至第七款的规定应予适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 36 1 . Within thirty days after the receipt of the award , either party , with notice to the other party , may request the arbitral tribunal to correct in the award any errors in computation , any clerical or typographical errors , or any errors of similar nature .
Translation: 第三十六条 一方当事人可在收到裁决书后三十日内，书面通知另一方后，请求仲裁庭对裁决书中计算错误、笔误或其他类似性质的错误进行更正。

Query_Text_en: The arbitral tribunal may within thirty days after the communication of the award make such corrections on its own initiative .
Translation: 仲裁庭可在裁决送达后三十日内主动作出相应更正。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Such corrections shall be in writing , and the provisions of article 32 , paragraphs 2 to 7 , shall apply .
Translation: 此类更正应以书面形式作出，本法第三十二条第二款至第七款的规定应予适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 37 1 . Within thirty days after the receipt of the award , either party , with notice to the other party , may request the arbitral tribunal to make an additional award as to claims presented in the arbitral proceedings but omitted from the award .
Translation: 第三十七条第一款 自收到裁决书之日起三十日内，任何一方当事人可通知另一方当事人后，请求仲裁庭就仲裁程序中提出但未包含在裁决中的请求作出补充裁决。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If the arbitral tribunal considers the request for an additional award to be justified and considers that the omission can be rectified without any further hearings or evidence , it shall complete its award within sixty days after the receipt of the request .
Translation: 如果仲裁庭认为补充裁决请求理由充分，并认为无需进一步听证或证据即可纠正遗漏，则应在收到请求之日起六十日内完成裁决。

Query_Text_en: 3 . When an additional award is made , the provisions of article 32 , paragraphs 2 to 7 , shall apply .
Translation: 当作出附加赔偿决定时，本条第32条第2款至第7款的规定应予适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 38 The arbitral tribunal shall fix the costs of arbitration in its award .
Translation: 第三十八条 仲裁庭应在裁决中确定仲裁费用。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] The travel and other expenses of witnesses to the extent such expenses are approved by the arbitral tribunal ;
Translation: 证人经仲裁庭批准的差旅和其他费用；

Query_Text_en: [ f ] Any fees and expenses of the appointing authority as well as the expenses of the Secretary-General of the Permanent Court of Arbitration at The Hague .
Translation: 指定机构的任何费用和开支以及海牙常设仲裁法院秘书长的费用。

Query_Text_en: Article 39 1 . The fees of the arbitral tribunal shall be reasonable in amount , taking into account the amount in dispute , the complexity of the subject-matter , the time spent by the arbitrators and any other relevant circumstances of the case .
Translation: 第三十九条第一款 仲裁庭的费用应当合理，应考虑争议金额、案件标的的复杂程度、仲裁员的工作时间以及案件中的其他相关情况。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If an appointing authority has been agreed upon by the parties or designated by the Secretary-General of the Permanent Court of Arbitration at The Hague , and if that authority has issued a schedule of fees for arbitrators in international cases which it administers , the arbitral tribunal in fixing its fees shall take that schedule of fees into account to the extent that it considers appropriate in the circumstances of the case .
Translation: 如果指派机构已由各方同意或由海牙常设仲裁法院秘书长指定，且该机构已为其管理的国际案件制定了仲裁员费用标准，则仲裁庭在确定费用时应考虑该费用标准，并根据案件具体情况酌情确定适当程度。

Query_Text_en: 3 . If such appointing authority has not issued a schedule of fees for arbitrators in international cases , any party may at any time request the appointing authority to furnish a statement setting forth the basis for establishing fees which is customarily followed in international cases in which the authority appoints arbitrators .
Translation: 如果相关任命机构未就国际案件制定仲裁员费用表，任何一方均可随时要求该机构提供一份说明文件，列明其在处理国际案件并委任仲裁员时通常遵循的制定费用依据。

Query_Text_en: If the appointing authority consents to provide such a statement , the arbitral tribunal in fixing its fees shall take such information into account to the extent that it considers appropriate in the circumstances of the case .
Translation: 如果指定机构同意提供此类声明，仲裁庭在确定其费用时，应根据案件具体情况，酌情考虑相关信息。

Query_Text_en: 4 . In cases referred to in paragraphs 2 and 3 , when a party so requests and the appointing authority consents to perform the function , the arbitral tribunal shall fix its fees only after consultation with the appointing authority which may make any comment it deems appropriate to the arbitral tribunal concerning the fees .
Translation: 根据第2款和第3款所述情形，当一方提出请求且指定机构同意履行该职能时，仲裁庭应在与指定机构协商后方能确定其费用，指定机构可就费用问题向仲裁庭提出其认为适当的任何意见。

Query_Text_en: Article 40 1 . Except as provided in paragraph 2 , the costs of arbitration shall in principle be borne by the unsuccessful party .
Translation: 第四十条第一款。除非本条第二款另有规定，仲裁费用原则上由败诉方承担。

Query_Text_en: However , the arbitral tribunal may apportion each of such costs between the parties if it determines that apportionment is reasonable , taking into account the circumstances of the case .
Translation: 然而，如仲裁庭认定分摊费用合理并结合案件具体情况，可裁定在当事人之间分摊各项费用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . With respect to the costs of legal representation and assistance referred to in article 38 , paragraph [ e ] , the arbitral tribunal , taking into account the circumstances of the case , shall be free to determine which party shall bear such costs or may apportion such costs between the parties if it determines that apportionment is reasonable .
Translation: 关于第38条[ e ]款所指的法律代表和协助费用，仲裁庭应当根据案件 circumstances ，有权决定由何方承担此类费用，或在认定分摊合理时在当事人间分摊此类费用。

Query_Text_en: 3 . When the arbitral tribunal issues an order for the termination of the arbitral proceedings or makes an award on agreed terms , it shall fix the costs of arbitration referred to in article 38 and article 39 , paragraph 1 , in the text of that order or award .
Translation: 当仲裁庭作出终止仲裁程序的命令或根据协议条款作出裁决时，应当在该命令或裁决文本中确定《第三十八条》以及《第三十九条》第一款所指的仲裁费用。

Query_Text_en: 4 . No additional fees may be charged by an arbitral tribunal for interpretation or correction or completion of its award under articles 35 to 37 .
Translation: 根据第三十五条至第三十七条，仲裁庭不得就其裁决的解释、更正或补充事项收取额外费用。

Query_Text_en: Article 41 1 . The arbitral tribunal , on its establishment , may request each party to deposit an equal amount as an advance for the costs referred to in article 38 , paragraphs [ a ] , [ b ] and [ c ] .
Translation: 第四十一条第一款 仲裁庭在其成立时，可要求每一方存入相等金额作为预付费用，该费用指第三十八条第（a）、（b）和（c）款所规定的费用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . During the course of the arbitral proceedings the arbitral tribunal may request supplementary deposits from the parties .
Translation: 在仲裁程序进行过程中，仲裁庭有权要求当事人追加押金。

Query_Text_en: 3 . If an appointing authority has been agreed upon by the parties or designated by the Secretary-General of the Permanent Court of Arbitration at The Hague , and when a party so requests and the appointing authority consents to perform the function , the arbitral tribunal shall fix the amounts of any deposits or supplementary deposits only after consultation with the appointing authority which may make any comments to the arbitral tribunal which it deems appropriate concerning the amount of such deposits and supplementary deposits .
Translation: 如果指定机构已由各方约定或由荷兰海牙常设仲裁法院秘书长指定，并且当一方当事方提出请求且该指定机构同意履行该职能时，仲裁庭应当仅在与该指定机构协商后，方能确定任何预付款项或附加预付款的金额。该指定机构可就相关预付款项及附加预付款的金额向仲裁庭提出其认为适当的任何意见。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If the required deposits are not paid in full within thirty days after the receipt of the request , the arbitral tribunal shall so inform the parties in order that one or another of them may make the required payment .
Translation: 如果收到请求后三十日内未全额支付应缴押金，仲裁庭应就此通知各方，以便相关方能够支付应缴款项。

Query_Text_en: If such payment is not made , the arbitral tribunal may order the suspension or termination of the arbitral proceedings .
Translation: 如未支付，仲裁庭可裁定中止或终止仲裁程序。

Query_Text_en: 5 . After the award has been made , the arbitral tribunal shall render an accounting to the parties of the deposits received and return any unexpended balance to the parties .
Translation: 裁决作出后，仲裁庭应就已收取的押金向各方作出说明，并将未动用的余额返还各方。

Query_Text_en: Agreement on the privileges and immunities of the ITER International Fusion Energy Organization for the Joint Implementation of the ITER ProjectNovember 21 , 2006The European Atomic Energy Community [ hereinafter ` Euratom ' ] , the Government of the People 's Republic of China , the Government of the Republic of India , the Government of Japan , the Government of the Republic of Korea and the Government of the Russian Federation [ hereinafter ` the Parties ' ] , WHEREAS Article 12 of the Agreement on the Establishment of the ITER International Fusion Energy Organization for the Joint Implementation of the ITER Project [ hereinafter ` the ITER Agreement ' ] requires the parties to that Agreement to give effect to privileges and immunities ;
Translation: 国际热核聚变实验堆组织关于联合实施ITER项目的特权与豁免协议  2006年11月21日  欧洲原子能共同体（以下简称“ Euratom”）、中华人民共和国政府、印度共和国政府、日本国政府、大韩民国政府和俄罗斯联邦政府（以下简称“各方”），鉴于《国际热核聚变实验堆组织关于联合实施ITER项目的协议》（以下简称“ITER协议”）第12条规定，各方应确保为ITER国际聚变能组织给予特权与豁免；

Query_Text_en: 1 . In accordance with Article 5 of the ITER Agreement , the ITER International Fusion Energy Organization [ hereinafter ` the ITER Organization ' ] shall have international legal personality , including the capacity to conclude agreements with States and\/or international organizations .
Translation: 根据《ITER协议》第五条，国际热核聚变能源ITER组织[以下简称"ITER组织"]享有国际法律人格，包括与各国和／或国际组织缔结合同的能力。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] conclude contracts ;
Translation: [ a ] 签订合同；

Query_Text_en: [ b ] acquire , hold and dispose of property ;
Translation: 取得、持有及处置财产；

Query_Text_en: [ c ] obtain licenses ;
Translation: 取得许可；

Query_Text_en: and [ d ] institute legal proceedings .
Translation: 并[ d ]提起法律诉讼。

Query_Text_en: Article 2 ? The buildings and premises of the ITER Organization shall be inviolable .
Translation: 第二条 国际热核实验反应堆组织的建筑物和场地应受不可侵犯。

Query_Text_en: Article 3 ? The archives and documents of the ITER Organization shall be inviolable .
Translation: 第三条 ITER组织的档案和文件不得侵犯。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] to the extent that the ITER Organization has expressly waived such immunity in a particular case ;
Translation: 在国际热核聚变实验堆组织已在某一特定案件中明确放弃此类豁免权的范围内；

Query_Text_en: [ b ] in respect of a civil action by a third party for damage arising from an accident caused by a motor vehicle belonging to , or operated on behalf of , the ITER Organization , or in respect of a motor traffic offence involving such a vehicle ;
Translation: 涉及ITER组织所属或由其运营的机动车引发事故所导致损害的第三方民事诉讼，或涉及此类车辆的道路交通违规行为。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] in respect of an enforcement of an arbitration award made under Article 23 ;
Translation: 关于根据第二十三条作出的仲裁裁决的执行；

Query_Text_en: and [ d ] in the event of an attachment of salary , enforced for a debt of a staff member of the ITER Organization , provided that such attachment results from a final and enforceable legal decision in accordance with the rules in force on the territory of enforcement .
Translation: 若发生ITER组织工作人员因债务而被强制执行工资扣押的情形，前提是此类扣押系根据执行地现行有效的规则，依据最终且具有执行力的法律裁决作出。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] in respect of a civil action provided for in paragraph 1 [ b ] ;
Translation: 关于本条第（一）项（b）规定的民事诉讼；

Query_Text_en: and [ c ] in respect of the enforcement of an arbitration award made under Article 23 .
Translation: 关于根据第二十三条作出的仲裁裁决的执行，[c]

Query_Text_en: [ a ] the prevention and investigation of accidents involving motor vehicles belonging to , or operated on behalf of , the ITER Organization ;
Translation: 涉及国际热核聚变实验堆组织所属或其委托运营的机动车辆事故的预防与调查；

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] the enforcement of an arbitration award made under Article 23 .
Translation: [ b ] 根据第二十三条作出的仲裁裁决的执行。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Within the scope of its official activities , the ITER Organization , its property and income shall be exempt from direct taxes .
Translation: 在履行其官方职责范围内，国际热核聚变实验堆组织及其财产和收入应免征直接税。

Query_Text_en: 2 . When goods or services , strictly necessary for the exercise of the official activities of the ITER Organization , are purchased or used by or on behalf of the ITER Organization , and when the price of such goods or services includes taxes or duties , appropriate measures shall , whenever possible , be taken by the Party to grant exemption from such taxes or duties or to provide for their reimbursement .
Translation: 当国际热核聚变实验堆组织（ITER组织）购买或使用严格必要以开展其官方活动的货物或服务时，若相关货物或服务的价格中包含税款或关税，缔约方应在可行情况下采取适当措施，为ITER组织提供此类税款或关税的减免，或安排相应返还。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Goods imported or exported by the ITER Organization , or on its behalf , for its official activities shall be exempt from all duties and taxes .
Translation: 国际热核聚变实验堆组织或以其名义进口或出口的货物，若用于其官方活动，则免征一切关税和税收。

Query_Text_en: Goods imported or exported by the ITER Organization for its official activities shall be exempt from prohibitions and restrictions on imports and exports except where such prohibitions or restrictions are consistent with the laws , regulations and policies referred to in Articles 14 and 20 of the ITER Agreement .
Translation: 国际热核聚变实验堆组织因开展官方活动而进出口的货物应免于进出口的禁止和限制，但此类禁止或限制须符合《ITER协定》第14条和第20条所指的法律、法规和政策的情况除外。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Goods which have benefited from the exemption provided for in Article 5 or imported under paragraph 1 shall not be sold or given away except in accordance with conditions laid down by the Parties which have granted exemptions .
Translation: 根据第五条获得免税优惠或根据第一条进口的货物，不得出售或赠送，除非符合授予免税待遇的缔约方所规定的条件。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For the purposes of Articles 5 and 6 , the official activities of the ITER Organization shall include its administrative activities , including its operations in connection with any social security scheme it establishes , and activities undertaken in pursuance of the purpose of the ITER Organization as defined in the ITER Agreement .
Translation: 根据《ITER协定》第五条和第六条，国际热核聚变实验堆组织的官方活动应包括其行政活动，包括其与所建立的任何社会保障制度相关的运营活动，以及为实现《ITER协定》所规定该组织宗旨而开展的活动。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of Articles 5 and 6 shall not apply to taxes and duties that are no more than charges for public utility services .
Translation: 本协定第五条和第六条的规定不适用于不超过公共服务费用的税款和费用。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 ? No exemption shall be granted under Articles 5 or 6 in respect of goods purchased or imported , or services provided for the personal benefit of the staff of the ITER Organization .
Translation: 第八条 不得根据第五条或第六条的规定，对于ITER组织工作人员个人利益而购买、进口的商品，或为其提供服务的情况给予豁免。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 ? Without prejudice to the laws , regulations and policies referred to in Articles 14 and 20 of the ITER Agreement , the circulation of publications and other information material sent by or to the ITER Organization shall not be restricted in any way .
Translation: 第九条 不影响根据ITER协议第14条和第20条所指的法律、法规和政策，ITER组织发送或接收的出版物及其他信息材料的流通不应受到任何限制。

Query_Text_en: it may dispose of them freely for any purpose provided for in the ITER Agreement and hold accounts in any currency to the extent required to meet its obligations .
Translation: 可根据ITER协议的规定自由处置相关资产，并可根据履行义务所需范围以任何货币开设账户。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In exercising its rights referred to in paragraph 1 , the ITER Organization shall pay due regard to any representations by any of its Members insofar as it is considered that effect can be given to such representations without detriment to the interests of the ITER Organization .
Translation: 国际热核聚变实验堆组织在行使本条第一款所述权利时，应充分考虑其任何成员所提出的主张。只要认为这些主张可以在不损害国际热核聚变实验堆组织利益的情况下得到落实，均应予以采纳。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For its official communications and the transfer of all its documents , the ITER Organization shall enjoy treatment no less favourable than that accorded by each Party to other international organizations .
