Translation: 在该机构允许使用多种语言的情况下，申请人、持有者或其他利害关系方可能需要遵守该机构规定的其他语言要求，但不得要求任何沟通内容或要素使用超过一种语言。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] No Contracting Party may require the attestation , notarization , authentication , legalization or any other certification of any translation of a communication other than as provided under this Treaty .
Translation: 任何缔约方均不得要求对通信文件的译文进行证明、公证、认证、领事认证或其他任何形式的认证，除非本条约另有规定。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Where a Contracting Party does not require a communication to be in a language admitted by its Office , the Office may require that a translation of that communication by an official translator or a representative , into a language admitted by the Office , be supplied within a reasonable time limit .
Translation: 如果缔约方不要求相关文件使用其机构认可的语言，该机构可要求由官方翻译员或其代表将文件翻译成机构认可的语言，并在合理期限内提交。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Signature of Communications on Paper ] [ a ] Any Contracting Party may require that a communication on paper be signed by the applicant , holder or other interested person .
Translation: [3] [纸质通信签署要求] [a] 任何缔约方均可要求由申请人、持有人或其他利害关系人在纸质通信上签署。

Query_Text_en: Where a Contracting Party requires a communication on paper to be signed , that Contracting Party shall accept any signature that complies with the requirements prescribed in the Regulations .
Translation: 当缔约方要求对纸质文件进行签署时，该缔约方应接受任何符合本法规规定要求的签名。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] No Contracting Party may require the attestation , notarization , authentication , legalization or other certification of any signature except , where the law of the Contracting Party so provides , if the signature concerns the surrender of a registration .
Translation: 任何缔约方均不得要求对任何签名进行证明、公证、认证、 legalization 或其他形式的认证，除非该缔约方法律有明确规定，且该签名涉及撤销注册的情形。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Notwithstanding subparagraph [ b ] , a Contracting Party may require that evidence be filed with the Office where the Office may reasonably doubt the authenticity of any signature of a communication on paper .
Translation: 尽管有第[ b ]款的规定，缔约方仍可在该机构对纸质通信中的任何签名真实性存在合理怀疑时，要求将证据提交至该机构。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Communications Filed in Electronic Form or by Electronic Means of Transmittal ] Where a Contracting Party permits the filing of communications in electronic form or by electronic means of transmittal , it may require that any such communications comply with the requirements prescribed in the Regulations .
Translation: [4] [以电子形式提交或通过电子传输方式提交的文件] 缔约方允许以电子形式提交文件或使用电子传输方式时，可要求此类文件符合法规规定的要求。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] [ Presentation of a Communication ] Any Contracting Party shall accept the presentation of a communication the content of which corresponds to the relevant Model International Form , if any , provided for in the Regulations .
Translation: 任何缔约方均应接受符合《公约》规定之相关标准国际格式（如有）的通信提交。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] [ Prohibition of Other Requirements ] No Contracting Party may demand that , in respect of paragraphs [ 1 ] to [ 5 ] , requirements other than those referred to in this Article be complied with .
Translation: [6] [禁止其他要求] 任何缔约方不得要求在关于第[1]款至[5]款的规定中，遵守本条未明确规定的其他要求。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] [ Means of Communication with Representative ] Nothing in this Article regulates the means of communication between an applicant , holder or other interested person and its representative .
Translation: 本条不排除申请人、持有人或其他利害关系人与其代表之间的沟通方式。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 ? ? ? Classification of Goods and\/or Services [ 1 ] [ Indications of Goods and\/or Services ] Each registration and any publication effected by an Office which concerns an application or registration and which indicates goods and\/or services shall indicate the goods and\/or services by their names , grouped according to the classes of the Nice Classification , and each group shall be preceded by the number of the class of that Classification to which that group of goods or services belongs and shall be presented in the order of the classes of the said Classification .
Translation: 第9条 商品及/或服务的分类  [ 所指商品及/或服务 ]  对于商标申请或注册事宜，各局所进行的任何注册及/或相关公告中涉及商品及/或服务说明的，均应当采用商品及/或服务的具体名称，并根据《尼斯分类》的类别进行分组。每个商品及/或服务组前需标注其所属的《尼斯分类》类别编号，并按照该分类中的类别顺序依次排列。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Goods or Services in the Same Class or in Different Classes ] [ a ] Goods or services may not be considered as being similar to each other on the ground that , in any registration or publication by the Office , they appear in the same class of the Nice Classification .
Translation: [2] [同一类别或不同类别商品或服务] [a] 商品或服务不得仅因在商标局的任何注册或公告中被列入同一尼斯分类类别，而被认定为类似。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Goods or services may not be considered as being dissimilar from each other on the ground that , in any registration or publication by the Office , they appear in different classes of the Nice Classification .
Translation: 商品或服务不得仅以商标局的任何注册或公告中将它们列入不同尼斯分类类别为理由，而被认定不属于同类。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 ? ? ? Changes in Names or Addresses [ 1 ] [ Changes in the Name or Address of the Holder ] [ a ] Where there is no change in the person of the holder but there is a change in its name and\/or address , each Contracting Party shall accept that a request for the recordal of the change by the Office in its register of marks be made by the holder in a communication indicating the registration number of the registration concerned and the change to be recorded .
Translation: 第十条 商标注册人名称或地址变更  [商标注册人名称或地址的变更]  (a) 在注册人身份未发生变更的情况下，若其名称和/或地址发生变化，每一缔约方应接受注册人通过书面通知向主管局提出在商标注册簿中记载变更的请求。该书面通知应注明相关注册的注册号及需记载的变更内容。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Any Contracting Party may require that , in respect of the request , a fee be paid to the Office .
Translation: 任何缔约方均可要求，就该请求而言，向该机构支付费用。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] A single request shall be sufficient even where the change relates to more than one registration , provided that the registration numbers of all registrations concerned are indicated in the request .
Translation: 即使变更涉及多个注册，只要在申请中列明所有相关注册的编号，单一申请即足够。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Change in the Name or Address of the Applicant ] Paragraph [ 1 ] shall apply , mutatis mutandis , where the change concerns an application or applications , or both an application or applications and a registration or registrations , provided that , where the application number of any application concerned has not yet been issued or is not known to the applicant or its representative , the request otherwise identifies that application as prescribed in the Regulations .
Translation: 关于申请人名称或地址变更的规定，如变更涉及申请或多项申请，或同时涉及申请及/和注册或多项注册，第1段规定应相应适用。但若涉及的任何申请之申请号尚未发放或不为申请人及其代理人所知，则请求书应按照本规章规定的方式另行标识该申请。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Change in the Name or Address of the Representative or in the Address for Service ] Paragraph [ 1 ] shall apply , mutatis mutandis , to any change in the name or address of the representative , if any , and to any change relating to the address for service , if any .
Translation: [3] [代表姓名或地址及送达地址变更] 如存在代表姓名或地址的变更，或存在送达地址的变更，则第[1]款应作必要调整后相应适用。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Prohibition of Other Requirements ] No Contracting Party may demand that requirements other than those referred to in paragraphs [ 1 ] to [ 3 ] and in Article 8 be complied with in respect of the request referred to in this Article . In particular , the furnishing of any certificate concerning the change may not be required .
Translation: [4] [禁止其他要求] 任何缔约方均不得要求遵守本条所述请求中除第1款至第3款及第八条所列之外的其他要求。尤其不得要求提供关于变更的任何证明文件。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] [ Evidence ] Any Contracting Party may require that evidence be furnished to the Office where the Office may reasonably doubt the veracity of any indication contained in the request .
Translation: 任何缔约方均可要求向该机构提供证据，当该机构对请求中所包含的任何陈述的真实性存在合理怀疑时。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 ? ? ? Change in Ownership [ 1 ] [ Change in the Ownership of a Registration ] [ a ] Where there is a change in the person of the holder , each Contracting Party shall accept that a request for the recordal of the change by the Office in its register of marks be made by the holder or by the person who acquired the ownership [ hereinafter referred to as `` new owner '' ] in a communication indicating the registration number of the registration concerned and the change to be recorded .
Translation: 第11条 所有权变更  [1] [商标注册所有权的变更]  [a] 当持有人身份发生变更时，每一缔约方应接受由该持有人或新获得所有权之人[以下简称“新所有人”]通过提交注明相关注册号及需记录之变更的书面文件，向该局提出在商标注册簿中记录该变更的请求。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Where the change in ownership results from a merger , any Contracting Party may require that the request indicate that fact and be accompanied by a copy of a document , which document originates from the competent authority and evidences the merger , such as a copy of an extract from a register of commerce , and that that copy be certified by the authority which issued the document or by a notary public or any other competent public authority , as being in conformity with the original document .
Translation: 当所有权变更源于企业合并时，缔约方可以要求该申请注明这一情况，并附上相关文件的副本，该文件须由主管机关出具且证明合并情况，例如商业登记册的摘录复印件。同时，该副本需由出具文件的机关或公证人或其他有权机关认证，以确保与原件一致。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Where there is a change in the person of one or more but not all of several co-holders and such change in ownership results from a contract or a merger , any Contracting Party may require that any co-holder in respect of which there is no change in ownership give its express consent to the change in ownership in a document signed by it .
Translation: 当若干共同持有人中有一人或数人发生变更，且该等变更系因合同或合并导致时，任何缔约方均可要求未发生所有权变更的共同持有人以由其签署的书面文件明示同意该变更。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] Where the change in ownership does not result from a contract or a merger but from another ground , for example , from operation of law or a court decision , any Contracting Party may require that the request indicate that fact and be accompanied by a copy of a document evidencing the change and that that copy be certified as being in conformity with the original document by the authority which issued the document or by a notary public or any other competent public authority .
Translation: 当所有权变更并非源于合同或合并，而是基于其他原因（例如法律规定或法院裁决），缔约方可以要求该请求注明这一事实并附上一份证明该变更的文件副本，且该副本须经签发该文件的机构、公证人或其他有权机关认证与原件一致。

Query_Text_en: [ g ] Any Contracting Party may require that , in respect of the request , a fee be paid to the Office .
Translation: 任何缔约方均有权要求，就该请求而言，应向该机构支付费用。

Query_Text_en: [ h ] A single request shall be sufficient even where the change relates to more than one registration , provided that the holder and the new owner are the same for each registration and that the registration numbers of all registrations concerned are indicated in the request .
Translation: 即使该变更涉及多个注册项目，只要每个注册的持有人和新所有者相同，并且申请中列明所有相关注册编号，则提交一份申请即为足够。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] Where the change of ownership does not affect all the goods and\/or services listed in the holder 's registration , and the applicable law allows the recording of such change , the Office shall create a separate registration referring to the goods and\/or services in respect of which the ownership has changed .
Translation: 当所有权变更不涉及持有人注册中所列的所有商品和/或服务，且相关法律规定允许对此类变更进行记录时，商标局应为涉及所有权已发生变更的商品和/或服务创建单独的注册记录。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Change in the Ownership of an Application ] Paragraph [ 1 ] shall apply , mutatis mutandis , where the change in ownership concerns an application or applications , or both an application or applications and a registration or registrations , provided that , where the application number of any application concerned has not yet been issued or is not known to the applicant or its representative , the request otherwise identifies that application as prescribed in the Regulations .
Translation: 当涉及申请或多项申请的所有权变更，或同时涉及申请及注册时，第[1]款应[在作必要调整后]相应适用，前提是：如果任何相关申请的申请号尚未签发或对申请人及其代表未知时，只要请求以《规定》中规定的方式指明该申请。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] an indication that the holder transferred , entirely or in part , its business or the relevant goodwill to the new owner , as well as the furnishing of evidence to either effect .
Translation: 表明持有人已将其业务或相关商誉全部或部分转让给新业主的证明，以及提供相关证明文件。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Evidence ] Any Contracting Party may require that evidence , or further evidence where paragraph [ 1 ] [ c ] or [ e ] applies , be furnished to the Office where that Office may reasonably doubt the veracity of any indication contained in the request or in any document referred to in the present Article .
Translation: [4][证据] 任何缔约方均可要求，若相关机构对请求或本条所涉任何文件中包含的任何说明的真实性存在合理怀疑，则应向该机构提供证据；在第1款(c)或(e)项适用的情况下，可要求提供进一步证据。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 ? ? ? Correction of a Mistake [ 1 ] [ Correction of a Mistake in Respect of a Registration ] [ a ] Each Contracting Party shall accept that the request for the correction of a mistake which was made in the application or other request communicated to the Office and which mistake is reflected in its register of marks and\/or any publication by the Office be made by the holder in a communication indicating the registration number of the registration concerned , the mistake to be corrected and the correction to be entered .
Translation: 第十二条 商标错误更正  【商标注册中的错误更正】  （一）每一缔约方应接受持有人提出的错误更正请求。该请求需针对在向该局提交的申请或其他请愿书中所出现的错误，并且该错误已被反映在其商标注册簿和／或该局的官方出版物中。持有人应通过书面请愿书提出更正请求，该请愿书需注明相关注册的注册号、需更正的错误及所需更正的内容。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] where the holder has an address for service , such address .
Translation: 当持有人有服务地址时，应使用该地址。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] A single request shall be sufficient even where the correction relates to more than one registration of the same person , provided that the mistake and the requested correction are the same for each registration and that the registration numbers of all registrations concerned are indicated in the request .
Translation: 即使更正涉及同一主体的多个注册条目，只要每个注册中的错误及更正内容相同，并在申请中列明所有相关注册的编号，一份申请即可。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Correction of a Mistake in Respect of an Application ] Paragraph [ 1 ] shall apply , mutatis mutandis , where the mistake concerns an application or applications , or both an application or applications and a registration or registrations , provided that , where the application number of any application concerned has not yet been issued or is not known to the applicant or its representative , the request otherwise identifies that application as prescribed in the Regulations .
Translation: 当所涉错误涉及申请或多项申请，或同时涉及申请和注册时，本条第一款应比照适用，但需满足以下条件：若任何相关申请的申请号尚未发放或未被申请人及其代理人知晓，则可根据法规规定以其他方式明确该申请。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Prohibition of Other Requirements ] No Contracting Party may demand that requirements other than those referred to in paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] and in Article 8 be complied with in respect of the request referred to in this Article .
Translation: [3] [禁止提出其他要求] 任何缔约方不得要求将本条第[1]款和第[2]款以及第八条未规定的要求作为本条所涉请求的前提条件。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Evidence ] Any Contracting Party may require that evidence be furnished to the Office where the Office may reasonably doubt that the alleged mistake is in fact a mistake .
Translation: [4][证据]任何缔约方均可要求向该机构提交证据，前提是该机构对所称错误是否确实属于错误存在合理理由怀疑。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] [ Mistakes Made by the Office ] The Office of a Contracting Party shall correct its own mistakes , ex officio or upon request , for no fee .
Translation: [5] [缔约方机关的错误更正] 缔约方机关应依职权或应请求对其所犯错误进行更正，且不收取费用。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] [ Uncorrectable Mistakes ] No Contracting Party shall be obliged to apply paragraphs [ 1 ] , [ 2 ] and [ 5 ] to any mistake which can not be corrected under its law .
Translation: [6] [不可纠正的错误] 任何缔约方均无义务将本条第1、2和5款适用于根据其法律规定无法纠正的任何错误。

Query_Text_en: [ viii ] where a Contracting Party allows a request for renewal to be filed by a person other than the holder or its representative and the request is filed by such a person , the name and address of that person .
Translation: [ viii ] 如缔约方允许由非持有人或其代表的其他人提交续期申请，且该申请由该人提交时，应列明该人的姓名和地址。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any Contracting Party may require that , in respect of the request for renewal , a fee be paid to the Office .
Translation: 任何缔约方可以要求，在续展请求时，向该机构缴纳费用。

Query_Text_en: Once the fee has been paid in respect of the initial period of the registration or of any renewal period , no further payment may be required for the maintenance of the registration in respect of that period .
Translation: 一旦支付了注册初始期或任何续期期间的费用，则在该期间内不应再要求支付维持注册的任何其他费用。

Query_Text_en: Fees associated with the furnishing of a declaration and\/or evidence of use shall not be regarded , for the purposes of this subparagraph , as payments required for the maintenance of the registration and shall not be affected by this subparagraph .
Translation: 与提供声明和/或使用证据相关的费用，不应视为就本款而言要求支付的用于维持注册的费用，且不受本款约束。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Any Contracting Party may require that the request for renewal be presented , and the corresponding fee referred to in subparagraph [ b ] be paid , to the Office within the period fixed by the law of the Contracting Party , subject to the minimum periods prescribed in the Regulations .
Translation: 任何缔约方均可要求将续展申请提交至该机构，并在该缔约方法律规定的期限内缴纳本条(b)项所述对应费用，但需遵守条例规定的最短期限要求。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] the furnishing of a declaration and\/or evidence concerning use of the mark .
Translation: [Ⅲ] 提交有关商标使用情况的声明和/或证据。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Evidence ] Any Contracting Party may require that evidence be furnished to the Office in the course of the examination of the request for renewal where the Office may reasonably doubt the veracity of any indication or element contained in the request for renewal .
Translation: 在审查续展请求的过程中，如果该机构对请求中包含的任何声明或内容的真实性存在合理怀疑，任何缔约方均可要求向该机构提交证据。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Prohibition of Substantive Examination ] No Office of a Contracting Party may , for the purposes of effecting the renewal , examine the registration as to substance .
Translation: [4] [禁止实质性审查] 缔约方的任何主管机关不得以办理续展为目的对注册进行实质性审查。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] [ Duration ] The duration of the initial period of the registration , and the duration of each renewal period , shall be 10 years .
Translation: 注册的初始有效期和每次续展期的有效期均为十年。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 ? ? ? Relief Measures in Case of Failure to Comply with Time Limits [ 1 ] [ Relief Measure Before the Expiry of a Time Limit ] A Contracting Party may provide for the extension of a time limit for an action in a procedure before the Office in respect of an application or a registration , if a request to that effect is filed with the Office prior to the expiry of the time limit .
Translation: 第十四条 因未遵守时间限制情况下的救济措施 [1] [时间限制到期前的救济措施]  若在时间限制到期前向该局提交相关请求，缔约方可以就申请或注册事宜在该局进行的程序中，为某项行动规定延期。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] reinstatement of the rights of the applicant , holder or other interested person with respect to the application or registration if the Office finds that the failure to comply with the time limit concerned occurred in spite of due care required by the circumstances having been taken or , at the option of the Contracting Party , that the failure was unintentional .
Translation: 若主管机关认定因相关期限未遵守系尽管已采取了情况所需谨慎注意措施所致，或由缔约方选择认定该未遵守行为属非故意，则应恢复申请人、注册人或其他利害关系人就该申请或注册所享有的权利。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Exceptions ] No Contracting Party shall be required to provide for any of the relief measures referred to in paragraph [ 2 ] with respect to the exceptions prescribed in the Regulations .
Translation: [3] [例外情况] 任何缔约方均无义务就本协定规定的例外情形，提供第二款所述的任何补救措施。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Fee ] Any Contracting Party may require that a fee be paid in respect of any of the relief measures referred to in paragraphs [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] .
Translation: 任何缔约方对于本条第[1]款和第[2]款所述的税收减免措施，均有权要求支付相关费用。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] [ Prohibition of Other Requirements ] No Contracting Party may demand that requirements other than those referred to in this Article and in Article 8 be complied with in respect of any of the relief measures referred to in paragraph [ 2 ] .
Translation: [5] [禁止提出其他要求] 任何缔约方均不得要求对于本条第[2]款所述的任何救济措施遵守本条及第八条以外的其他要求。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 ? ? ? Obligation to Comply with the Paris ConventionAny Contracting Party shall comply with the provisions of the Paris Convention which concern marks .
Translation: 第十五条 遵守《巴黎公约》的义务  任何缔约国均应遵守《巴黎公约》中涉及商标的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 ? ? ? Service MarksAny Contracting Party shall register service marks and apply to such marks the provisions of the Paris Convention which concern trademarks .
Translation: 第十六条 任何缔约方应当注册服务标志，并将《巴黎公约》中涉及商标的规定适用于这些标志。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 ? ? ? Request for Recordal of a License [ 1 ] [ Requirements Concerning the Request for Recordal ] Where the law of a Contracting Party provides for the recordal of a license with its Office , that Contracting Party may require that the request for recordal [ i ] be filed in accordance with the requirements prescribed in the Regulations , and [ ii ] be accompanied by the supporting documents prescribed in the Regulations .
Translation: 第十七条 登记许可的请求 [1] [关于登记请求的要求]  如果某缔约方的法律要求在该缔约方机构登记许可，则该缔约方可要求登记许可的申请须满足以下条件：[i] 按照《条例》规定的要求提交；以及 [ii] 随附《条例》规定的相关证明文件。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Fee ] Any Contracting Party may require that , in respect of the recordal of a license , a fee be paid to the Office .
Translation: 任何缔约方均可要求，就许可的登记事宜，向该机构缴纳费用。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Single Request Relating to Several Registrations ] A single request shall be sufficient even where the license relates to more than one registration , provided that the registration numbers of all registrations concerned are indicated in the request , the holder and the licensee are the same for all registrations , and the request indicates the scope of the license in accordance with the Regulations with respect to all registrations .
Translation:
[3] 涉及多项注册的单一申请请求  
即使许可涉及多项注册，只要申请中列明所有相关注册的注册编号、所有注册的权利人与被许可人为同一主体，并且申请中根据《规定》明确所有注册的许可范围，则单一申请即视为有效。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] an indication of the financial terms of the license contract .
Translation: [ iii ] 许可合同的财务条款说明。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Subparagraph [ a ] is without prejudice to any obligations existing under the law of a Contracting Party concerning the disclosure of information for purposes other than the recording of the license in the register of marks .
Translation: 本款规定不影响缔约方法律规定的任何义务，这些义务涉及除在商标注册簿中记录许可之外的其他目的的信息披露。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] [ Evidence ] Any Contracting Party may require that evidence be furnished to the Office where the Office may reasonably doubt the veracity of any indication contained in the request or in any document referred to in the Regulations .
Translation: 任何缔约方均有权要求向该机构提交证据，当该机构对请求中或规章所提及的任何文件中包含的任何陈述的真实性存在合理怀疑时。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] [ Requests Relating to Applications ] Paragraphs [ 1 ] to [ 5 ] shall apply , mutatis mutandis , to requests for recordal of a license for an application , where the law of a Contracting Party provides for such recordal .
Translation: [6] [涉及申请的请求] 当某一缔约方的法律就此类登记作出规定时，本条第1款至第5款经必要修改后，应适用于申请许可的登记请求。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 ? ? ? Request for Amendment or Cancellation of the Recordal of a License [ 1 ] [ Requirements Concerning the Request ] Where the law of a Contracting Party provides for the recordal of a license with its Office , that Contracting Party may require that the request for amendment or cancellation of the recordal of a license [ i ] be filed in accordance with the requirements prescribed in the Regulations , and [ ii ] be accompanied by the supporting documents prescribed in the Regulations .
Translation: 第十八条      许可备案的修改或取消请求  [1] [申请要求] 如果某一缔约方的法律规定其主管机构需对许可进行备案，则该缔约方可要求修改或取消许可备案的请求：  [i] 应按照《规程》规定的具体要求提交；  [ii] 需附具《规程》所规定的相关证明文件。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Other Requirements ] Article 17 [ 2 ] to [ 6 ] shall apply , mutatis mutandis , to requests for amendment or cancellation of the recordal of a license .
Translation: 本法第十七条第二款至第六款经相应调整后，适用于登记许可的修改或注销请求。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 ? ? ? Effects of the Non-Recordal of a License [ 1 ] [ Validity of the Registration and Protection of the Mark ] The non-recordal of a license with the Office or with any other authority of the Contracting Party shall not affect the validity of the registration of the mark which is the subject of the license or the protection of that mark .
Translation: 本文第十九条 版权许可未登记的效力 [ 1 ] [ 商标注册及保护的有效性 ] 许可未经主管机关或其他缔约方机构登记，不影响该许可标的商标的注册有效性及其保护。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Certain Rights of the Licensee ] A Contracting Party may not require the recordal of a license as a condition for any right that the licensee may have under the law of that Contracting Party to join infringement proceedings initiated by the holder or to obtain , by way of such proceedings , damages resulting from an infringement of the mark which is the subject of the license .
Translation: 缔约方不得将许可登记作为被许可方依据该缔约方法律享有参与商标权人发起的侵权诉讼或通过此类诉讼程序获得因该许可所涉及商标被侵权所致损害赔偿等权利的条件。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Use of a Mark Where License Is Not Recorded ] A Contracting Party may not require the recordal of a license as a condition for the use of a mark by a licensee to be deemed to constitute use by the holder in proceedings relating to the acquisition , maintenance and enforcement of marks .
Translation: [3] [关于未登记许可的商标使用] 缔约方不得将许可登记作为认定被许可人使用商标构成商标权人使用该商标的条件，此项认定适用于涉及商标注册、维持及执行程序的相关事宜。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 ? ? ? Indication of the LicenseWhere the law of a Contracting Party requires an indication that the mark is used under a license , full or partial non-compliance with that requirement shall not affect the validity of the registration of the mark which is the subject of the license or the protection of that mark , and shall not affect the application of Article 19 [ 3 ] .
Translation: 第二十条 许可表明  如果某一缔约方的法律要求表明商标系在许可下使用，则对该要求的完全或部分未遵守，均不得影响该许可标的商标注册的有效性或该商标所享有的保护，亦不得影响第十九条[3]的适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 ? ? ? Observations in Case of Intended RefusalAn application under Article 3 or a request under Articles 7 , 10 to 14 , 17 and 18 may not be refused totally or in part by an Office without giving the applicant or the requesting party , as the case may be , an opportunity to make observations on the intended refusal within a reasonable time limit .
Translation: 第二十一条 在意图拒绝情况下的陈述机会  根据第三条提出的申请或根据第七条、第十至第十四条、第十七条及第十八条提出的请求，不得由主管机构在未在合理期限内给予申请人或请求方就拟拒绝事项发表意见的机会的情况下，全部或部分拒绝。

Query_Text_en: In respect of Article 14 , no Office shall be required to give an opportunity to make observations where the person requesting the relief measure has already had an opportunity to present an observation on the facts on which the decision is to be based .
Translation: 关于第十四条，如请求救济措施之人已就作为该决定依据的事实陈述过意见，则无任何机关需再为其提供陈述机会。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] any administrative requirements , matters or procedures .
Translation: [ iii ] 任何行政要求、事项或程序。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The Regulations also contain Model International Forms .
Translation: 本条例还包含标准国际表格。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Amending the Regulations ] Subject to paragraph [ 3 ] , any amendment of the Regulations shall require three-fourths of the votes cast .
Translation: [2] [修改条例] 除第[3]款另有规定外，对本条例的任何修改均须经投票表决的四分之三多数通过。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] In determining whether unanimity is attained , only votes actually cast shall be taken into consideration .
Translation: 在确定是否达成一致时，仅以实际投出的票数为准。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Conflict Between the Treaty and the Regulations ] In the case of conflict between the provisions of this Treaty and those of the Regulations , the former shall prevail .
Translation: [4] [条约与法规冲突] 如本条约的规定与相关法规的规定发生冲突，前者应优先适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 ? ? ? Assembly [ 1 ] [ Composition ] [ a ] The Contracting Parties shall have an Assembly .
Translation: 第二十三条 ??? 机构[1][构 成][a] 缔约方应设立一个大会。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Each Contracting Party shall be represented in the Assembly by one delegate , who may be assisted by alternate delegates , advisors and experts .
Translation: 每一缔约方应在大会中由一名代表代表，该代表可由替代代表、顾问和专家协助。

Query_Text_en: Each delegate may represent only one Contracting Party .
Translation: 每位代表只能代表一个缔约方。

Query_Text_en: [ iv ] perform such other functions as are appropriate to implementing the provisions of this Treaty .
Translation: 履行适当实施本条约各项规定的其他职能。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Quorum ] [ a ] One-half of the members of the Assembly which are States shall constitute a quorum .
Translation: [3] [法定人数] [a] 大会半数成员国应构成法定人数。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Notwithstanding subparagraph [ a ] , if , in any session , the number of the members of the Assembly which are States and are represented is less than one-half but equal to or more than one-third of the members of the Assembly which are States , the Assembly may make decisions but , with the exception of decisions concerning its own procedure , all such decisions shall take effect only if the conditions set forth hereinafter are fulfilled .
Translation: 尽管有本款第(a)项规定，但如果在任何会议期间，作为国家的成员实际到会有表决权的不足半数但不少于三分之一时，大会仍可作出决定，但有关大会自身议事程序的决定除外，所有其他决定均须在满足本条款下列条件后方能生效。

Query_Text_en: [ v ] `` non-exclusive license '' means a license which does not exclude the holder from using the mark or from granting licenses to any other person .
Translation: “非独家许可”指不禁止被许可人使用该商标或向任何其他人授予许可的许可。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Abbreviated Expressions Defined in the Treaty ] The abbreviated expressions defined in Article 1 for the purposes of the Treaty shall have the same meaning for the purposes of these Regulations .
Translation:
[2] [条约中定义的缩略语]  
本条约第一条为本条约目的而定义的缩略语，在本条例中具有同等含义。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] where the person is a natural person , that the name to be indicated be the family or principal name and the given or secondary name or names of that person or that the name to be indicated be , at that person s option , the name or names customarily used by the said person ;
Translation: 若该人为自然人，则应标明该人的姓氏或主名以及名字或次要名称；或由该人自行选择以其惯常使用的姓名。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] where the person is a legal entity , that the name to be indicated be the full official designation of the legal entity .
Translation: [ ii ] 当该人为法人实体时，应使用该法人实体的全称作为标明的名称。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Where the name of a representative which is a firm or partnership is to be indicated , any Contracting Party shall accept as indication of the name the indication that the firm or partnership customarily uses .
Translation: 当代表处的名称为公司或合伙企业时，任何缔约方均应接受该企业通常使用的名称作为其名称的表示。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Addresses ] [ a ] Where the address of a person is to be indicated , any Contracting Party may require that the address be indicated in such a way as to satisfy the customary requirements for prompt postal delivery at the indicated address and , in any case , consist of all the relevant administrative units up to , and including , the house or building number , if any .
Translation: 当需要注明某人地址时，任何缔约方均可要求该地址以满足快速邮寄送达的惯例要求的方式进行标注，并且无论如何，必须包含直至门牌号或楼号（如有）在内的所有相关行政单位。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Where a communication to the Office of a Contracting Party is in the name of two or more persons with different addresses , that Contracting Party may require that such communication indicate a single address as the address for correspondence .
Translation: 当向某一缔约方机构提交的文件以两名或以上地址不同的人员名义提出时，该缔约方可以要求该文件指定一个通信地址作为联络地址。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] The indication of an address may contain a telephone number , a telefacsimile number and an e-mail address and , for the purposes of correspondence , an address different from the address indicated under subparagraph [ a ] .
Translation: 地址的说明可以包含电话号码、传真号码和电子邮件地址，出于通信目的，还可以包含与第[a]项所列地址不同的地址。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Subparagraphs [ a ] and [ c ] shall apply , mutatis mutandis , to addresses for service .
Translation: 送达地址应适用子段落[ a ]和[ c ]的规定，并作相应调整。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Other Means of Identification ] Any Contracting Party may require that a communication to the Office indicate the number or other means of identification , if any , with which the applicant , holder , representative or interested person is registered with its Office .
Translation: [3] [其他识别方式] 缔约方可以要求向该机构提交的文件注明申请人、持有人、代表或利害关系人在其机构登记时使用的编号或其他识别方式（如有）。

Query_Text_en: No Contracting Party may refuse a communication on grounds of failure to comply with any such requirement , except for applications filed in electronic form .
Translation: 任何缔约方不得以未遵守任何此类要求为由拒绝接收提交的文件，除非是以电子形式提交的申请。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Script to Be Used ] Any Contracting Party may require that any indication referred to in paragraphs [ 1 ] to [ 3 ] be in the script used by the Office .
Translation: [4] [使用的文字] 任何缔约方均可要求本条第[1]至[3]项所述的任何标识采用该机构使用的文字。

Query_Text_en: Rule 3 ? ? ? Details Concerning the Application [ 1 ] [ Standard Characters ] Where the Office of a Contracting Party uses characters [ letters and numbers ] that it considers as being standard , and where the application contains a statement to the effect that the applicant wishes that the mark be registered and published in the standard characters used by the Office , the Office shall register and publish that mark in such standard characters .
Translation: 当缔约方的商标局使用其认为属于标准的字符[字母和数字]时，若申请中包含申请人希望该商标以商标局所使用标准字符进行注册及公布的声明，则该商标局应以该类标准字符注册并公布该商标。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Mark Claiming Color ] Where the application contains a statement to the effect that the applicant wishes to claim color as a distinctive feature of the mark , the Office may require that the application indicate the name or code of the color or colors claimed and an indication , in respect of each color , of the principal parts of the mark which are in that color .
Translation: [2] [商标颜色主张] 若申请书中包含申请人希望将颜色作为商标显著特征的声明，商标局可要求申请人在申请中注明所主张颜色的名称或代码，并针对每种颜色标明该颜色在商标中所应用的主要部分。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] one reproduction of the mark in black and white where the application contains a statement to the effect that the applicant wishes the mark to be registered and published in the standard characters used by the Office of that Contracting Party .
Translation: [ ii ] 如果申请中包含申请人希望以该缔约方主管机关使用的标准字符注册并公布的声明，则需提交一份该商标的黑白复制品。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Where the application contains a statement to the effect that the applicant wishes to claim color as a distinctive feature of the mark , a Contracting Party may not require more than five reproductions of the mark in black and white and five reproductions of the mark in color .
Translation: [ b ] 如果申请书中包含申请人拟将颜色作为商标显著特征的声明，缔约方不得要求提交超过五份黑白复制件及五份彩色复制件。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Three-Dimensional Mark ] [ a ] Where the application contains a statement to the effect that the mark is a three-dimensional mark , the reproduction of the mark shall consist of a two-dimensional graphic or photographic reproduction .
Translation: [4][三维标志][a] 如果申请书中包含该商标为三维商标的声明，则该商标的复制应由二维图形或照片复制构成。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The reproduction furnished under subparagraph [ a ] may , at the option of the applicant , consist of one single view of the mark or of several different views of the mark .
Translation: 根据第(a)款提交的复制件可由申请人选择，可以是该标识的一个单一视图，也可以是多个不同视图。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Where the Office considers that the reproduction of the mark furnished by the applicant under subparagraph [ a ] does not sufficiently show the particulars of the three-dimensional mark , it may invite the applicant to furnish , within a reasonable time limit fixed in the invitation , up to six different views of the mark and\/or a description by words of that mark .
Translation: **官方翻译：**商标行政管理部门在认为申请人依据子条款（a）所提交的商标复制品未能充分展示该三维商标细节时，可通知申请人在其指定期限内提供最多六张不同视角的商标视图和/或对该商标的文字描述。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Where the Office considers that the different views and\/or the description of the mark referred to in subparagraph [ c ] still do not sufficiently show the particulars of the three-dimensional mark , it may invite the applicant to furnish , within a reasonable time limit fixed in the invitation , a specimen of the mark .
Translation: 如果商标局认为根据第（c）项所述的视图和/或文字描述仍不足以充分展示三维标志的细节特征，商标局可以要求申请人在通知中规定的合理期限内提交该标志的商标样件。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] Paragraph [ 3 ] [ a ] [ i ] and [ b ] shall apply mutatis mutandis .
Translation: 第3段（a）（i）和（b）款应作相应调整后适用。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] [ Hologram Mark , Motion Mark , Color Mark , Position Mark ] Where the application contains a statement to the effect that the mark is a hologram mark , a motion mark , a color mark or a position mark , a Contracting Party may require one or more reproductions of the mark and details concerning the mark , as prescribed by the law of that Contracting Party .
Translation: [5] [全息图商标、动态商标、颜色商标、位置商标] 若申请中声明商标为全息图商标、动态商标、颜色商标或位置商标，缔约方可根据该缔约方法律规定，要求提交一份或多份商标复制品及相关详细信息。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] [ Mark Consisting of a Non-Visible Sign ] Where the application contains a statement to the effect that the mark consists of a non-visible sign , a Contracting Party may require one or more representations of the mark , an indication of the type of mark and details concerning the mark , as prescribed by the law of that Contracting Party .
Translation: [6] [包含不可见标志的商标] 若商标申请中声明该商标由不可见标志构成，缔约方可要求提供该商标的一种或多种图样、该标志类型的说明以及有关该标志的具体细节，具体要求依该缔约方法律规定而定。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] [ Transliteration of the Mark ] For the purposes of Article 3 [ 1 ] [ a ] [ xiii ] , where the mark consists of or contains matter in script other than the script used by the Office or numbers expressed in numerals other than numerals used by the Office , a transliteration of such matter in the script and numerals used by the Office may be required .
Translation: [7] [商标音译] 根据第三条（一）款（a）项（xiii）目之规定，若商标由或包含非该局所使用文字书写的文字内容，或以该局未使用的数字形式表示的数字，则可要求将此类文字内容以该局使用的文字及数字形式进行音译。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] [ Translation of the Mark ] For the purposes of Article 3 [ 1 ] [ a ] [ xiv ] , where the mark consists of or contains a word or words in a language other than the language , or one of the languages , admitted by the Office , a translation of that word or those words into that language or one of those languages may be required .
Translation: 为第三条（一）款（xiv）项之目的，若商标由或者包含非主管机关认可语言的词汇组成，可要求将其翻译成该语言或其中一种语言。

Query_Text_en: [ 9 ] [ Time Limit for Furnishing Evidence of Actual Use of the Mark ] The time limit referred to in Article 3 [ 3 ] shall not be shorter than six months counted from the date of allowance of the application by the Office of the Contracting Party where that application was filed .
Translation: [9] [提交商标实际使用证据的期限] 本条第3款所指期限自该申请受理之日起算，不得短于六个月。

Query_Text_en: The applicant or holder shall have the right to an extension of that time limit , subject to the conditions provided for by the law of that Contracting Party , by periods of at least six months each , up to a total extension of at least two years and a half .
Translation: 申请者或持有者在相关缔约方法律规定的条件下，有权申请对该期限进行延期，每次延期至少六个月，直至总延长时限达到至少两年六个月。

Query_Text_en: Rule 4 ? ? ? Details Concerning Representation and Address for Service [ 1 ] [ Address Where a Representative Is Appointed ] Where a representative is appointed , a Contracting Party shall consider the address of that representative to be the address for service .
Translation: 关于代表及其送达地址的细节  [1] [指定代表时的送达地址]  当已指定代表时，缔约方应将该代表的地址视为送达地址。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Address Where No Representative Is Appointed ] Where no representative is appointed and an applicant , holder or other interested person has provided as its address an address on the territory of the Contracting Party , that Contracting Party shall consider that address to be the address for service .
Translation: [2] [未指定代表时的地址] 当未指定代表且申请人、持有人或其他利害关系人在缔约方境内提供了地址时，该缔约方应将该地址视为送达地址。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Time Limit ] The time limit referred to in Article 4 [ 3 ] [ d ] shall be counted from the date of receipt of the communication referred to in that Article by the Office of the Contracting Party concerned and shall not be less than one month where the address of the person on whose behalf the communication is made is on the territory of that Contracting Party and not less than two months where such an address is outside the territory of that Contracting Party .
Translation: 第三款[d]项所指的时间限制应自相关缔约方办公室收到该条款提及的通信之日起开始计算。若该通信所代表的人的地址位于该缔约方领土内，则时间不得少于一个月；若该地址位于该缔约方领土外，则时间不得少于两个月。

Query_Text_en: Rule 5 ? ? ? Details Concerning the Filing Date [ 1 ] [ Procedure in Case of Non-Compliance with Requirements ] If the application does not , at the time of its receipt by the Office , comply with any of the applicable requirements of Article 5 [ 1 ] [ a ] or [ 2 ] [ a ] , the Office shall promptly invite the applicant to comply with such requirements within a time limit indicated in the invitation , which time limit shall be at least one month from the date of the invitation where the applicant s address is on the territory of the Contracting Party concerned and at least two months where the applicant s address is outside the territory of the Contracting Party concerned . Compliance with the invitation may be subject to the payment of a special fee . Even if the Office fails to send the said invitation , the said requirements remain unaffected .
Translation: 规则5 ? ? ? 关于申请日的细节 [1] [程序不当情形下的补正流程] 若申请文件在提交至专利局时未满足相关适用的规则5[1][a]或[2][a]条款之要求，专利局应尽快通知申请人需在指定时间内完成补正，当申请人的地址位于相关缔约国境内时该期限应不少于一个月，若地址位于缔约国外则至少为两个月。完成补正可能需缴纳特别费用。即便专利局未发出上述通知，涉及要求亦不因此失效。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Filing Date in Case of Correction ] If , within the time limit indicated in the invitation , the applicant complies with the invitation referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] and pays any required special fee , the filing date shall be the date on which all the required indications and elements referred to in Article 5 [ 1 ] [ a ] have been received by the Office and , where applicable , the required fees referred to in Article 5 [ 2 ] [ a ] have been paid to the Office .
Translation: [2] [更正申请的提交日期] 如果申请人在邀请函指定期限内遵守第[1]款所述邀请并支付所需特别费用，则申请日应为本局收到第五条第[1]款第(a)项所述所有必要说明和要素之日；如需缴纳时，第五条第[2]款第(a)项所述费用亦应在此日期前缴至本局。

Query_Text_en: Otherwise , the application shall be treated as if it had not been filed .
Translation: 否则，该申请将被视为未提交。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] an indication of the capacity in which that person signed , where such capacity is not obvious from reading the communication .
Translation: [ii] 如该人员签署文件时所代表的身份无法从相关文件内容中直接明确得出时，需注明其签署身份。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Date of Signing ] Any Contracting Party may require that a signature be accompanied by an indication of the date on which the signing was effected .
Translation: [2] [签署日期] 任何缔约方均可要求签署时附具签署日期。

Query_Text_en: Where that indication is required but is not supplied , the date on which the signing is deemed to have been effected shall be the date on which the communication bearing the signature was received by the Office or , if the Contracting Party so allows , a date earlier than the latter date .
Translation: 当应当提供但未提供该指示时，视为生效的签署日期应为载有签名的文件送达主管机关之日，或者在缔约方允许的情况下，可采用早于上述日期的日期。

Query_Text_en: [ iii ] may , where the natural person who signs the communication is a national of the Contracting Party and such person s address is on its territory , or where the legal entity on behalf of which the communication is signed is organized under its law and has either a domicile or a real and effective industrial or commercial establishment on its territory , require that a seal be used instead of a handwritten signature .
Translation: 在以下情况下，缔约方可要求使用印章代替手写签名：签署沟通文件的自然人为该缔约方国民且其地址位于其领土内；或签署该文件的法人实体根据其法律成立并在其领土内设有住所或实际有效的工业或商业机构。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Signature of Communications on Paper Filed by Electronic Means of Transmittal ] A Contracting Party that provides for communications on paper to be filed by electronic means of transmittal shall consider any such communication signed if a graphic representation of a signature accepted by that Contracting Party under paragraph [ 3 ] appears on the communication as received .
Translation: [4] [通过电子传输方式提交的纸质通信的签名] 若缔约方规定可通过电子传输方式提交纸质通信，则只要接收到的通信上带有该缔约方根据第[3]款接受的签名的图形表示，该缔约方应视为此类通信已签署。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] [ Original of a Communication on Paper Filed by Electronic Means of Transmittal ] A Contracting Party that provides for communications on paper to be filed by electronic means of transmittal may require that the original of any such communication be filed [ i ] with the Office accompanied by a letter identifying that earlier transmission and [ ii ] within a time limit which shall be at least one month from the date on which the Office received the communication by electronic means of transmittal .
Translation: 使用电子传送方式提交书面通信的缔约方，可以要求此类通信的原件需满足以下条件：[一]随附注明此前已进行电子传送的函件向该机构提交；[二]在自该机构收讫电子传送方式提交的通信之日起至少一个月的期限内提交。

Query_Text_en: [ 6 ] [ Authentication of Communications in Electronic Form ] A Contracting Party that permits the filing of communications in electronic form may require that any such communication be authenticated through a system of electronic authentication as prescribed by that Contracting Party .
Translation: [6] [电子形式通信的认证] 允许以电子形式提交通信文件的缔约方，可要求通过该缔约方规定的电子认证系统对相关通信进行认证。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] [ Date of Receipt ] Each Contracting Party shall be free to determine the circumstances in which the receipt of a document or the payment of a fee shall be deemed to constitute receipt by or payment to the Office in cases in which the document was actually received by or payment was actually made to [ i ] a branch or sub-office of the Office , [ ii ] a national Office on behalf of the Office of the Contracting Party , where the Contracting Party is an intergovernmental organization referred to in Article 26 [ 1 ] [ ii ] , [ iii ] an official postal service , [ iv ] a delivery service , or an agency , specified by the Contracting Party , [ v ] an address other than the nominated addresses of the Office .
Translation: [7] [收讫日期] 在下列情况下，每一缔约方应有权自行决定何种情况下视为该机构收到文件或收取费用：  [ⅰ] 该文件实际由该机构的分支机构或下属机构接收，或费用实际支付至该机构的分支机构或下属机构；  [ⅱ] 该缔约方为《第二十六条》[1][ⅱ]所指的政府间组织时，文件实际由代表该缔约方的国家级机构接收，或费用实际支付至代表该缔约方的国家级机构；  [ⅲ] 文件实际由缔约方指定的官方邮政服务接收，或费用实际支付至缔约方指定的快递服务或代理机构；  [ⅳ] 文件实际由缔约方指定的非该机构指定地址的其他地址接收。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] [ Electronic Filing ] Subject to paragraph [ 7 ] , where a Contracting Party provides for the filing of a communication in electronic form or by electronic means of transmittal and the communication is so filed , the date on which the Office of that Contracting Party receives the communication in such form or by such means shall constitute the date of receipt of the communication .
Translation: 除第[7]款另有规定外，如一缔约方规定以电子形式提交或通过电子传输方式提交通信文件且该文件已依此方式提交，则该缔约方主管机构收到该通信文件之日即视为该文件的收讫日期。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] the provisional application number , if any , given by the Office , or [ ii ] a copy of the application , or [ iii ] a representation of the mark , accompanied by an indication of the date on which , to the best knowledge of the applicant or the representative , the application was received by the Office and an identification number given to the application by the applicant or the representative .
Translation:
[一] 该机构签发的临时申请编号（如有）；  
[二] 申请书副本；  
[三] 商标图样，并附申请人或其代理人所知的申请被该机构受理的日期说明，以及申请人或其代理人赋予该申请的识别编号。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Prohibition of Other Requirements ] No Contracting Party may demand that requirements other than those referred to in paragraph [ 1 ] be complied with in order for an application to be identified where its application number has not yet been issued or is not known to the applicant or its representative .
Translation: [2] [禁止其他要求] 任何缔约方不得要求将除第[1]款所述要求以外的其他要求作为识别该申请的条件，除非该申请编号尚未签发或申请人及其代表未知悉该编号。

Query_Text_en: Rule 8 ? ? ? Details Concerning Duration and RenewalFor the purposes of Article 13 [ 1 ] [ c ] , the period during which the request for renewal may be presented and the renewal fee may be paid shall start at least six months before the date on which the renewal is due and shall end at the earliest six months after that date .
Translation: 关于第十三条 [1][c] ，提交续展请求以及缴纳续展费用的期限应符合以下规定：该期限应至少从续展截止日期前六个月开始计算，并最迟持续至该日期后的六个月结束。

Query_Text_en: If the request for renewal is presented and\/or the renewal fees are paid after the date on which the renewal is due , any Contracting Party may subject the acceptance of the request for renewal to the payment of a surcharge .
Translation: 如果续期申请在应缴费日之后提交，和/或续期费用在该日期之后缴纳，任何缔约方可要求缴纳滞纳金，作为受理该续期申请的条件。

Query_Text_en: Rule 9 ? ? ? Relief Measures in Case of Failure to Comply with Time Limits [ 1 ] [ Requirements Concerning Extension of Time Limits Under Article 14 [ 2 ] [ i ] ] A Contracting Party that provides for the extension of a time limit under Article 14 [ 2 ] [ i ] shall extend the time limit for a reasonable period of time from the date of filing the request for extension and may require that the request [ i ] contain an identification of the requesting party , the relevant application or registration number and the time limit concerned , and [ ii ] be filed within a time limit which shall not be less than two months from the date of expiry of the time limit concerned .
Translation: 第九条 关于未遵守时限情况下的救济措施  [1] [关于依据第十四条（2）（i）款延长时限的规定[2][i]]  凡根据第十四条（2）（i）款规定允许延长时限的缔约方，应自收到延长时限请求之日起，合理延长时限，并可要求该请求[（i）]包含请求方的标识、相关申请或注册号以及涉及的具体时限，以及[（ii）]在原时限届满后至少两个月内提交该请求。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] [ Requirements Concerning Continued Processing Under Article 14 [ 2 ] [ ii ] ] A Contracting Party may require that the request for continued processing under Article 14 [ 2 ] [ ii ] [ i ] contain an identification of the requesting party , the relevant application or registration number and the time limit concerned , and [ ii ] be filed within a time limit which shall not be less than two months from the date of expiry of the time limit concerned . The omitted act shall be completed within the same period or , where the Contracting Party so provides , together with the request .
Translation: 缔约方可要求，根据第14条第(2)(ii)(i)款提出的继续处理请求中须载明请求方身份、相关申请或注册号以及所涉期限；且[(2)(ii)]该请求需在时间限制内提交，而此时间限制不得早于所涉期限届满后，且至少包含两个月。遗漏行为须在相同期限内完成，或由缔约方另行规定随同请求一并提交。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] [ Requirements Concerning Reinstatement of Rights Under Article 14 [ 2 ] [ iii ] ] [ a ] A Contracting Party may require that the request for reinstatement of rights under Article 14 [ 2 ] [ iii ] [ i ] contain an identification of the requesting party , the relevant application or registration number and the time limit concerned , and [ ii ] set out the facts and evidence in support of the reasons for the failure to comply with the time limit concerned .
Translation: 关于根据第十四条[2][iii]恢复权利的要求  [ a ] 缔约方可要求根据第十四条[2][iii][i]提出的恢复权利请求包含请求方的识别信息、相关申请或注册号以及涉及的期限，并[ ii ] 列明支持未遵守该期限原因的事实和证据。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] The request for reinstatement of rights shall be filed with the Office within a reasonable time limit , the duration of which shall be determined by the Contracting Party from the date of the removal of the cause of failure to comply with the time limit concerned .
Translation: 权利恢复申请应向该机构提出，申请期限应为合理期间，该期间应由缔约方自导致未遵守相关期限的原因消除之日起算确定。

Query_Text_en: The omitted act shall be completed within the same period or , where the Contracting Party so provides , together with the request .
Translation: 遗漏的行为应在同一期限内完成，或如缔约方另有规定，与请求一并提交。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] A Contracting Party may provide for a maximum time limit for complying with the requirements under subparagraphs [ a ] and [ b ] of not less than six months from the date of expiry of the time limit concerned .
Translation: 缔约方可规定，就第（a）项和（b）项所述要求的履行，自相关期限届满之日起，最长期限不得少于六个月。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] [ Exceptions Under Article 14 [ 3 ] ] The exceptions referred to in Article 14 [ 3 ] are the cases of failure to comply with a time limit [ i ] for which a relief measure has already been granted under Article 14 [ 2 ] , [ ii ] for filing a request for a relief measure under Article 14 , [ iii ] for payment of a renewal fee , [ iv ] for an action before a board of appeal or other review body constituted in the framework of the Office , [ v ] for an action in inter partes proceedings , [ vi ] for filing the declaration referred to in Article 3 [ 1 ] [ a ] [ vii ] or the declaration referred to in Article 3 [ 1 ] [ a ] [ viii ] , [ vii ] for filing a declaration which , under the law of the Contracting Party , may establish a new filing date for a pending application , and [ viii ] for the correction or addition of a priority claim .
Translation: 第14条[3]所述的例外情况是指未遵守下列期限的情形：[i] 已根据第14条[2]获得救济措施的情况；[ii] 提交第14条所述救济措施的请求；[iii] 缴纳续展费用；[iv] 在根据局方框架设立的上诉委员会或其他复审机构前提出申诉；[v] 在双方程序中采取行动；[vi] 提交第3条[1][a][vii]或第3条[1][a][viii]所述声明；[vii] 提交一声明——根据缔约方法律，该声明可能为待审申请确立新的申请日期；以及[viii] 修正或补充优先权主张。

Query_Text_en: [ xiii ] the duration of the license .
Translation: [ xiii ] 许可期限。

Query_Text_en: [ ii ] where the amendment or cancellation concerns any of the indications or elements specified under subparagraph [ a ] , the nature and scope of the amendment or cancellation to be recorded .
Translation: [ ii ] 若修改或取消涉及子项（a）中规定的任何事项或要素，则应记录该修改或取消的性质及范围。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] an extract of the license contract indicating the parties and the rights being licensed , certified by a notary public or any other competent public authority as being a true extract of the contract ; or [ ii ] an uncertified statement of license , the content of which corresponds to the statement of license Form provided for in the Regulations , and signed by both the holder and the licensee .
Translation:
[i] 经公证人或其他有权机关认证的许可合同摘要，须载明合同当事人及许可权利等内容，并确认其为合同真实摘录；或  
[ii] 内容须与《条例》规定的许可声明格式一致的未经认证许可声明书，且须由许可方和被许可方双方签署。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any Contracting Party may require that any co-holder who is not a party to the license contract give its express consent to the license in a document signed by it .
Translation: 任何缔约方可以要求未参与许可合同的共同持有人以书面形式签署文件，明确表示同意该许可。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] documents substantiating the requested amendment of the recordal of the license ; or [ ii ] an uncertified statement of amendment of license , the content of which corresponds to the statement of amendment of license Form provided for in these Regulations , and signed by both the holder and the licensee .
Translation: [i] 证明所请求修改许可证登记记录的文件；或 [ii] 一份未认证的许可证变更声明书，其内容应与本规定所规定的许可证变更声明书格式一致，并由持证人和被许可人双方签署。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Any Contracting Party may require that any co-holder who is not a party to the license contract give its express consent to the amendment of the license in a document signed by it .
Translation: 任何缔约方均可要求未参与许可合同的共同持有人以由其签署的书面文件明确同意对许可进行修改。

Query_Text_en: [ i ] documents substantiating the requested cancellation of the recordal of the license ; or [ ii ] an uncertified statement of cancellation of license , the content of which corresponds to the statement of cancellation of license Form provided for in these Regulations , and signed by both the holder and the licensee .
Translation:
[一] 证明请求注销许可证登记的文件；或  
[二] 一份未经认证的许可证注销声明，其内容应与本规定提供的许可证注销声明格式一致，并由许可证持有人和被许可人共同签署。

Query_Text_en: Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety to the Convention on Biological DiversityJanuary 29 , 2000PREAMBLEThe Parties to this Protocol , Being Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity , hereinafter referred to as `` the Convention '' , Recalling Article 19 , paragraphs 3 and 4 , and Articles 8 [ g ] and 17 of theConvention , Recalling also decision II\/5 of 17 November 1995 of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention to develop a Protocol on biosafety , specifically focusing on transboundary movement of any living modified organism resulting from modern biotechnology that may have adverse effect on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity , setting out for consideration , in particular , appropriate procedures for advance informed agreement , Reaffirming the precautionary approach contained in Principle 15 of the Rio Declaration on Environment and Development , Aware of the rapid expansion of modern biotechnology and the growing public concern over its potential adverse effects on biological diversity , taking also into account risks to human health , Recognizing that modern biotechnology has great potential for human wellbeing if developed and used with adequate safety measures for the environment and human health , Recognizing also the crucial importance to humankind of centres of origin and centres of genetic diversity , Taking into account the limited capabilities of many countries , particularly developing countries , to cope with the nature and scale of known and potential risks associated with living modified organisms , Recognizing that trade and environment agreements should be mutually supportive with a view to achieving sustainable development , Emphasizing that this Protocol shall not be interpreted as implying a change in the rights and obligations of a Party under any existing international agreements , Understanding that the above recital is not intended to subordinate this Protocol to other international agreements , Have agreed as follows :
Translation: 《生物多样性公约》卡塔赫纳生物安全议定书2000年1月29日序言本议定书缔约方：作为《生物多样性公约》的缔约方，谨此援引公约第19条第3款和第4款，以及第8(g)条和第17条；同样援引1995年11月17日《生物多样性公约》缔约方第二次会议所作第II/5号决定：即制定一项以现代生物技术产生的、可能对生物多样性保护和可持续利用造成不利影响的任何活体改良生物体的越境转移为重点的生物安全议定书，特别是设立相关的事先知情同意程序；重申《里约环境与发展宣言》第15项原则所载的预防性措施；注意到现代生物技术的迅速发展以及公众对其可能对生物多样性产生的不利影响的日益关切，包括与人类健康相关的风险；认识到若采取充分保障环境及人类健康的安保措施，现代生物技术将对人类福祉具有巨大潜力；同样认识到起源中心和遗传多样性中心对人类的重要意义；注意到许多国家，尤其是发展中国家，应对现代生物技术相关已知及潜在风险的能力有限；确认环境与贸易协定应相互支持以实现可持续发展目标；强调本议定书的解释不得被视为改变各方在任何现有国际协定中的权利与义务；同时理解上述序言内容不旨在使本议定书从属于其他国际协定；兹协议如下：

Query_Text_en: Article 1 OBJECTIVEIn accordance with the precautionary approach contained in Principle 15 of the Rio Declaration on Environment and Development , the objective of this Protocol is to contribute to ensuring an adequate level of protection in the field of the safe transfer , handling and use of living modified organisms resulting from modern biotechnology that may have adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity , taking also into account risks to human health , and specifically focusing on transboundary movements .
Translation:
第一条 目的  
根据《里约环境与发展宣言》第15条规定的预防原则，本议定书的目的是旨在确保在现代生物技术所获得的活体转基因生物的安全转移、处理和使用领域达到充分保护水平，此类生物可能对生物多样性保护和可持续利用产生不利影响，同时考虑到对人类健康的风险，并特别关注跨境转移。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Party shall take necessary and appropriate legal , administrative and other measures to implement its obligations under this Protocol .
Translation: 每一方应采取必要且适当的法律、行政及其他措施，以履行其根据本议定书所承担的义务。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Parties shall ensure that the development , handling , transport , use , transfer and release of any living modified organisms are undertaken in a manner that prevents or reduces the risks to biological diversity , taking also into account risks to human health .
Translation: 缔约方应确保任何转基因生物的研发、处理、运输、使用、转移和释放均以防止或减少对生物多样性的风险的方式进行，同时考虑到对人类健康的影响。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Nothing in this Protocol shall affect in any way the sovereignty of States over their territorial sea established in accordance with international law , and the sovereign rights and the jurisdiction which States have in their exclusive economic zones and their continental shelves in accordance with international law , and the exercise by ships and aircraft of all States of navigational rights and freedoms as provided for in international law and as reflected in relevant international instruments .
Translation: 本议定书的任何规定均不得以任何方式影响各国根据国际法对其领海所享有的主权，以及各国根据国际法在其专属经济区和大陆架上所享有的主权权利和管辖权；同时不得影响所有国家的船舶和飞机根据国际法所规定的航行权利和自由，以及这些权利和自由在相关国际文件中的体现。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Nothing in this Protocol shall be interpreted as restricting the right of aParty to take action that is more protective of the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity than that called for in this Protocol , provided that such action is consistent with the objective and the provisions of this Protocol and is in accordance with that Party 's other obligations under international law .
Translation: 本议定书的任何规定均不得被解释为限制缔约方采取比本议定书要求更具保护性的措施以促进生物多样性的保护和可持续利用的权利，只要此类措施与本议定书的目标和条款保持一致，并符合该缔约方依据国际法所承担的其他义务。

Query_Text_en: 5 . The Parties are encouraged to take into account , as appropriate , available expertise , instruments and work undertaken in international forums with competence in the area of risks to human health .
Translation: 缔约方应酌情考虑在人类健康风险领域具有权威性的国际论坛所提供的相关专业知识、工具及已开展的工作。

Query_Text_en: b. Fusion of cells beyond the taxonomic family , that overcome natural physiological reproductive or recombination barriers and that are not techniques used in traditional breeding and selection ;
Translation: 不同科属间的细胞融合，即突破自然生理生殖或重组屏障且不属于传统育种和选择技术的方法。

Query_Text_en: [ k ] `` Transboundary movement '' means the movement of a living modified organism from one Party to another Party , save that for the purposes of Articles 17 and 24 transboundary movement extends to movement between Parties and non-Parties .
Translation: “越境转移”系指转基因生物从一缔约方输往另一缔约方。但就第17条和第24条而言，越境转移包括缔约方与非缔约方之间的转移。

Query_Text_en: Article 4 SCOPEThis Protocol shall apply to the transboundary movement , transit , handling and use of all living modified organisms that may have adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity , taking also into account risks to human health .
Translation: 本议定书适用于可能对生物多样性保护和可持续利用产生不利影响的所有活体转基因生物的越境转移、过境、处理及利用，同时考虑到对人类健康的风险。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 PHARMACEUTICALSNotwithstanding Article 4 and without prejudice to any right of a Party to subject all living modified organisms to risk assessment prior to the making of decisions on import , this Protocol shall not apply to the transboundary movement of living modified organisms which are pharmaceuticals for humans that are addressed by other relevant international agreements or organizations .
Translation:
第五条 药品  
尽管第四条存在，且不影响任何一方在进口决策前对所有活体转基因生物进行风险评估的权利，本议定书不适用于由其他相关国际协议或组织所涵盖的、作为人类药品的活体转基因生物的跨境转移。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Notwithstanding Article 4 and without prejudice to any right of a Party of transit to regulate the transport of living modified organisms through its territory and make available to the Biosafety Clearing-House , any decision of that Party , subject to Article 2 , paragraph 3 , regarding the transit through its territory of a specific living modified organism , the provisions of this Protocol with respect to the advance informed agreement procedure shall not apply to living modified organisms in transit .
Translation: 本条规定不排除《议定书》第四条的适用，亦不影响缔约方行使过境权对通过其领土运输的转基因生物进行监管并向生物安全信息交换所提供相关信息。根据本议定书第二条第三款的规定，缔约方就特定转基因生物过境其领土所作的决定，本议定书关于事先知情同意程序的规定不适用于过境中的转基因生物。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Notwithstanding Article 4 and without prejudice to any right of a Party to subject all living modified organisms to risk assessment prior to decisions on import and to set standards for contained use within its jurisdiction , the provisions of this Protocol with respect to the advance informed agreement procedure shall not apply to the transboundary movement of living modified organisms destined for contained use undertaken in accordance with the standards of the Party of import .
Translation: 本议定书不排除《公约》第四条，且无损于任何缔约方对进口活体转基因生物进行事前风险评估并设定境内控制使用标准的权利。但本议定书关于事先知情同意程序的规定不适用于按照进口缔约方规定的标准进行的受控用途活体转基因生物越境转移。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to Articles 5 and 6 , the advance informed agreement procedure in Articles 8 to 10 and 12 shall apply prior to the first intentional transboundary movement of living modified organisms for intentional introduction into the environment of the Party of import .
Translation: 除第五条和第六条规定外，在活体转基因生物首次有意跨境转移并计划有意引入进口缔约方环境之前，第八至第十条以及第十二条所述事先知情同意程序应予适用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . `` Intentional introduction into the environment '' in paragraph 1 above , does not refer to living modified organisms intended for direct use as food or feed , or for processing .
Translation: “本条第一段中的‘有意引入环境’不包括作为食品、饲料直接使用或用于加工的活体转基因生物。”

Query_Text_en: 3 . Article 11 shall apply prior to the first transboundary movement of living modified organisms intended for direct use as food or feed , or for processing .
Translation: 《第11条》应适用于首次跨境转移活体转基因生物之前，且该生物拟作为食品、饲料直接使用或用于加工的情形。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The advance informed agreement procedure shall not apply to the intentional transboundary movement of living modified organisms identified in a decision of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol as being not likely to have adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity , taking also into account risks to human health .
Translation: 事先知情同意程序不适用于《公约》缔约方大会作为本议定书缔约方会议通过决定所确定的活体转基因生物。此类生物经评估认定不太可能对生物多样性保护和可持续利用产生不利影响，同时亦考量了对人类健康的风险。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Party of export shall notify , or require the exporter to ensure notification to , in writing , the competent national authority of the Party of import prior to the intentional transboundary movement of a living modified organism that falls within the scope of Article 7 , paragraph 1 .
Translation: 出口缔约方应在有意进行属于《第7条第1款》范围内的转基因生物越境转移前，以书面形式通知进口缔约方的国家主管部门，或要求出口商确保完成该通知程序。

Query_Text_en: The notification shall contain , at a minimum , the information specified in Annex I.
Translation: 通知应至少包含附件一所规定的信息。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Party of export shall ensure that there is a legal requirement for the accuracy of information provided by the exporter .
Translation: 出口方应确保出口商提供的信息符合法定准确性要求。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Party of import shall acknowledge receipt of the notification , in writing , to the notifier within ninety days of its receipt .
Translation: 进口方应在自收到通知之日起九十天内，以书面形式向通知方确认已收到该通知。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] Whether to proceed according to the domestic regulatory framework of the Party of import or according to the procedure specified in Article 10 .
Translation: 是按照进口方的国内监管框架来进行，还是按照第十条规定的程序来进行？

Query_Text_en: 3 . The domestic regulatory framework referred to in paragraph 2 [ c ] above , shall be consistent with this Protocol .
Translation: 本节第2款[c]项所述的国内监管框架应与本议定书保持一致。

Query_Text_en: 4 . A failure by the Party of import to acknowledge receipt of a notification shall not imply its consent to an intentional transboundary movement .
Translation: 进口缔约方未能确认收到通知，不得视为其同意进行故意跨境转移。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Decisions taken by the Party of import shall be in accordance with Article 15 .
Translation: 进口方所作决定应符合第十五条的规定。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] After no less than ninety days without a subsequent written consent .
Translation: 在未取得后续书面同意的情况下，经过不少于九十日之后。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] Informing the notifier that the period specified in this paragraph is extended by a defined period of time .
Translation: 通知申报方，本段所规定之期限延长了一个确定的期限。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Except in a case in which consent is unconditional , a decision under paragraph 3 above , shall set out the reasons on which it is based .
Translation: 除非有关同意是无条件的，本条上述第3款所作的决定应当阐明其依据的理由。

Query_Text_en: 5 . A failure by the Party of import to communicate its decision within two hundred and seventy days of the date of receipt of the notification shall not imply its consent to an intentional transboundary movement .
Translation: 进口方未在其收到通知之日起二百七十日内通报其决定的，不得视为其同意该故意跨境转移行为。

Query_Text_en: 6 . Lack of scientific certainty due to insufficient relevant scientific information and knowledge regarding the extent of the potential adverse effects of a living modified organism on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity in the Party of import , taking also into account risks to human health , shall not prevent that Party from taking a decision , as appropriate , with regard to the import of the living modified organism in question as referred to in paragraph 3 above , in order to avoid or minimize such potential adverse effects .
Translation: 进口缔约方因缺乏足够的相关科学信息和知识，无法确定转基因生物对其保护和可持续利用生物多样性可能产生的不利影响程度（同时亦需考虑对人类健康的风险），不得因此妨碍其根据上述第3款规定，就有关转基因生物进口事宜采取适当决策，以避免或尽量减少此类潜在不利影响。

Query_Text_en: 7 . The Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties shall , at its first meeting , decide upon appropriate procedures and mechanisms to facilitate decision-making by Parties of import .
Translation: 缔约方大会作为缔约方会议，应在首次会议上决定适当的程序和机制，以促进进口缔约方的决策。

Query_Text_en: 1 . A Party that makes a final decision regarding domestic use , including placing on the market , of a living modified organism that may be subject to transboundary movement for direct use as food or feed , or for processing shall , within fifteen days of making that decision , inform the Parties through the Biosafety Clearing-House .
Translation: 就国内使用问题作出最终决定的缔约方，包括涉及可能需越境转移并作为食品或饲料直接使用或用于加工的转基因生物的投放市场决定，应当在作出该决定后十五日内，通过生物安全信息交换所向缔约方通报。

Query_Text_en: This information shall contain , at a minimum , the information specified in Annex II .
Translation: 本信息至少应包含附件二中规定的信息。

Query_Text_en: The Party shall provide a copy of the information , in writing , to the national focal point of each Party that informs the Secretariat in advance that it does not have access to the Biosafety Clearing - House .
Translation: 缔约方应向已提前通知秘书处其无法使用生物安全信息交换所的每一缔约方的国家联络点提供书面材料。

Query_Text_en: This provision shall not apply to decisions regarding field trials .
Translation: 本条款不适用于涉及田间试验的决定。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Party making a decision under paragraph 1 above , shall ensure that there is a legal requirement for the accuracy of information provided by the applicant .
Translation: 根据本条上文第1款作出决定的政党，应确保申请人所提供信息的准确性有法律依据。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Any Party may request additional information from the authority identified in paragraph [ b ] of Annex II .
Translation: 任何一方有权向附件II第(b)段中指定的主管机构要求补充信息。

Query_Text_en: 4 . A Party may take a decision on the import of living modified organisms intended for direct use as food or feed , or for processing , under its domestic regulatory framework that is consistent with the objective of this Protocol .
Translation: 缔约方可根据其国内监管框架，就拟直接用作食品或饲料或用于加工的活体转基因生物进口事宜作出决定，该监管框架应符合本议定书的目标。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Each Party shall make available to the Biosafety Clearing-House copies of any national laws , regulations and guidelines applicable to the import of living modified organisms intended for direct use as food or feed , or for processing , if available .
Translation: 每一缔约方应向生物安全信息交换中心提供任何适用于拟直接用作食品或饲料或用于加工的转基因生物进口的国家法律、法规和指南的副本，如有。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] A decision made within a predictable timeframe , not exceeding two hundred and seventy days .
Translation: 在可预见的时间框架内作出的决定，且不超过二百七十天。

Query_Text_en: 7 . Failure by a Party to communicate its decision according to paragraph 6 above , shall not imply its consent or refusal to the import of a living modified organism intended for direct use as food or feed , or for processing , unless otherwise specified by the Party .
Translation: 一方未根据上述第6段的规定通报其决定，不得视为其对拟直接用作食品或饲料或用于加工的活体转基因生物的进口表示同意或拒绝，除非该方另有规定。

Query_Text_en: 8 . Lack of scientific certainty due to insufficient relevant scientific information and knowledge regarding the extent of the potential adverse effects of a living modified organism on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity in the Party of import , taking also into account risks to human health , shall not prevent that Party from taking a decision , as appropriate , with regard to the import of that living modified organism intended for direct use as food or feed , or for processing , in order to avoid or minimize such potential adverse effects .
Translation: 进口缔约方由于缺乏足够的相关信息和知识，无法确定转基因生物对其保护和可持续利用生物多样性可能产生的不利影响的程度，同时考虑到对人类健康的风险，不得因此阻止该缔约方根据具体情况，就进口该转基因生物（用于直接用作食品或饲料，或用于加工）采取适当决定，以避免或尽量减少此类潜在不利影响。

Query_Text_en: 9 . A Party may indicate its needs for financial and technical assistance and capacity-building with respect to living modified organisms intended for direct use as food or feed , or for processing .
Translation: 缔约方可表明其在直接用作食品或饲料或用于加工的转基因生物方面所需的资金、技术和能力建设需求。

Query_Text_en: Parties shall cooperate to meet these needs in accordance with Articles 22 and 28 .
Translation: 各方应按照第22条和第28条的规定，合作满足这些需求。

Query_Text_en: 1 . A Party of import may , at any time , in light of new scientific information on potential adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity , taking also into account the risks to human health , review and change a decision regarding an intentional transboundary movement .
Translation: 进口缔约方可随时根据有关可能对生物多样性保护及可持续利用产生不利影响的新科学信息，并考虑到对人类健康的危害风险，审查并改变关于有意跨境转移的决定。

Query_Text_en: In such case , the Party shall , within thirty days , inform any notifier that has previously notified movements of the living modified organism referred to in such decision , as well as the Biosafety Clearing-House , and shall set out the reasons for its decision .
Translation: 在这种情况下，缔约方应当在三十日内通知此前已通报所涉转基因生物活动情况的通报方以及生物安全信息交换所，并说明其作出该决定的理由。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Party of import shall respond in writing to such a request within ninety days and set out the reasons for its decision .
Translation: 进口方应于九十天内以书面形式答复此类请求，并说明其决定的理由。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The Party of import may , at its discretion , require a risk assessment for subsequent imports .
Translation: 进口方可自行决定是否要求对后续进口进行风险评估。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Imports of living modified organisms to it to be exempted from the advance informed agreement procedure .
Translation: 输入其境内的活体转基因生物可免于事先知情同意程序。

Query_Text_en: Notifications under subparagraph [ a ] above , may apply to subsequent similar movements to the same Party .
Translation: 根据上述子项[ a ]的通知，可适用于同一方的后续类似行为。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The information relating to an intentional transboundary movement that is to be provided in the notifications referred to in paragraph 1 [ a ] above , shall be the information specified in Annex I.
Translation: 根据上述第1款（a）项所述通知须提供的与有意跨境转移有关的信息，应包含附件一所列信息。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Parties may enter into bilateral , regional and multilateral agreements and arrangements regarding intentional transboundary movements of living modified organisms , consistent with the objective of this Protocol and provided that such agreements and arrangements do not result in a lower level of protection than that provided for by the Protocol .
Translation: 缔约方可以缔结关于转基因生物有意跨境转移的双边、区域和多边协议和安排，前提是这些协议和安排与本议定书的目标一致，且不得导致保护水平低于本议定书规定的标准。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Parties shall inform each other , through the Biosafety Clearing-House , of any such bilateral , regional and multilateral agreements and arrangements that they have entered into before or after the date of entry into force of this Protocol .
Translation: 缔约方应通过生物安全信息交换所，相互通知其在本议定书生效之前或之后缔结的任何双边、区域和多边协定及安排。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The provisions of this Protocol shall not affect intentional transboundary movements that take place pursuant to such agreements and arrangements as between the parties to those agreements or arrangements .
Translation: 本议定书的规定不得影响根据相关协议或安排各方之间达成的此类安排进行的有意跨境转移。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Any Party may determine that its domestic regulations shall apply with respect to specific imports to it and shall notify the Biosafety Clearing-House of its decision .
Translation: 任何一方均可决定对其进口的特定货物适用本国法规，并应将该决定通知生物安全信息交换中心。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Risk assessments undertaken pursuant to this Protocol shall be carried out in a scientifically sound manner , in accordance with Annex III and taking into account recognized risk assessment techniques .
Translation: 根据本议定书开展的风险评估，应当以科学合理的方式进行，依据附件三，并考虑公认的评估技术。

Query_Text_en: Such risk assessments shall be based , at a minimum , on information provided in accordance with Article 8 and other available scientific evidence in order to identify and evaluate the possible adverse effects of living modified organisms on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity , taking also into account risks to human health .
Translation: 此类风险评估应至少基于根据第八条提供的信息及其他现有科学证据，以识别和评估转基因生物对生物多样性保护和可持续利用的潜在不利影响，并同时考虑对人类健康的风险。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The Party of import shall ensure that risk assessments are carried out for decisions taken under Article 10 .
Translation: 进口方应确保根据第十条所作的决定均经过风险评估。

Query_Text_en: It may require the exporter to carry out the risk assessment .
Translation: 可能需要出口商开展风险评估。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The cost of risk assessment shall be borne by the notifier if the Party of import so requires .
Translation: 如进口方提出要求，风险评估费用应由申报人承担。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The Parties shall , taking into account Article 8 [ g ] of the Convention , establish and maintain appropriate mechanisms , measures and strategies to regulate , manage and control risks identified in the risk assessment provisions of this Protocol associated with the use , handling and transboundary movement of living modified organisms .
Translation: 各方应考虑到公约第8条(g)项，建立并维持适当的机制、措施和策略，以监管、管理和控制本议定书风险评估条款中确定的与转基因生物的使用、处理及其越境转移相关的风险。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Measures based on risk assessment shall be imposed to the extent necessary to prevent adverse effects of the living modified organism on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity , taking also into account risks to human health , within the territory of the Party of import .
Translation: 进口缔约方应基于风险评估采取必要措施，以防止转基因生物对生物多样性保护和可持续利用造成不利影响，同时需考虑对人类健康的风险。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Each Party shall take appropriate measures to prevent unintentional transboundary movements of living modified organisms , including such measures as requiring a risk assessment to be carried out prior to the first release of a living modified organism .
Translation: 缔约方应采取适当措施防止活体转基因生物的无意越境转移，包括要求在首次释放活体转基因生物前进行风险评估等措施。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Without prejudice to paragraph 2 above , each Party shall endeavor to ensure that any living modified organism , whether imported or locally developed , has undergone an appropriate period of observation that is commensurate with its life-cycle or generation time before it is put to its intended use .
Translation: 不影响上述第2款的规定，每一方应努力确保任何活体转基因生物（无论为进口或本土开发）在将其用于预定用途前，已经过与其生命周期或繁殖周期相适应的适当观察期。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] Taking appropriate measures regarding the treatment of such living modified organisms or specific traits .
Translation: 对此类转基因生物或特定性状的处理采取适当措施。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Party shall take appropriate measures to notify affected or potentially affected States , the Biosafety Clearing-House and , where appropriate , relevant international organizations , when it knows of an occurrence under its jurisdiction resulting in a release that leads , or may lead , to an unintentional transboundary movement of a living modified organism that is likely to have significant adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity , taking also into account risks to human health in such States .
Translation: 各缔约方应在知悉其管辖范围内发生导致或可能导致活体转基因生物非故意越境转移的情况下（且该转移可能对生物多样性保护及可持续利用产生重大不利影响时），采取适当措施及时通知受影响或可能受影响的缔约方、生物安全信息交换所以及在适当情况下相关国际组织，并同时考虑此类转移对受涉国家人类健康所造成的风险。

Query_Text_en: The notification shall be provided as soon as the Party knows of the above situation .
Translation: 一方一旦知晓上述情况，应立即发出通知。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Party shall , no later than the date of entry into force of this Protocol for it , make available to the Biosafety Clearing-House the relevant details setting out its point of contact for the purposes of receiving notifications under this Article .
Translation: 每一缔约方应不迟于本议定书对其生效之日，向生物安全信息交换所提供相关详细信息，列明其联络点，以便接收本条规定的通知。

Query_Text_en: [ e ] A point of contact for further information .
Translation: 进一步信息的联系人。

Query_Text_en: 4 . In order to minimize any significant adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity , taking also into account risks to human health , each Party , under whose jurisdiction the release of the living modified organism referred to in paragraph 1 above , occurs , shall immediately consult the affected or potentially affected States to enable them to determine appropriate responses and initiate necessary action , including emergency measures .
Translation: 为尽量减少对生物多样性保护和可持续利用的重大不利影响，并同时考虑对人类健康的风险，对于在其管辖范围内发生本条第一款所述活体转基因生物释放的缔约方，应立即与受影响或可能受影响的国家进行磋商，以帮助其确定适当应对措施并采取必要行动，包括紧急措施。

Query_Text_en: 1 . In order to avoid adverse effects on the conservation and sustainable use of biological diversity , taking also into account risks to human health , each Party shall take necessary measures to require that living modified organisms that are subject to intentional transboundary movement within the scope of this Protocol are handled , packaged and transported under conditions of safety , taking into consideration relevant international rules and standards .
Translation: 为避免对生物多样性保护和可持续利用产生不利影响，并考虑到对人类健康的风险，各缔约方应采取必要措施，确保在本议定书范围内有意进行跨境转移的转基因生物在处理、包装和运输过程中符合安全条件，同时参考相关国际规则和标准。

Query_Text_en: [ a ] Living modified organisms that are intended for direct use as food or feed , or for processing , clearly identifies that they `` may contain '' living modified organisms and are not intended for intentional introduction into the environment , as well as a contact point for further information .
Translation: 活体转基因生物，如果其被用作直接食品或饲料，或用于加工用途，应明确标明其"可能含有"活体转基因生物且不用于有意释放到环境中，同时需提供联系方式以获取进一步信息。

Query_Text_en: and contains a declaration that the movement is in conformity with the requirements of this Protocol applicable to the exporter .
Translation: 并包含一份声明，证明该运输符合本议定书适用于该出口商的规定。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Protocol shall consider the need for and modalities of developing standards with regard to identification , handling , packaging and transport practices , in consultation with other relevant international bodies .
Translation: 作为本议定书缔约方会议的缔约方大会应与其他相关国际机构协商，考虑制定关于识别、处理、包装和运输实践标准的必要性和方式。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Each Party shall designate one national focal point to be responsible on its behalf for liaison with the Secretariat .
Translation: 各缔约方应指定一名国家联络点，代表其负责与秘书处的联络事宜。
