Query_Text_en: goods of the categories defined in Annex 3
Translation: 附件3所列类别的货物

Query_Text_en: an attachment to the Agreement that will contain time and or site specific variable elements A Protocol forms an integral part of the Agreement and will be equally binding
Translation: 本协议的附件将载有时段或地点特定的可变要素。本附件构成协议的不可分割组成部分，并与协议具有同等约束力。

Query_Text_en: includes river crossing by ferry where there is no bridge available
Translation: 包括在无桥梁可供通行的区域通过渡轮摆渡。

Query_Text_en: a transport service over a specified route according to a fixed route table with predetermined stopping places and for which set fares are charged accessible to everyone either on a first come first served basis or with prior booking
Translation: 一种按照固定班次时刻表在指定路线上运行，停靠预定站点并收取固定票价的运输服务，对所有公众开放，可通过先到先得或提前预订方式乘坐。

Query_Text_en: a country that is not a Contracting Party to the Agreement
Translation: 非该协议缔约方的国家

Query_Text_en: a natural or legal private or public person who carries goods and or People by road for reward
Translation: 以获取报酬为目的，通过公路运输货物或人员的自然人、法人或其他组织。

Query_Text_en: a transport operation that is an ancillary activity of an enterprise in view of moving its employee or the goods that are the object of its commercial activity in Vehicles owned by the enterprise and driven by its employees
Translation: 企业为运输员工或其商业活动中的货物而使用自有车辆并由员工驾驶的运输业务，属于企业的附属活动。

Query_Text_en: a country through the territory of which traffic in transit passes
Translation: 过境国

Query_Text_en: transport of goods across the territory of a Contracting Party when the passage through this territory is only a portion of a complete journey starting and ending beyond the frontiers of a Contracting Party across whose territory the traffic passes
Translation: 当货物通过某一缔约方领土的运输仅为整个运输过程的一部分，且该运输的起点和终点均位于所涉运输经过的缔约方领土之外时

Query_Text_en: any means of road transport
Translation: 公路运输工具

Query_Text_en: The different inspections and controls of People passport visa driving license foreign exchange customs health epidemiological Vehicles registration roadworthiness insurance and goods customs quality phytosanitary plant protection veterinary shall be carried out jointly and simultaneously by the respective Competent Authorities involved e g customs police immigration trade agriculture health department
Translation: 涉及人员护照、签证、驾驶执照、外汇、海关、卫生防疫、车辆登记、安全检测、保险、货物通关、质量、动植物检疫及卫生检验等不同领域监管事项的检查与管控，应由相关主管部门（如海关、警察、移民局、贸易、农业、卫生部门等）联合同时实施。

Query_Text_en: The officials of the country pairs shall assist one another to the extent possible in the performance of their duties The two adjacent national authorities will carry out their inspections jointly and simultaneously Where the local configuration does not allow the installation of physically adjacent back to back frontier control posts the control officials from one Contracting Party shall be allowed to perform their duties on the territory of the other Contracting Party
Translation: 缔约双方官员应相互提供尽可能的协助以履行其职责。两国相邻国家机关将联合同步实施检查。若当地地理条件无法设置物理相邻的背靠背边境检查站，一方缔约方的边境管控官员可获准在另一方缔约方领土上执行职务。

Query_Text_en: The Contracting Parties will coordinate the hours of operation of their adjacent frontier crossing control authorities
Translation: 缔约双方将协调各自毗邻边境口岸管理机构的开放时间。

Query_Text_en: The Contracting Parties will work together to allow for advance exchange of information and clearance of goods and People
Translation: 缔约双方将共同努力，促进预先交换信息以及货物和人员的清关。

Query_Text_en: a For People Engaged in Transport OperationsThe Contracting Parties undertake to grant visas to nationals of the other Contracting Parties engaged in transport operations and who are subject to visa requirements multiple entry transit and exit visas for prolonged periods.
Translation: 从事运输业务人员缔约各方承诺向其他缔约方从事运输业务且需办理签证的本国公民提供有效期较长的多次过境和出入境签证。

Query_Text_en: b For People not Engaged in Transport OperationsThe conditions and modalities of visa issuance will be elaborated in Annex 5
Translation: （二）未从事运输业务人员的签证签发条件及程序将在附件五中详细说明。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Transport of PeopleThe performance of cross border transport of People such as Vehicles transport routes ticket pricing will be clearly stipulated in Annex 5 and Protocol 1
Translation:
第六条 人员运输  
关于跨境运输的实施事项，例如车辆运输路线、票价定价等，将在附件五和议定书一中明确规定。

Query_Text_en: iii the deposit of a bond as a guarantee for the customs duties
Translation: iii 缴纳保证金作为关税担保

Query_Text_en: b For that purpose the Contracting Parties undertake to institute a transit and inland customs clearance regime as specified in Annex 6
Translation: 缔约各方为此承诺建立如附件六所规定的过境和内陆海关清关制度。

Query_Text_en: a The Contracting Parties grant freedom of transit through their territory for Transit Traffic to or from the territory of the other Contracting Parties
Translation: 缔约各方准予其他缔约方领土的过境运输通过其领土享有过境自由。

Query_Text_en: b Transit Traffic shall be exempt from any customs duties and taxes
Translation: 过境运输应免予缴纳任何关税和税费。

Query_Text_en: Charges concerning Transit Traffic other than customs duties and taxes shall be levied as determined in Protocol 2.
Translation: 除关税和税费外的过境运输相关费用应按照《议定书》第二条的规定征收。

Query_Text_en: Charges levied on Transit Traffic shall only be cost related
Translation: 对过境交通征收的费用应仅与成本相关。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 Phytosanitary and Veterinary InspectionThe Contracting Parties shall comply with international agreements related to the regulations of the World Health Organization Food and Agriculture Organization and Office International des Epizooties in applying inspection of goods crossing the border
Translation:
第九条 动植物检疫  
缔约各方在对进出口货物实施检验检疫时，应遵守与世界卫生组织、联合国粮农组织以及国际兽医局（OIE）相关规定相关的国际协议。

Query_Text_en: a The Agreement shall not apply to the transport of Dangerous Goods as defined in Annex 1
Translation: 本协议不适用于附件一所定义的危险品的运输。

Query_Text_en: b The transport of Perishable Goods as defined in Annex 3 shall be granted a priority regime for border crossing clearance formalities set out in Annex 3 so that they may not be unduly delayed
Translation: 根据附件三定义的易腐货物运输应适用附件三规定的边境通关手续优先制度，以免遭受不合理延误。

Query_Text_en: Article 11 Admittance of Road Vehicles in Other Contracting PartiesSubject to the conditions set out in this Part the Contracting Parties shall admit to their territory Vehicles whether left hand or right hand drive operated either commercially for reward or for own account or privately registered by another Contracting Party
Translation: 缔约方应准许其他缔约方注册的车辆进入其领土。此类车辆无论是左舵或右舵驾驶，无论系以有偿方式从事商业运营、以自用为目的进行运营，或是由另一缔约方私人注册，均应适用本章规定的条件。

Query_Text_en: a Vehicles in cross border traffic shall be registered in their Home Country and in accordance with the rules set out in Annex 2
Translation: 从事跨境运输的车辆须在其所属国进行登记，并遵守附件2所载规定。

Query_Text_en: b The Vehicles shall bear identification marks trademark of manufacturer chassis and engine serial number carry a registration certificate display their registration number on a plate in the rear and the front and display a distinguishing sign of the country where it is registered
Translation: 车辆应标明识别标志、制造商商标、底盘编号和发动机序列号，携带登记证书，在前后牌照上显示注册号，并展示注册国的识别标志。

Query_Text_en: Article 13 Technical RequirementsVehicles and containers traveling to the territory of other Contracting Parties shall satisfy the equipment safety and emissions standards in force in their Home Country With respect to weights axle loads and dimensions Vehicles traveling to the territory of other Contracting Parties must comply with the technical standards of the Host Country
Translation:
第三条 技术要求  
驶往其他缔约方领土的车辆及集装箱，应当符合其所属国现行有效的设备安全与排放标准。在重量、轴荷及尺寸方面，驶往其他缔约方领土的车辆必须遵守东道国的技术标准。

Query_Text_en: a Vehicles traveling to the territory of other Contracting Parties shall be in good working order
Translation: 进入其他缔约方领土的车辆应当处于良好的工作状态。

Query_Text_en: b The Home Country is charged with the supervision of the roadworthiness of the Vehicles registered in its territory based on which it will issue a technical inspection certificate
Translation: 缔约国应负责对其境内注册车辆的适路性进行监管，并据此签发技术检验合格证书。

Query_Text_en: c The other Contracting Parties will recognize such technical inspection certificates
Translation: 其他缔约方将认可此类技术检验证书。

Query_Text_en: Article 15 Road Traffic Regulations and SignageThe Contracting Parties undertake to gradually adopt their road traffic regulations and signage to the rules and standards set out in Annex 7
Translation:
第十五条 道路交通法规和标志  
缔约各方承诺逐步使其道路交通法规和标志符合附件七所规定的规则和标准。

Query_Text_en: Article 16 Compulsory Third Party Motor Vehicle Liability InsuranceMotor Vehicles traveling to the territory of other Contracting Parties shall comply with the compulsory third party motor vehicle liability insurance required in the Host Country
Translation:
第十六条 机动车交通事故责任强制保险  
进入其他缔约方境内行驶的机动车，应当遵守东道国规定的机动车交通事故责任强制保险要求。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 Driving PermitsThe Contracting Parties shall recognize driving licenses issued by all other Contracting Parties in accordance with the Agreement on the Recognition of Domestic Driving Licenses issued by ASEAN Countries signed at Kuala Lumpur on 9 July 1985
Translation:
第十七条 驾驶执照互认  
缔约各方应根据一九八五年七月九日在吉隆坡签署的《东盟国家国内驾驶执照相互承认协议》的规定，相互承认其他各缔约方颁发的驾驶执照。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 Temporary Importation of Motor VehiclesThe Contracting Parties shall grant temporary admission to Motor Vehicles and the fuel contained in its supply tanks its lubricants maintenance supplies and spare parts in reasonable quantities registered in the territory of another Contracting Party without payment of import duties and import taxes without depositing a Customs ` guarantee bond and free of import prohibitions and restrictions subject to re exportation and subject to the other conditions laid down in Annex 8
Translation:
第八条 机动车辆的临时进口  
缔约各方应准许在另一缔约方境内注册的机动车辆及其油箱内所含燃料、润滑油、维修物资及合理数量的备用零件临时进口，免征进口关税及税费，无需缴纳海关保证金，并不受进口禁令和限制，但须以重新出口为条件，且须遵守附件8规定的其他条件。

Query_Text_en: and c Outbound from another Contracting Party
Translation: 来自另一缔约方的出境（c）

Query_Text_en: Transport Operators established in one Contracting Party may according to free market forces undertake transport operations into from or across the territory of other Contracting Parties Cabotage shall however only be permitted on the basis of a special authorization from the Host Country
Translation: 在一缔约方设立的运输经营人可根据市场自由竞争原则，在其他缔约方领土内、来自或穿越其领土开展运输业务。但国内运输业务仅可在东道国给予特别授权的基础上进行。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 Designation of Routes and Points of Entry and ExitProtocol 1 defines permissible routes and points of entry and exit for cross border transport of goods and People
Translation:
第二十条 过境路线及出入境点的指定  
议定书一规定了货物和人员跨境运输的允许路线及出入境点。

Query_Text_en: a Transport Operators shall be licensed for crossborder transport operations by their Home Country according to the criteria set out in Annex 9
Translation: 运输运营商应由其所属成员国根据附件9所规定标准，颁发从事跨境运输业务的许可证。

Query_Text_en: b The operating license can not be sold or transferred by the legal entity to which it is issued
Translation: 运营许可证不得由发放该许可证的法人实体出售或转让。

Query_Text_en: c The Host Country will recognize the operating license issued by the Home Country
Translation: 东道国将承认母国所颁发的运营许可。

Query_Text_en: a Any Transport Operator properly licensed for cross border transport operations in its Home Country according to the criteria set in Annex 9 shall be entitled to undertake cross border transport operations under the Agreement
Translation: 根据本协议，任何在其所属国根据附件9所设定标准获得跨境运输业务合法许可的运输运营商，均有权开展跨境运输业务。

Query_Text_en: b The Host Country shall grant permission to Transport Operators engaged in cross border transport to establish representative offices for the purpose of facilitating their traffic operations
Translation: 东道国应准予从事跨境运输的运输经营机构设立代表机构，以便为其运输业务运营提供便利。

Query_Text_en: The Vehicles to be operated in accordance with the Agreement shall be designated in Protocol 3 of the Agreement Transport frequency may be determined in Protocol 3 In addition the time frame to implement Step l shall be determined in Protocol 3 The National Transport Facilitation Committee of each Contracting Party as specified in Article 28 will exchange and issue the agreed number of permits each year.
Translation: 根据本协议运营的车辆应指定于本协议附件三。运输频次可确定于本协议附件三。此外，实施步骤一的时限应确定于本协议附件三。各缔约方根据第二十八条设立的国家运输便利化委员会将每年交换并发放商定数量的许可证。

Query_Text_en: The frequency and capacity of the transport operations under the Agreement will not be subject to any restriction other than contained in the Agreement
Translation: 本协议项下的运输业务频次和运力不受任何限制，除非本协议另有规定。

Query_Text_en: The conditions of transport will conform to the rules set out in Annex 10
Translation: 运输条件应符合附件10中载明的规定。

Query_Text_en: Price setting for cross border transport will be free and determined by market forces but subject to antitrust restrictions and supervision of the Joint Committee so as to avoid excessively high or low pricing
Translation: 跨境运输定价实行市场化调节，但需接受反垄断限制及联合委员会的监管，以防止出现过高或过低的价格。

Query_Text_en: a Construction or reconstruction of the roads including bridges linking the countries and shown in Protocol 1 shall be carried out within the framework of national public works programs or with international financing
Translation: 连接各国的如附件一所列道路（含桥梁）的建设或重建工作，应通过国家公共工程计划框架内实施或利用国际资金进行。

Query_Text_en: b Construction or reconstruction of the agreed roads including bridges shall be carried out in accordance with the minimum characteristics set out in Annex 11 to the extent permitted by available financial resources
Translation: 建设或重建双方商定的道路（含桥梁）应按照附件十一规定的最低标准，在可用资金允许的范围内进行。

Query_Text_en: C The Contracting Parties will ensure that the agreed roads are safe secure and in good condition They undertake to carry out the necessary repairs
Translation: 缔约各方应确保约定道路安全畅通并保持良好状态，并承诺实施必要的维修工作。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 Road Signs and SignalsThe Contracting Parties undertake to gradually bring the traffic signs and signals on their territory in line with the standards set in Annex 7
Translation:
第二十六条 交通标志和信号  
缔约各方应逐步使其境内的交通标志和信号符合附件七所规定之标准。

Query_Text_en: Article 27 Border Crossing FacilitiesThe Contracting Parties undertake to build or upgrade the required infrastructure at the border crossing points and to staff them so as to assure speedy and efficient completion of frontier crossing formalities as specified in Annex 12
Translation:
第二十七条 边境通关设施  
缔约双方承诺建设和升级改造边境口岸所需的基础设施，并配备足够人员，以确保快速高效地完成边境通关手续，具体规定详见附件十二。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 National Transport Facilitation CommitteesThe Contracting Parties will each establish a permanent National Transport Facilitation Committee chaired by a Minister or Vice Minister or its equivalent It will bring together representatives of all parties concerned with the implementation of the Agreement
Translation:
第二十八条 国家运输便利化委员会  
缔约各方应各自设立常设国家运输便利化委员会，该委员会由部长或副部长级官员担任主席，并召集与本协定实施相关的各方代表。

Query_Text_en: a Representatives of the respective National Transport Facilitation Committees will form together the Joint Committee
Translation: 各自的国家运输促进委员会代表将共同组成联合委员会。

Query_Text_en: b The Joint Committee will monitor and assess the functioning of the Agreement It will serve as a platform for discussion a forum for amicable settlement of disputes and it may address advice to the Contracting Parties and formulate proposals for amendment of the Agreement
Translation: 联合委员会将负责监督和评估本协议的执行情况。其将作为讨论的平台、友好解决争端的论坛，并可向缔约方提出建议及制定协议修改建议。

Query_Text_en: a People Transport Operators and Vehicles shall comply with the laws and regulations in force in the territory of the Host Country
Translation: 运输运营商及车辆应遵守东道国境内现行的法律法规。

Query_Text_en: b The enforcement of the local laws and regulations will be the sole competence of the authorities of the Host Country in whose territory the law was infringed
Translation: 东道国在其领土内发生违法行为时，当地法律法规的执行将完全属于该国主管机关的专属权限。

Query_Text_en: c The Host Country may temporarily or permanently deny access to its territory to a person a driver a Transport Operator or a Vehicle that has infringed the provisions of the Agreement or its national laws and regulations
Translation: 东道国可暂时或永久禁止违反本协定条款或其国内法律法规的人员、驾驶员、运输经营人或车辆进入其领土。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 Transparency of Legislation Regulation and Status of InfrastructureThe Contracting Parties undertake to make available in the English language a comprehensive brochure on the national laws regulations procedures and technical information relating to the cross border transport of goods and People as stipulated in the Agreement
Translation:
第三十一条 立法、法规及基础设施状况的透明度  
缔约各方承诺以英文提供一份全面的小册子，内容涉及协议中规定跨境货物和人员运输相关的国家法律、法规、程序及技术信息。

Query_Text_en: Article 32 Nondiscriminatory TreatmentThe Contracting Parties undertake to provide equal and not less favorable treatment to the Vehicles goods and People of the other Contracting Parties than to those of any Third Country in the cross border transport in accordance with the provisions of the Agreement
Translation:
第三十二条 非歧视待遇  
各缔约方承诺在跨境运输中，按照本协议规定，对其他缔约方的车辆、货物和人员所提供的待遇，不低于其给予任何第三国车辆、货物和人员的待遇。

Query_Text_en: Article 33 Assistance in the Case of Traffic AccidentsIn case of a road traffic accident involving People Transport Operators Vehicles or goods from another Contracting Party the Host Country will provide all possible assistance and notify the Competent Authorities of the Home Country as soon as possible
Translation:
第三十三条 交通事故中的协助  
在涉及另一缔约方运输经营者的车辆或货物的道路交通事故中，东道国将提供一切可能的协助，并尽快通知原籍国的主管机关。

Query_Text_en: and c a special container customs regime as set out in Annex 14
Translation: 并按照附件14所述实施特殊集装箱海关监管制度。

Query_Text_en: a The Contracting Parties recognize that documentation and procedures represent important time and cost elements affecting the efficiency of transit operations and agree to keep these costs and delays to a minimum
Translation: 缔约各方认识到，单证和程序是影响过境运输效率的重要时间和成本因素，并同意将相关成本和延误降至最低限度。

Query_Text_en: and viii give due advance notice to the other Contracting Parties of any additional requirement or modification in prescribed documentation and procedures to be introduced regarding cross border traffic
Translation: 第八项，应提前适当通知其他缔约方有关跨境运输将要引入的任何额外要求或对规定文件和程序的修改。

Query_Text_en: Article 36 Ratification or AcceptanceThe Agreement is subject to ratification or acceptance of the Governments of the Contracting Parties
Translation:
第三十六条 批准或接受  
本协议须经缔约各方政府批准或接受。

Query_Text_en: Article 37 Conforming National LawWhere necessary the Contracting Parties undertake to conform their relevant national legislation with the contents of the Agreement
Translation:
第三十七条 协调国内法律  
必要时，缔约各方应确保其相关国内立法与本协议内容保持一致。

Query_Text_en: Article 38 ReservationsNo reservation to the Agreement shall be permitted
Translation:
第三十八条 保留  
本协议不得提出任何保留。

Query_Text_en: Article 39 Entry into ForceThe Agreement will come into force on the day that all the Contracting Parties have ratified or accepted the Agreement
Translation:
第三十九条 生效  
本协议应在所有缔约方完成批准或接受之日生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 40 Suspension of the AgreementEach Contracting Party may temporarily suspend the application of the Agreement with immediate effect in the case of emergencies affecting its national safety The Contracting Party will inform the other Contracting Parties as soon as possible of such suspension which will end as soon as the situation returns to normal
Translation:
第四十条 协议暂停  
缔约方可在发生影响其国家安全的紧急情况时，立即暂停本协议的适用。该缔约方应尽快将暂停情况通知其他缔约方，暂停措施待情况恢复正常时终止。

Query_Text_en: Article 41 Relationship with Other International InstrumentsThe Agreement or any actions taken thereto shall not affect the rights and obligations of the Contracting Parties under any existing agreements or international conventions to which they are also Contracting Parties
Translation:
第四十一条 与其他国际条约的关系  
本协议或依据本协议采取的任何行动，均不影响缔约方根据其作为缔约方的现有协议或国际公约所享有的权利和承担的义务。

Query_Text_en: Article 42 Dispute SettlementAny dispute between or among two or more Contracting Parties on the interpretation or application of the Agreement shall be settled directly or by amicable negotiation in the Joint Committee
Translation: 第四十二条 争端解决 缔约方之间因对本协定的解释或适用产生的任何争端，应通过联合委员会进行直接磋商或友好协商解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 43 AmendmentAny Contracting Party may propose amendments to the Agreement via the Joint Committee The entry into force of such amendments shall be subject to the unanimous consent of the Contracting Parties
Translation:
第四十三条 修正案  
任何缔约方均可通过联合委员会提出对本协定的修改建议。此类修正案的生效须经全体缔约方一致同意。

Query_Text_en: Article 44 Denunciation a The Agreement may be denounced by any Contracting Party thereto after the expiration of two years from the date when it came into force by means of a notification addressed to the other two Contracting Parties b The denunciation shall take effect one year after its notification In witness whereof the undersigned being duly authorized to sign the Agreement have signed the Agreement on the Facilitation of Cross Border Transport of Goods and People Done at Vientiane on 26 November 1999 in three originals in the English language Signed :
Translation:
第四十四条 终止  
（一）自本协定生效之日起满两年后，任何缔约方可通过书面通知其他两缔约方的方式终止本协定。  
（二）终止通知自通知之日起一年后生效。  
下列签字人，经各自适当授权签署本协定，以资证明。  
《促进货物和人员跨境运输协定》  
于老挝万象签订，时间一九九九年十一月二十六日，以英文写成正本三份。  
签署人：

老挝人民民主共和国、泰王国与越南社会主义共和国  
关于便利货物和人员跨境运输协议的修正案  

老挝人民民主共和国、泰王国和越南社会主义共和国政府（以下简称“缔约各方”），  
鉴于各方于1999年11月26日在万象签署的《老挝人民民主共和国、泰王国与越南社会主义共和国政府间便利货物和人员跨境运输协议》（以下简称“本协议”），  
并鉴于大湄公河次区域（GMS）经济合作计划下的第九次次区域经济合作会议决定，各方同意所有六国GMS国家应于2001年底前完成《货物和人员跨境流动便利化框架协议》的制定和签署，  
希望对本协议进行修订，以作为大湄公河次区域（GMS）各国之间扩大货物和人员运输合作的初始阶段的基础，  
现达成如下协议：

Query_Text_en: Article 1The Contracting Parties agree that the first paragraph of the Preamble shall be replaced by the Contracting Parties
Translation:
第一条  
缔约各方同意，序言的第一段应由缔约各方予以替换。

Query_Text_en: Definitions of Terms Used in the Agreement shall be replaced by Agreement : this Agreement together with its Annexes and Protocols for the Facilitation of Cross Border Transport of Goods and People in the Greater Mekong Subregion Article 3The Contracting Parties agree that Article 36 shall be replaced by : The Agreement is subject to ratification or acceptance of the Governments of the Contracting Parties The signing ratification or acceptance and entry into force of the agreement may be performed before and independently from the signing ratification or acceptance and entry into force of the Annexes and Protocols
Translation:
本协议所用术语定义应以协议为准：本协议连同其附件及关于大湄公河次区域跨境货物和人员运输便利化的议定书  
第三条  
缔约各方同意以以下条款替代原第三十六条：  
本协议须经缔约各方政府批准或接受。本协议的签署、批准、接受及生效可先于并独立于其附件和议定书的签署、批准、接受及生效程序而进行。

Query_Text_en: Article 4The Contracting Parties agree that a new Article 36 bis be inserted after Article 36 : Ratification or Acceptance to read as follows : Article 36 bis : AccessionThe Agreement is open for accession by any country in the Greater Mekong Subregion The instruments of accession shall be deposited with the Governments of the Contracting Parties
Translation:
第四条  
缔约各方同意在第三十六条之后增加第三十六条之二，其内容如下：  
第三十六条之二：加入  
本协议对大湄公河次区域内的任何国家开放加入。加入书应存档于缔约各方政府。

Query_Text_en: Article 5Upon accession by a GMS country the title of the Agreement will be automatically amended so as to include the name of the acceding country
Translation: 第五条 当某一GMS国家加入本协定时，本协定的名称将自动修改，以包含该加入国的名称。

Query_Text_en: Article 6The aforesaid Amendment to the Agreement is subject to ratification or acceptance of the Governments of the Contracting Parties DONE at Yangon on 29 November 2001 in three originals in the English language Signed :
Translation:
第六条  
本协议的上述修正案须经各缔约方政府批准或接受。  
本协议于2001年11月29日在仰光以英文文本制成正本三份。  
签署人：

Query_Text_en: Formally known as the Agreement Between and Among the Governments of the Kingdom of Cambodia the Lao People 's Democratic Republic the Kingdom of Thailand and the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam for the Facilitation of Cross Border Transport of Goods and People
Translation: 柬埔寨王国、老挝人民民主共和国、泰王国和越南社会主义共和国政府之间关于便利跨境货物和人员运输的协议

Query_Text_en: Note**: Signed at Phnom Penh on 3 November 2002 and entered into force on the same date.
Translation: 注：于2002年11月3日在金边签署，并于同日生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 1The Contracting Parties to the Agreement undertake to specify in the relevant Annexes and Protocols a staged approach to the application of the Agreement to non commercially operated vehicles between the Contracting Parties and the People 's Republic of China The Government of the People 's Republic of China also undertakes to apply the Agreement to non commercially operated vehicles within two years after the entry into force of the relevant Annexes and Protocols
Translation:
第一条  
缔约各方应通过相关附件和议定书明确本协定关于缔约方与中华人民共和国之间非营运车辆适用的分阶段方式。中华人民共和国政府亦承诺在相关附件和议定书生效后两年内，将本协定适用于非营运车辆。

Query_Text_en: The Contracting Parties shall mutually recognize the driving licenses issued by their respective competent authorities in accordance with an additional Annex to be formulated to the Agreement
Translation: 缔约各方应根据本协议拟制定的附加附件，相互承认各自主管机关颁发的驾驶证。

Query_Text_en: Article 3This Memorandum of Understanding becomes effective on the date of its signature Done at Phnom Penh on 3 November 2002 in six originals in the English language Signed :
Translation:
第三条 本谅解备忘录自签署之日起生效。本文件于2002年11月3日在金边以英文一式六份签署。  
签署人：

Query_Text_en: H.E. Minister of Public Works and Transport, Royal Government of Cambodia, H.E. Minister of Transport of the Government of the People's Republic of China, H.E. Zhang Chunxian, Minister of the Prime Minister's Office, Government of the Lao People's Democratic Republic Deputy Prime Minister, Phong Minh Lok Su Lid, Minister of Planning and Investment, Government of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, H.E. Vu Hong Phuc Agreement on Facilitating Cross-border Transport of Goods and Personnel by the Government of the Royal Government of Cambodia, the Government of the People's Republic of China, the Government of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, the Government of the Union of Myanmar, the Government of the Royal Kingdom of Thailand and the Government of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam Article 17 Amendment* (Note*: Signed in Phnom Penh on 30 April 2004.)
Translation: 柬埔寨王国政府公共工程与运输大臣阁下、中华人民共和国政府交通运输部部长阁下、老挝人民民主共和国政府总理办公室部长兼政府副总理丰明通、越南社会主义共和国政府计划与投资部部长武鸿福关于柬埔寨王国政府、中华人民共和国政府、老挝人民民主共和国政府、缅甸联邦政府、泰国王国政府及越南社会主义共和国政府便利货物与人员跨境运输的协议第十七条修正案（注：于2004年4月30日在金边签署。）

Query_Text_en: Driving PermitsThe Contracting Parties shall mutually recognize the driving licenses issued by their respective competent authorities in accordance with Annex 16
Translation: 缔约方应相互承认各自主管机关按照附件十六签发的驾驶执照。

Query_Text_en: Article 2In the list of Annexes and Protocols attached to the Agreement the words Annex 16 : Criteria for Driving Licenses will be inserted
Translation: 第二条 在协议所附的附件和议定书清单中，将插入"附件16：驾驶执照标准"这一条目。

Query_Text_en: Article 3This amendment to the Agreement is subject to the ratification or acceptance by all the Contracting Parties
Translation: 第三条 本协议的修正案须经所有缔约方批准或接受。

Query_Text_en: Article 4This amendment to the Agreement will come into force on the day that all the Contracting Parties have ratified or accepted it In witness whereof the undersigned being duly authorized have signed this Annex Done at Phnom Penh on 30 April 2004 in six originals in the English language Signed :
Translation:
本协议修正案将在所有缔约方完成批准或接受程序之日生效。为此，下列经正式授权的签署人签署了本附件。本文件于2004年4月30日在金边签订，以英文制成，共六份。  
签署人：

Query_Text_en: Article 1 Protection granted under this Convention shall leave intact and shall in no way affect the protection of copyright in literary and artistic works Consequently no provision of this Convention may be interpreted as prejudicing such protection
Translation: 本公约提供的保护不得损害或影响对文学、艺术作品著作权的保护。因此，本公约的任何规定均不得被解释为损害此种保护。

Query_Text_en: c to broadcasting organizations which have their headquarters on its territory as regards broadcasts transmitted from transmitters situated on its territory
Translation: 缔约国应向总部设在其境内的广播机构提供关于从其境内发射台发射的广播节目。

Query_Text_en: 2 National treatment shall be subject to the protection specifically guaranteed and the limitations specifically provided for in this Convention
Translation: 国民待遇应受本公约明确规定的保护和限制。

Query_Text_en: g Rebroadcasting means the simultaneous broadcasting by one broadcasting organization of the broadcast of another broadcasting organization
Translation: 再播是指某一广播组织对另一广播组织的节目进行的同时转播。

Query_Text_en: c the performance not being fixed on a phonogram is carried by a broadcast which is protected by Article 6 of this Convention
Translation: 如果表演未被录制在录音制品上，而是通过受本公约第六条保护的广播进行传播。

Query_Text_en: 2 If a phonogram was first published in a non Contracting State but if it was also published within thirty days of its first publication in a Contracting State simultaneous publication it shall be considered as first published in the Contracting State
Translation: 如果录音制品首次在非缔约国出版，但其在该非缔约国首次出版之日起三十日内也在缔约国进行了出版，则应视为在缔约国首次出版。

Query_Text_en: 3 By means of a notification deposited with the Secretary General of the United Nations any Contracting State may declare that it will not apply the criterion of publication or alternatively the criterion of fixation Such notification may be deposited at the time of ratification acceptance or accession or at any time thereafter ; in the last case it shall become effective six months after it has been deposited
Translation: 缔约国可通过向联合国秘书长提交书面声明，宣布其不适用出版标准或固定标准。此类声明可在批准、接受或加入本公约之时提交，亦可在其后任何时间提交；在后一种情况下，该声明应自提交之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: b the broadcast was transmitted from a transmitter situated in another Contracting State
Translation: 该广播节目系从位于另一缔约国境内的发射台播送。

Query_Text_en: 2 By means of a notification deposited with the Secretary General of the United Nations any Contracting State may declare that it will protect broadcasts only if the headquarters of the broadcasting organization is situated in another Contracting State and the broadcast was transmitted from a transmitter situated in the same Contracting State Such notification may be deposited at the time of ratification acceptance or accession or at any time thereafter ; in the last case it shall become effective six months after it has been deposited
Translation: 缔约国可通过向联合国秘书长递交声明的方式，声明其仅在以下情况下对广播予以保护：该广播组织的总部设在另一缔约国，且该广播系通过位于同一缔约国境内的发射台进行传输。此类声明可在批准、接受或加入本公约之时递交，也可在其后任何时间递交；若在后一情形下，该声明应自递交之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: iii if the original fixation was made in accordance with the provisions of Article 15 and the reproduction is made for purposes different from those referred to in those provisions
Translation: 如果原始固定是根据第十五条的规定进行的，且复制行为的目的与该条款所指目的不同

Query_Text_en: 2 1 If broadcasting was consented to by the performers it shall be a matter for the domestic law of the Contracting State where protection is claimed to regulate the protection against rebroadcasting fixation for broadcasting purposes and the reproduction of such fixation for broadcasting purposes
Translation: 如果表演者同意进行广播，则关于为广播目的防止固定内容的再广播及复制此类固定内容的保护问题，应由主张保护的缔约国国内法予以规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 The terms and conditions governing the use by broadcasting organizations of fixations made for broadcasting purposes shall be determined in accordance with the domestic law of the Contracting State where protection is claimed
Translation: 广播机构使用为广播目的而固定的复制件的条款和条件，应由要求给予保护的缔约国国内法律确定。

Query_Text_en: 3 However the domestic law referred to in sub paragraphs 1 and 2 of this paragraph shall not operate to deprive performers of the ability to control by Contract their relations with broadcasting organizations
Translation: 然而，本段第1款和第2款所指的国内法不得导致剥夺表演者通过合同对其与广播组织关系进行控制的能力。

Query_Text_en: Article 8 Any Contracting State may by its domestic laws and regulations specify the manner in whichperformers will be represented in connexion with the exercise of their rights if several of them participate in the same performance
Translation: 第八条 任何缔约国均可通过其国内法律和法规，就多名表演者参与同一表演时其权利的行使方式作出规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 Any Contracting State may by its domestic laws and regulations extend the protection provided for in this Convention to artistes who do not perform literary or artistic works
Translation: 缔约国可依据其国内法律和法规，将本公约规定的保护范围扩大至不表演文学或艺术作品的表演者。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 Producers of phonograms shall enjoy the right to authorise or prohibit the direct or indirect reproduction of their phonograms
Translation: 录音制品制作者享有授权或禁止直接或间接复制其录音制品的权利。

Query_Text_en: and furthermore if the copies or their containers do not identify the principal performers the notice shall also include the name of the person who in the country in which the fixation was effected owns the rights of such performers
Translation: 此外，如果复制件或其载体未标明主要表演者，则通知中还应包括在该固定行为发生国拥有此类表演者权利的人员的姓名。

Query_Text_en: Article 12 If a phonogram published for commercial purposes or a reproduction of such phonogram is used directly for broadcasting or for any communication to the public a single equitable remuneration shall be paid by the user to the performers or to the producers of the phonograms or to both Domestic law may in the absence of agreement between these parties lay down the conditions as to the sharing of this remuneration
Translation: 第十二条 当以商业目的发行的录音制品或其复制件被直接用于广播或向公众传播时，使用者应向表演者或录音制品制作者，或向双方支付一笔合理报酬。国内法律在当事人之间未达成协议时，可规定该报酬分配的条件。

Query_Text_en: d the communication to the public of their television broadcasts if such communication is made in places accessible to the public against payment of an entrance fee ; it shall be a matter for the domestic law of the State where protection of this fight is claimed to determine the conditions under which it may be exercised
Translation: 如果对电视节目进行向公众传播的行为是在向公众开放并收取入场费的场所内实施的，则该传播行为需受保护；主张该权利保护的国家的国内法应确定行使该权利的具体条件。

Query_Text_en: At the end of the year when the radio program began broadcasting
Translation: 在该广播节目开播的那一年年底

Query_Text_en: d use solely for the purposes of teaching or scientific research
Translation: d 仅用于教学或科学研究目的。

Query_Text_en: 2 Irrespective of paragraph I of this Article any Contracting State may in its domestic laws and regulations provide for the same kinds of limitations with regard to the protection of performers producers of phonograms and broadcasting organizations as it provides for in its domestic laws and regulations in connexion with the protection of copyright in literary and artistic works However compulsory licencee may be provided for only to the extent to which they are compatible with this Convention
Translation: 本条第一款的规定不妨碍，各缔约国可在其国内法律和法规中，对表演者、录音制品制作者和广播组织的保护，规定与文学艺术作品著作权保护相同的限制。但此类强制许可仅限于符合本公约规定的范围。

Query_Text_en: 1 Any State upon becoming party to this Convention shall be bound by all the obligations and shall enjoy all the benefits thereof
Translation: 任何国家在成为本公约缔约方后，应承担一切义务并享有其中的一切权利。

Query_Text_en: however the fact that the Contracting State of which the producer is a national does not grant the protection to the same beneficiary or beneficiaries as the State making the declaration shall not be considered as a difference in the extent of the protection ;
Translation: 然而，生产者所属的缔约国未向同一受益人或受益人群体提供与作出声明的国家相同的保护，这一事实不应视为保护范围的差异。

Query_Text_en: if a Contracting State makes such a declaration the other Contracting States shall not be obliged to grant the right referred to in Article 13 item d to broadcasting organizations whose headquarters are in that State
Translation: 如果某一缔约国作出此类声明，其他缔约国无义务向该国境内设有总部的广播组织授予《第十三条第(d)项》所规定的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 If the notification referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article is made after the date of the deposit of the instrument of ratification acceptance or accession the declaration will become effective six months after it has been deposited
Translation: 若本条第一款所述通知是在批准、接受或加入的文书交存日期之后作出的，则该声明应于交存后六个月生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 17 Any State which on October 26 1961 grants protection to producers of phonograms solely on the basis of the criterion of fixation may by a notification deposited with the Secretary General of the United Nations at the time of ratification acceptance or accession declare that it will apply for the purposes of Article 5 the criterion of fixation alone and for the purposes of paragraph 1 a iii and iv of Article 16 the criterion of fixation instead of the criterion of nationality
Translation: 第十七条 凡于1961年10月26日依据录制标准单独给予录音制品制作者保护的缔约国，可在批准、接受或加入本公约时，通过向联合国秘书长提交书面声明，宣布其将仅根据录制标准适用本公约第五条之规定，并根据录制标准而非国籍标准适用本公约第十六条第一款a项第三和第四点之规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 Any State which has deposited a notification under paragraph 3 of Article 5 paragraph 2 of Article 6 paragraph I of Article 16 or Article 17 may by a further notification deposited with the Secretary General of the United Nations reduce its scope or withdraw it
Translation: 第十八条 根据第五条第三款、第六条第二款、第十六条第一款或第十七条提交通知的任何国家，均可通过向联合国秘书长提交进一步通知的方式，缩小该通知的适用范围或撤回该通知。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 Notwithstanding anything in this Convention once a performer has consented to the incorporation of his performance in a visual or audio visual fixation Article 7 shall have no further application
Translation: 本公约第19条：尽管本公约有任何其他规定，一旦表演者同意将其表演固定于视听载体，第七条即不再适用。

Query_Text_en: 1 This Convention shall not prejudice rights acquired in any Contracting State before the date of coming into force of this Convention for that State
Translation: 本公约的生效不得损害任何缔约国在本公约对该国生效前已取得的权利。

Query_Text_en: 2 No Contracting State shall be bound to apply the provisions of this Convention to performances or broadcasts which took place or to phonograms which were fixed before the date of coming into force of this Convention for that State
Translation: 第二条 本公约任何缔约国均无义务将本公约的规定适用于在该公约对该国生效之前已发生之表演或广播，以及在此之前已录制之录音制品。

Query_Text_en: Article 21 The protection provided for in this Convention shall not prejudice any protection otherwise secured to performers producers of phonograms and broadcasting organizations
Translation: 本公约所提供的保护不得损害表演者、录音制品制作者及广播组织通过其他方式已获得的任何保护。

Query_Text_en: Article 23 This Convention shall be deposited with the Secretary General of the United Nations It shall be open until June 30 1962 for signature by any State invited to the Diplomatic Conference on the International Protection of Performers Producers of Phonograms and Broadcasting Organisations which is a party to the Universal Copyright Convention or a member of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works
Translation: 本公约应交存于联合国秘书长处。本公约应开放供任何受邀参加国际保护表演者、录音制品制作者和广播组织外交会议的国家签署，直至1962年6月30日。该等国家须为《普遍版权公约》的缔约方或国际保护文学艺术作品联盟的成员国。

Query_Text_en: 1 This Convention shall be subject to ratification or acceptance by the signatory States
Translation: 本公约须经各签署国批准或接受。

Query_Text_en: 2 This Convention shall be open for accession by any State invited to the Conference referred to in Article 23 and by any State Member of the United Nations provided that in either case such State is a party to the Universal Copyright Convention or a member of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works
Translation: 本公约应开放供根据第二十三条所述会议所邀请的任何国家以及联合国任何会员国加入，但前提是该国须是《万国版权公约》的缔约方或国际文学艺术作品保护联盟的成员之一。

Query_Text_en: 3 Ratification acceptance or accession shall be effected by the deposit of an instrument to that effect with the Secretary General of the United Nations
Translation: 批准、接受或加入应通过向联合国秘书长交存相关文书的方式完成。

Query_Text_en: 1 This Convention shall come into force three months after the date of deposit of the sixth instrument of ratification acceptance or accession
Translation: 本公约应自第六份批准、接受或加入文书交存之日起满三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 Subsequently this Convention shall come into force in respect of each State three months after the date of deposit of its instrument of ratification acceptance or accession
Translation: 本公约应于每一缔约国交存批准、接受或加入文件之日起三个月后对其生效。

Query_Text_en: 1 Any State may at the time of ratification acceptance or accession or at any time thereafter declare by notification addressed to the Secretary General of the United Nations that this Convention shall extend to all or any of the territories for whose international relations it is responsible provided that the Universal Copyright Convention or the International Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works applies to the territory or territories concerned This notification shall take effect three months after the date of its receipt
Translation: 任何国家均可在批准、接受或加入本公约之时，或在此之后的任何时间，通过向联合国秘书长提交书面声明的方式声明：本公约应扩展适用于该国负责其国际关系的所有或部分领土，但前提是《万国版权公约》或《保护文学艺术作品国际公约》适用于相关领土。该声明自联合国秘书长收到之日起三个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 2 The notifications referred to in paragraph 3 of Article 5 paragraph 2 of Article 6 paragraph 2 of Article 16 and Articles 17 and 18 may be extended to cover all or any of the territories referred to in paragraph I of this Article
Translation: 根据《第五条第3款》《第六条第2款》《第十六条第2款》及第十七条、第十八条所提及的通知，可扩展适用于本条第一款所述全部或部分区域。

Query_Text_en: 1 Any Contracting State may denounce this Convention on its own behalf or on behalf of all or any of the territories referred to in Article 27
Translation: 任何缔约国均可自行或以第二十七条所指任何领土的名义退出本公约。

Query_Text_en: 2 The denunciation shall be effected by a notification addressed to the Secretary General of the United Nations and shall take effect twelve months after the date of receipt of the notification
Translation: 终止应通过向联合国秘书长提交书面通知的方式生效，并自联合国秘书长收到该通知之日起十二个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: 3 The right of denunciation shall not be exercised by a Contracting State before the expiry of a period of five years from the date on which the Convention came into force with respect to that State
Translation: 缔约国不得在该公约对该缔约国生效之日起满五年之前行使废除权。

Query_Text_en: 4 A Contracting State shall cease to be a party to this Convention from that time when it is neither a party to the Universal Copyright Convention nor a member of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works
Translation: 某一缔约国既非世界版权公约的缔约方，亦非国际保护文学艺术作品联盟成员之时起，该国即不再是本公约的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: 5 This Convention shall cease to apply to any territory referred to in Article 27 from that time when neither the Universal Copyright Convention nor the International Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works applies to that territory
Translation: 本公约应停止适用于第二十七条所指的任何领土，自该领土不再适用《万国版权公约》和《保护文学艺术作品伯尔尼公约》之时起。

Query_Text_en: 1 After this Convention has been in force for five years any Contracting State may by notification addressed to the Secretary General of the United Nations request that a conference be convened for the purpose of revising the Convention The Secretary General shall notify all Contracting States of this request If within a period of six months following the date of notification by the Secretary General of the United Nations not less than one half of the Contracting States notify him of their concurrence with the request the Secretary General shall inform the Director General of the International Labor Office the Director General of the United Nations Educational Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Director of the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works who shall convene a revision conference in co operation with the Intergovernmental Committee provided for in Article 32
Translation: 本公约生效满五年后，任何缔约国均可通过向联合国秘书长提交书面通知，请求召开修订本公约的会议。联合国秘书长应将此请求通知所有缔约国。自联合国秘书长发出通知之日起六个月内，若不少于半数缔约国向其表示同意该请求，联合国秘书长应通知国际劳工局局长、联合国教育科学文化组织总干事以及国际文学艺术作品保护联盟局主任，上述机构负责人应与第三十二条规定的政府间委员会合作，召开修订会议。

Query_Text_en: 2 The adoption of any revision of this Convention shall require an affirmative vote by two thirds of the States attending the revision conference provided that this majority includes two thirds of the States which at the time of the revision conference are parties to the Convention
Translation: 对本公约的任何修订的通过，需由参加会议的缔约国以三分之二多数通过，且该多数中须包括在修订会议时仍是公约缔约国的国家的三分之二。

Query_Text_en: b this Convention shall remain in force as regards relations between or with Contracting States which have not become parties to the revising Convention
Translation: 本公约在未成为修订公约缔约方的缔约国之间或与该等缔约国之间的关系方面，应继续有效。

Query_Text_en: Article 30 Any dispute which may arise between two or more Contracting States concerning the interpretation or application of this Convention and which is not settled by negotiation shall at the request of any one of the parties to the dispute be referred to the International Court of Justice for decision unless they agree to another mode of settlement
Translation: 第三十条 因本公约的解释或适用而产生的缔约国之间的任何争端，如经谈判未能解决，应争端任何一方请求，应将争端提交国际法院裁决，除非有关各方同意以其他方式解决。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 Without prejudice to the provisions of paragraph 3 of Article 5 paragraph 2 of Article 6 paragraph 1 of Article 16 and Article 17 no reservation may be made to this Convention
Translation: 不影响第五条第三款、第六条第二款、第十六条第一款和第十七条的规定，不得对本公约提出保留。

Query_Text_en: to collect proposals and to prepare documentation for possible revision of this Convention
Translation: 为可能的公约修订征集建议并准备相关文件。

Query_Text_en: b  The Committee shall consist of representatives of the Contracting States chosen with due regard to equitable geographical distribution
Translation: 委员会应由缔约国代表组成，其遴选需兼顾公平的地理分布。

Query_Text_en: The number of members shall be six if there are twelve Contracting States or less nine if there are thirteen to eighteen Contracting States and twelve if there are more than eighteen Contracting States
Translation: 当缔约国数量为十二个或以下时，成员人数应为六人；若为十三至十八个时，应为九人；若超过十八个时，则为十二人。

Query_Text_en: 3 The Committee shall be constituted twelve months after the Convention comes into force by an election organised among the Contracting States each of which shall have one vote by the Director General of the International Labor Office the Director General of the United Nations Educational Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Director of the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works in accordance with rules previously approved by a majority of all Contracting States
Translation: 本公约生效后十二个月，委员会应由国际劳工局长、联合国教育科学文化组织总干事及国际文学艺术作品保护局负责人共同组织缔约国进行选举产生。每缔约国享有一票，选举须依据事先经全体缔约国多数批准的规则进行。

Query_Text_en: 4 The Committee shall elect its Chairman and officers It shall establish its own rules of procedure These rules shall in particular provide for the future operation of the Committee and for a method of selecting its members for the future in such a way as to ensure rotation among the various Contracting States
Translation: 委员会应当选举其主任委员和委员，并制定自身的议事规则。这些规则应特别规定委员会未来的运作方式以及未来成员的遴选方法，确保各缔约国之间的轮换。

Query_Text_en: 5 Officials of the International Labor Office the United Nations Educational Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works designated by the Directors General and the Director thereof shall constitute the Secretariat of the Committee
Translation: 国际劳工局、联合国教育科学文化组织以及国际文学艺术作品保护联盟局根据总干事及该机构主任指定的官员，应组成委员会的秘书处。

Query_Text_en: 6 Meetings of the Committee which shall be convened whenever a majority of its members deems it necessary shall be held successively at the headquarters of the International Labor Office the United Nations Educational Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works
Translation: 委员会会议应由其多数成员认为必要时召开，并依次在国际劳工组织总部、联合国教育科学文化组织以及国际保护文学艺术作品联盟局举行。

Query_Text_en: 7 Expenses of members of the Committee shall be borne by their respective Governments
Translation: 第七条 委员会成员的费用应由各自所属政府承担。

Query_Text_en: 1 The present Convention is drawn up in English French and Spanish the three texts being equally authentic
Translation: 本公约以英语、法语和西班牙语三种文字写成，三种文本具有同等法律效力。

Query_Text_en: 2 In addition official texts of the present Convention shall be drawn up in German Italian and Portuguese
Translation: 此外，本公约的正式文本应以德语、意大利语和葡萄牙语三种语文写成。

Query_Text_en: d if any of the situations referred to in paragraphs 4 and 5 of Article 28 arise
Translation: 如出现第二十八条第四款和第五款所规定的情形

Query_Text_en: 2 The Secretary General of the United Nations shall also notify the Director General of the International Labor Office the Director General of the United Nations Educational Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Director of the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works of the requests communicated to him in accordance with Article 29 as well as of any communication received from the Contracting States concerning the revision of the Convention IN FAITH WHEREOF the undersigned being duly authorised thereto have signed this Convention Done at Rome this twenty sixth day of October 1961 in a single copy in the English French and Spanish languages Certified true copies shall be delivered by the Secretary General of the United Nations to all the States invited to the Conference referred to in Article 23 and to every State Member of the United Nations as well as to the Director General of the International Labor Office the Director General of the United Nations Educational Scientific and Cultural Organization and the Director of the Bureau of the International Union for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works
Translation:
为此，下列具名代表，经各自正式授权，签署本公约。本公约于1961年10月26日在罗马签署，以英文、法文和西班牙文三种文本制成单一正本。联合国秘书长应向所有受邀参加本条约所述会议的国家、联合国各会员国，以及国际劳工局局长、联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事和文学艺术作品保护国际联盟局主任，交付经认证的副本。  
联合国秘书长应根据第二十九条之规定，将其收到的请求及各缔约国关于修订本公约的任何通信，通知国际劳工局局长、联合国教育、科学及文化组织总干事以及文学艺术作品保护国际联盟局主任。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Convention applies to all international carriage of persons , baggage or cargo performed by aircraft for reward .
Translation: 本公约适用于以营利为目的，由航空器实施的一切国际旅客、行李或货物运输。

Query_Text_en: It applies equally to gratuitous carriage by aircraft performed by an air transport undertaking .
Translation: 本规定同等适用于航空运输企业实施的航空器无偿运输。

Query_Text_en: 2 . For the purposes of this Convention , the expression `` international carriage '' means any carriage in which , according to the agreement between the parties , the place of departure and the place of destination , whether or not there be a break in the carriage or a transhipment , are situated either within the territories of two States Parties , or within the territory of a single State Party if there is an agreed stopping place within the territory of another State , even if that State is not a State Party .
Translation: 根据本公约，"国际运输"系指根据当事人之间的协议，无论是否存在运输中断或转运情形，凡起运地和目的地符合下列情况之一者：（一）位于两个缔约国的领土内；（二）位于单一缔约国领土内，但该运输包含经另一国领土内的约定停靠点，即使该国非缔约国。

Query_Text_en: Carriage between two points within the territory of a single State Party without an agreed stopping place within the territory of another State is not international carriage for the purposes of this Convention .
Translation: 单一缔约国领土内两点之间的运输，若未在另一缔约国领土内约定停靠地点，则不构成本公约所指的国际运输。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Carriage to be performed by several successive carriers is deemed , for the purposes of this Convention , to be one undivided carriage if it has been regarded by the parties as a single operation , whether it had been agreed upon under the form of a single contract or of a series of contracts , and it does not lose its international character merely because one contract or a series of contracts is to be performed entirely within the territory of the same State .
Translation: 根据本公约的规定，如果当事人将由数个连续承运人履行的运输视为单一操作，无论其是以一份合同或一系列合同约定，只要该运输未因其中一份合同或一系列合同完全在一个国家领土内履行而丧失其国际性质，则应视为一项不可分割的运输。

Query_Text_en: 4 . This Convention applies also to carriage as set out in Chapter V , subject to the terms contained therein .
Translation: 本公约也适用于第五章所述的运输，但须遵守该章所载条款。

Query_Text_en: 1 . This Convention applies to carriage performed by the State or by legally constituted public bodies provided it falls within the conditions laid down in Article 1 .
Translation: 本公约适用于国家或依法成立的公共机构实施的运输，前提是该运输符合本公约第一条规定的条件。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In the carriage of postal items , the carrier shall be liable only to the relevant postal administration in accordance with the rules applicable to the relationship between the carriers and the postal administrations .
Translation: 在邮政物品运输过程中，承运人仅对相关邮政管理部门承担责任，且应按照适用于承运人与邮政管理部门之间关系的规则行事。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Except as provided in paragraph 2 of this Article , the provisions of this Convention shall not apply to the carriage of postal items .
Translation: 除本条第二款规定的情形外，本公约的规定不适用于邮政物品的运输。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] if the places of departure and destination are within the territory of a single State Party , one or more agreed stopping places being within the territory of another State , an indication of at least one such stopping place .
Translation: 如果出发地和目的地均在一个缔约国境内，且有一个或多个约定的停靠地点位于另一缔约国境内，则需标明其中至少一个停靠地点。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any other means which preserves the information indicated in paragraph 1 may be substituted for the delivery of the document referred to in that paragraph .
Translation: 其他能够保存第1款所述信息的方式，可以替代交付该款所指文件。

Query_Text_en: If any such other means is used , the carrier shall offer to deliver to the passenger a written statement of the information so preserved .
Translation: 如果使用其他方式，承运人应向旅客提供所保存信息的书面说明。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The carrier shall deliver to the passenger a baggage identification tag for each piece of checked baggage .
Translation: 承运人应向旅客提供每一件托运行李的行李识别标签。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The passenger shall be given written notice to the effect that where this Convention is applicable it governs and may limit the liability of carriers in respect of death or injury and for destruction or loss of , or damage to , baggage , and for delay .
Translation: 当本公约适用时，承运人的责任受其管辖并可能因人身伤亡、行李的毁损、灭失或损坏以及因延误造成的损失而受到限制。该事项应以书面形式通知旅客。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Non-compliance with the provisions of the foregoing paragraphs shall not affect the existence or the validity of the contract of carriage , which shall , nonetheless , be subject to the rules of this Convention including those relating to limitation of liability .
Translation: 违反上述条款规定的，不影响运输合同的存在或有效性，但该合同仍应受本公约规则的约束，包括关于责任限制的规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 . In respect of the carriage of cargo , an air waybill shall be delivered .
Translation: 就货物运输而言，应提交航空运单。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Any other means which preserves a record of the carriage to be performed may be substituted for the delivery of an air waybill .
Translation: 其他任何能够保存即将执行的运输活动记录的方式均可替代空运单的提交。

Query_Text_en: If such other means are used , the carrier shall , if so requested by the consignor , deliver to the consignor a cargo receipt permitting identification of the consignment and access to the information contained in the record preserved by such other means .
Translation: 如使用其他方式记录，应托运人要求，承运人应向托运人签发可识别货物并可查阅相关记录信息的货物收据，该记录信息应通过其他方式完整保存。

Query_Text_en: [ c ] an indication of the weight of the consignment .
Translation: [c] 货物重量的标明。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 Document Relating to the Nature of the CargoThe consignor may be required , if necessary , to meet the formalities of customs , police and similar public authorities to deliver a document indicating the nature of the cargo .
Translation:
第六条 货物性质证明文件  
托运人如必要时，应办理海关、警察及其他相关公共机关要求的手续，提交说明货物性质的文件。

Query_Text_en: This provision creates for the carrier no duty , obligation or liability resulting therefrom .
Translation: 本条款不对承运人创设任何责任、义务或由此产生的责任。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The air waybill shall be made out by the consignor in three original parts .
Translation: 航空运单应由托运人签发三份正本。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The first part shall be marked `` for the carrier '' ; it shall be signed by the consignor .
Translation: 第一联应注明“承运人留存”，并由托运人签字确认。

Query_Text_en: The second part shall be marked `` for the consignee '' ; it shall be signed by the consignor and by the carrier .
Translation: 第二部分应标注“收货人”；该部分应由发货人及承运人签署。

Query_Text_en: The third part shall be signed by the carrier who shall hand it to the consignor after the cargo has been accepted .
Translation: 第三联应由承运人签署，并在货物收妥后转交托运人。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The signature of the carrier and that of the consignor may be printed or stamped .
Translation: 承运人和托运人的签字可为打印或盖章形式。

Query_Text_en: 4 . If , at the request of the consignor , the carrier makes out the air waybill , the carrier shall be deemed , subject to proof to the contrary , to have done so on behalf of the consignor .
Translation: 承运人应托运人要求签发航空货运单时，除非有相反证据证明，否则应视为其系代表托运人签发。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] the consignor has the right to require the carrier to deliver separate cargo receipts when the other means referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 4 are used .
Translation: 当使用第四条第二款所述的其他方式时，托运人有权要求承运人分别签发货物收据。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 Non-compliance with Documentary RequirementsNon-compliance with the provisions of Articles 4 to 8 shall not affect the existence or the validity of the contract of carriage , which shall , nonetheless , be subject to the rules of this Convention including those relating to limitation of liability .
Translation:
第九条 未遵守单证要求  
未遵守第四条至第八条之规定，不影响运输合同的存在或有效性，但该合同仍应受本公约规则的约束，包括有关责任限制的规定。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The consignor is responsible for the correctness of the particulars and statements relating to the cargo inserted by it or on its behalf in the air waybill or furnished by it or on its behalf to the carrier for insertion in the cargo receipt or for insertion in the record preserved by the other means referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 4 .
Translation: 托运人应对由其或代表其在航空货运单中填入的信息，或向承运人提供以便填入货运收据中的信息，或根据第四条第二款所述其他方式保存的记录中填入的信息的正确性负责。

Query_Text_en: The foregoing shall also apply where the person acting on behalf of the consignor is also the agent of the carrier .
Translation: 上述规定亦适用于托运人委托的代理人同时作为承运人代理人的场合。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The consignor shall indemnify the carrier against all damage suffered by it , or by any other person to whom the carrier is liable , by reason of the irregularity , incorrectness or incompleteness of the particulars and statements furnished by the consignor or on its behalf .
Translation: 托运人应对因托运人或其委托人提供的详细资料和声明存在不规范、不正确或不完整情形，而使承运人或承运人对其负有责任的任何其他人遭受的一切损失，向承运人进行赔偿。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Subject to the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article , the carrier shall indemnify the consignor against all damage suffered by it , or by any other person to whom the consignor is liable , by reason of the irregularity , incorrectness or incompleteness of the particulars and statements inserted by the carrier or on its behalf in the cargo receipt or in the record preserved by the other means referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 4 .
Translation: 除本条第1款和第2款另有规定外，承运人应对托运人及其需承担责任的任何其他人因货物收据或根据第4条第2款所述其他方式保存的记录中，由承运人或其代表填写的事项和声明存在不规范、不准确或不完整情形所遭受的损失承担赔偿责任。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The air waybill or the cargo receipt is prima facie evidence of the conclusion of the contract , of the acceptance of the cargo and of the conditions of carriage mentioned therein .
Translation: 航空运单或货物收据是合同订立、货物接收以及其中载明的运输条件的初步证据。

Query_Text_en: those relating to the quantity , volume and condition of the cargo do not constitute evidence against the carrier except so far as they both have been , and are stated in the air waybill or the cargo receipt to have been , checked by it in the presence of the consignor , or relate to the apparent condition of the cargo .
Translation: 涉及货物数量、体积及状况的事项不构成对承运人的不利证据，除非相关事项既已被承运人查验，且在托运人面前完成查验的事实已在航空货运单或货运收据中明确载明，或涉及货物的表面状态。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Subject to its liability to carry out all its obligations under the contract of carriage , the consignor has the right to dispose of the cargo by withdrawing it at the airport of departure or destination , or by stopping it in the course of the journey on any landing , or by calling for it to be delivered at the place of destination or in the course of the journey to a person other than the consignee originally designated , or by requiring it to be returned to the airport of departure .
Translation: 在托运人履行运输合同项下所有义务的前提下，托运人有权通过以下方式处置货物：在始发地或目的地机场提取货物；在途经任何降落地点停止运输；要求将货物在目的地或运输途中交付给非原指定收货人；或要求将货物退回始发地机场。

Query_Text_en: The consignor must not exercise this right of disposition in such a way as to prejudice the carrier or other consignors and must reimburse any expenses occasioned by the exercise of this right .
Translation: 托运人不得以行使此项权利的方式损害承运人或其他托运人的利益，并应赔偿因行使此项权利而产生的费用。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If it is impossible to carry out the instructions of the consignor , the carrier must so inform the consignor forthwith .
Translation: 如果无法执行托运人的指示，承运人必须立即告知托运人。

Query_Text_en: 3 . If the carrier carries out the instructions of the consignor for the disposition of the cargo without requiring the production of the part of the air waybill or the cargo receipt delivered to the latter , the carrier will be liable , without prejudice to its right of recovery from the consignor , for any damage which may be caused thereby to any person who is lawfully in possession of that part of the air waybill or the cargo receipt .
Translation: 承运人若在未要求出示后者持有的航空运单部分或货物收据的情况下，按照托运人的指示处置货物，则应对因此对合法持有该航空运单部分或货物收据的任何人员造成的损失承担赔偿责任，但此责任不影响其向托运人追偿的权利。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The right conferred on the consignor ceases at the moment when that of the consignee begins in accordance with Article 13 .
Translation: 根据第十三条，当收货人的权利开始时，发货人所享有的权利即告终止。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , if the consignee declines to accept the cargo , or can not be communicated with , the consignor resumes its right of disposition .
Translation: 若收货人拒绝接收货物或无法取得联系，则发货人可恢复其对货物的处置权。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Except when the consignor has exercised its right under Article 12 , the consignee is entitled , on arrival of the cargo at the place of destination , to require the carrier to deliver the cargo to it , on payment of the charges due and on complying with the conditions of carriage .
Translation: 除非托运人依据第12条行使了相关权利，否则货物抵达目的地后，收货人在支付应付款项并遵守运输条款的前提下，有权要求承运人向其交付货物。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Unless it is otherwise agreed , it is the duty of the carrier to give notice to the consignee as soon as the cargo arrives .
Translation: 除非另有约定，承运人应于货物到达后立即通知收货人。

Query_Text_en: 3 . If the carrier admits the loss of the cargo , or if the cargo has not arrived at the expiration of seven days after the date on which it ought to have arrived , the consignee is entitled to enforce against the carrier the rights which flow from the contract of carriage .
Translation: 如果承运人承认货物灭失，或者货物在应当到达日期后七日内仍未到达，收货人有权根据货物运输合同向承运人主张相关权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 14 Enforcement of the Rights of Consignor and ConsigneeThe consignor and the consignee can respectively enforce all the rights given to them by Articles 12 and 13 , each in its own name , whether it is acting in its own interest or in the interest of another , provided that it carries out the obligations imposed by the contract of carriage .
Translation: 第十四条 托运人和收货人权利的行使托运人和收货人可分别以自己的名义，依据第十二条和第十三条的规定行使赋予其的权利，无论该行为是为了自身利益还是他人利益，但须履行运输合同所规定的义务。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Articles 12 , 13 and 14 do not affect either the relations of the consignor and the consignee with each other or the mutual relations of third parties whose rights are derived either from the consignor or from the consignee .
Translation: 第十二条、第十三条和第十四条不影响发货人与收货人之间的相互关系，亦不影响其权利来源于发货人或收货人的第三方之间的相互关系。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The provisions of Articles 12 , 13 and 14 can only be varied by express provision in the air waybill or the cargo receipt .
Translation: 第12、13和14条的规定只能通过航空运单或货物收据中的明示规定进行修改。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The consignor must furnish such information and such documents as are necessary to meet the formalities of customs , police and any other public authorities before the cargo can be delivered to the consignee .
Translation: 托运人在货物交付收货人之前，必须提供为满足海关、警方及其他公共管理部门手续所需的一切信息和文件。

Query_Text_en: The consignor is liable to the carrier for any damage occasioned by the absence , insufficiency or irregularity of any such information or documents , unless the damage is due to the fault of the carrier , its servants or agents .
Translation: 托运人应对承运人因此类信息或单证的缺失、不完整或不规范所造成的任何损害承担责任，除非该损害系由承运人及其受雇人员或代理的过错所致。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The carrier is under no obligation to enquire into the correctness or sufficiency of such information or documents .
Translation: 承运人无义务核查上述信息或文件的正确性或充分性。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The carrier is liable for damage sustained in case of death or bodily injury of a passenger upon condition only that the accident which caused the death or injury took place on board the aircraft or in the course of any of the operations of embarking or disembarking .
Translation: 承运人仅在造成乘客死亡或人身伤害的事故发生在航空器上或在上下飞机的过程中时，才对由此产生的损失承担赔偿责任。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The carrier liable for damage sustained in case of destruction or loss of , or of damage to , checked baggage upon condition only that the event which caused the destruction , loss or damage took place on board the aircraft or during any period within which the checked baggage was in the charge of the carrier .
Translation: 承运人应当对托运行李发生的毁损、灭失或损坏承担责任，其唯一条件是：造成托运行李毁损、灭失或损坏的事件发生于航空器上，或发生于托运行李处于承运人监管期间的任何时间段内。

Query_Text_en: However , the carrier is not liable if and to the extent that the damage resulted from the inherent defect , quality or vice of the baggage .
Translation: 但是，如果损害是由行李本身的固有缺陷、性质或瑕疵所导致，则承运人不承担责任。

Query_Text_en: In the case of unchecked baggage , including personal items , the carrier is liable if the damage resulted from its fault or that of its servants or agents .
Translation: 在未申报行李（包括随身携带的个人物品）的情况下，如果损害是由于承运人及其工作人员或代理机构的过失造成的，则承运人应承担责任。

Query_Text_en: 3 . If the carrier admits the loss of the checked baggage , or if the checked baggage has not arrived at the expiration of twenty-one days after the date on which it ought to have arrived , the passenger is entitled to enforce against the carrier the rights which flow from the contract of carriage .
Translation: 如果承运人承认托运行李丢失，或者托运行李自应当到达之日起满二十一日仍未到达，旅客有权根据运输合同向承运人主张相关权利。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Unless otherwise specified , in this Convention the term `` baggage '' means both checked baggage and unchecked baggage .
Translation: 本公约中，除非另有规定，"行李"一词指托运行李和非托运行李。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The carrier is liable for damage sustained in the event of the destruction or loss of or damage to , cargo upon condition only that the event which caused the damage so sustained took place during the carriage by air .
Translation: 承运人仅以造成该损害的事件发生于航空运输期间为条件，对货物的毁灭、遗失或损坏所造成的损害承担赔偿责任。

Query_Text_en: [ d ] an act of public authority carried out in connection with the entry , exit or transit of the cargo .
Translation: 与货物进出口或过境相关的公共当局行为。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The carriage by air within the meaning of paragraph 1 of this Article comprises the period during which the cargo is in the charge of the carrier .
Translation: 本条第一款所指的航空运输包括货物处于承运人掌管之下的期间。

Query_Text_en: 4 . The period of the carriage by air does not extend to any carriage by land , by sea or by inland waterway performed outside an airport .
Translation: 航空运输期间不包括在机场外进行的陆地、海洋或内河运输。

Query_Text_en: If , however , such carriage takes place in the performance of a contract for carriage by air , for the purpose of loading , delivery or transhipment , any damage is presumed , subject to proof to the contrary , to have been the result of an event which took place during the carriage by air .
Translation: 如果这种运输行为是在履行航空运输合同时发生，并出于装载、交付或转运目的，则任何损害应推定系因航空运输过程中发生的事件所致，除非有相反证据证明。

Query_Text_en: If a carrier , without the consent of the consignor , substitutes carriage by another mode of transport for the whole or part of a carriage intended by the agreement between the parties to be carriage by air , such carriage by another mode of transport is deemed to be within the period of carriage by air .
Translation: 如果承运人未经托运人同意，将本应根据双方协议约定由航空运输完成的全部或部分运输，擅自以其他运输方式代替，则该其他运输方式的运输期间应视为属于航空运输期间。

Query_Text_en: Article 19 DelayThe carrier is liable for damage occasioned by delay in the carriage by air of passengers , baggage or cargo .
Translation:
第十九条 延误  
承运人应对在旅客、行李或货物的航空运输中因延误所造成的损害承担责任。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , the carrier shall not be liable for damage occasioned by delay if it proves that it and its servants and agents took all measures that could reasonably be required to avoid the damage or that it was impossible for it or them to take such measures .
Translation: 然而，承运人如能证明其及受雇人员和代理采取了一切可以合理要求的措施以避免损害，或者无法采取此类措施，则其无须对延误造成的损害承担责任。

Query_Text_en: Article 20 ExonerationIf the carrier proves that the damage was caused or contributed to by the negligence or other wrongful act or omission of the person claiming compensation , or the person from whom he or she derives his or her rights , the carrier shall be wholly or partly exonerated from its liability to the claimant to the extent that such negligence or wrongful act or omission caused or contributed to the damage .
Translation:
第二十条 免责  
如承运人能够证明损害系因请求赔偿方或其权利来源之人存在过失、其他过错行为或疏忽所导致或促成，则承运人应在其过失或过错行为对损害发生或扩大存在作用的范围内，全部或部分免除向索赔方承担的责任。

Query_Text_en: When by reason of death or injury of a passenger compensation is claimed by a person other than the passenger , the carrier shall likewise be wholly or partly exonerated from its liability to the extent that it proves that the damage was caused or contributed to by the negligence or other wrongful act or omission of that passenger .
Translation: 当旅客因死亡或受伤而由非旅客本人提出赔偿请求时，承运人亦可全部或部分免除责任，具体免除范围以承运人证明损害系因该旅客的过失或其他不当行为或疏忽所导致或促成的程度为限。

Query_Text_en: This Article applies to all the liability provisions in this Convention , including paragraph 1 of Article 21 .
Translation: 本条款适用于本公约中的所有责任条款，包括第二十一条第一款。

Query_Text_en: 1 . For damages arising under paragraph 1 of Article 17 not exceeding 100,000 Special Drawing Rights for each passenger , the carrier shall not be able to exclude or limit its liability .
Translation: 对于根据第17条第1款规定，每位旅客不超过10万特别提款权的损害，承运人不得免除或限制其责任。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] such damage was solely due to the negligence or other wrongful act or omission of a third party .
Translation: 此类损害完全由于第三方的过失或其他不当行为或疏漏所致。

Query_Text_en: 1 . In the case of damage caused by delay as specified in Article 19 in the carriage of persons , the liability of the carrier for each passenger is limited to 4,150 Special Drawing Rights .
Translation: 在旅客运输中因延误造成损害的情况下，承运人对每位旅客的赔偿责任以4150特别提款权为限。

Query_Text_en: 2 . In the carriage of baggage , the liability of the carrier in the case of destruction , loss , damage or delay is limited to 1,000 Special Drawing Rights for each passenger unless the passenger has made , at the time when the checked baggage was handed over to the carrier , a special declaration of interest in delivery at destination and has paid a supplementary sum if the case so requires .
Translation: 在行李运输中，除非旅客在将托运行李交给承运人时已作出目的地交付的特别利益声明并支付所需附加费（如需支付时），否则承运人对于行李损毁、灭失、损坏或延误所承担的责任，每位旅客的最高赔偿限额为1,000特别提款权。

Query_Text_en: In that case the carrier will be liable to pay a sum not exceeding the declared sum , unless it proves that the sum is greater than the passenger 's actual interest in delivery at destination .
Translation: 在这种情况下，承运人承担的赔偿金额不得超过申报金额，除非承运人能证明申报金额高于旅客在目的地收到货物的实际利益。

Query_Text_en: 3 . In the carriage of cargo , the liability of the carrier in the case of destruction , loss , damage or delay is limited to a sum of 17 Special Drawing Rights per kilogram , unless the consignor has made , at the time when the package was handed over to the carrier , a special declaration of interest in delivery at destination and has paid a supplementary sum if the case so requires .
Translation: 在货物运输中，承运人对于货物毁损、灭失、损坏或延误所应承担的责任限额为每公斤17特别提款权，除非托运人在将货物交付承运人时已特别声明其对到货利益有特别关注，并在必要时支付了附加费用。

Query_Text_en: In that case the carrier will be liable to pay a sum not exceeding the declared sum , unless it proves that the sum is greater than the consignor 's actual interest in delivery at destination .
Translation: 承运人应承担的赔偿金额不得超过申报金额，除非承运人能够证明申报金额高于托运人在目的地交付中的实际利益。

Query_Text_en: 4 . In the case of destruction , loss , damage or delay of part of the cargo , or of any object contained therein , the weight to be taken into consideration in determining the amount to which the carrier 's liability is limited shall be only the total weight of the package or packages concerned .
Translation: 在货物的部分毁损、灭失、损坏或延误，或其中所含任何物品发生毁损、灭失、损坏或延误的情况下，确定承运人责任限额时应考虑的重量，仅限于涉及的相关包装物的总重量。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , when the destruction , loss , damage or delay of a part of the cargo , or of an object contained therein , affects the value of other packages covered by the same air waybill , or the same receipt or , if they were not issued , by the same record preserved by the other means referred to in paragraph 2 of Article 4 , the total weight of such package or packages shall also be taken into consideration in determining the limit of liability .
Translation: 当货物的一部分或其内含物品发生毁灭、遗失、损坏或延误，且这种情况影响到同一航空货运单、同一收据所涵盖的其他包裹价值，或若未签发上述单据则根据第4条第2款所述其他方式保存的同一记录所涉包裹的价值时，在确定责任限额时亦应考虑相关包裹的总重量。

Query_Text_en: provided that , in the case of such act or omission of a servant or agent , it is also proved that such servant or agent was acting within the scope of its employment .
Translation: 只要能够证明该代理人或受雇人在执行职务范围内行事，即可视为其行为或疏忽。

Query_Text_en: 6 . The limits prescribed in Article 21 and in this Article shall not prevent the court from awarding , in accordance with its own law , in addition , the whole or part of the court costs and of the other expenses of the litigation incurred by the plaintiff , including interest .
Translation: 第六条 本法第二十一条及本条所规定的限制，不得妨碍法院根据其本国法律，裁定由原告所支出的全部或部分诉讼费用及其他诉讼费用，并包括利息。

Query_Text_en: The foregoing provision shall not apply if the amount of the damages awarded , excluding court costs and other expenses of the litigation , does not exceed the sum which the carrier has offered in writing to the plaintiff within a period of six months from the date of the occurrence causing the damage , or before the commencement of the action , if that is later .
Translation: 本条款不适用于以下情形：若损害赔偿金额（不包括诉讼费用及其他诉讼开支）未超过承运人自损害发生之日起六个月内以书面形式向原告提出的赔偿数额，或在提起诉讼之前（以较晚者为准）所提出的数额。

Query_Text_en: 1 . The sums mentioned in terms of Special Drawing Right in this Convention shall be deemed to refer to the Special Drawing Right as defined by the International Monetary Fund .
Translation: 本公约中以特别提款权表示的金额应视为指国际货币基金组织所定义的特别提款权。

Query_Text_en: Conversion of the sums into national currencies shall , in case of judicial proceedings , be made according to the value of such currencies in terms of the Special Drawing Right at the date of the judgement .
Translation: 在司法诉讼的情况下，涉及金额转换为本国货币时，应以裁决之日该货币相对于特别提款权的价值进行计算。

Query_Text_en: The value of a national currency , in terms of the Special Drawing Right , of a State Party which is a Member of the International Monetary Fund , shall be calculated in accordance with the method of valuation applied by the International Monetary Fund , in effect at the date of the judgement , for its operations and transactions .
Translation: 缔约国中属于国际货币基金组织成员方的国家货币对特别提款权的价值，应按照国际货币基金组织在裁决之日有效的、适用于其业务和交易的计价方法进行计算。

Query_Text_en: The value of a national currency , in terms of the Special Drawing Right , of a State Party which is not a Member of the International Monetary Fund , shall be calculated in a manner determined by that State .
Translation: 非国际货币基金组织成员的缔约国，其国家货币以特别提款权计算的价值，应按照该国确定的方式进行计算。

Query_Text_en: and 250 monetary units per kilogram with respect to paragraph 3 of Article 22 .
Translation: 关于第二十二条第三款，每公斤250货币单位。

Query_Text_en: This monetary unit corresponds to sixty-five and a half milligrams of gold of millesimal fineness nine hundred .
Translation: 该货币单位相当于纯度为千分之九百的黄金六十五点五毫克。

Query_Text_en: These sums may be converted into the national currency concerned in round figures .
Translation: 这些金额可兑换为相关国家货币的整数形式。

Query_Text_en: The conversion of these sums into national currency shall be made according to the law of the State concerned .
Translation: 这些金额的兑换应依照有关国家的法律规定进行。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The calculation mentioned in the last sentence of paragraph I of this Article and the conversion method mentioned in paragraph 2 of this Article shall be made in such manner as to express in the national currency of the State Party as far as possible the same real value for the amounts in Articles 21 and 22 as would result from the application of the first three sentences of paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 本条第一段末句所述计算方法及本条第二段所述换算方式，应当以缔约方本国货币尽可能体现如同适用本条第一段前三句所产生之相同实际价值，方得适用于第二十一条及第二十二条所涉金额。

Query_Text_en: States Parties shall communicate to the depositary the manner of calculation pursuant to paragraph 1 of this Article , or the result of the conversion in paragraph 2 of this Article as the case may be , when depositing an instrument of ratification , acceptance , approval of or accession to this Convention and whenever there is a change in either .
Translation: 缔约国在交存批准、接受、认可或加入本公约的文书时，以及无论上述任何一项发生变更时，应向保存国通报根据本条第一款规定的计算方式，或视情况而定根据本条第二款规定的转换结果。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Without prejudice to the provisions of Article 25 of this Convention and subject to paragraph 2 below , the limits of liability prescribed in Articles 21 , 22 and 23 shall be reviewed by the Depositary at five-year intervals , the first such review to take place at the end of the fifth year following the date of entry into force of this Convention , or if the Convention does not enter into force within five years of the date it is first open for signature , within the first year of its entry into force , by reference to an inflation factor which corresponds to the accumulated rate of inflation since the previous revision or in the first instance since the date of entry into force of the Convention .
Translation: 根据本公约第二十五条的规定，不受本条第二款限制，第二十一条、第二十二条和第二十三条规定的责任限额应由保存国每五年进行一次审查。首次审查应于本公约生效后第五年的年末进行；如果本公约自开放签署之日起五年内仍未生效，则首次审查应于其生效后第一年内进行。审查应参照自上次修订以来或首次修订时自本公约生效日起的累计通货膨胀率对应的通货膨胀系数进行。

Query_Text_en: The measure of the rate of inflation to be used in determining the inflation factor shall be the weighted average of the annual rates of increase or decrease in the Consumer Price Indices of the States whose currencies comprise the Special Drawing Right mentioned in paragraph 1 of Article 23 .
Translation: 用于确定通胀系数的通胀率衡量标准应为特别提款权组成货币所在国消费者价格指数的年度增减幅度的加权平均值，该特别提款权即第二十三条第一款所指。

Query_Text_en: 2 . If the review referred to in the preceding paragraph concludes that the inflation factor has exceeded 10 percent , the Depositary shall notify States Parties of a revision of the limits of liability .
Translation: 如果前文所述审查认定通胀因素已超过10%，保管人应通知缔约国有关责任限额的修订事宜。

Query_Text_en: Any such revision shall become effective six months after its notification to the States Parties .
Translation: 任何此类修订应自其通知缔约国之日起六个月后生效。

Query_Text_en: If within three months after its notification to the States Parties a majority of the States Parties register their disapproval , the revision shall not become effective and the Depositary shall refer the matter to a meeting of the States Parties .
Translation: 如缔约国自收到通知之日起三个月内有缔约国多数成员登记反对，则修订内容不得生效，保存国应将此事提交缔约国会议审议。

Query_Text_en: The Depositary shall immediately notify all States Parties of the coming into force of any revision .
Translation: 保存国应立即通知所有缔约国有关任何修订生效事宜。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding paragraph 1 of this Article , the procedure referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article shall be applied at any time provided that one-third of the States Parties express a desire to that effect and upon condition that the inflation factor referred to in paragraph 1 has exceeded 30 percent since the previous revision or since the date of entry into force of this Convention if there has been no previous revision .
Translation: 本条第1款的规定不妨碍，本条第2款所述程序可在任何时候启动，但需满足以下条件：缔约国中有三分之一表示希望启动该程序，且自上次修订以来（若此前未曾进行过修订，则自本公约生效之日起），本条第1款所述通货膨胀因素已超过30%。

Query_Text_en: Subsequent reviews using the procedure described in paragraph 1 of this Article will take place at five-year intervals starting at the end of the fifth year following the date of the reviews under the present paragraph .
Translation: 按照本条第1款所述程序进行的后续审查，应自本款所述审查之日起每满五年后的年末开始，每五年进行一次。

Query_Text_en: Article 25 Stipulation on LimitsA carrier may stipulate that the contract of carriage shall be subject to higher limits of liability than those provided for in this Convention or to no limits of liability whatsoever .
Translation:
第二十五条 关于责任限额的规定  
承运人可以约定运输合同应受本公约规定的更高责任限额的约束，或完全不受责任限额的约束。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 Invalidity of Contractual ProvisionsAny provision tending to relieve the carrier of liability or to fix a lower limit than that which is laid down in this Convention shall be null and void , but the nullity of any such provision does not involve the nullity of the whole contract , which shall remain subject to the provisions of this Convention .
Translation:
第二十六条 合同条款的无效性  
任何旨在免除承运人责任或设定低于本公约规定之责任限额的条款均属无效；但此类条款的无效性并不导致整个合同无效，该合同仍受本公约条款的约束。

Query_Text_en: Article 27 Freedom to ContractNothing contained in this Convention shall prevent the carrier from refusing to enter into any contract of carriage , from waiving any defences available under the Convention , or from laying down conditions which do not conflict with the provisions of this Convention .
Translation:
第二十七条 缔约自由  
本公约的任何规定均不得妨碍承运人拒绝签订任何运输合同、放弃根据本公约享有的任何抗辩权，或规定与本公约条款不相抵触的条件。

Query_Text_en: Article 28 Advance PaymentsIn the case of aircraft accidents resulting in death or injury of passengers , the carrier shall , if required by its national law , make advance payments without delay to a natural person or persons who are entitled to claim compensation in order to meet the immediate economic needs of such persons .
Translation:
第二十八条 预付款项  
在因航空事故导致乘客死亡或受伤的情况下，承运人应当根据其国家法律的要求，及时向有权获得赔偿的自然人支付预付款，以满足其紧急经济需求。
