Query_Text_en: 1 A treaty shall be interpreted in good faith in accordance with the ordinary meaning to be given to the terms of the treaty in their context and in the light of its object and purpose
Translation: 条约应按照善意原则，根据条约条款的通常含义，并结合其上下文，同时考虑条约的目的和宗旨进行解释。

Query_Text_en: b any instrument which was made by one or more parties in connection with the conclusion ofthe treaty and accepted by the other parties as an instrument related to the treaty
Translation: 任何由一个或多个缔约方在条约缔结过程中制定，并经其他缔约方接受为与条约相关之文书的文件

Query_Text_en: c any relevant rules of international law applicable in the relations between the parties
Translation: 适用于缔约方之间关系的相关国际法准则。

Query_Text_en: 4 A special meaning shall be given to a term if it is established that the parties so intended
Translation: 4. 若可证明双方确有此意向，则某一术语应被赋予特殊含义。

Query_Text_en: Article 32 Supplementary means of interpretationRecourse may be had to supplementary means of interpretation , including the preparatory work of the treaty and the circumstances of its conclusion , in order to confirm the meaning resulting from the application of article 31 , or to determine the meaning when the interpretation according to article 31 :
Translation:
第三十二条 补充解释手段  
可以借助条约的预备工作及其缔结情况等补充解释手段，以确认第三十一条适用所产生的含义，或在根据第三十一条进行解释时确定条约含义。

Query_Text_en: 1 When a treaty has been authenticated in two or more languages , the text is equally authoritative in each language , unless the treaty provides or the parties agree that , in case of divergence , a particular text shall prevail
Translation: 当一项条约经两种或两种以上文字认证时，该条约的文本在每种语言中均具有同等效力，除非条约另有规定或各方达成协议，规定在出现分歧时某一特定文本应优先适用。

Query_Text_en: 2 A version of the treaty in a language other than one of those in which the text was authenticated shall be considered an authentic text only if the treaty so provides or the parties so agree
Translation: 本条约如以未被认证的语言文本形式存在，仅在条约另有规定或各方就此达成一致时，方可视为认证文本。

Query_Text_en: 3 The terms of a treaty are presumed to have the same meaning in each authentic text
Translation: 条约条款在每一正式文本中应视为具有相同的含义。

Query_Text_en: 4 Except where a particular text prevails in accordance with paragraph 1 , when a comparison of the authentic texts discloses a difference of meaning which the application of articles 31 and 32 does not remove , the meaning which best reconciles the texts , having regard to the object and purpose of the treaty , shall be adopted
Translation: 除根据第1款规定某一文本具有约束力的情形外，当对正式文本进行比较发现存在含义差异且适用第31条和第32条未能消除该差异时，应采用最能调和各文本且兼顾条约目的和宗旨的解释。

Query_Text_en: Article 34 General rule regarding third States and third organizationsA treaty does not create either obligations or rights for a third State or a third organization without the consent of that State or that organization
Translation:
第三十四条 关于第三国及第三国际组织的一般规则  
条约未经第三国或第三国际组织同意，不得为其创设任何义务或权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 35 Treaties providing for obligations for third States or third organizationsAn obligation arises for a third State or a third organization from a provision of a treaty if the parties to the treaty intend the provision to be the means of establishing the obligation and the third State or the third organization expressly accepts that obligation in writing Acceptance by the third organization of such an obligation shall be governed by the rules of that organization
Translation:
第三十五条 关于规定第三国或第三组织义务的条约  
若条约各方旨在通过条约条款确立某项义务，且第三国或第三组织以书面形式明确接受该义务，则该条款即对第三国或第三组织产生约束力。第三组织接受此类义务应受该组织规则的约束。

Query_Text_en: 1 A right arises for a third State from a provision of a treaty if the parties to the treaty intend the provision to accord that right either to the third State , or to a group of States to which it belongs , or to all States , and the third State assents thereto Its assent shall be presumed so long as the contrary is not indicated , unless the treaty otherwise provides
Translation: 条约中某一规定如赋予第三国权利，须以条约当事方意图通过该规定向该第三国、其所属国家集团或全体国家赋予该权利为前提，且该第三国表示同意。其同意应推定存在，除非有相反表示或条约另有规定。

Query_Text_en: 2 A right arises for a third organization from a provision of a treaty if the parties to the treaty intend the provision to accord that right either to the third organization , or to a group of international organizations to which it belongs , or to all organizations , and the third organization assents thereto Its assent shall be governed by the rules of the organization
Translation: 若条约中的某项条款赋予第三方组织某项权利，则需满足以下条件：缔约方意图通过该条款将该权利赋予该第三方组织，或其所属的某一国际组织群体，或所有组织，且该第三方组织对此表示同意。该第三方组织的同意应受其自身组织规则的约束。

Query_Text_en: 3 A State or an international organization exercising a right in accordance with paragraph 1 or 2 shall comply with the conditions for its exercise provided for in the treaty or established in conformity with the treaty
Translation: 行使本条第一款或第二款规定权利的国家或国际组织，应当遵守条约中为行使该权利所规定或根据条约确立的各项条件。

Query_Text_en: 1 When an obligation has arisen for a third State or a third organization in conformity with article 35 , the obligation may be revoked or modified only with the consent of the parties to the treaty and of the third State or the third organization , unless it is established that they had otherwise agreed
Translation: 根据第三十五条的规定，当第三国或第三国际组织的义务产生后，除非经证实各方已有其他约定，否则必须经条约各方以及该第三国或第三国际组织同意，方可撤销或修改该义务。

Query_Text_en: 2 When a right has arisen for a third State or a third organization in conformity with article 36 , the right may not be revoked or modified by the parties if it is established that the right was intended not to be revocable or subject to modification without the consent of the third State or the third organization
Translation: 当第三方国家或第三方组织根据第三十六条享有相关权利时，若经确认该权利被设定为不可撤销或未经该第三方国家或组织同意不得修改，则缔约方不得撤销或修改该权利。

Query_Text_en: 3 The consent of an international organization party to the treaty or of a third organization , as provided for in the foregoing paragraphs , shall be governed by the rules of that organization
Translation: 条约中一方国际组织或第三方国际组织的同意，应依前款规定所载该组织的规则予以确定。

Query_Text_en: Article 38 Rules in a treaty becoming binding on third States or third organizations through international customNothing in articles 34 to 37 precludes a rule set forth in a treaty from becoming binding upon a third State or a third organization as a customary rule of international law , recognized as such
Translation:
第三十八条 通过国际习惯使条约规则对第三国或第三国组织产生约束力的规定  
本公约第三十四条至第三十七条中的任何内容均不排除条约中规定的一项规则通过成为国际习惯法规则并被承认为此类规则的方式，对第三国或第三国组织产生约束力。

Query_Text_en: 1 A treaty may be amended by agreement between the parties The rules laid down in Part II apply to such an agreement except in so far as the treaty may otherwise provide
Translation: 条约可经缔约方协议进行修改。除非条约另有规定，否则第二部分所规定之规则适用于此类协议。

Query_Text_en: 2 The consent of an international organization to an agreement provided for in paragraph 1 shall be governed by the rules of that organization
Translation: 本条第一款所述协议如需获得某一国际组织的批准，应遵循该组织的规则。

Query_Text_en: 1 Unless the treaty otherwise provides , the amendment of multilateral treaties shall be governed by the following paragraphs
Translation: 除非条约另有规定，多边条约的修正应依照以下各款进行。

Query_Text_en: b the negotiation and conclusion of any agreement for the amendment of the treaty
Translation: 关于修改条约的任何协议的谈判与达成

Query_Text_en: 3 Every State or international organization entitled to become a party to the treaty shall also be entitled to become a party to the treaty as amended
Translation: 有权成为条约缔约方的每一国家或国际组织，同样有权成为经修订条约的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: article 30 , paragraph4 b , applies in relation to such State or organization
Translation: 第30条第4(b)款适用于此类国家或组织。

Query_Text_en: 5 Any State or international organization which becomes a party to the treaty after the entry into force of the amending agreement shall , falling an expression of a different intention by that State or that organization : a be considered as a party to the treaty as amended and b be considered as a party to the unamended treaty in relation to any party to the treaty not bound by the amending agreement
Translation:
修正协议生效后成为条约缔约方的任何国家或国际组织，若该国或该组织未表明不同意向，则：  
a. 应视为修正后的条约缔约方；  
b. 在与不受该修正协议约束的条约缔约方的关系中，应视为未修正条约的缔约方。

Query_Text_en: ii does not relate to a provision derogation from which is incompatible with the effective execution of the object and purpose of the treaty as a whole
Translation: 该条款的例外与条约整体目的和有效执行不相容，因此第II条不涉及该条款。

Query_Text_en: 2 Unless in a case falling under paragraph 1 a the treaty otherwise provides , the parties in question shall notify the other parties of their intention to conclude the agreement and of the modification to the treaty for which it provides
Translation: 除非在属于第1(a)款情形且条约另有规定的情况下，有关缔约方应当将缔结该协议的意图以及该协议所规定的对条约的修改内容通知其他缔约方。

Query_Text_en: 1 The validity of a treaty or of the consent of a State or an international organization to be bound by a treaty may be impeached only through the application of the present Convention
Translation: 条约的有效性或国家或国际组织同意受条约约束的意思表示，只能依据本公约的规定予以质疑。

Query_Text_en: 2 The termination of a treaty , its denunciation or the withdrawal of a party , may take place only as a result of the application of the provisions of the treaty or of the present Convention The same rule applies to suspension of the operation of a treaty
Translation: 条约的终止、废止或缔约方退出，只能依据条约条款或本公约的规定予以实施。条约暂停施行亦适用相同规则。

Query_Text_en: Article 43 Obligations imposed by international law independently of a treatyThe invalidity , termination or denunciation of a treaty , the withdrawal of a party from it , or the suspension of its operation , as a result of the application of the present Convention or of the provisions of the treaty , shall not in any way impair the duty of any State or of any international organization to fulfil any obligation embodied in the treaty to which that State or that organization would be subject under international law independently of the treaty
Translation:
第四十三条 国际法项下独立于条约的义务  
根据本公约或条约的规定予以适用而导致的条约无效、终止或废除，缔约方退出条约，或暂停条约实施，均不得以任何方式影响任何国家或国际组织履行条约中所载义务的责任，而该等义务根据国际法应由该国或该组织承担，且独立于该条约之外。

Query_Text_en: 1 A right of a party , provided for in a treaty or arising under article 56 , to denounce , withdraw from or suspend the operation of the treaty may be exercised only with respect to the whole treaty unless the treaty otherwise provides or the parties otherwise agree
Translation: 根据条约规定或依第56条产生的、一缔约方退出、退出或暂停实施条约的权利，除条约另有规定或各方另有协议外，只能针对整个条约行使。

Query_Text_en: 2 A ground for invalidating , terminating , withdrawing from or suspending the operation of a treaty recognized in the present Convention may be invoked only with respect to the whole treaty except as provided in the following paragraphs or in article 60
Translation: 根据本公约承认的可导致条约无效、终止、退出或暂停执行的理由，仅可针对整个条约提出主张，除非本条以下各款或第六十条另有规定。

Query_Text_en: c continued performance of the remainder of the treaty would not be unjust
Translation: 继续履行条约剩余部分不会构成不公正。

Query_Text_en: 4 In cases falling under articles 49 and 50 , the State or international organization entitled to invoke the fraud or corruption may do so with respect either to the whole treaty or , subject to paragraph 3 , to the particular clauses alone
Translation: 根据第49条和第50条的规定，有权援引欺诈或腐败的国家或国际组织，可以就整个条约或仅就特定条款进行援引，但需遵守第3款的规定。

Query_Text_en: 5 In cases falling under articles 51,52 and 53 , no separation of the provisions of the treaty is permitted
Translation: 在第51条、第52条和第53条所规定的情形下，不得分割条约条款。

Query_Text_en: or b it must by reason of its conduct be considered as having acquiesced in the validity of the treaty or in its maintenance in force or in operation , as the case may be
Translation: 若一国由于其行为必须被视为已默许条约的有效性，或同意维持其效力，或继续实施（视具体情况而定）。

Query_Text_en: or b it must by reason of the conduct of the competent organ be considered as having renounced the right to invoke that ground
Translation: 或者，由于有权机构的行为，应视为其已放弃援引该理由的权利。

Query_Text_en: 1 A State may not invoke the fact that its consent to be bound by a treaty has been expressed in violation of a provision of its internal law regarding competence to conclude treaties as invalidating its consent unless that violation was manifest and concerned a rule of its internal law of fundamental importance
Translation: 一国不得援引其同意受条约约束系违反国内法关于缔约权限规定为由，主张该同意无效，除非此种违反显而易见且涉及国内法中具有根本重要性的规则。

Query_Text_en: 2 An international organization may not invoke the fact that its consent to be bound by a treaty has been expressed in violation of the rules of the organization regarding competence to conclude treaties as invalidating its consent unless that violation was manifest and concerned a rule of fundamental importance
Translation: 国际组织不得援引其表示同意受条约约束的方式违反该组织关于缔约权限的规则这一事实，作为使其同意无效的理由，除非该违反行为显而易见且涉及组织规则中具有根本性重要性的规定。

Query_Text_en: 3 A violation is manifest if it would be objectively evident to any State or any international organization conducting itself in the matter in accordance with the normal practice of States and , where appropriate , of international organizations and in good faith
Translation: 违反行为显而易见是指：任何国家或任何国际组织在处理相关事务时，依据国家间正常做法，并在适当情况下依据国际组织的做法，且出于善意的情况下，客观上能够明显察觉到的。

Query_Text_en: Article 47 Specific restrictions on authority to express the consent of a State or an international organizationIf the authority of a representative to express the consent of a State or of an international organization to be bound by a particular treaty has been made subject to a specific restriction , his omission to observe that restriction may not be invoked as invalidating the consent expressed by him unless the restriction was notified to the negotiating States and negotiating organizations prior to his expressing such consent
Translation:
第四十七条 关于国家或国际组织表达同意权限的特定限制  
如果某代表表达其所属国家或国际组织受特定条约约束之同意的权限已受特定限制，则其未遵守该限制不得作为使其所表达同意无效的理由，除非该限制已在该代表表达同意前通知相关缔约国和缔约国际组织。

Query_Text_en: 1 A State or an international organization may invoke an error in a treaty as invalidating its consent to be bound by the treaty if the error relates to a fact or situation which was assumed by that State or that organization to exist at the time when the treaty was concluded and formed an essential basis of the consent of that State or that organization to be bound by the treaty
Translation: 一国或一国际组织可援引条约中的错误作为使其同意受条约约束的同意无效的理由，若该错误涉及缔约时该国或该组织所假设存在的事实或情况，并构成其同意受条约约束的基本依据。

Query_Text_en: 2 Paragraph 1 shall not apply if the State or international organization in question contributed by its own conduct to the error or if the circumstances were such as to put that State or that organization on notice of a possible error
Translation: 本条第一款不适用于以下情形：若相关国家或国际组织因自身行为导致错误发生，或相关情况已使该国或该组织应当知晓可能存在错误。

Query_Text_en: 3 An error relating only to the wording of the text of a treaty does not affect its validity article 80 then applies
Translation: 仅涉及条约文本措辞的错误不影响条约的有效性，第八十条则适用。

Query_Text_en: Article 49 FraudA State or an international organization induced to conclude a treaty by the fraudulent conduct of a negotiating State or a negotiating organization may invoke the fraud as invalidating its consent to be bound by the treaty
Translation:
第四十九条 欺诈  
因另一缔约国或缔约国际组织的欺诈行为而订立条约的国家或国际组织，可援引该欺诈行为作为使其受条约约束同意无效的理由。

Query_Text_en: Article 50 Corruption of a representative of a State or of an international organizationA State or an international organization the expression of whose consent to be bound by a treaty has been procured through the corruption of its representative directly or indirectly by a negotiating State or a negotiating organization may invoke such corruption as invalidating its consent to be bound by the treaty
Translation:
第五十条 对国家代表或国际组织代表的贿赂  
若一国或一国际组织缔结条约的同意系由谈判国或谈判国际组织直接或间接通过贿赂其代表而获取的，该国或该国际组织可援引该贿赂行为主张其缔约同意无效。

Query_Text_en: Article 51 Coercion of a representative of a State or of an international organizationThe expression by a State or an international organization of consent to be bound by a treaty which has been procured by the coercion of the representative of that State or that organization through acts or threats directed against him shall be without any legal effect
Translation:
第五十一条 对国家或国际组织代表的胁迫  
一国或国际组织因该国代表或该国际组织代表遭受胁迫而作出的同意受条约约束的声明，若该胁迫系通过针对该代表的行为或威胁实施，则该声明不具有任何法律效力。

Query_Text_en: Article 52 Coercion of a State or of an international organization by the threat or use of forceA treaty is void if its conclusion has been procured by the threat or use of force in violation of the principles of international law embodied in the Charter of the United Nations
Translation:
第五十二条 以威胁或使用武力胁迫国家或国际组织  
凡条约之缔结系以违反《联合国宪章》所载国际法原则之威胁或使用武力手段，迫使他国或国际组织屈服而达成者，该条约即属无效。

Query_Text_en: Article 53 Treaties conflicting with a peremptory norm of general international law jus cogens A treaty is void if , at the time of its conclusion , it conflicts with a peremptory norm of general international law For the purposes of the present Convention , a peremptory norm of general international law is a norm accepted and recognized by the international community of States as a whole as a norm from which no derogation is permitted and which can be modified only by a subsequent norm of general international law having the same character
Translation:
第五十三条 与强行法规则冲突的条约  
凡在缔结时与一般国际法强行法规则相抵触的条约无效。  
本公约之目的，所谓一般国际法强行法规则，系指国际社会各国普遍接受并确认的、具有强制性质且不得有任何背离的规范，此类规范仅能由具有同样性质的后续一般国际法规则予以修改。

Query_Text_en: or b at any time by consent of all the parties after consultation with the contracting States and contracting organizations
Translation: 或经所有缔约方协商一致后，可随时选择B。

Query_Text_en: Article 55 Reduction of the parties to a multilateral treaty below the number necessary for its entry into forceUnless the treaty otherwise provides , a multilateral treaty does not terminate by reason only of the fact that the number of the parties falls below the number necessary for its entry into force
Translation:
第五十五条 多边条约当事国数量低于生效所需数额的处理  
除非条约另有规定，多边条约不会仅因当事国数量低于其生效所需数额而终止。

Query_Text_en: or b a right of denunciation or withdrawal may be implied by the nature of the treaty
Translation: 根据条约的性质，可推定存在废止或退出权。

Query_Text_en: 2 A party shall give not less than twelve months notice of its intention to denounce or withdraw from a treaty under paragraph 1
Translation: 2. 根据本条第一款，任何缔约方如欲退出或废除条约，应提前不少于十二个月通知其意向。

Query_Text_en: We , the Heads of State , Government and delegation of the People 's Republic of China and 48 African countries , met in Beijing from 4 to 5 November 2006 for the Summit of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation .
Translation: 我们，中华人民共和国和48个非洲国家的国家元首、政府首脑及代表团成员，于2006年11月4日至5日在北京举行中非合作论坛峰会。

Query_Text_en: We applaud the Summit held on the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the inauguration of diplomatic relations between the People 's Republic of China and the African countries .
Translation: 我们热烈祝贺在中华人民共和国与非洲国家建交50周年之际召开的峰会。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of promoting `` friendship , peace , cooperation and development '' , we have reviewed the sincere friendship , solidarity and cooperation between China and Africa over the past half century , and had fruitful discussions on the common goals and direction for growing China-Africa cooperation in the new era .
Translation: 为推动“友谊、和平、合作、发展”，我们回顾了中非双方半个世纪以来的真诚友谊、团结互助和密切合作，并就新时代深化中非合作的共同目标和方向进行了富有成果的讨论。

Query_Text_en: Conscious of the fact that thanks to the concerted efforts of both sides , the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation founded in 2000 has become an important platform for collective dialogue and an effective mechanism for pragmatic cooperation between the two sides , we have decided to enhance the role of the Forum and to this end , reaffirmed our commitment to the purposes and objectives set forth in the documents adopted by the Forum .
Translation: 鉴于双方共同努力的事实，中非合作论坛自2000年成立以来已成为双方集体对话的重要平台和务实合作的有效机制，我们已决定加强论坛的作用，并为此重申对论坛通过的文件中确定的宗旨和目标的承诺。

Query_Text_en: We hold that the world today is undergoing complex and profound changes , that human society is becoming increasingly interdependent , and that the pursuit of peace , development and cooperation has become the trend of the times and the priority of all countries .
Translation: 我们坚信，当今世界正在经历复杂而深刻的变化，人类社会日益相互依存，追求和平、发展与合作已成为时代潮流和各国的优先选项。

Query_Text_en: We urge that diversity of the world should be respected and upheld , that all countries in the world , big or small , rich or poor , strong or weak , should respect each other , treat each other as equals and live in peace and amity with each other , and that different civilizations and modes of development should draw on each other 's experience , promote each other and coexist in harmony .
Translation: 我们呼吁世界的多样性应当受到尊重和维护，世界上所有国家，无论大小、贫富、强弱，都应相互尊重，平等相待，和平友爱地共处；不同文明和发展模式应当相互学习借鉴、互相促进、和谐共存。

Query_Text_en: Faced with the growing trend of economic globalization , we call for enhancing South-South cooperation and North-South dialogue and call on the World Trade Organization to resume the Doha Round of negotiations to promote balanced , coordinated and sustainable development of the global economy to enable all countries to share its benefits and realize common development and prosperity .
Translation: 面对经济全球化深入发展的趋势，我们呼吁加强南南合作和南北对话，呼吁世界贸易组织重启多哈回合谈判，推动全球经济实现平衡、协调、可持续发展，使各国共享其成果，实现共同发展繁荣。

Query_Text_en: Priority should be given to increasing the representation and full participation of African countries in the UN Security Council and other UN agencies .
Translation: 应优先考虑增加非洲国家在联合国安理会和其他联合国机构中的代表权和充分参与。

Query_Text_en: We hold that the adherence of China , the world 's largest developing country , to peaceful development and the commitment of Africa , a continent with the largest number of developing countries , to stability , development and renaissance are in themselves significant contribution to world peace and development .
Translation: 中国作为世界上最大的发展中国家坚持走和平发展道路，非洲作为发展中国家数量最多的大陆致力于实现稳定、发展与复兴，这本身就是对世界和平与发展作出的重大贡献。

Query_Text_en: They reiterate that they adhere to the one China policy and support China 's peaceful reunification .
Translation: 他们重申坚持一个中国政策，支持中国和平统一。

Query_Text_en: China commends Africa 's progress in safeguarding regional peace , promoting regional cooperation and accelerating economic and social development , appreciates the active role played by the African countries , the African Union and other regional and sub-regional organizations in this regard , reaffirms its support for the African countries in their efforts to strengthen themselves through unity and independently resolve African problems , supports the African regional and sub-regional organizations in their efforts to promote economic integration , and supports the African countries in implementing the `` New Partnership for Africa 's Development '' [ NEPAD ] programs .
Translation: 中国赞扬非洲在维护地区和平、促进区域合作、加快经济社会发展方面取得的进展，肯定了非洲国家、非洲联盟以及其他区域和次区域组织在上述领域发挥的积极作用，重申支持非洲国家通过团结自强独立解决非洲自身的努力，支持非洲区域和次区域组织推动经济一体化的行动，并支持非洲国家实施"非洲发展新伙伴关系"（NEPAD）计划。

Query_Text_en: In particular , we urge the developed countries to increase official development assistance and honor their commitments to opening market and debt relief , and call on the related international organizations to provide more financial and technical assistance to enhance Africa 's capacity in poverty and disaster reduction and prevention and control of desertification , and help Africa realize the UN Millennium Development Goals .
Translation: 我们敦促发达国家增加官方发展援助，履行开放市场和债务减免的承诺，并呼吁相关国际组织为非洲提供更多资金和技术援助，提升其减贫、防灾减灾及防治荒漠化方面的能力建设，帮助非洲实现联合国千年发展目标。

Query_Text_en: Greater attention should be paid to the issue of development facing the least developed countries and the heavily indebted poor countries as well as the small island and landlocked countries in Africa .
Translation: 应更加关注最不发达国家、负债较重的发展中国家以及非洲小岛屿国家和内陆国家所面临的发展问题。

Query_Text_en: Having stood the test of time and changing international environment , China-Africa friendship is flourishing and enjoys immense popular support .
Translation: 历经时间考验和国际环境变化的洗礼，中非友谊蓬勃发展，享有广泛而深厚的民众支持。

Query_Text_en: We maintain that in the new era , China and Africa have common development goals and converging interests which offer a broad prospect for cooperation .
Translation: 我们坚信，在新时代，中国与非洲国家的发展目标相契合、利益趋同，为双方合作提供了广阔前景。

Query_Text_en: In the new century , China and the African countries should enhance their traditional friendship and expand mutually beneficial cooperation to achieve common development and prosperity .
Translation: 进入新世纪以来，中国与非洲国家应加强传统友谊，扩大互利合作，以实现共同发展与繁荣。

Query_Text_en: and - Properly handle issues and challenges that may arise in the course of cooperation through friendly consultation in keeping with China-Africa friendship and the long-term interests of the two sides .
Translation: 并秉持中非友谊及双方长远利益，通过友好协商妥善处理合作过程中可能出现的问题和挑战。

Query_Text_en: We hold that the establishment of a new type of strategic partnership is both the shared desire and independent choice of China and Africa , serves our common interests , and will help enhance solidarity , mutual support and assistance and unity of the developing countries and contribute to durable peace and harmonious development in the world .
Translation: 我们坚信，建立新型战略伙伴关系是中国和非洲的共同愿望和自主选择，符合双方的共同利益，有助于加强发展中国家的团结协作、相互支持与协助，为推动世界持久和平与和谐发展作出贡献。

Query_Text_en: We have , in the spirit of this Declaration , formulated and adopted the Beijing Action Plan of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation [ 2007-2009 ] .
Translation: 根据本宣言精神，我们制定了并采纳了《中非合作论坛北京行动计划（2007-2009年）》。

Query_Text_en: We commend the Ministers participating in the Third Ministerial Conference of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation for their dedicated efforts and outstanding work , applaud the outcome of the High-Level Dialogue between Chinese and African Leaders and Business Representatives , and express our congratulations on the full success of the Summit .
Translation: 我们高度评价参加中非合作论坛第三届部长级会议的各国部长们所付出的辛勤工作和取得的卓著成绩，热烈欢迎中非领导人与工商界代表高层对话会取得的成果，并热烈祝贺峰会圆满成功。

Query_Text_en: Declaration of Sharm El Sheikh of the Forum on China-Africa CooperationWe , the ministers of foreign affairs and ministers in charge of economic cooperation of the People 's Republic of China and 49 African countries , met in Sharm El Sheikh , Egypt from 8 to 9 November 2009 for the 4th Ministerial Conference of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation [ FOCAC ] .
Translation: 沙姆沙伊赫中非合作论坛宣言中华人民共和国与49个非洲国家的外交部长及负责经济合作的部长们，于2009年11月8日至9日在埃及沙姆沙伊赫出席了中非合作论坛（FOCAC）第四次部长级会议。

Query_Text_en: We applaud the convening of the 4th Ministerial Conference of FOCAC , under the leadership of H. E. Hosny Mobarak , President of the Arab Republic of Egypt and H. E. Wen Jiabao , Premier of the State Council of the People 's Republic of China , and in the presence of Their Excellences the Heads of State and Government and leaders of 17 African countries .
Translation: 我们热烈赞扬在阿拉伯埃及共和国总统胡斯尼·穆巴拉克阁下和中华人民共和国国务院总理温家宝阁下的领导下，并在17个非洲国家元首、政府首脑和领导人出席下，召开中非合作论坛第四届部长级会议。

Query_Text_en: For the purpose of `` deepening the new type of China-Africa Strategic Partnership for sustainable development '' , we , on the occasion of the third anniversary of the Beijing Summit of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation , reviewed with satisfaction the implementation of the follow-up actions to the Beijing Summit of the Forum , and agreed that the set goals had been accomplished . We also discussed the ways and means to further deepen China-Africa relations under new circumstances .
Translation: 为"深化中非新型战略伙伴关系以实现可持续发展"，值此中非合作论坛北京峰会召开三周年之际，我们满意地回顾了峰会后续行动落实情况，并一致认为既定目标已如期实现。我们还就新形势下进一步深化中非关系的途径和举措进行了探讨。

Query_Text_en: We are pleased to note that , thanks to joint efforts of the two sides , the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation has grown in strength and showed great vigor and vitality over the past nine years since its inception .
Translation: 我们高兴地注意到，在双方共同努力下，中非合作论坛自成立以来的九年中不断发展壮大，展现出旺盛的生命力和活力。

Query_Text_en: It is particularly noteworthy that a new type of strategic partnership between China and Africa featuring political equality and mutual trust , economic win-win cooperation and cultural exchanges was established at the successful Beijing Summit of the Forum , making it a milestone in the history of China-Africa relations .
Translation: 尤为值得关注的是，在论坛北京峰会成功召开之际，中非双方建立了以政治平等互信、经济互利共赢合作与文化交流为特征的新型战略伙伴关系，成为中非关系史上的重要里程碑。

Query_Text_en: We solemnly reiterate the spirit of the Beijing Summit of the Forum and believed that the principles it set out will provide long-term guidance for the growth of China-Africa relations and steer the relations forward .
Translation: 我们庄严重申中非合作论坛北京峰会的精神，并坚信峰会确立的原则将为中非关系发展提供长期指导，引领双方关系不断向前。

Query_Text_en: We hold that the international situation , while on the whole being stable , is complex and volatile . The world is still gripped by the economic recession triggered by the global financial crisis . Global concerns , represented by food security , the energy issue , climate change , and the need to prevent and control major diseases , are getting more acute , and destabilizing factors and uncertainties are notably on the rise in the international political , economic and other fields .
Translation: 我们认为，当前国际形势总体保持稳定，但复杂多变。世界仍深陷由全球金融危机引发的经济衰退之中。以粮食安全、能源问题、气候变化及重大疾病防治为代表的全球性挑战日益突出，国际政治、经济等领域的不稳定因素和不确定性显著增加。

Query_Text_en: Climate change in particular is having a devastating effect on many countries and regions across the world and urgently requires solutions .
Translation: 气候变化尤其对全球许多国家和地区造成严重破坏，亟需解决方案。

Query_Text_en: The effect of the financial crisis on developing countries is still spreading . In particular , the grave consequences of the crisis on the African economies , fragile as they are , may be further felt , making it more difficult for African countries to meet the UN Millennium Development Goals .
Translation: 金融危机对发展中国家的影响仍在持续蔓延。特别是，此次危机对脆弱的非洲经济体造成的严重影响可能进一步显现，使得非洲国家更难实现联合国千年发展目标。

Query_Text_en: We believe that the international community particularly developed countries should pay special attention to the negative impact of the crisis on developing countries , particularly African countries , and further efforts should be made in order to mitigate those effects .
Translation: 我们呼吁国际社会，尤其是发达国家，特别关注危机对发展中国家，尤其是非洲国家的负面影响，并进一步加大努力以减轻这些影响。

Query_Text_en: Therefore , effective measures should be implemented by the developed countries , in order to fulfill their commitments on aid , debt relief , promoting and increasing investment , opening up and accessing market , and assisting developing countries to promote economic growth in order to achieve sustainable development .
Translation: 因此，发达国家应采取有效措施，履行其在援助、减债、促进和扩大投资、开放市场并提高市场准入等方面所作承诺，帮助发展中国家促进经济增长，以实现可持续发展。

Query_Text_en: In this context , we call on the developed countries to further assist African countries to achieve the UN Millennium Development Goals .
Translation: 在此背景下，我们呼吁发达国家进一步协助非洲国家实现联合国千年发展目标。

Query_Text_en: In particular , we recommend that specific actions be taken in favor of island , least developed and landlocked states .
Translation: 我们尤其建议采取具体行动，以支持岛国、最不发达国家和内陆发展中国家。

Query_Text_en: We call on all countries to , as an effective response to the current challenges and threats , act under the principles of multilateralism and democracy in international relations to increase communications , respect and support each other , make the international order more just and equitable , and promote harmonious development and common prosperity of the world .
Translation: 我们呼吁各国有效应对当前挑战和威胁，秉持多边主义和国际关系民主化原则，加强沟通、相互尊重、彼此支持，推动国际秩序更加公正合理，促进世界和谐发展与共同繁荣。

Query_Text_en: We reaffirm the need for strengthening the role of the United Nations through inter alia , its reform and , as a matter of priority , increasing the representation of African countries in the Security Council and other UN agencies .
Translation: 我们重申加强联合国作用的必要性，其中包括推进其改革，并优先增加非洲国家在安理会和其他联合国机构中的代表性。

Query_Text_en: We also express our appreciation for the Chinese support to the African just and fair causes in the international fora , particularly in the General Assembly and the Security Council of the United Nations .
Translation: 我们对中国在国际多边平台上，特别是在联合国大会和安理会中，对非洲正义和正当事业的支持表示感谢。

Query_Text_en: We call for reform of the international financial system to ensure its development in a fair , just , inclusive and orderly manner , and for increasing the representation and voice of developing countries therein .
Translation: 我们呼吁改革国际金融体系，确保其公平、公正、包容、有序发展，并增加发展中国家在其中的代表性和话语权。

Query_Text_en: We oppose protectionism in all its forms , and stand to uphold an open and free trade and investment environment .
Translation: 我们坚决反对任何形式的保护主义，并致力于维护开放、自由的贸易和投资环境。

Query_Text_en: We will continue to advance the Doha Round of trade negotiations on the basis of observing the negotiation mandate , sticking to the Development Agenda and respecting the existing outcomes , and call for a successful conclusion of these negotiations in 2010 with the attainment of the development goals and the reflection of the interests and concerns of developing countries , including African countries , in the outcome .
Translation: 我们将继续在遵守谈判授权、坚持发展议程、尊重既有成果的基础上推进多哈回合贸易谈判，并呼吁各方在2010年如期达成圆满成果，实现发展目标，同时充分体现包括非洲国家在内的发展中国家的利益和关切。

Query_Text_en: We underline in particular African countries ' urgent need for stronger capacity to adapt to climate change and support their legitimate right in combating climate change .
Translation: 我们尤其强调非洲国家亟需增强适应气候变化的能力，并支持其在应对气候变化方面的合法权利。

Query_Text_en: The African countries are greatly encouraged by China 's sustained , steady and fast economic growth , appreciate the significant actions taken by China in response to the financial crisis , and believe that these actions have not only contributed to stabilizing the world economy but also helped the African economy towards achieving recovery and growth .
Translation: 非洲国家对中国持续、稳定和快速的经济增长感到深受鼓舞，高度赞赏中国在应对金融危机中采取的重大举措，并认为这些举措不仅有助于稳定世界经济，同时也促进了非洲经济的复苏与增长。

Query_Text_en: China applauds Africa 's endeavor and achievement in strengthening governance , resolving regional conflicts , advancing poverty relief and development , and speeding up the integration process .
Translation: 中国高度评价非洲在加强治理、解决地区冲突、推进减贫和发展、加快一体化进程等方面所作的努力和取得的成就。

Query_Text_en: China is concerned with the difficulties Africa has encountered as a result of the global financial crisis and believes that the world should not overlook the issue of development while tackling the crisis .
Translation: 中国关注非洲国家在 global financial crisis 中面临的困难，并认为国际社会在应对危机时不应忽视发展问题。

Query_Text_en: China reaffirms its support for African countries in their efforts to strengthen themselves through unity and independently resolve Africa 's problems . It appreciates the positive role of African countries , the African Union [ AU ] and other regional and sub-regional organizations in this regard , and supports African countries in the process of African regional integration and development being conducted under the African Union , the `` New Partnership for Africa 's Development '' [ NEPAD ] , and the Regional Economic Communities .
Translation: 中国重申支持非洲国家通过团结自强实现自主发展、独立解决非洲问题的努力。中国赞赏非洲国家、非洲联盟（非盟）以及其他区域和次区域组织在此进程中发挥的积极作用，支持非洲国家在非洲联盟框架下，依托"非洲发展新伙伴计划"（NEPAD）和区域经济共同体，推进非洲区域一体化和发展进程。

Query_Text_en: The two sides hold that the decades-long cooperation between China and Africa has produced fruitful results and delivered considerable benefits to their peoples . It is a good example of South-South cooperation .
Translation: 双方认为，中国与非洲数十年的合作取得了丰硕成果，为双方人民带来了实实在在的利益，是南南合作的典范。

Query_Text_en: - Make the most of their consultation mechanisms at various levels and through multiple channels to strengthen strategic dialogue , expand common ground and deepen cooperation in multilateral institutions , so as to uphold the common interests of developing countries .
Translation: 充分利用其多层次、多渠道的磋商机制，加强战略对话，扩大共识，深化在多边机构中的合作，以维护发展中国家的共同利益。

Query_Text_en: - Increase high-level visits , enhance political mutual trust and strengthen communication and coordination between China and Africa on major issues .
Translation: 增加高层互访，增进政治互信，加强在重大问题上的沟通与协调。

Query_Text_en: - Maintain unity and mutual support to jointly tackle the challenges brought by the global financial crisis and make sure that Africa 's endeavor to achieve the Millennium Development Goals will not be reversed .
Translation: 保持团结与相互支持，共同应对全球金融危机带来的挑战，确保非洲实现千年发展目标的努力不被逆转。

Query_Text_en: - Expand mutual benefit and upgrade the level of China-Africa practical cooperation .
Translation: 深化互利共赢，提升中非务实合作水平。

Query_Text_en: The two sides will encourage and promote two-way trade and investment , diversify ways of cooperation , and strengthen collaborative efforts in such priority areas as poverty relief , environmental protection , human resources training and capacity-building , and information and communications technologies . In particular , specific attention is needed on the critical sectors of infrastructure , agriculture and food security .
Translation: 双方将鼓励和促进双向贸易和投资，拓展合作方式，加强在扶贫、环境保护、人力资源培训和能力建设、信息通信技术等重点领域的协作。特别需要重点关注基础设施、农业和粮食安全等关键领域。

Query_Text_en: - Broaden exchanges and deepen people-to-people and cultural cooperation .
Translation: 扩大交流合作，深化民间和文化领域的合作。

Query_Text_en: Efforts will be made to promote exchanges in culture , education , science and technology , medical and health care , sports , tourism and other fields , and forge closer ties among the young people , women , non-governmental organizations , media organizations and academic institutions of the two sides with a view to enhancing mutual understanding and friendship between the Chinese and African peoples .
Translation: 将致力于推动文化、教育、科技、医疗卫生、体育、旅游等领域的交流合作，加强双方青年、妇女、非政府组织、媒体机构和学术机构之间的联系，以期增进中非人民之间的相互理解和友好情谊。

Query_Text_en: - Strengthen coordination and work together to enhance the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation and promote its sustainable development .
Translation: 加强协调、共同努力，提升中非合作论坛水平，促进其可持续发展。

Query_Text_en: In light of the needs of the two sides and changed circumstances , China and Africa will steadily improve the mechanisms of the Forum , enrich its contents , identify reasonable targets , make the best use of the leading role of the Forum in driving forward China-Africa relations , and ensure successful implementation of the follow-up actions to the Forum .
Translation: 鉴于双方需求和形势变化，中国与非洲将稳步完善论坛机制，丰富论坛内容，明确合理目标，充分发挥论坛在推动中非关系中的引领作用，确保论坛后续行动顺利实施。

Query_Text_en: - China pledges to work within its ability to further scale up aid to Africa , cut and cancel debt owed by African countries , expand investment in Africa , further open China 's market and strengthen practical cooperation with Africa .
Translation: 中国承诺将量力而行，进一步扩大对非援助，减免非洲国家债务，扩大对非投资，进一步开放中国市场，加强同非洲务实合作。

Query_Text_en: - African countries welcome China 's commitments and expressed readiness to enhance coordination and experience-sharing with China and work to ease the adverse impact of the financial crisis on the African economy .
Translation: 非洲国家欢迎中国的承诺，表示愿加强同中国的协调与经验交流，并共同致力于缓解金融危机对非洲经济的不利影响。

Query_Text_en: - The African countries reiterate their commitment to the one China policy and support for China 's peaceful reunification .
Translation: 非洲国家重申其坚持一个中国原则，并支持中国和平统一。

Query_Text_en: We have , in the spirit of this Declaration , formulated and adopted the Sharm El Sheikh Action Plan of the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation [ 2010-2012 ] .
Translation: 我们根据本宣言精神，制定了《中非合作论坛沙姆沙伊赫行动计划（2010-2012年）》并审议通过。

Query_Text_en: We express our congratulations on the fruitful results and great success of the Conference .
Translation: 谨向本次会议取得的丰硕成果和巨大成功表示热烈祝贺。

Query_Text_en: I. At the invitation of President Lee Myung-bak of the Republic of Korea , President Hu Jintao of the People 's Republic of China paid a state visit to the Republic of Korea from 25 to 26 August 2008 .
Translation: 应大韩民国李明博总统邀请，中华人民共和国主席胡锦涛于2008年8月25日至26日对大韩民国进行国事访问。

Query_Text_en: During the visit , President Hu Jintao held talks with President Lee Myung-bak and they reached broad common understanding .
Translation: 胡锦涛主席在访问期间与李明博总统举行会谈，并就广泛问题达成共识。

Query_Text_en: II . The two Presidents expressed satisfacation with the great progress bilateral relations have made in the political , economic , social , cultural and other areas since the two countries established diplomatic ties in 1992 , which , they believed , not only promoted the development of their respective countries , but also contributed to the peace and development of Asia and the world at large .
Translation: 两国元首对自1992年建交以来双边关系在政治、经济、社会、文化及其他领域取得的重大进展表示满意。他们认为，这不仅促进了各自国家的发展，也有利于亚洲乃至世界的和平与发展。

Query_Text_en: III . President Lee Myung-bak offered congratulations on China 's success in hosting the Beijing Olympic Games .
Translation: 三、李明博总统对中国成功举办北京奥运会表示祝贺。

Query_Text_en: President Hu Jintao thanked President Lee Myung-bak for making a special trip to Beijing to attend the opening ceremony of the Games and for ROK 's support to the Games .
Translation: 胡锦涛总统感谢李明博总统专程前来北京出席运动会开幕式，并对大韩民国对本届运动会的支持表示感谢。

Query_Text_en: IV . They agreed that China-ROK ties are important bilateral ties for each other .
Translation: 第四部分：他们一致认为，中韩关系是双方重要的双边关系。

Query_Text_en: The two sides decided to promote China-ROK strategic cooperative partnership in an all-round way on the basis of the China-ROK Joint Statement issued in May 2008 during President Lee Myung-bak 's visit to China .
Translation: 双方决定在2008年5月李明博总统访华期间发布的中韩联合声明基础上，全面推动中韩战略合作伙伴关系。

Query_Text_en: Committed to the fundamental goal of long-term common development , the two sides will expand and deepen mutual cooperation comprehensively , strengthen coordination on major regional and international issues and work for lasting peace and common prosperity of the world and development and progress of mankind .
Translation: 双方致力于实现长期共同发展的根本目标，将全面扩大和深化相互合作，加强在地区和国际重大问题上的协调配合，致力于维护世界持久和平与发展，促进各国共同繁荣和人类社会进步。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Enhancing political mutual-trust and supporting each other 's peaceful development .
Translation: 加强政治互信，相互支持和平发展。

Query_Text_en: The two sides will maintain and strengthen bilateral high-level exchanges , expand and deepen exchanges and dialogues between their governments , parliaments and political parties , and strengthen defense dialogue and exchanges .
Translation: 双方将保持并加强双边高层交流，扩大和深化两国政府、议会及政党之间的对话与合作，并强化国防领域的对话与交流。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Deepening mutually beneficial cooperation .
Translation: 深化互利共赢合作。

Query_Text_en: The two sides will continously explore new areas of cooperation and expand the scope and depth of cooperation based on complementarity and mutual benefits , and promote sustainable development of the two countries through practical cooperation .
Translation: 双方将基于互补优势和互利共赢持续探索新的合作领域，拓展合作广度和深度，并通过务实合作推动两国可持续发展。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Promoting people-to-people and cultural exchanges .
Translation: 3. 促进民间和文化交流。

Query_Text_en: The long history of mutual exchanges and profound cultural links between the two countries should be used to promote exchanges and deepen mutual understanding and friendship between the two peoples .
Translation: 两国间悠久的交流历史和深厚的文化纽带应被充分利用，以促进两国人民之间的交流，加深彼此的相互理解和友谊。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Strengthening coordination and cooperation on regional and global issues .
Translation: 加强在区域和全球性问题上的协调与合作。

Query_Text_en: The two sides are committed to the peace and stability of the Korean Peninsula and Northeast Asia .
Translation: 双方致力于朝鲜半岛和东北亚的和平与稳定。

Query_Text_en: They will actively participate in regional cooperation of Asia , strengthen dialogue and cooperation in international multilateral arena and earnestly engage in cooperation in major issues vital for mankind 's survival and development .
Translation: 他们将积极参与亚洲区域合作，加强国际多边场合中的对话与合作，并在关乎人类生存与发展的重大问题上认真开展合作。

Query_Text_en: V. The ROK side stated that it will develop South-North relations of mutual benefit and common prosperity through reconciliation and cooperation .
Translation: 韩国方面表示，将通过和解与合作推动南北关系朝着互利共赢、共同繁荣的方向发展。

Query_Text_en: The Chinese side reiterated its continued support to the efforts of the South and the North to promote the reconciliation and cooperation process , improve relations and ultimately achieve peaceful reunification .
Translation: 中方重申将继续支持南北双方推动和解与合作进程、改善关系并最终实现和平统一。

Query_Text_en: On the Taiwan question , the ROK side reaffirmed its position in the China-ROK Joint Statement issued in May 2008 and continued adherence to the one-China policy .
Translation: 在台湾问题上，韩方重申了其在2008年5月发布的中韩联合声明中所持的立场，并继续坚持一个中国政策。

Query_Text_en: 1 . Political Area [ 1 ] Top leaders of the two countries will maintain regular exchange of visits and contact .
Translation: 政治领域[1] 双方国家领导人将保持高层交往和接触常态化。

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] The foreign ministries of the two countries will hold the first high-level strategic dialogue within 2008 to launch the strategic dialogue mechanism for exchanging views on major issues concerning the two countries ' shared interests .
Translation: 双方外交部将于2008年内举行首次高层战略对话，正式启动战略对话机制，就涉及双方共同利益的重大问题交换意见。

Query_Text_en: The two foreign ministries ' working-level consultation will be institutionalized to strengthen communication on foreign policies and the international situation .
Translation: 两国外交部的工作层级磋商将实现机制化，以加强就外交政策和国际形势的沟通。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] Experts and scholars of the two countries will conduct a joint study and submit a report to the two governments on how to comprehensively promote China-ROK exchanges and cooperation .
Translation: 两国专家和学者将共同开展联合研究并提交报告，就全面促进中韩交流与合作提出建议，呈报两国政府。

Query_Text_en: [ 4 ] Defense ministries of the two countries will have high-level exchange of visits , strengthen contact and liaison mechanism and conduct multi-tier exchanges and cooperation in various areas .
Translation: 两国国防部门将开展高层互访，加强沟通联络机制，并在各领域开展多层次交流与合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 5 ] Consultation will be expedited on the maritime delimitation issue between China and the ROK , an early solution of which will be important to the long-term , stable development of their bilateral relations .
Translation: 中韩两国将加快海域划界问题的磋商，尽早解决这一问题对双边关系的长期稳定发展具有重要意义。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Economic and Trade Area [ 6 ] The two sides will make joint efforts to increase bilateral trade volume to US$ 200 billion by 2010 . To this end , they will strengthen cooperation in trade and investment facilitation , quality inspection and quarantine , trade remedy and intellectual property rights .
Translation: 二、经贸领域[6] 双方将共同努力，争取到2010年使双边贸易额达到2000亿美元。为此，双方将加强在贸易投资便利化、质量检验检疫、贸易救济及知识产权等领域的合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 7 ] The two sides will continue working on the adjustment and supplement to the Joint Research Report on China-ROK Mid-to-Long Term Development Plan on Economic Cooperation and Trade , in accordance with the agreement reached by the two Presidents in May 2008 .
Translation: 双方将继续根据两国总统于2008年5月达成的共识，推进《中韩经济合作与贸易中长期发展规划联合研究报告》的调整和补充工作。

Query_Text_en: [ 8 ] The two sides will further strengthen the mechanism of trade and economic consultation and practical trade cooperation to expand bilateral economic and trade cooperation .
Translation: 双方将进一步加强贸易和经济磋商机制，深化务实贸易合作，以扩大双边经贸合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 9 ] The two sides will further strengthen cooperation in key areas such as environmental protection , information technology , telecommunication , finance , logistics and energy .
Translation: 双方将进一步加强在环境保护、信息技术、电信、金融、物流和能源等重点领域的合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 10 ] Since an increase in mutual investment can promote mutually beneficial development of the two economies , the two governments will strengthen cooperation and support for a better investment environment .
Translation: 鉴于增加相互投资能够促进两国经济的互利发展，两国政府将加强合作与支持，以营造更加良好的投资环境。

Query_Text_en: [ 11 ] The two sides will find ways to actively advance the China-ROK FTA process in a mutually beneficial way on the basis of the joint study on China-ROK FTA involving government agencies , industries and academia .
Translation: 双方将以涵盖政府部门、产业界和学术界的中韩自贸协定联合研究为基础，探索方式以互利共赢方式积极推进中韩自贸协定谈判进程。

Query_Text_en: [ 12 ] The two sides will sign the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation and Exchanges between the 2010 Shanghai World Expo in the People ' s Republic of China and the 2012 Yeosu Expo in the Republic of Korea so as to ensure the success of both expos by strengthening cooperation and sharing experience and information .
Translation: 双方将签署中华人民共和国2010年上海世博会与大韩民国2012年丽水世博会合作与交流备忘录，以加强合作、共享经验信息，确保两个世博会取得成功。

Query_Text_en: [ 13 ] The Employment Permit System will be launched in labor service cooperation according to agreement between the two governments to protect the legitimate rights and interests of labor from both sides .
Translation: 根据两国政府间达成的协议，就业准证制度将在劳务合作领域启动，以保护双方劳动者的合法权益。

Query_Text_en: [ 14 ] The two sides welcome the outcome of their mutually beneficial cooperation in the financial sector and will strengthen cooperation in mutual market access for financial institutions from each other 's countries .
Translation: 双方欢迎两国金融领域互利共赢合作取得的成果，并将加强各自国家金融机构相互市场准入方面的合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 15 ] Competent government departments and companies from the two countries will sign the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in IT Technology Innovation so as to strengthen and develop IT technology cooperation .
Translation: 两国相关政府部门和企业将签署关于信息技术创新合作的谅解备忘录，以加强和拓展信息技术领域的合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 16 ] The two sides will cooperate actively in building an environment-friendly and resource-conserving society .
Translation: 双方将在建设环境友好型和资源节约型社会方面积极合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 17 ] The two sides will strengthen exchanges and cooperation to cope with natural disasters such as earthquake , tsunami and typhoon .
Translation: 双方将加强交流与合作，应对地震、海啸和台风等自然灾害。

Query_Text_en: [ 18 ] The two sides will sign the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in Energy Conservation , so as to enhance cooperation in energy conservation consulting , personnel exchange and technological development .
Translation: 双方将签署《能源节约合作谅解备忘录》，以加强在能源节约咨询、人员交流和技术开发方面的合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 19 ] The two sides are aware of the importance of protecting global ecosystems and agree to sign the Memorandum of Understanding on Scientific and Technological Cooperation for Desertification Prevention , which will promote and strengthen such cooperation through joint studies , expert exchanges and information sharing .
Translation: 双方认识到保护全球生态系统的重要性，同意签署《防治荒漠化科技合作谅解备忘录》，通过联合研究、专家交流和信息共享等方式，推动和加强此类合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 20 ] The two sides will sign the Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation in the Operation and Maintenance of the China-ROK Economic and Trade Cooperation Website . The website to be launched will offer the latest information on trade and investment .
Translation: 双方将签署《中韩经济贸易合作网站运营与维护合作谅解备忘录》。即将开通的网站将提供最新的贸易和投资信息。

Query_Text_en: [ 21 ] The two sides will sign the Memorandum of Understanding on Hi-Tech Cooperation and will cooperate in IT , telecommunications technology and new energy , and actively explore new hi-tech cooperation programs in the next five years .
Translation: 双方将签署《高科技合作谅解备忘录》，并在信息技术、电信技术和新能源领域开展合作，同时积极探讨未来五年的新一轮高科技合作项目。

Query_Text_en: [ 22 ] The two sides will sign the Agreement on the Sanitary Management of Export and Import of Aquacultural Products , so as to strengthen cooperation in inspection and quarantine , legal information sharing and mutual visits by aquacultural product quarantine personnel .
Translation: 双方将签署《关于水产养殖产品进出口卫生管理的协定》，以加强在检验检疫、法律信息共享以及检疫人员互访方面的合作。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Cultural Exchanges [ 23 ] The two sides will expand the present scale of people-to-people exchanges of six million visits per year and provide all necessary facilitation , including the study of visa facilitation measures .
Translation: 双方将扩大现有人文交流规模至每年六百万人次，并提供必要便利，包括研究签证便利化措施。

Query_Text_en: [ 24 ] The two sides have designated 2010 the Visit China Year and 2012 the Visit Korea Year and will host tourist events and other bilateral exchanges to enhance people-to-people exchanges between the two countries .
Translation: 双方选定2010年为“中国旅游年”、2012年为“韩国旅游年”，并将举办旅游活动及双边交流项目以增进两国人民之间的相互了解。

Query_Text_en: [ 25 ] The Chinese side has announced the upgrading of the Consular Office in Gwangju of the Embassy of the People 's Republic of China to a Consulate-General , which the ROK welcomes .
Translation: 中方宣布将驻韩国光州总领事馆升格，韩方对此表示欢迎。

Query_Text_en: [ 26 ] The two sides will sign the Agreement on Educational Exchanges and Cooperation Between 2008 and 2010 and increase the number of annual government scholarship exchange students from 40 to 60 . Young people will be invited to make mutual visits under the youth exchange program .
Translation: 双方将签署《2008年至2010年教育交流与合作协议》，并将政府奖学金年度交流生名额从每年40名增至60名。青年将在青年交流计划框架下开展互访。

Query_Text_en: [ 27 ] The two sides will promote exchanges and mutual understanding between the cultural sectors , media , sister cities , academia and private organizations and support exchanges between private organizations in culture and media and exchanges between academic institutions in history and culture .
Translation: 双方将促进文化界、媒体、友好城市、学术机构及民间组织之间的交流与相互了解，支持民间组织在文化和媒体领域的交流合作，以及学术机构在历史和文化领域的交流活动。

Query_Text_en: [ 28 ] The two sides will sign the Memorandum of Understanding on the Gift of Crested Ibises from China to the ROK and Cooperation in Crested Ibis ' Breeding and Population Rebuilding . China will make a gift of a couple of Crested Ibises to the ROK , which the ROK appreciates . The two countries agree to strengthen cooperation in the rescue of Crested Ibis , an endangered species .
Translation: 双方将签署关于中国向韩国赠送朱鹮及两国在朱鹮繁育与种群重建领域开展合作的谅解备忘录。中国将向韩国赠送一对朱鹮，韩国对此表示赞赏。两国同意加强在濒危物种朱鹮保护方面的合作。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Regional and International Affairs [ 29 ] The two sides will continue to strengthen communication and cooperation under the framework of the Six-Party Talks , promote the implementation of the second phase actions in a comprehensive and balanced manner at an early date and make constructive efforts for the comprehensive implementation of the September 19 Joint Statement .
Translation: 双方将继续在六方会谈框架内加强沟通与合作，推动第二阶段行动早日得到全面平衡落实，并为全面实施9月19日共同声明作出建设性努力。

Query_Text_en: [ 30 ] The two sides will maintain coordination and cooperation in ASEAN plus three [ China , Japan , the Republic of Korea ] , China-ROK-Japan , the East Asia Summit , the ASEAN Regional Forum , APEC , the Asia Cooperation Dialogue , ASEM , the East Asia-Latin America Forum , the Asia-Middle East Dialogue and the Asia-Africa Summit .
Translation: 双方将在东盟与中日韩、中日韩、东亚峰会、东盟地区论坛、亚太经合组织、亚洲合作对话、亚欧会议、东亚-拉美论坛、亚洲-中东对话和亚非峰会等机制框架下保持协调与合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 31 ] The two sides will establish a consultative mechanism on UN affairs between their foreign affairs departments to strengthen mutual understanding and cooperation in UN affairs .
Translation: 双方外交部门之间将建立联合国事务磋商机制，以加强在联合国事务中的相互理解和合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 32 ] The two sides will advance dialogue and cooperation in international human rights .
Translation: 双方将在国际人权领域推进对话与合作。

Query_Text_en: [ 33 ] The two sides will strengthen cooperation in the prevention of the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction and the cracking down on international terrorism , drugs , financial and economic crimes , hi-tech crimes and piracy .
Translation: 双方将加强在防止大规模杀伤性武器扩散方面的合作，并严厉打击国际恐怖主义、毒品、金融经济犯罪、高科技犯罪和海盗行为。

Query_Text_en: [ 34 ] The two sides will work unremittingly with the international community to address climate change , a common concern of the world .
Translation: 双方将与国际社会不懈努力，共同应对作为全球共同关切的气候变化。

Query_Text_en: VII . The two sides agree to make full use of bilateral mechanisms such as the strategic dialogue between foreign affairs departments , the joint economic and trade committee and the tourism ministers ' meeting to make specific arrangements for and effectively promote the implementation of the above mentioned agreements in various areas .
Translation: 双方同意充分利用外交部门战略对话、联合经济贸易委员会及旅游部长会议等双边机制，为上述各领域协议的具体实施作出安排并有效推进。

Query_Text_en: VIII . China appreciates the warm and friendly reception given to President Hu Jintao during the visit by the ROK .
Translation: 第八，中国感谢韩国在胡锦涛主席对韩国进行国事访问期间给予的热情友好接待。

Query_Text_en: Joint Communique on the results of the trilateral meeting of the Foreign Minister of India , Russia and ChinaA trilateral meeting of the Foreign Ministers of the Republic of India , the Russian Federation , and the People 's Republic of China was held in New Delhi on February 14 , 2007 .
Translation: 2007年2月14日，印度共和国、俄罗斯联邦和中华人民共和国三国外长在新德里举行了三方会晤。  会议期间，三国外长就国际和地区问题以及共同关心的议题交换了意见。他们一致认为，当前国际局势复杂多变，加强三国之间的协调与合作至关重要。  外长们强调，三国在维护世界和平与稳定、促进多边主义及推动全球治理改革方面肩负重要责任。他们同意继续在联合国等国际组织框架内开展合作，推动构建更加公正合理的国际秩序。  此外，三国外长还讨论了全球经济治理、气候变化、反恐及区域合作等议题，并决定通过外交渠道保持定期沟通，以深化战略伙伴关系。

Query_Text_en: The Ministers noted that the mechanism of trilateral meetings is a manifestation of enhanced mutual understanding and trust among the three countries and positively assessed the outcome of their meetings . They agreed that the Summit level trilateral meeting held in St. Petersburg on July 17 , 2006 on the sidelines of the G-8 Summit demonstrated the willingness of the three sides to carry forward consultations on issues of shared interest , at the highest political level , with the aim or promoting the development objectives of the three countries as well as peace , security and stability in the region and the world .
Translation: 三国部长注意到，三方会议机制体现了三国间加深相互理解和信任的成果，并对会议成果予以积极评价。各方一致认为，2006年7月17日在圣彼得堡举行的峰会级三方会议（在八国集团峰会期间召开），体现了三国各方以最高政治层面推进共同关切议题磋商的意愿，旨在推动三国的发展目标以及维护地区和世界的和平、安全与稳定。

Query_Text_en: They reaffirmed that trilateral cooperation was not directed against the interests of any other country and was , on the contrary , intended to promote international harmony and understanding and find common ground amidst divergent interests .
Translation: 他们重申，三方合作并非针对任何其他国家的利益，而是旨在促进国际社会的和谐与相互理解，并在利益分歧中寻求共识。

Query_Text_en: They also emphasized the strong commitment of India , Russia and China to multilateral diplomacy .
Translation: 他们还强调了印度、俄罗斯和中国对多边外交的坚定承诺。

Query_Text_en: The Ministers discussed the political , security and economic aspects of the current global situation , besides exchanging views on how international relations are being presently conducted .
Translation: 各国外长深入讨论了当前国际形势的政治、安全和经济层面，并就当前国际关系的开展方式交换了看法。

Query_Text_en: They noted that globalization opens up opportunities for a more even distribution of development resources and influence in the world thus creating a foundation for a more stable and balanced international system .
Translation: 他们指出，全球化为发展资源和影响力的更加均衡分配开辟了机会，从而为建立更加稳定和均衡的国际体系奠定了基础。

Query_Text_en: They also emphasized the need to preserve the cultural and civilizational diversity of the contemporary world and to promote the existing initiatives for dialogue among civilizations and religions .
Translation: 他们还强调了维护当今世界文化与文明多样性以及推动现有文明与宗教间对话倡议的必要性。

Query_Text_en: They expressed their conviction that democratization of international relations is the key to building an increasingly multi-polar world order that would be based on principles of equality of nations-big or small , respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity of countries , international law and mutual respect .
Translation: 他们坚信，国际关系民主化是构建基于国家无论大小一律平等、尊重各国主权和领土完整、遵守国际法及相互尊重原则的多极世界秩序的关键。

Query_Text_en: The Ministers acknowledged that the UN is an appropriate instrument for promoting and attaining such a world order .
Translation: 部长们认识到，联合国是促进并实现这一世界秩序的重要工具。

Query_Text_en: The Sides stressed the importance of reforms at the UN , including the UN Security Council , in order to deal with the myriad challenges of today 's world more effectively .
Translation: 各方强调，为更有效地应对当今世界的各种复杂挑战，必须重视联合国改革，包括联合国安理会改革。

Query_Text_en: They shared the view that member states should aim to make the UN more transparent , efficient and reflective of contemporary realities .
Translation: 他们一致认为，成员国应致力于使联合国更加透明、高效，并更具代表性。

Query_Text_en: The Sides agreed to take steps in this direction .
Translation: 双方同意朝这一方向推进相关工作。

Query_Text_en: In this context , the Foreign Ministers of Russia and China reiterated that their countries attach great importance to the status of India in international affairs , and understand and support India 's aspirations to play a greater role in the United Nations .
Translation: 在此背景下，俄罗斯和中国外长重申，两国高度重视印度在国际事务中的地位，理解并支持印度在联合国发挥更大作用的诉求。

Query_Text_en: The Ministers noted that international terrorism continued to pose a grave threat to all nations and expressed concern about the new and evolving forms of the menace .
Translation: 各国部长指出，国际恐怖主义持续对各国构成严重威胁，并对恐怖主义威胁的新形式及其演变表示关切。

Query_Text_en: They agreed that under central and coordinating role of the UN and within the framework of its Global Counter-Terrorism Strategy collective action must be strengthened further by taking into account the mutating character of terrorism and its networks .
Translation: 他们一致认为，应充分发挥联合国的核心协调作用，在其全球反恐战略框架内，鉴于恐怖主义及其网络的不断演变特征，必须进一步加强集体行动。

Query_Text_en: They agreed that an early entry into force of International Convention for the Suppression of Acts of Nuclear Terrorism and the earliest possible adoption in the UN of the India-sponsored draft Comprehensive Convention on International Terrorism would lead to further consolidation of the international legal basis for combating terrorism .
Translation: 他们一致认为，《制止核恐怖主义行为国际公约》尽早生效以及在联合国尽早通过由印度发起的《全面反国际恐怖主义公约》草案，将有助于进一步巩固打击恐怖主义的国际法律基础。

Query_Text_en: The Sides underlined the substantial potential of their counter-terrorism cooperation in regional organizations .
Translation: 双方强调了在区域组织框架下开展反恐合作的巨大潜力。

Query_Text_en: They agreed that there can be no justification for any act of terrorism , irrespective of motivations , wherever and by whosoever committed .
Translation: 他们一致认为，任何形式的恐怖主义行为都是无法开脱罪责的，无论其动机、发生地点或实施者是谁。

Query_Text_en: They stressed that selective approaches in counter-terrorism can not yield sustainable results and it should be combated in a consistent , sustained and comprehensive manner without any double standards .
Translation: 他们强调指出，采取选择性反恐做法无法取得可持续成果，反恐应以一贯、持续和全面的方式推进，不搞双重标准。

Query_Text_en: The Sides also agreed to coordinate action against all factors that feed international terrorism , including its financing , illegal drug trafficking and trans-national organized crime .
Translation: 双方还同意协调行动，共同打击一切助长国际恐怖主义的因素，包括其资金支持、非法毒品贩运和跨国有组织犯罪。

Query_Text_en: The Ministers agreed that India , Russia and China , as countries with growing international influence , can make substantive positive contribution to global peace , security and stability .
Translation: 部长们一致认为，作为国际影响力日益增强的国家，印度、俄罗斯和中国可以为全球和平、安全与稳定作出实质性积极贡献。

Query_Text_en: In this context , the Ministers exchanged views on various regional and international issues of concern . They agreed that cooperation rather than confrontation should govern approaches to regional and global affairs .
Translation: 在此背景下，部长们就各种区域和国际关切问题交换了意见。双方一致认为，处理地区和全球事务应以合作而非对抗为指导原则。

Query_Text_en: While welcoming India 's joining the Shanghai Cooperation Organization [ SCO ] as an observer country , the Foreign Ministers of Russia and China stated that they would actively facilitate early realization of mutually beneficial contribution of India to the SCO .
Translation: 俄罗斯和中国外交部长在欢迎印度以观察员国身份加入上海合作组织（上合组织）的同时表示，将积极促进印度对上合组织作出的互利共赢贡献早日实现。

Query_Text_en: The Ministers paid specific attention to the high potential of trilateral cooperation and synergy in the economic field . The Ministers reiterated the considerable potential for mutually beneficial economic interaction among the three countries in areas such as energy , transport infrastructure , health , high technologies , including IT and biotechnology .
Translation: 部长们特别关注了经济领域三方合作与协同效应的高潜力。部长们重申，三国在能源、交通基础设施、卫生、高新技术（包括信息技术和生物技术）等领域的互利经济合作存在巨大潜力。

Query_Text_en: Recognizing the important role of the business and industrial circles of the three consistently growing and large economies , the Ministers agreed to advice their respective apex business bodies to organize a trilateral business forum taking into account the capabilities and potential of the three countries .
Translation: 认识到三个持续增长的大型经济体工商界的重要作用，各部部长同意建议本国最高级别商业机构组织三方工商论坛，并充分考虑三国的能力与潜力。

Query_Text_en: The Ministers agreed to monitor this process with a view to facilitating the agreed business meeting which would take place before September 2007 .
Translation: 部长们同意监督这一进程，旨在促进定于2007年9月前举行的已商定商务会议。

Query_Text_en: The Ministers expressed satisfaction at the results of the trilateral meeting in New Delhi and agreed to hold their next meeting in China .
Translation: 部长们对新德里三方会议的成果表示满意，并同意下次会议在中国举行。

Query_Text_en: PreambleThe Contracting States Desiring to make a contribution to the progress of science and technology Desiring to perfect the legal protection of inventions Desiring to simplify and render more economical the obtaining of protection for inventions where protection is sought in several countries Desiring to facilitate and accelerate access by the public to the technical information contained in documents describing new inventions Desiring to foster and accelerate the economic development of de eloping countries through the adoption of measures designed to in crease the efficiency of their legal systems whether national or regional instituted for the protection of inventions by providing easily accessible information on the availability of technological solutions applicable to their special needs and by facilitating access to the ever expanding volume of modern technology
Translation: 缔约各国希加强科学技术进步  希完善发明的法律保护制度  希简化在多个国家寻求发明保护的程序并降低成本  希促进和加速公众获取包含于描述新发明的文件中的技术信息  希通过对发展中国家经济发展的支持措施——提供易于获取的、适用于其特殊需求的技术解决方案的信息，并促进现代技术成果的日益普及——从而提升其国内或区域层面的发明保护法律体系效率，以促进和发展中国家的经济增长

Query_Text_en: Convinced that cooperation among nations will greatly facilitate the attainment of these aims Have concluded the present Treaty
Translation: 鉴于深信各国之间的合作将极大促进实现这些目标，兹缔结本条约。

Query_Text_en: Article 1 Establishment of a Union1The States party to this Treaty hereinafter calledthe Contracting Statesconstitute a Union for cooperation in the filing searching and examination of applications for the protection of inventions and for rendering special technical servicesThe Union shall be known as the International Patent Cooperation Union
Translation: 第一条 建立联盟  本条约的缔约国，以下简称缔约国，构成一个旨在就发明保护申请的受理、检索及审查开展合作，并提供特殊技术支援服务的联盟。该联盟应称为国际专利合作联盟。

Query_Text_en: 2No provision of this Treaty shall be interpreted as diminishing the rights under the Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property of any national or resident of any country party to that Convention
Translation: 本条约的任何规定均不得视为削弱《保护工业产权巴黎公约》任何缔约国国民或居民依该公约享有的权利。

Query_Text_en: references to a national Officeshall be construed as referring also to any intergovernmental authority which several States have entrusted with the task of granting regional patents provided that at least one of those States is a Contracting State and provided that the said States have authorized that authority to assume the obligations and exercise the powers which this Treaty and the Regulations provide for in respect of national Offices ;
Translation: 本条约中对"国家专利局"的任何援引均应视为同时指代多个缔约国委托其负责授予区域专利的任何政府间机构，但需满足以下条件：其中至少有一个国家是本条约缔约国，且相关国家已授权该机构承担本条约及实施细则所规定的缔约国国家专利局应承担的义务并行使相应职权。

Query_Text_en: xxDirector Generalmeans the Director General of the Organization and as long as BIRPI subsists the Director of BIRPI
Translation: 总干事指该组织的总干事，只要BIRPI存续，则指BIRPI的主任。

Query_Text_en: 1Applications for the protection of inventions in any of the Contracting States may be filed as international applications under this Treaty
Translation: 根据本条约，任何缔约国均可就发明保护提出国际申请。

Query_Text_en: 2An international application shall contain as specified in this Treaty and the Regulations a request a description one or more claims one or more drawings where required and an abstract
Translation: 国际申请应按照本条约及其实施细则的规定载明请求书、说明书、一项或多项权利要求书、必要时一项或多项附图以及摘要。

Query_Text_en: 3The abstract merely serves the purpose of technical informationand can not be taken into account for any other purpose particularly not for the purpose of interpreting the scope of the protection sought
Translation: 摘要仅用于提供技术信息之用，不得用于其他任何目的，尤其不得用于界定所寻求保护的范围。

Query_Text_en: ivbe subject to the payment of the prescribed fees
Translation: 须支付规定的费用。

Query_Text_en: if for any designated State a regional patent is available and the applicant wishes to obtain a regional patent rather than a national patent the request shall so indicate ;
Translation: 如果对于某一指定国存在区域专利且申请人希望获得区域专利而非国家专利，则应在请求中予以说明。

Query_Text_en: Otherwise the said indications may be furnished either in the request or in separate notices addressed to each designated Office whose national law requires the furnishing of the said indications but allows that they be furnished at a time later than that of the filing of a national application
Translation: 否则，上述信息可在请求中提供，或通过单独通知提交给每个要求提供上述信息的指定机构，这些机构所在国家法律允许在提交国家申请之后的某个时间点提交此类信息。

Query_Text_en: 2Every designation shall be subject to the payment of the prescribed fee within the prescribed time limit
Translation: 每一项指定均应按规定期限缴纳规费。

Query_Text_en: 3Unless the applicant asks for any of the other kinds of protection referred to in Article 43 designation shall mean that the desired protection consists of the grant of a patent by or for the designated StateFor the purposes of this paragraph Article 2 iishall not apply
Translation: 除非申请人要求第四十三条所规定的其他种类的保护，否则"指定"应指要求的保护形式为由指定国授予专利权。就本款而言，第二条第（二）项不适用。

Query_Text_en: 4Failure to indicate in the request the name and other prescribed data concerning the inventor shall have no consequence in any designated State whose national law requires the furnishing of the said indications but allows that they be furnished at a time later than that of the filing of a national applicationFailure to furnish the said indications in a separate notice shall have no consequence in any designated State whose national law does not require the furnishing of the said indications
Translation: 在请求中未注明发明人姓名及其他法定信息的，在任何要求提供这些信息但允许在提交本国申请之后补交的指定国家，均不产生法律后果。未在单独通知中提供上述信息，对于任何法律不要求提供所述信息的指定国家，亦不产生法律后果。

Query_Text_en: Article 5 The DescriptionThe description shall disclose the invention in a manner sufficiently clear and complete for the invention to be carried out by a person skilled in the art
Translation: 第五条 说明书说明书应当对发明作出充分清晰且完整的披露，以使所属技术领域的技术人员能够实施该发明。

Query_Text_en: Article 6 The ClaimsThe claim or claims shall define the matter for which protection is soughtClaims shall be clear and conciseThey shall be fully supported by the description
Translation: 第六条 权利要求  权利要求应界定请求保护的主题。权利要求应当清楚、简明。权利要求应当得到说明书充分支持。

Query_Text_en: 1Subject to the provisions of paragraph 2ii drawings shall be required when they are necessary for the understanding of the invention
Translation: 根据第2ii款的规定，当附图对理解发明是必要时，应当提交附图。

Query_Text_en: 2Where without being necessary for the understanding of the invention the nature of the invention admits of illustration by drawings :
Translation: 当发明的性质可以通过附图说明且并非理解该发明所必需时：

Query_Text_en: ithe applicant may include such drawings in the international application when filed
Translation: 申请人可在提交国际申请时包含此类图纸。

Query_Text_en: iiany designated Office may require that the applicant file such drawings with it within the prescribed time limit
Translation: 任何指定机构有权要求申请人在规定期限内向其提交相关图纸。

Query_Text_en: 1The international application may contain a declaration as prescribed in the Regulations claiming the priority of one or more earlier applications filed in or for any country party to the Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property
Translation: 国际申请可载有按照规定主张一项或多项先前提交的申请在巴黎公约缔约国境内或向其提交的优先权的声明。

Query_Text_en: 2aSubject to the provisions of subparagraph b the conditions for and the effect of any priority claim declared under paragraph 1shall be as provided in Article 4 of the Stockholm Act of the Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property
Translation: 除本款b项规定外，根据第1款提出的任何优先权主张的条件及其效力应按照《保护工业产权巴黎公约》斯德哥尔摩文本第四条的规定办理。

Query_Text_en: bThe international application for which the priority of one or more earlier applications filed in or for a Contracting State is claimed may contain the designation of that StateWhere in the international application the priority of one or more national applications filed in or for a designated State is claimed or where the priority of an international application having designated only one State is claimed the conditions for and the effect of the priority claim in that State shall be governed by the national law of that State
Translation: 就要求一项或多项在缔约国国内或向该缔约国提出过申请的优先权的国际申请而言，其中可以包含该国的指定。若在国际申请中提出过在指定国内或向指定国提交的一件或多件国家申请的优先权主张，或若提出过仅指定单一国家的国际申请的优先权主张，则该优先权主张在该指定国的条件及效力应受该国国家法律的约束。

Query_Text_en: 1Any resident or national of a Contracting State may file an international application
Translation: 缔约国的任何居民或国民均有权提交国际申请。

Query_Text_en: 2The Assembly may decide to allow the residents and the nationals of any country party to the Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property which is not party to this Treaty to file international applications
Translation: 总干事会可决定允许未加入本条约的《保护工业产权巴黎公约》缔约国的居民和国民提交国际申请。

Query_Text_en: 3The concepts of residence and nationality and the application of those concepts in cases where there are several applicants or where the applicants are not the same for all the designated States are defined in the Regulations
Translation: 关于居住地和国籍的概念，以及在存在多个申请人或申请人并非所有指定成员国均相同的场合下这些概念的适用情形，在《条例》中作出了明确规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 10 The Receiving OfficeThe international application shall be filed with the prescribed receiving Office which will check and process it as provided in this Treaty and the Regulations
Translation:
第十条 受理局  
国际申请应当向指定的受理局提交，该受理局将按照本条约和细则的规定进行审查并处理。

Query_Text_en: ea part which on the face of it appears to be a claim or claims
Translation: 表面上看似乎属于一种或多种主张的部分。

Query_Text_en: 2aIf the receiving Office finds that the international application did not at the time of receipt fulfill the requirements listed in paragraph 1 it shall as provided in the Regulations invite the applicant to file the required correction
Translation: 如果受理局发现国际申请在收到时未满足第1款规定的要求，应当根据相关规定通知申请人提交必要的更正材料。

Query_Text_en: bIf the applicant complies with the invitation as provided in the Regulations the receiving Office shall accord as the international filing date the date of receipt of the required correction
Translation: 如果申请人遵守规定中的邀请，受理局应将收到必要更正之日视为国际申请日。

Query_Text_en: 3Subject to Article 64 4 any international application fulfilling the requirements listed in items 1ito 1iiiand accorded an international filing date shall have the effect of a regular national application in each designated State as of the international filing date which date shall be considered to be the actual filing date in each designated State
Translation: 根据第64条，符合第1(i)项至1(iii)项所列要求并获得国际申请日的任何国际申请，自该国际申请日起在每一指定国产生正式国家申请的效力，该日期应视为在每一指定国的实际申请日。

Query_Text_en: 4Any international application fulfilling the requirements listed in items 1ito 1iiishall be equivalent to a regular national filing within the meaning of the Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property
Translation: 4. 凡符合本条第1(i)项至第1(iii)项规定条件的国际申请，均视为根据《保护工业产权巴黎公约》规定所指的国家正式申请。

Query_Text_en: 1One copy of the international application shall be kept by the receiving Office home copy one copy record copyshall be transmitted to the International Bureau and another copy search copyshall be transmitted to the competent International Searching Authority referred to in Article 16 as provided in the Regulations
Translation: 国际申请的一份副本应由受理局留存，另一份记录副本应转交国际局，再一份检索副本应按照规定转交第16条所指的负责国际检索的单位。

Query_Text_en: 2The record copy shall be considered the true copy of the international application
Translation: 该记录副本应视为该国际申请的真实副本。

Query_Text_en: 3The international application shall be considered withdrawn if the record copy has not been received by the International Bureau within the prescribed time limit
Translation: 如果国际局未在规定的期限内收到副本，该国际申请将被视为已撤回。

Query_Text_en: 1Any designated Office may ask the International Bureau to transmit to it a copy of the international application prior to the communication provided for in Article 20 and the International Bureau shall transmit such copy to the designated Office as soon as possible after the expiration of one year from the priority date
Translation: 任何指定局可在根据第二十条规定的通知提交前，要求国际局向其传送国际申请副本，国际局应自优先权日起满一年后尽快将该副本传送至指定局。

Query_Text_en: 2aThe applicant may at any time transmit a copy of his international application to any designated Office
Translation: 申请人可随时向任何指定的受理机构提交其国际申请的副本。

Query_Text_en: bThe applicant may at any time ask the International Bureau to transmit a copy of his international application to any designated Office and the International Bureau shall transmit such copy to the designated Office as soon as possible
Translation: 申请人可随时要求国际局将其国际申请的副本转交至任何指定局，国际局应尽快将该副本转交至相关指定局。

Query_Text_en: cAny national Office may notify the International Bureau that it does not wish to receive copies as provided for in subparagraph b in which case that subparagraph shall not be applicable in respect of that Office
Translation: 任何国家局处均可通知国际局其不希望根据子段(b)接收副本，如有此情形，则该分项对该局处不适用。

Query_Text_en: vit does not comply to the extent provided in the Regulations with the prescribed physical requirements
Translation: VIT未在条例规定的范围内符合规定的身体要求。

Query_Text_en: bIf the receiving Office finds any of the said defects it shall invite the applicant to correct the international application within the prescribed time limit failing which that application shall be considered withdrawn and the receiving Office shall so declare
Translation: 如果受理局发现国际申请存在上述缺陷，应当通知申请人在规定期限内进行更正，逾期未予更正的，该申请视为撤回，受理局应当予以宣布。

Query_Text_en: 2If the international application refers to drawings which in fact are not included in that application the receiving Office shall notify the applicant accordingly and he may furnish them within the prescribed time limit and if he does the international filing date shall be the date on which the drawings are received by the receiving OfficeOtherwise any reference to the said drawings shall be considered nonexistent
Translation: 如果国际申请中提及的图纸实际上未包含在该申请中，受理局应通知申请人，申请人可在规定期限内补交这些图纸，如果申请人这样做，国际申请日即为受理局收到图纸的日期。否则，对上述图纸的任何提及均视为不存在。

Query_Text_en: 3aIf the receiving Office finds that within the prescribed time limits the fees prescribed under Article 3 4ivhave not been paid or no fee prescribed under Article 42has been paid in respect of any of the designated States the international application shall be considered withdrawn and the receiving Office shall so declare
Translation: 如果受理局发现未在规定的期限内缴纳根据《专利合作条约》第三条第四款第(iv)项规定的费用，或者对于指定国中的任何国家未缴纳根据《专利合作条约》第四十二条规定的费用，则该国际申请应视为撤回，受理局应就此作出声明。

Query_Text_en: bIf the receiving Office finds that the fee prescribed under Article 42has been paid in respect of one or more but less than alldesignated States within the prescribed time limit the designation of those States in respect of which it has not been paid within the prescribed time limit shall be considered withdrawn and the receivingOffice shall so declare
Translation: 如果受理机构发现根据第四十二条规定的费用仅针对部分而非全部指定国在规定期限内缴纳，则对于未在规定期限内缴纳费用的指定国，其指定应视为撤回，受理机构应就此作出声明。

Query_Text_en: 4If after having accorded an international filing date to the international application the receiving Office finds within the prescribed time limit that any of the requirements listed in Article 11 1ito 11 1iiiwas not complied with at that date the said application shall be considered withdrawn and the receiving Office shall so declare
Translation: 受理局已给予国际申请日后，若其在规定的期限内发现该申请在该日期未满足第11条第（一）项i至iii目中的任何一项要求，则该申请应视为撤回，受理局应作出相应声明。

Query_Text_en: 1Each international application shall be the subject of international search
Translation: 每一项国际申请均须接受国际检索。

Query_Text_en: 2The objective of the international search is to discover relevant prior art
Translation: 国际检索的目的是查找相关现有技术。

Query_Text_en: 3International search shall be made on the basis of the claims with due regard to the description and the drawings if any
Translation: 国际检索应以权利要求为基础，并适当考虑说明书及附图（如有）。

Query_Text_en: 4The International Searching Authority referred to in Article 16 shall endeavor to discover as much of the relevant prior art as its facilities permit and shall in any case consult the documentation specified in the Regulations
Translation: 根据第十六条所述的国际检索单位应努力在其现有设施条件下尽可能多地发现相关现有技术，并须在任何情况下查阅规费规定中的相关文件。

Query_Text_en: 5aIf the national law of the Contracting State so permits the applicant who files a national application with the national Office of or acting for such State may subject to the conditions provided for in such law request that a search similar to an international search internationaltype searchbe carried out on such application
Translation: 如果缔约国的国家法律允许，向该缔约国的国家局提交国家阶段申请的申请人，可依据该法律规定所设定的条件，请求对该申请进行类似国际检索的检索。

Query_Text_en: bIf the national law of the Contracting State so permits the national Office of or acting for such State may subject any national application filed with it to an internationaltype search
Translation: 如果缔约国的国家法律允许此类做法，该国的国家局或为其行事的机构可对向其提交的任何国家申请进行国际类型检索。
