Query_Text_en: cThe internationaltype search shall be carried out by the International Searching Authority referred to in Article 16 which would be competent for an international search if the national application were an international application and were filed with the Office referred to in subparagraphs aand bIf the national application is in a language which the International Searching Authority considers it is not equipped to handle the internationaltype search shall be carried out on a translation prepared by the applicant in a language prescribed for international applications and which the International Searching Authority has undertaken to accept for international applicationsThe national application and the translation when required shall be presented in the form prescribed for international applications
Translation: 国际式检索应由按照第16条规定的国际检索机构实施，该机构在假设该国家申请成为国际申请并提交至该局的情况下具备进行国际检索的能力。若国家申请使用的语言不属于国际检索机构认为能够处理的语种，则国际式检索应基于申请人为该申请准备的翻译版本实施，该翻译需采用国际申请规定的指定语言，并且国际检索机构已承诺接受该语言用于国际检索。当翻译文件为必要时，国家申请与该翻译文件须按照国际申请规定的格式提交。

Query_Text_en: 1International search shall be carried out by an International Searching Authority which may be either a national Office or an intergovernmental organization such as the International Patent Institute whose tasks include the establishing of documentary search reports on prior art with respect to inventions which are the subject of applications
Translation: 国际检索应由国际检索机构进行，该机构可以是国家专利局或类似于国际专利局的政府间组织，其职责包括针对申请所涉及的发明，编制关于现有技术的文献检索报告。

Query_Text_en: 2If pending the establishment of a single International Searching Authority there are several International Searching Authorities each receiving Office shall in accordance with the provisions of the applicable agreement referred to in paragraph 3b specify the International Searching Authority or Authorities competent for the searching of international applications filed with such Office
Translation: 在建立单一国际检索当局之前，如果存在多个国际检索当局，每个受理局均应按照第3b段所指相关协议的规定，指定负责检索该局所受理的国际申请的国际检索当局或当局。

Query_Text_en: 3aInternational Searching Authorities shall be appointed by the AssemblyAny national Office and any intergovernmental organization satisfying the requirements referred to in subparagraph cmay be appointed as International Searching Authority
Translation: 国际检索机构应由总务委员会指定。任何符合第c分段所述要求的国家局和任何政府间组织均可指定为国际检索机构。

Query_Text_en: bAppointment shall be conditional on the consent of the national Office or intergovernmental organization to be appointed and the conclusion of an agreement subject to approval by the Assembly between such Office or organization and the International BureauThe agreement shall specify the rights and obligations of the parties in particular the formal undertaking by the said Office or organization to apply and observe all the common rules of international search
Translation: 任命应取决于拟被指定的国家局或政府间组织的同意，以及该局或组织与国际局之间达成的协议。此协议需经大会批准，其中应明确规定各方的权利与义务，尤其是该局或组织须作出正式承诺，遵循并遵守所有国际检索共同规则。

Query_Text_en: cThe Regulations prescribe the minimum requirements particularly as to manpower and documentation which any Office or organization must satisfy before it can be appointed and must continue to satisfy while it remains appointed
Translation: 本规定明确了机构获任前必须满足的最低要求，特别是关于人力配备和文件管理方面的要求，同时这些机构在任期内也须持续满足上述条件。

Query_Text_en: dAppointment shall be for a fixed period of time and may be extended for further periods
Translation: 本任命应为固定期限，并可予以延长。

Query_Text_en: eBefore the Assembly makes a decision on the appointment of any national Office or intergovernmental organization or on the extension of its appointment or before it allows any such appointment to lapse the Assembly shall hear the interested Office or organization and seek the advice of the Committee for Technical Cooperation referred to in Article 56 once that Committee has been established
Translation: 在大会就任何国家机构或政府间组织的任命、延长其任期作出决定，或允许该任命到期终止之前，大会应听取有关机构或组织的意见，并在技术合作委员会（根据第五十六条设立后）征求该委员会的意见。

Query_Text_en: 1Procedure before the International Searching Authority shall be governed by the provisions of this Treaty the Regulations and the agreement which the International Bureau shall conclude subject to this Treaty and the Regulations with the said Authority
Translation: 在国际检索机构前的程序应受本条约的规定、规章以及国际局将与该机构在本条约和规章框架下达成的协议规范。

Query_Text_en: ithat the international application relates to a subject matter which the International Searching Authority is not required under the Regulations to search and in the particular case decides not to search oriithat the description the claims or the drawings fail to comply with the prescribed requirements to such an extent that a meaningful search could not be carried out the said Authority shall so declare and shall notify the applicant and the International Bureau that no international search report will be established
Translation: 当国际申请涉及根据规定无需检索的主题事项，且在特定情况下国际检索机构决定不进行检索；或者说明书、权利要求书或附图未能遵守规定的格式要求，以至于无法进行有意义的检索时，该机构应就此作出声明，并应通知申请人及国际局将不建立国际检索报告。

Query_Text_en: bIf any of the situations referred to in subparagraph ais found to exist in connection with certain claims only the international search report shall so indicate in respect of such claims whereas for the other claims the said report shall be established as provided in Article 18
Translation: 如果在某些权利要求中发现存在第(a)项所述情形，国际检索报告应对这些权利要求作出相应说明，而对于其他权利要求，则应按照第十八条的规定作出该报告。

Query_Text_en: 3aIf the International Searching Authority considers that the international application does not comply with the requirement of unity of invention as set forth in the Regulations it shall invite the applicant to pay additional feesThe International Searching Authority shall establish the international search report on those parts of the international application which relate to the invention first mentioned in the claims main inventionand provided the required additional fees have been paid within the prescribed time limit on those parts of the international application which relate to inventions in respect of which the said fees were paid
Translation: 如果国际检索单位认为该国际申请不符合行政规程所规定的发明单一性要求，应当邀请申请人缴纳附加费。国际检索单位应就国际申请中涉及主权利要求所提及的发明的部分作出国际检索报告，且在申请人按规定期限缴纳了针对这些部分的附加费用的情况下，也应就国际申请中涉及缴纳附加费的其他发明的部分作出国际检索报告。

Query_Text_en: bThe national law of any designated State may provide that where the national Office of that State finds the invitation referred to in subparagraph a of the International Searching Authority justified and where the applicant has not paid all additional fees those parts of the international application which consequently have not been searched shall as far as effects in that State are concerned be considered withdrawn unless a special fee is paid by the applicant to the national Office of that State
Translation: 指定国的国家法律可规定，若该国国家局认定国际检索当局所指子项(a)的邀请合理，且申请人未支付全部附加费用，则国际申请中因此未被检索的部分在该国的效力方面应视为已撤回，除非申请人向该国国家局缴纳特殊费用。

Query_Text_en: 1The international search report shall be established within the prescribed time limit and in the prescribed form
Translation: 国际检索报告应当在规定的期限内按照规定的格式制定。

Query_Text_en: 2The international search report shall as soon as it has been established be transmitted by the International Searching Authority to the applicant and the International Bureau
Translation: 国际检索报告一经制定完成，应由国际检索当局发送给申请人及国际局。

Query_Text_en: 3The international search report or the declaration referred to in Article 17 2ashall be translated as provided in the RegulationsThe translations shall be prepared by or under the responsibility of the International Bureau
Translation: 国际检索报告或根据《实施细则》规定进行翻译的第十七条第二款提及的声明，其翻译内容应由国际局负责准备或在其监督下完成。

Query_Text_en: 1The applicant shall after having received the international search report be entitled to one opportunity to amend the claims of the international application by filing amendments with the International Bureau within the prescribed time limitHe may at the same time file a brief statement as provided in the Regulations explaining the amendments and indicating any impact that such amendments might have on the description and the drawings
Translation: 申请人收到国际检索报告后，在规定期限内有权通过向国际局提交修改文件的方式对国际申请的权利要求进行一次修改。同时，申请人可根据法规提交一份简要说明，解释所作修改并指出这些修改可能对说明书及附图造成的影响。

Query_Text_en: 2The amendments shall not go beyond the disclosure in the international application as filed
Translation: 修改内容不得超出提交的国际申请中所公开的内容。

Query_Text_en: 3If the national law of any designated State permits amendments to go beyond the said disclosure failure to comply with paragraph 2shall have no consequence in that State
Translation: 如果任何指定国的国家法律允许对所述披露进行超出范围的修改，则未遵守第2段的规定在该国将不产生任何后果。

Query_Text_en: 1aThe international application together with the international search report including any indication referred to in Article 17 2bor the declaration referred to in ` Article 17 2a shall be communicated to each designated Office as provided in the Regulations unless the designated Office waives such requirement in its entirety or in part
Translation: 国际申请连同国际检索报告（包括第17条2款(b)项所指明的内容）或第17条2款(a)项所指的声明，应按照规定提交至各指定机构，除非该指定机构全部或部分豁免此项要求。

Query_Text_en: 2If the claims have been amended by virtue of Article 19 1 the communication shall either contain the full text of the claims both as filed and as amended or shall contain the full text of the claims as filed and specify the amendments and shall include the statement if any referred to in Article 191
Translation: 根据第19.1条对权利要求进行修改的，相关通知应包含以下内容：要么完整列明作为原始提交及修改后的权利要求全文，要么完整列明原始提交的权利要求文本并明确说明修改内容，同时应包含根据第19.1条所述的任何声明（如有）。

Query_Text_en: 3At the request of the designated Office or the applicant the International Searching Authority shall send to the said Office or the applicant respectively copies of the documents cited in the international search report as provided in the Regulations
Translation: 应指定机构或申请人的要求，国际检索机构应根据规定，向该机构或申请人分别发送国际检索报告中所引用文件的副本。

Query_Text_en: 1The International Bureau shall publish international applications
Translation: 国际局应当公布国际申请。

Query_Text_en: 2aSubject to the exceptions provided for in subparagraph band in Article 643 the international publication of the international application shall be effected promptly after the expiration of 18 months from the priority date of that application
Translation: 除本条约第643条b款规定的例外情形外，国际申请的国际公布应自该申请优先权日起满18个月后尽快进行。

Query_Text_en: bThe applicant any ask the International Bureau to publish his international application any time before the expiration of the time limit referred to in subparagraph aThe International Bureau shall proceed accordingly as provided in the Regulations
Translation: 申请人可在本款a)项所述期限届满前任何时候请求国际局公布其国际申请。国际局应根据《实施细则》相应办理。

Query_Text_en: 3The international search report or the declaration referred to in Article 172ashall be published as prescribed in the Regulations
Translation: 根据《条例》规定，第172条所指的国际检索报告或声明应当予以公布。

Query_Text_en: 4The language and form of the international publication and other details are governed by the Regulations
Translation: 国际出版物的语言、形式以及其他细节均须符合《规定》。

Query_Text_en: 5There shall be no international publication if the international application is withdrawn or is considered withdrawn before the technical preparations for publication have been completed
Translation: 如果国际申请在公布的技术准备工作完成前被撤回或被视为已撤回，则不得进行国际公布。

Query_Text_en: 6If the international application contains expressions or drawings which in the open of the International Bureau are contrary to morality or public order or if in its opinion zhe international application contains disparaging statements as defined in the Regulations it may omit such expressions drawings and statements from its publications indicating the place and number of words or drawings omitted and furnishing upon request individual copies of the passages omitted
Translation: 如果国际申请中包含的表达或图纸在国际局看来有悖于道德或公共秩序，或者国际局认为该申请包含根据规定所定义的贬低性陈述，它可以将其出版物中的此类表达、图纸和陈述予以删减，在出版物中标明删减内容的位置以及删减的文字或图纸数量，并根据请求提供被删减部分的单独复印件。

Query_Text_en: 1The applicant shall furnish a copy of the international application unless the communication provided for ia Article 20 has already taken placeand a translation thereof as prescribed and pay the national fee if any to each designated Office not later than at the expiration of 20 months from the priority dateWhere the national law of the designated State requires the indication of the name of and other prescribed data concerning the inventor but allows that these indications be furnished at a time later than that of the filing of a national application the applicant shall unless they were contained in the request furnish the said indications to the national Office of or acting for the State not later than at the expiration of 20 months from the priority date
Translation: 申请人应提交国际申请的副本（除非根据第20条已进行过告知且已提供译文），并缴纳任何国家费用，向每个指定的主管机构提交，最迟不得晚于自优先权日起满20个月时。若指定国家的国家法律要求标明发明人姓名及其他规定的事项，但允许这些信息的提交时间晚于国家申请的提交时间，则除非这些信息已在请求中包含，申请人应最迟于自优先权日起满20个月时，向该国家的国家主管机构或为其代理的机构提交所述信息。

Query_Text_en: 2Where the International Searching Authority makes a declaration under Article 17 2 a that no international search report will be established the time limit for performing the acts referred to in paragraph 1of this Article shall be the same as that provided for in paragraph 1
Translation: 如果国际检索单位根据《专利合作条约》第十七条第二款（a）项的规定作出声明，不制定国际检索报告，则本条第一款所述行为的期限应与本款第一段规定的期限相同。

Query_Text_en: 3Any national law may for performing the acts referred to in paragraphs 1or 2 fix time limits which expire later than the time limit provided for in those paragraphs
Translation: 任何国家法律均可为实施本条第1款或第2款所述行为，规定晚于该条款所设期限的时限。

Query_Text_en: 1No designated Office shall process or examine the international application prior to the expiration of the applicable time limit under Article 22
Translation: 指定机构不得在第22条规定的期限届满前处理或审查国际申请。

Query_Text_en: 2Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 any designated Office may on the express request of the applicant process or examine the international application at any time
Translation: 尽管第1段有相关规定，任何指定主管机构仍可应申请人明确请求，在任何时间处理或审查国际申请。

Query_Text_en: 1Subject in case iibelow to the provisions of Article 25 the effect of the international application provided for in Article 113shall cease in any designated State with the same consequences as the withdrawal of any national application in that State :
Translation: 根据本条第二款规定，在指定国中，国际申请的效力终止的后果与该国国家申请撤回的后果相同。

Query_Text_en: iiiif the applicant fails to perform the acts referred to in Article 22 within the applicable time limit
Translation: 如申请人未在规定的期限内履行本条例第二十二条规定的相关手续。

Query_Text_en: 2Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 any designated Office may maintain the effect provided for in Article XI 3even where such effect is not required to be maintained by virtue of Article 252
Translation: 尽管第1款有相关规定，任何指定机构仍可维持《第十一章》第三条所规定的效力，即使根据第252条无需维持该效力。

Query_Text_en: 1aWhere the receiving Office has refused to accord an international filing date or has declared that the international application is considered withdrawn or where the International Bureau has made a finding under Article 12 3 the International Bureau shall promptly send at the request of the applicant copies of any document in the file to any of the designated Offices named by the applicant
Translation: 当接收局拒绝授予国际申请日，或宣布国际申请被视为撤回，或国际局根据第12条第3款作出认定时，国际局应应申请人的请求，向其指定的任何选定局发送文件中的任何文件副本。

Query_Text_en: bWhere the receiving Office has declared that the designation of any given State is considered withdrawn the International Bureau shall promptly send at the request of the applicant copies of any document in the file to the national Office of such State
Translation: 当受理局已声明某指定国的指定被视为撤回时，国际局应立即应申请人的请求，将该申请案卷中的任何文件副本发送至该国国家局。

Query_Text_en: cThe request under subparagraphs aor bshall be presented within the prescribed time limit
Translation: 根据子段(a)或(b)提出的请求，应于规定的期限内提交。

Query_Text_en: 2aSubject to the provisions of subparagraph b each designated Office shall provided that the national fee if anyhas been paid and the appropriate translation as prescribedhas been furnished within the prescribed time limit decide whether the refusal declaration or finding referred to in paragraph 1was justified under the provisions of this Treaty and the Regulations and if it finds that the refusal or declaration was the result of an error or omission on the part of the receiving Office or that the finding was the result of an error or omission on the part of the International Bureau it shall as far as effects in the State of the designated Office are concerned treat the international application as if such error or omission had not occurred
Translation: 根据本款b项的规定，在已缴纳国家费用（如有）且在规定期限内提交了规定的译文的前提下，每一指定局应决定第1款所述的驳回声明或决定是否符合本条约及实施细则的相关规定。如果该指定局认定驳回或声明系由于受理局的错误或疏漏所致，或该决定系由于国际局的错误或疏漏所致，那么就该指定局所在国的影响范围而言，应将该国际申请视为相关错误或疏漏未曾发生过。

Query_Text_en: bWhere the record copy has reached the International Bureau after the expiration of the time limit prescribed under Article 123on account of any error or omission on the part of the applicant the provisions of subparagraph ashall apply only under the circumstances referred to in Article 482
Translation: 若因申请人方面的任何错误或疏漏导致记录副本在第123条规定的期限届满后送达国际局，则仅应按照第482条所述情形适用第a款的规定。

Query_Text_en: Article 26 Opportunity to Correct before Designated OfficesNo designated Office shall reject an international application onthe grounds of noncompliance with the requirements of this Treaty and the Regulations without first giving the applicant the opportunity to correct the said application to the extent and according to the procedure provided by the national law for the same or comparable situations in respect of national applications
Translation:
第二十六条 修正机会  
在拒绝国际申请前，指定机构不得以该申请不符合本条约及实施细则规定为由作出驳回决定，除非事先已给予申请人根据本国法律就相同或类似情形对国内申请所规定的程度和程序进行修正的机会。

Query_Text_en: 1No national law shall require compliance with requirements relating to the form or contents of the international application different from or additional to those which are provided for in this Treaty and the Regulations
Translation: 任何国家的法律均不得要求国际申请在形式或内容方面遵守与本条约及实施细则规定不同的或额外的要求。

Query_Text_en: iwhen the applicant is a legal entity of the name of an officer entitled to represent such legal entity iiof documents not part of the international application but which constitute proof of allegations or statements made in that application including the confirmation of the international application by the signature of the applicant when that application as filed was signed by his representative or agent
Translation: 当申请人为法人实体时，需注明该法人实体的有权代表人姓名，以及包括以下文件：构成对申请中所述内容的证明材料（即使这些文件并非国际申请的组成部分），包括当该申请提交时由其代表人或代理人签署的情况下，申请人通过签名对国际申请进行的确认。

Query_Text_en: 3Where the applicant for the purposes of any designated State is not qualified according to the national law of that State to file a national application because he is not the inventor the international application may be rejected by the designated Office
Translation: 如果就任何指定国而言，申请人根据该指定国的国家法律，由于并非发明人而没有资格提交国家申请，则该指定局可以驳回该国际申请。

Query_Text_en: 4Where the national law provides in respect of the form or contents of national applications for requirements which from the view point of applicants are more favorable than the requirements provided for by this Treaty and the Regulations in respect of international applications the national Office the courts and any other competent organs of or acting for the designated State may apply the former requirements instead of the latter requirements to international applications except where the applicant insists that the requirements provided for by this Treaty and the Regulations be applied to his international application
Translation: 当国家法律就本国申请的形式或内容所规定的条件从申请人角度更为有利时，指定国的国家主管机关、法院以及代表该国行事的其他有关部门可对国际申请适用上述本国条件，除非申请人坚持要求适用本条约和实施细则所规定的相应条件。

Query_Text_en: 5Nothing in this Treaty and the Regulations is intended to be construed as prescribing anything that would limit the freedom of each Contracting State to prescribe such substantive conditions of patentability as it desiresIn particular any provision in this Treaty and the Regulations concerning the definition of prior art is exclusively for the purposes of the international procedure and consequently any Contracting State is free to apply when determining the patentability of an invention claimed in an international application the criteria of its national law in respect of prior art and other conditions of patentability not constituting requirements as to the form and contents of applications
Translation: 本条约及实施细则的任何内容均不旨在被解释为对缔约各方自行设定专利实质性授权条件的权利构成限制。特别是，本条约及实施细则中有关现有技术定义的任何条款，专用于国际程序目的。因此，当根据国际申请确定所要求保护发明的专利性时，各缔约国可自由适用其本国法关于现有技术及其他不涉及申请形式与内容要求的专利授权条件的标准。

Query_Text_en: 6The national law may require that the applicant furnish evidence in respect of any substantive condition of patentability prescribed by such law
Translation: 国家法律可能要求申请人就该法律所规定的任何专利性实质性条件提交证据。

Query_Text_en: 7Any receiving Office or once the processing of the international application has started in the designated Office that Office may apply the national law as far as it relates to any requirement that the applicant be represented by an agent having the right to represent applicants before the said Office andaor that the applicant have an address in the designated State for the purpose of receiving notifications
Translation: 任何受理局或一旦指定局开始处理国际申请，该指定局有权就以下要求适用本国法律：要求申请人必须由有权在该机构代理申请事务的代理人代表，或要求申请人在指定国设有可接收通知的地址。

Query_Text_en: 8Nothing in this Treaty and the Regulations is intended to be construed as limiting the freedom of any Contracting State to apply measures deemed necessary for the preservation of its national security or to limit for the protection of the general economic interests of that State the right of its own residents or nationals to file international applications
Translation: 本条约及实施细则的任何规定均不得被解释为旨在限制任一缔约方为维护国家安全而采取必要措施的自由，亦不得被解释为限制该缔约方为保护本国总体经济利益而使其本国居民或国民享有提交国际申请权利的自由。

Query_Text_en: 1The applicant shall be given the opportunity to amend the claims the description and the drawings before each designated Office within the prescribed time limitNo designated Office shall grant a patent or refuse the grant of a patent before such time limit has expired except with the express consent of the applicant
Translation: 申请人应在各指定机构规定的期限内被给予机会修改权利要求、说明书和附图。任何指定机构均不得在该期限届满前授予或拒绝授予专利，除非获得申请人的明确同意。

Query_Text_en: 2The amendments shall not go beyond the disclosure in the international application as filed unless the national law of the designated State permits them to go beyond the said disclosure
Translation: 修改内容不得超出国际申请提交时的公开范围，除非指定国的国家法律允许超出所述公开内容。

Query_Text_en: 3The amendments shall be in accordance with the national law of the designated State in all respects not provided for in this Treaty and the Regulations
Translation: 对于本条约和条例未作规定的各个方面，修改应依照指定国的国家法律。

Query_Text_en: 4Where the designated Office requires a translation of the international application the amendments shall be in the language of the translation
Translation: 如果指定受理机关要求对国际申请进行翻译，则修改内容应采用译文所使用的语言。

Query_Text_en: 1As far as the protection of any rights of the applicant in a designated State is concerned the effects in that State of the international publication of an international application shall subject to the provisions of paragraphs 2to 4 be the same as those which the national law of the designated State provides for the compulsory national publication of unexamined national applications as such
Translation: 就指定国对申请人权利的保护而言，国际申请的国际公布在该指定国所产生的效力，除本条第二款至第四款另有规定外，应与该指定国国家法律就未经审查的国家申请的强制性国家公布所规定的效力相同。

Query_Text_en: ia translation into the latter language has been published as provided by the national laworiia translation into the latter language has been made available to the public by laying open for public inspection as provided by the national law oriiia translation into the latter language has been transmitted by the applicant to the actual or prospective unauthorized user of the invention claimed in the international application orivboth the acts described iniandiii or both the acts described iniiandiii have taken place
Translation:
根据国家法律规定，该语言译文已予以公布；  
根据国家法律规定，该语言译文已通过公开供公众查阅的方式使公众可获使用；  
申请人已将该语言译文提交给国际申请中所涉发明的实际或潜在未经许可使用者；  
上述第一项和第三项所述行为均已发生，或上述第二项和第三项所述行为均已发生。

Query_Text_en: 3The national law of any designated State may provide that where the international publication has been effected on the request of the applicant before the expiration of 18 months from the priority date the effects provided for in paragraph 1shall be applicable only from the expiration of 18 months from the priority date
Translation: 指定国的国家法律可以规定，如果国际公布是在优先权日起满18个月之前应申请人请求作出的，则本条第一款规定的效力仅自优先权日起满18个月之日起适用。

Query_Text_en: 4The national law of any designated State may provide that the effects provided for in paragraph 1shall be applicable only from the date on which a copy of the international application as published under Article 21 has been received in the national Office of or acting for such StateThe said Office shall publish the date of receipt in its gazette as soon as possible
Translation: 任何指定国的国家法律可规定本条第一段规定的效力仅自国际申请按照第二十一条公布的副本送交该国或其代表机构之日起生效。该机构应尽快在其官方公报上公布收到副本的日期。

Query_Text_en: 1aSubject to the provisions of subparagraph b the International Bureau and the International Searching Authorities shall not allow access by any person or authority to the international application before the international publication of that application unless requested or authorized by the applicant
Translation: 除本款(b)项另有规定外，在该申请进行国际公布之前，国际局和国际检索机构不得允许任何个人或机构查阅该国际申请，除非经申请人请求或授权。

Query_Text_en: bThe provisions of subparagraph ashall not apply to any transmittal to the competent International Searching Authority to transmittals provided for under Article 13 and to communications provided for under Article 20
Translation: 本款(a)项的规定不适用于向主管国际检索当局提交的任何传输、根据第十三条规定的传输以及根据第二十条规定的通信。

Query_Text_en: i date of the international publication of the international application ii date of the receipt of the communication of the international application under Article 20 iii date of the receipt of a copy of the international application under Article 22
Translation:
i 国际申请的国际公布日期  
ii 根据第二十条收到国际申请通知的日期  
iii 根据第二十二条收到国际申请副本的日期

Query_Text_en: bThe provisions of subparagraph ashall not prevent any national Office from informing third parties that it has been designated or from publishing that factSuch information or publication may however contain only the following data : identification of the receiving Office name of the applicant international filing date international application number and title of the invention
Translation: 根据子款(a)的规定不得妨碍任何国家局将本局已被指定的事实告知第三方或予以公开。但此类告知或公开仅可包含以下数据：受理局的标识、申请人的姓名、国际申请日、国际申请号以及发明名称。

Query_Text_en: cThe provisions of subparagraph ashall not prevent any designated Office from allowing access to the international application for the purposes of the judicial authorities
Translation: 本条第(a)项规定不得妨碍任何指定机构为司法机关之目的允许查阅国际申请。

Query_Text_en: 3The provisions of paragraph 2ashall apply to any receiving Office except as far as transmittals provided for under Article 121are concerned
Translation: 本款规定适用于任何接收局，但涉及根据第121条规定的转递事项的部分除外。

Query_Text_en: 4For the purposes of this Article the termaccesscovers any means by which third parties may acquire cognizance including individual communication and general publication provided however that no national Office shall generally publish an international application or its translation before the international publication or if international publication has not taken place by the expiration of 20 months from the priority date before the expiration of 20 months from the said priority date
Translation: 本条所述"公开"一词涵盖第三方可能获得知晓的任何方式，包括个别沟通或一般性公开。但需明确的是，任何国家局不得在国际公布前擅自公开国际申请或其译文，且若国际公布尚未在优先权日起20个月内完成，国家局亦不得在该优先权日起20个月届满前进行公开。

Query_Text_en: 1On the demand of the applicant his international application shall be the subject of an international preliminary examination as provided in the following provisions and the Regulations
Translation: 应申请人的请求，其国际申请应接受国际初步审查，具体依照本细则及《条例》的相关规定进行。

Query_Text_en: 2aAny applicant who is a resident or national as defined in the Regulations of a Contracting State bound by Chapterll and whose international application has been filed with the receiving Office of or acting for such State may make a demand for international preliminary examination
Translation: 根据《实施细则》定义，若某申请人属于受本章约束的缔约国的居民或国民，且其国际申请已向该国的受理局提交或由该局代理提交，则该申请人可提出国际初步审查请求。

Query_Text_en: bThe Assembly may decide to allow persons entitled to file international applications to make a demand for international preliminary examination even if they are residents or nationals of a State not party to this Treaty or not bound by Chapterll
Translation: 大会可决定允许有权提交国际申请的人员提出国际初步审查请求，即使他们是某一非本条约缔约国或不受本条约第二章约束的国家的居民或国民。

Query_Text_en: 3The demand for international preliminary examination shall be made separately from the international applicationThe demand shall contain the prescribed particulars and shall be in the prescribed language and form
Translation: 国际初步审查请求应单独提交，与国际申请分开。该请求应包含规定事项，并需使用规定语言及形式。

Query_Text_en: 4aThe demand shall indicate the Contracting State or States in which the applicant intends to use the results of the international preliminary examination elected StatesAdditional Contracting States may be elected laterElection may relate only to Contracting States already designated under Article 4
Translation: 申请中应指明申请人打算使用国际初步审查结果的缔约国或缔约国多方。之后可以选出其他缔约国。选定只能涉及根据第四条已指定的缔约国。

Query_Text_en: bApplicants referred to in paragraph 2amay elect any Contracting State bound by Chapter Applicants referred to in paragraph 2bmay elect only such Contracting States bound by Chapter as have declared that they are prepared to be elected by such applicants
Translation: 根据第二款(a)项所述的申请人，可选择任何受本章约束的缔约国，根据第二款(b)项所述的申请人，仅可选择该类申请人声明愿被其选定且受本章约束的缔约国。

Query_Text_en: 5The demand shall be subject to the payment of the prescribed fees within the prescribed time limit
Translation: 该请求须以在规定时限内支付应缴费用为前提。

Query_Text_en: 6aThe demand shall be submitted to the competent International Preliminary Examining Authority referred to in Article 32
Translation: 该请求应提交至第三十二条所指的有权国际初步审查局。

Query_Text_en: bAny later election shall be submitted to the International Bureau
Translation: 以后的任何选举均应提交至国际局。

Query_Text_en: 7Each elected Office shall be notified of its election
Translation: 每个当选的职位应被告知其当选结果。

Query_Text_en: 1International preliminary examination shall be carried out by the International Preliminary Examining Authority
Translation: 国际初步审查应由国际初步审查局进行。

Query_Text_en: 2In the case of demands referred to in Article 312a the receiving Office and in the case of demands referred to in Article 31 2b the Assembly shall in accordance with the applicable agreement between the interested International Preliminary Examining Authority or Authorities and the International Bureau specify the International Preliminary Examining Authority or Authorities competent for the preliminary examination
Translation: 根据第312a条所述请求，受理局以及根据第312b条所述请求，大会应根据相关国际初步审查单位或各单位与国际局之间达成的协议，指定负责进行初步审查的国际初步审查单位或各单位。

Query_Text_en: 3The provisions of Article 16 3shall apply mutatis mutandis in respect of International Preliminary Examining Authorities
Translation: 本条第16.3款的规定应相应调整后适用于国际初步审查单位。

Query_Text_en: 1The objective of the international preliminary examination is to formulate a preliminary and nonbinding opinion on the questions whether the claimed invention appears to be novel to involve an inventive step to be nonobvious and to be industrially applicable
Translation: 国际初步审查的目的是就所要求保护的发明是否具有新颖性、是否涉及创造性、是否属于非显而易见以及是否具备工业实用性等问题，形成初步且无约束力的意见。

Query_Text_en: 2For the purposes of the international preliminary examination a claimed invention shall be considered novel if it is not anticipated by the prior art as defined in the Regulations
Translation: 在国际初步审查程序中，若所要求保护的发明未被本细则定义的现有技术所公开，则该发明应被视为具有新颖性。

Query_Text_en: 3For the purposes of the international preliminary examination a claimed invention shall be considered to involve an inventive step if having regard to the prior art as defined in the Regulations it is not at the prescribed relevant date obvious to a person skilled in the art
Translation: 在国际初步审查中，一项所要求保护的发明若根据《实施细则》定义的现有技术，在规定的相关日期时，对于本领域技术人员而言并非显而易见的，则应被视为具有创造性步骤。

Query_Text_en: 4For the purposes of the international preliminary examination a claimed invention shall be considered industrially applicable if according to its nature it can be made or used in the technological sensein any kind of industryIndustry shall be understood in its broadest sense as in the Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property
Translation: 在国际初步审查中，所要求保护的发明应被视为具有工业应用性，如果根据其本质，其可在技术意义上在任何行业中被制造或使用。“行业”应按照《保护工业产权巴黎公约》中的最广义理解来解释。

Query_Text_en: 5The criteria described above merely serve the purposes of international preliminary examinationAny Contracting State may apply additional or different criteria for the purpose of deciding whether in that State the claimed invention is patentable or not
Translation: 上述标准仅用于国际初步审查的目的。任何缔约国均可采用额外或不同的标准来决定在该国所要求的发明是否具备专利性。

Query_Text_en: 6The international preliminary examination shall take into consideration all the documents cited in the international search reportIt may take into consideration any additional documents considered to be relevant in the particular case
Translation: 国际初步审查应考虑国际检索报告中所引用的所有文件。它还可考虑在特定情况下被认为相关的任何其他文件。

Query_Text_en: 1Procedure before the International Preliminary Examining Authority shall be governed by the provisions of this Treaty the Regulations and the agreement which the International Bureau shall conclude subject to this Treaty and the Regulations with the said Authority
Translation: 国际初步审查局的程序应受本条约、细则以及国际局与该机构在本条约和细则框架下达成的协议的约束。

Query_Text_en: 2aThe applicant shall have a right to communicate orally and in writing with the International Preliminary Examining Authority
Translation: 申请人有权以口头和书面方式与国际初步审查机构进行沟通。

Query_Text_en: bThe applicant shall have a right to amend the claims the description and the drawings in the prescribed manner and within the prescribed time limit before the international preliminary examination report is establishedThe amendment shall not go beyond the disclosure in the international application as filed
Translation: 申请人在国际初步审查报告作出前，有权以规定的方式在规定的期限内对权利要求书、说明书和附图进行修改。修改内容不得超出原始国际申请文件中所公开的范围。

Query_Text_en: ithe invention satisfies the criteria set forth in Article 33 1 iithe international application complies with the requirements of this Treaty and the Regulations in so far as checked by that Authority iiino observations are intended to be made under Article 35 2 last sentence
Translation: 该发明符合第三十三条第一款第二项所规定之标准；该国际申请在经该机构审查范围内符合本条约及实施细则的要求；无意见需根据第三十五条第二款最后一句提出。

Query_Text_en: dThe applicant may respond to the written opinion
Translation: 申请人可对书面意见提交答复。

Query_Text_en: 3aIf the International Preliminary Examining Authority considers that the international application does not comply with the requirement of unity of invention as set forth in the Regulations it may invite the applicant at his option to restrict the claims so as to comply with the requirement or to pay additional fees
Translation: 如果国际初步审查单位认为国际申请不符合规定所述的单一性要求，可通知申请人选择通过限制权利要求以满足该要求或支付附加费用。

Query_Text_en: bThe national law of any elected State may provide that where the applicant chooses to restrict the claims under subparagraph a those parts of the international application which as a consequence of the restriction are not to be the subject of international preliminary examination shall as far as effects in that State are concerned be considered withdrawn unless a special fee is paid by the applicant to the national Office of that State
Translation: 任何已选定国家的国内法律可规定，若申请人根据子款(a)选择限制权利要求，则因此导致在国际初步审查程序中不再作为审查对象的国际申请相关部分，就该国本国效力而言应被视为撤回，除非申请人向该国国家主管机关缴纳特殊费用。

Query_Text_en: cIf the applicant does not comply with the invitation referred to in subparagraph awithin the prescribed time limit the International Preliminary Examining Authority shall establish an international preliminary examination report on those parts of the international application which relate to what appears to be the main invention and shall indicate the relevant facts in the said reportThe national law of any elected State may provide that where its national Office finds the invitation of the International Preliminary Examining Authority justified those parts of the international application which do not relate to the main invention shall as far as effects in that State are concerned be considered withdrawn unless a special fee is paid by the applicant to that Office
Translation: 如果申请人未在规定期限内遵守第(a)项所述的邀请，则国际初步审查局应就国际申请中涉及看似主要发明的部分制定国际初步审查报告，并在所述报告中说明相关事实。任何选定国的国家法律可规定：若其国家机构认定国际初步审查局的邀请具有正当性，则对于与主要发明无关的国际申请部分，就其在该国产生的效力而言，应被视为撤回，除非申请人向该机构缴纳特殊费用。

Query_Text_en: ithat the international application relates to a subject matter on which the International Preliminary Examining Authority is not required under the Regulations to carry out an international preliminary examination and in the particular case decides not to carry out such examination oriithat the description the claims or the drawings , are so unclear or the claims are so inadequately supported by the description that no meaningful opinion can be formed on the novelty inventive step nonobvious ness or industrial applicability of the claimed invention the said Authority shall not go into the questions referred to in Article 33 1and shall inform the applicant of this opinion and the reasons therefor
Translation: 若国际申请涉及国际初步审查局根据规定无需进行国际初步审查的主题，并在这种情况下决定不开展此类审查；或若说明书、权利要求或图纸过于模糊不清，或权利要求未被说明书充分支持，导致无法对该发明所主张的新颖性、创造性、非显而易见性或工业实用性形成有意义的意见，则该局不得对第三十三条第一款所述的问题进行审议，并应将此意见及理由通知申请人。

Query_Text_en: Article 1Each Member for which this Convention is in force undertakes to pursue a national policy designed to ensure the effective abolition of child labor and to raise progressively the minimum age for admission to employment or work to a level consistent with the fullest physical and mental development of young persons .
Translation: 本公约对该国生效的每一缔约国承诺推行一项旨在确保有效废除童工劳动的国家政策，并逐步提高就业或工作的最低年龄，使其达到与青少年身心发展的最高水平相一致的水平。

Query_Text_en: subject to Articles 4 to 8 of this Convention , no one under that age shall be admitted to employment or work in any occupation .
Translation: 根据本公约第四条至第八条之规定，未满该年龄者不得在任何职业或工作中就业。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Member which has ratified this Convention may subsequently notify the Director-General of the International Labor Office , by further declarations , that it specifies a minimum age higher than that previously specified .
Translation: 每个批准本公约的会员国均可通过进一步声明，通知国际劳工局长，将其规定的最低年龄提高至高于此前所规定的年龄。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The minimum age specified in pursuance of paragraph 1 of this Article shall not be less than the age of completion of compulsory schooling and , in any case , shall not be less than 15 years .
Translation: 根据本条第一款规定确定的最低年龄不得低于完成义务教育的年龄，且无论如何不得低于15周岁。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 3 of this Article , a Member whose economy and educational facilities are insufficiently developed may , after consultation with the organizations of employers and workers concerned , where such exist , initially specify a minimum age of 14 years .
Translation: 本条规定第三款另有规定外，经济和教育设施发展水平较低的成员国，在与相关雇主和工人组织协商（如存在此类组织）后，可规定最低年龄为14岁。

Query_Text_en: or [ b ] that it renounces its right to avail itself of the provisions in question as from a stated date .
Translation: 或[b]声明自某一指定日期起放弃其援引相关条款的权利。

Query_Text_en: Article 31 . The minimum age for admission to any type of employment or work which by its nature or the circumstances in which it is carried out is likely to jeopardise the health , safety or morals of young persons shall not be less than 18 years .
Translation: 第31条 任何因其性质或工作环境可能危害未成年人健康、安全或道德之工作的最低准入年龄，不得低于十八岁。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The types of employment or work to which paragraph 1 of this Article applies shall be determined by national laws or regulations or by the competent authority , after consultation with the organizations of employers and workers concerned , where such exist .
Translation: 本条第一款适用的就业或工作类型，应由国家法律、法规或主管部门确定，其中在存在相关雇主和工人组织的情况下，需与其协商。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article , national laws or regulations or the competent authority may , after consultation with the organizations of employers and workers concerned , where such exist , authorise employment or work as from the age of 16 years on condition that the health , safety and morals of the young persons concerned are fully protected and that the young persons have received adequate specific instruction or vocational training in the relevant branch of activity .
Translation: 根据本条第一款规定，国家法律或法规或主管部门可在与相关雇主和工人组织协商后（如存在此类组织），授权自十六岁起就业或工作，条件是充分保障相关人员的健康、安全和道德，并确保相关人员已接受相关职业领域充分的职业指导或职业培训。

Query_Text_en: Article 41 . In so far as necessary , the competent authority , after consultation with the organizations of employers and workers concerned , where such exist , may exclude from the application of this Convention limited categories of employment or work in respect of which special and substantial problems of application arise .
Translation: 第四十一条 在必要范围内，主管当局在与相关雇主和工人组织协商后（如存在此类组织），可将本公约在某些特殊且重大问题上难以适用的有限类别职业或工作排除在适用范围之外。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Member which ratifies this Convention shall list in its first report on the application of the Convention submitted under article 22 of the Constitution of the International Labor Organisation any categories which may have been excluded in pursuance of paragraph 1 of this Article , giving the reasons for such exclusion , and shall state in subsequent reports the position of its law and practice in respect of the categories excluded and the extent to which effect has been given or is proposed to be given to the Convention in respect of such categories .
Translation: 每个批准本公约的会员国应在根据国际劳工组织章程第二十二条提交的关于公约实施情况的首次报告中，列出依据本条第一款可能予以排除的各类别，并说明排除理由；并在后续报告中说明对所排除各类别的法律和实践现状，以及已采取或拟采取的实施本公约的具体范围。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Employment or work covered by Article 3 of this Convention shall not be excluded from the application of the Convention in pursuance of this Article .
Translation: 本公约第三条所涵盖的就业或工作，不得因此而排除在本公约的适用范围之外。

Query_Text_en: Article 51 . A Member whose economy and administrative facilities are insufficiently developed may , after consultation with the organizations of employers and workers concerned , where such exist , initially limit the scope of application of this Convention .
Translation: 第五十一条 经济和行政设施欠发达的会员国，可经与相关雇主和工人组织协商（如其存在），最初限制本公约的适用范围。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Each Member which avails itself of the provisions of paragraph 1 of this Article shall specify , in a declaration appended to its ratification , the branches of economic activity or types of undertakings to which it will apply the provisions of the Convention .
Translation: 根据本条第一款规定予以适用的每一缔约方，应在其批准书所附声明中具体说明其将适用本公约规定的经济活动领域或企业类型。

Query_Text_en: and plantations and other agricultural undertakings mainly producing for commercial purposes , but excluding family and small-scale holdings producing for local consumption and not regularly employing hired workers .
Translation: 指以商业目的为主要生产方向的种植园及其他农业项目，但不包括那些为本地消费而生产、且不经常雇佣雇工的家庭经营性或小规模农场。

Query_Text_en: [ b ] may at any time formally extend the scope of application by a declaration addressed to the Director-General of the International Labor Office .
Translation: [ b ]可随时通过向国际劳工局局长提交声明的方式，正式扩大适用范围。

Query_Text_en: or [ c ] a program of guidance or orientation designed to facilitate the choice of an occupation or of a line of training .
Translation: 旨在帮助选择职业或培训方向的职业指导或定向计划。

Query_Text_en: and [ b ] not such as to prejudice their attendance at school , their participation in vocational orientation or training programs approved by the competent authority or their capacity to benefit from the instruction received .
Translation: 不得损害其就学、参与经主管部门批准的职业指导或培训项目，或影响其从所接受的教育中获益。

Query_Text_en: 2 . National laws or regulations may also permit the employment or work of persons who are at least 15 years of age but have not yet completed their compulsory schooling on work which meets the requirements set forth in sub-paragraphs [ a ] and [ b ] of paragraph 1 of this Article .
Translation: 国家法律或法规也可能允许雇佣或安排年满15周岁但尚未完成义务教育的人员，从事符合本条第1款[a]和[b]项规定要求的工作。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The competent authority shall determine the activities in which employment or work may be permitted under paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article and shall prescribe the number of hours during which and the conditions in which such employment or work may be undertaken .
Translation: 主管部门应确定本条第一款和第二款规定允许进行的就业或工作类型，并规定此类就业或工作的具体工作时间及条件。

Query_Text_en: 4 . Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article , a Member which has availed itself of the provisions of paragraph 4 of Article 2 may , for as long as it continues to do so , substitute the ages 12 and 14 for the ages 13 and 15 in paragraph 1 and the age 14 for the age 15 in paragraph 2 of this Article .
Translation: 根据本条第1款和第2款的规定，凡援引本协定第2条第4款规定的成员方，在其继续适用该条款期间，可将本条第1款中的13岁和15岁分别替换为12岁和14岁，并将本条第2款中的15岁替换为14岁。

Query_Text_en: Article 81 . After consultation with the organizations of employers and workers concerned , where such exist , the competent authority may , by permits granted in individual cases , allow exceptions to the prohibition of employment or work provided for in Article 2 of this Convention , for such purposes as participation in artistic performances .
Translation: 第八十一条 经与存在时的相关雇主和工人组织协商，主管当局可个别颁发许可证，允许例外情形，准许从事本公约第二条所规定的禁止雇佣或工作活动，例如参加艺术表演等。

Query_Text_en: 2 . Permits so granted shall limit the number of hours during which and prescribe the conditions in which employment or work is allowed .
Translation: 所颁发的许可应规定允许工作或就业的时间长度，并明确相关条件。

Query_Text_en: Article 9 1 . All necessary measures , including the provision of appropriate penalties , shall be taken by the competent authority to ensure the effective enforcement of the provisions of this Convention .
Translation: 第九条第一款 主管机关应采取一切必要措施，包括规定适当的处罚措施，以确保本公约条款的有效执行。

Query_Text_en: 2 . National laws or regulations or the competent authority shall define the persons responsible for compliance with the provisions giving effect to the Convention .
Translation: 国家法律法规或主管部门应规定负责公约规定的条款遵守的责任主体。

Query_Text_en: such registers or documents shall contain the names and ages or dates of birth , duly certified wherever possible , of persons whom he employs or who work for him and who are less than 18 years of age .
Translation: 此类登记册或文件应载明其雇佣或为其工作的人员中年龄未满18周岁的人员的姓名、年龄或出生日期，并尽可能提供经正式认证的证明。

Query_Text_en: Article 101 . This Convention revises , on the terms set forth in this Article , the Minimum Age [ Industry ] Convention , 1919 , the Minimum Age [ Sea ] Convention , 1920 , the Minimum Age [ Agriculture ] Convention , 1921 , the Minimum Age [ Trimmers and Stokers ] Convention , 1921 , the Minimum Age [ Non-Industrial Employment ] Convention , 1932 , the Minimum Age [ Sea ] Convention [ Revised ] , 1936 , the Minimum Age [ Industry ] Convention [ Revised ] , 1937 , the Minimum Age [ Non-Industrial Employment ] Convention [ Revised ] , 1937 , the Minimum Age [ Fishermen ] Convention , 1959 , and the Minimum Age [ Underground Work ] Convention , 1965 .
Translation: 第101条 本公约根据本条的规定，修订1919年《最低年龄（工业）公约》、1920年《最低年龄（海员）公约》、1921年《最低年龄（农业）公约》、1921年《最低年龄（清炉工和司炉工）公约》、1932年《最低年龄（非工业就业）公约》、1936年《最低年龄（海员）修订公约》、1937年《最低年龄（工业）修订公约》、1937年《最低年龄（非工业就业）修订公约》、1959年《最低年龄（渔民）公约》及1965年《最低年龄（地下作业）公约》。

Query_Text_en: 2 . The coming into force of this Convention shall not close the Minimum Age [ Sea ] Convention [ Revised ] , 1936 , the Minimum Age [ Industry ] Convention [ Revised ] , 1937 , the Minimum Age [ Non-Industrial Employment ] Convention [ Revised ] , 1937 , the Minimum Age [ Fishermen ] Convention , 1959 , or the Minimum Age [ Underground Work ] Convention , 1965 , to further ratification .
Translation: 本公约的生效不应阻止《1936年最低工作年龄（海事）公约》（修订）、《1937年最低工作年龄（工业）公约》（修订）、《1937年最低工作年龄（非工业就业）公约》（修订）、《1959年最低工作年龄（渔业）公约》以及《1965年最低工作年龄（地下作业）公约》接受进一步批准。

Query_Text_en: 3 . The Minimum Age [ Industry ] Convention , 1919 , the Minimum Age [ Sea ] Convention , 1920 , the Minimum Age [ Agriculture ] Convention , 1921 , and the Minimum Age [ Trimmers and Stokers ] Convention , 1921 , shall be closed to further ratification when all the parties thereto have consented to such closing by ratification of this Convention or by a declaration communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office .
Translation: 当所有缔约方通过批准本公约或向国际劳工局主任干事提交声明的方式同意关闭时，《1919年最低就业年龄公约》《1920年最低年龄（海事）公约》《1921年最低年龄（农业）公约》及《1921年最低年龄（司炉工和烧火工）公约》将停止接受进一步批准。

Query_Text_en: 4 . When the obligations of this Convention are accepted -- [ a ] by a Member which is a party to the Minimum Age [ Industry ] Convention [ Revised ] , 1937 , and a minimum age of not less than 15 years is specified in pursuance of Article 2 of this Convention , this shall ipso jure involve the immediate denunciation of that Convention , [ b ] in respect of non-industrial employment as defined in the Minimum Age [ Non-Industrial Employment ] Convention , 1932 , by a Member which is a party to that Convention , this shall ipso jure involve the immediate denunciation of that Convention , [ c ] in respect of non-industrial employment as defined in the Minimum Age [ Non-Industrial Employment ] Convention [ Revised ] , 1937 , by a Member which is a party to that Convention , and a minimum age of not less than 15 years is specified in pursuance of Article 2 of this Convention , this shall ipso jure involve the immediate denunciation of that Convention , [ d ] in respect of maritime employment , by a Member which is a party to the Minimum Age [ Sea ] Convention [ Revised ] , 1936 , and a minimum age of not less than 15 years is specified in pursuance of Article 2 of this Convention or the Member specifies that Article 3 of this Convention applies to maritime employment , this shall ipso jure involve the immediate denunciation of that Convention , [ e ] in respect of employment in maritime fishing , by a Member which is a party to the Minimum Age [ Fishermen ] Convention , 1959 , and a minimum age of not less than 15 years is specified in pursuance of Article 2 of this Convention or the Member specifies that Article 3 of this Convention applies to employment in maritime fishing , this shall ipso jure involve the immediate denunciation of that Convention , [ f ] by a Member which is a party to the Minimum Age [ Underground Work ] Convention , 1965 , and a minimum age of not less than the age specified in pursuance of that Convention is specified in pursuance of Article 2 of this Convention or the Member specifies that such an age applies to employment underground in mines in virtue of Article 3 of this Convention , this shall ipso jure involve the immediate denunciation of that Convention , if and when this Convention shall have come into force .
Translation: 当本公约的义务由以下缔约国接受后：  [a] 对于同时是1937年《最低年龄（工业）公约（修订）》缔约国的成员国，并根据本公约第2条将最低年龄规定为不低于15岁时，这应自动生成立即废除该公约；  [b] 对于同时是1932年《最低年龄（非工业就业）公约》缔约国的成员国，就非工业就业（按该公约定义的范畴），这应自动生成立即废除该公约；  [c] 对于同时是1937年《最低年龄（非工业就业）公约（修订）》缔约国的成员国，并根据本公约第2条将最低年龄规定为不低于15岁时，这应自动生成立即废除该公约；  [d] 对于同时是1936年《最低年龄（海员）公约（修订）》缔约国的成员国，就海事就业而言，若根据本公约第2条规定最低年龄不低于15岁，或该成员国指定本公约第3条适用于海事就业，那么这应自动生成立即废除该公约；  [e] 对于同时是1959年《最低年龄（渔民）公约》缔约国的成员国，就海上渔业就业而言，若根据本公约第2条规定最低年龄不低于15岁，或该成员国指定本公约第3条适用于海上渔业就业，那么这应自动生成立即废除该公约；  [f] 对于同时是1965年《最低年龄（地下工作）公约》缔约国的成员国，并根据本公约第2条将最低年龄规定为不低于该公约所规定的年龄时，或该成员国指定上述年龄适用于矿山地下工作，根据本公约第3条，这应自动生成立即废除该公约，但前提是本公约已正式生效。

Query_Text_en: 5 . Acceptance of the obligations of this Convention -- [ a ] shall involve the denunciation of the Minimum Age [ Industry ] Convention , 1919 , in accordance with Article 12 thereof , [ b ] in respect of agriculture shall involve the denunciation of the Minimum Age [ Agriculture ] Convention , 1921 , in accordance with Article 9 thereof , [ c ] in respect of maritime employment shall involve the denunciation of the Minimum Age [ Sea ] Convention , 1920 , in accordance with Article 10 thereof , and of the Minimum Age [ Trimmers and Stokers ] Convention , 1921 , in accordance with Article 12 thereof , if and when this Convention shall have come into force .
Translation: 第五项，接受本公约的义务——[a]应根据该公约第12条废除1919年《最低年龄公约（工业）》，[b]涉及农业时应根据相关公约第9条废除1921年《最低年龄公约（农业）》，[c]涉及海事就业时应根据相关公约第10条废除1920年《最低年龄公约（海事）》，并根据相关公约第12条废除1921年《最低年龄公约（司炉工与铲煤工）》，若且仅当本公约生效时。

Query_Text_en: Article 11The formal ratifications of this Convention shall be communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office for registration .
Translation: 本公约的正式批准书应送交国际劳工局局长登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 121 . This Convention shall be binding only upon those Members of the International Labor Organisation whose ratifications have been registered with the Director-General .
Translation: 第121条 本公约仅对国际劳工组织中已向总干事登记批准书的会员国具有约束力。

Query_Text_en: 3 . Thereafter , this Convention shall come into force for any Member twelve months after the date on which its ratifications has been registered .
Translation: 此后，本公约应于任何缔约方的批准书登记之日起满十二个月后对该缔约方生效。

Query_Text_en: Article 131 . A Member which has ratified this Convention may denounce it after the expiration of ten years from the date on which the Convention first comes into force , by an act communicated to the Director-General of the International Labor Office for registration .
Translation: 第131条。批准本公约的会员国可在公约生效之日起满十年后，通过向国际劳工局局长提交退出通知的方式退出本公约，并由局长登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 141 . The Director-General of the International Labor Office shall notify all Members of the International Labor Organisation of the registration of all ratifications and denunciations communicated to him by the Members of the Organisation .
Translation: 国际劳工局局长应将各会员国向国际劳工组织通报的批准和退出情况，通知所有国际劳工组织会员国。

Query_Text_en: Article 15The Director-General of the International Labor Office shall communicate to the Secretary-General of the United Nations for registration in accordance with Article 102 of the Charter of the United Nations full particulars of all ratifications and acts of denunciation registered by him in accordance with the provisions of the preceding Articles .
Translation: 第十五条国际劳工局局长应根据前条规定，将其登记的所有批准书及废除行为的详细情况，按照《联合国宪章》第一百零二条之规定，提交联合国秘书长予以登记。

Query_Text_en: Article 16At such times as it may consider necessary the Governing Body of the International Labor Office shall present to the General Conference a report on the working of this Convention and shall examine the desirability of placing on the agenda of the Conference the question of its revision in whole or in part .
Translation: 第十六条 国际劳工局管理机构认为必要时，应向国际劳工大会提交本公约实施情况的报告，并审议是否将本公约全部或部分内容的修订问题列入大会议程。

Query_Text_en: a ] the ratification by a Member of the new revising Convention shall ipso jure involve the immediate denunciation of this Convention , notwithstanding the provisions of Article 13 above , if and when the new revising Convention shall have come into force ;
Translation: 某一成员国对新修订公约的批准应依法自动导致立即废止本公约，尽管上文第13条另有规定，当修订后的公约生效时。

Query_Text_en: b ] as from the date when the new revising Convention comes into force this Convention shall cease to be open to ratification by the Members .
Translation: b ] 自新修订公约生效之日起，本公约将不再对会员国开放供其批准。

Query_Text_en: Article 18 The English and French versions of the text of this Convention are equally authoritative .
Translation: 第十八条 本公约文本的英文和法文版本具有同等效力。
